10.1001/jamahealthforum.2021.0290.abstractZh: 本文讨论了那些样本暴露于研究人员无法控制的环境中的实验，这些实验有助于对暴露与结果之间的潜在因果关系做出合理的结论。

abstract.text: Importance: Substantial patient racial and ethnic differences in opioid prescribing have been documented, but how much of these differences were attributable to physicians prescribing opioids differently to patients of racial and ethnic minority groups is unknown, particularly during the first wave of the opioid epidemic when the dangers of opioid prescribing and use were not as well known. Objective: To examine associations of patient race and ethnicity with differences in opioid prescribing by the same primary care physician (PCP) for new low back pain episodes among older adults from 2007 to 2014. Design Setting and Participants: This cross-sectional study used Medicare data of PCP office visits by Medicare beneficiaries who were 66 years or older with new low back pain. Main Outcomes and Measures: Prescribing of any opioid in the first year of a new low back pain episode (days 1-365) and subsequent long-term use of an opioid (prescribed for ≥180 days in days 366-730). Results: Among the study population of 274 771 patients (mean [SD] age, 77.1 [7.2] years; 192 105 [69.9%] women) with new low back pain, 15 285 (6%) were Asian or Pacific Islander, 16 079 (6%) were Black, 21 289 (8%) were Hispanic, and 222 118 (81%) were White, cared for by 63 494 physicians. In adjusted analysis, on average, 11.5% of the White patients (95% CI, 11.4 to 11.6) received an opioid prescription in the first year of new low back pain. The same prescribing physician was 1.5 percentage points (PP; 95% CI, -2.2 PP to -0.8 PP) less likely to prescribe an opioid if the patient was Black, 2.7 PP (95% CI, -3.5 PP to -1.8 PP) less likely if the patient was Asian or Pacific Islander, and 1.0 PP (95% CI, -1.7 PP to -0.3 PP) less likely if the patient was Hispanic. The same physician was more likely to prescribe a prescription nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug to a patient of a racial or ethnic minority group. White patients with new low back pain were more likely to develop subsequent long-term opioid use than patients of racial and ethnic minority groups (eg, 1.8% for White patients vs 0.5% for Hispanic patients). Conclusions and Relevance: This cross-sectional study found that from 2007 to 2014, primary care physicians prescribed opioids for new low back pain more often to White patients than to patients of racial and ethnic minority groups. These results suggest that there may have been unequal treatment of pain by physicians when less was known about the morbidity associated with opioid use.

10.1001/jamahealthforum.2021.2333.abstractZh:
重要性：已有大量研究记录了患者在阿片类药物处方上的种族和族裔差异，但这些差异中有多少是由于医生对少数族裔患者使用阿片类药物的方式不同造成的，目前尚不清楚，尤其是在阿片类药物流行病的第一波期间，人们对阿片类药物的处方和使用风险并不十分了解。  
目的：研究患者种族和族裔与同一初级保健医生在2007年至2014年间对老年人群体新发腰痛患者阿片类药物处方差异之间的关联。  
设计、背景与参与者：本横断面研究使用了Medicare数据，记录了66岁或以上的Medicare受益人因新发腰痛而就诊于初级保健医生的记录。  
主要结果与测量指标：在新发腰痛发作的第一年内（第1天至第365天），是否使用了任何阿片类药物，以及此后长期使用阿片类药物的情况（在第366天至第730天内，处方使用时间超过180天）。  
结果：在274771名新发腰痛患者中，有15,285名（6%）为亚裔或太平洋岛民，16,079名（6%）为黑人，21,289名（8%）为西班牙裔，222,118名（81%）为白人，由63,494名医生负责治疗。经过调整分析后，平均有11.5%的白人在新发腰痛发作的第一年内接受了阿片类药物处方。如果患者是黑人，同一位医生开具阿片类药物的意愿会降低1.5个百分点；如果患者是亚裔或太平洋岛民，则降低2.7个百分点；如果患者是西班牙裔，则降低1.0个百分点。同一位医生更有可能为种族或族裔少数群体的患者开具非甾体抗炎药。新患下背痛的白人患者比种族和族裔少数群体的患者更有可能出现长期使用阿片类药物的情况（白人患者为1.8%，西班牙裔患者为0.5%）。结论与意义：这项横断面研究发现，从2007年到2014年，初级保健医生在为新患下背痛的白人患者开具阿片类药物时，比为种族和族裔少数群体的患者更频繁。这些结果表明，在人们对阿片类药物相关疾病的了解较少时，医生在疼痛治疗方面可能存在不平等待遇。

abstract.text: Importance Medicare’s Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS), a public reporting and pay-for-performance program, adjusts clinician payments based on publicly reported measures that are chosen primarily by clinicians or their practices. However, measure selection raises concerns that practices could earn bonuses or avoid penalties by selecting measures on which they already perform well, rather than by improving care—a form of gaming. This has prompted calls for mandatory reporting on a smaller set of measures including patient experiences. Objective To examine (1) practices’ selection of Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) patient experience measures for quality scoring under the pay-for-performance program and (2) the association between mandated public reporting on CAHPS measures and performance on those measures within precursor programs of the MIPS. Design, Setting, and Participants This cross-sectional study included 2 analyses. The first analysis examined the association between the baseline CAHPS scores of large practices (≥100 clinicians) and practices’ selection of these measures for quality scoring under a pay-for-performance program up to 2 years later. The second analysis examined changes in patient experiences associated with a requirement that large practices publicly report CAHPS measures starting in 2014. A difference-in-differences analysis of 2012 to 2017 fee-for-service Medicare CAHPS data was conducted to compare changes in patient experiences between large practices (111-150 clinicians) that became subject to this reporting mandate and smaller unaffected practices (50-89 clinicians). Analyses were conducted between October 1, 2020, and July 30, 2021. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcomes of the 2 analyses were (1) the association of baseline CAHPS scores of large practices with those practices’ selection of those measures for quality scoring under a pay-for-performance program; and (2) changes in patient experiences associated with a requirement that large practices publicly report CAHPS measures starting in 2014. Results Among 301 large practices that publicly reported patient experience measures, the mean (IQR) age of patients at baseline was 71.6 (70.4-73.2 ) years, and 55.8% of patients were women (IQR, 54.3%-57.7%). Large practices in the top vs bottom quintile of patient experience scores at baseline were more likely to voluntarily include these scores in the pay-for-performance program 2 years later (96.3% vs 67.9%), a difference of 28.4 percentage points (95% CI, 9.4-47.5 percentage points;P = .004). After 2 to 3 years of the reporting mandate, patient experiences did not differentially improve in affected vs unaffected practices (difference-in-differences estimate: −0.03 practice-level standard deviations of the composite score; 95% CI, −0.64 to 0.58;P = .92). Conclusions and Relevance In this cross-sectional study of US physician practices that participated in precursors of the MIPS, large practices were found to select measures on which they were already performing well for a pay-for-performance program, consistent with gaming. However, mandating public reporting was not associated with improved patient experiences. These findings support recommendations to end optional measures in the MIPS but also suggest that public reporting on mandated measures may not improve care.

10.1001/jamahealthforum.2021.3105.abstractZh:
医疗保险的基于绩效的激励支付系统（MIPS）是一项公开报告和绩效付费计划，其支付方式依据由临床医生或其诊所选定的公开报告指标来调整。然而，指标选择引发了一个问题：诊所可能会通过选择自己已经表现良好的指标来获得奖励或避免处罚，而非通过改善医疗服务来提升绩效——这是一种形式的“游戏”。这促使人们呼吁强制报告包括患者体验在内的较少数量的指标。研究目的为：(1) 考察在绩效付费计划下，大型诊所（拥有≥100名临床医生）如何选择Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems（CAHPS）患者体验指标用于质量评分；(2) 强制公开报告CAHPS指标与MIPS前身计划中的绩效表现之间的关联。研究设计、背景与参与者：本横断面研究包含两项分析。第一项分析探讨了大型诊所（拥有≥100名临床医生）的基线CAHPS评分与这些指标在绩效付费计划下的选择之间的关联，时间跨度可达2年。第二项分析则考察了自2014年起要求大型诊所公开报告CAHPS指标后，患者体验的变化情况。通过对2012年至2017年Medicare CAHPS数据的差异分析，比较了受此报告要求影响的大型诊所（拥有111-150名临床医生）与未受影响的较小规模诊所（拥有50-89名临床医生）之间的患者体验变化。所有分析均于2020年10月1日至2021年7月30日期间进行。主要研究结果与指标  
两项分析的主要结果包括：(1)大型医疗机构在绩效付费计划下，其基线CAHPS评分与其选择用于质量评分的指标之间的关联；(2)自2014年起，要求大型医疗机构公开报告CAHPS指标后，患者体验发生的变化。  

结果  
在301家公开报告患者体验指标的大型医疗机构中，基线的患者平均年龄为71.6岁（范围：70.4-73.2岁），55.8%的患者为女性（范围：54.3%-57.7%）。在基线时患者体验评分处于最高与最低五分位数的医疗机构中，两年后更有可能自愿将这些指标纳入绩效付费计划（分别为96.3%和67.9%），差异为28.4个百分点（95%置信区间：9.4-47.5个百分点；P = .004）。在强制报告两年到三年后，受影响与未受影响的医疗机构在患者体验方面并没有显著差异（差异估计：复合评分的标准差变化为−0.03；95%置信区间：−0.64至0.58；P = .92）。  

结论与意义  
在这项针对参与MIPS前期的美国医疗机构的横向研究中，发现大型医疗机构倾向于选择那些它们已经表现良好的指标来参与绩效付费计划，这与“游戏化”行为一致。然而，强制公开报告并未带来患者体验的改善。这些发现支持终止MIPS中可选指标的推荐，但也表明强制公开报告某些指标可能无法提升医疗服务质量。

abstract.text: Importance: Although there have been signs of increasing interest in entrepreneurship among physicians as well as claims of a paucity of entrepreneurial activity in health care in general, there is little systematic evidence of the extent, type, and characteristics of entrepreneurship by physicians. Physician involvement in entrepreneurship may result in more innovative and financially successful health care companies. Objective: To evaluate the proportion and characteristics of physicians who founded new businesses and the types of businesses that they started. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cross-sectional study was conducted by matching all 33 770 physicians holding a Massachusetts medical license in 2017 with the Massachusetts new business registration records from 1960 to 2017 to identify companies founded by physicians. Data were analyzed from September 2017 to December 2019. Main Outcomes and Measures: The number of physician-founded companies in Massachusetts and the types of businesses as characterized by the stated purpose at the time of founding. Results: Among the 33 770 physicians holding a Massachusetts license in 2017, 13 839 (41.0%) were women and 8029 (23.8%) were international medical graduates; the median year of graduation from medical school was 1994 (interquartile range, 1983-2004). A total of 6494 (19.2%) physicians had founded at least 1 new business, and 831 of the 2448 physicians (33.9%) who graduated from medical school between 1974 and 1978 had founded a business. A total of 9501 companies were founded, of which 6267 (66.0%) were clinical practice, real estate, or practice management companies; 703 companies (7.4%) were in the public interest, including advocacy, public health, and philanthropy; 533 (5.6%) were biotechnology, health care information technology, or medical device companies; and 1759 (18.5%) were other business pursuits. For physician entrepreneurs, the mean (SD) time from medical school graduation to company founding was 20.2 (9.8) years. Regression analysis suggested that female physicians founded companies at lower rates than male physicians (odds ratio [OR], 0.529; 95% CI, 0.494-0.567) and that there was an association between attending a top-10 medical school by National Institutes of Health research funding and starting a clinical practice (OR, 0.687; 95% CI, 0.616-0.766) or biotechnology company (OR, 4.326; 95% CI, 2.951-6.344). Conclusions and Relevance: The findings of this cross-sectional study suggest that physicians may be substantially involved in entrepreneurship, although there may be disparities by sex. Facilitation of physician entrepreneurship by policy makers, educators, and institutions may enhance medical innovation and public health.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2020.26938.abstractZh: 重要性：尽管有迹象表明医生对创业的兴趣日益增加，也有说法称医疗保健领域的创业活动普遍不足，但关于医生创业的规模、类型和特征的系统性证据却很少。医生参与创业可能会带来更具创新性和财务上更成功的医疗保健公司。目的：评估创办新企业的医生所占比例及其特征，以及他们创办的企业类型。设计、实施与参与者：这项横断面研究通过将2017年持有马萨诸塞州医疗执照的33,770名医生与1960至2017年的马萨诸塞州新企业注册记录进行匹配，以识别由医生创办的企业。数据收集时间为2017年9月至2019年12月。主要结果与测量指标：马萨诸塞州由医生创办的企业数量，以及根据创办时的目的所分类的企业类型。结果：在2017年持有马萨诸塞州执照的33,770名医生中，13,839名（41.0%）为女性，8,029名（23.8%）为国际医学毕业生；医学院毕业的中位年份为1994年（四分位范围：1983-2004年）。共有6,494名（19.2%）医生至少创办了1家企业，而在1974至1978年间毕业的2,448名医生中，有831名（33.9%）创办了企业。共有9501家公司成立，其中6267家（占66.0%）属于临床实践、房地产或实践管理公司；703家公司（占7.4%）从事公益事业，包括倡导、公共卫生和慈善活动；533家（占5.6%）属于生物技术、医疗保健信息技术或医疗器械公司；另有1759家（占18.5%）从事其他商业活动。对于医生创业者而言，从医学院毕业到公司成立的平均时间为20.2年（标准差9.8年）。回归分析表明，女性医生创办公司的比例低于男性医生（比值比[OR]为0.529，95%置信区间[CI]为0.494-0.567），并且国立卫生研究院研究经费排名前十的医学院毕业与创办临床实践公司（OR为0.687，95%置信区间[CI]为0.616-0.766）或生物技术公司（OR为4.326，95%置信区间[CI]为2.951-6.344）之间存在关联。结论与意义：这项横断面研究的结果表明，医生可能积极参与创业活动，尽管性别差异可能存在。政策制定者、教育工作者和机构对医生创业活动的支持可能会促进医学创新和公共卫生发展。

abstract.text: Importance: Despite billions spent in public investment, electronic health records (EHRs) have not delivered on the promise of large quality and safety improvement. Simultaneously, there is debate on whether public quality reporting is a useful tool to incentivize quality improvement. Objective: To evaluate whether publicly reported feedback was associated with hospital improvement in an evaluation of medication-related clinical decision support (CDS) safety performance. Design, Settings, and Participants: This nonrandomized controlled trial included US hospitals that participated in the Computerized Provider Order Entry (CPOE) Evaluation Tool in the Leapfrog Hospital Survey, a national quality reporting program that evaluates safety performance of hospital CDS using simulated orders and patients, in 2017 to 2018. A sharp regression discontinuity design was used to identify the association of receiving negative feedback with hospital performance improvement in the subsequent year. Data were analyzed from January through September 2020. Exposures: Publicly reported quality feedback. Main Outcomes and Measures: The main outcome was improvement from 2017 to 2018 on the Leapfrog CPOE Evaluation Tool, using regression discontinuity model estimates of the association of receiving negative publicly reported feedback with quality improvement. Results: A total of 1183 hospitals were included, with a mean (SD) CPOE score of 59.3% (16.3%) at baseline. Hospitals receiving negative feedback improved 8.44 (95% CI, 0.09 to 16.80) percentage points more in the subsequent year compared with hospitals that received positive feedback on the same evaluation. This change was driven by differences in improvement in basic CDS capabilities (β = 8.71 [95%CI, 1.67 to 18.73]) rather than advanced CDS (β = 6.15 [95% CI, -9.11 to 26.83]). Conclusions and Relevance: In this nonrandomized controlled trial, publicly reported feedback was associated with quality improvement, suggesting targeted measurement and reporting of process quality may be an effective policy lever to encourage improvement in specific areas. Clinical decision support represents an important tool in ensuring patient safety and decreasing adverse drug events, especially for complex patients and those with multiple chronic conditions who often receive several different drugs during an episode of care.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2021.25173.abstractZh:
重要性：尽管在公共投资上投入了数十亿美元，电子健康记录并未实现预期的大规模质量和安全提升。同时，关于公共质量报告是否是激励质量改进的有效工具也存在争议。  
目的：评估公开报告的反饋是否与医院在药物相关临床决策支持安全性能方面的改进有关。  
设计、实施对象：本研究为一项非随机对照试验，纳入了2017至2018年间参与Leapfrog医院调查的美国医院。该调查是一个全国性的质量报告项目，通过模拟订单和患者来评估医院临床决策支持的安全性能。采用回归不连续设计来识别收到负面反馈与次年医院绩效改进之间的关联。数据收集时间为2020年1月至9月。  
暴露因素：公开报告的质量反馈。  
主要结果与测量指标：主要结果是2017至2018年间Leapfrog CPOE评估工具的改进情况。通过回归不连续模型估计，收到负面公开报告反馈与质量改进之间的关联。  
结果：共有1183家医院参与了研究，基线时CPOE得分平均为59.3%（标准差为16.3%）。收到负面反馈的医院在次年比收到正面反馈的医院提高了8.44个百分点（95%置信区间：0.09至16.80）。这一变化主要源于基础临床决策支持能力的提升（β=8.71，95%置信区间：1.67至18.73），而非高级临床决策支持能力的提升（β=6.15，95%置信区间：-9.11至26.83）。结论与意义：在这项非随机对照试验中，公开报告的反馈与质量提升相关，这表明有针对性地测量和报告过程质量可能是鼓励特定领域改进的有效政策手段。临床决策支持是确保患者安全并减少不良药物事件的重要工具，尤其适用于复杂患者以及那些在护理期间经常接受多种不同药物治疗的患有多种慢性疾病的患者。

abstract.text: We investigate the returns to college attendance in Canada in terms of health and mortality reduction. To do so, we first use a dynamic health microsimulation model to document how interventions that incentivize college attendance among high school graduates may impact their health trajectory, health care consumption, and life expectancy. We find large returns both in terms of evity (4.1 years additional years at age 51), reduction in the prevalence of various health conditions (10-15 percentage points reduction in diabetes and 5 percentage points for stroke), and health care consumption (27.3% reduction in lifetime hospital stays, 19.7 for specialists). We find that education impacts mortality mostly by delaying the incidence of health conditions as well as providing a survival advantage conditional on having diseases. Second, we provide quasi-experimental evidence on the impact of college attendance on long-term health outcomes by exploiting the Canadian Veteran's Rehabilitation Act, a program targeted towards returning WW-II veterans and which incentivized college attendance. The impact on mortality is found to be larger than those estimated from the health microsimulation model (hazard ratio of 0.216 compared with 0.6 in the simulation model), which suggests substantial returns to college education in terms of healthy life extension which we estimate to be approximately one million canadian dollars.

10.1002/hec.3975.abstractZh: 我们研究了在加拿大，大学教育对健康和死亡率降低的回报。为此，我们首先使用动态健康微观模拟模型来研究激励高中生接受大学教育的干预措施如何影响他们的健康轨迹、医疗保健消费和预期寿命。我们发现，这些干预措施带来了显著的回报：在51岁时，寿命增加了4.1年；各种健康状况的患病率也降低了10-15个百分点（糖尿病减少了5个百分点，中风减少了5个百分点）；医疗保健消费也减少了27.3%，专科医疗费用减少了19.7%。我们发现，教育主要通过延缓健康状况的发生以及在有疾病的情况下提供生存优势来影响死亡率。其次，我们通过利用加拿大退伍军人康复法案这一针对二战退伍军人的计划，提供了关于大学教育对长期健康结果影响的准实验证据。该计划激励了大学教育，其降低死亡率的效果比健康微观模拟模型估计的效果更为显著（模拟模型中的危险比为0.6，而该计划为0.216），这表明大学教育在延长健康寿命方面具有巨大的回报，我们估计这一回报约为100万加元。

abstract.text: The substantial social and economic burden attributable to smoking is well-known, with heavy smokers at higher risk of chronic disease and premature mortality than light smokers and nonsmokers. In aging societies with high rates of male smoking such as in East Asia, smoking is a leading preventable risk factor for extending lives (including work-lives) and healthy aging. However, little is known about whether smoking interventions targeted at heavy smokers relative to light smokers lead to disproportionately larger improvements in life expectancy and prevalence of chronic diseases and how the effects vary across populations. Using a microsimulation model, we examined the health effects of smoking reduction by simulating an elimination of smoking among subgroups of smokers in South Korea, Singapore, and the United States. We found that life expectancy would increase by 0.2 to 1.5 years among light smokers and 2.5 to 3.7 years among heavy smokers. Whereas both interventions led to an increased life expectancy and decreased the prevalence of chronic diseases in all three countries, the life-extension benefits were greatest for those who would otherwise have been heavy smokers. Our findings illustrate how smoking interventions may have significant economic and social benefits, especially for life extension, that vary across countries.

10.1002/hec.3978.abstractZh: 吸烟所带来的重大社会和经济负担是众所周知的，重度吸烟者比轻度吸烟者和非吸烟者更容易患上慢性疾病和早死。在东亚等男性吸烟率较高的老龄化社会中，吸烟是延长寿命（包括工作与生活）和促进健康老龄化的重要可预防风险因素。然而，关于针对重度吸烟者的戒烟干预措施是否能使预期寿命和慢性疾病的患病率得到更大程度的改善，以及这些效果在不同人群中如何变化，目前了解甚少。通过微观模拟模型，我们模拟了在韩国、新加坡和美国对特定吸烟群体实施戒烟措施后对健康的影响。研究发现，轻度吸烟者的预期寿命将增加0.2至1.5年，而重度吸烟者的预期寿命将增加2.5至3.7年。尽管这两种干预措施都增加了预期寿命并降低了慢性疾病的患病率，但预期寿命的延长效果在那些原本可能成为重度吸烟者的群体中最为显著。我们的研究结果表明，戒烟干预措施可能带来显著的经济和社会效益，尤其是在延长寿命方面，而这些效益在不同国家之间存在差异。

abstract.text: Accurate future projections of population health are imperative to plan for the future healthcare needs of a rapidly aging population. Multistate-transition microsimulation models, such as the U.S. Future Elderly Model, address this need but require high-quality panel data for calibration. We develop an alternative method that relaxes this data requirement, using repeated cross-sectional representative surveys to estimate multistate-transition contingency tables applied to Japan's population. We calculate the birth cohort sex-specific prevalence of comorbidities using five waves of the governmental health surveys. Combining estimated comorbidity prevalence with death record information, we determine the transition probabilities of health statuses. We then construct a virtual Japanese population aged 60 and older as of 2013 and perform a microsimulation to project disease distributions to 2046. Our estimates replicate governmental projections of population pyramids and match the actual prevalence trends of comorbidities and the disease incidence rates reported in epidemiological studies in the past decade. Our future projections of cardiovascular diseases indicate lower prevalence than expected from static models, reflecting recent declining trends in disease incidence and fatality.

10.1002/hec.3986.abstractZh: 准确预测人口健康状况对未来医疗保健需求的规划至关重要，尤其是针对快速老龄化的人口。多州过渡微观模拟模型，如美国的“未来老年模型”，能够解决这一需求，但需要高质量的时间序列数据进行校准。我们提出了一种替代方法，该方法无需依赖这些高质量数据，而是通过多次横断面代表性调查来估算多州过渡情况，并将其应用于日本人口。我们利用五次政府健康调查数据，计算出不同性别出生队列中的共病患病率。结合估算出的共病患病率与死亡记录信息，我们确定了健康状况的转移概率。随后，我们构建了截至2013年的虚拟日本60岁及以上人口，并对其进行微观模拟，以预测到2046年的疾病分布。我们的估算结果与政府的人口金字塔预测一致，且符合过去十年流行病学研究中报告的共病患病率及疾病发病率的实际趋势。我们对心血管疾病的未来预测显示，其患病率低于静态模型的预期，这反映了疾病发病率和死亡率的近期下降趋势。

abstract.text: This study forecasts the life-cycle treatment effects on health of a high-quality early childhood program. Our predictions combine microsimulation using nonexperimental data with experimental data from a midlife long-term follow-up. The follow-up incorporated a full epidemiological exam. The program mainly benefits males and significantly reduces the prevalence of heart disease, stroke, cancer, and mortality across the life-cycle. For men, we estimate an average reduction of 3.8 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs). The reduction in DALYs is relatively small for women. The gain in quality-adjusted life years is almost enough to offset all of the costs associated with program implementation for males and half of program costs for women.

10.1002/hec.4148.abstractZh: 本研究预测了高质量早期儿童教育项目对健康的生命周期影响。我们的预测结合了使用非实验数据的微观模拟结果与来自中年长期随访的实验数据。随访过程中进行了全面的流行病学评估。该项目主要对男性有益，并显著降低了整个生命周期中心脏病、中风、癌症和死亡率的患病率。对于男性来说，我们估计平均减少了3.8个伤残调整生命年（DALYs）。而女性的DALYs减少幅度相对较小。对于男性而言，质量调整生命年的增加几乎足以抵消项目实施所涉及的全部成本，而对于女性来说，则足以抵消一半的项目成本。

abstract.text: It is well established that the United States lags behind peer nations in life expectancy, but it is less established that there is heterogeneity in life expectancy trends. We compared mortality trends from 2004 to 2014 for the United States with 17 high-income countries for persons under and over 65. The United States ranked last in survival gains for the young but ranked near the middle for persons over 65, the group with universal access to public insurance. To explore the over-65 mortality trend, we estimated Cox proportional hazards models for individuals soon after entering Medicare. These were estimated separately by race and sex, controlling for 26 chronic conditions and condition-specific time trends. The separate regressions enabled survival comparisons for the 2004 and 2014 cohorts by race and sex, conditional on baseline health. We predicted 5-year survival for all combinations of diabetes, hyperlipidemia, hypertension, and ischemic heart disease (IHD). All 16 combinations of these conditions showed survival gains, with diabetes as a key driver. Notably, survival improved and racial disparities narrowed for individuals with diabetes, hypertension, and IHD. White females, black females, white males, and black males gained 3.61, 3.90, 3.57, and 5.89 percentage points in 5-year survival, respectively.

10.1002/hec.4168.abstractZh: 众所周知，美国的预期寿命落后于其他国家，但预期寿命趋势是否存在差异则尚不明确。我们比较了2004年至2014年间美国的死亡率与17个高收入国家的死亡率，重点关注65岁以下和65岁以上人群的情况。美国在年轻人生存率的提升方面排名垫底，但在65岁以上的人群中则处于中等水平，因为这一群体能够享受全民公共保险。为了探究65岁以上人群的死亡率趋势，我们为刚加入医疗保险的个体建立了Cox比例风险模型。这些模型分别按种族和性别进行了估计，同时控制了26种慢性疾病以及各疾病的时间趋势。通过这种单独回归分析，我们可以在基线健康状况相同的情况下，按种族和性别对比2004年和2014年两组的生存情况。我们预测了糖尿病、高脂血症、高血压和缺血性心脏病等多种疾病组合下的5年生存率。所有16种疾病组合都显示出生存率的提升，其中糖尿病是主要因素。值得注意的是，患有糖尿病、高血压和缺血性心脏病的个体，其生存状况有所改善，种族差异也缩小了。白人女性、黑人女性、白人男性和黑人男性的5年生存率分别提高了3.61、3.90、3.57和5.89个百分点。

abstract.text: The Future Elderly Model (FEM) is a microsimulation model designed to forecast health status, longevity, and a variety of economic outcomes. Compared to traditional actuarial models, microsimulation models provide greater opportunities for policy forecasting and richer detail, but they typically build upon smaller samples of data that may mitigate forecasting accuracy. We perform validation analyses of the FEM's mortality and quality of life forecasts using a version of the FEM estimated exclusively on early waves of data from the Health and Retirement Study. First, we compare FEM mortality and longevity projections to the actual mortality and longevity experience observed over the same period of time. We also compare the FEM results to actuarial forecasts of mortality and longevity during the same time. We find that FEM projections are generally in line with observed mortality rates and closely match longevity. Then, we assess the FEM's performance at predicting quality of life and longitudinal outcomes, two features missing from traditional actuarial models. Our analysis suggests the FEM performs at least as well as actuarial forecasts of mortality, while providing policy simulation features that are not available in actuarial models.

10.1002/hec.4169.abstractZh: 未来老年模型（FEM）是一种微观模拟模型，旨在预测健康状况、寿命以及多种经济结果。与传统的精算模型相比，微观模拟模型在政策预测方面提供了更多机会和更丰富的细节，但它们通常基于较小规模的数据样本，这可能会降低预测的准确性。我们使用基于《健康与退休研究》早期数据估算的FEM版本，对FEM的死亡率和生活质量预测进行了验证分析。首先，我们将FEM的死亡率和寿命预测与同一时期实际观察到的死亡率和寿命情况进行了比较。同时，还将FEM的结果与同一时期精算预测的死亡率和寿命进行了对比。研究发现，FEM的预测结果通常与实际观察到的死亡率相符，并且与寿命预测也高度吻合。接下来，我们评估了FEM在预测生活质量及长期结果方面的表现，这两个方面是传统精算模型所缺乏的。我们的分析表明，FEM在预测死亡率方面至少与精算预测一样有效，同时提供了传统精算模型所不具备的政策模拟功能。

abstract.text: While aging population and technological innovation are expected to increase healthcare demand in the future, increase in healthcare spending is not likely to be sustainable in times of fiscal constraint. This might lead to a tightening of hospital capacity and, potentially, to higher patient waiting times. This paper studies waiting times and quality in a healthcare market where semi-altruistic hospitals operate at full capacity. We show that in this context a trade-off between waiting times and quality emerges which, if hospitals dislike patients to wait, decreases the incentive for the quality of care. We also show that, when hospitals operate at full capacity, standard waiting time policies involving targets and penalties (e.g., "Targets and Terror" in England) can meet the target at the expense of a lower quality of care, with relevant implications for the empirical evaluation of waiting time policy.

10.1002/hec.4171.abstractZh: 虽然人口老龄化和技术创新预计会增加未来的医疗需求，但在财政紧缩的情况下，增加医疗支出可能难以持续。这可能导致医院床位紧张，进而使患者等待时间延长。本文研究了一个半利他主义医院满负荷运营的医疗市场中等待时间和医疗质量的问题。研究表明，在这种情况下，等待时间和医疗质量之间存在权衡关系：如果医院不希望患者等待，就会降低对医疗质量的重视。此外，当医院满负荷运营时，采用带有目标和惩罚的标准等待时间政策（例如英国的“目标与恐怖”政策）可以在牺牲医疗质量的情况下实现目标，这对等待时间政策的实证评估具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Financial protection in health is an essential aspect of the universal health coverage discourse. It is about ensuring that paying for health services does not affect the ability of households and individuals to afford necessities. A well-known way to assess financial protection is whether or not people are pushed into-or further into-poverty by paying out-of-pocket for health services. Although impoverishment from out-of-pocket health spending is not an explicit indicator of the sustainable development goals, it has gained prominence among researchers and policymakers because of its intuitive appeal and link to overall poverty reduction. Using data from Nigeria, this paper demonstrates that the choice of poverty line matters for assessing the impoverishing effect of paying out-of-pocket for health services. Among other things, the inconsistencies (or lack of dominance) could occur in ranking impoverishment levels by mutually exclusive groups within a country or in ranking different countries or a country over time. The implication is that the choice of poverty line could lead to manipulation of results for policy and for supporting an agenda that demonstrates an improvement in financial protection when this may not necessarily be the case.

10.1002/hec.4172.abstractZh: 在全民健康覆盖的论述中，财务保障是一个至关重要的方面。它旨在确保支付医疗费用不会影响到家庭和个人购买基本生活必需品的能力。评估财务保障的一个常见方法是，人们因自费支付医疗费用而是否陷入或进一步陷入贫困。虽然因自费医疗支出导致的贫困并不是实现可持续发展目标的明确指标，但由于其直观的吸引力以及与整体减贫的关联，这一指标在研究人员和政策制定者中越来越受到重视。本文利用尼日利亚的数据表明，选择贫困线对于评估自费医疗支出的贫困效应至关重要。此外，不同国家之间或同一国家在不同时间段的贫困程度排序可能存在不一致性或缺乏一致性。这意味着，选择贫困线的方式可能会导致结果被操纵，从而支持那些声称财务保障有所改善的议程，而实际情况可能并非如此。

abstract.text: Use of choice models is growing rapidly in tobacco research. These models are being used to answer key policy questions. However, certain aspects of smokers' choice behavior are not well understood. One such feature is addiction. Here, we address this issue by modeling data from a choice experiment on the US smokers. We model addiction using a latent variable. We use this latent variable to understand the relationship between choices and addiction, giving attention to nicotine levels. We find that more addicted smokers have stronger preferences for cigarettes and are unwilling to switch to e-cigarettes. Addicted smokers value nicotine in tobacco products to a much greater extent than those that are less addicted. Lastly, we forecast short-term responses to lowering nicotine levels in cigarettes. The results suggest that current nicotine-focused policies could be effective at encouraging addicted smokers to less harmful products and lead to substantial public health gains.

10.1002/hec.4173.abstractZh: 在烟草研究领域，选择模型的运用正在迅速增长。这些模型被用来回答重要的政策问题。然而，关于吸烟者选择行为的某些方面尚未得到充分理解。其中一个特征是成瘾。在这里，我们通过对美国吸烟者的选择实验数据进行分析来探讨这个问题。我们使用潜变量来建模成瘾现象。我们利用这一潜变量来理解选择与成瘾之间的关系，特别关注尼古丁水平的影响。我们发现，成瘾程度较高的吸烟者对香烟的偏好更强，并且不愿意转向电子香烟。与成瘾程度较低的吸烟者相比，成瘾吸烟者更重视烟草产品中的尼古丁成分。最后，我们预测了降低香烟中尼古丁含量的短期反应。研究结果表明，目前以尼古丁为重点的政策可能有助于促使成瘾吸烟者转向危害较小的产品，从而带来显著的公共卫生效益。

abstract.text: Reverse payments (pay-for-delay) are payments from an originator to a generic pharmaceutical producer to settle a potential litigation. In many jurisdictions, these payments are banned. This study shows that when the parties' investments are considered and the information about the patent strength is asymmetric, reverse payments increase both the possibility of generic entry and the litigation rate-both of which increase consumer surplus and do not necessarily delay generic entry. Reverse payments typically increase consumer surplus when the asymmetry between the parties is low, the competitiveness in the market is soft, and their size is small. Results suggest that a ban per se may be suboptimal.

10.1002/hec.4174.abstractZh: 反向支付（即“延迟支付”）是指发起方向 generic 制药生产商支付的款项，用于解决潜在的诉讼问题。在许多司法管辖区，这种支付行为是被禁止的。本研究表明，当考虑到各方的投资情况，且关于专利实力的信息存在不对称时，反向支付会增加 generic 药品进入市场的可能性以及诉讼的发生率——这两种情况都会增加消费者的剩余，并且并不一定会导致 generic 药品进入市场的延迟。当各方之间的信息不对称程度较低、市场竞争较为疲软且支付金额较小时，反向支付通常会增加消费者的剩余。研究结果表明，单纯禁止反向支付可能并不理想。

abstract.text: Since 2010, adult social care spending in England has fallen significantly in real terms whilst demand has risen. Reductions in social care supply may also have impacted demand for NHS services, particularly for those whose care is provided at the interface of the health and care systems. We analyzed a panel dataset of 150 local authorities (councils) to test potential impacts on hospital utilization by people aged 65 and over: emergency admission rates for falls and hip fractures ("front-door" measures); and extended stays of 7 days or longer; and 21 days or longer ("back-door" measures). Changes in social care supply were assessed in two ways: gross current expenditure (per capita 65 and over) adjusted by local labor costs and social care workforce (per capita 18 and over). We ran negative binomial models, controlling for deprivation, ethnicity, age, unpaid care, council class, and year effects. To account for potential endogeneity, we ran instrumental variable regressions and dynamic panel models. Sensitivity analysis explored potential effects of funding for integrated care (the Better Care Fund). There was no consistent evidence that councils with higher per capita spend or higher social care staffing rates had lower hospital admission rates or shorter hospital stays.

10.1002/hec.4175.abstractZh: 自2010年以来，英格兰的成人社会护理支出实际金额显著下降，而需求却有所上升。社会护理供应的减少也可能影响了国民医疗服务体系的服务需求，尤其是那些在医疗和护理系统交汇处接受护理的人群。我们分析了150个地方政府的面板数据集，以测试对65岁及以上人群医院使用率的影响：因跌倒和髋部骨折而需要急诊入院的比例（“前端”指标）；以及7天或更长时间的住院时间；以及21天或更长时间的住院时间（“后端”指标）。社会护理供应的变化通过两种方式进行评估：按当地劳动力成本和社会护理人员数量调整后的总当前支出（针对65岁及以上人口）；以及按18岁及以上人口调整后的总当前支出。我们运行了负二项模型，控制了贫困程度、种族、年龄、无偿护理、地方政府等级以及年份效应。为了考虑潜在的内生性问题，我们还进行了工具变量回归和动态面板模型分析。敏感性分析探讨了为综合护理提供资金可能产生的效果（“更好的护理基金”）。没有一致的证据表明，人均支出较高或社会护理人员配备较多的地方政府，其医院入院率或住院时间较短。

abstract.text: Countries which are introducing a system of Universal health coverage have to make a number of key tradeoffs, of which one is the tradeoff between the level of coverage and the degree to which patients are exposed to potentially catastrophic financial risk. In this study, we first present a way in which decision makers might be supported to focus on in a particular part of the tradeoff curve and ultimately choose an efficient solution. We then introduce some multiobjective optimization models for generating the tradeoff curves given data about potential treatment numbers, costs, and benefits. Using a dataset from Malawi, we demonstrate the approach and suggest a core index metric to make specific observations on the individual treatments. Moreover, as there has been some debate about the best way to measure financial exposure, we also investigate the extent to sensitivity of our results to the precise technical choice of financial exposure metric. Specifically, we consider two metrics, which are the total number of cases protected from catastrophic expenditure and a convex penalty function that penalizes out-of-pocket expenditures in an increasingly growing way, respectively.

10.1002/hec.4176.abstractZh: 在引入全民健康覆盖制度的国家，必须做出一系列关键权衡，其中之一就是覆盖水平与患者面临潜在灾难性财务风险程度之间的权衡。本研究首先提出了一种方法，以帮助决策者专注于权衡曲线上的特定部分，并最终选择出一个有效的解决方案。随后，我们引入了一些多目标优化模型，根据潜在治疗数量、成本和收益的数据来生成权衡曲线。利用马拉维的数据集，我们展示了这一方法，并提出了一种核心指标，以对各项治疗进行具体分析。此外，由于关于如何衡量财务风险存在争议，我们还研究了我们的结果对财务风险度量技术选择的敏感性。具体来说，我们考虑了两种度量方法：一种是保护患者免受灾难性支出影响的病例总数，另一种则是以递增方式对自付费用进行惩罚的凸形惩罚函数。

abstract.text: We introduce a summary wellbeing measure for economic evaluation of cross-sectoral public policies with impacts on health and living standards. We show how to calculate period-specific and lifetime wellbeing using quality-adjusted life years based on widely available data on health-related quality of life and consumption and normative assumptions about three parameters-minimal consumption, standard consumption, and the elasticity of the marginal value of consumption. We also illustrate how these three parameters can be tailored to the decision-making context and varied in sensitivity analysis to provide information about the implications of alternative value judgments. As well as providing a general measure for cost-effectiveness analysis and cost-benefit analysis in terms of wellbeing, this approach also facilitates distributional analysis in terms of how many good years different population subgroups can expect to live under different policy scenarios.

10.1002/hec.4177.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于评估对健康和生活水平有影响的跨部门公共政策的综合福祉指标。我们展示了如何利用基于广泛可用的健康相关生活质量及消费数据的质量调整生命年来计算特定时期和终身的福祉。同时，基于关于三个参数的规范假设——最低消费、标准消费以及消费边际价值的弹性，我们进一步说明了如何根据决策背景对这三个参数进行定制，并在敏感性分析中对其进行调整，以提供关于不同价值判断影响的信息。除了为成本效益分析和成本效益分析提供通用的福祉衡量标准外，这种方法还便于进行分配性分析，即不同人口群体在不同政策情景下能够预期生活的良好年数。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impact of the enforcement of SB 1070, a stringent immigration law, on the mental health, health-risk behaviors, and academic performance of Hispanic adolescent residents in Arizona. Using the difference-in-differences method, this study finds that SB 1070 increases their probability of feeling sad and decreases their physical activeness. The impact of SB 1070 on sad feelings and level of physical activity could have serious repercussions while it lasts. In addition, obese male Hispanic adolescents are more likely than their female or non-obese counterparts to develop mental health problems and engage in health-risk behaviors attributable to the stringent immigration policy. This study's empirical evidence on adverse mental health repercussions for Hispanic adolescents of state-level immigration enforcement suggests the need to be careful in formulating and implementing immigration policies.

10.1002/hec.4178.abstractZh: 本研究调查了严格的移民法律SB 1070的实施对亚利桑那州西班牙裔青少年居民的心理健康、健康风险行为以及学业表现的影响。通过差异-差异法分析发现，SB 1070增加了他们感到悲伤的可能性，并降低了他们的身体活动量。SB 1070对悲伤情绪和身体活动水平的影响在持续期间可能会产生严重后果。此外，肥胖的西班牙裔男性青少年比女性或非肥胖同龄人更容易出现心理健康问题，并倾向于采取与严格移民政策相关的健康风险行为。本研究关于州级移民执法对西班牙裔青少年心理健康负面影响的实际证据，表明在制定和实施移民政策时需要谨慎。

abstract.text: In economic evaluations of health technologies, health outcomes are commonly measured in terms of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). QALYs are the product of time and health-related quality of life. Health-related quality of life, in turn, is determined by a social tariff, which is supposed to reflect the public's preference over health states. This study argues that, because of the tariff's role in the societal decision-making process, it should not be understood as merely an operational (statistical) definition of health, but as a major instrument of democratic participation. I outline what implications this might have for both the method used to aggregate individual preferences, and the set of individuals whose preferences should count. Alternative tariff specifications and decision rules are explored, and future research directions are proposed.

10.1002/hec.4179.abstractZh: 在健康技术的经济评估中，健康结果通常以质量调整生命年（QALYs）来衡量。QALYs是时间和健康相关生活质量的乘积。健康相关生活质量又由社会偏好决定，这种偏好反映了公众对不同健康状态的偏好。本研究认为，由于社会偏好在社会决策过程中的作用，它不应仅仅被视为健康的一种操作性（统计性）定义，而应被视为民主参与的重要工具。我概述了这可能对用于汇总个体偏好所采用的方法以及应计入偏好范围的个体群体产生的影响。文中还探讨了不同的偏好设定和决策规则，并提出了未来的研究方向。

abstract.text: In the United States, all newly developed drugs undergo a lengthy review process conducted by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA). These regulatory delays have direct immediate costs for drug manufacturers and patients waiting for treatment. Under certain market conditions, regulatory delays may also affect future research and development (R&D) strategies of pharmaceutical companies. To estimate the magnitude of this effect, we match data on drugs in the development pipeline in 2006 to data that we collect on FDA review times for all drugs approved between 1999 and 2005. Employing a rich and novel set of controls that affect drug R&D decisions and, potentially, regulatory review lags, we find that on average, three additional months of delay result in one fewer drug in development in that drug category. Our results suggest that the length of the regulatory delay matters for pharmaceutical firms' R&D decisions and that the firms are likely unable to pass on these costs onto consumers.

10.1002/hec.4180.abstractZh: 在美国，所有新开发的药品都要经过美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的漫长审查流程。这些监管延迟直接导致了制药公司和患者的即时成本。在某些市场条件下，监管延迟还可能影响制药公司的未来研发策略。为了评估这种影响的程度，我们将2006年处于开发阶段的药品数据与我们收集的1999年至2005年间获批药品的食品药监部门审查时间数据进行了对比。通过运用一套丰富的、能够影响药品研发决策以及监管审查延迟的新颖控制变量，我们发现，平均而言，每延迟三个月，该类别的待开发药品数量就会减少一种。我们的研究结果表明，监管延迟的持续时间对制药公司的研发决策至关重要，而制药公司很可能无法将这些成本转嫁给消费者。

abstract.text: Many aspects of asthma-in particular the relationship between beliefs, averting behaviors, and symptoms-are not directly observable from market data. An approach that combines observable market data with nonmarket valuation to gather data on unobservable aspects of the illness can improve efforts to quantify the burden of asthma if it accounts for the endogeneity in the system. Such approaches are used in the valuation of recreation but have not been widely used to value the burden of a chronic illness. We estimate parents' willingness to pay (WTP) to reduce their child's asthma symptoms using a three-equation model that combines revealed preference, contingent valuation, and burden of asthma, increasing the efficiency of estimation and correcting for endogeneity. WTP for a device that reduces a child's asthma symptoms by 50% is $125/month (s.d. $20). Parents' valuations are driven by beliefs about asthma and by their degree of worry about asthma between episodes. There is a nonlinear relationship between the number of days with symptoms and WTP per symptom day. The experience of living with asthma affects families' responses to a contingent valuation scenario, because it influences willingness to spend money to manage the illness and their subjective perceptions and beliefs about the illness itself.

10.1002/hec.4181.abstractZh: 哮喘的许多方面，尤其是信念、避免行为与症状之间的关系，无法直接从市场数据中观察到。一种将可观察的市场数据与非市场估值相结合的方法，可以收集到关于疾病不可观察方面的数据，从而更好地量化哮喘的负担，前提是考虑到系统中的内生性问题。这种方法在娱乐业的估值中已被使用，但并未广泛应用于慢性疾病的负担评估。我们采用了一个包含三个方程的模型来估计父母为减少孩子哮喘症状而愿意支付的金额，该模型结合了显性偏好、条件估值和哮喘负担的评估，从而提高了估值的效率并解决了内生性问题。一种能够减少孩子哮喘症状50%的设备，父母愿意每月支付125美元（标准差为20美元）。父母的估值受到他们对哮喘的信念以及在不同发作期间对哮喘的担忧程度的影响。症状天数与每症状天数对应的支付金额之间存在非线性关系。与哮喘共存的经历会影响家庭对条件估值情景的反应，因为它会影响他们为管理疾病而愿意花费金钱的意愿，以及他们对疾病本身的主观认知和信念。

abstract.text: Our study examines how physician prescribing responds to new scientific information added to drug labels. We focus on a series of label changes with new information about the effects of drugs in children. The information arose in response to a 1997 policy, pediatric exclusivity, which gave drug sponsors a 6-month exclusivity extension for conducting additional pediatric studies of already marketed drugs. The information from these studies was expected to improve pediatric prescribing by promoting appropriate use and by reducing inappropriate off-label prescribing. However, there has been little study about the actual effects of these labeling changes on physician prescribing behavior. We use a difference-in-differences strategy to examine how pediatric prescriptions respond to different types of labeling changes. Our results show that most label changes lead to reductions in prescribing to children. We find that the largest drop in prescribing occurs when the label indicates a drug is not effective for children. The evidence suggests that the labeling changes alleviated physician uncertainty about prescribing drugs to children and reduced some inappropriate off-label use.

10.1002/hec.4182.abstractZh: 我们的研究探讨了医生在看到药物标签上新增科学信息后的处方行为变化。我们重点关注一系列涉及儿童用药效果的标签变更。这些信息的出现是为了响应1997年的一项政策——儿科独占权，该政策允许药品制造商在已上市药品上再开展6个月的儿科研究。这些研究预期能够通过促进合理用药和减少非适应症用药来改善儿科处方情况。然而，关于这些标签变更对医生处方行为实际影响的研究却很少。我们采用差异-差异策略来研究不同类型的标签变更对儿科处方的影响。研究结果表明，大多数标签变更都导致了儿童用药处方的减少。我们发现，当标签显示某种药物对儿童无效时，处方量下降最为明显。这些证据表明，标签变更有助于减轻医生对儿童用药的顾虑，并减少了一些非适应症用药现象。

abstract.text: This paper uses policy-induced variation in legal access to alcohol in the United States to explore interactions between genetic predispositions and health behaviors. It is well known that Minimum Legal Drinking Age (MLDA) laws have discrete impacts on binge drinking behaviors, but less is known about heterogeneity of the effects and the characteristics of individuals most and least affected. Using the Add Health data, this paper explores differential policy effects based on polygenic scores (PGS), which are genome-wide summary measures predicting health outcomes. Specifically, we leverage PGS for alcoholism and for a broader set of risk-taking behaviors to explore heterogeneities in response to the policy and consider mechanisms for the responses. Like previous literature using the Add Health and other datasets, we find main effects of MLDA in increasing recent binge drinking episodes by approximately 5 percentage points. We find MLDA effects are concentrated entirely in individuals with high PGS for alcohol use. We are also able to compare these results with measures of parental alcoholism as a global proxy for family history.

10.1002/hec.4183.abstractZh: 本文利用美国法律对酒精获取的限制政策变化，探讨遗传倾向与健康行为之间的相互作用。众所周知，最低法定饮酒年龄法案对酗酒行为有显著影响，但关于这些影响的异质性以及受影响最严重的个体和最不受影响的个体特征，目前了解较少。本文利用Add Health数据，基于多基因评分（PGS）来研究政策的不同影响，多基因评分是一种全基因组总结指标，用于预测健康结果。具体而言，我们利用多基因评分来评估酗酒行为以及一系列风险行为，以探讨政策对行为的不同影响，并考虑这些影响的机制。与之前使用Add Health和其他数据集的文献一样，我们发现最低法定饮酒年龄法案的主要影响是使近期酗酒事件增加了约5个百分点。我们还发现，最低法定饮酒年龄法案的影响主要集中在那些在酗酒多基因评分上得分较高的个体身上。此外，我们还能将这些结果与父母酗酒情况作为家庭历史的全球代理指标进行比较。

abstract.text: Governments around the world are encouraging people to switch away from sedentary modes of travel towards more active modes, including walking and cycling. The aim of these schemes is to improve population health and to reduce emissions. There is considerable evidence on the latter, but relatively little on the former. This paper investigates the impact of mode choice on physical and mental health. Using data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study, we exploit changes in mode of commute to identify health outcome responses. Individuals who change modes are matched with those whose mode remains constant. Overall we find that mode switches affect both physical and mental health. When switching from car to active travel we see an increase in physical health for women and in mental health for both genders. In contrast, both men and women who switch from active travel to car are shown to experience a significant reduction in their physical health and health satisfaction, and a decline in their mental health when they change from active to public transport.

10.1002/hec.4184.abstractZh: 全球各国政府都在鼓励人们从久坐的出行方式转向更积极的出行方式，包括步行和骑自行车。这些计划的目的是改善民众的健康状况并减少排放。关于后者的研究已经有很多，但关于前者则相对较少。本文研究了出行方式选择对身心健康的影响。利用英国家庭纵向研究的数据，我们通过分析通勤方式的变化来识别健康结果的变化。那些改变出行方式的人与那些保持原有出行方式的人进行了对比。总体而言，我们发现出行方式的改变对身心健康都有影响。当从汽车出行转向积极出行方式时，女性的身体健康状况有所改善，而男女两性的心理健康状况都有所提升。相反，当从积极出行方式转向汽车出行时，无论是男性还是女性，其身体健康状况和健康满意度都会显著下降，心理健康状况也会随之恶化。

abstract.text: We offer a flexible latent type approach to rank populations according to unequal health opportunities. Building upon the latent-class method, an approch increasingly adopted to estimate health inequalities, our contribution is to let the number of socioeconomic groups considered vary to obtain an opportunity-inequality curve for a population that gives how the between-type inequality varies with the number of types. A population A is said to have less inequality of opportunity than population B if its curve is statistically below that of population B. This version of the latent class approach allows for a robust ranking of 31 European countries regarding inequality of opportunity in health.

10.1002/hec.4185.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种灵活的潜在类型方法，用于根据不平等的健康机会对人群进行排名。该方法基于潜在类别方法，逐渐成为估算健康不平等的常用手段。我们的贡献在于允许调整考虑的社会经济群体数量，从而得到一个机会不平等曲线，该曲线能够展示不同类型之间的不平等如何随着类型数量的变化而变化。如果某个群体的机会不平等曲线在统计上低于另一个群体的曲线，那么该群体就被认为具有更低的机会不平等。这种潜在类别方法的版本能够较为准确地对31个欧洲国家的健康机会不平等情况进行排名。

abstract.text: Most OECD countries have downsized treatment capacity at psychiatric hospitals substantially. We investigate consequences of these reductions by studying how the decision whether to admit individuals in mental distress to a psychiatric hospital affects their subsequent crime, treatment trajectories, and labor market outcomes. To circumvent nonrandom selection into admission, we use a proxy of occupancy rates prior to a patient's first contact with a psychiatric hospital as an instrument. We find that admissions reduce criminal behavior, likely due to incapacitation, and predominantly for males and those with a criminal record. Furthermore, admission lowers patients' subsequent labor market attachment, likely because a psychiatric hospital admission is an eligibility criterion for welfare benefits.

10.1002/hec.4186.abstractZh: 大多数经合组织国家已经大幅减少了精神病医院的治疗能力。我们通过研究将精神困扰者收治到精神病医院的决定如何影响他们的后续犯罪行为、治疗轨迹以及劳动力市场表现，来探讨这种减少所带来的后果。为了规避非随机性的收治选择，我们使用了患者在首次接触精神病医院之前的占用率作为工具变量。研究发现，收治确实减少了犯罪行为，这可能是由于患者被限制行动所致，且这一现象主要发生在男性以及有犯罪记录的人群身上。此外，收治还降低了患者的劳动力市场参与度，可能是因为精神病医院的收治是领取福利援助的资格条件之一。

abstract.text: We analyze household-level changes in alcohol consumption in response to pregnancy. Using scanner data, we identify households with a pregnant household member. Within an event study and a dynamic difference-in-differences estimation, we find that during a first pregnancy, households reduce their alcohol purchases by 36%. After pregnancy, purchases of alcohol are 34% lower than before pregnancy. We do not find any effect during the second pregnancy. One possible explanation for our result is that lower consumption during pregnancy changes habits and reduces consumption in the long term. We discuss other explanations and comment on policy implications.

10.1002/hec.4188.abstractZh: 我们分析了家庭层面因怀孕而变化的酒精消费情况。通过扫描数据，我们识别出有怀孕家庭成员的家庭。在事件研究和动态差异估计模型中，我们发现第一次怀孕时，家庭酒精消费减少了36%。怀孕之后，酒精消费比怀孕前降低了34%。第二次怀孕期间，我们没有发现任何影响。我们的结果可能的一种解释是，怀孕期间的低消费会改变习惯，并长期减少消费。我们还讨论了其他可能的解释，并对政策含义进行了评论。

abstract.text: We test the importance of information source on consumer choice in the context of sin goods, specifically electronic and tobacco cigarettes, among adult smokers. We proxy choice with intentions to vape and quit smoking in the next 30 days. We experimentally vary the information source: government, private companies, physicians, and no source. Our findings suggest that information source matters in the context of cigarettes choice for adult smokers. Private companies appear to be an important information source for cigarettes among adult smokers.

10.1002/hec.4189.abstractZh: 我们测试了信息来源对成年吸烟者选择电子产品和烟草香烟时消费选择的影响。我们通过使用“未来30天内开始使用电子烟和戒烟”的意图来替代实际选择行为。我们实验性地改变了信息来源：政府、私人公司、医生以及无信息来源的情况。研究发现，信息来源对成年吸烟者选择香烟的行为具有重要影响。在成年吸烟者中，私人公司似乎是重要的香烟信息来源。

abstract.text: We study the effect of recent legalization of recreational marijuana use laws (RMLs) in the United States on new applications and allowances for Social Security Disability Insurance and Supplemental Security Income over the period 2001-2019. We combine administrative caseload data from the Social Security Administration with state policy changes using two-way fixed-effects methods. We find that RML adoption increases applications for both benefits. However, there is no change in allowances post-RML. We provide suggestive evidence that the observed changes in applications post-RML are driven by increases in marijuana misuse and selective migration, and decreases in unemployment.

10.1002/hec.4190.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国最近对娱乐性大麻使用法律合法化的影响，以及这一变化在2001年至2019年期间对社会保障残疾保险和补充安全收入的新申请和批准数量的影响。我们结合了社会保障管理局的行政案件数据以及各州的政策变化，采用双向固定效应模型进行分析。研究发现，大麻使用法律合法化后，这两项福利的新申请数量均有所增加。然而，合法化后福利的批准数量并未发生变化。我们有理由认为，申请数量的变化是由大麻滥用率的上升、选择性迁移以及失业率的下降所驱动的。

abstract.text: This study focuses on Guizhou Province, a region with difficult geographical conditions and poor economic development, to examine the effect of rainfall shocks on contemporaneous infant health and long-run socioeconomic outcomes in China. The study results indicate that negative rainfall shocks are robustly correlated with higher infant mortality and lower birth weight. In the long run, early life rainfall shortages limit an individual's income and housing conditions. The study findings indicate a significant interaction of rainfall shock with the severity of water scarcity. This result implies that drinking water safety is an essential channel through which early life rainfall shocks influence individual health endowments. However, agriculture production is not a likely channel for rainfall effects despite its association with infant mortality. Accordingly, our empirical results suggest that improving public facility coverage will reduce the vulnerability of infant health to adverse rainfall shocks in Guizhou and other developing areas.

10.1002/hec.4191.abstractZh: 本研究聚焦于贵州省，该地区地理条件恶劣，经济发展滞后，旨在探讨降雨冲击对中国儿童健康及长期社会经济成果的影响。研究结果表明，负面降雨冲击与较高的婴儿死亡率和较低的出生体重之间存在显著相关性。从长期来看，早期降雨不足会限制个人的收入和住房条件。研究还发现，降雨冲击与水资源短缺的严重程度之间存在显著的交互作用。这意味着饮用水安全是降雨冲击影响个人健康状况的重要渠道。然而，尽管农业生产与婴儿死亡率有关，但它并非降雨影响的显著渠道。因此，我们的实证结果表明，改善公共设施的覆盖程度将有助于降低贵州省及其他发展地区儿童健康对不利降雨冲击的脆弱性。

abstract.text: During the COVID-19 pandemic, health care systems around the world have received additional funding, while at other times, financial support has been lowered to consolidate public spending. Such budget changes likely affect provision behavior in health care. We study how different degrees of resource scarcity affect medical service provision and, in consequence, patients' health. In a controlled lab environment, physicians are paid by capitation and allocate limited resources to several patients. This implies a trade-off between physicians' profits and patients' health benefits. We vary levels of resource scarcity and patient characteristics systematically and observe that most subjects in the role of physician devote a relatively stable share of budget to patient treatment, implying that they provide fewer services when they face more severe budget constraints. Average patient benefits decrease in proportion to physician budgets. The majority of subjects chooses an allocation that leads to equal patient benefits as opposed to allocating resources efficiently.

10.1002/hec.4192.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，全球各地的医疗系统获得了额外的资金支持，而在其他时候，财政支持则被削减以整合公共支出。这样的预算变化可能会对医疗服务的提供行为产生影响。我们研究了不同程度的资源稀缺如何影响医疗服务提供，进而影响患者的健康。在实验室环境中，医生通过按人头收费的方式获得报酬，并且只能为少数患者分配有限的资源。这意味着医生的利润与患者健康收益之间存在权衡。我们系统地改变了资源稀缺程度和患者特征，发现大多数扮演医生角色的研究对象会为患者治疗分配相对固定的预算份额，这意味着当面临更严重的预算限制时，他们提供的服务会减少。患者的平均收益随着医生预算的减少而相应下降。大多数研究对象选择了一种分配方式，使得患者受益水平相等，而不是有效分配资源。

abstract.text: We here consider the cognitive and noncognitive consequences on young adults of growing up with a mother who reported experiencing major financial problems. We use UK data from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children to show that early childhood financial problems are associated with worse adolescent cognitive and noncognitive outcomes, controlling for both income and a set of standard variables, and in value-added models controlling for children's earlier age-5 outcomes. The estimated effect of financial problems is almost always larger in size than that of income. Around one-quarter to one-half of the effect of financial problems on the noncognitive outcomes seems to transit through mother's mental health.

10.1002/hec.4194.abstractZh: 我们研究了母亲在成长过程中遭遇重大财务问题的现象对年轻成年人的认知和非认知影响。通过英国“Avon父母与儿童纵向研究”的数据发现，儿童早期的财务问题与青少年时期的认知和非认知表现较差之间存在关联。这一关联在控制收入和一系列标准变量后依然成立，而在增值模型中，这一关联还考虑了儿童在5岁时的年龄因素。财务问题的影响幅度几乎总是大于收入的影响。财务问题对非认知表现的影响大约相当于四分之一到一半，且这种影响似乎会通过母亲的心理健康状况传递。

abstract.text: This study examines how the Affordable Care Act (ACA) affected income related inequality in health insurance coverage in the United States. Analyzing data from the American Community Survey (ACS) from 2010 through 2018, we apply difference-in-differences, and triple-differences estimation to the Recentered Influence Function OLS estimation. We find that the ACA reduced inequality in health insurance coverage in the United States. Most of this reduction was a result of the Medicaid expansion. Additional decomposition analysis shows there was little change in inequality of coverage through an employer plan, and a decrease in inequality for coverage through direct purchase of health insurance. These results indicate that the insurance exchanges also contributed to declining inequality in health insurance coverage.

10.1002/hec.4195.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了《平价医疗法案》对美国健康保险覆盖中收入相关不平等的影响。通过分析2010至2018年的美国社区调查数据，我们采用了差异差分法和三重差分法，并结合重新中心化影响函数OLS估计方法。研究发现，《平价医疗法案》确实减少了美国健康保险覆盖中的不平等现象。其中大部分减少是由于医疗补助计划的扩展所致。进一步的分解分析显示，通过雇主计划获得的保险覆盖的不平等程度变化不大，而通过直接购买健康保险获得的保险覆盖的不平等程度则有所降低。这些结果表明，保险交易平台也有助于减少健康保险覆盖中的不平等现象。

abstract.text: This study provides empirical evidence on the labor market effects of public health insurance using evidence from China. In 2007, China launched a national public health insurance program, Urban Resident Basic Medical Insurance (URBMI), targeting residents in urban areas who were not insured by employment-based health insurance. Using panel data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey, I identify the impacts of the program based on its staggered implementation across cities. I find that URBMI did not have a significant average causal effect on labor force participation. However, it did increase employment mobility, as evidenced by the decrease in long-term employment and expansion of fixed-term contract jobs and self-employment. After the program was implemented, job lock declined and job flexibility increased, especially among women, the less educated, and individuals with good health status. The results also suggest increased employment for unhealthy workers, indicating a direct health improvement effect.

10.1002/hec.4198.abstractZh: 本研究基于中国的数据，提供了关于公共健康保险对劳动力市场影响的实证证据。2007年，中国推出了全国性的公共健康保险计划——城镇居民基本医疗保险（URBMI），旨在为那些没有通过就业型健康保险获得保障的城镇居民提供保障。利用中国健康与营养调查的数据，我根据该计划在不同城市中的分阶段实施情况，分析了其影响。研究发现，URBMI对劳动力参与率并没有显著的平均因果效应。然而，它确实增加了就业流动性，表现为长期就业的减少以及临时合同工作和个体经营的扩大。在计划实施之后，工作锁定现象减少，工作灵活性增加，尤其是在女性、受教育程度较低的人群以及健康状况良好的个体中。研究结果还表明，不健康的工人就业情况也有所改善，这表明公共健康保险直接促进了健康水平的提高。

abstract.text: Spillovers can arise in markets with multiple purchasers relying on shared producers. Prior studies have found such spillovers in health care, from managed care to nonmanaged care populations-reducing spending and utilization, and improving outcomes, including in Medicare. This study provides the first plausibly causal estimates of such spillovers from Medicare Advantage (MA) to Traditional Medicare (TM) in the post-Affordable Care Act era using an instrumental variables approach. Controlling for health status and other potential confounders, we estimate that a one percentage point increase in county-level MA penetration results in a $64 (95% CI: $18 to $110) (0.7%) reduction in standardized per-enrollee TM spending. We find evidence for reductions in utilization both on the intensive and extensive margins, across a number of health care services. Our results complement and extend prior work that found spillovers from MA to TM in earlier years and under different payment policies than are in place today.

10.1002/hec.4199.abstractZh: 在多个购买者依赖共同生产者的市场中，可能会出现溢出效应。先前的研究发现，这种溢出效应存在于医疗保健领域，无论是从管理式护理还是非管理式护理的人群中，都会减少支出和利用率，同时改善治疗效果，包括在医疗保险体系中。本研究首次使用工具变量方法，对《平价医疗法案》后时期医疗保险优势计划对传统医疗保险的溢出效应进行了合理的因果估计。在控制健康状况和其他潜在混杂因素后，我们估计，县级医疗保险优势计划的普及率每提高一个百分点，传统医疗保险的每参保人员支出就会减少64美元（95%置信区间：18至110美元）（0.7%）。我们发现，在多种医疗服务上，无论是住院还是门诊服务，都出现了使用率的下降。我们的研究结果补充并扩展了先前的研究，这些研究发现在早期和不同的支付政策下，医疗保险优势计划对传统医疗保险产生了溢出效应。

abstract.text: This study provides the first evidence on the determinants of uptake of two recent public dental benefit programs for Australian children and adolescents from disadvantaged families. Using longitudinal data from a nationally representative survey linked to administrative data with accurate information on eligibility and uptake, we find that only a third of all eligible families actually claim their benefits. We provide new and robust evidence consistent with the idea advanced by recent economic literature that cognitive biases and behavioral factors are barriers to uptake. For instance, mothers with worse mental health or riskier lifestyles are much less likely to claim the available benefits for their children. These barriers to uptake are particularly large in magnitude: together, they reduce the uptake rate by up to 10 percentage points (or 36%). We also find some indicative evidence that a lack of information is a barrier to uptake.

10.1002/hec.4200.abstractZh: 本研究首次提供了关于澳大利亚来自弱势家庭的儿童和青少年两类近期公共牙科福利计划接受情况的决定因素的证据。通过一项具有全国代表性的调查所获得的纵向数据，并结合行政数据中的准确信息，我们发现只有三分之一的符合条件家庭实际申请了这些福利。我们的研究结果与近期经济文献中提出的观点一致，即认知偏差和行为因素是影响福利计划接受率的重要因素。例如，心理健康状况较差或生活方式风险较高的母亲，其子女申请相关福利的可能性要低得多。这些阻碍接受率的因素影响尤为显著：它们共同将接受率降低了多达10个百分点（即36%）。我们还发现了一些迹象表明，信息不足也是影响福利计划接受率的一个因素。

abstract.text: We study the effect of exposure to political instability in-utero on health at birth. We exploit the coup d'état that took place in Spain on February 23, 1981. Although short-lived and unsuccessful, the event generated stress and fear among the population, especially in areas that had suffered more repression during the Civil War and the recent dictatorship. We follow a difference-in-differences strategy and compare birth outcomes before and after the coup, in areas that were differentially "affected". We find that children who were in utero during the coup in more affected areas were born with significantly lower birth-weight (around 9 g lighter), especially if they were exposed to the coup in the first or second trimester of pregnancy. We contribute to the literature on the effects of maternal stress by focusing on an acute (and relatively common) source of distress that is unlikely to have affected newborn health via other channels.

10.1002/hec.4201.abstractZh: 我们研究了子宫内暴露于政治不稳定对出生健康的影响。我们选取了1981年2月23日发生在西班牙的政变作为研究案例。尽管这次政变持续时间短暂且未能成功，但它给民众带来了压力和恐惧，尤其是在内战和近期独裁统治期间遭受过更多压迫的地区。我们采用差异差异策略，比较了政变前后那些受影响程度不同的地区的出生结果。研究发现，在受影响较严重的地区，子宫内经历政变的婴儿出生时体重明显较低（大约轻9克），尤其是在妊娠的第一或第二季度暴露于政变的情况下。通过聚焦这种急性且相对常见的压力源，我们为关于母体压力对新生儿健康影响的文献做出了贡献，因为这种压力源不太可能通过其他途径影响新生儿的健康。

abstract.text: The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami was an international natural disaster unlike any seen before, killing 166,561 people in Aceh province, Indonesia. It prompted an unprecedented humanitarian response and was a catalyst in ending almost 30 years of civil conflict in Aceh. Since the tsunami was followed by a multitude of events, we first conduct a systematic review to identify those events in Indonesia. We then use a synthetic control method to estimate the combination of those effects on child mortality indicators in Aceh for the 13 years that followed the disaster using data from 258,918 children born between 1990 and 2017. The results show a significant increase in under-5 mortality only the year after the tsunami and no effect in the medium term. However, younger and older children were affected differently in the medium term. In fact, we show a decrease in child mortality among children aged 1-4 years. In contrast, we observe an increase in mortality among children under-1 in 2009 and 2010. Overall, the resilience of Aceh province points to the importance of coordinated international disaster responses after natural disasters.

10.1002/hec.4202.abstractZh: 2004年印度洋海啸是一场前所未有的国际自然灾害，导致印度尼西亚亚齐省有166,561人死亡。这场灾难引发了前所未有的人道主义救援行动，并成为结束亚齐近30年内战的催化剂。由于海啸之后发生了许多事件，我们首先进行了系统性的回顾，以识别印度尼西亚境内发生的这些事件。然后，我们采用合成控制方法，利用1990年至2017年间出生的258,918名儿童的数据，估计这些事件对亚齐地区儿童死亡率指标的影响，时间跨度为13年。研究结果显示，儿童死亡率在海啸发生后的第二年显著上升，而在中期则没有显著影响。然而，在中期，不同年龄段的儿童受到的影响不同。实际上，我们发现1-4岁儿童的死亡率有所下降。相比之下，2009年和2010年，1岁以下儿童的死亡率有所上升。总体而言，亚齐省的韧性表明，在自然灾害之后，协调一致的国际救灾行动具有重要意义。

abstract.text: While waiting for a decision, individuals who apply for Social Security Disability Insurance face strong incentives to remain out of the labor force and receive no support from the program. An extended period with low income, high uncertainty, and lowered access to health insurance has the potential to harm applicants' well-being along many dimensions. In this study, I estimate the effect of initial wait time on health, healthcare access, and financial well-being, using the prevailing wait at the time an applicant applied as an instrument for their own initial wait. I find that a longer wait decreases the likelihood that an applicant has benefits terminated at the time of survey and increases the likelihood that they are currently receiving benefits, consistent with prior findings that longer waits decrease future work and earnings. Wait time also increases the number of conditions causing activity limitations. This suggests that new or worsening medical conditions contribute to the effect of wait time on employment and earnings, and that wait time has effects that extend beyond labor force outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4203.abstractZh: 在等待决定期间，申请社会保障残疾保险的个人有强烈的动机保持不参加劳动力，从而不获得该计划的支持。长期处于低收入、高不确定性以及较低的医疗保险覆盖状态，可能会从多个维度损害申请人的福祉。在这项研究中，我使用申请人申请时所处的等待时间作为工具变量，来估计初始等待时间对健康、医疗保健获取和财务福祉的影响。我发现，较长的等待时间会降低申请人在调查时失去福利的可能性，并增加他们目前仍领取福利的可能性，这与先前的研究结果一致，即较长的等待时间会降低未来的工作和收入。等待时间还会增加导致活动受限的疾病数量。这表明，新的或恶化的医疗状况加剧了等待时间对就业和收入的影响，而等待时间的影响不仅限于劳动力结果。

abstract.text: Many OECD countries have replaced per-diem hospital reimbursement with lump sum payments by diagnosis-related groups. This study analyzes hospital responses to a large-scale refinement of reimbursement practices in Germany on January 1, 2006, in which regulating authorities introduce reimbursements by treatment intensity in the market for stroke disorder. We find that the share of admissions receiving high-intensity treatments jumps by approximately 7 percentage points around the turn of the year. At the same time, a decrease in the average clinical severity of patients receiving these high-intensity treatments reveals that the marginal high-intensity treated patient in 2006 might be less appropriate for high-intensity treatments compared to 2005. We do not find accompanying (short-term) changes in the quality of care, such as decreases in in-hospital mortality.

10.1002/hec.4204.abstractZh: 许多经合组织国家已经用按诊断相关组划分的一次性付款取代了每日住院报销制度。本研究分析了德国在2006年1月1日对报销制度进行大规模改革后的医院反应，当时监管机构在中风疾病的治疗强度方面引入了报销机制。我们发现，在年度转折点上，接受高强度治疗的住院患者比例增加了约7个百分点。同时，接受这些高强度治疗的患者的平均临床严重程度有所下降，这表明2006年接受高强度治疗的患者的比例可能不如2005年适合进行高强度治疗。我们没有发现伴随的（短期）护理质量变化，例如住院死亡率的下降。

abstract.text: Countries seeking to move away from a purely fee-for-service (FFS) system may consider a hybrid approach whereby only some procedures are paid by FFS while others are paid prospectively. Yet little evidence exists whether such a hybrid payment system contains overall costs without adverse influences on health outcomes. In 2003, Japan experienced a reform from FFS to a hybrid payment system in which only some inpatient procedures were paid prospectively. We exploit this reform to test how such a hybrid system affects overall costs and health outcomes. Briefly, we find that healthcare providers responded opportunistically to the reform, moving some procedures out of the bundled inpatient setting to FFS services, leading to no reduction in cost. There was some evidence of a moderate deterioration in health outcomes, in terms of a decline in the probability of symptoms being cured at discharge. In sum, our results suggest that in some cases, a hybrid payment system can be non-superior to either FFS or prospective payment system.

10.1002/hec.4205.abstractZh: 寻求从纯按服务收费制度转向其他模式的国家可以考虑采用混合支付方式，即只有部分程序按服务收费，而其余程序则按预期支付。然而，目前几乎没有证据表明这种混合支付系统是否能在不影响健康结果的情况下降低总体成本。2003年，日本从纯按服务收费制度转向混合支付制度，其中只有部分住院程序按预期支付。我们利用这一改革来研究这种混合支付方式对总体成本和健康结果的影响。研究发现，医疗服务提供者对这一改革做出了机会主义反应，将一些程序从捆绑的住院服务中分离出来，改为按服务收费，但并未导致成本降低。此外，有证据表明健康结果有所恶化，出院时症状治愈的概率有所下降。总之，我们的结果表明，在某些情况下，混合支付系统并不优于纯按服务收费制度或按预期支付制度。

abstract.text: This article explores a three-party contracting problem when the patient and the provider possess private information that is unobservable to the insurer. We show that for an insurance mechanism to be collusion-proof, it suffices for the insurer to rely on the incentive for one side of the patient-provider coalition. If the risk premium for the patient is smaller than the provider's informational rent, placing the incentive on the patient generates a lower social cost than placing the incentive on the provider. We show that if the provider's effort is highly valued by the patient, the insurer should rely on the patient's incentive to implement a collusion-proof second-best insurance. Interestingly, an altruistic provider may lead to a higher social cost than a self-interested provider. However, even if the insurer does not know the degree of provider altruism, it may still achieve the second-best outcome by assuming that the provider is self-interested. The model can be further extended to allow for different objective of the insurer, provider's informational advantage over patient, and auditing.

10.1002/hec.4206.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种三方契约问题，其中患者和医疗服务提供者拥有保险公司无法观察到的私人信息。我们指出，为了使保险机制能够防止勾结行为，保险公司只需依赖患者-提供者联盟中一方的激励即可。如果患者的风险溢价低于提供者的信息租金，那么将激励放在患者身上会比放在提供者身上产生更低的社会成本。我们还发现，如果提供者付出的努力受到患者的高度重视，那么保险公司应该依赖患者的激励来实施一种防止勾结的次优保险机制。有趣的是，一个无私的提供者可能会导致更高的社会成本，而一个自私的提供者则可能导致更低的社会成本。然而，即使保险公司不知道提供者的无私程度，通过假设提供者具有自私倾向，仍然可以实现次优的结果。该模型还可以进一步扩展，以考虑保险公司的不同目标、提供者相对于患者的信息优势以及审计问题。

abstract.text: We test a door-to-door marketing intervention aimed to increase use of a targeted health product among poor households. Specifically, we examine three treatments in which this good-chlorine tablets for drinking water purification-is: (1) sold alone, (2) sold alongside a familiar and cheaper side good that is priced at its retail value, and (3) sold alongside the same side good that is priced on a promotional offer. The side good when sold at retail price is intended to be an "opt-out" good to reduce the marketing pressure, which should in turn reduce the amount of products sold that go unused. When the side good is sold on promotion, however, we hypothesize that it reintroduces marketing pressure due to the "gift" aspect of the promotion. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that chlorine use is nearly double in the second condition compared to the other two conditions. Our results suggest that household valuation of a new product is shaped by both the presence and the price of a side good due to marketing pressure.

10.1002/hec.4207.abstractZh: 我们测试了一项门到门的营销干预措施，旨在提高贫困家庭对特定健康产品的使用率。具体来说，我们研究了三种销售方式：第一种是单独销售这种饮用水净化氯片；第二种是将其与一种价格较低的、人们熟悉的辅助商品一起销售；第三种是将其与同样的价格优惠辅助商品一起销售。当辅助商品以零售价销售时，其目的是作为一种“可选不买”的商品，以减少营销压力，从而减少未使用的产品数量。然而，当辅助商品在促销期间销售时，我们假设这会因促销的“赠品”性质而重新引入营销压力。与这一假设一致的是，我们发现第二种销售方式下的氯使用量几乎是其他两种销售方式的两倍。我们的研究结果表明，新产品的家庭接受度受到辅助商品存在与否及其价格的影响，这主要是由于营销压力所致。

abstract.text: Many epidemiological models of the COVID-19 pandemic have focused on preventing deaths. Questions have been raised as to the frailty of those succumbing to the COVID-19 infection. In this paper we employ standard life table methods to illustrate how the potential quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) losses associated with COVID-19 fatalities could be estimated, while adjusting for comorbidities in terms of impact on both mortality and quality of life. Contrary to some suggestions in the media, we find that even relatively elderly patients with high levels of comorbidity can still lose substantial life years and QALYs. The simplicity of the method facilitates straightforward international comparisons as the pandemic evolves. In particular, we compare five different countries and show that differences in the average QALY losses for each COVID-19 fatality is driven mainly by differing age distributions for those dying of the disease.

10.1002/hec.4208.abstractZh: 许多关于COVID-19大流行的流行病学模型都关注于预防死亡。人们提出了关于因COVID-19感染而死亡的人的脆弱性问题。在本文中，我们采用标准生命表方法，来估算与COVID-19死亡相关的潜在质量调整生命年（QALY）损失，同时考虑到合并症对死亡率和生活质量的影响。与媒体中的一些说法相反，我们发现即使是比较年老且合并症较多的患者，仍然会失去大量的生命年和QALY。该方法的简单性使得随着疫情的发展，可以进行直接的国际比较。特别是，我们比较了五个不同国家的情况，发现每个COVID-19死亡病例的平均QALY损失差异主要源于死亡人群的年龄分布不同。

abstract.text: This paper compares career expectations and career outcomes of Swiss healthcare assistants (HCA), an occupation created to increase the supply of nurses. We investigate whether HCAs can predict their own professional careers two years ahead by eliciting their expectations for a range of career alternatives, including nursing and other studies. Polytomous choice situations have rarely been analyzed using numerical probabilities in the expectations literature. Our results show that almost all respondents give informative answers to the probabilistic online survey question. Individuals express considerable uncertainty about their future careers, with over 60% attaching positive probabilities to more than one career alternative. The analyses reveal that individuals' numerical expectations have substantial predictive value for their future careers, even after controlling for many variables. This finding confirms that individuals have private information not directly available to researchers, and that eliciting choice probabilities for polytomous choice situations is a viable approach in surveys. However, the mean shares for career alternatives implied by individual probabilities do not fully coincide with actual shares and are more accurate over 4 than over 2 years. The information conveyed in expectations and their deviations from outcomes enables us to derive policy recommendations to increase transitions to nursing.

10.1002/hec.4209.abstractZh: 本文比较了瑞士医疗保健助理的职业期望与职业结果，这一职业的设立是为了增加护士的供应。我们研究了医疗保健助理是否能够通过调查他们对各种职业选择的期望来预测自己两年后的职业发展，这些职业选择包括护理及其他领域。在期望分析文献中，多选项选择情况很少使用数值概率进行分析。我们的研究结果显示，几乎所有受访者都对在线调查中的概率问题给出了有参考价值的回答。个人对未来职业的不确定性相当大，超过60%的人对多个职业选择赋予了正面的概率。分析表明，即使在控制了许多变量之后，个人对职业的期望仍然具有相当大的预测价值。这一发现证实了个人拥有研究人员无法直接获取的信息，而通过调查多选项选择情况下的选择概率是一种可行的研究方法。然而，个人概率所暗示的职业选择比例并不完全与实际比例一致，且四年内的预测准确性高于两年。通过期望中的信息及其与结果的偏差，我们可以得出政策建议，以促进向护理职业的过渡。

abstract.text: Environmental disasters impact disadvantaged communities disproportionately both through the epidemiological challenge of exposure, but also by undermining the progress of public health efforts. This paper studies changes to smoking cessation, breastfeeding, and weight gain during pregnancy in the period following the switch in water supply in Flint, Michigan, in April 2014. As the switch resulted in immediate and significant deterioration in water quality, eventually leading to its contamination with lead, we estimate a 10.5 percentage point increase in smoking and a 2.1 percentage point decrease in breastfeeding. We show evidence that these changes in maternal behavior are linked to increased stress due to changing water quality. We estimate that the increase in smoking alone is responsible for most of the increase in incidence of low birthweight among infants in Flint, resulting in $700 additional costs per birth. Increased smoking during pregnancy and lower breastfeeding rates in Flint roll back years of public health efforts, resulting in lifetime higher rates of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer for mothers in the community.

10.1002/hec.4210.abstractZh: 环境灾难对弱势社区的影响尤为严重，不仅通过暴露带来的流行病学挑战，还破坏了公共卫生工作的进展。本文研究了2014年4月密歇根州弗林特市供水系统更换后，吸烟、母乳喂养和孕期体重增长的变化。由于供水系统的更换导致水质立即显著恶化，最终使水受到铅污染，我们估计吸烟率增加了10.5个百分点，母乳喂养率减少了2.1个百分点。研究表明，这些母亲行为的变化与水质变化带来的压力增加有关。我们估计，吸烟率的上升是导致弗林特市婴儿低出生体重率增加的主要原因，每出生婴儿的成本增加了700美元。弗林特市孕期吸烟率的增加和母乳喂养率的降低，抵消了多年来公共卫生工作的成果，导致该社区的母亲一生中患心血管疾病、糖尿病和癌症的风险增加。

abstract.text: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) to prevent human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) enables female sex workers (FSWs) to protect themselves from HIV without relying on clients using condoms. Yet, because PrEP reduces HIV risk, financial incentives to not use condoms may lead to risk compensation: reductions in condom use and/or increases in commercial sex, and may reduce the price of unprotected sex. In this analysis, we integrate market forces into a dynamic HIV transmission model to assess how risk compensation could change the impact of PrEP among FSWs and clients. We parameterise how sexual behavior may change with PrEP use among FSWs using stated preference data combined with economic theory. Our projections suggest the impact of PrEP is sensitive to risk compensatory behaviors driven by changes in the economics of sex work. Condom substitution could reduce the impact of PrEP on HIV incidence by 55%, while increases in the frequency of commercial sex to counter decreases in the price charged for unprotected sex among PrEP users could entirely mitigate the impact of PrEP. Accounting for competition between PrEP users and nonusers exacerbates this further. Alternative scenarios where increases in unprotected sex among PrEP users are balanced by decreases in non-PrEP users have the opposite effect, resulting in PrEP having much greater impact. Intervention studies need to determine how HIV prevention products may change the economics of sex work and provision of unprotected sex to enable a better understanding of their impact.

10.1002/hec.4211.abstractZh: 预防性暴露预防（PrEP）用于预防人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）可以帮助女性性工作者（FSWs）在不依赖客户使用避孕套的情况下保护自己免受HIV感染。然而，由于PrEP降低了HIV风险，不使用避孕套的财务激励可能会导致风险补偿：避孕套使用量减少和/或商业性交易增加，这可能会降低无保护性行为的价格。在这项分析中，我们将市场力量纳入一个动态的HIV传播模型中，以评估风险补偿如何改变PrEP在FSWs和客户中的影响。我们使用陈述偏好数据结合经济理论来参数化PrEP使用对FSWs的性行为的影响。我们的预测表明，PrEP的影响对由性工作经济变化驱动的风险补偿行为非常敏感。避孕套替代可能使PrEP对HIV发病率的影响降低55%，而为了抵消PrEP使用者无保护性行为价格下降而增加商业性交易频率，可能会完全消除PrEP的影响。考虑到PrEP使用者与非使用者之间的竞争，这一影响会进一步加剧。在PrEP使用者中增加无保护性行为，同时减少非PrEP使用者的替代方案则会产生相反的效果，从而使PrEP产生更大的影响。干预研究需要确定HIV预防产品如何改变性工作的经济性和无保护性行为的发生，以便更好地理解它们的影响。

abstract.text: This study analyses mechanisms that link education to human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) with a focus on gender differences, using data from four nationally representative surveys in Botswana. To estimate the causal effect, an exogenous 1-year increase of junior secondary school is used. The key finding is that women and men responded differently to the reform. Among women, it led to delayed sexual debut and reduced time between first sex and marriage by up to a year. Among men, risky sex, measured by the likelihood of concurrent sexual partnerships and paying for sex, increased. The increase in risky sex among men is likely to be due to the education reform's positive impact on income. The reform reduced the likelihood of HIV infection sharply among women, especially among relatively young women age 18-24. The impact on men's likelihood of HIV infection is uncertain.

10.1002/hec.4212.abstractZh: 本研究分析了教育与人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）之间的关联机制，重点关注性别差异，并采用了博茨瓦纳四项具有全国代表性的调查数据。为了估算因果效应，采用了初级中学教育年限增加一年的假设。主要发现是，女性和男性对这项改革的反应不同。在女性中，这项改革导致性行为的开始时间推迟，首次性行为到结婚之间的时间延长了至少一年。而在男性中，通过同时性伴侣关系以及支付性交易费用来衡量，冒险性行为有所增加。男性冒险性行为增加的原因可能是教育改革对收入产生了积极影响。这项改革显著降低了女性感染HIV的风险，尤其是18-24岁之间的年轻女性。而男性感染HIV的风险则不确定。

abstract.text: With the implementation of the National Integrated Health System in 2007, the Uruguayan government extended social health insurance (SHI) to groups of individuals previously covered by the public safety net (PSN) or that paid for private insurance out-of-pocket. The policy allowed new beneficiaries to choose care from a set of private providers. In this study, we focus on the extension of SHI to adolescent mothers previously covered by the PSN. Exploiting the gradual incorporation of children of formal workers during the 2008-2013 period, and the geographic variation in the intensity of the reform, we find suggestive evidence that the increase in choice associated to the expansion of SHI decreased adolescent fertility, improved prenatal care and birthweight, and decreased first year mortality among low birthweight infants. These effects were only observed in the medium run, suggesting initial choice frictions and input shortage. We provide evidence that families increased their choice of private providers and that market concentration decreased in certain areas of the country, supporting the hypothesis that choice, and possibly competition, were the main mechanisms behind the findings.

10.1002/hec.4213.abstractZh: 随着2007年国家综合健康体系的实施，乌拉圭政府将社会健康保险扩展到了那些原本由公共安全网络覆盖或需自付私人保险费用的人群。该政策允许新的受益人从一系列私人医疗服务提供者中选择医疗服务。本研究重点关注将社会健康保险扩展至原本由公共安全网络覆盖的青少年母亲群体。通过分析2008-2013年期间正式工人子女逐渐纳入保险范围的情况，以及改革实施程度的地域差异，我们发现，社会健康保险扩展带来的选择增加有助于降低青少年生育率、改善产前护理和出生体重，并减少低出生体重婴儿在第一年的死亡率。这些效应仅在中期才显现，表明初期存在选择上的摩擦和资源短缺问题。我们的研究还表明，家庭增加了对私人医疗服务提供者的选择，并且该国的某些地区的市场集中度有所下降，这支持了选择以及可能的竞争是这些现象主要机制这一假设。

abstract.text: The integration of primary care organizations and interprofessional cooperation is encouraged in many countries to both improve the productive and allocative efficiency of care provision and address the unequal geographical distribution of general practitioners (GPs). In France, a pilot experiment promoted the vertical integration of and teamwork between GPs and nurses. This pilot experiment relied on the staffing and training of nurses; skill mixing, including the authorization to shift tasks from GPs to nurses; and new remuneration schemes. This article evaluates the overall impact of this pilot experiment over the period 2010-2017 on GP activities based on the following indicators: number of working days, patients seen at least once, patients registered, and visits delivered. We control for endogeneity and reduce selection bias by using a case-control design combining coarsened exact matching and difference-in-differences estimates on panel data. We find a small positive impact on the number of GP working days (+1.2%) following enrollment and a more pronounced effect on the number of patients seen (+7.55%) or registered (+6.87%). However, we find no effect on the number of office and home visits. In this context, cooperation and teamwork between GPs and nurses seem to improve access to care for patients.

10.1002/hec.4214.abstractZh: 许多国家都鼓励初级保健机构与跨专业之间的合作，以提高护理服务的生产效率和配置效率，并解决全科医生在地理分布上的不均衡问题。在法国，一项试点实验促进了全科医生与护士之间的垂直整合和团队合作。该试点实验依赖于护士的人员配备和培训、技能共享（包括授权全科医生将部分任务转交给护士）以及新的薪酬制度。本文基于以下指标，评估该试点实验在2010-2017年期间对全科医生活动的总体影响：工作天数、至少就诊一次的患者数量、注册患者数量以及提供的诊疗次数。我们通过使用病例对照设计来控制内生性问题并减少选择偏差，该设计结合了粗略的精确匹配和面板数据上的差异估计方法。研究发现，在试点实验实施后，全科医生的工作天数略有增加（+1.2%），而就诊患者数量和注册患者数量则出现了更显著的增加（+7.55%和+6.87%）。然而，我们发现该试点实验对门诊和家庭就诊次数没有显著影响。总体而言，全科医生与护士之间的合作和团队合作似乎有助于改善患者的就医机会。

abstract.text: This study addresses the question of how hospitals respond to the cross price incentives inherent in reimbursements based on diagnosis-related groups (DRG).
