Unique market-wide administrative data allow to exploit a natural experiment in Germany in which the relative attractiveness of greatly divergent reimbursements for clinically similar patients changes in the market for sepsis conditions on January 1, 2010. This natural experiment provides-unintentionally-extra reimbursements in cases in which hospitals reorganize transfers for deceasing patients to other facilities, alter the time of death, the choice of the condition being chiefly responsible for the hospital admission (primary diagnosis), or the intensity of mechanical ventilation. The differences-in-differences results demonstrate that hospitals primarily alter the primary diagnosis. As the choice of the primary diagnosis is the backbone of the design of modern DRG systems, the findings suggest that payment contracts between hospitals and payers based on modern DRG algorithms may not necessarily improve patient welfare.

10.1002/hec.4215.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了医院如何应对基于诊断相关分组（DRG）的报销机制所固有的交叉价格激励问题。通过利用德国范围内的独特市场数据，可以观察到2010年1月1日，对于临床相似但报销标准差异巨大的患者，医院在败血症治疗中的相对吸引力发生了变化。这一自然实验无意中揭示了：当医院为病情较轻的患者进行转院处理、改变死亡时间、确定导致住院的主要诊断，或调整机械通气强度时，医院会获得额外的报销。差异-差异结果表明，医院主要通过改变主要诊断来影响报销情况。由于主要诊断的选择是现代DRG系统设计的核心，这些发现提示，基于现代DRG算法制定的医院与支付方之间的支付协议，未必能真正改善患者的福利。

abstract.text: We study the effects of inherited socioeconomic characteristics on markers of unhealthy bodyweight. Taking Australian microdata from 2007 to 2013, we show that approximately 4% of the variation in outcomes is determined by factors beyond an individual's control, such as their race, gender, and social class. Paternal socioeconomic status is the primary explanatory factor, with those born to more affluent fathers slightly less likely to be overweight in adulthood. Decompositions reveal that only 20%-25% of this effect is attributable to advantaged families exhibiting better health behaviors, which implies that unobserved factors also play an important role. Since diseases associated with unhealthy weight place a major strain on public healthcare systems, our results have implications for the provision of treatment when resources are constrained.

10.1002/hec.4216.abstractZh: 我们研究了继承的社会经济特征对健康体重指标的影响。通过利用2007至2013年的澳大利亚微观数据，我们发现大约4%的结果变异是由个体无法控制的因素决定的，如种族、性别和社会阶层。父亲的社会经济地位是主要的解释因素，那些出生在较富裕家庭的孩子在成年后超重的可能性略低。分析显示，这一效应中只有20%-25%可以归因于优势家庭所表现出的更好的健康行为，这意味着未观察到的因素也起着重要作用。由于与不健康体重相关的疾病给公共医疗系统带来了巨大负担，我们的研究结果对于在资源有限的情况下提供治疗具有启示意义。

abstract.text: Prior studies have found that poor mental health during pregnancy is associated with poor birth outcomes, but little is known about the ability of mental health care access and treatment to counteract these effects. I use a difference-in-differences strategy exploiting the staggered enactment of state mental health parity laws in 25 states from 1995 to 2002 to identify the impact of mental health care access on the probability of an adverse birth outcome. These state mental health parity laws are insurance mandates requiring coverage of mental health care be equivalent to physical health care. Using birth records, I find that, among the group of mothers most likely to have private insurance, introduction of a mental health parity law in a state decreased the probability of an adverse birth outcome. Furthermore, I find that the parity laws decreased the likelihood that a pregnant woman hospitalized for delivery would receive a mental illness diagnosis.

10.1002/hec.4217.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，孕期心理健康状况不佳与不良出生结果相关，但关于心理健康服务的获取和治疗能否抵消这些影响，目前了解甚少。我采用差异-差异策略，利用1995年至2002年间25个州分阶段实施心理健康平等法律的情况，来研究心理健康服务获取对不良出生结果概率的影响。这些心理健康平等法律是保险强制规定，要求心理健康服务的覆盖与身体健康服务相当。通过出生记录分析，我发现，在拥有私人保险的母亲群体中，某一州实施心理健康平等法律后，不良出生结果的概率有所下降。此外，我还发现，这些平等法律降低了因分娩而住院的孕妇被诊断为精神疾病的几率。

abstract.text: Recent studies argue that major crises can have long-lasting effects on individual behavior. While most studies focused on natural disasters, we explore the consequences of the global pandemic caused by a lethal influenza virus in 1918-19: the so-called "Spanish Flu." This was by far the worst pandemic of modern history, causing up to 100 million deaths worldwide. Using information about attitudes of respondents to the General Social Survey, we find evidence that experiencing the pandemic likely had permanent consequences in terms of individuals' social trust. Our findings suggest that lower social trust was passed on to the descendants of the survivors of the Spanish Flu who migrated to the United States. As trust is a crucial factor for long-term economic development, our research offers a new angle from which to assess current health threats.

10.1002/hec.4218.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，重大危机可能对个人行为产生长期影响。虽然大多数研究集中在自然灾害上，但我们探讨了1918-19年间由致命流感病毒引发的全球大流行的后果，即所谓的“西班牙流感”。这是现代历史上最严重的疫情，导致全球多达1亿人死亡。通过《综合社会调查》中受访者态度的数据分析，我们发现经历这次大流行可能给个人的社会信任带来了永久性影响。我们的研究还发现，西班牙流感幸存者迁移到美国后，其后代的社会信任水平较低。由于信任是长期经济发展的关键因素，我们的研究为评估当前的健康威胁提供了一个新的视角。

abstract.text: Social accountability programs are increasingly used to improve the performance of public service providers in low-income settings. Despite their growing popularity, evidence on the effectiveness of social accountability programs remains mixed. In this manuscript, we assess the impact of a social accountability intervention on health facility management exploring quasiexperimental variation in program exposure in Tanzania. We find that the social accountability intervention resulted in a 1.8 SD reduction in drug stockouts relative to the control group, but did not improve facility infrastructure maintenance. The results of this study suggest that social accountability programs may be effective in areas of health service provision that are responsive to changes in provider behavior but may not work in settings where improvements in outcomes are conditional on larger health systems features.

10.1002/hec.4219.abstractZh: 社会问责制计划越来越多地被用于提升低收入地区公共服务提供者的绩效。尽管这类计划越来越受欢迎，但关于其有效性的证据仍然参差不齐。在本研究中，我们评估了社会问责制干预措施对坦桑尼亚医疗机构管理的影响，并探讨了该计划实施情况的准实验性差异。研究发现，社会问责制干预措施使药品短缺的情况减少了1.8个标准差，但并未改善医疗机构的基础设施维护状况。研究结果表明，社会问责制计划在那些能够适应提供者行为变化的医疗服务领域可能有效，但在那些结果改善依赖于更大规模卫生系统特征的环境中可能并不奏效。

abstract.text: This paper leverages the expansion of the United States' Community Health Center program over the 21st century to investigate whether improved access to health care reduces disability insurance (DI) participation at the county level. I find that the introduction of a health center that specializes in mental health and substance abuse services is associated with a 0.09 to 0.40 percentage point reduction in working-age DI enrollment in rural counties. A cost-benefit analysis indicates that the money saved from reduced program participation can account for more than a third of the cost the federal government faces in funding well-targeted health care access initiatives.

10.1002/hec.4220.abstractZh: 本文利用21世纪以来美国社区健康中心项目的扩展情况，研究改善医疗保健服务是否可以减少县级残疾保险参保人数。研究发现，在农村县中，设立专门提供心理健康和药物滥用服务的健康中心，可使工作年龄人口的残疾保险参保人数减少0.09至0.40个百分点。成本效益分析表明，通过减少项目参与而节省的资金，可以弥补联邦政府在资助精准医疗保健计划方面的三分之一以上成本。

abstract.text: Recent reports show that at least 95% of the world's population is breathing polluted air. However, the impact of air quality on air pollution-related medical expenditure and utilization is sparse. This study estimates the short-term health care cost impacts of air pollution using a meteorological phenomenon-thermal inversion-as an instrumental variable for air quality. Using information on outpatient care for respiratory diseases from universal health insurance claim data in Taiwan during 2006-2012, our estimates suggest that a one-unit reduction in the air quality index (AQI) leads to NT$2.3 billion (nearly US$74 million) of savings in respiratory-related outpatient expenditure per year. Given that the average AQI is equal to 32 during our study period, completely removing air pollution would reduce the national health expenditure by approximately 8% annually. Our results provide the important implication that the cost of controlling air pollutant emissions can be offset by curtailing health care expenditure.

10.1002/hec.4221.abstractZh: 最近的报告显示，全球至少有95%的人口呼吸着污染的空气。然而，空气质量对与空气污染相关的医疗支出和医疗利用的影响却很少被研究。本研究利用气象现象——热逆温——作为空气质量的一个工具变量，来估算空气污染对短期医疗保健成本的影响。通过利用2006年至2012年间台湾全民健康保险索赔数据中的呼吸系统疾病门诊护理信息，我们的估计表明，空气质量指数每降低一个单位，每年可节省23亿新台币（约合7400万美元）的呼吸系统疾病门诊费用。鉴于研究期间平均空气质量指数为32，完全消除空气污染将使国家医疗支出每年减少约8%。我们的研究结果表明，控制空气污染物的排放所付出的成本可以通过减少医疗保健支出来抵消。

abstract.text: In the Dutch health care system of managed competition, insurers and mental health providers negotiate on prices for mental health services. Contract prices are capped by a regulator who sets a maximum price for each mental health service. In 2013, the majority of the contract prices equaled these maximum prices. We study price setting after a major policy change in 2014. In 2014, mental health care providers had to negotiate prices with each individual health insurer separately, instead of with all insurers collectively as in 2013. Moreover, after a cost-price revision, the regulator increased in 2014 maximum prices by about 10%. Insurers and mental health providers reacted to this policy change by setting most contract prices below the new maximum prices. We find that in 2014 mental health providers with more market power, that is, a higher willingness-to-pay measure, contracted significantly higher prices. Some insurers negotiated significantly lower prices than other insurers but these differences are unrelated to an insurers' market share.

10.1002/hec.4222.abstractZh: 在荷兰的竞争性医疗体系中，保险公司和心理健康服务提供者会就心理健康服务的价格进行谈判。合同价格受到监管机构的限制，监管机构为每项心理健康服务设定了最高价格。2013年，大多数合同价格都符合这些最高价格。我们研究了2014年重大政策变化后的价格设定情况。2014年，心理健康服务提供者必须分别与每个保险公司单独谈判价格，而不是像2013年那样与所有保险公司集体谈判。此外，在成本价格调整之后，监管机构在2014年将最高价格提高了约10%。保险公司和心理健康服务提供者对这一政策变化做出了反应，将大多数合同价格设定在新的最高价格以下。我们发现，在2014年，具有更大市场力量的心理健康服务提供者，即支付意愿较高的服务提供者，签订了明显更高的价格。一些保险公司谈判出的价格明显低于其他保险公司，但这些差异与保险公司的市场份额无关。

abstract.text: This paper studies patient choice of provider following government reforms in the 2000s, which allowed for-profit surgical centers to compete with existing public National Health Service (NHS) hospitals in England. For-profit providers offer significant benefits, notably shorter waiting times. We estimate the extent to which different types of patients benefit from the reforms, and we investigate mechanisms that cause differential benefits. Our counterfactual simulations show that, in terms of the value of access, entry of for-profit providers benefitted the richest patients twice as much as the poorest, and white patients six times as much as ethnic minority patients. Half of these differences is explained by healthcare geography and patient health, while primary care referral practice plays a lesser, though non-negligible role. We also show that, with capitated reimbursement, different compositions of patient risks between for-profit surgical centers and existing public hospitals put public hospitals at a competitive disadvantage.

10.1002/hec.4223.abstractZh: 本文研究了2000年代政府改革后患者对医疗服务提供者的选择情况，这些改革使得营利性外科中心能够在英格兰与现有的公共国家卫生服务系统医院竞争。营利性医疗服务提供者提供了显著的优势，尤其是更短的等待时间。我们估算了不同类型的患者从改革中获益的程度，并探讨了导致差异的机制。我们的反事实模拟显示，在获取服务的价值方面，营利性医疗服务提供者的加入使最富有的患者获益程度是最贫穷患者的两倍，而白人患者获益程度是最少族裔患者的六倍。这些差异中有一半可以由医疗地理分布和患者健康状况来解释，而初级医疗转诊实践的作用虽然较小，但依然不可忽视。我们还指出，在固定费用报销制度下，营利性外科中心与现有公立医院之间患者风险的差异使得公立医院处于竞争劣势。

abstract.text: Mental health is a neglected health issue in developing countries. We test if mental health issues are particularly likely to occur among some of the most vulnerable children in developing countries: those that work. Despite falling in recent decades, child labor still engages 168 million children across the world. While the negative impacts of child labor on physical health are well documented, the effect of child labor on a child's psychosocial wellbeing has been neglected. We investigate this issue with a new dataset of 947 children aged 12-18 years from 750 households in 20 villages across five districts of Tamil Nadu, India. Our purpose-built survey allows for a holistic approach to the analysis of child wellbeing by accounting for levels of happiness, hope, emotional wellbeing, self-efficacy, fear and stress. We use a variety of econometric approaches, some of which utilize household-level fixed effects and account for differences between working and nonworking siblings. We document a robust, large and negative association between child labor and most measures of psychosocial wellbeing. The results are robust to a battery of exercises, including tests for selection on unobservables, randomization inference, instrumental variable techniques, and falsification exercises.

10.1002/hec.4224.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，心理健康是一个被忽视的健康问题。我们研究了在发展中国家一些最脆弱的儿童群体——那些从事劳动的儿童——中是否更容易出现心理健康问题。尽管近几十年来童工现象有所减少，但全球仍有1.68亿儿童从事童工劳动。虽然童工对身体健康的影响已有充分记录，但童工对儿童的心理社会福祉的影响却一直被忽视。我们利用来自印度泰米尔纳德邦五个地区750户家庭中的947名12-18岁儿童的新数据集来研究这一问题。我们的调查采用全面的方法，考虑了幸福感、希望、情绪健康、自我效能感、恐惧和压力等多个维度，从而全面分析儿童福祉状况。我们采用了多种计量经济学方法，其中一些方法利用了家庭层面的固定效应，并考虑了从事劳动与未从事劳动 siblings之间的差异。我们的研究结果表明，童工与大多数心理社会福祉指标之间存在显著的负相关关系。这些结果在一系列检验中均保持稳定，包括针对不可观测变量的选择问题、随机化推断、工具变量技术以及伪造检验等。

abstract.text: We study the link between health status and economic preferences using survey data from 22 Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries. We hypothesize that there is a relationship between poor health and the preferences that people hold, and therefore their choices and decisions. We find that individuals with a limiting health condition are more risk averse and less patient, and that this is true for physical and mental health conditions. The magnitudes of the health gap are approximately 60% and 70% of the gender gap in risk and time preferences, respectively. Importantly, the health gaps are large for males, females, young, old, school dropouts, degree holders, employed, nonemployed, rich, and poor. They also hold for countries with different levels of gross domestic product (GDP), inequality, social expenditure, and disease burden.

10.1002/hec.4225.abstractZh: 我们利用来自22个经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家的调查数据，研究了健康状况与经济偏好之间的关系。我们假设健康状况不佳与人们的偏好之间存在关联，从而影响他们的选择和决策。研究发现，患有严重健康状况的个体更倾向于规避风险，且耐心较差，这一特征在身体和心理健康状况中均存在。健康方面的差异大约相当于性别在风险和时间偏好方面的差异的60%和70%。值得注意的是，这种健康差异在男性、女性、年轻人、老年人、辍学者、毕业生、就业者、非就业者、富裕者和贫困者中均较为明显。这些差异在不同国内生产总值（GDP）、不平等程度、社会支出和疾病负担水平的国家中同样存在。

abstract.text: We estimate the impacts of losing access to parental health insurance on Supplemental Security Income (SSI) participation, focusing on the age-26 limit for dependent coverage. We analyze the age pattern of SSI claims to develop counterfactual predictions that assume no change in access to insurance. Relative to this prediction, we find a 3.4% spike in SSI applications in the months immediately surrounding the 26th birthday, along with a slightly smaller increase in awards. These claims are primarily motivated by losing coverage; there might be more direct ways to address unmet insurance needs without also increasing reliance on cash payments.

10.1002/hec.4226.abstractZh: 我们评估了失去父母健康保险对补充社会保障金（SSI）参与率的影响，重点关注依赖保险覆盖的年龄限制为26岁的情况。我们通过分析SSI索赔的年龄分布，提出了假设保险获取情况不变的反事实预测。与这一预测相比，我们发现在26岁生日前后几个月内，SSI申请数量增加了3.4%，而发放金额的增长幅度则略小。这些索赔主要是由于失去保险覆盖而产生的；或许存在更直接的方法来解决未满足的保险需求，而无需增加对现金支付的依赖。

abstract.text: The literature on the effect of psychotherapy for schizophrenia is limited and characterized by small samples and possible bias from risk selection. We examined the effects of psychotherapy on suicide attempts and health and economic outcomes using an instrumental variable (IV) approach that exploits the variation in the propensities of hospital departments to prescribe psychotherapy. This was supplemented with naïve probit models as exogeneity could not be ruled out for all of the outcomes. The validity of the instrument was examined by distributional plots and various tests. The assumed randomness in referring patients to providers with high versus low propensities to psychotherapy appeared to be a critical aspect. Splitting the sample into homogeneous provider types did not substantially alter the results. Based on the IV results, we found no support for the effect of psychotherapy on suicide attempt, psychiatric readmission, assisted living, or labor market attachment. However, we cannot rule out smaller effects due to confidence intervals including the probit estimates. The main contribution of this study is new evidence on a broad range of outcomes and a large and representative population.

10.1002/hec.4227.abstractZh: 关于心理治疗对精神分裂症影响的文献较为有限，且样本量较小，还存在因风险选择而产生的偏差。我们采用工具变量方法，利用医院部门对心理治疗的需求差异来研究心理治疗对自杀企图、健康及经济结果的影响。同时，由于无法排除所有结果的外生性因素，我们还使用了朴素Probit模型进行补充分析。通过分布图和各种检验方法，我们验证了工具变量的有效性。在将患者分配到具有不同心理治疗需求倾向的医疗机构时，随机性是一个关键因素。将样本分为具有相似治疗需求的医疗机构类型，并未显著改变研究结果。根据工具变量结果，我们没有发现心理治疗对自杀企图、精神科再入院、辅助生活或劳动力市场参与度有显著影响。然而，由于置信区间包含了Probit估计值，我们无法完全排除较小规模的影响。本研究的主要贡献在于为一系列结果提供了新的证据，并且样本数量较大且具有代表性。

abstract.text: Primary healthcare systems are central to achieving universal healthcare coverage. However, in many low- and middle-income country settings, primary care quality is challenged by inadequate facility infrastructure and equipment, limited human resources, and poor provider process. We study the effects of a recent large-scale quality improvement policy in South Africa, the Ideal Clinics Realization and Maintenance Program (ICRMP). The ICRMP introduced a set of standards for facilities and a quality improvement process involving manuals, district-based support, and external assessment. Exploiting differential prioritization of facilities for the ICRMP's quality improvement process, we apply differences-in-differences methods to identify the effects of the program's efforts on standards scores and primary care quality indicators over the first 12 months of implementation. We find large and statistically significant increases in standards scores, but mixed effects on care outcomes-a small magnitude improvement in early antenatal care usage, null effects on childhood immunization and cervical cancer screening, and small negative effect of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) care. While the ICRMP process has led to significant improvements in facilities' satisfaction of the program's standards, we were unable to detect meaningful change in care quality indicators.

10.1002/hec.4228.abstractZh: 初级医疗体系是实现全民医疗覆盖的关键。然而，在许多低收入和中等收入国家，初级医疗的质量受到设施基础设施和设备的不足、人力资源的限制以及医疗服务提供流程的缺陷所困扰。我们研究了南非一项大规模质量改进政策——理想诊所实现与维护计划（ICRMP）的效果。该计划引入了一套设施标准以及包括手册、地区级支持和外部评估在内的质量改进流程。通过利用ICRMP质量改进过程中对设施的不同优先级安排，我们采用差异-差异方法来识别该计划实施前12个月中，其对标准评分和初级医疗质量指标的影响。我们发现标准评分有显著且统计学上显著的提升，但在护理结果方面则存在混合效应——早期产前护理的使用率有小幅提升，儿童免疫接种和宫颈癌筛查效果无明显变化，而人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）护理则产生了轻微的负面影响。尽管ICRMP流程显著提高了设施对计划标准的满足度，但我们未能检测到护理质量指标方面的实质性变化。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness analyses of health care programs often focus on maximizing health and ignore nonhealth impacts. Assessing the cost-effectiveness of public health interventions from a narrow health care perspective would likely underestimate their full impact, and potentially lead to inefficient decisions about funding. The aim of this study is to provide a practical application of a recently proposed framework for the economic evaluation of public health interventions, evaluating an intervention to reduce alcohol misuse in criminal offenders. This cross-sectoral analysis distinguishes benefits and opportunity costs for different sectors, makes explicit the value judgments required to consider alternative perspectives, and can inform heterogeneous decision makers with different objectives in a transparent manner. Three interventions of increasing intensity are compared: client information leaflet, brief advice, and brief lifestyle counseling. Health outcomes are measured in quality-adjusted life-years and criminal justice outcomes in reconvictions. Costs considered include intervention costs, costs to the NHS and costs to the criminal justice system. The results are presented for four different perspectives: "narrow" health care perspective; criminal justice system perspective; "full" health care perspective; and joint "full" health and criminal justice perspective. Conclusions and recommendations differ according to the normative judgment on the appropriate perspective for the evaluation.

10.1002/hec.4229.abstractZh: 关于医疗保健项目的成本效益分析通常侧重于最大化健康效益，而忽视了非健康影响。从狭隘的医疗保健角度来评估公共卫生干预措施的成本效益，可能会低估其整体影响，并可能导致资金分配决策的不合理。本研究旨在将最近提出的公共卫生干预措施经济评估框架应用于实际案例，即评估一项旨在减少刑事罪犯酒精滥用的干预措施。该跨领域分析区分了不同领域的收益与机会成本，明确了对不同视角进行考虑所需的价值判断，并以透明的方式为具有不同目标的异构决策者提供信息。本研究比较了三种强度不同的干预措施：客户信息宣传册、简短建议和简短生活方式咨询。健康成果以质量调整生命年来衡量，刑事司法成果则以再监禁次数来表示。考虑的成本包括干预措施的成本、国民健康服务体系的成本以及刑事司法系统的成本。研究结果从四个不同的视角进行呈现：“狭隘”的医疗保健视角；刑事司法系统视角；“全面”的医疗保健视角；以及综合的“全面”健康与刑事司法视角。结论和建议因对评估适用视角的规范判断不同而有所差异。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal effect of accidents on employment and earnings among Chilean men using event study methods and monthly administrative data. An accident of any type reduces the probability of being employed by 8.4 percentage points in the first year, by 11.2 percentage points in the second year, and by 14.8 percentage points in the third year after the accident. On average, over the three years after the accident, employment declines by 14%, relative to the pre-accident mean. In addition, accidents reduce monthly earnings by around 11% in the first year, 17% in the second year, and 22% in the third year after the accident. On average, monthly earnings fall by 16%, relative to the pre-accident average. Thus, we estimate persistent and increasing labor market effects of accidents over time. These effects vary by individuals' age, education, and industry and by severity of the accident. Our findings imply that the economic consequences of health shocks go beyond direct medical expenses.

10.1002/hec.4230.abstractZh: 我们通过事件研究方法和月度行政数据，估计了事故对智利男性就业和收入的影响。任何类型的事故都会使事故发生后的第一年就业概率降低8.4个百分点，第二年降低11.2个百分点，第三年降低14.8个百分点。在事故发生的三年期间，平均而言，就业率相比事故前均值下降了14%。此外，事故还会使事故发生后的第一年月收入降低约11%，第二年降低17%，第三年降低22%。平均而言，月收入相比事故前均值下降了16%。因此，我们估计事故对劳动力市场的影响具有持续性且逐渐加剧的趋势。这些影响因个体的年龄、教育水平、行业以及事故的严重程度而异。我们的研究结果表明，健康冲击的经济后果不仅仅局限于直接的医疗费用。

abstract.text: The fetal origins hypothesis suggests that health and nutrition shocks in utero are causally related to health deficits in old age. It has received considerable empirical support, both within epidemiology and economics but so far it has not been integrated into a life cycle theory of human aging and longevity. The present study shows that the health deficit model, based on the frailty index developed in gerontology, generates shock amplification consistent with the hypothesis. In order to discuss human health over the life cycle from conception to death, we develop a theory of ontogenetic growth and health in utero and during childhood, unify it with the health deficit model of adult aging, and discuss the transmission of early-life shocks to late-life health deficit accumulation.

10.1002/hec.4231.abstractZh: 胎儿起源假说认为，子宫内的健康与营养冲击与老年期的健康缺陷之间存在因果关系。这一假说在流行病学和经济学领域都获得了大量实证支持，但迄今为止尚未被整合到人类衰老和长寿的生命周期理论中。本研究表明，基于老年学开发的脆弱性指数的健康缺陷模型能够产生与假说一致的冲击放大效应。为了讨论从受孕到死亡的生命周期中的人类健康，我们发展了一个关于子宫内及儿童期生长与健康的理论，并将其与成人衰老的健康缺陷模型相结合，探讨早期生活冲击对后期健康缺陷积累的传递作用。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of monitoring institutions on market outcomes in health care. Healthcare markets are characterized by asymmetric information. Physicians have an information advantage over patients with respect to appropriate treatments, which they may exploit through over- or under-provision or by overcharging. We introduce two types of costly monitoring: endogenous and exogenous monitoring. When monitoring detects misbehavior, physicians have to pay a fine. Endogenous monitoring can be requested by patients, while exogenous monitoring is performed randomly by a third party. We present a toy model that enables us to derive hypotheses and test them in a laboratory experiment. Our results show that introducing endogenous monitoring reduces the level of undertreatment and overcharging. Even under high monitoring costs, the threat of patient monitoring is sufficient to discipline physicians. Exogenous monitoring also reduces undertreatment and overcharging when performed sufficiently frequently. Market efficiency increases when endogenous monitoring is introduced and when exogenous monitoring is implemented with sufficient frequency. Our results suggest that monitoring may be a feasible instrument to improve outcomes in healthcare markets.

10.1002/hec.4232.abstractZh: 本文研究了监控机构对医疗市场结果的影响。医疗市场具有信息不对称的特点。医生在适当治疗方面比患者拥有更多的信息优势，他们可以通过过度或不足提供医疗服务或过度收费来利用这一优势。我们引入了两种类型的昂贵监控：内生监控和外在监控。当监控发现不当行为时，医生必须支付罚款。内生监控可以由患者提出，而外在监控则由第三方随机执行。我们提出了一个简单模型，通过该模型可以推导出假设并在实验室实验中进行测试。我们的结果显示，引入内生监控可以减少治疗不足和过度收费的情况。即使在高监控成本的情况下，患者监控的威胁也足以约束医生的行为。当外在监控的频率足够高时，同样可以减少治疗不足和过度收费。引入内生监控以及实施足够频繁的外在监控时，市场效率会提高。我们的结果表明，监控可能是改善医疗市场结果的一种可行手段。

abstract.text: Comparing median outcomes to gauge treatment effectiveness is widespread practice in clinical and other investigations. While common, such difference-in-median characterizations of effectiveness are but one way to summarize how outcome distributions compare. This paper explores properties of median treatment effects (TEs) as indicators of treatment effectiveness. The paper's main focus is on decisionmaking based on median TEs and it proceeds by considering two paths a decisionmaker might follow. Along one, decisions are based on point-identified differences in medians alongside partially identified median differences; along the other decisions are based on point-identified differences in medians in conjunction with other point-identified parameters. On both paths familiar difference-in-median measures play some role yet in both the traditional standards are augmented with information that will often be relevant in assessing treatments' effectiveness. Implementing either approach is straightforward. In addition to its analytical results the paper considers several policy contexts in which such considerations arise. While the paper is framed by recently reported findings on treatments for COVID-19 and uses several such studies to explore empirically some properties of median-treatment-effect measures of effectiveness, its results should be broadly applicable.

10.1002/hec.4233.abstractZh: 在临床及其他研究中，通过比较中位数结果来评估治疗效果是一种普遍的做法。虽然这种基于中位数差异的描述方式很常见，但它只是总结结果分布差异的一种方式。本文探讨了作为治疗效果指标的 Median Treatment Effects（TEs）的特性。文章的主要焦点是基于中位数TEs进行决策，并探讨了决策者在两种不同路径上的决策方式。在一种路径上，决策基于中位数上的点识别差异以及部分识别的中位数差异；在另一种路径上，决策则基于中位数上的点识别差异以及其他点识别参数。在这两种路径上，常见的基于中位数差异的度量方法仍然发挥作用，但传统标准得到了补充，这些补充信息在评估治疗效果时往往具有相关性。采用任何一种方法都很简单。除了分析结果外，文章还考虑了在多种政策背景下出现此类考虑的情况。虽然本文以最近关于COVID-19治疗的研究为基础，并借助这些研究来实证探讨中位数治疗效果指标的一些特性，但其结果应该具有广泛的适用性。

abstract.text: We aim to investigate the cost containment effects of the creation in 2005 of agencies specifically responsible for all technical and administrative services within the regional healthcare system of the Tuscany region of Italy. We seek to contribute to the existing literature on the centralization and decentralization of purchases and technical services by assessing the amount of savings produced by these agencies at the intermediate level between local authorities and hospitals and the regional administration. We use the balances of all Italian local health authorities and hospital trusts combined with the synthetic control procedure to create from a donor pool of untreated units a weighted average of observations resembling the exposed units before and after the policy change in 2005. The magnitude of the effect is significant as the creation of these agencies is estimated to have reduced expenditures on auxiliary goods and contracted services by 6% in the period from 2006-2014. Moreover, we find that the cost reduction is not associated with a decrease in the provision of healthcare services and procedures to the general population or in the quality or efficiency of the regional healthcare system itself.

10.1002/hec.4234.abstractZh: 我们的研究旨在探讨2005年设立专门负责意大利托斯卡纳地区区域医疗系统所有技术和服务管理的机构的成本控制效果。通过评估这些机构在地方当局与医院以及区域行政机构之间的中间层级所实现的节省金额，我们希望为关于采购和技术服务集中化与分散化问题的现有文献做出贡献。我们采用了所有意大利地方卫生当局和医院信托机构的统计数据，并结合综合控制方法，从未受影响的单位样本中计算出一个加权平均值，以模拟2005年政策变更前后暴露单位的状况。研究结果表明，这些机构的设立确实减少了2006至2014年期间辅助商品和合同服务的支出，降幅达到了6%。此外，我们发现成本降低并未导致向普通民众提供的医疗服务和程序的减少，也未影响区域医疗系统的质量或效率。

abstract.text: Medical expenditure risk is widely believed to reduce households' willingness to bear other risks and in turn alter their behavior. In this paper, we investigate the role of health insurance in household financial decision. To this end, we consider a double-multinomial discrete-factor model of insurance choice and portfolio allocation. Using data from a Chinese household survey, we find that enrolling in a health insurance scheme with better policies is associated with a higher probability of owning risky assets. This positive effect is stronger for households with lower risk aversion. Our findings suggest that risk attitudes could indirectly influence portfolio outcomes through affecting households' responsiveness to changes in medical expenditure risk.

10.1002/hec.4235.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，医疗支出风险会降低家庭承担其他风险的意愿，从而改变他们的行为。在本文中，我们研究了健康保险在家庭财务决策中的作用。为此，我们采用了一种双多项式离散因素模型来研究保险选择和投资组合的分配。通过中国家庭调查的数据分析，我们发现，加入政策更优的健康保险计划与持有风险资产的概率更高之间存在关联。这种正面效应在风险厌恶程度较低的家庭中更为明显。我们的研究结果表明，风险态度可能通过影响家庭对医疗支出风险变化的反应，间接影响投资组合的结果。

abstract.text: It is well established that the underlying theoretical assumptions needed to obtain a constant proportional trade-off between a quality adjusted life year (QALY) and willingness to pay (WTP) are restrictive and often empirically violated. In this paper, we set out to investigate whether the proportionality conditions (in terms of scope insensitivity and severity independence) can be satisfied when data is restricted to include only respondents who pass certain consistency criteria. We hypothesize that the more we restrict the data, the better the compliance with the requirement of constant proportional trade-off between WTP and QALY. We revisit the Danish data from the European Value of a QALY survey eliciting individual WTP for a QALY (WTP-Q). Using a "chained approach" respondents were first asked to value a specified health state using the standard gamble (SG) or the time-trade-off (TTO) approach and subsequently asked their WTP for QALY gains of 0.05 and 0.1 (tailored according to the respondent's SG/TTO valuation). Analyzing the impact of the different exclusion criteria on the two proportionality conditions, we find strong evidence against a constant WTP-Q. Restricting our data to include only respondents who pass the most stringent consistency criteria does not impact on the performance of the proportionality conditions for WTP-Q.

10.1002/hec.4236.abstractZh: 已有大量研究表明，实现质量调整生命年（QALY）与支付意愿（WTP）之间恒定比例权衡所需的理论基础假设往往具有限制性，并且在实际中经常遭到违反。本文旨在探讨，当数据仅限于符合特定一致性标准的受访者时，比例性条件（在范围不敏感性和严重性独立性方面）是否仍然能够满足。我们假设，数据限制越严格，WTP与QALY之间恒定比例权衡的要求就越能得到更好的遵守。我们重新审视了欧洲QALY价值调查中的丹麦数据，该调查旨在获取个体对QALY收益的支付意愿（WTP-Q）。采用“链式方法”，首先让受访者使用标准赌博法或时间权衡法对特定健康状态进行估值，随后再询问他们对0.05和0.1 QALY收益支付的意愿（根据受访者的SG/TTO估值进行调整）。通过分析不同排除标准对两种比例性条件的影响，我们发现有强有力的证据表明WTP-Q并不恒定。将数据限制为仅包括符合最严格一致性标准的受访者，并不会影响WTP-Q的比例性条件的表现。

abstract.text: Using data from Truven Health MarketScan Commercial Claims and Encounters Database between 2009 and 2015, we studied the effects of medical and recreational marijuana laws on opioid prescribing in employer-sponsored health insurance. We used a differences-in-differences (DD) approach and found that the implementation of medical marijuana laws (MMLs) and recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) reduced morphine milligram equivalents per enrollee by 7% and 13%, respectively. The reduction associated with MMLs was predominately in people aged 55-64, whereas the reduction associated with RMLs was largely in people aged 35-44 and aged 45-54. Our findings suggest that both MMLs and RMLs have the potential to reduce opioid prescribing in the privately insured population, especially for the middle-aged population.

10.1002/hec.4237.abstractZh: 我们利用Truven Health MarketScan商业索赔和接触数据库中的数据，对2009年至2015年期间医疗大麻和娱乐大麻法律对雇主赞助的健康保险中阿片类药物处方的影响进行了研究。采用差异对差异（DD）方法分析后发现，医疗大麻法律的实施使每位参保人的吗啡毫克当量分别减少了7%和13%。与医疗大麻法律相关的减少主要发生在55-64岁的人群中，而娱乐大麻法律相关的减少则主要发生在35-44岁和45-54岁的人群中。我们的研究结果表明，医疗大麻法律和娱乐大麻法律都有潜力减少私人保险人群中的阿片类药物处方，尤其是中年人群。

abstract.text: The author analyzes how risk preferences affect primary prevention for health risks using Kihlstrom and Mirman (1974) transformation function approach. This ensures consistency of ordinal preferences. Higher risk aversion may increase or decrease optimal prevention depending on a probability threshold. Higher downside risk aversion always has a negative effect on optimal prevention. Our findings corroborate the role of downside risk aversion as an important determinant of optimal prevention for health risks but renders fear of sickness irrelevant. We also point out several unique properties of prevention for health risks compared to financial risks.

10.1002/hec.4238.abstractZh: 作者分析了风险偏好如何影响健康风险的主要预防措施，采用了Kihlstrom和Mirman（1974）的转换函数方法。这确保了序数偏好的一致性。较高的风险厌恶程度可能会根据概率阈值的不同，增加或减少最优预防措施的效果。较高的下行风险厌恶程度总是会对最优预防措施产生负面影响。我们的研究结果证实了下行风险厌恶程度是健康风险最优预防措施的重要决定因素，但表明对疾病的恐惧并不重要。我们还指出了与健康风险相关的预防措施与金融风险相关的预防措施之间的几个独特之处。

abstract.text: The capability approach is potentially valuable for economic evaluation at the end of life because of its conceptualization of wellbeing as freedom and the potential for capturing outcomes for those at end of life and those close to persons at the end of life. For decision making, however, this information needs to be integrated into current evaluation paradigms. This research explored weights for an integrated economic evaluation framework using a deliberative approach. Twelve focus groups were held (38 members of the public, 29 "policy makers," seven hospice volunteers); budget pie tasks were completed to generate weights. Constant comparison was used to analyze qualitative data, exploring principles behind individuals' weightings. Average weights elicited from members of the general population and policy makers for the importance that should be given to close persons (vs. patients) were very similar, at around 30%. A "sliding scale" of weights between health gain and the capability for a good death resulted from the policy maker and volunteer groups, with increasing weight given to the capability for a good death as the trajectory got closer to death. These weights can be used in developing a more comprehensive framework for economic evaluation at end of life.

10.1002/hec.4239.abstractZh: 能力方法在生命终末期的经济评估中具有潜在价值，因为它将福祉概念化为自由，并且能够捕捉生命终末期的人以及与他们关系密切的人的结果。然而，在决策过程中，这些信息需要整合到现有的评估框架中。本研究采用审议方法，探讨了用于综合经济评估框架的权重。共举行了12个焦点小组（38名公众成员、29名“政策制定者”和7名临终关怀志愿者）；通过预算分配任务来生成权重。采用恒定比较法分析定性数据，探讨个人权重背后的原则。来自普通民众和政策制定者的平均权重显示，对于与临终者相比应给予患者的重视程度，两者非常接近，约为30%。政策制定者和志愿者小组提出的权重“滑动比例”显示，随着评估接近死亡阶段，给予“良好死亡能力”的权重逐渐增加。这些权重可用于开发更全面的生命终末期经济评估框架。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of delaying retirement on mortality among the French population. We take advantage of the 1993 pension reform in the private sector to identify the causal effect of an increase in claiming age on mortality. We use administrative data which provide detailed information on career characteristics, dates of birth and death. Our results, precisely estimated, show that an exogenous increase of one year in the claiming age has no significant impact on the probability to die, measured between age 61 and 79, even when we allow for nonlinear effects of treatment intensity. To test the power of our sample to detect statistically significant effects for rare events like death, we compute minimum detectable effects (MDEs). Our MDE estimates suggest that, if an impact of later retirement on mortality would be detectable, it would remain very small in magnitude.

10.1002/hec.4240.abstractZh: 本文研究了推迟退休对法国人口死亡率的影响。我们利用1993年私营部门的养老金改革数据，来识别退休年龄提高对死亡率的因果效应。我们使用的行政数据提供了关于职业特征、出生日期和死亡日期的详细信息。我们的精确估计结果显示，退休年龄外生增加一年对61至79岁之间死亡概率的影响并不显著，即使我们考虑了处理强度的非线性效应。为了检验我们的样本在检测如死亡这样的罕见事件时是否具有统计显著性，我们计算了最小可检测效应。我们的MDE估计表明，如果推迟退休对死亡率的影响能够被检测到，其影响幅度将非常微小。

abstract.text: In this paper we adopt a growth accounting projection model to estimate and characterize health-financing needs in Brazil as well as to assess the extent to which financing needs may diverge from spending capacity in the future. We estimate an annual increase of 0.71% in the share of projected financing needs relative to GDP, with excess growth rates being 0.74% and 0.69% for the public and private health sectors, respectively. Institutional reforms and public spending restrictions may leverage public-private segmentation in health financing throughout the next decades, thus potentially leading to losses of equity in the system. Our projections contribute to a scant empirical literature on health financing sustainability in low- and middle-income countries and shed light on the role of spending capacity and institutional constraints over the path towards universal health coverage.

10.1002/hec.4241.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用增长核算预测模型来估算和描述巴西的卫生融资需求，并评估未来融资需求与支出能力之间的差距。我们估计，预计融资需求占GDP的比例每年将增加0.71%，其中公共卫生部门和私营卫生部门的增长率分别为0.74%和0.69%。制度改革和公共支出限制可能会在未来几十年加剧卫生融资的公私分割，从而可能导致系统中的股权损失。我们的预测为关于低收入和中等收入国家卫生融资可持续性的实证研究提供了补充，并揭示了支出能力和制度约束在实现全民健康覆盖过程中的作用。

abstract.text: We model the locational determinants of nine categories of healthcare services in the contiguous United States using restricted access federal establishment data. These data enable close examination of rural health services, which are subject to suppression in publicly published data sources. After reviewing differences in public and unsuppressed restricted data and testing underlying data generation processes for each healthcare industry, including the Poisson, negative binomial, and their zero-inflated counterparts, we estimate marginal effects for four categories of independent variables: place-based factors, financial access, characteristics of population, and industry interdependencies. Findings show establishments are less likely to be found with high concentrations of Medicare and Medicaid recipients, while agglomerations are associated with more establishments. Nonemployer establishments serve a broader spectrum of people, but the rural poor still experience less access to health care.

10.1002/hec.4242.abstractZh: 我们使用受限的联邦机构数据，对美国本土九类医疗服务的区位决定因素进行了建模。这些数据使我们能够详细研究在公开数据来源中被忽略的农村医疗服务。在审查公共数据与受限数据的差异，并测试每个医疗行业的底层数据生成过程后，包括泊松分布、负二项分布及其零膨胀对应分布，我们估计了四个独立变量的边际效应：基于地点的因素、财务可及性、人口特征以及行业间的相互依赖关系。研究发现，机构更不容易出现在拥有大量医疗保险和医疗补助患者的地区，而某些聚集区则拥有更多的机构。非雇主机构服务的人群更为广泛，但农村贫困人口仍然难以获得医疗服务。

abstract.text: This paper measures consumer responsiveness to cost sharing in healthcare using a regression discontinuity design. I use a novel and detailed claims-level dataset from the Colombian healthcare market, where the government exogenously determines a tier system for coinsurance rates and copays based on the enrollee's monthly income. I find that patients exposed to higher coinsurance rates demand fewer services relative to patients facing lower cost sharing. This reduction holds for both discretionary and preventive services. Lower utilization translates into lower costs, despite evidence that patients facing higher prices do not substitute away from more expensive providers.

10.1002/hec.4244.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计，测量消费者对医疗成本分担的响应能力。我使用了来自哥伦比亚医疗市场的新型且详细的数据集，该数据集记录了政府根据参保者的月收入自主设定的共同保险费率和自付费用等级。研究发现，面临较高共同保险费率的患者，相对于面临较低成本分担的患者，对服务的需求较低。这种需求减少适用于自主选择和预防性服务。较低的利用率意味着较低的成本，尽管有证据表明，面临较高价格的患者并不会转向更昂贵的医疗服务提供者。

abstract.text: Multi-attribute choices are commonly analyzed in economics to value goods and services. Analysis assumes individuals consider all attributes, making trade-offs between them. Such decision-making is cognitively demanding, often triggering alternative decision rules. We develop a new model where individuals aggregate multi-attribute information into meta-attributes. Applying our model to a choice experiment (CE) dataset, accounting for attribute aggregation (AA) improves model fit. The probability of adopting AA is greater for: homogenous attribute information; participants who had shorter response time and failed the dominance test; and for later located choices. Accounting for AA has implications for welfare estimates. Our results underline the importance of accounting for information processing rules when modelling multi-attribute choices.

10.1002/hec.4245.abstractZh: 在经济学中，多属性选择通常被用来评估商品和服务的价值。分析假设个体会考虑所有属性，并在这些属性之间进行权衡。这种决策过程需要较高的认知能力，常常会导致不同的决策规则的运用。我们开发了一个新模型，该模型将多属性信息汇总为综合属性。将我们的模型应用于选择实验数据集时，考虑属性汇总因素可以提高模型的拟合度。采用属性汇总的概率在以下情况下更高：属性信息同质的情况；响应时间较短且未能通过支配性测试的参与者；以及位于较后位置的选择项。考虑属性汇总因素对福利估计有重要影响。我们的研究结果强调了在建模多属性选择时，考虑信息处理规则的重要性。

abstract.text: Stated preference (SP) survey responses may not predict actual behavior, leading to hypothetical bias. We developed an approach that harnesses large-scale routine data to help SP surveys provide more accurate estimates of revealed preferences (RPs), within a study which elicited preferences for alternative changes to the blood service in England. The SP survey responses were used to predict the mean number of annual whole blood donations. Ex ante, the iterative survey design estimated hypothetical bias by contrasting pilot SP survey responses (N = 1254), with individually linked data on RPs, to inform the main SP survey design (N = 25,187). Ex post, the analysis recognized mediation of the relationship between SP and RP when blood donation is deferred. The pilot survey reported that donors' intended donation frequency of 3.2 (men) and 2.6 (women) times per year, exceeded their actual frequency by 41% and 30% respectively. Choice scenario attributes for the main SP survey were then modified, and over-prediction subsequently decreased to 34% for men and 16% for women. The mediating effect of deferrals explained 29% (men) and 86% (women) of the residual discrepancy between SP and RP. Future studies can use this approach to reduce hypothetical bias, and provide more accurate predictions for decision-making.

10.1002/hec.4246.abstractZh: 陈述性偏好调查回应可能无法预测实际行为，从而导致假设性偏差。我们开发了一种方法，利用大规模常规数据来帮助陈述性偏好调查提供更准确的显性偏好估计，该研究旨在了解英格兰血液服务替代方案的偏好选择。陈述性偏好调查回应被用来预测平均每年的全血捐赠数量。在事前阶段，通过对比试点陈述性偏好调查回应（N=1254）与个体链接的显性偏好数据，来估计假设性偏差，从而为主要的陈述性偏好调查设计提供信息（N=25,187）。事后分析发现，当血液捐赠被推迟时，陈述性偏好与显性偏好之间存在中介关系。试点调查显示，捐赠者预期的捐赠频率分别为男性每年3.2次，女性每年2.6次，实际频率分别高出41%和30%。随后对主要陈述性偏好调查的选择情景进行了调整，过度预测的比例分别降至男性34%和女性16%。推迟行为的中介效应解释了陈述性偏好与显性偏好之间剩余差异的29%（男性）和86%（女性）。未来的研究可以利用这种方法减少假设性偏差，并为决策提供更准确的预测。

abstract.text: Public health insurers often use an implicit or explicit cost-effectiveness threshold to determine which health products and services should be insured. We challenge the convention of a single threshold. For competitively provided products and services, prices are determined by cost; but for products with market power, patentees will increase the price according to the perceived threshold. As a result, a change in the threshold affects the prices of all patented products, including those which would have been developed even at a lower threshold. The insurer can increase efficiency by reducing the threshold for patented products, even accounting for the effect on innovation. We also model a multi-country setting, in which thresholds for patented products will fall below the globally cooperative solution because each country does not recognize the positive externality of its own spending on innovative medicines. We show that this tragedy of the commons problem can be partly corrected through referencing other countries' thresholds, but only when the countries have similar willingness to pay.

10.1002/hec.4247.abstractZh: 公共卫生保险公司通常使用隐含或明确的成本效益阈值来决定哪些健康产品和服务应该被承保。我们挑战了单一阈值的传统做法。对于竞争性提供的产品和服务，价格由成本决定；但对于具有市场力量的产品，专利持有者会根据感知的阈值提高价格。因此，阈值的改变会影响所有专利产品的价格，包括那些即使以较低的阈值开发出来的产品。保险公司可以通过降低专利产品的阈值来提高效率，即使要考虑到对创新的影响。我们还模拟了一个多国环境，在这种情况下，专利产品的阈值会低于全球共同解决方案，因为每个国家都不认可自己在创新药物上的支出所带来的正面外部性。我们表明，这种“公地悲剧”问题可以通过参考其他国家的阈值来部分解决，但前提是这些国家具有相似的支付意愿。

abstract.text: Growth in pharmaceutical prices is a major policy issue in the United States. Competition is encouraged to counteract such growth, yet less is known about the effect of brand competition on prices. We discover a unique feature of this market by studying the pricing strategies of incumbent drug manufacturers under tiered-insurance anticipating branded competition. Using the insulin market as a natural experiment, we exploit exogenous variation in several potential entrants' completion of clinical trials to identify the effect of drug pipeline pressure on the prices of incumbent drugs. We find that pipeline pressure exerts cumulative and significant upward pressure on prices of incumbent drugs. In the insulin market such pressure explained 10.5% of the growth of prices. We were able to replicate these findings among incumbents with other emerging biosimilars. Insurance designs that fail to promote price competition through negotiations and value-based principles may contribute to such price increases.

10.1002/hec.4248.abstractZh: 药品价格的上涨是美国的一个主要政策问题。为了抑制这种价格上涨，美国鼓励竞争，但关于品牌竞争对价格的影响，我们知之甚少。通过研究在品牌竞争预期下，现有制药企业采用的分级保险定价策略，我们发现该市场具有独特的特点。以胰岛素市场作为自然实验，我们利用几个潜在进入者完成临床试验的外生变化，来识别药品研发压力对现有药品价格的影响。我们发现，研发压力对现有药品价格产生了累积且显著的上涨压力。在胰岛素市场中，这种压力解释了价格上涨的10.5%。我们在其他新兴生物仿制药的现有企业中也复制了这些发现。那些无法通过谈判和基于价值的原则来促进价格竞争的保险设计，可能会导致此类价格上涨。

abstract.text: Improvements in quality of care through supporting decision-making processes and increased efficiency have prompted widespread implementation of electronic medical records (EMRs) in Canada. Using a set of indicators of preventive care, chronic disease management, and hospitalizations due to ambulatory care sensitive conditions (ACSC), this study measures the effect of EMR adoption on quality of primary care measures. Population-based data for the Canadian province of Manitoba are used in a difference-in-differences approach with patient- and time-fixed effects. Evidence of changes in the selected quality-of-care indicators is weak, with preventive care, management of asthma, and hospitalizations showing no significant change due to EMR adoption. A statistically significant increase in the quality of diabetes care was found for EMR users, changes being larger for late EMR adopters which is possibly explained by a network effect. This research demonstrates that measuring whether EMRs prompt changes in the quality of care confronts serious challenges. The rapid evolution and gradual adoption of EMR technology, the inevitable learning/acceptance process by individual health practitioners, and its potential reflection on different patient populations create unmeasurable variables that confound EMRs' impact. This study also underscores the importance of data development to support the economic value of EMRs.

10.1002/hec.4249.abstractZh: 通过支持决策过程和提高效率，加拿大在医疗质量方面取得了显著改善，这促使电子病历（EMR）得到了广泛的应用。本研究使用一系列指标来衡量预防保健、慢性病管理和因门诊护理相关状况而发生的住院情况，以评估EMR采用对初级保健质量的影响。研究采用了基于人口数据的差异-差异方法，并考虑了患者和时间固定效应。结果显示，所选医疗质量指标的变化并不显著，例如预防保健、哮喘管理和住院情况在EMR采用后没有显著变化。对于使用EMR的用户来说，糖尿病护理质量有显著提升，而较晚采用EMR的用户则表现出更大的改善，这可能是由于网络效应所致。研究表明，衡量EMR是否确实能带来医疗质量的改善面临诸多挑战。EMR技术的快速发展和逐步采用、个体医疗从业者不可避免的学习和接受过程，以及其对不同患者群体的潜在影响，都使得评估EMR效果变得复杂。本研究还强调了数据开发对于理解EMR的经济价值的重要性。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the source of multiple large-scale health insurance expansions affecting various segments of the US population. Although much has been done to quantify the first-order effects of these policies, less empirical investigation has been devoted to the effects on the supply-side of health care. We focus on a well-known ACA initiative (the young adult dependent coverage mandate) to offer novel evidence on two fronts: the policy's heterogeneous effect across different labor markets and the potential for the policy-induced shift in payer mix to influence provider treatment decisions. First, we show that the federal mandate's direct effect on young adult private insurance take-up is strongly mitigated by the Great Recession. Second, we demonstrate that providers do not treat young adults more aggressively when more of them hold private coverage. Policymakers should keep these broader considerations and more diffuse risk protection implications in mind when contemplating changes to the law.

10.1002/hec.4250.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》是引发美国多个大规模健康保险扩展的源头，这些扩展影响了美国人口的各个群体。尽管已经有很多研究致力于量化这些政策的一级效应，但关于其对医疗保健供应端影响的实证研究却相对较少。我们重点关注《平价医疗法案》中的一个著名举措——年轻成年人依赖保险强制要求，从两个角度提供新的证据：该政策在不同劳动力市场中的异质效应，以及政策导致的支付方结构变化可能如何影响医疗服务提供者的决策。首先，我们发现联邦强制要求对年轻成年人私人保险投保率的直接影响因经济大衰退而得到了显著缓解。其次，我们证明，当更多年轻人拥有私人保险时，医疗服务提供者并不会对年轻成年人采取更积极的治疗措施。政策制定者在考虑法律变更时，应考虑到这些更广泛的考量以及更为广泛的风险保护影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the tough anti-alcohol legislation recently introduced in Russia, which due to regional variation allows it to be used as a natural experiment. The effect of the restricted trading hours on alcoholic poisoning mortality is estimated. To establish a causal link, difference-in-differences and synthetic controls are used. The main conclusion is that the sales restrictions lead to higher alcohol poisoning mortality, which implies that more toxic alcohol surrogates serve as substitutes for commercially available alcohol.

10.1002/hec.4251.abstractZh: 本文探讨了俄罗斯最近实施的严格反酒精法规，由于地区差异，该法规可以被用作一个自然实验。文章估计了限制交易时间对酒精中毒死亡率的影响。为了建立因果关系，采用了差异-差异分析和合成控制方法。主要结论是，销售限制导致酒精中毒死亡率上升，这意味着更具毒性的酒精替代品成为了商业可用酒精的替代品。

abstract.text: Many insurance markets have reinstated premium stabilization programs to ensure financial protection from market volatility. In this paper, we focus on one such regulation-risk corridors (RCs)-in the context of the Health Insurance Marketplaces established under the Affordable Care Act. We develop a model to show how the program provided incentives for some insurers to lower their premiums. The RCs program was defunded unexpectedly for coverage year 2016, before its legislated end in 2016. Consistent with the model, we find that making a RCs claim before the program ended is associated with higher premium growth after the program's demise. The model and empirical evidence are consistent with the view that the end of the RCs program contributed to premium growth in the Marketplaces.

10.1002/hec.4252.abstractZh: 许多保险市场重新实施了保费稳定计划，以确保投资者免受市场波动的财务影响。在本文中，我们重点关注根据《平价医疗法案》建立的医疗保险市场中的一项此类监管措施——风险走廊制度。我们建立了一个模型，以说明该计划如何促使一些保险公司降低保费。实际上，风险走廊制度在2016年保险年度被突然取消，而该计划法定的终止时间是在2016年。与模型结果一致的是，我们发现，在计划终止前提出风险走廊索赔，会导致计划终止后保费增长幅度增加。该模型和实证证据支持了这样的观点：风险走廊制度的终止导致了医疗保险市场的保费增长。

abstract.text: Using objective measures of lung function, we document strong positive associations in health within couples in all European countries but large and significant differences in this correlation within broad European regions, with Southern Europe having by far stronger correlations than elsewhere. We analyze potential explanations for such differences, investigating the role of measures capturing current and past health behaviors, early life circumstances of each spouse, and measures capturing assortative mating in multiple dimensions. We show that marital sorting patterns by dimensions of early life health and socioeconomic position, as well as by geographical subregion within countries, are key to understanding the empirical patterns observed.

10.1002/hec.4253.abstractZh: 通过采用客观的肺功能测量方法，我们发现所有欧洲国家的夫妻之间都存在显著的积极健康关联，但在欧洲各个大区域中，这种关联存在显著差异。南欧地区的关联程度远高于其他地区。我们分析了这些差异的潜在原因，探讨了能够反映当前和过去健康行为、配偶早年生活状况以及多维度选择性交配因素的测量指标的作用。研究表明，根据早年健康状况、社会经济地位以及国家内部的地理子区域进行婚姻排序，是理解所观察到的实证模式的关键。

abstract.text: This note studies the effect of the availability of a test for a virus on the public health of a population. It is shown by example that the existence of a freely available and moderately informative test for a virus may lower society's welfare in comparison to the case where no test exists or access to the test is restricted. In this setting, any test provided to any subset of agents who would find it optimal not to isolate absent the test improves welfare.

10.1002/hec.4254.abstractZh: 本文研究了病毒检测方法的可用性对人群公共卫生的影响。通过实例表明，如果存在一种免费且信息量适中的病毒检测方法，那么与没有检测方法或检测方法无法获取的情况相比，社会的福利可能会降低。在这种情况下，只要向那些在没有检测方法时会选择不隔离的群体提供该检测方法，就能提高社会福利。

abstract.text: Opioid agonist treatment (OAT) is the evidence-based standard of care for people with opioid use disorder. In British Columbia, Canada, only social assistance registrants received full coverage for OAT prior to the introduction of the Pharmacare Plan G coverage expansion on February 1st, 2017. We aimed to determine the effect of the coverage expansion on OAT initiation, re-initiation, and retention. Using linked population-level data, we executed a difference-in-differences analysis to compare outcomes of individuals eligible for the additional coverage and social assistance registrants already receiving the most generous coverage for OAT prior to the policy change, adjusting for individual and prescriber characteristics. We found Plan G coverage expansion significantly increased OAT retention. Specifically, coverage expansion decreased the number of OAT episode discontinuations by 12.8% (95% CI: 8.4%, 17.2%).

10.1002/hec.4255.abstractZh: 阿片受体激动剂治疗是针对阿片类药物使用障碍患者的基于证据的标准治疗方法。在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省，直到2017年2月1日Pharmacare计划G的覆盖范围扩大之前，只有接受社会援助登记的人能够享受阿片受体激动剂治疗的全额覆盖。我们的研究旨在探讨覆盖范围扩大对阿片受体激动剂治疗的开始、重新开始以及持续效果的影响。通过利用关联的人口级数据，我们进行了差异-差异分析，以比较在政策变更前已经享受最广泛阿片受体激动剂治疗的社会援助登记者与新增覆盖人群的结果，并调整了个体特征和处方者特征的影响。研究发现，计划G的覆盖范围扩大显著提高了阿片受体激动剂治疗的持续率。具体而言，覆盖范围扩大的措施使阿片受体激动剂治疗的终止次数减少了12.8%（95%置信区间：8.4%，17.2%）。

abstract.text: Reported mental health problems have risen dramatically among US college students over time, as has treatment for these problems. We examine the effect of state-level Medicaid expansion following the 2014 implementation of the Affordable Care Act on the diagnosis of mental health conditions, psychotropic prescription drug use, and the mental health status of a national sample of college students. We find that students from disadvantaged backgrounds are more likely to report being on public insurance after 2014 in expansion states relative to non-expansion states, while more advantaged students do not see this increase. Both diagnosis of common mental health conditions and psychotropic drug use increase following expansion for disadvantaged students relative to advantaged ones, which translates into an elimination of the pre-expansion gap in these outcomes by family background in expansion states. However, in contrast to some recent work on Medicaid expansion and mental health, we do not find that these changes are associated with improvements in self-reported mental health status. We also do not find that Medicaid expansion has affected risky health behaviors or academic outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4256.abstractZh: 据报道，美国大学生的心理健康问题随着时间而显著上升，相关治疗需求也相应增加。我们研究了2014年《平价医疗法案》实施后的州级医疗补助扩展对心理健康状况诊断、精神药物处方使用以及全国大学生心理健康状况的影响。研究发现，2014年后，来自弱势背景的学生在扩展州更有可能使用公共保险，而来自优势背景的学生则没有出现这种增加。与优势背景的学生相比，弱势背景的学生在扩展州常见心理健康状况的诊断和精神药物使用都有所增加，这意味着扩展州因家庭背景导致的这些结果上的差距被缩小了。然而，与一些关于医疗补助扩展与心理健康关系的最新研究不同，我们没有发现这些变化与自我报告的心理健康状况改善有关。此外，我们也没有发现医疗补助扩展对危险健康行为或学业成绩产生了影响。

abstract.text: We use administrative data from Medicare to document the massive consolidation of primary care physicians over the last decade and its impact on patient healthcare utilization. We first document that primary care organizations have consolidated all over the United States between 2008 and 2014. We then show that regions that experienced greater consolidation are associated with greater decline in overall healthcare spending. Finally, in our primary exercise, we exploit transitions of patients across organizations that are driven by changes in the organizational affiliations of their primary care physicians to study the impact of organizational size on overall spending. Our preferred specification suggests that patients switching from small to large physician organizations reduce their overall healthcare spending by 16%, and that this reduction is primarily driven by a 13% reduction in primary care visits and 0.09 (21%) fewer inpatient admissions per year.

10.1002/hec.4257.abstractZh: 我们利用Medicare的行政数据来记录过去十年中初级保健医生的大规模整合情况，以及这一整合对患者医疗利用的影响。我们首先发现，2008年至2014年间，全美各地的初级保健组织都进行了整合。接着，我们发现，整合程度较高的地区，整体医疗支出出现了更大的下降。最后，在我们的主要研究中，我们通过分析患者在不同组织之间的转移情况，来研究组织规模对整体支出的影响。我们的分析表明，患者从小型医生组织转移到大型医生组织后，整体医疗支出减少了16%，这一减少主要源于初级保健就诊次数的减少13%，以及每年住院人次减少0.09（21%）。

abstract.text: The aging process in OECD countries calls for a better understanding of the future disease prevalence, life expectancy (LE) and patterns of inequalities in health outcomes. In this paper we present the results obtained from several dynamic microsimulation models of the Future Elderly Model family for 12 OECD countries, with the aim of reproducing for the first time comparable long-term projections in individual health status across OECD countries. We provide projections of LE and prevalence of major chronic conditions and disabilities, overall, by gender and by education. We find that the prevalence of main chronic conditions in Europe is catching-up with the United States and significant heterogeneity in the evolution of gender and educational gradients. Our findings represent a contribution to support policymakers in designing and implementing effective interventions in the healthcare sector.

10.1002/hec.4258.abstractZh: 在经合组织国家中，人口老龄化进程要求我们对未来疾病发病率、预期寿命以及健康结果中的不平等现象有更深入的了解。本文介绍了基于Future Elderly Model系列动态微观模拟模型得出的结果，这些模型涵盖了12个经合组织国家。我们的研究首次实现了对各国个体健康状况的长期可比预测。我们提供了按性别和教育水平划分的预期寿命和主要慢性病及残疾发病率的预测数据。研究发现，欧洲主要慢性疾病的发病率正在赶上美国，且性别和教育水平对疾病发展的影响存在显著差异。我们的研究结果有助于为政策制定者设计和实施有效的医疗保健干预措施提供支持。

abstract.text: While increasing attention is given to how health reductions affect workers, estimating their effects is usually challenging. This paper aims to identify the causal effect of health deterioration on labor market outcomes by exploiting the incidence of stroke. Stroke, which often reduces health suddenly and unexpectedly, allows us to exploit the within-person random variation of the timing and isolate the effects of health reduction. By applying the fixed-effects method to a sample of stroke survivors in the University of Michigan Health and Retirement Study data, I find that stroke immediately halves the employment probability as well as hours and weeks worked 1 year after the occurrence and its effects persist for at least 3 years, while earnings reduction is relatively moderate and gradual. I also find the negative effects of stroke are larger among men with severe stroke and women with longer pre-stroke job tenure, while the effects are mitigated for younger women. These results make a stark contrast with the studies on other health events such as cancer diagnosis, which generally find much smaller effects and significant heterogeneity by education and occupation. This analysis shows that the labor market effects largely differ by types of diseases and calls for disease-specific studies in order to understand the social gradient in health and how workers adjust to work limitations.

10.1002/hec.4259.abstractZh: 虽然人们越来越关注健康下降对劳动者的影响，但估计这些影响通常具有挑战性。本文旨在通过利用中风的发生情况，来识别健康恶化对劳动力市场结果的因果效应。中风往往会导致健康状况突然且不可预测地下降，这使我们能够利用个体内部的时间随机变化，并分离出健康下降的效应。通过对密歇根大学健康与退休研究数据中的中风幸存者样本应用固定效应模型，我发现中风会立即将就业概率以及工作时间和周数减半，且这种影响至少持续3年。同时，收入减少的幅度相对较小且较为缓慢。我还发现，对于患有严重中风的男性以及有较长中风前工作经历的女性来说，中风的负面影响更为显著，而对于较年轻的女性来说，这种影响则有所减轻。这些结果与关于其他健康事件的研究形成了鲜明对比，例如癌症诊断，后者通常发现的影响要小得多，并且在不同教育和职业群体中存在显著的异质性。这项分析表明，不同疾病的劳动力市场效应存在很大差异，因此需要进行针对特定疾病的研究，以了解健康方面的社会差异以及劳动者如何适应工作限制。

abstract.text: Although violence in healthcare settings has become a common occurrence worldwide, there is limited evidence on the spillover effects of patient violence on physicians' medical decisions. Utilizing microdata on inpatients from a major public hospital, we investigated how extreme patient violence-the murder of a physician in China-affected physicians' treatment decisions and patient welfare in a hospital geographically distant from the murder site. By matching this patient dataset to physician profiles, we performed a difference-in-differences analysis in which the treatment group comprised patients admitted shortly before and after the murder shock, and the control group consisted of patients admitted during the same months in the previous year. Immediately after the shock, the provision of medical treatment was notably higher, with a 16.9% increase in the number of surgeries and a 9.5% increase in the treatment expenditures. However, patient health outcomes were worse, with an increased mortality rate of 0.9% points. Findings suggest that patient violence dramatically changed physician behavior, causing negative consequences on patients even when the healthcare workers were not direct victims of patient violence.

10.1002/hec.4260.abstractZh: 尽管医疗环境中的暴力行为在全球范围内已成为常见现象，但关于患者暴力对医生医疗决策影响的证据却十分有限。本研究利用一家大型公立医院的住院患者微观数据，探讨了极端患者暴力行为——例如在中国发生的医生被谋杀事件——如何影响医生的治疗决策以及远离案发地点的医院中的患者健康状况。通过将患者数据与医生信息匹配，我们进行了差异比较分析，其中治疗组包括在谋杀事件前后不久入院的患者，而对照组则包括前一年同一时间段入院的患者。在事件发生后，医疗服务的数量显著增加，手术数量增加了16.9%，治疗费用也增加了9.5%。然而，患者的健康状况却恶化了，死亡率上升了0.9个百分点。研究结果表明，患者暴力行为显著改变了医生的行为，即使医疗工作者并非直接受害者，这种行为也会给患者带来负面影响。

abstract.text: We hypothesize that when interpersonal comparisons, often referred to as "keeping up with the Joneses", are operational, relative deprivation (income inequality) results in increased likelihood of morbidity among lower income households. Using a simple theoretical model, we show that the larger the income disparities between "the Joneses" and "the followers", the higher is the followers' expenditure on conspicuous consumption and the lower is their expenditure on health. We empirically test our hypotheses using Canadian data from the Canadian Community Health Survey and the Survey of Household Spending and US data from the National Health Interview Survey. We find that, in peer groups defined by geographic proximity of residence or similar socio-economic background, larger income disparities are associated with higher spending by the followers on conspicuous consumption, lower health expenditure, worse self-reported health and younger age at death.

10.1002/hec.4261.abstractZh: 我们假设，当人们进行人际比较时，这种现象通常被称为“攀比”，相对剥夺（收入不平等）会导致低收入家庭患病的可能性增加。通过一个简单的理论模型，我们发现，“攀比者”与“追随者”之间的收入差距越大，追随者在炫耀性消费上的支出就越高，而健康方面的支出则越低。我们使用加拿大社区健康调查和家庭支出调查的数据以及美国国家健康访谈调查的数据来实证验证我们的假设。研究发现，在由居住地理位置或相似社会经济背景定义的同龄群体中，较大的收入差距与追随者在炫耀性消费上的支出增加、健康支出减少、自我报告的健康状况恶化以及死亡年龄提前有关。

abstract.text: Despite widespread use, evidence is sparse on whether financial incentives in healthcare should be linked to structure, process or outcome. We examine the impact of different incentive types on the quantity and effectiveness of referrals made by general practices to a new national prevention programme in England. We measured effectiveness by the number of referrals resulting in programme attendance. We surveyed local commissioners about their use of financial incentives and linked this information to numbers of programme referrals and attendances from 5170 general practices between April 2016 and March 2018. We used multivariate probit regressions to identify commissioner characteristics associated with the use of different incentive types and negative binomial regressions to estimate their effect on practice rates of referral and attendance. Financial incentives were offered by commissioners in the majority of areas (89%), with 38% using structure incentives, 69% using process incentives and 22% using outcome incentives. Compared to practices without financial incentives, neither structure nor process incentives were associated with statistically significant increases in referrals or attendances, but outcome incentives were associated with 84% more referrals and 93% more attendances. Outcome incentives were the only form of pay-for-performance to stimulate more participation in this national disease prevention programme.

10.1002/hec.4262.abstractZh: 尽管金融激励在医疗保健领域的应用非常广泛，但关于是否应将金融激励与结构、流程或结果联系起来，相关的研究证据却很少。我们研究了不同激励类型对英格兰一项新的国家预防计划下普通诊所推荐数量及效果的影响。我们通过推荐人数来衡量效果，即推荐人数转化为实际参加该计划的人数。我们对当地卫生官员使用金融激励的情况进行了调查，并将这些信息与2016年4月至2018年3月期间5170家普通诊所的推荐数量和参加人数进行了关联分析。我们使用多元Probit回归模型来识别与不同激励类型使用相关的卫生官员特征，并通过负二项回归模型来估计这些激励类型对推荐率和参加率的影响。在大部分地区（89%），卫生官员提供了金融激励，其中38%使用结构激励，69%使用流程激励，22%使用结果激励。与没有金融激励的诊所相比，结构或流程激励并未显著增加推荐或参加人数，但结果激励使推荐数量增加了84%，参加人数增加了93%。结果激励是唯一一种能够激励更多参与者参与这项国家疾病预防计划的绩效支付形式。

abstract.text: We develop a method for data-driven estimation and analysis of heterogeneity in cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) with experimental or observational individual-level data. Our implementation uses causal forests and cross-fitted augmented inverse probability weighted learning to estimate heterogeneity in incremental outcomes, costs and net monetary benefits, as well as other parameters relevant to CEA. We also show how the results can be visualized in relevant ways for the analysis of heterogeneity in CEA, such as using individual-level cost effectiveness planes. Using a simulated dataset and an R package implementing our methods, we show how the approach can be used to estimate the average cost-effectiveness in the entire sample or in subpopulations, explore and analyze the heterogeneity in incremental outcomes, costs and net monetary benefits (and their determinants), and learn policy rules from the data.

10.1002/hec.4263.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种数据驱动的方法，用于分析具有实验性或观察性个体层面数据的成本效益分析中的异质性。我们的实现方法使用了因果森林和交叉拟合增强逆概率加权学习技术，以估计增量结果、成本和净货币收益中的异质性，以及成本效益分析中其他相关参数。我们还展示了如何以相关方式可视化这些结果，例如使用个体层面的成本效益平面图。通过模拟数据集和实现我们方法的R包，我们展示了如何利用该方法估计整个样本或子群体的平均成本效益，探索和分析增量结果、成本和净货币收益中的异质性（及其决定因素），并从数据中学习政策规则。

abstract.text: This paper presents the first causal estimates of the effect of weather on children's time allocation. It exploits exogenous variations in local weather observed during the random diary dates of two nationally representative cohorts of Australian children whose time-use diaries were surveyed biennially over 10 years. Unfavorable weather conditions, as represented by cold or hot temperature or rain, cause children to switch activities from outdoors to indoors, mainly by reducing the time allocated to active pursuits and travel and increasing the time allocated to media. Furthermore, the effects of bad weather are more pronounced on weekends and for children with asthma. Our results also provide some evidence of adaptation, as temperature tends to have greater impact not only in winter months but also in colder regions. Our findings are robust to a wide range of sensitivity checks, including controlling for individual fixed effects and using alternative model specifications. Overall, the results suggest that extreme weather conditions may diminish children's health, development and long-term achievements through their effects on children's time allocation.

10.1002/hec.4264.abstractZh: 本文首次对天气对儿童时间分配的影响进行了因果估计。研究利用了澳大利亚两个具有全国代表性的儿童群体在10年间每两年进行一次时间调查时观察到的局部天气变化。不利的天气条件，如寒冷、炎热或降雨，会导致儿童将活动从室外转移到室内，主要是减少用于积极活动和旅行的時間，增加用于媒体消费的时间。此外，恶劣天气的影响在周末和患有哮喘的儿童身上更为明显。我们的研究结果还表明，温度不仅会在冬季对儿童的身体发育产生较大影响，在较寒冷的地区也是如此。我们的发现经多种敏感性检验后依然稳健，包括控制个体固定效应和使用不同的模型设定。总体而言，结果表明极端天气条件可能会通过影响儿童的时间分配，从而损害他们的健康、发展及长期成就。

abstract.text: Understanding the relationship between disability and employment is critical and has long been the subject of study. However, estimating this relationship is difficult, particularly with survey data, since both disability and employment status are known to be misreported. Here, we use a partial identification approach to bound the joint distribution of disability and employment status in the presence of misclassification. Allowing for a modest amount of misclassification leads to bounds on the labor market status of the disabled that are not overly informative given the relative size of the disabled population. Thus, absent further assumptions, even a modest amount of misclassification creates much uncertainty about the employment gap between the non-disabled and disabled. However, additional assumptions considered are shown to have some identifying power. For example, under our most stringent assumptions, we find that the employment gap is at least 15.2% before the Great Recession and 22.0% afterward.

10.1002/hec.4265.abstractZh: 理解残疾与就业之间的关系至关重要，这一主题长期以来一直是研究的重点。然而，估计这种关系非常困难，尤其是在使用调查数据的情况下，因为残疾和就业状况都被发现存在误报现象。在这里，我们采用部分识别方法来处理在误分类存在的情况下残疾和就业状况的联合分布问题。考虑到一定程度的误分类，得到的残疾人群体劳动力市场状况的界限并不具有太多信息量，因为残疾人群体的相对规模较小。因此，在没有其他假设的情况下，即使存在一定程度的误分类，也会使得非残疾人与残疾人在就业方面的差距变得非常不确定。不过，经过进一步考虑的额外假设显示出一定的识别能力。例如，在我们最严格的假设下，我们发现大衰退之前，就业差距至少为15.2%，而大衰退之后则上升至22.0%。

abstract.text: Utilizing the Consumer Expenditure Interview Survey from 2005 to 2019, I study spending on food and alcohol following recreational marijuana law (RML). Exploiting differences in the timing of the passage of RMLs and employing two-way fixed-effects methods, I find that households located in states adopting these laws increase their quarterly spending on food, which is driven mainly by spending on food consumed away from home. Legalization of recreational marijuana also leads to increased quarterly spending on alcohol. These findings suggest a complementarity between food, alcohol, and marijuana.

10.1002/hec.4266.abstractZh: 通过利用2005至2019年的消费者支出调查数据，我研究了在娱乐性大麻法律实施后食品和酒精类商品的支出情况。通过对比不同州通过大麻法律的时间点，并采用双向固定效应模型进行分析，我发现采用这些法律的州的家庭在食品方面的季度支出有所增加，其中大部分支出用于外出就餐。娱乐性大麻合法化还导致酒精类商品的季度支出增加。这些发现表明，食品、酒精和 marijuana之间存在互补性。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of a sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) tax that took effect in Oakland, California in 2017. Using rich customized universal product code -level data, we estimate the effect of the SSB tax on prices and volume in the short to medium term in a difference-in-differences framework. We pay particular attention to tax-avoidance strategies that may minimize the policy's intended effect including: (i) transfers to SSBs to the nontaxed border area (i.e., cross-border shopping), (ii) a move from high-priced per ounce single serve to their cheaper multipacks or larger format counterparts (i.e., format switching), and (iii) a move from high-priced beverages to less expensive ones within a category and format (i.e., brand switching). We find that the year-over-year tax pass-through is 49%. We find that volume sold of taxed beverages fell by 14%, but 46% of this decrease is offset with an increase in the border area. We also find evidence of substitution to lower-priced taxed beverages but no evidence of switching to cheaper formats. Finally, we find important dynamic effects with respect to tax pass-through, volume sold and cross-border shopping.

10.1002/hec.4267.abstractZh: 我们研究了2017年在加利福尼亚州奥克兰实施的含糖饮料税的影响。利用详细的通用产品代码数据，我们通过差异-差异框架，评估了该税收对短期至中期价格和销量的影响。我们特别关注可能最小化政策效果的避税策略，包括：将含糖饮料转移到未征税的边境地区（即跨境购物）、从单价较高的单杯装转向价格更低的多包装或更大包装的版本（即格式转换），以及从价格较高的饮料转向同类中价格较低的饮料（即品牌转换）。我们发现，税收的年度传递率为49%。我们发现，征税饮料的销量下降了14%，但这一下降被边境地区销量的增加所抵消。我们还发现了消费者转向价格较低的征税饮料的替代行为，但没有发现消费者转向更便宜格式的证据。最后，我们发现税收传递率、销量和跨境购物方面存在重要的动态效应。

abstract.text: Operationalizing cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) requires that decisionmakers select maximum willingness to pay thresholds (K). We generalize previous methods used to estimate K using highly flexible hyperbolic absolute risk aversion (HARA) utility functions that encompass a wide range of risk behavior. For HARA utility, we calculate formulas for relative risk aversion (r*) and relative prudence (π ∗ ), using literature-based estimates to calibrate our HARA model. We then assess optimal WTP thresholds (K) in absolute value and relative to income (K/M). Across the most-plausible range of risk preference parameters (r* and π ∗ ), optimal K/M ratios sit (approximately) in the range of 1 to 3, although we cannot readily rule out larger K/M values. The optimal K always increases with income, while K/M falls with income if utility has increasing relative risk aversion. Results of this more-general model of economic utility are broadly consistent with previous work using more-restrictive Weibull functions. More precision in measuring the key parameters-particularly relative prudence (π ∗ ) will narrow down the range of K/M estimates. The highly general HARA structure illuminates why and how optimal CEA thresholds change with income. An appendix illuminates how relative risk aversion and relative prudence relate to each other.

10.1002/hec.4268.abstractZh: 将成本效益分析（CEA）操作化需要决策者选择最大支付意愿阈值（K）。我们推广了之前用于估计K的方法，使用高度灵活的双曲绝对风险厌恶效用函数，这些函数能够涵盖广泛的风险行为。对于HARA效用，我们计算了相对风险厌恶（r*）和相对谨慎性（π*）的公式，并使用基于文献的估计来校准我们的HARA模型。然后，我们评估了最优支付意愿阈值（K）的绝对值以及相对于收入的比例（K/M）。在最合理的风险偏好参数范围内（r*和π*），最优的K/M比率大致在1到3之间，尽管我们无法轻易排除更大的K/M值。最优K总是随着收入的增加而上升，而如果效用具有递增的相对风险厌恶，则K/M会随着收入的增加而下降。这种更通用的经济效用模型的结果与之前使用更严格的Weibull函数的研究结果大致一致。在测量关键参数时，尤其是相对谨慎性（π*），更高的精度将缩小K/M估计的范围。高度通用的HARA结构揭示了最优CEA阈值为何以及如何随收入变化。附录说明了相对风险厌恶和相对谨慎性之间的关系。

abstract.text: Sin good consumption entails health damage, which is in general not fully perceived by individuals, what results in its overconsumption. One way to tackle this problem is to tax these unhealthy goods. However, not all the individual choices that affect health status can be easily observed and effectively taxed by the government. This paper considers a setting where individuals can consume two types of sin goods that differ in their observability (taxability) by the government. As a benchmark, the first-best taxes for the observable and non-observable sin good are derived, considering homogeneous individuals. In the second-best setting, where observability on sin good consumption is limited, the rule for the taxable sin good is shown to depend on the degree of complementarity or substitutability with the unobservable sin good. Finally, redistributional considerations are incorporated by extending the analysis to a setting where individuals differ in their wealth and in their degree of misperception of the health damage caused by sin good consumption. Policy implications are illustrated considering physical inactivity and illicit drugs as examples of non-taxable sin goods, while alcohol, tobacco, fat and sugar account for the taxable sin goods.

10.1002/hec.4269.abstractZh: 不良消费会导致健康损害，而个人通常并未完全意识到这一点，从而导致过度消费。解决这一问题的一种方法是对这些有害商品征税。然而，并非所有影响健康状况的个人选择都能被轻易观察到，并且政府也无法对其进行有效征税。本文考虑了一个情境，其中个人可以消费两种类型的有害商品，这两种商品在政府的征税可能性上存在差异。作为基准，本文推导了可观察与不可观察有害商品的理想征税方案，假设个体具有同质性。在次优情境下，当对有害商品消费的观察能力有限时，可征税有害商品的规则取决于其与不可观察有害商品的互补性或替代性程度。最后，通过将分析扩展到个体在财富和对健康损害感知程度上的差异，本文纳入了再分配考虑。以身体不活动和非法药物作为不可征税有害商品的例子，而酒精、烟草、脂肪和糖则作为可征税有害商品的例子，本文阐述了政策含义。

abstract.text: We examine how immigrants' health insurance in the United States is shaped by institutional traits of the health care systems in their origin societies. Conditional on a wide range of individual, country-of-origin, state-level, and temporal controls, we find the affordability of health care back home helps explain immigrants' US health coverage. Specifically, low- and middle-income migrants from countries with less affordable health care are more likely to get private insurance once in the United States and, correspondingly, less likely to have public coverage, relative to migrants from countries with more affordable care. The relationship conforms to multiple hypotheses. As predicted by the institutional beliefs hypothesis, migrants from countries with less affordable care might anticipate equally expensive health services in the United States and, in turn, insure themselves against high medical bills. Likewise, as predicted by the endogenous preferences hypothesis, migrants from countries with less affordable care might be accustomed to paying more for health care and, in turn, be less reluctant to pay for private health insurance. Overall, the findings underscore the relevance of migrants' past health care experiences in their origin societies in informing their health insurance in the United States even years after migration.

10.1002/hec.4270.abstractZh: 我们研究了移民在美国的健康保险如何受到其原籍社会医疗体系制度特征的影响。在考虑了广泛的个人、原籍国、州级以及时间因素后，我们发现原籍国医疗服务的可负担性有助于解释移民在美国的健康保险状况。具体而言，来自医疗服务成本较低国家的低收入和中等收入移民，在美国更有可能获得私人保险，相应地，他们获得公共保险的可能性较低，相比之下，来自医疗服务成本较高的国家的移民则更容易获得公共保险。这一关系符合多个假设。正如制度信念假设所预测的，来自医疗服务成本较低国家的移民可能会预期在美国同样昂贵的医疗服务，因此选择购买私人保险以防范高昂的医疗费用。同样，根据内生偏好假设，来自医疗服务成本较低国家的移民可能习惯于支付更高的医疗费用，因此不太抗拒购买私人健康保险。总体而言，这些发现强调了移民在原籍国的医疗经历对其在美国健康保险选择的影响，这种影响甚至在移民多年后仍然存在。

abstract.text: The association of insurance expansions and the distribution of health status is still a matter we know little about. This paper draws upon new measures of pure (univariate) inequality and mobility which accommodate categorical data to understand how an expansion of public insurance may be related to both health inequality and mobility. These measures require a definition of individual's status that is either "downward looking" or "upward looking". Using data from the Mexican Family Life Survey, a nationally representative longitudinal survey, we find that the distribution of health has worsened in Mexico between 2002 and 2009, although the change is only consistent for an upward looking definition status. Together with the lack of mobility in self-reported health, we can thus conclude that Mexico has become more rigid over time despite the rapid public health expansion that took place over the 2000s decade. While further research on the potential drivers of health inequalities is needed, our findings suggest that insurance coverage alone may be not enough to reduce health disparities and promote health mobility. Indeed, health inequality and mobility likely depend on a myriad of factors beyond health care.

10.1002/hec.4271.abstractZh: 保险扩展与健康状况分布之间的关联仍然是我们知之甚少的领域。本文利用新的纯（单变量）不平等度量方法和流动性度量方法，结合分类数据，来探讨公共保险扩展如何与健康不平等和流动性相关。这些度量方法需要一种“向下看”或“向上看”的个人状态定义。通过墨西哥家庭生活调查的数据，一项具有全国代表性的纵向调查，我们发现墨西哥的健康状况分布在2002年至2009年间恶化，不过这种变化仅适用于“向上看”的状态定义。再加上自我报告的健康状况缺乏流动性，我们可以得出结论：尽管在2000年代经历了快速的公共卫生扩展，墨西哥的社会结构却变得更加僵化。虽然还需要进一步研究健康不平等的潜在驱动因素，但我们的研究结果表明，仅靠保险覆盖可能不足以减少健康差异并促进健康流动性。事实上，健康不平等和流动性可能取决于许多除医疗保健之外的因素。

abstract.text: Upcoding is a common type of fraud in healthcare. However, how audit policies need to be designed to cope with upcoding is not well understood. We provide causal evidence on the effect of random audits with different probabilities and financial consequences. Using a controlled laboratory experiment, we mimic the decision situation of obstetrics staff members to report birth weights of neonatal infants. Subjects' payments in the experiment depend on their reported birth weights and follow the German non-linear diagnosis-related group remuneration for neonatal care. Our results show that audits with low detection probabilities only reduce fraudulent birth-weight reporting, when they are coupled with fines for fraudulent reporting. For audit policies with fines, increasing the probability of an audit only effectively enhances honest reporting, when switching from detectable to less gainful undetectable upcoding is not feasible. Implications for audit policies are discussed.

10.1002/hec.4272.abstractZh: 上编码是医疗保健领域常见的欺诈行为。然而，关于如何设计审计政策以应对上编码问题，目前尚未有充分的研究。我们通过实验性研究，提供了关于不同概率和财务后果下随机审计效果的因果证据。实验中，受试者根据报告的婴儿出生体重获得报酬，这一报酬机制参照德国新生儿护理的非线性诊断相关组薪酬制度。研究结果表明，当审计的检出概率较低时，仅结合对欺诈性报告行为的罚款措施，才能有效减少这种欺诈行为。对于带有罚款措施的审计政策，提高审计的概率确实能促使受试者更诚实地报告出生体重，而当从可检测的上编码转变为难以检测的上编码时，这种效果则不再明显。最后，本文还讨论了这些研究结果对审计政策的启示意义。

abstract.text: This paper broadens the literature on intergenerational persistence of socioeconomic status to consider individual, family, and spatial variation in intergenerational health mobility in the United States. Using a school-based representative panel (Add Health), we report overall health persistence of 0.17 with higher mobility in Hispanic families. We find large variation by place; intergenerational health persistence estimates range between 0 and 0.5, with similarly large ranges for absolute upward and downward health mobility. School- and contextual-level correlates indicate local race/ethnicity composition, proportion of single parents, and average mother's education may be related to observed variation in intergenerational health mobility.

10.1002/hec.4273.abstractZh: 本文扩展了关于社会经济地位代际持续性的研究，考虑了美国个体、家庭和空间层面的健康流动变化。通过基于学校的代表性样本（Add Health）进行研究，我们发现整体健康状态的持续时间为0.17，而西班牙裔家庭中的健康流动性更高。我们发现不同地区的健康流动性存在较大差异；代际健康持续性的估计值在0到0.5之间，而健康流动的绝对上升和下降幅度也相差很大。学校和情境层面的相关因素表明，当地的种族/族裔构成、单亲家庭的比例以及母亲的平均教育水平可能与观察到的代际健康流动性的差异有关。

abstract.text: We investigate the long-term effects of the 1944-45 Great Vietnam Famine on early-life survivors and their offspring using census data, household survey data and historical administrative data. Unlike previous famine studies, we measure famine severity using a unique, more direct, and "plausibly exogenous" metric of food availability: province-level excess paddy (rice) production per capita in 1944. Our study makes two novel contributions.
