First, we overcome several selection problems associated with the estimation of true famine effects, given the short duration and spatial variation of the Vietnamese famine. Second, we investigate the intergenerational effects of famine, focusing specifically on the occupation of the survivors' parents and the school participation of the survivors' offspring. Our preferred specification estimates generalized triple differences that allow us to control for birth-year and birth-province fixed effects and nation-wide shocks. Our findings suggest that the Vietnamese famine reduced literacy by around 3 percent, BMI by 5.6%-8.4%, arm-length by 4.5%-6.7% (1.1-1.7 cm), height by 2.2%-3.2% (3.4-5 cm), and weight by 10%-14% (4.7-6.9 kg) among the affected cohort. These detrimental famine effects also extended to economic welfare, in the form of lower household incomes and lower non-food household expenditures in adulthood. We also document a 4.9%-7.2% reduction in school participation among survivors' offspring, which has major implications for the exogenous origins of social mobility, inequality, and poverty.

10.1002/hec.4274.abstractZh: 我们利用人口普查数据、家庭调查数据以及历史行政数据，研究了1944-45年越南大饥荒对早期幸存者及其后代的长期影响。与以往的研究不同，我们采用一种独特且更直接的“可合理外生”指标来衡量饥荒的严重程度：即1944年各省人均稻米产量过剩情况。我们的研究提出了两个创新点：首先，我们克服了由于越南饥荒持续时间短且空间分布不均而带来的估计真实饥荒效应时的选择问题；其次，我们重点关注饥荒对代际影响的调查，特别考察了幸存者父母的工作状况以及幸存者后代的受教育程度。我们采用广义三重差分模型进行估计，以控制出生年份、出生省份的固定效应以及全国性的冲击。研究发现，越南饥荒导致受影响人群识字率下降约3%，体重指数下降5.6%-8.4%，臂长减少4.5%-6.7%（1.1-1.7厘米），身高减少2.2%-3.2%（3.4-5厘米），体重减少10%-14%（4.7-6.9千克）。这些负面影响还体现在经济福利上，表现为家庭收入下降以及成年后非食品类家庭支出减少。我们还发现，幸存者后代的受教育程度下降了4.9%-7.2%，这一结果对社会流动性、不平等和贫困的外生起源具有重大意义。

abstract.text: We use data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study (UKHLS) to compare measures of socioeconomic inequality in psychological distress, measured by the General Health Questionnaire (GHQ), before (Waves 9 and the Interim 2019 Wave) and during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic (April to July 2020). Based on a caseness measure, the prevalence of psychological distress increased from 18.5% to 27.7% between the 2019 Wave and April 2020 with some reversion to earlier levels in subsequent months. Also, there was a systematic increase in total inequality in the Likert GHQ-12 score. However, measures of relative socioeconomic inequality have not increased. A Shapley-Shorrocks decomposition analysis shows that during the peak of the first wave of the pandemic (April 2020) other socioeconomic factors declined in their share of socioeconomic inequality, while age and gender account for a larger share. The most notable increase is evident for younger women. The contribution of working in an industry related to the COVID-19 response played a small role at Wave 9 and the Interim 2019 Wave, but more than tripled its share in April 2020. As the first wave of COVID-19 progressed, the contribution of demographics declined from their peak level in April and chronic health conditions, housing conditions, and neighbourhood characteristics increased their contributions to socioeconomic inequality.

10.1002/hec.4275.abstractZh: 我们利用了英国家庭纵向研究的数据，比较了在COVID-19疫情第一波期间（2020年4月至7月）以及疫情前（2019年9波和2019年中期波）社会经济不平等对心理困扰的影响。根据犯罪率指标，心理困扰的患病率从2019年波期的18.5%上升到2020年4月的27.7%，但在随后的几个月中又有所回落。此外，Likert GHQ-12评分的总不平等程度也出现了系统性上升。然而，相对社会经济不平等的衡量指标并未增加。Shapley-Shorrocks分解分析显示，在疫情第一波高峰时期（2020年4月），其他社会经济因素在造成心理困扰的不平等中的占比下降，而年龄和性别则占据了更大的比例。最显著的增长体现在年轻女性身上。在2019年9波和2019年中期波期间，与COVID-19应对相关的行业工作对心理困扰的影响较小，但在2020年4月其占比增加了两倍多。随着COVID-19疫情第一波的发展，人口统计因素对心理困扰的不平等贡献从4月的峰值下降，而慢性健康状况、住房条件以及社区特征则增加了它们对社会经济不平等的贡献。

abstract.text: In general, past studies have estimated the average effect of public smoking bans on youth, ignoring differences across sub-populations. We extend the literature by considering Indigenous youth, who are a vulnerable and previously unexamined group (however, our analysis excludes First Nations youth who live on reserve). We also consider previously unexamined outcomes among youth: self-assessed health and subjective well-being. Our difference-in-differences estimates from Canada indicate that public bans reduced youth smoking and second-hand exposure in public places, on average. There was no displacement on the extensive margin, but the bans increased the number of people who smoke in the homes of youth, conditional on the presence of smokers in the household. Beyond average effects, however, we find that public bans reduced second-hand exposure in the homes of Indigenous youth (particularly Métis youth), on the extensive and intensive margins. The same youth experienced concurrent improvements in self-assessed health and life satisfaction. We conclude that public bans mitigate disparities in health and well-being between Indigenous and non-Indigenous youth, but the extent varies across Indigenous sub-populations, even within a particular country.

10.1002/hec.4276.abstractZh: 总体而言，以往的研究通常仅针对青少年群体估计公共禁烟令的平均影响，而忽略了不同亚群体的差异。我们扩展了这一研究框架，将原住民青少年纳入考量，这一群体历来被视为脆弱且未被充分研究的群体（不过，我们的分析未涵盖居住在保留地内的原住民青少年）。我们还考察了青少年在自我评估的健康状况及主观幸福感方面的变化。来自加拿大的差异比较估计结果显示，公共禁烟令平均减少了青少年在公共场所的吸烟行为及二手烟暴露。虽然在广泛层面上并未出现替代现象，但禁烟令增加了青少年家庭中吸烟者的数量。然而，除了这些平均效应之外，我们发现公共禁烟令在广泛和密集层面上减少了原住民青少年（尤其是梅蒂斯族青少年）家中的二手烟暴露。同时，这些青少年在自我评估的健康状况及生活满意度方面也出现了改善。我们得出结论，公共禁烟令有助于缩小原住民与非原住民青少年之间的健康与福祉差距，但这一效果在不同原住民亚群体中存在差异，即便在同一国家内也是如此。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between the spatial distribution of excess deaths and the presence of care home facilities during the first wave of the COVID-19 outbreak in Italy. Using registry-based mortality data for Lombardy, one of the areas most severely hit by the pandemic we show that the presence of a care home in a municipality is associated with significantly higher excess death rates in the population. This effect appears to be driven by excess mortality in the elderly population of 70 years old and older. Our results are robust to controlling for the number of residents in each care home, suggesting that the presence of such facilities may have acted as one of factors contributing to the diffusion of COVID-19 at the local level.

10.1002/hec.4277.abstractZh: 本文探讨了意大利新冠疫情第一波期间，超额死亡的空间分布与护理院设施存在之间的关联。通过利用伦巴第大区基于登记数据的死亡数据（该大区是疫情最严重的地区之一），我们发现，某个市镇存在护理院时，该地区的超额死亡率会显著上升。这种效应似乎是由70岁及以上老年人口的超额死亡所驱动的。我们的研究结果在控制每个护理院的居民数量后依然保持稳定，这表明这类设施的存在可能是导致当地新冠疫情传播的因素之一。

abstract.text: I show that serious, yet common, parental health events in childhood have immediate and lasting effects on mental health and educational outcomes for children. Following a parental health event, the children are more likely to receive therapy and consume anti-depressant (AD) medication. More so, the children achieve lower test scores and have lower school enrollment rates. The effect immediately occurs following the event and persists at least into early adulthood. I find that the effect on test scores doesn't differ significantly across family income, but that children from low-income families are more likely to be prescribed ADs following the event, while children from high-income families are more likely to receive therapy. Exploiting differences in general practitioners' behavior in prescribing AD and referring children to therapy, I find suggestive evidence that children who are more exposed to medical treatment of mental health issues have lower educational attainments in early adulthood.

10.1002/hec.4278.abstractZh: 我指出，儿童时期发生的严重但常见的父母健康事件会对儿童的心理健康和教育成果产生即时且持久的影响。在父母健康事件发生后，儿童更有可能接受治疗并服用抗抑郁药物。此外，这些儿童的考试成绩较低，入学率也较低。这种影响在事件发生后立即出现，并至少持续到成年早期。我发现，考试成绩的影响在家庭收入方面并没有显著差异，但来自低收入家庭的儿童在事件后更有可能被开具抗抑郁药物，而来自高收入家庭的儿童则更有可能接受治疗。通过研究全科医生在开具抗抑郁药物和治疗儿童方面的行为差异，我发现，那些更容易接受心理健康治疗的儿童在成年早期的教育成就较低。

abstract.text: Decisions on interventions or policy alternatives affecting health can be informed by economic evaluations, like cost-benefit or cost-utility analyses. In this context, there is a need for valid estimates of the monetary equivalent value of health (gains), which are often expressed in € per quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). Obtaining such estimates remains methodologically challenging, with a recent addition to the health economists' toolbox, which is based on well-being data: The well-being valuation approach. Using general population panel data from Germany, we put this approach to the test by investigating several empirical and conceptual challenges, such as the appropriate functional specification of income utility, the choice of health utility tariffs, or the health state dependence of consumption utility. Depending on specification, the bulk of estimated € per QALY values ranged from €20,000-60,000, with certain specifications leading to more considerable deviations, underlining persistent practical challenges when applying the well-being valuation methodology to health and QALYs. Based on our findings, we formulate recommendations for future research and applications.

10.1002/hec.4279.abstractZh: 关于影响健康的干预措施或政策选择的决策，可以通过经济评估来辅助，例如成本效益分析或成本效用分析。在这种情况下，需要有效估算健康的货币等价价值，这些价值通常以欧元/质量调整生命年来表示。然而，这种估算在方法论上仍然存在挑战，最近出现了一种基于幸福感数据的评估方法，即幸福感估值方法。我们利用德国的一般人口面板数据，对这一方法进行了测试，探讨了几个实证和概念上的挑战，例如收入效用的适当函数设定、健康效用税率的选择，以及消费效用的健康状态依赖性等问题。根据不同的设定方式，估算出的每质量调整生命年的欧元价值范围在20,000至60,000欧元之间，某些设定方式会导致更大的偏差，这凸显了在将幸福感估值方法应用于健康和质量调整生命年时存在的持续实际挑战。基于我们的研究结果，我们提出了对未来研究和应用的建议。

abstract.text: This paper examines the immediate and long-term effects of public smoking bans on smoking prevalence, smoking regularity, smoking intensity, and secondhand tobacco smoke exposure. We supplement the extensive literature on the effects of various types of tobacco control legislation on smoking behavior in developed countries by studying the provincial smoking bans and more recent national ban of a middle-income country, Argentina. We focus on the difference between full and partial smoking bans, and take advantage of the time and province variation in ban implementation in order to determine the causal effects of each type of ban. We find that full bans reduce national smoking prevalence over time, especially among younger demographic groups, but have no significant impact on intensity of smoking among smokers. Full bans also benefit nonsmokers, as they are associated with a significant reduction in environmental tobacco smoke exposure. Partial bans do not significantly impact smoking prevalence, and are found to increase smoking intensity among individuals who smoke every day. These findings provide support for ratification of full bans by all provinces according to the National Tobacco Control Law of 2011.

10.1002/hec.4280.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共禁烟令对吸烟率、吸烟频率、吸烟强度以及二手烟草烟雾暴露的直接和长期影响。我们通过研究一个中等收入国家——阿根廷的省级禁烟令以及更近期的全国性禁烟令，补充了关于各类烟草控制立法对发达国家吸烟行为影响的丰富文献。我们重点关注全面禁烟令与部分禁烟令之间的差异，并利用禁令实施的时间和地区差异来确定每种禁烟令的因果效应。研究发现，全面禁烟令能够长期降低全国吸烟率，尤其是在年轻人群体中；但对吸烟者的吸烟强度没有显著影响。全面禁烟令还使非吸烟者受益，因为它们显著减少了环境烟草烟雾的暴露。部分禁烟令对吸烟率的显著影响不明显，反而会增加每天吸烟者的吸烟强度。这些发现支持了根据2011年《国家烟草控制法》所有省份应实施全面禁烟令的必要性。

abstract.text: Health economics uses quality adjusted life years (QALYs) to help healthcare decision makers. However, unlike life expectancy for which age- and sex-dependent national life tables are available, no general population norms exist to use as a benchmark against which to compare observed or modeled projections of QALYs in sub-populations or patients. We developed a 2-state Markov model to generate QALY population norms for the USA, UK, China and Australia. Annual age- and sex-specific probabilities of all-cause mortality were taken from life tables combined with general population country-specific age- and sex-specific health state utilities for the EQ-5D-3L (all countries); and SF-6D (Australia) multi-attribute utility instruments (MAUI). To validate our QALY benchmark model we found that the model closely predicted population life expectancies. Using EQ-5D-3L, undiscounted QALYs for males/females aged 18 years ranged 54.62/58.90 (USA), 55.55/60.21 (China), 57.11/60.16 (Australia), and 58.01/61.43 (UK) years. SF-6D benchmark QALYs for Australia were consistently lower than those generated from the EQ-5D-3L. The gap in undiscounted QALYs between the UK (highest) and the USA (lowest) was 2.53 QALYs in women and 3.39 QALYs in men aged 18 years. Our model's QALY population norms can be used for internal validation of future health economic models for the country-specific value sets for the instruments that we adopted, and when quantifying burden of disease in terms of QALYs lost due to illness compared to the general population. We have created a publicly available repository to continuously include QALY benchmarks that use country-specific value sets for other MAUIs and life expectancies.

10.1002/hec.4281.abstractZh: 健康经济学使用质量调整生命年（QALYs）来帮助医疗决策者。然而，与年龄和性别相关的全国生命表可用于计算预期寿命不同，目前并没有通用的群体标准作为基准，以比较子群体或患者观察到的或建模的QALYs。我们开发了一个双状态马尔可夫模型，用于生成美国、英国、中国和澳大利亚的QALY群体标准。年度年龄和性别特定的全因死亡率概率来自生命表，并结合了通用群体国家特定的年龄和性别特定的健康状态效用函数，用于EQ-5D-3L（所有国家）和SF-6D（澳大利亚）多属性效用工具（MAUI）。为了验证我们的QALY基准模型，我们发现该模型能够准确预测群体预期寿命。使用EQ-5D-3L，18岁男性/女性的未贴现QALYs分别为54.62/58.90（美国）、55.55/60.21（中国）、57.11/60.16（澳大利亚）和58.01/61.43（英国）。澳大利亚的SF-6D基准QALYs始终低于从EQ-5D-3L得出的结果。18岁女性中，英国（最高）与美国（最低）之间的未贴现QALYs差距为2.53 QALYs，男性则为3.39 QALYs。我们的模型生成的QALY群体标准可用于内部验证未来健康经济模型，适用于我们采用的工具的国家特定价值集，并可用于量化疾病造成的QALYs损失与一般人群相比的情况。我们已经创建了一个公开可用的存储库，持续包含使用国家特定价值集为其他MAUIs和预期寿命计算QALY基准的数据。

abstract.text: Using monthly data from the Understanding Society (UKHLS) COVID-19 Survey we analyse the evolution of unmet need and assess how the UK health care system performed against the principle of horizontal equity in health care use during the first wave of COVID-19 wave. Unmet need was most evident for hospital care, and less pronounced for primary health services (non-emergency medical helplines, GP consultations, community pharmacist advice, over the counter medications and prescriptions). Despite this, there is no evidence that horizontal equity, with respect to income, was violated for NHS hospital outpatient and inpatient care during the first wave of the pandemic. There is evidence of pro-rich inequities in use of GP consultations, prescriptions and medical helplines at the peak of the first wave, but these were eliminated as the pandemic progressed. There are persistent pro-rich inequities for services that may relate to individuals' ability to pay (over the counter medications and advice from community pharmacists).

10.1002/hec.4282.abstractZh: 我们利用英国社会理解组织（UKHLS）的COVID-19调查月度数据，分析了未满足需求的变化情况，并评估了英国医疗保健系统在COVID-19第一波疫情期间在医疗使用方面是否遵循了横向公平原则。未满足需求在医院护理方面最为明显，而在初级医疗服务方面则不太明显（如非紧急医疗热线、全科医生咨询、社区药剂师建议、非处方药和处方药物）。尽管如此，没有证据表明在疫情第一波期间，NHS医院门诊和住院护理方面的横向公平原则被违反。在疫情第一波高峰期间，全科医生咨询、处方药物和医疗热线使用方面存在有利于富人的不平等现象，但随着疫情的发展，这些不平等现象得到了消除。在那些可能与个人支付能力相关的服务方面，仍然存在有利于富人的不平等现象（如非处方药和社区药剂师的建议）。

abstract.text: There are several types of pharmaceutical competition. In addition to competition among producers of the same chemical substance ("within-substance competition"), there may be competition among producers of different chemical substances in the same chemical subgroup ("between-substance competition"). There have been numerous econometric studies of the effect of within-substance competition on drug prices, but empirical evidence about the effect of between-substance competition is far more limited. The primary objective of this study is to assess the impact of the entry of new drugs in a drug's therapeutic class on branded drug prices, generic drug prices, and the generic market share, using publicly-available US data for the period 1997-2017. Two methods are used to estimate the effects of between-substance and within-substance competition on those variables. The first method is standard 2-way fixed effects estimation based on aggregate data. The second method, based on micro data, is estimation using the DID_MULTIPLEGT procedure developed by de Chaisemartin et al. (2021), which does not rely on, and allows us to test for, "parallel trends." Between-substance competition does not appear to have any effect on brand-name drug prices, although our inability to fully account for rebates may bias the estimates towards zero. (There is also little evidence for an effect of within-substance competition on brand-name drug prices.) However, between-substance competition has a significant negative effect on generic drug prices. We estimate that the 1985-2005 increase in the number of substances ever registered in a drug's ATC4 chemical subgroup reduced the 2017 price of generic drugs by 42%. (The ratio of the generic-price reduction attributable to rising between-substance competition to the generic-price reduction attributable to rising within-substance competition also happens to be 42%.) A striking finding is that the entry of imitators has no effect on the prices of brand-name drugs, but the entry of innovators has a significant negative effect on the prices of generic drugs in the same ATC4 chemical subgroup. In addition, between-substance competition has a significant positive effect on the generic market share: the 1985-2005 increase in the number of substances ever registered in a drug's ATC4 chemical subgroup increased the 2017 generic market share by 15.0 percentage points. Due to its effects on generic drug prices and the generic market share, the 1985-2005 increase in between-substance competition reduced the average 2017 price of drugs that were already sold in 1997 by 35%. We estimate that 36% of 2017 expenditure on drugs that were first registered during 1986-2005 was offset by reduced 2017 expenditure on drugs that were sold in both 1997 and 2017.

10.1002/hec.4283.abstractZh: 医药竞争有多种类型。除了同一化学物质的生产者之间的竞争（“同类竞争”）之外，同一化学亚组中的不同化学物质的生产者之间也可能存在竞争（“异类竞争”）。已有大量计量经济学研究探讨了同类竞争对药品价格的影响，而关于异类竞争影响的实证证据则相对较少。本研究的主要目标是利用1997-2017年间公开可用的美国数据，评估新药品进入某一治疗类别对品牌药品价格、仿制药价格以及仿制药市场份额的影响。本研究采用了两种方法来估计异类竞争和同类竞争对这些变量的影响。第一种方法是基于汇总数据的标准双向固定效应估计方法。第二种方法基于微观数据，采用de Chaisemartin等人（2021年）开发的DID_MULTIPLEGT程序进行估计，该程序不依赖于某些假设，并允许我们检验“平行趋势”。研究表明，异类竞争对品牌药品价格似乎没有显著影响，尽管我们无法完全考虑回扣因素，这可能导致估计值趋于零。（同时，也没有证据表明同类竞争对品牌药品价格有影响。）然而，异类竞争对仿制药价格有显著的负面影响。我们的估计表明，1985-2005年间在某一ATC4化学亚组中注册的物质数量增加，使得2017年仿制药的价格降低了42%。研究发现，由于药品内部成分竞争导致的 generic-price reduction 与由于药品之间成分竞争导致的 generic-price reduction 的比例也达到了42%。一个显著的发现是，仿制药的进入对品牌药品的价格没有影响，而创新药的进入则对同类ATC4化学分组中的仿制药价格产生了显著的负面影响。此外，药品之间成分竞争对仿制药市场份额有显著的正面影响：1985年至2005年间，同一ATC4化学分组中药品注册成分数量的增加，使得2017年仿制药的市场份额增加了15.0个百分点。由于对仿制药价格和市场份额的影响，1985年至2005年间药品之间成分竞争的增加使得1997年已经销售的药品在2017年的平均价格降低了35%。我们估计，1986年至2005年间首次注册的药品在2017年的支出中，有36%被1997年和2017年都销售的药品在2017年的支出减少所抵消。

abstract.text: We use harmonized household panel data from Europe and the US and a three-state survival model to provide comparable measurements of education and gender inequalities in total, healthy, and unhealthy life expectancies at age 50. Common across countries, the education advantage in total life expectancy is larger for males but the education advantage in (fewer) unhealthy years is larger for females. Counterfactual decompositions show that these results arise because the education advantage in conditional survival rates is relatively more important for males, while the education advantage in better health transitions is relatively more important for females. Across countries, the US stands out with the largest education gradient in healthy life expectancy.

10.1002/hec.4284.abstractZh: 我们使用了来自欧洲和美国的统一家庭面板数据，并结合了三州生存模型，来比较教育和性别因素对50岁时总体预期寿命、健康预期寿命以及不健康预期寿命的影响。各国普遍存在的一个现象是，男性在总体预期寿命上的教育优势更大，而女性在不健康年份上的教育优势则更为显著。反事实分析表明，这些结果源于教育在条件生存率上的优势对男性更为重要，而教育在改善健康状况方面的优势则对女性更为重要。在各国中，美国的健康预期寿命方面的教育梯度最为显著。

abstract.text: Several studies have estimated effects of body mass index (BMI) on labour market outcomes, and these studies have mixed findings. A significant challenge has been to adequately control for omitted variables, selection, reverse causality, and measurement error. We examine the impact of BMI on income using genetic variants as instrumental variables for BMI. Individual-level pre-tax income from tax records was merged with health survey data containing measured height and weight, and data on genetic variants. The analyses were stratified by sex and a variety of methods were used to explore the sensitivity and validity of the instrumental variable (IV) strategy. For females we found that BMI had a negative effect on the logarithm of income. The effect estimated from the IV models (-0.02) was larger than the effect estimated from naïve ordinary least squares regressions (-0.01). For males, the coefficients for the effect of BMI on income were imprecise, and both positive and negative coefficients were estimated depending on the estimation method. Our results suggest that females are susceptible to reduced income levels following increased BMI.

10.1002/hec.4285.abstractZh: 多项研究曾估算过体重指数（BMI）对劳动力市场结果的影响，但这些研究的结论并不一致。一个重要的挑战在于如何充分控制遗漏变量、选择偏差、反向因果关系以及测量误差。本研究使用遗传变异作为BMI的工具变量，来考察BMI对收入的影响。通过税务记录获取的个人税前收入数据与包含身高、体重以及遗传变异数据的人口健康调查数据进行了合并。分析过程中按性别进行了分层，并采用了多种方法来评估工具变量策略的敏感性和有效性。对于女性而言，我们发现BMI对收入的对数存在负面影响。从工具变量模型估算出的效应为-0.02，高于使用简单最小二乘回归法估算出的效应（-0.01）。对于男性而言，BMI对收入影响的系数并不精确，根据所使用的估计方法，估算出的系数既有正值也有负值。我们的研究结果表明，女性在BMI增加后更容易出现收入下降的情况。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of exogenous local conditions which favor high market concentration on supply, price and quality in local markets for care homes for older people in England. We extend the existing literature in: (i) considering supply capacity as a market outcome alongside price and quality; (ii) taking account of the chain structure of care home supply and differences between the nursing home and residential care home sectors; (iii) using an econometric approach based on reduced form relationships that treats market concentration as a jointly determined outcome of a complex market. We find that areas susceptible to a high degree of market concentration tend to have greatly restricted supply of care home places and (to a lesser extent) a higher average public cost, than areas susceptible to low degree of market concentration. There is no significant evidence that conditions favoring high market concentration affect average care home quality.

10.1002/hec.4286.abstractZh: 我们研究了外部局部条件对英格兰老年人护理院市场供应、价格和质量的影响，这些外部条件有利于市场高度集中。我们在以下几个方面扩展了现有研究：(i)将供应能力视为与价格和质量并列的市场结果；(ii)考虑到护理院供应的连锁结构以及养老院和住宅护理院之间的差异；(iii)采用基于简化形式关系的计量经济学方法，将市场集中视为复杂市场共同决定的结果。我们发现，那些容易出现市场高度集中的地区，护理院床位供应往往受到严重限制，平均公共成本也相对较高，而容易出现市场低度集中的地区则情况较为温和。没有证据表明有利于市场高度集中的条件会影响护理院的平均质量。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the consequences that patients face when their regular general practitioner (GP) closes down her practice, typically due to retirement. We estimate the causal impact of closures on patients' utilization patterns, healthcare expenditures, hospitalizations, mortality, and health plan choices. Employing a difference-in-difference framework, we find that patients who experience a discontinuity of care persistently adjust their ambulatory utilization pattern by shifting visits away from GPs (-12%) toward specialists (+11%) and hospital outpatient facilities (+6%). In contrast, we find no evidence on adverse health effects as measured by hospitalizations and mortality. The impact on utilization is heterogeneous along several dimensions. In particular, we find geographic disparities between regions with high and low availability of primary care. We also observe that patients with chronic conditions substitute more strongly toward other providers. Our results have potential implications for health policy in at least two dimensions: first, practice closures lead to more fragmented care which may entail inefficiencies, and second, closures deteriorate access to primary care in regions with low physician density.

10.1002/hec.4287.abstractZh: 本文研究了患者当其常规全科医生因退休而关闭诊所时所面临的后果。我们估算了诊所关闭对患者就诊模式、医疗支出、住院率、死亡率以及健康计划选择的影响。通过差异-差异框架的分析，我们发现经历医疗中断的患者会持续调整其就诊模式，将就诊次数从全科医生转向专科医生，以及医院门诊设施（增加了11%）。相比之下，我们没有发现因住院和死亡率而带来的健康负面影响。就诊模式的影响在多个维度上呈现出异质性。特别是，我们发现不同地区在初级医疗服务的可获得性上存在差异。我们还观察到，患有慢性疾病的患者更倾向于转向其他医疗服务提供者。我们的研究结果在至少两个层面上对卫生政策具有潜在意义：首先，诊所关闭会导致医疗服务的碎片化，这可能带来效率低下的问题；其次，在医生密度较低的地区，诊所关闭会进一步恶化初级医疗服务的可及性。

abstract.text: In response to the opioid crisis, each US state has implemented a prescription drug monitoring program (PDMP) to collect data on controlled substances prescribed and dispensed in the state. I study whether health information technology (HIT) complements patient prescription data in PDMPs to reduce opioid-related mortality and morbidity. A novel dataset is constructed that records state policies that integrate PDMP with HIT and facilitate interstate data sharing. Using difference-in-differences models, I find that PDMP-HIT integration policies reduce opioid-related inpatient morbidity. The reductions are substantial in states that established integration without ever mandating the use of a PDMP. A mechanism test suggests that PDMP integration works mainly through the hospital system while a mandate affects legal opioids prescription. The impacts from integration are strongest for the vulnerable groups-middle-aged, low-to middle-income patients, and those with public insurance. There is suggestive evidence that interstate data sharing further complements integration despite not having a significant impact independently. The results are robust to a set of tests using alternative specifications and measures. The total benefits from integration far exceed the associated costs.

10.1002/hec.4360.abstractZh: 为应对阿片类药物危机，美国各州都实施了处方药监测计划，以收集该州内开具和分发管制药物的相关数据。本研究探讨健康信息技术是否能补充PDMP中的患者处方数据，从而降低与阿片类药物相关的死亡率和发病率。我们构建了一个新的数据集，记录了将PDMP与健康信息技术整合的州政策，以及促进州际数据共享的措施。通过差异-差异模型分析，我们发现PDMP与健康信息技术的整合政策能够降低与阿片类药物相关的住院发病率。在那些未强制要求使用PDMP的州，这种降低效果尤为显著。机制测试表明，PDMP的整合主要通过医院系统发挥作用，而强制要求则主要影响合法阿片类药物的处方。整合对弱势群体——中年、低收入患者以及持有公共保险的患者——的影响最为显著。有证据表明，尽管州际数据共享本身没有显著效果，但它能进一步补充整合措施的效果。研究结果在采用不同规范和度量标准的情况下依然稳健。整合带来的总收益远远超过相关成本。

abstract.text: Technological advancements bring changes to our life, altering our behaviors as well as our role in the economy. In this paper, we examine the potential effect of the rise of robotic technology on health. Using the variation in the initial distribution of industrial employment in US cities and the difference in robot adoption across industries over time to predict robot exposure at the local labor market, we find evidence that higher penetration of industrial robots in the local economy is positively related to the health of the low-skilled population. A 10% increase in robots per 1000 workers is associated with an approximately 10% reduction in the share of low-skilled individuals reporting poor health. Further analysis suggests that the reallocation of tasks partly explains this finding. A 10% increase in robots per 1000 workers is associated with an approximately 1.5% reduction in physical tasks supplied by low-skilled workers.

10.1002/hec.4361.abstractZh: 技术进步改变了我们的生活，也改变了我们的行为以及我们在经济中的角色。在本文中，我们探讨了机器人技术的兴起对健康可能产生的影响。通过研究美国城市工业就业的初始分布变化以及不同行业对机器人的采用情况，我们预测了当地劳动力市场中的机器人普及程度。研究发现，工业机器人的更高普及率与低技能人群的健康状况呈正相关。每1000名工人中增加10%的机器人数量，会导致报告健康状况不佳的低技能人群的比例减少约10%。进一步分析表明，任务的重新分配部分解释了这一现象。每1000名工人中增加10%的机器人数量，会导致低技能工人承担的体力任务减少约1.5%。

abstract.text: Recent debate about raising federal minimum wage to $15 per hour receives substantial public attention. Yet the minimum wage literature has been focusing on the labor market outcomes, with the health implications rarely being discussed. This paper investigates the impact of minimum wage increases on multiple dimensions of cigarette smoking behaviors for the low-skilled population using the Current Population Survey-Tobacco Use Supplement over a long time period (1998-2015). Results show that a $1 increase in the minimum wage raises the prevalence of smoking by about 2.3% and reduces cessation by about 13.7% among the low-skilled workers. With further examinations, we find evidence of an income effect as one potential mechanism that leads to more smoking. The impacts on all low-skilled adults, however, are somewhat smaller, which are most likely driven by the null effects among those who are out of the labor force. We additionally conduct a series of sensitivity tests and confirm the robustness of these results.

10.1002/hec.4362.abstractZh: 近期关于将联邦最低工资提高到每小时15美元的讨论引起了公众的广泛关注。然而，关于最低工资的研究大多集中在劳动力市场的结果上，而其对健康的影响却很少被讨论。本文利用当前人口调查-烟草使用补充数据，在较长时间范围内（1998-2015年）研究了最低工资提高对低技能人群吸烟行为的多重影响。结果显示，最低工资提高1美元会使低技能工人的吸烟率上升约2.3%，并使戒烟率下降约13.7%。进一步分析发现，收入效应可能是导致吸烟增加的潜在机制之一。然而，对所有低技能成年人来说，这种影响相对较小，这很可能是由于那些已经脱离劳动力市场的人的零效应所驱动的。我们还进行了一系列敏感性测试，以确认这些结果的稳健性。

abstract.text: Methods for measuring outcomes suitable for economic evaluations of health and care interventions have primarily focused on adults. The validity of such methods for children and young people is questionable in areas including the outcome domains measured and how they are measured and valued, with most existing measures narrowly focusing on health. Novel methods for assessing benefits beyond health by focusing on a person's capability have also concentrated on adults to date. This paper aims to set out the rationale for capability measures in children and young people. It argues for the need to expand the evaluative space beyond health functioning towards broader capabilities, with children and young people playing an integral role in capability measure development. Drawing from existing literature, specific challenges related to the identification, measurement, and valuation of capabilities in children and young people are also discussed. Finally, the practical implications for conducting economic evaluation when measuring and valuing capabilities at different stages across the life-course are illustrated. We develop an alternative framework based on conceiving capabilities as evolving across the life-course. This framework may also be helpful in thinking about how to model health outcomes across the life-course.

10.1002/hec.4363.abstractZh: 在评估健康和护理干预措施的经济效果时，衡量结果的方法主要集中在成年人身上。对于儿童和年轻人来说，这些方法的有效性在包括所测量的结果领域以及测量和评估方式等方面存在疑问，现有的大多数测量方法都仅关注健康方面。此外，评估健康以外效益的新方法也主要集中在成年人身上。本文旨在阐述在儿童和年轻人中采用能力测量方法的合理性。文章强调需要将评估范围从健康功能扩展到更广泛的能力方面，而儿童和年轻人在能力测量方法的开发中发挥着重要作用。文章还结合现有文献，讨论了与识别和测量儿童及年轻人的能力相关的具体挑战。最后，文章阐述了在生命周期不同阶段衡量和评估能力时进行经济评估的实际意义。我们提出了一种基于将能力视为在生命周期中不断发展的替代框架，这一框架也有助于思考如何对生命周期中的健康结果进行建模。

abstract.text: We study the impact of conflict exposure on health in the Gaza Strip using individual-level longitudinal data and geo-localized information on conflict-related violent events. Results show that individuals living in localities exposed to more conflict events have a higher probability of suffering from a physical impairment and a chronic disease. Two mechanisms contribute to explain why living in conflict-affected area increases the incidence of physical impairment: conflict increases the difficulty to reach health facilities and it decreases individual income. The conflict-induced increase in the probability of having high blood pressure is instead consistent with the development of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) due to the exposure to conflict-related violent events.

10.1002/hec.4364.abstractZh: 我们利用个体层面的纵向数据以及关于冲突相关暴力事件的地理定位信息，研究了冲突暴露对加沙地带健康的影响。研究结果表明，生活在更多冲突事件发生的地区的人们，出现身体损伤和慢性疾病的几率更高。有两个机制可以解释为什么生活在受冲突影响地区会增加身体损伤的发生率：冲突使得获取医疗服务的难度增加，同时降低了个人收入。而冲突导致的高血压发生率增加，则与因冲突相关暴力事件而引发的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）的发展相一致。

abstract.text: This paper assesses whether providing people with information on the public benefits of bed net use, and on other people's bed net use, changes their bed net use behavior. I use a survey experiment from rural Kenya, where randomly selected households are provided with information on the public benefits generated by bed net use, and on the consequences of an individual's own bed net use on the health of the immediate neighbor. The results show that information increased willingness to use bed nets, and that people are more willing to use bed nets when they know other people are using them as well. Results are robust to the inclusion of a broad set of controls, including risk aversion; number of household members to have suffered from malaria in the past 12 months; and number of children in the household who are below five years age. Overall, these results suggest that in addition to free distribution of bed nets, informing people on the private and public benefits of bed net use could potentially save many more lives.

10.1002/hec.4365.abstractZh: 本文评估了向人们提供关于使用蚊帐的公共利益信息，以及他人使用蚊帐的情况，是否会改变他们的蚊帐使用行为。我们采用了肯尼亚农村的一项调查实验，随机选取的家庭获得了关于使用蚊帐所产生的公共利益的详细信息，以及个人使用蚊帐对邻近居民健康的影响。结果显示，这些信息增加了人们使用蚊帐的意愿，而且当人们知道其他人也在使用蚊帐时，他们更愿意使用蚊帐。研究结果在纳入一系列控制变量后依然保持稳定，包括风险厌恶程度、过去12个月内家庭成员患疟疾的人数，以及家庭中五岁以下儿童的数量。总体而言，这些结果表明，除了免费分发蚊帐外，向人们提供关于使用蚊帐的私人和公共利益的信息，有可能挽救更多的生命。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of birth allowances (so-called baby bonus) on fertility, newborn health, and birth-scheduling in Switzerland. Switzerland provides an optimal quasi-experiment: 11 out of 26 cantons introduced a baby bonus during the last 50 years at different points in time. To identify the effect of changes in the baby bonus, we employ an event study with control groups using several administrative data sets on births, stillbirths, and infant deaths in Switzerland from 1969 to 2017. While there is no evidence for birth-scheduling, we find, however, a sizable but only temporary increase in the fertility rate of 5.5% and a permanent but diminishing increase in the birth weight of 2.8%. The latter effect is particularly strong at the lower end of the birth weight distribution. Furthermore, we document substantial heterogeneity by citizenship of mothers.

10.1002/hec.4366.abstractZh: 本文研究了出生津贴（所谓的“婴儿奖金”）对瑞士生育率、新生儿健康和出生时间安排的影响。瑞士提供了一个理想的准实验环境：在过去的50年中，26个州中有11个在不同的时间引入了婴儿奖金制度。为了识别婴儿奖金变化的影响，我们采用事件研究法，结合对照组，利用1969年至2017年间瑞士的出生、死胎和婴儿死亡数据。虽然没有证据表明出生时间安排发生了变化，但我们发现生育率出现了显著但短暂的上升，为5.5%，同时婴儿出生体重出现了持续但逐渐下降的趋势，为2.8%。后一种效应在出生体重分布较低端尤为明显。此外，我们还发现不同国籍的母亲在生育行为上存在显著的异质性。

abstract.text: In public health epidemiology, quasi-experimental methods are widely used to estimate the causal impacts of interventions. In this paper, we demonstrate the contribution the synthetic control method (SCM) can make in evaluating public health interventions, when routine surveillance data are available and the validity of other quasi-experimental approaches may be in question. In our application, we evaluate the short-term effects of a large-scale Mass Drug Administration (MDA) based malaria elimination initiative in Southern Mozambique. We apply the SCM to district level weekly malaria incidence data and compare the observed reduction in age group specific malaria incidence. Between August 2015 and April 2017, a total of 13,322 (78%) cases of malaria were averted relative to the synthetic control. During the peak malaria seasons, the elimination initiative resulted in an 87% reduction in Year 1 (December 2015-April 2016), and 79% reduction in Year 2 (December 2016-April 2017). Comparison with an interrupted time series approach shows the SCM accounts for pre-intervention trends in the data and post-intervention weather events influencing malaria cases. We conclude MDA brought about a drastic reduction in malaria burden and can be a useful addition to existing (or new) vector control strategies and tools in accelerating towards elimination.

10.1002/hec.4367.abstractZh: 在公共卫生流行病学中，准实验方法被广泛用于评估干预措施的因果效应。本文展示了合成控制法在评估公共卫生干预措施时的作用，尤其是在常规监测数据可用且其他准实验方法的有效性受到质疑的情况下。在我们的研究中，我们评估了莫桑比克南部一项大规模药物管理计划对疟疾消除的短期效果。我们将合成控制法应用于地区级别的每周疟疾发病率数据，并比较了特定年龄组疟疾发病率的降低情况。在2015年8月至2017年4月期间，与合成控制相比，共有13,322例（78%）疟疾病例得以避免。在疟疾高发季节，该消除计划在第一年（2015年12月至2016年4月）实现了87%的减少，在第二年（2016年12月至2017年4月）实现了79%的减少。与中断时间序列方法相比，合成控制法能够考虑到数据中的干预前趋势以及影响疟疾病例的干预后天气事件。我们得出结论，药物管理计划显著减少了疟疾负担，可以成为现有或新的病媒控制策略的有效补充，有助于加速实现疟疾消除的目标。

abstract.text: In many low- and middle-income countries, geographical accessibility continues to be a barrier to health care utilization. In this paper, we aim to better understand the full relationship between distance to providers and utilization of maternal delivery services. We address three methodological challenges: non-linear effects between distance and utilization; unobserved heterogeneity through non-random distance "assignment"; and heterogeneous effects of distance. Linking Malawi Demographic Health Survey household data to Service Provision Assessment facility data, we consider distance as a continuous treatment variable, estimating a Dose-Response Function based on generalized propensity scores, allowing exploration of non-linearities in the effect of an increment in distance at different distance exposures. Using an instrumental variables approach, we examine the potential for unobserved differences between women residing at different distances to health facilities. Our results suggest distance significantly reduces the probability of having a facility delivery, with evidence of non-linearities in the effect. The negative relationship is shown to be particularly strong for women with poor health knowledge and lower socio-economic status, with important implications for equity. We also find evidence of potential unobserved confounding, suggesting that methods that ignore such confounding may underestimate the effect of distance on the utilization of health services.

10.1002/hec.4368.abstractZh: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，地理上的可达性仍然是影响医疗服务利用的一个障碍。本文旨在更深入地了解距离医疗服务提供者的远近与医疗服务利用之间的完整关系。我们面临三个方法论上的挑战：距离与利用之间的非线性效应；由于非随机的距离“分配”而产生的未观测到的异质性；以及距离带来的不同效应。通过将马拉维人口健康调查的家庭数据与医疗服务提供评估设施的数据联系起来，我们将距离视为一个连续的处理变量，并基于广义倾向评分估计剂量-反应函数，从而能够探索在不同距离条件下距离增加所带来的非线性效应。通过工具变量方法，我们研究了居住在不同距离的健康设施之间的女性之间可能存在的未观测到的差异。我们的研究结果表明，距离显著降低了进行设施分娩的概率，且这种效应存在非线性特征。对于健康知识匮乏和社会经济地位较低的女性来说，这种负相关性尤为明显，这对公平性具有重要意义。我们还发现了潜在未观测到的混杂因素，这表明忽略这种混杂因素的方法可能会低估距离对医疗服务利用的影响。

abstract.text: Is workers' health more sensitive to losses than gains in job security? I address this question using the 1999 rise in the French Delalande tax as a quasi-natural experiment. The tax design allows to separately identify the causal impact of exogenous gains and losses in job security on workers' health. Difference-in-differences estimation results show that a greater job insecurity reduces significantly self-reported health. At the same time, more job security does not translate into a higher level of self-reported health.

10.1002/hec.4369.abstractZh: 工人的健康对就业保障的丧失是否比收益更为敏感？本文以1999年法国Delalande税制的变动作为准自然实验来探讨这一问题。该税制的设计使得可以单独识别就业保障中外部收益与损失对工人健康的因果影响。差异估计结果显示，更大的就业不稳定性显著降低了工人自我报告的健康状况。同时，更稳定的就业保障并不会带来更高的自我报告健康水平。

abstract.text: Moral hazard and adverse selection are potential explanations for missing health insurance in low-income countries. In recent years, informal financial institutions have attempted to complete health insurance markets by offering micro health insurance (MHI). We evaluate an MHI offered through informal financial institutions (Self-Help Groups) in Maharashtra, India. Exploiting random assignment of when villages were offered the MHI, we do not find support for MHI increasing health care utilization. In contrast, we do find evidence for adverse selection: enrollees are significantly more likely than non-enrollees to report poor health prior to the introduction of MHI. This adverse selection persists even when the MHI is offered as a group insurance to Self-Help Groups, as opposed to individual insurance. Our results suggest that MHI offered through informal financial groups may not suffer from moral hazard, but does fall short of eliminating adverse selection.

10.1002/hec.4370.abstractZh: 道德风险与逆向选择可能是低收入国家健康保险缺失的潜在原因。近年来，非正规金融机构试图通过提供微型健康保险来填补健康保险市场的空白。我们评估了印度马哈拉施特拉邦通过非正规金融机构（自助小组）提供的微型健康保险。通过随机分配村庄接受微型健康保险的时间点，我们发现微型健康保险并未增加医疗服务的利用率。相反，我们发现逆向选择的证据：在微型健康保险引入之前，参保者报告健康状况较差的可能性显著高于非参保者。即使微型健康保险以团体保险的形式提供给自助小组，这种逆向选择仍然存在。我们的结果表明，通过非正规金融机构提供的微型健康保险可能并未受到道德风险的影响，但未能完全消除逆向选择的问题。

abstract.text: During the first United Kingdom wave of the COVID-19 outbreak, the first lockdown was announced on March 23, 2020, with a final easing of the restrictions on July 4, 2020. Among the most important public health costs of lockdown restrictions are the potential adverse effects on mental health and physical activity. Using data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and Google COVID-19 Mobility Reports we find evidence of reduced park mobility during the initial period of the first UK lockdown and confirm existing evidence of worsening mental health. Linkage with weather data shows that contrary to popular belief, daily or weekly weather conditions do not exacerbate the mental health consequences of the pandemic, as we found no systematic associations during the first lockdown period; on the other hand, we find systematic links between park mobility and weather over the same period.

10.1002/hec.4371.abstractZh: 在英国首次出现COVID-19疫情时，首次封锁措施于2020年3月23日宣布，最终放宽限制措施则于2020年7月4日实施。封锁措施带来的最重要的公共卫生成本之一，是对心理健康和体力活动的潜在负面影响。通过英国家庭纵向研究数据和谷歌COVID-19出行报告，我们发现英国首次封锁初期，公园内的活动量减少，并证实了现有关于心理健康恶化的证据。结合天气数据分析后发现，与普遍看法相反，日常或每周的天气状况并不会加剧疫情对心理健康的影响，因为在首次封锁期间并未发现系统性关联；另一方面，我们发现同一时期公园活动量与天气状况之间存在系统性关联。

abstract.text: Prior to the Affordable Care Act (ACA), insurance companies could charge higher premiums, or outright deny coverage, to people with preexisting health problems. But the ACA's "guaranteed issue" provision forbids such price discrimination and denials of coverage. This paper seeks to determine whether, after implementation of the ACA, nongroup private insurance plans have experienced adverse selection. Our empirical approach employs a copula-based hurdle regression model, with dependence modeled as a function of dimensions along which adverse selection might occur. Our main finding is that, after implementation of the ACA, nongroup insurance enrollees with preexisting health problems do not appear to exhibit adverse selection. This finding suggests that the ACA's mandate that everyone acquire coverage might have attracted enough healthy enrollees to offset any adverse selection.

10.1002/hec.4372.abstractZh: 在《平价医疗法案》实施之前，保险公司可以向有既往健康问题的患者收取更高的保费，或者完全拒绝为他们提供保险。但《平价医疗法案》中的“保证提供保险”条款禁止了这种价格歧视和拒绝提供保险的行为。本文旨在探讨在《平价医疗法案》实施之后，非团体私人保险计划是否经历了逆向选择问题。我们的实证方法采用了基于Copula的障碍回归模型，将依赖性作为逆向选择可能发生的维度函数来建模。我们的主要发现是，在《平价医疗法案》实施之后，有既往健康问题的非团体保险参保者似乎并未出现逆向选择现象。这一发现表明，《平价医疗法案》要求每个人都必须获得保险的规定，可能吸引了足够多的健康参保者，从而抵消了任何逆向选择的影响。

abstract.text: This paper establishes a unified framework to fully account for the changing social gradient over the lifecycle in terms of a sufficient set of mobility indices characterizing the coevolution of socioeconomic status and health within each of a series of overlapping cohorts. We proceed to demonstrate the impact of selective mortality on health inequality changes, making use of a counterfactual health distribution for the start of the study period that leaves out those who are known to die before the end. Specifically, initial differences between the average health and educational attainment rank of survivors and nonsurvivors are found in our empirical study to be an increasingly important factor explaining changes in the education-health gradient in older cohorts in Great Britain. Our identification strategy has the advantage that it does not require the imputation of the "would be" health of nonsurvivors, which if carried out using inverse probability weighting procedures-as in several previous studies-is shown to bias estimates of this direct effect of selective mortality toward zero. Parallel results for the income-health gradient exhibit stronger confounding influences due to a number of other factors given that income is a less stable indicator of socioeconomic status in adulthood.

10.1002/hec.4373.abstractZh: 本文建立了一个统一的框架，以充分考虑生命周期中社会梯度变化的情况，通过一系列 Mobility 指标来表征社会经济地位与健康之间的共同演化。我们进一步探讨了选择性死亡对健康不平等变化的影响，使用了研究起始时期的一个反事实健康分布模型，该模型排除了那些在研究结束前去世的人群。具体来说，我们的实证研究发现，幸存者与非幸存者在平均健康水平和教育成就方面的初始差异，是解释英国老年群体教育-健康梯度变化的重要因素。我们的识别策略具有优势，因为它不需要对非幸存者的“原本会有的”健康状况进行插补，而如果使用逆概率加权方法来进行插补的话，正如一些先前的研究所显示的那样，这可能会导致选择性死亡的这一直接效应的估计值趋于零。对于收入-健康梯度的研究也显示了更强的混杂效应，因为收入是成年后社会经济地位的一个不太稳定的指标。

abstract.text: In clinical trials, smoking-cessation aids (SCAs) have proven to be effective at improving the odds of smoking cessation. Because of the effectiveness of SCAs in these settings, many countries have adopted the coverage of SCAs to reduce tobacco use. However, the effect of such coverage on tobacco use is ambiguous. On one hand, the coverage may have the intended effect and reduce tobacco use. On the other hand, the coverage may cause beneficiaries to participate in tobacco use more as the drug coverage protects beneficiaries from future costs associated with tobacco use. To understand the effect of SCA coverage, we examine it using 2008-2012 Canadian Tobacco Use Monitoring Survey and a difference-in-differences approach. We find that SCA coverage increases cigarette and cigarillo use. Moreover, the effect of SCA coverage on tobacco use is stronger in men and in those with at least a college education. Our results point to the unintended consequences of the coverage of SCAs on tobacco use.

10.1002/hec.4375.abstractZh: 在临床试验中，戒烟辅助工具被证明能够有效提高戒烟的成功率。由于这些工具的有效性，许多国家采用了戒烟辅助工具的政策来减少烟草使用。然而，这种政策对烟草使用的影响并不明确。一方面，这种政策可能达到预期效果，减少烟草使用；另一方面，由于药物覆盖使受益者免于未来因烟草使用而产生的费用，这可能导致他们更频繁地使用烟草。为了了解戒烟辅助工具政策的实际效果，我们采用了2008-2012年加拿大烟草使用监测调查数据，并采用差异-差异分析法进行分析。研究发现，戒烟辅助工具政策的实施增加了香烟和雪茄的使用量。此外，戒烟辅助工具政策对男性以及至少受过大学教育的人群的烟草使用影响更为显著。我们的研究结果揭示了戒烟辅助工具政策对烟草使用的非预期影响。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of policies aimed at restricting the use of false identification to purchase alcohol on traffic fatalities involving alcohol-impaired underage drivers. We find that the implementation of policies that incentivize alcohol retailers to adopt ID scanners reduces traffic fatalities from accidents involving 16-18 year old drivers with a BAC >0, but we do not find that similar policies like vertical ID laws lead to statistically significant changes in traffic fatalities involving underage impaired drivers. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that if all remaining states passed ID scanner laws, the reduction in underage alcohol-related fatal accidents would generate over $400 million in annual economic benefits.

10.1002/hec.4376.abstractZh: 我们研究了旨在限制使用虚假身份证件购买酒精饮料的政策对涉及酒精影响的未成年驾驶员交通事故死亡人数的影响。研究发现，实施激励酒精零售商使用身份识别扫描器的政策能够减少16-18岁驾驶员在血液酒精浓度超过0的情况下发生的交通事故死亡人数，但我们并未发现类似的政策如垂直身份识别法律能够显著改变涉及未成年驾驶员酒精影响的交通事故死亡人数。粗略计算表明，如果所有剩余州都通过身份识别扫描器法律，那么减少未成年驾驶员因酒精引发的死亡事故将带来超过4亿美元的年经济效益。

abstract.text: The opioid epidemic in the United States has accelerated during the COVID-19 pandemic. As of 2021, roughly a third of Americans now live in a state with a recreational cannabis law (RCL). Recent evidence indicates RCLs could be a harm reduction tool to address the opioid epidemic. Individuals may use cannabis to manage pain, as well as to relieve opioid withdrawal symptoms, though it does not directly treat opioid use disorder. It is thus unclear whether RCLs are an effective policy tool to reduce adverse opioid-related health outcomes. In this study, we examine the impact of RCLs on a key opioid-related adverse health outcome: opioid-related emergency department (ED) visit rates. We estimate event study models using nearly comprehensive ED data from 29 states from 2011 to 2017. We find that RCLs reduce opioid-related ED visit rates by roughly 7.6% for two quarters after implementation. These effects are driven by men and adults aged 25-44. These effects dissipate after 6 months. Our estimates indicate RCLs did not increase opioid-related ED visits. We conclude that, while cannabis liberalization may offer some help in curbing the opioid epidemic, it is likely not a panacea.

10.1002/hec.4377.abstractZh: 在美国，阿片类药物危机在COVID-19疫情期间进一步加剧。截至2021年，大约三分之一的美国人生活在有娱乐性大麻法律的州。最新证据表明，娱乐性大麻法律可能是减少阿片类药物危机危害的一种手段。人们可能会使用大麻来缓解疼痛，以及缓解阿片类药物戒断症状，尽管它并不能直接治疗阿片类药物使用障碍。因此，目前尚不清楚娱乐性大麻法律是否是减少与阿片类药物相关的不良健康后果的有效政策工具。在这项研究中，我们考察了娱乐性大麻法律对与阿片类药物相关的关键不良健康后果的影响：与阿片类药物相关的急诊就诊率。我们使用2011至2017年间来自29个州的几乎全面的急诊数据，建立了事件研究模型。研究发现，在实施娱乐性大麻法律后的两个季度内，娱乐性大麻法律使与阿片类药物相关的急诊就诊率降低了约7.6%。这些效应主要由男性以及25-44岁的成年人所承担。这些效应在6个月后消失。我们的估计表明，娱乐性大麻法律并没有增加与阿片类药物相关的急诊就诊次数。我们得出结论，虽然大麻的放开可能在遏制阿片类药物危机方面提供一些帮助，但它可能并非万能药。

abstract.text: We analyze the timing, magnitude, and income dependence of pharmaceutical panic buying around the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary. We use district-level monthly and daily administrative data on detailed categories of pharmaceutical purchases, merge them to income statistics, and estimate multilevel panel models. Our main results are as follows. First, the days of therapy (DOT) of pharmaceutical purchases increased by more than 30% in March 2020, when major lockdown measures were announced. This pattern holds for almost all categories of pharmaceuticals. Second, shortly after the panic reactions, the aggregate amount of pharmaceutical purchases returned to their preshock levels; however, the frequency of pharmacy visits decreased. Third, the panic buying reaction was significantly stronger in richer geographical areas, where-according to the daily data-people also reacted earlier to the pandemic-related news. Overall, the results suggest that panic buying of pharmaceuticals can have detrimental effects on vulnerable populations.

10.1002/hec.4378.abstractZh: 我们分析了COVID-19疫情爆发期间匈牙利地区药品恐慌性购买的时间、规模以及收入依赖性。我们使用了地区级别的月度及每日药品购买数据，将其与收入统计数据进行合并，并采用多层面板模型进行估计。主要研究结果如下：首先，在2020年3月宣布重大封锁措施时，药品购买的“治疗日”增加了30%以上，这一趋势几乎适用于所有类别的药品。其次，在恐慌反应过后，药品购买总量逐渐恢复到疫情前的水平，但药店访问的频率却有所下降。第三，在收入较高的地区，恐慌性购买反应更为强烈，根据每日数据，这些地区的居民对疫情相关新闻的反应更为迅速。总体而言，这些结果表明，药品恐慌性购买可能对脆弱群体产生负面影响。

abstract.text: This study uses individual level data from a 13-year, nationally representative rotating panel survey of Kyrgyzstan to estimate the effects of fluctuations in predicted income on health and nutrition outcomes from early childhood to adulthood. We consider impacts on both undernutrition and overnutrition side-by-side, and carefully consider the mechanisms at work. We address the endogeneity of income following Bartik (1991): We construct a measure of predicted income, obtained using the household's initial period share of income from different sources and aggregate national growth rates over time in each source. We find that young children (under age 5) exposed to reductions in predicted income experienced reductions in important measures of health and nutrition: weight, weight-for-age Z-scores, and weight-for-height Z-scores. We further identify reductions in both weight and height among older children (aged 5-18). Declines in child health and nutrition are most pronounced among households most dependent on agriculture and those living in rural areas. Reduced consumption of healthy foods and reduced parental time spent with children may help explain the results. A channel possibly offsetting negative impacts is increased use of contraceptives. At the same time, older children and adults experienced decreases in body mass index and-for adults-decreases in the incidence of overweight and obesity, suggesting selective health benefits for some groups.

10.1002/hec.4379.abstractZh: 本研究利用吉尔吉斯斯坦一项为期13年、具有全国代表性的循环面板调查中的个体数据，来估算预期收入波动对从幼儿期到成年期健康和营养状况的影响。我们同时考虑了营养不良和营养过剩的影响，并仔细研究了其中的机制。针对Bartik（1991）提出的收入内生性问题，我们构建了预期收入的衡量指标，该指标基于家庭在不同来源的收入占比以及各来源的收入随时间的增长情况来计算。研究发现，5岁以下的幼儿在预期收入减少的情况下，其体重、体重与年龄的Z分数以及体重与身高的Z分数等重要健康与营养指标都会下降。此外，5至18岁的较大儿童也出现了体重和身高的下降。在最依赖农业的家庭和农村地区的家庭中，儿童健康和营养状况的下降最为明显。健康食品消费减少以及父母与子女相处时间的减少可能有助于解释这些结果。此外，使用避孕措施可能抵消部分负面影响。同时，较大儿童和成人体重指数的下降以及超重和肥胖发病率的降低，表明某些群体可能获得了选择性健康收益。

abstract.text: Although cannabis is federally prohibited, a majority of U.S. states have implemented medical cannabis laws (MCLs). As more individuals consider the drug for medical treatment, they potentially substitute away from prescription drugs. Therefore, an MCL signals competitor entry. This paper exploits geographic and temporal variation in MCLs to examine the strategic response in direct-to-physician marketing by pharmaceutical firms as cannabis enters the market. Using office detailing records from 2014-2018 aggregated to the county level, we find weak evidence of a relatively small and delayed response in substitute prescription drug- and opioid-related detailing. While these effects on detailing dollars are more pronounced among smaller pharmaceutical firms, the magnitudes are economically small and likely muted at aggregate levels by the small percent of doctors that actively recommend cannabis for medical treatment.

10.1002/hec.4380.abstractZh: 尽管大麻在联邦层面被禁止，但大多数美国州已经实施了医用大麻法律。随着越来越多的人考虑将大麻用于医疗治疗，他们可能会逐渐替代处方药。因此，医用大麻法律的实施意味着竞争对手的进入。本文通过研究医用大麻法律在地理和时间上的差异，来探讨制药公司在大麻进入市场时针对医生直接营销的战略反应。利用2014年至2018年的办公室详细数据，我们发现在替代处方药和阿片类药物相关的详细数据方面，反应较为微弱且滞后。虽然这些影响在较小的制药公司中更为明显，但从经济角度来看，这种影响微不足道，而且由于有少量医生主动推荐医用大麻，这种影响在总体层面上可能被抵消。

abstract.text: The income-adjusted price of fast food in China is five times more than in the United States, yet we show that the introduction of Western fast-food restaurants to China still leads to significant weight gain in children. Using the community-year-level presence of Western fast-food outlets, difference-in-differences estimations find a 4.8-percentage-point increase in the prevalence of overweight/obese children after controlling for child and year fixed effects. The effect decreases at a distance of 3-4 km from a fast-food restaurant, and we find no further weight gain 2 years after the restaurant's introduction. The underweight rate is not affected by fast-food introduction. The increase in fat share of energy intake serves as the channel for weight gain. Children in high-income families, younger than 11 years, and girls are more affected than other Chinese children.

10.1002/hec.4381.abstractZh: 中国快餐的收入调整后价格是美国市场的五倍，然而我们的研究表明，西方快餐店在中国引入后，仍然会导致儿童体重显著增加。通过分析西方快餐店在社区和年份层面的分布，差异估计结果显示，在控制儿童和年份固定效应后，超重/肥胖儿童的比例增加了4.8个百分点。当距离快餐店3-4公里时，这种影响会减弱，并且在快餐店引入两年后，不再出现进一步的体重增加。快餐店的引入并未对体重过轻的儿童产生影响。能量摄入中脂肪比例的增加是导致体重增加的途径。高收入家庭的孩子、11岁以下的儿童以及女孩受到的影响比其他中国儿童更为严重。

abstract.text: In health economics, the distinction between welfarism and extra-welfarism has been employed to discuss various epistemological and normative differences between health evaluation approaches. However, a clear consensus on the definition of either welfarism, extra-welfarism, or the differences between the two sets of approaches has not emerged. I propose an alternative set of distinctions that allows for a more fine-grained categorization of health evaluation approaches. This categorization focuses on five dimensions: (1) the maximand of an evaluation approach, (2) its sensitivity toward normative concerns that defy compensation, (3) its position on which groups of individuals or collective entities act as sources of values, (4) its sensitivity to changes of mind, and (5) the inclusion of process-external values.

10.1002/hec.4382.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，人们常使用“福利主义”与“超福利主义”这两个概念来区分不同的健康评估方法在认识论和规范性上的差异。然而，对于这两种主义的定义或它们之间的区别，目前尚未形成明确的共识。我提出了一套替代性的分类方法，可以更细致地划分健康评估方式。这一分类基于五个维度：(1)评估方法的核心目标，(2)其对那些无法用补偿来解决的规范性问题的敏感度，(3)关于哪些群体或个人或集体实体应被视为价值来源的定位，(4)对观念变化的敏感性，以及(5)是否包含过程外部的价值。

abstract.text: In response to the Covid-19 outbreak, the Italian Government imposed an economic lockdown on March 22, 2020, and ordered the closing of all non-essential economic activities. This paper estimates the causal effects of this measure on mortality by Covid-19 and on mobility patterns. The identification of the causal effects exploits the variation in the active population across municipalities induced by the economic lockdown. The difference-in-differences empirical design compares outcomes in municipalities above and below the median variation in the share of active population before and after the lockdown within a province, also controlling for municipality-specific dynamics, daily shocks at the provincial level, and municipal unobserved characteristics. Our results show that the intensity of the economic lockdown is associated with a statistically significant reduction in mortality by Covid-19 and, in particular, for age groups between 40 and 64 and older (with larger and more significant effects for individuals above 50). Back of the envelope calculations indicate that 4793 deaths were avoided, in the 26 days between April 5 and April 30, in the 3518 municipalities which experienced a more intense lockdown. Several robustness checks corroborate our empirical findings.

10.1002/hec.4383.abstractZh: 为应对新冠疫情，意大利政府于2020年3月22日实施了经济封锁，并下令关闭所有非必要的经济活动。本文旨在评估这一措施对新冠死亡率和出行模式的影响。通过利用经济封锁导致的各市镇活跃人口变化，本文能够识别这些影响的因果关系。差异-差异模型设计比较了在封锁前后活跃人口比例处于中位数上下各一个区间的市镇的结果，同时控制了各市镇的特有动态、省级日常冲击以及市镇未观测到的特征。研究结果表明，经济封锁的严格程度与新冠死亡率的显著下降相关，尤其是在40至64岁及更高年龄段的群体中（50岁以上个体的影响更为显著）。初步计算显示，在4月5日至4月30日的26天内，有4793例死亡被避免，这些地区均为实施更严格封锁的3518个市镇。多项稳健性检验也证实了我们的实证发现。

abstract.text: Using cross-sectional survey data from Indonesia from 2007 and 2014, this study estimates the effect of the number of available television channels during childhood on food consumption later in life with a focus on unhealthy food items. To address endogeneity of television signal strength, I exploit exogenous variations in television signal quality due to random diffractions caused by topography within a small area. Using an instrumental variables approach the results suggest that exposure to television during youth of the household head has a positive effect on household-level snack and soft drink expenditures. At the individual level I document more frequent consumption of soft drinks. Additional analysis suggests that households shift their consumption basket at the expense of vegetables and staples. Finally, heterogeneous effects analysis imply that results are driven by young individuals who are younger than 24 years old.

10.1002/hec.4384.abstractZh: 本研究利用2007年至2014年印度尼西亚的横向调查数据，估计了童年时期可观看电视频道数量对日后食物消费的影响，重点关注不健康食品的消费情况。为解决电视信号强度内生性问题，我利用小区域内地形导致的随机散射现象，将电视信号质量的变化视为外生变量。通过工具变量方法分析发现，家庭主人在青少年时期接触电视，会积极影响家庭层面的零食和饮料支出。在个体层面，研究还发现人们更频繁地消费饮料。进一步分析表明，家庭会为了增加饮料消费而减少蔬菜和其他主食的摄入。最后，异质性效应分析表明，研究结果主要受到24岁以下年轻人的影响。

abstract.text: Narrow network health insurance plans have been shown to have lower premiums and lower costs to insurers. This paper decomposes and quantifies the magnitudes for various mechanisms by which networks may reduce premiums and costs. Using data on the Colorado non-group market, we examine three mechanisms through which a narrow network might achieve lower costs: (1) enroll a population with lower utilization, (2) negotiate lower prices, or (3) steer patients away from high-cost hospitals. We find that all three mechanisms play a role. Narrow plans are partly able to achieve lower costs because they both steer patients to lower cost hospitals and, for a given hospital, negotiate lower prices than broad plans. The lower negotiated prices mechanism accounts for 15% of the cost savings to narrow network plans, and the steering away from higher cost hospitals accounts for about 18%. Both of these mechanisms can be ways to efficiently lower costs. The remaining 67% of the cost savings is due to lower utilization of narrow network plan enrollees. These findings are important for policymakers considering how to balance containing healthcare costs with concern for the appropriate regulation of narrow network plans.

10.1002/hec.4385.abstractZh: 研究表明，窄网络健康保险计划的保费和成本都较低。本文对网络降低保费和成本的各种机制进行了分解和量化分析。利用科罗拉多州非团体市场的数据，我们研究了窄网络实现成本降低的三种机制：(1) 招募使用率较低的人群；(2) 协商更低的价格；(3) 引导患者远离高成本医院。我们发现这三种机制都发挥着作用。窄网络计划能够降低成本，部分原因是它们能够引导患者前往成本较低的医院，并且对于同一家医院而言，其协商价格也低于宽网络计划。较低的价格协商机制占窄网络计划成本节约的15%，而引导患者远离高成本医院则占约18%。这两种机制都可以有效降低成本。剩余67%的成本节约是由于窄网络计划参保者的使用率较低所致。这些发现对于考虑如何平衡控制医疗成本与合理监管窄网络计划的政策制定者来说非常重要。

abstract.text: Subsidising quality-assured artemisinin combination therapies (QAACTs) for distribution in the for-profit sector is a controversial strategy for improving access. The Affordable Medicines Facility-malaria (AMFm) was the largest initiative of this kind. We assessed the equity of AMFm in two ways using nationally representative household survey data on care seeking for children from Nigeria and Uganda. First, the delivery of subsidized drugs through the for-profit sector via AMFm was compared with two alternative mechanisms: subsidized delivery in public health facilities and unsubsidized delivery in the for-profit sector. Second, we developed a novel extension of benefit incidence analysis (BIA) methods based on the concept of pass-through, and applied them to Uganda. In Nigeria, the use of subsidized QAACTs from both public health facilities and for-profit outlets was concentrated among the rich, while in Uganda, the use of QAACTs from both sources was concentrated among the poor. Similarly, the BIA of AMFm found that the intervention was pro-poor in Uganda. Unsubsidized antimalarials from for-profit outlets were distributed equally across wealth quintiles in both countries. Private sector subsidies may have a role in bolstering access to effective malaria treatments, including among the poor, but the equity impact of subsidies may depend on context.

10.1002/hec.4386.abstractZh: 为营利性部门提供补贴的优质青蒿素组合疗法（QAACTs）的推广策略在改善获取途径方面存在争议。 Affordable Medicines Facility-malaria（AMFm）是此类计划中规模最大的项目。我们利用来自尼日利亚和乌干达的具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，从两个方面评估了AMFm的公平性。首先，通过AMFm在营利性部门提供的补贴药品与两种替代机制进行了比较：在公共卫生设施中提供补贴药品，以及在营利性部门中提供无补贴药品。其次，我们基于“传递性”概念开发了一种新的效益发生率分析方法，并将其应用于乌干达。在尼日利亚，来自公共卫生设施和营利性机构的补贴QAACTs主要被富人使用，而在乌干达，来自这两种来源的QAACTs主要被穷人使用。同样，AMFm的效益发生率分析表明，该干预措施在乌干达对穷人有利。在两国中，来自营利性机构的无补贴抗疟药物在财富五分位人群中分布均匀。私营部门的补贴可能在提高有效抗疟治疗的可及性方面发挥作用，包括帮助穷人获得治疗，但补贴的公平性影响可能取决于具体情境。

abstract.text: This paper examines the causal links between early human endowments and socioeconomic outcomes in adulthood. We use a genotyped longitudinal survey (Cardiovascular Risk in Young Finns Study) that is linked to the administrative registers of Statistics Finland. We focus on the effect of birth weight on income via two anthropometric mediators: body mass index (BMI) and height in adulthood. We find that (i) the genetic instruments for birth weight, adult height, and adult BMI are statistically powerful; (ii) there is a robust total effect of birth weight on income for men but not for women; (iii) the total effect of birth weight on income for men is partly mediated via height but not via BMI; and (iv) the share of the total effect mediated via height is substantial, of approximately 56%.

10.1002/hec.4387.abstractZh: 本文探讨了早期人类禀赋与成年后社会经济成果之间的因果关系。我们采用了一项与芬兰统计局行政登记数据相关联的遗传标记纵向调查（芬兰年轻人心血管风险研究），重点关注出生体重对收入的影响，通过两种人体测量指标进行中介分析：体重指数（BMI）和成年身高。研究发现：（i）出生体重、成年身高和成年BMI的遗传指标具有统计学上的显著效力；（ii）出生体重对男性收入的影响显著，但对女性则不明显；（iii）出生体重对男性收入的影响部分通过身高进行中介，但并未通过BMI进行中介；（iv）通过身高进行中介的总效应比例相当大，约为56%。

abstract.text: We explore the discontinuity in the allocation of the main federal grant to Brazilian municipalities to identify the local effects of health spending and the spillovers into the bordering jurisdictions. Fiscal reactions are asymmetric: small neighbors reduce health spending, while we do not find a significant budgetary response in the largest neighbor. Our results suggest a reduction in the spread of infectious diseases in the neighbors, with fewer residents hospitalized with gastrointestinal infections. In addition, the elderly demand less hospitalization in the largest bordering jurisdictions due to respiratory infectious diseases. Finally, we find a direct and significant reduction in infant mortality, consistent with the observed pediatricians' increase, while the spillover effects on neighbors' mortality rates are not conclusive.

10.1002/hec.4388.abstractZh: 我们探讨了联邦主要拨款分配给巴西各市镇的过程中存在的不连续性，以识别卫生支出的地方效应以及对邻近地区的溢出效应。财政反应是不对称的：较小的邻近地区减少了卫生支出，而最大的邻近地区则没有显示出显著的预算响应。我们的研究结果表明，邻近地区的传染病传播有所减少，因胃肠道感染而住院的居民数量也减少了。此外，由于呼吸系统传染病的影响，老年人在最大的邻近地区需要住院的人数也减少了。最后，我们发现婴儿死亡率出现了直接且显著的下降，这与观察到的儿科医生数量增加现象一致。不过，对邻近地区死亡率的溢出效应尚无法得出明确结论。

abstract.text: The maternity benefit scheme piloted as Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana (IGMSY) since 2011 and recently rolled out as Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) incentivizes mothers to participate in infant health-promoting activities. It has become India's largest conditional cash transfer program ever, outrivaling the country's first-generation maternity benefit scheme Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), which incentivizes institutional delivery and has been criticized for its unintended side effects on fertility. We approach IGMSY's geographically targeted pilot phase as a natural experiment and use data from a large national health survey to estimate its effects by a matched-pair difference-in-differences approach. Consistent with the program's conditions, we find increases in infant immunization. As side effect, long-term utilization of public health facilities becomes more frequent and intervals between eligible births increase by 17%. Our findings suggest that India'ns second-generation maternity benefit scheme has been more carefully designed than its predecessor, with side effects that support the program's broader objectives. But both direct and indirect effects are small and can make only a small contribution to redressing India's dismal maternal and child health record.

10.1002/hec.4390.abstractZh: 自2011年起实施的 maternity benefit scheme，即Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana (IGMSY)，最近被更名为Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)。该计划旨在激励母亲参与促进婴儿健康的活动。这已成为印度历史上规模最大的有条件现金转移计划，其规模超过了该国第一代 maternity benefit scheme——Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)，后者主要鼓励在医疗机构分娩，但因其对生育率的意外影响而受到批评。我们将IGMSY的地理定向试点阶段视为一个自然实验，并利用一项大型全国健康调查的数据，通过配对差异-差异方法来估算其效果。与计划的条件一致，我们发现婴儿免疫接种率有所提高。作为副作用，长期使用公共卫生设施的情况变得更加频繁，符合条件的分娩间隔也延长了17%。我们的研究结果表明，印度的第二代 maternity benefit scheme比其前身设计得更周密，其副作用也支持了计划的更广泛目标。不过，无论是直接效应还是间接效应都非常有限，对改善印度糟糕的母婴健康状况的贡献也微乎其微。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to shed light on the ongoing Dutch health system reforms and identify whether hospital costs and hospital outcomes have changed over time. We present an empirical analysis that is based on granular micro-costing data and focuses on conditions for which mortality is indicative of outcome quality, that is, acute myocardial infarction (AMI), chronic heart failure (CHF), and pneumonia (PNE). We deploy a dataset of more than 80,000 inpatient episodes over 5 years (2013-2017) to estimate regression models that control for variation between patients and hospitals. We have three main findings. First, our results do not indicate significant outcome improvements over the years; that is, there is no time trend for mortality. Second, there is heterogeneity in cost developments: for patients who survive their inpatient stay, our data indicate that costs increase significantly by 0.9% per year for AMI patients, while costs decrease significantly by 1.7% per year for CHF patients and by 1.9% per year for PNE patients. For patients who pass away during their inpatient stay, our data do not indicate significant time trends. Third and finally, our results suggest the existence of substantial cost variation between hospitals.

10.1002/hec.4391.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨荷兰医疗系统正在进行的改革，并分析医院费用和医疗效果是否随时间发生变化。我们基于详细的微观成本数据进行了实证分析，重点关注那些能反映医疗效果质量的疾病，包括急性心肌梗死、慢性心力衰竭和肺炎。我们使用了超过80,000例住院病例的数据，在2013年至2017年间进行回归模型分析，以控制患者和医院之间的差异。我们的主要发现如下：首先，结果显示这些年来医疗效果并未显著改善，即死亡率没有随时间变化；其次，成本变化存在异质性：对于在住院期间存活下来的患者，我们的数据显示急性心肌梗死患者的成本每年增加0.9%，而慢性心力衰竭患者和肺炎患者的成本则分别每年减少1.7%和1.9%；对于在住院期间去世的患者，我们的数据并未显示出显著的时间趋势。最后，我们的结果表明不同医院之间的成本存在较大差异。

abstract.text: Previous studies have estimated that patients served by health systems accrue 59-98% of the value generated by new pharmaceuticals. This has led to questions about whether sufficient returns accrue to manufacturers to incentivize socially optimal levels of R&D. These studies have not, however, fully reflected the health opportunity costs imposed by payments for branded pharmaceuticals. We present a framework for estimating how the value generated by new branded pharmaceuticals is shared. We quantify value in net health effects and account for benefits and health opportunity costs in the patent period and post-patent period when generic/biosimilar products become available. We apply the framework to 12 National Institute for Health and Care Excellence appraisals and show that realized net health effects range from losses of 160%, to gains of 94%, of the potential net health benefits available. In many cases, even in the long run, the benefits of new medicines are not sufficient to offset the opportunity costs of payments to manufacturers, and approval is expected to reduce population health. This cannot be dynamically efficient as it incentivizes future innovation at prices which will also reduce population health. Further work should consider how to reflect these findings in reimbursement policies.

10.1002/hec.4393.abstractZh: 先前的研究估计，由医疗系统服务的患者获得了新药品所创造价值的59%至98%。这引发了关于制造商是否能够获得足够的回报以激励社会最优水平的研发的问题。然而，这些研究并未充分考虑到品牌药品支付所带来的健康机会成本。我们提出了一个框架，用于估算新品牌药品所创造的价值是如何分配的。我们量化了净健康效应中的价值，并考虑了专利期及仿制药/生物类似物上市后的收益与健康机会成本。我们将该框架应用于12项国家健康与护理卓越研究所的评估，结果显示，实际获得的净健康效应从潜在净健康收益的160%损失到94%的收益不等。在许多情况下，即使从长远来看，新药的收益也不足以抵消对制造商的支付所带来的机会成本，而且批准新药预计会降低人群的健康水平。这种做法并非动态高效，因为它激励了未来的创新，而这些创新的代价同样会降低人群的健康水平。未来的研究应考虑如何将这些发现纳入报销政策中。

abstract.text: Worldwide, countries have been restricting work and social activities to counter the emerging public health crisis due to the coronavirus pandemic. These measures have caused dramatic increases in unemployment. Some commentators argue that the "draconian measures" will do more harm than good due to the economic contraction, despite a large literature that finds mortality rates decline during recessions. We estimate the relationship between unemployment, a proxy for economic climate, and mortality in Australia, a country with universal health care. Using administrative time-series data on mortality by state, age, sex, and cause of death for 1979-2017, we find no relationship between unemployment and mortality on average. However, we observe beneficial health effects in economic downturns for young men, associated with a reduction in transport accidents. Our estimates imply 431 fewer deaths in 2020 if unemployment rates double as forecast. For the early 1980s, we find a procyclical pattern in infant mortality rates. However, this pattern disappears starting from the mid-1980s, coincident with the 1984 implementation of universal health care. Our results suggest that universal health care may insulate individuals from the health effects of macroeconomic fluctuations.

10.1002/hec.4394.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，各国为了应对新冠病毒大流行引发的公共卫生危机，纷纷限制工作和社会活动。这些措施导致失业率急剧上升。一些评论人士认为，尽管大量文献表明经济衰退期间死亡率会下降，但这些“严厉措施”带来的危害可能大于好处。我们研究了澳大利亚这一拥有全民医疗体系的国家的失业率与经济环境指标——死亡率之间的关系。通过利用1979年至2017年间各州按年龄、性别和死因划分的死亡数据，我们发现失业率与死亡率之间平均没有关联。然而，我们观察到在经济衰退期间，年轻男性的健康状况有所改善，这与交通事故数量的减少有关。我们的估计表明，如果失业率翻倍，2020年的死亡人数将减少431人。对于1980年代初，我们发现婴儿死亡率呈现出一种支持经济周期变化的趋势。然而，这一趋势从1980年代中期开始消失，这与1984年实施全民医疗体系的时间相吻合。我们的研究结果表明，全民医疗体系可能有助于保护个人免受宏观经济波动对健康的负面影响。

abstract.text: When measuring inequality using conventional inequality measures, ethical assumptions about distributional preferences are often implicitly made. In this paper, we ask whether the ethical assumptions underlying the concentration index for income-related health inequality and the Gini index for income inequality are supported in a representative sample of the Swedish population using an internet-based survey. We find that the median subject has preferences regarding income-related health inequality that are in line with the ethical assumptions implied by the concentration index, but put higher weight on the poor than what is implied by the Gini index of income inequality. We find that women and individuals with a poorer health status put higher weight on the poor than men and healthier individuals. Ethically flexible inequality measures, such as the s-Gini index and the extended concentration index, imply that researchers have to choose from a toolbox of infinitely many inequality indices. The results of this paper are indicative of which indices (i.e. which parameter values) reflect the views of the population regarding how inequality should be defined.

10.1002/hec.4395.abstractZh: 在使用传统的不平等衡量指标来评估不平等时，通常隐含着关于分配偏好的伦理假设。本文通过一项基于互联网的调查，探讨在瑞典人口的代表性样本中，收入相关健康不平等的集中指数和收入不平等的基尼指数所依据的伦理假设是否成立。研究发现，中位受调查者对于收入相关健康不平等的偏好与集中指数所暗示的伦理假设一致，但他们对贫困群体的重视程度高于基尼指数所反映的差距。此外，女性以及健康状况较差的个体对贫困群体的重视程度高于男性和健康个体。具有伦理灵活性的不平等衡量指标，如s-基尼指数和扩展集中指数，意味着研究人员需要从无限多的不平等指标中选择。本文的结果表明，哪些指标（即哪些参数值）能够反映公众对不平等定义的看法。

abstract.text: Public long-term care (LTC) systems provide services to support people experiencing difficulties with their activities of daily living. This study investigates the marginal effect of changes in public LTC expenditure on care-related quality of life (CRQoL) of existing service users in England. The public LTC program for people aged 18 or older in England is called Adult Social Care (ASC) and it is provided and managed by local authorities. We collect data on the outcomes and characteristics of public ASC users, on public ASC expenditure, and on the characteristics of local authorities across England in 2017/18. We employ an instrumental variable approach using conditionally exogenous elements of the public funding system to estimate the effect of public ASC expenditure on user CRQoL. Our findings show that by increasing public ASC expenditure by £1000 per user, on average, local authorities increase user CRQoL by 0.0030. These results suggest that public ASC is effective in increasing users' quality of life but only to a relatively small extent. When combined with the other potential effects of LTC expenditure (e.g., on informal carers, mortality), this study can inform policy makers in the United Kingdom and internationally about whether social care provides good value for money.

10.1002/hec.4396.abstractZh: 公共长期护理系统为那些在日常生活中面临困难的人士提供服务支持。本研究探讨了公共长期护理支出变化对英格兰现有服务用户护理相关生活质量的影响。英格兰针对18岁及以上人群的公共长期护理计划被称为成人社会护理，由地方当局负责提供和管理。我们收集了2017/18年度英格兰各地公共成人社会护理用户的结果和特征数据，以及公共成人社会护理支出和地方政府特征的相关数据。我们采用工具变量方法，利用公共资金系统中的条件外生要素来估计公共成人社会护理支出对用户护理相关生活质量的影响。研究结果表明，每增加1000英镑的公共成人社会护理支出，地方当局能够平均提高用户护理相关生活质量0.0030。这些结果表明，公共成人社会护理在提高用户生活质量方面是有效的，但效果相对有限。结合长期护理支出其他潜在影响（如对非正式护理人员的支持、死亡率等），本研究可以为英国及国际上的政策制定者提供信息，帮助他们判断社会护理是否物有所值。

abstract.text: Although colorectal cancer (CRC) screening is highly effective, screening rates lag far below recommended levels, particularly for low-income people. The Colorectal Cancer Control Program (CRCCP) funded $100 million in competitively awarded grants to 25 states from 2009-2015 to increase CRC screening rates among low-income, uninsured populations, in part by directly providing and paying for screening services. Using data from the 2001-2015 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) and a difference-in-differences strategy, we find no effects of CRCCP on the use of relatively cheap fecal occult blood tests (FOBT). We do, however, find that the CRCCP significantly increased the likelihood that uninsured 50-64-year-olds report ever having a relatively expensive endoscopic CRC screening (sigmoidoscopy or colonoscopy) by 2.9 percentage points, or 10.7%. These effects are larger for women, minorities, and individuals who did not undertake other types of preventive care. We do not find that the CRCCP led to significant changes in CRC cancer detection. Our results indicate that the CRCCP was effective at increasing CRC screening rates among the most vulnerable.

10.1002/hec.4397.abstractZh: 尽管结直肠癌筛查非常有效，但筛查率远低于推荐水平，尤其是在低收入人群中。结直肠癌控制计划（CRCCP）在2009-2015年间向25个州提供了1亿美元的竞争性拨款，以提高低收入、无保险人群的结直肠癌筛查率，部分措施包括直接提供并支付筛查服务费用。通过2001-2015年行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS）的数据以及差异-差异策略分析，我们发现CRCCP对相对便宜的粪便隐血试验的使用没有产生影响。然而，我们发现CRCCP显著提高了50-64岁无保险人群进行昂贵的内镜筛查（乙状结肠镜检查或结肠镜检查）的可能性，提高了2.9个百分点，即10.7%。这些影响在女性、少数族裔以及未接受其他类型预防保健的人群中更为明显。我们没有发现CRCCP对结直肠癌检测率产生了显著变化。我们的结果表明，CRCCP在提高最弱势群体的结直肠癌筛查率方面是有效的。

abstract.text: This paper documents important mental health spillovers in the context of a program that offered pregnant women modest cash incentives to use pre- and perinatal health care services. Program participation was randomized and the payments were made after the birth of the child (and after the completion of an endline mental health assessment). I present causal evidence that the program led to improvements in mothers' mental health. The effect size ranges from a 1-3 percentage point reduction in postpartum depression measured using the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale. I present suggestive evidence that these beneficial effects on mental health may be related to program-induced improvements in child health. These results provide novel evidence that programs designed to improve birth outcomes may generate unanticipated spillover effects on mental health.

10.1002/hec.4398.abstractZh: 本文记录了在一项为孕妇提供适度现金激励以使用产前和围产期健康服务的计划背景下，心理健康方面的重要溢出效应。该计划的参与是随机分配的，支付是在孩子出生后（并在完成最终心理健康评估后）进行的。我们提供了因果证据，表明该计划有助于改善母亲的心理健康。效果大小表现为使用爱丁堡产后抑郁量表测量的产后抑郁程度减少了1-3个百分点。我们还提供了一些线索，表明这些对心理健康的积极影响可能与计划带来的儿童健康改善有关。这些结果提供了新的证据，表明旨在改善出生结果的项目可能会产生意想不到的心理健康溢出效应。

abstract.text: General population health state values are used in healthcare resource allocation, including health technology assessment. We examine whether UK general population health valuations changed during the COVID-19 pandemic. Ratings of EQ-5D-5L health states 11111 (no problems), 55555 (extreme problems), and dead were collected in a UK general population survey during the pandemic (April-May 2020) using the 0 = worst imaginable health, 100 = best imaginable health visual analog scale (EQ-VAS). Ratings for 55555 were transformed to a full health = 1, dead = 0 scale. Responses were compared to similar data collected pre-pandemic (2018). After propensity score matching to minimize sample differences, EQ-VAS responses were analyzed using Tobit regressions. On the 0-100 scale, 11111 was rated on average 8.67 points lower, 55555 rated 9.56 points higher, and dead rated 7.45 points lower post-pandemic onset compared to pre-pandemic. On the full health = 1, dead = 0 scale, 55555 values were 0.09 higher post-pandemic onset. There was evidence of differential impacts of COVID-19 by gender, age, and ethnicity, although only age impacted values on the 1-0 scale. COVID-19 may have affected how people value health. It is unknown whether the effect is large enough to have policy relevance, but caution should be taken in assuming pre-COVID-19 values are unchanged.

10.1002/hec.4399.abstractZh: 在医疗资源分配中，包括健康技术评估，通常会使用普通人群的健康状态值。我们研究了在COVID-19疫情期间，英国普通人群的健康评估值是否发生了变化。在疫情期间（2020年4月至5月），通过0=最糟糕的健康状态，100=最佳健康状态的视觉模拟量表（EQ-VAS），收集了11111（无问题）、55555（极度问题）和死亡状态的评估数据。将55555状态的评估数据转换为全健康状态=1，死亡状态=0的尺度。将评估结果与疫情前的类似数据（2018年）进行了比较。通过倾向得分匹配来最小化样本差异后，使用Tobit回归分析了EQ-VAS的评估数据。在0-100的尺度上，11111状态的评估值平均降低了8.67分，55555状态的评估值提高了9.56分，而死亡状态的评估值降低了7.45分。在全健康状态=1，死亡状态=0的尺度上，55555状态的评估值在疫情后上升了0.09分。虽然有证据表明COVID-19对不同性别、年龄和种族的影响不同，但只有年龄对1-0尺度上的评估值产生了影响。COVID-19可能影响了人们对健康的评估。目前尚不清楚这种影响是否足够大以具有政策意义，但在假设疫情前的评估值保持不变时仍需谨慎。

abstract.text: Previous studies, mostly analyzing data from high-income economies, present mixed evidence on the relationship between retirement and healthcare utilization. This study leverages administrative data for over 80,000 urban Chinese workers to explore the effect of retirement on outpatient and inpatient care utilization using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design. The analyses of medical claims from a large city in China complement and extend the current literature by providing evidence of potential mechanisms underlying increased short-run utilization. In this relatively well-insured population, annual total healthcare expenditures significantly increase primarily because of more intensive use of outpatient care at retirement, especially at the right tail of the distribution of outpatient visits. This increase in outpatient care appears to stem from a decline in the patient cost-sharing rate and the reduced opportunity cost of time upon retirement, interacting with supplier-induced demand, not from any sudden impact on health. We do not find evidence of change in inpatient care at retirement. The results hold for both females and males, and are robust to a number of sensitivity analyses.

10.1002/hec.4400.abstractZh: 以往的研究大多基于高收入经济体的数据，关于退休与医疗使用之间的关系，研究结果并不一致。本研究利用超过80,000名中国城市工人的行政数据，采用模糊回归不连续设计来探讨退休对门诊和住院医疗使用的影响。对中国某大城市的医疗索赔数据的分析，补充并扩展了现有文献，提供了关于短期医疗使用增加潜在机制的证据。在这一个保险覆盖相对完善的人群中，年度总医疗支出显著增加，主要是因为退休时更加频繁地使用门诊服务，尤其是在门诊就诊分布的高端人群中。这种门诊服务的增加似乎源于患者自付费用率的下降以及退休后时间机会成本的降低，这些因素与供应商诱导的需求相互作用，而非由于健康状况的突然变化所致。我们没有发现退休后住院医疗使用发生变化的证据。这些结果适用于男性和女性，并且经过多次敏感性分析后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: Medical interventions that increase life expectancy of patients result in additional consumption of non-medical goods and services in 'added life years'. This paper focuses on the distributional consequences across socio-economic groups of including these costs in cost effectiveness analysis. In that context, it also highlights the role of remaining quality of life and household economies of scale.
