Data from a Dutch household spending survey was used to estimate non-medical consumption and household size by age and educational attainment. Estimates of non-medical consumption and household size were combined with life tables to estimate what the impact of including non-medical survivor costs would be on the incremental cost effectiveness ratio (ICER) of preventing a death at a certain age. Results show that including non-medical survivor costs increases estimated ICERs most strongly when interventions are targeted at the higher educated. Adjusting for household size (lower educated people less often live additional life years in multi-person households) and quality of life (lower educated people on average spend added life years in poorer health) mitigates this difference. Ignoring costs of non-medical consumption in economic evaluations implicitly favors interventions targeted at the higher educated and thus potentially amplifies socio-economic inequalities in health.

10.1002/hec.4401.abstractZh: 增加患者寿命的医学干预措施会导致在“额外寿命年”中额外消费非医疗商品和服务。本文重点关注将这些成本纳入成本效益分析对不同社会经济群体的分配影响。同时，本文还强调了剩余生活质量和家庭规模经济的作用。研究使用了荷兰家庭支出调查的数据，根据年龄和教育水平来估算非医疗消费和家庭规模。通过结合非医疗消费和家庭规模的估计值与生命表数据，可以估算将非医疗幸存者成本纳入考虑会对预防特定年龄死亡的成本效益比产生何种影响。研究结果表明，当干预措施针对受教育程度较高的人群时，非医疗幸存者成本的增加对成本效益比的提升作用最为显著。通过调整家庭规模（受教育程度较低的人较少在多人口家庭中额外享受寿命年）和生活质量（受教育程度较低的人平均会在健康状况较差的情况下额外享受寿命年），可以减轻这种差异。在经济效益评估中忽略非医疗消费的成本，实际上会倾向于支持针对受教育程度较高人群的干预措施，从而可能加剧社会经济在健康方面的不平等。

abstract.text: We evaluate the role of behavioral attributes in predicting engagement in an intervention program. Distinct from the previous studies, we investigate how parental preferences influence their engagement behavior in a health program when the targeted outcomes relate to the health of their children, as opposed to their own. We use an artifactual field experiment where the participants were former parent enrollees in a child health management program in Australia. Our findings suggest that parents' time preference and risk tolerance are robust predictors of engagement, measured by program attendance. Attendance is positively associated with patience and risk tolerance in the health domain, after controlling for a host of personality traits and socioeconomic factors. By improving our understanding of the behavioral risk factors for attrition, these findings offer important insights for enhancing participant engagement in intervention programs that are beset with the problem of high attrition.

10.1002/hec.4402.abstractZh: 我们评估了行为属性在预测参与干预计划中的作用。与以往的研究不同，我们研究了父母偏好如何影响他们参与健康计划的行为，特别是当目标结果与子女的健康相关时，而不是他们自己的健康。我们采用了一个人工设计的实地实验，参与者是澳大利亚一项儿童健康管理计划中的前父母参与者。我们的研究发现表明，父母的时间偏好和风险承受能力是参与度的可靠预测因素，这可以通过参与计划的出勤率来衡量。在控制了多种人格特质和社会经济因素后，出勤率与耐心和风险承受能力呈正相关。通过更好地理解导致参与者退出行为的行为风险因素，这些发现为提升那些面临高退出率的干预计划的参与者参与度提供了重要启示。

abstract.text: I analyze the relationship between state-level economic shocks and suicides using gold mined in the United States (US) between 1840 and 1860 as a large unexpected economic shock. Mined gold was an unexpected and large economic shock of up to 3.5% of GDP. This provides as good as random variation to the local economy that I use to estimate the effect of economic changes on suicides. Comprehensive mortality data by state and year does not exist for the US for 1840-1860. Thus, I use web-scraped data from a newspaper archive and use suicide mentions per 100,000 pages to proxy for suicides. Overall, results show that mined gold is linked with an apparent reduction in newspaper suicide mentions in line with previous research.

10.1002/hec.4403.abstractZh: 我分析了国家级经济冲击与自杀事件之间的关系，以1840至1860年间美国开采的黄金作为一次重大的意外经济冲击。当时开采的黄金对经济的冲击巨大，高达GDP的3.5%。这一冲击对当地经济产生了类似随机变化的影响，我利用这种影响来估计经济变化对自杀率的影响。在1840至1860年间，美国没有按州和年份分列的全面死亡数据。因此，我使用了从报纸档案中抓取的数据，并以每10万页报纸中的自杀提及次数作为自杀事件的替代指标。总体来看，研究结果表明，黄金开采与报纸上自杀提及次数的减少有关，这与之前的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: This paper provides novel evidence that child health affects adult financial behavior, that is, risky asset market participation. We do so by using a longitudinal dataset with a rich set of covariates and exploit sibling fixed-effects (FE) to control for invariant unobserved heterogeneity. We begin by proposing a new mechanism working via skill formation and portfolio choice. To be precise, we test two hypotheses. First, we expect a negative correlation between poor child health and risky asset market participation. Second, this correlation should be mostly explained by differences in skills. To test these hypotheses, we use data from the National Longitudinal Study of Youth 1979 (NLSY79). Our results show that poor child health is associated with an 11 pp decrease in adult risky market participation conditional on demographics and family background. Moreover, our results suggest that disruption in pre-labor market skill formation is a main mediator of this relationship. These results are robust to a wide range of robustness checks. Our findings have implications for the design of health policies and policies intended to increase financial literacy and asset market participation.

10.1002/hec.4404.abstractZh: 本文提供了新的证据，表明儿童健康会影响成年人的金融行为，尤其是风险资产市场的参与程度。我们通过使用一个包含丰富协变量的纵向数据集，并利用兄弟固定效应来控制未观察到的异质性。我们首先提出了一种通过技能形成和投资组合选择来影响风险资产市场参与的新机制。具体来说，我们测试了两个假设：首先，我们认为儿童健康状况不佳与风险资产市场参与之间存在负相关关系；其次，这种相关性主要由技能差异所解释。为了验证这些假设，我们使用了1979年青少年全国纵向研究的数据。我们的结果显示，在考虑人口统计和家庭背景的情况下，儿童健康状况不佳会导致成年人风险资产市场参与程度减少11个百分点。此外，我们的研究还表明，劳动前市场技能形成的中断是这种关系的主要中介因素。这些结果在广泛的稳健性检验中都是稳健的。我们的发现对制定健康政策以及旨在提高金融素养和风险资产市场参与度的政策具有启示意义。

abstract.text: This study investigates the effect of ambiguity on personal vaccination decisions. We first characterize the vaccination decision in the absence of ambiguity. We then show that uncertainty about the probability of side effects and the efficacy of the vaccine always reduces take-up under ambiguity aversion. However, uncertainty about the underlying disease, being the probability of sickness or the probability of a severe course of disease, may either encourage or discourage vaccination. Our results are relevant for policy because reducing uncertainty associated with the vaccine always has the desired effect whereas reducing uncertainty associated with the disease may have unintended consequences.

10.1002/hec.4405.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了模糊性对个人疫苗接种决策的影响。我们首先描述了在没有模糊性情况下的疫苗接种决策。然后我们发现，在模糊性厌恶的情况下，对疫苗副作用概率和疫苗有效性的不确定性总是会降低疫苗接种的接受度。然而，对疾病本身的不确定性，即生病的概率或疾病严重程度的预期，可能会促进或阻碍疫苗接种。我们的研究结果对政策具有参考价值，因为减少与疫苗相关的不确定性总是会产生预期的效果，而减少与疾病相关的不确定性可能会产生意想不到的后果。

abstract.text: Violations of the assumptions of complete information [CI] and independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) in discrete-choice experiment (DCE) data imply sensitivity of preference estimates to the decision context and the alternatives evaluated. There is a paucity of evidence on how these two assumptions affect health-preference results and whether the usual specifications of random-parameters logit models are sufficient to address these violations. We assessed the appropriateness of these assumptions in a DCE valuating interventions to prevent long-term health problems that could be identified through whole genome sequencing. A DCE survey was administered to members of a nationally representative consumer panel to elicit their preferences for options to reduce the risk of health problems. The treatment options presented (surgery, medication, and watchful waiting) and the context for the decisions elicited (severity and likelihood of the health problem) were varied experimentally to evaluate the sensitivity of preference results to such changes. We find evidence of IIA violations as the options presented to prevent health changed. Our results also are consistent with the expectation that additional substitutes decrease the monetized value of alternatives. We also find some evidence that the decision context can moderate such effects, which constitutes a new finding.

10.1002/hec.4406.abstractZh: 在离散选择实验数据中，完全信息假设[CI]和无关替代方案独立性假设(IIA)的违反会导致偏好估计对决策背景和评估的替代方案产生敏感性。关于这两个假设如何影响健康偏好结果，以及通常使用的随机参数逻辑模型是否足以应对这些违反情况，目前缺乏足够的证据。我们评估了这些假设在离散选择实验中评估预防长期健康问题的干预措施的适当性，这些问题可以通过全基因组测序来识别。我们对一个具有全国代表性的消费者小组的成员进行了离散选择实验调查，以了解他们对减少健康问题风险的选项偏好。实验中改变了所提出的处理选项（手术、药物治疗和观察等待）以及决策背景（健康问题的严重性和可能性），以评估偏好结果对这些变化的敏感性。我们发现，随着预防健康问题的选项的变化，存在IIA违反的情况。我们的结果也与“额外替代品会降低替代方案的货币价值”这一预期一致。此外，我们还发现了一些证据表明决策背景可以缓和这种效应，这是一个新的发现。

abstract.text: We present a model of learning in healthcare markets. Hospitals have junior physicians with low and senior physicians with high ability. Junior physicians turn senior if they treat enough patients. Patients face heterogeneous costs for waiting if a physician's capacity is utilized. Hospitals choose to either allocate patients to physicians randomly or let patients choose their physicians. In a monopolistic market, the hospital always chooses the welfare-maximizing allocation system. In a competitive market, inefficiencies may arise due to two externalities. If patients are free to choose their physician, the marginal patient neither internalizes her impact on other patients' waiting costs nor the learning of junior physicians.

10.1002/hec.4407.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于医疗市场学习模型的设想。医院中的初级医生能力较低，而高级医生能力较高。如果初级医生治疗了足够的病人，他们就会晋升为高级医生。如果患者等待的时间过长，他们将面临不同的等待成本。医院可以选择随机地将患者分配给医生，或者让患者自行选择医生。在垄断市场中，医院总是会选择能够最大化福利的分配方案。而在竞争市场中，由于两种外部性因素的影响，可能会出现效率低下的情况。如果患者可以自由选择医生，那么边际患者既不会内部化自己对其他患者等待成本的影响，也不会内部化初级医生学习的过程。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) are recommended to include sensitivity analyses which make a range of contextually plausible assumptions about missing data. However, with longitudinal data on, for example, patients' health-related quality of life (HRQoL), the missingness patterns can be complicated because data are often missing both at specific timepoints (interim missingness) and following loss to follow-up. Methods to handle these complex missing data patterns have not been developed for CEA, and must recognize that data may be missing not at random, while accommodating both the correlation between costs and health outcomes and the non-normal distribution of these endpoints. We develop flexible Bayesian longitudinal models that allow the impact of interim missingness and loss to follow-up to be disentangled. This modeling framework enables studies to undertake sensitivity analyses according to various contextually plausible missing data mechanisms, jointly model costs and outcomes using appropriate distributions, and recognize the correlation among these endpoints over time. We exemplify these models in the REFLUX study in which 52% of participants had HRQoL data missing for at least one timepoint over the 5-year follow-up period. We provide guidance for sensitivity analyses and accompanying code to help future studies handle these complex forms of missing data.

10.1002/hec.4408.abstractZh: 建议进行成本效益分析时包含敏感性分析，以对缺失数据的各种情境假设进行考虑。然而，对于例如患者健康相关生活质量等纵向数据而言，缺失模式可能较为复杂，因为数据往往在特定时间点缺失，并且在随访结束后也可能缺失。目前尚未开发出处理这些复杂缺失数据模式的方法，必须认识到数据缺失并非随机，同时还要考虑成本与健康结果之间的相关性以及这些终点分布的非正态性。我们开发了灵活的贝叶斯纵向模型，能够区分中期缺失和随访缺失的影响。这一建模框架使得研究能够根据各种情境下的缺失数据机制进行敏感性分析，使用适当的分布联合建模成本与结果，并识别这些终点随时间的变化关系。我们在REFLUX研究中展示了这些模型的应用，在该研究中，52%的参与者在5年的随访期间至少有一个时间点的健康相关生活质量数据缺失。我们提供了敏感性分析的指导以及相应的代码，以帮助未来的研究处理这些复杂的缺失数据问题。

abstract.text: Child maltreatment is a major public health problem with significant consequences for individual victims and for society. In this paper, we quantify for the first time the economic costs of fatal and nonfatal child maltreatment in the UK in relation to several short-, medium-, and long-term outcomes ranging from physical and mental health problems to labor market outcomes and welfare use. We combine novel regression analysis of rich data from the National Child Development Study and the English Longitudinal Study of Aging with secondary evidence to produce an incidence-based estimate of the lifetime costs of child maltreatment from a societal perspective. The discounted average lifetime incidence cost of nonfatal child maltreatment by a primary caregiver is estimated at £89,390 (95% uncertainty interval £44,896 to £145,508); the largest contributors to this are costs from social care, short-term health, and long-term labor market outcomes. The discounted lifetime cost per death from child maltreatment is estimated at £940,758, comprising health care and lost productivity costs. Our estimates provide the first comprehensive benchmark to quantify the costs of child maltreatment in the UK and the benefits of interventions aimed at reducing or preventing it.

10.1002/hec.4409.abstractZh: 儿童虐待是一个重大的公共卫生问题，对个体受害者和社会都产生严重后果。在本文中，我们首次量化了英国儿童虐待造成的经济成本，这些成本涉及从身体和心理健康问题到劳动力市场结果以及福利使用等多个短期、中期和长期后果。我们通过结合《国家儿童发展研究》和《英格兰老龄化纵向研究》的丰富数据，并参考其他次要证据，从社会角度对儿童虐待的终生成本进行了估算。据估计，主要照顾者造成非致命性儿童虐待的贴现平均终生成本约为89,390英镑（95%置信区间：44,896至145,508英镑）；其中，社会护理、短期健康问题和长期劳动力市场结果的成本最为显著。儿童虐待导致的每例死亡的平均终生成本估计为940,758英镑，其中包括医疗保健和生产力损失成本。我们的估算为量化英国儿童虐待的成本以及旨在减少或预防此类问题的干预措施所带来的益处提供了首个全面的基准。

abstract.text: We examine the heterogeneous effects of reference pricing, a health insurance reform introduced by the California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS), on the distribution of spending by patients and insurers. Using medical claims data for CalPERS and a comparison group not subject to reference pricing, we use the changes-in-changes approach to estimate the quantile treatment effects of the program across different medical procedures. We find that the quantile treatment effects vary across the patient spending distributions, with a range of positive and negative estimates of the QTE, depending on the medical procedure considered. However, across all procedures, the insurer's spending distributions tend to shift left, with the largest reductions occurring in the right-tail of the spending distributions. These effects are not captured by mean estimates but have important policy implications.

10.1002/hec.4410.abstractZh: 我们研究了加州公共雇员退休系统（CalPERS）引入的参考定价改革对医患双方支出分布的不同影响。通过对比CalPERS样本组与未实施参考定价的对照组的数据，我们使用变化-变化方法估算该改革对不同医疗程序的分位数处理效应。研究发现，分位数处理效应因患者支出分布的不同而有所差异，根据所考虑的医疗程序，其估计值既有正值也有负值。不过，所有医疗程序中，保险公司的支出分布都倾向于向左移动，其中最大的减少发生在支出分布的右尾部分。这些效应无法通过均值估计来捕捉，但它们具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: Quality of life outcomes for family carers and patients may be measured in different ways within the same economic evaluation. We used the wellbeing valuation method to calculate "exchange rates" between care-related outcomes (the Carer Experience Scale and CarerQoL-7D) and health-related (the EQ-5D-5L) outcomes. Data on quality of life outcomes were collected through a postal quality of life survey in the UK. A random effects model was used to estimate carers' wellbeing as a function of their EQ-5D-5L, Carer Experience Scale (or CarerQoL-7D) and a set of control variables. When life satisfaction was used as the measure of wellbeing, a one-point gain in the Carer Experience Scale (0-100 scale) was equivalent (in wellbeing terms) to a 0.014 gain in EQ-5D-5L value; and a one point gain in the CarerQoL-7D (0-100 scale) was equivalent to a 0.033 gain in EQ-5D-5L. The exchange rate values were reduced when capability was used as the measure of wellbeing. The exchange rates estimated in this study offer a means to place carer and patient outcomes, measured via different quality of life instruments, on a common scale, although there are important issues to consider in operationalising the technique.

10.1002/hec.4411.abstractZh: 家庭照顾者和患者的生活质量结果可以在同一经济评估中以不同的方式衡量。我们采用了幸福感评估方法来计算与护理相关的结果（照顾者体验量表和CarerQoL-7D）与健康相关的结果（EQ-5D-5L）之间的“交换比率”。生活质量结果的数据是通过在英国进行的邮寄式生活质量调查收集的。使用随机效应模型来估计照顾者的幸福感，作为他们的EQ-5D-5L、照顾者体验量表（或CarerQoL-7D）以及一组控制变量的函数。当以生活满意度作为幸福感的衡量标准时，照顾者体验量表中的一点提升（0-100分制）在幸福感方面相当于EQ-5D-5L值增加0.014；而CarerQoL-7D中的一点提升则相当于EQ-5D-5L值增加0.033。当以能力作为幸福感的衡量标准时，交换比率会降低。本研究估计的交换比率提供了一种方法，可以将通过不同生活质量工具衡量的照顾者和患者的结果放在一个共同的尺度上，尽管在将该技术付诸实践时还存在一些重要的问题需要考虑。

abstract.text: In the evaluation of well-being, it is not only important what people have in absolute terms, but also how this compares to reference points in relative terms. We explore the relevance of relative comparisons by testing the effect of people's self-rated position on potential reference points for income and health on their subjective well-being. We used Multiple Discrepancies Theory as a framework to identify seven potentially relevant reference points for income and health. A representative sample (N = 550) of the Netherlands assessed their income and health relative to these reference points. In addition, we elicited monthly household income, health status (EQ-5D-5L), and subjective well-being (SWLS). In line with the literature, we found a negative convex relationship between subjective well-being and age and a positive relationship with being employed, income, and health. For income, subjective well-being was also associated with how current income compared to respondents' needs and progression over time, and for health especially with how current health compared to what they felt they deserved. Our findings suggest that income and health are important for subjective well-being both in absolute and relative terms. We found negative effects on life satisfaction if some of the domain specific reference points were not met.

10.1002/hec.4412.abstractZh: 在幸福感评估中，不仅人们拥有的绝对财富很重要，而且这些财富与参考点的相对比较同样重要。我们通过测试人们自我评估的处境对收入和健康潜在参考点对其主观幸福感的影响，来探讨相对比较的相关性。我们采用多重差异理论作为框架，识别出七个可能与收入和健康相关的参考点。荷兰的550名代表样本根据这些参考点评估了自己的收入和健康状况。此外，我们还收集了家庭月收入、健康状况（EQ-5D-5L）以及主观幸福感（SWLS）的数据。与文献一致，我们发现主观幸福感与年龄呈负相关，与就业状况、收入和健康状况呈正相关。对于收入而言，主观幸福感还与当前收入与受访者需求之间的比较以及随时间的变化有关；对于健康而言，则与当前健康状况与他们认为应得的状况之间的比较有关。我们的研究结果表明，收入和健康在绝对和相对意义上都对主观幸福感至关重要。如果发现某些领域特定的参考点未得到满足，则会对生活满意度产生负面影响。

abstract.text: The classic "logistic" model has provided a realistic model of the behaviour of Covid-19 in China and many East Asian countries. Once these countries passed the peak, the daily case count fell back, mirroring its initial climb in a symmetric way, just as the classic model predicts. However, in Italy and Spain and most other Western countries, the first wave of the epidemic was very different. The daily count fell back gradually from the peak but remained stubbornly high. The reason for the divergence from the classical model remain unclear. We take an empirical stance on this issue and develop a model framework based upon the statistical characteristics of the time series. With the possible exception of China, the workhorse logistic model is decisively rejected against more flexible alternatives.

10.1002/hec.4413.abstractZh: 经典的“逻辑斯蒂”模型为研究中国及许多东亚国家中新冠疫情的行为提供了一个现实的模型。这些国家一旦度过高峰，每日病例数会以对称的方式回落，正如经典模型所预测的那样。然而，在意大利、西班牙以及大多数其他西方国家，疫情的第一波情况却与预期大相径庭。每日病例数虽从高峰逐渐下降，但依然维持在较高的水平。这种与经典模型不符的现象原因尚不清楚。我们对此问题采取实证主义立场，并基于时间序列的统计特征开发了一个模型框架。除了中国之外，传统的逻辑斯蒂模型被更灵活的替代模型所取代。

abstract.text: The graduated driver licensing (GDL) program requires teenage drivers to pass through an intermediate stage, which contains specific driving restrictions such as a night curfew or a limit on the number of teen passengers to be carried, before earning full driving privileges. Using individual data from the 1999 to 2017 biennial Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBS) combined with state-level GDL policy variations, we estimate the effects of GDL on teenage body weight in the United States. We find that the presence of GDL raises adolescents' body mass index Z-score and their likelihood of being overweight or obese. Among the restrictions imposed, a night curfew implemented together with a passenger restriction makes the most significant impact. These estimated effects are concentrated among states with more restrictive GDL policies. We also find that the presence of GDL reduces adolescent physical activity and heavy smoking, while increasing their time spent watching TV and milk intake, perhaps contributing to youth weight gain. An event study analysis reveals that the effects of GDL on adolescent weight increase may be transitory.

10.1002/hec.4414.abstractZh: 毕业级驾驶执照（GDL）计划要求青少年驾驶员经过一个中间阶段，该阶段包含特定的驾驶限制，例如夜间宵禁或限制可搭载的青少年乘客数量，之后才能获得完整的驾驶特权。我们利用1999年至2017年两年一次的青少年风险行为监测系统的个人数据，结合各州的GDL政策差异，估算了GDL对美国青少年体重的影响。研究发现，GDL的存在提高了青少年的体质指数Z分数，并增加了他们超重或肥胖的可能性。在各项限制措施中，夜间宵禁与乘客限制的结合作用最为显著。这些影响主要集中在实施更严格GDL政策的州。我们还发现，GDL的存在减少了青少年的体育活动和重度吸烟行为，同时增加了他们看电视和饮用牛奶的时间，这可能导致了青少年的体重增加。事件研究分析表明，GDL对青少年体重的影响可能是暂时的。

abstract.text: Learning the true calorie content of fast food may induce consumers to change behavior, yet recent evidence is mixed on whether calorie labels cause consumers to order healthier meals. Especially for individuals for whom consumption of highly caloric fast-food is habitual, a rational response to calorie labeling may instead be to maintain consumption levels but increase physical activity. Using American Time Use Survey data from 2004 to 2012, we show that the 2008 New York City Calorie Labeling Mandate significantly improved several measures of physical activity, including overall metabolic equivalents of task units and minutes of sedentary activity. Our results translate to an average extra 28 calories burned per day or a 0.6 kg weight decrease for the average person over one year. These results provide a plausible mechanism for calorie labeling mandates to lower obesity rates, which we demonstrate in the New York City context.

10.1002/hec.4415.abstractZh: 了解快餐的真实卡路里含量可能会促使消费者改变行为，但最近的研究结果并不一致，关于卡路里标签是否会导致消费者选择更健康的饮食，目前尚无定论。特别是对于那些习惯于食用高卡路里快餐的人来说，对卡路里标签的理性反应可能是保持当前的消费水平，同时增加体力活动。利用2004年至2012年的美国时间使用调查数据，我们发现2008年纽约市实施的卡路里标签规定显著提高了多项体力活动指标，包括总体代谢当量以及静坐活动时间。我们的结果显示，平均每人每天额外燃烧28卡路里，一年内体重减少了0.6公斤。这些结果为卡路里标签规定降低肥胖率的机制提供了合理的解释，我们在纽约市背景下证实了这一点。

abstract.text: We rank counties in the United States with respect to population health. We utilize the five observable county health variables used to construct the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute's County Health Rankings (CHRs). Our method relies on a Bayesian factor analysis model that estimates data-driven weights for our rankings, incorporates county population sizes into the level of rank uncertainty, and allows for spillovers of health stock across county lines. We find that demographic and economic variation explains a large portion of the variation in health rankings. We address the importance of uncertainty caused by imputation of missing data and show that there is a substantial quantity of uncertainty in rankings throughout the rank distribution. Analyzing the health of counties both within and across state lines shows notable degrees of disparity in county health. While we find some disagreement between the ranks of our model and the CHRs, we show that there is additional information gained by utilizing the rankings produced by both methods.

10.1002/hec.4416.abstractZh: 我们根据人口健康状况对美国的各个县进行了排名。我们采用了威斯康星大学人口健康研究所使用的五个可观测的县健康变量来构建县健康排名体系。我们的方法基于贝叶斯因子分析模型，该模型为排名估算出数据驱动的权重，并将县人口规模纳入排名的不确定性考量中，同时允许健康状况在县际间的传递。我们发现，人口统计和经济因素在很大程度上解释了健康排名的差异。我们强调了因缺失数据而引发的不确定性问题，并表明在整个排名分布中存在着大量的不确定性。分析县内及跨州范围内的健康状况，我们发现县际健康状况存在显著的差异。虽然我们发现我们的模型排名与CHRs排名之间存在一些分歧，但我们发现同时使用这两种方法产生的排名能够为我们提供额外的信息。

abstract.text: We study whether two groups of mental health care providers-each paid according to a different payment scheme-adjusted the duration of their patients' treatments after they faced an exogenous 20% drop in the number of patients. For the first group of providers, self-employed providers, we find that they did not increase treatment duration to recoup their income loss. Treatment duration thresholds in the stepwise fee-for-service payment function seem to have prevented these providers to treat patients longer. For the second group of providers, large mental health care institutions who were subject to a budget constraint, we find an average increase in treatment duration of 8%. Prior rationing combined with professional uncertainty can explain this increase. We find suggestive evidence for overtreatment of patients as the longer treatments did not result in better patient outcomes, i.e. better General Assessment of Functioning scores.

10.1002/hec.4417.abstractZh: 我们研究了两组心理健康护理提供者——各自按照不同的支付方案获得报酬——在面临患者数量减少20%的外生冲击后，是否调整了患者的治疗时长。对于第一组提供者，即个体经营者，我们发现他们并未延长治疗时长以弥补收入损失。阶梯式按服务收费机制中的治疗时长限制似乎阻碍了这些提供者延长治疗时间。对于第二组提供者，即面临预算限制的大型心理健康护理机构，我们发现治疗时长平均增加了8%。之前的资源分配限制以及专业人员的不确定性可以解释这一增长。我们发现有证据表明，过度治疗可能是一个问题，因为更长的治疗并未带来更好的患者治疗效果，即患者的一般功能评估得分并未提高。

abstract.text: Strong empirical evidence points towards a significantly higher prevalence of opioid consumption among people receiving disability benefits (DB) than in the general population of the United States. However, no previous research established a causal relationship between the decision to award DB to applicants and their subsequent opioid use. We aim to contribute towards filling this gap. There are channels through which awarding DB may both increase and depress opioid consumption, and thus, ex ante, the sign of a potential causal relationship is ambiguous. To correct for the treatment endogeneity, since an individual's age at the time of the decision on an application impacts discontinuously at certain age cutoffs the award decision, we employ a fuzzy Regression Discontinuity model with three age cutoffs used for identification. We find that awarding DB increases the likelihood of using opioids by about 27-30 percentage points. This suggests that the positive association between DB receipt and opioid consumption is likely to be causal.

10.1002/hec.4418.abstractZh: 大量实证证据表明，领取残疾福利的人中，阿片类药物的消费率显著高于美国普通人群。然而，之前的研究并未探讨授予残疾福利的决定与随后阿片类药物使用之间的因果关系。我们的研究旨在填补这一空白。授予残疾福利可能会增加或降低阿片类药物的消费，因此，从先验角度来看，潜在的因果关系并不明确。为了纠正处理的内生性问题，由于个人在申请时的年龄会在某些年龄临界点产生不连续的影响，我们采用了一种模糊回归不连续模型，并使用了三个年龄临界点来进行识别。研究发现，授予残疾福利会使使用阿片类药物的可能性增加约27-30个百分点。这表明，领取残疾福利与阿片类药物使用之间的正相关关系很可能是因果关系。

abstract.text: Recent papers have documented positive externalities of Medicaid expansions on several non-health related variables, such as crime, financial stress, child support, and child abuse. In this paper, we investigate the relationship between access to public health insurance and foster care admissions following state decisions to expand Medicaid coverage after the Affordable Care Act. Over 70% of all foster care admissions are related to child abuse incidents, which have been found to decrease following the Medicaid expansions. Our results suggest that the Medicaid expansions are associated with a large decrease in foster care admissions, driven by neglect incidents.

10.1002/hec.4419.abstractZh: 近期的研究记录了医疗补助扩展对多个非健康相关变量的积极影响，例如犯罪率、经济压力、子女抚养费和儿童虐待。本文探讨了在《平价医疗法案》之后，州政府扩大医疗补助覆盖范围后，公共健康保险的可及性与寄养机构入住率之间的关系。超过70%的寄养机构入住案例与儿童虐待事件有关，而医疗补助扩展后这些事件有所减少。我们的研究结果表明，医疗补助扩展与寄养机构入住率的显著下降有关，其主要原因是疏忽事件的增加。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on the effect of adolescent health behaviors/outcomes (obesity, depression, smoking, and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder [ADHD]) on schooling attainment using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health. We take two different approaches to deal with omitted variable bias and reverse causality. Our first approach attends to the issue of reverse causality by estimating the effect of health polygenic scores (PGSs) on schooling. Second, we estimate the effect of adolescent health using sibling fixed-effects models that control for unmeasured genetic and family factors shared by siblings. We use the PGSs as additional controls in the sibling fixed-effects models to reduce concerns about residual confounding from sibling-specific genetic differences. We find consistent evidence across both approaches that being genetically predisposed to smoking and smoking regularly in adolescence reduces schooling attainment. Estimates for depression are more imprecise, but also suggest that a high genetic risk of depression and adolescent depression reduce schooling attainment. We find mixed evidence for ADHD. Our estimates suggest that having a high genetic risk for ADHD reduces grades of schooling, but we do not find any statistically significant negative effects of ADHD. Finally, we find no consistent evidence for a detrimental effect of obesity on schooling attainment.

10.1002/hec.4421.abstractZh: 我们利用“青少年至成人健康全国纵向研究”提供了关于青少年健康行为/结果（肥胖、抑郁、吸烟以及注意力缺陷多动障碍[ADHD]）对学业成就影响的新的证据。我们采用了两种不同的方法来处理遗漏变量偏差和反向因果关系的问题。第一种方法通过估计健康多基因评分对学业成就的影响来解决反向因果关系的问题。其次，我们使用兄弟姐妹固定效应模型来估计青少年健康对学业成就的影响，这些模型控制了兄弟姐妹之间共有的未测量遗传和家庭因素。我们在兄弟姐妹固定效应模型中使用多基因评分作为额外的控制变量，以减少由于兄弟姐妹之间遗传差异导致的残留混杂问题。我们发现，无论是遗传上倾向于吸烟还是在青少年时期经常吸烟，都会降低学业成就。对于抑郁问题的估计则较为不精确，但同样表明，较高的抑郁遗传风险和青少年时期的抑郁症状都会降低学业成就。关于ADHD的估计则存在混合性证据。我们的估计表明，较高的ADHD遗传风险会降低学业成绩，但我们并未发现ADHD有任何统计学上显著的负面影响。最后，我们没有发现肥胖对学业成就有负面影响的证据。

abstract.text: Analyses of an individual's sexual orientation over time are desirable for policy evaluations and in estimating causal effects. We explore whether accounting for those who change sexual orientation over two time points, to create a measure of fluidity, produces substantially different results compared to sexual orientation measured at one time point and extrapolated to subsequent survey waves. We use seven waves of the UK Household Longitudinal Study which asked sexual orientation identity questions at two time points: waves three (2011-2013) and nine (2017-2019). Using the relationship with sexual orientation and various health outcomes as an empirical example, via a correlated random effects estimation approach, we find that the infrequent reporting of sexual orientation could over-estimate the negative impact for lesbian, gay and "other" individuals and under-estimate the negative impact for bisexuals. We further test the feasibility of the fluidity measure by examining attrition by sexual orientation identity and find small but statistically significant probabilities of attrition. Correction for attrition bias through inverse probability weighting makes little difference to the results. These results highlight the importance of accounting for changes in sexual orientation in empirical analysis and that doing so is feasible.

10.1002/hec.4422.abstractZh: 对个体性取向随时间变化的分析对于政策评估以及估计因果效应是非常必要的。我们探讨的是，如果考虑到那些在两个时间点之间改变性取向的人，从而创建一个流动性指标，是否会与仅在一个时间点测量并推断到后续调查波的结果产生显著不同的结果。我们使用了英国家庭纵向研究的七次调查数据，这些调查在两个时间点询问了性取向身份问题：第三次调查（2011-2013年）和第九次调查（2017-2019年）。通过相关随机效应估计方法，以性取向与各种健康结果之间的关系为例，我们发现，不频繁报告性取向可能会高估女同性恋、男同性恋和“其他”群体的负面影响，而低估双性恋群体的负面影响。我们还通过检查性取向身份的流失情况来测试流动性指标的可行性，发现流失概率虽然较小，但具有统计学上的显著性。通过逆概率加权法对流失偏差进行校正，对结果几乎没有影响。这些结果强调了在实证分析中考虑性取向变化的重要性，并且这样做是可行的。

abstract.text: We study the demand for Long Term Care (LTC hereafter) insurance in a setting where agents have state-dependent preferences over both a daily life consumption good and LTC expenditures. We assume that dependency creates a demand for LTC expenditures while decreasing the marginal utility of daily life consumption, for any given consumption level. Agents optimize over their consumption of both goods as well as over the amount of LTC insurance (LTCI). We first show that some agents optimally choose not to insure themselves, while no agent wishes to buy complete insurance, in accordance with the so-called LTCI puzzle. At equilibrium, the transfer received from the insurer covers only a fraction of the LTC expenditures. The demand for LTCI need not increase with income when preferences are non state-dependent or insurance is actuarially unfair. Also, preferences have to be state-dependent with no insurance bought to rationalize the empirical observation of a higher marginal utility at equilibrium when autonomous. Finally, focusing on iso-elastic preferences, we recover the empirical observation that health/LTC expenditures are not very sensitive to income, and we show that LTCI as a fraction of income should decrease with income and then become nil above a threshold.

10.1002/hec.4423.abstractZh: 我们研究了在代理人对日常生活消费品和长期护理支出具有状态依赖偏好的情况下，对长期护理保险的需求。我们假设依赖性会导致对长期护理支出的需求增加，同时降低在给定消费水平下日常生活消费品的边际效用。代理人会优化他们对两种商品的消费以及长期护理保险的数量。我们首先证明了有些代理人最优选择不购买保险，而没有任何代理人希望购买完全保险，这与所谓的长期护理保险悖论相符。在均衡状态下，从保险公司获得的转移金额仅能覆盖部分长期护理支出。当偏好不具有状态依赖性或保险在精算上不公平时，对长期护理保险的需求不会随收入增加而增加。此外，为了使观察到的在均衡状态下自主消费时边际效用较高的现象合理化，偏好必须具有状态依赖性且没有人购买保险。最后，在考虑等弹性偏好的情况下，我们得出了健康/长期护理支出对收入并不十分敏感的结论，并且表明长期护理保险占收入的比例应该随收入增加而减少，并在某个阈值以上变为零。

abstract.text: Physicians' relationships with the pharmaceutical industry have recently come under public scrutiny, particularly in the context of opioid drug prescribing. This study examines the effect of doctor-industry marketing interactions on subsequent prescribing patterns of opioids using linked Medicare Part D and Open Payments data for the years 2014-2017. Results indicate that both the number and the dollar-value of marketing visits increase physicians' patented opioid claims. Furthermore, direct-to-physician marketing of safer abuse-deterrent formulations of opioids is the primary driver of positive and persistent spillovers on the prescribing of less safe generic opioids - a result that we show appears to be driven by insurance coverage policies. These findings suggest that pharmaceutical marketing efforts may have unintended public health implications.

10.1002/hec.4424.abstractZh: 医生与制药行业的关系最近受到了公众的关注，尤其是在阿片类药物处方方面。本研究通过2014年至2017年的Medicare Part D和公开支付数据，探讨了医生与制药行业营销互动对阿片类药物处方模式的影响。研究结果表明，营销活动的次数和金额增加会促使医生提出更昂贵的阿片类药物索赔。此外，直接针对医生的、更安全的阿片类药物营销活动，是促使对安全性较低的通用阿片类药物处方增加的正向影响的主要因素——我们认为这一结果是由保险政策所驱动的。这些发现表明，制药行业的营销活动可能带来意想不到的公共卫生影响。

abstract.text: Poor respiratory health is a major cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, and children are especially vulnerable. Existing research in economics has documented the effect of pollution on severe health outcomes, such as hospitalizations for asthma and infant death. However, evidence on the effect of air pollution on less extreme measures of respiratory health is limited, because these effects are difficult to measure. Using a more sensitive measure, aerobic capacity ( VO2max ), I study the impact of air pollution on respiratory performance of children. I combine school-grade level data from the California Physical Fitness Test from 2009 to 2017 with local air pollution and weather data to estimate the impact on student aerobic capacity of fluctuations in air pollution levels on testing days. Ozone affects child aerobic capacity at levels even below the Environmental Protection Agency thresholds.

10.1002/hec.4425.abstractZh: 不良的呼吸健康是全球死亡和疾病的主要原因之一，儿童尤其容易受到影响。现有的经济学研究已经记录了污染对严重健康后果的影响，例如因哮喘而住院和婴儿死亡。然而，关于空气污染对不太严重的呼吸健康指标的影响的证据有限，因为这些影响难以测量。通过使用更敏感的指标——最大摄氧量，我研究了空气污染对儿童呼吸能力的影响。我结合了2009年至2017年加州体能测试的数据以及当地的空气污染和天气数据，以估算测试日空气污染水平波动对学生最大摄氧量的影响。即使臭氧水平低于美国环境保护署的阈值，也会影响儿童的呼吸能力。

abstract.text: We examined the impact of primary care physician density on perinatal health outcomes in Norway. From 1992 and onwards, primary care physicians who chose to work in selected remote municipalities were given an annual reduction in their student loan. This reduction, combined with increased supply of physicians, led to an increase in the density of primary care physicians in these selected municipalities. Our register-based population study showed that this increase in physician density significantly improved perinatal health in terms of fewer fetal deaths and increased birth weight. The richness of the data allowed us to perform several robustness tests.

10.1002/hec.4426.abstractZh: 我们研究了初级保健医生密度对挪威围产期健康结果的影响。从1992年开始，选择在偏远市镇工作的初级保健医生每年可以获得学生贷款的减免。这一减免措施，加上医生供应量的增加，使得这些选定市镇的初级保健医生密度有所提高。我们的基于登记的人口研究显示，医生密度的增加显著改善了围产期健康，表现为胎儿死亡数量减少和出生体重增加。数据的丰富性使我们能够进行多项稳健性测试。

abstract.text: We investigate how utilization of primary care, specialist care, and emergency department (ED) care (and the mix across the three) changes in response to a change in health need. We determine whether any changes in utilization are impacted by socio-economic status. The use of a unique Australian data set that consists of a large survey linked to multiple years of detailed administrative records enables us to better control for individual heterogeneity and allows us to exploit changes in health that are related to the onset of two health shocks: a new diagnosis of diabetes and heart disease. We extend the analysis by also examining changes to patient out-of-pocket costs. We find significant differences in the mix between primary and specialist care use according to income and type of health shock but no evidence of using ED as a substitute for other care. Our results indicate that low- and high-income patients navigate very different pathways for their care following the onset of diabetes and to a lesser extent heart disease. These pathways appear to be chosen on the basis of ability to pay, rather than the most effective or efficient bundle of care delivered through a combination of GP and specialist care.

10.1002/hec.4427.abstractZh: 我们研究了在健康需求发生变化时，对初级保健、专科医疗以及急诊服务的利用情况及其组合方式如何变化。我们探讨了这些利用情况是否受到社会经济状况的影响。通过使用一个独特的澳大利亚数据集，该数据集包含大量调查数据以及多年详细的行政记录，我们能够更好地控制个体差异，并分析与健康相关的变化，这些变化与两种健康危机的出现有关：糖尿病和心脏病的诊断。我们还研究了患者自付费用的变化。研究发现，根据收入和健康危机的类型，初级保健与专科医疗的利用组合存在显著差异，但并没有证据表明急诊服务被用作其他医疗服务的替代方式。我们的结果表明，低收入和高收入患者在糖尿病和心脏病发病后的医疗路径存在很大差异。这些路径似乎是基于支付能力来选择的，而不是基于通过全科医生和专科医生联合提供的有效医疗组合。

abstract.text: Enhancing population resilience to adverse events is now a policy priority. Accordingly, there have been calls for more evidence on the determinants of resilience. We answer this call by identifying financial and non-financial resources associated with psychological resilience during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using longitudinal survey data, psychological resilience is measured by comparing distress reported pre-COVID-19 with distress reported during the outbreak and initial lockdown in April 2020. Methodologically, we compare differences in resilience and resources between people with identical gender, ethnicity, health, parenthood status, education, employment status, and region of residence (all measured pre-2020). We also provide estimates from within-household comparisons. Surprisingly, income, savings, and debt levels did not affect the likelihood of psychologically resilient outcomes. Cognitive ability, religiosity, and neighborhood social capital also had no protective effect. In contrast, we find robust evidence that non-cognitive skills, measured by self-efficacy, strongly protected against psychological distress. Self-efficacy also dampened the increase in distress caused by large earnings shocks. These findings support investments in non-cognitive skills that modify the damage-function from adverse events.

10.1002/hec.4428.abstractZh: 增强人口对不利事件的韧性已成为政策优先事项。因此，人们呼吁提供更多关于韧性决定因素的证据。我们通过识别在COVID-19疫情期间与心理韧性相关的财务和非财务资源来回应这一需求。利用纵向调查数据，通过将COVID-19爆发前报告的痛苦程度与2020年4月疫情爆发及初期封锁期间报告的痛苦程度进行比较，来衡量心理韧性。在方法上，我们比较了具有相同性别、种族、健康状况、父母身份、教育水平、就业状况以及居住地区的人群在韧性和资源方面的差异（所有指标均于2020年前测量）。我们还提供了家庭内部比较的估计结果。令人惊讶的是，收入、储蓄和债务水平并未影响心理韧性结果的可能性。认知能力、宗教信仰和社区社会资本也没有保护作用。相反，我们发现，通过自我效能感衡量的非认知技能对心理痛苦的防护作用非常显著。自我效能感还减轻了因重大收入冲击导致的痛苦增加。这些发现支持了投资于能够减轻不利事件带来的损害的非认知技能。

abstract.text: Many developing countries have adopted community-based primary health-care programs. A vital component of these programs is health literacy, which teaches households to avoid physical harm. Child labor can often result in physical harm through injury. Our hypothesis is that health literacy programs make households aware of previously unknown costs of child labor (i.e., risks of injury), resulting in a reallocation of labor away from children. Using Ethiopian data, we investigate if exposure to a community-level health program delivered by Health Extension Workers (HEWs) lowers child labor. We use panel data comprising 5587 observations from 2255 children over four waves of the Young Lives Project. These data are combined with administrative regional-level data on HEWs over the 2006-2016 period. Our identification strategy exploits variations in the deployment of HEWs across regions and time to investigate a plausibly exogenous effect on child labor. We provide evidence that supports our hypothesis. We posit that the mechanism behind our result is likely behavioral change, and rule out several other potential channels, including public safety net programs and the effect of HEWs on education. Our results point to the role that health programs can play in the fight against child labor.

10.1002/hec.4429.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家采用了基于社区的初级医疗保健计划。这些计划的一个重要组成部分是健康素养教育，它教导家庭避免身体伤害。童工往往会导致身体伤害。我们的假设是，健康素养计划使家庭意识到童工带来的未知成本（如受伤风险），从而导致劳动力从儿童身上转移。利用埃塞俄比亚的数据，我们研究了由健康推广人员提供的社区级健康计划是否有助于降低童工现象。我们使用了包含5587个观测数据的面板数据，这些数据来自“青年生活项目”的四个阶段，涉及2255名儿童。这些数据与2006-2016年期间关于健康推广人员的行政区域级数据相结合。我们的识别策略利用不同地区和时间上健康推广人员部署的变化，来研究对童工现象的可能的外生影响。我们的证据表明支持我们的假设。我们认为，我们的结果背后的机制可能是行为改变，并排除了其他几个潜在渠道，包括公共安全网络计划以及健康推广人员对教育的影响。我们的结果指出了健康计划在打击童工方面可以发挥的作用。

abstract.text: Vaccine hesitancy (VH) might represent a serious threat to the next COVID-19 mass immunization campaign. We use machine learning algorithms to predict communities at a high risk of VH relying on area-level indicators easily available to policymakers. We illustrate our approach on data from child immunization campaigns for seven nonmandatory vaccines carried out in 6062 Italian municipalities in 2016. A battery of machine learning models is compared in terms of area under the receiver operating characteristics curve. We find that the Random Forest algorithm best predicts areas with a high risk of VH improving the unpredictable baseline level by 24% in terms of accuracy. Among the area-level indicators, the proportion of waste recycling and the employment rate are found to be the most powerful predictors of high VH. This can support policymakers to target area-level provaccine awareness campaigns.

10.1002/hec.4430.abstractZh: 疫苗犹豫可能成为下一次COVID-19大规模免疫接种活动的重大威胁。我们采用机器学习算法，根据政策制定者可轻易获取的区域级指标，预测存在高疫苗犹豫风险的社区。我们以2016年意大利6062个市镇开展的七种非强制疫苗儿童免疫接种活动的数据为例，比较了多种机器学习模型的性能。研究发现，随机森林算法在预测高疫苗犹豫风险区域方面表现最佳，其准确率提高了24%。在区域级指标中，垃圾回收率和就业率被认为是预测高疫苗犹豫风险的最有力指标。这些数据可以帮助政策制定者针对性地开展区域级的疫苗意识宣传活动。

abstract.text: A healthcare provider faces two decision problems. On the one hand, it chooses its organizational form: a hospital can be a for-profit institution providing compensated care only, or it can be a nonprofit organization whose mission is enhancing access to care for uninsured, low-income patients. On the other hand, the provider chooses which health professionals to hire, without observing their heterogeneous skills and their pro-social motivation. These decisions are related because an increase in the percentage of revenues, that the nonprofit hospital sacrifices for charity care, might enhance the motivation of its workers and induce some of them to donate their labor, that is, to volunteer. Accordingly, this article analyzes the provider's optimal screening contracts, which are contingent on workers' ability and satisfy limited liability, and relates them to the optimal choice of its mission-orientation. The results provide a new rationale for: a the emergence of different organizational forms for hospitals, such as for-profits and nonprofits, which complement public hospitals in the provision of health care, b the heterogeneity in the degree of charity care chosen by different nonprofit hospitals.

10.1002/hec.4431.abstractZh: 医疗服务提供者面临两个决策问题。一方面，它需要选择其组织形式：医院可以是仅提供有偿服务的营利性机构，也可以是致力于为无保险、低收入患者提供医疗服务的非营利组织。另一方面，提供者需要选择雇佣哪些医疗专业人员，而无需考虑这些人员的技能差异和他们的亲社会动机。这两个决策是相互关联的，因为非营利医院为慈善医疗服务而牺牲的部分收入可能会增加员工的积极性，促使其中一些人自愿奉献自己的劳动，即成为志愿者。因此，本文分析了提供者的优化筛选合同，这些合同取决于员工的能力并满足有限责任的要求，并将它们与其使命导向的最优选择联系起来。研究结果为以下现象提供了新的解释：一是医院出现了不同的组织形式，如营利性和非营利性医院，它们与公立医院互补，共同提供医疗服务；二是不同非营利医院选择慈善医疗服务的程度存在差异。

abstract.text: In response to an emerging pandemic, there is urgent need for information regarding individual evaluation of risk and preferences toward mitigation strategies such as vaccinations. However, with social distancing policies and financial stress during an outbreak, traditional robust survey methodologies of face-to-face, probabilistic sampling, may not be feasible to deploy quickly, especially in developing countries. We recommend a protocol that calls for a sensitive survey design, acceptance of a web-based approach and adjustments for uncertainty of respondents, to deliver urgently needed information to policymakers as the public health crisis unfolds, rather than in its aftermath. This information is critical to tailor comprehensive vaccination campaigns that reach critical immunity thresholds. We apply our recommendations in a regional study of 16 Latin American countries in the month following index cases of COVID-19. We use a split-sample, contingent valuation approach to evaluate the effects of cost, duration of immunity and effectiveness of the vaccine. Our results show that cost and duration of immunity are significant factors in the decision to vaccinate, while the degree of effectiveness is insignificant, unless the vaccine is 100% effective. Income as well as perceived risk and severity of the virus are important determinants also.

10.1002/hec.4432.abstractZh: 面对新兴的疫情，迫切需要关于个人风险评估及对疫苗接种等缓解策略的偏好的信息。然而，在社交距离政策实施和疫情期间的财务压力下，传统的面对面、概率抽样等调查方法可能无法迅速实施，尤其是在发展中国家。我们建议采用一种敏感的调查设计，采用基于网络的方法，并对受访者的不确定性进行调整，以便在公共卫生危机发生时向政策制定者提供急需的信息，而不是在危机过后才进行。这些信息对于制定能够达到关键免疫阈值的全面疫苗接种计划至关重要。我们在16个拉丁美洲国家进行了一项区域研究，该研究在COVID-19指数病例出现后的一个月内进行了调查。我们采用了分割样本、条件估值的方法来评估成本、免疫持续时间以及疫苗效果的影响。研究结果表明，成本和免疫持续时间是决定是否接种疫苗的重要因素，而疫苗的有效性则并不重要，除非疫苗具有100%的有效性。收入、感知风险和病毒严重程度也是重要的决定因素。

abstract.text: This paper is one of the first to investigate mobility in overall health using high-quality administrative data. The attractiveness of this approach lies in objective health measures and large sample sizes allowing twin analyses. I operationalize health mobility by a variety of statistics: rank-rank slopes, intergenerational correlations (IGCs) and sibling and identical twin correlations. I find rank-rank slopes and IGCs in the range 0.11-0.15 and sibling correlations in the range 0.14-0.20. Mobility in health is thus relatively high, both when compared to similar US-based studies, and when contrasted with outcomes such as educational attainment and income. Comparing sibling and identical twin correlations with parent-child associations confirms earlier findings in the literature on equality of opportunity, namely that sibling correlations capture far more variation than traditional IGCs. I conclude that 14%-38% of the variation in individual health outcomes can be attributed to family background and genes, factors which the individual cannot be held accountable for. This finding suggests that simple parent-child associations may be a poor metric for measuring health mobility.

10.1002/hec.4433.abstractZh: 本文是首批利用高质量行政数据研究健康领域流动性的研究之一。这种方法的优势在于其基于客观的健康指标，以及能够进行双变量分析的大样本数据。我通过多种统计指标来量化健康领域的流动性：等级-等级斜率、代际相关性（IGC）以及兄弟姐妹和同卵双胞胎之间的相关性。研究发现，等级-等级斜率和IGC的值在0.11-0.15之间，而兄弟姐妹相关性则在0.14-0.20之间。因此，与健康相关的流动性相对较高，无论是在与类似美国研究相比时，还是与教育成就和收入等结果相比时。将兄弟姐妹和同卵双胞胎之间的相关性与父母-子女关系进行比较，进一步证实了文献中关于机会平等的研究结果，即兄弟姐妹相关性能够捕捉到比传统IGC更多的变异。我得出结论，个体健康结果的14%-38%的变异可以归因于家庭背景和基因因素，而这些因素并非个体所能控制的。这一发现表明，简单的父母-子女关系可能并不是衡量健康流动性的有效指标。

abstract.text: Policymakers face difficult choices over which health interventions to publicly finance. We developed an approach to health benefits package design that accommodates explicit tradeoffs between improvements in health and provision of financial risk protection (FRP). We designed a mathematical optimization model to balance gains in health and FRP across candidate interventions when publicly financed. The optimal subset of interventions selected for inclusion was determined with bi-criterion integer programming conditional on a budget constraint. The optimal set of interventions to publicly finance in a health benefits package varied according to whether the objective for optimization was population health benefits or FRP. When both objectives were considered jointly, the resulting optimal essential benefits package depended on the weights placed on the two objectives. In the Sustainable Development Goals era, smart spending toward universal health coverage is essential. Mathematical optimization provides a quantitative framework for policymakers to design health policies and select interventions that jointly prioritize multiple objectives with explicit financial constraints.

10.1002/hec.4434.abstractZh: 政策制定者在选择哪些健康干预措施进行公共融资时面临困难。我们提出了一种健康福利套餐设计方法，能够明确权衡健康改善与财务风险保护之间的权衡。我们设计了一个数学优化模型，以在公共融资的情况下平衡健康收益与财务风险保护之间的平衡。通过双标准整数规划，并在预算限制条件下，确定最优干预措施子集。在健康福利套餐中公共融资的最优干预措施组合会根据优化目标的不同而有所变化——如果目标是群体健康收益，则最优方案会有所不同；如果目标是财务风险保护，则最优方案也会有所不同。当同时考虑这两个目标时，最终的最优基本福利套餐取决于对这两个目标的权重分配。在可持续发展目标时代，向全民健康覆盖领域进行明智的支出至关重要。数学优化为政策制定者提供了一个定量框架，帮助他们设计健康政策并选择能够同时兼顾多个目标的干预措施，同时明确财务约束。

abstract.text: Physical inactivity is the leading cause of non-communicable diseases, and further research on the cost-effectiveness of interventions that target inactivity is warranted. Socioeconomic status is vital in this process. We aim to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of a cycle-network expansion plan in Oslo compared to the status quo by income quintiles. We applied a Markov model using a public payer perspective. Health outcomes were measured by quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) gained from the prevention of coronary heart disease, stroke, type 2 diabetes, and cancer. We measured equity impact by the concentration index and social welfare using the achievement index. We conducted sensitivity analyses. The intervention was generally more costly and more effective than the status quo. Incremental cost per QALY falls with income quintile, ranging from $10,098 in the richest quintile to $23,053 per QALY gained in the poorest quintile. The base-case intervention increased health inequality. However, a scenario targeting low-income quintiles reduced inequality and increased social welfare. In conclusion, the cycle-network expansion is likely to be cost-effective, but with equity concerns. If decision makers care about health inequalities, the disadvantaged groups could be targeted to produce more equitable and socially desirable outcomes instead of a uniform intervention across income quintiles.

10.1002/hec.4435.abstractZh: 身体活动不足是非传染性疾病的主要原因，因此有必要进一步研究针对活动不足的干预措施的成本效益。社会经济地位在这一过程中起着至关重要的作用。我们的目标是通过收入五分位数来评估奥斯陆的自行车网络扩展计划与现状之间的成本效益。我们采用了从公共支付者视角出发的马尔可夫模型。健康结果通过预防冠心病、中风、2型糖尿病和癌症所增加的质量调整生命年来衡量。我们通过集中指数和社会福利指数来衡量公平影响。我们进行了敏感性分析。该干预措施通常比现状更为昂贵且更为有效。每QALY的增加成本随着收入五分位数的增加而降低，从最富裕的五分位数中的10,098美元降至最贫困的五分位数中的23,053美元。基础情况下的干预措施加剧了健康不平等。然而，针对低收入五分位数的方案则减少了不平等并增加了社会福利。总之，自行车网络扩展措施可能具有成本效益，但存在公平方面的担忧。如果决策者关心健康不平等问题，那么可以针对弱势群体实施更公平且符合社会期望的干预措施，而不是对收入五分位数进行统一的干预。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: Satisfaction with healthcare may be captured by surveys of patients and staff, or in extreme cases, the number and severity of medical disputes. This study tries to investigate the relationship between satisfaction and hospital management as well as the role of good management in preventing medical disputes ex ante. METHOD: We investigate this relationship using information on management practices collected from 510 hospitals in mainland China using the World Management Survey questionnaire and combined with medical malpractice litigation data and patient/staff satisfaction surveys. Multiple regression models were used to analyse the relationship between hospital management scores and medical litigation outcomes as well as patient and staff satisfaction during 2014-2016. RESULTS: An increase of one standard deviation in the management score was related to 13.1% (p < 0.10) lower incidence of medical disputes, 12.4% (p < 0.05) fewer medical litigations, and 51.3% (p < 0.10) less compensation. Better management quality of hospitals was associated with higher inpatient satisfaction (p < 0.05) and staff well-being (p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: Improving hospital management could reduce hospital costs generated by lawsuits, reduce potential harm to patients, and improve patient and staff satisfaction, thus leading to a better patient-physician relationship.

10.1002/hpm.3399.abstractZh: 目的：患者对医疗服务的满意度可以通过对患者和员工的调查来捕捉，或者在极端情况下，通过医疗纠纷的数量和严重程度来衡量。本研究试图探讨满意度与医院管理之间的关系，以及良好的管理在预防医疗纠纷方面的作用。方法：我们利用《世界管理调查》问卷收集的中国大陆510家医院的管理实践信息，并结合医疗纠纷诉讼数据和患者/员工满意度调查，来研究这种关系。通过多元回归模型分析医院管理评分与医疗诉讼结果以及2014-2016年期间患者和员工满意度之间的关系。结果：管理评分增加一个标准差，与医疗纠纷发生率降低13.1%（p < 0.10）、医疗诉讼减少12.4%（p < 0.05）以及赔偿金额减少51.3%（p < 0.10）相关。医院更好的管理质量与更高的住院满意度（p < 0.05）和员工福祉（p < 0.01）相关。结论：改善医院管理可以减少因诉讼产生的医院成本，减少对患者的潜在伤害，并提高患者和员工的满意度，从而改善医患关系。

abstract.text: There is much evidence that good management practice is an important factor that positively affects firms' productivity around the world. However, little evidence on effect of management practices on Vietnamese firms has been drawn. This paper provides results of such a study. The quality of management activities is found to be poor and be positively related to the turnovers of firms, the ages of firms, the numbers of employees, investment capital, and human capital. Also, management practice scores change significantly according to the influencing factors including level of competition, degree of decentralization, types of ownership, types of customer firms are serving, advancement of export market, and types of product firms are selling.

10.1002/mde.3447.abstractZh: 有大量证据表明，良好的管理实践是全球企业生产力提升的重要因素。然而，关于管理实践对越南企业影响的实证研究却相对较少。本文提供了此类研究的结果。研究发现，管理活动的质量较差，并且与企业的营业额、企业规模、员工数量、投资资本以及人力资本呈正相关。此外，管理实践的表现还会因多种因素的影响而发生变化，这些因素包括竞争程度、权力下放程度、所有制类型、企业服务的客户类型、出口市场的发展状况以及企业销售的产品类型等。

abstract.text: Medicare is a roughly $700 billion public program, with physician payments representing one of its largest expenditures. Medicare's prices are also administratively set, which leaves the structure of payment changes subject to a political process that may introduce idiosyncratic features and even perverse incentives. At the same time, physician responses to changes in Medicare reimbursements are likely to vary according to the policy's duration, scope, and size. We study a setting where broad federal laws contained specific provisions that financially benefit a narrow group: Alaskan physicians. The geographically targeted payment reforms were also unique along key dimensions. Using difference‐in‐differences strategies, we find that large, temporary price changes increase spending but elicit no detectable supply response. Conversely, generous and permanent price shocks induce greater service flows but not uniformly across specialties. Our findings suggest that Congress may engage in fiscally inefficient Medicare spending to accomplish other legislative objectives.

10.1002/pam.22344.abstractZh: 医疗保险是一项规模约为7000亿美元的公共项目，其中医生薪酬是其最大的支出之一。医疗保险的定价也是通过行政手段确定的，这使得支付结构的变化受到政治因素的影响，可能会引入一些特殊特征甚至不合理的激励措施。同时，医生对医疗保险报销政策变化的反应可能会因政策的持续时间、范围和规模而有所不同。我们研究了一个特定的情况：一些广泛的联邦法律中包含了对特定群体有利的条款，比如阿拉斯加州的医生。这些针对特定地区的支付改革在关键方面也具有独特性。通过差异比较策略，我们发现大规模的临时价格变动会增加支出，但并不会引发明显的供应反应。相反，大幅且永久性的价格变动则会促进服务流动，但这种影响并不均匀，不同专业领域的情况也有所不同。我们的研究结果表明，国会可能会为了实现其他立法目标而采取财务上不高效的医疗保险支出方式。

abstract.text: Abstracts Research Summary Network centrality is an important determinant of alliance performance. However, estimating how each alliance member's centrality affects alliance performance is challenging because the end market might value each partner's contribution differently. We solve this empirical question with a two‐sided matching model that accounts for the partners' endogenous selection and estimates the effect of each side's centrality and input quality on performance. We implement the method in the novel context of the Thoroughbred horse industry, in foal‐sharing alliances between buyers and suppliers. We find that buyer centrality has a larger marginal effect on the alliance performance than the supplier centrality because buyers, who on average are less central in our context, are more likely to diffuse valuable information to the end market. Managerial Summary Alliance partners often struggle with identifying what their contributions and their partner's contribution are to the alliance performance. We use a new method to identify each side's contribution to their alliance. Our findings offer a few recommendations to firms forming similar alliances. First, we find that the less central partner in the business network has greater impact on the alliance performance due to their ability to diffuse more valuable information to the market. Second, our results suggest that product input quality that is relatively unknown impacts alliance performance more than low and average quality. Alliance partners may benefit more from experimenting with unknown inputs. Third, more central actors may reduce spending on mass communications if valuable information comes to the market through their less central partners.

10.1002/smj.3275.abstractZh:
摘要  
联盟中心性是影响联盟绩效的重要因素。然而，要评估每个联盟成员的中心性对联盟绩效的影响却颇具挑战性，因为最终市场可能对各合作伙伴的贡献价值有不同评估。我们通过一个双边匹配模型来解决这一实证问题，该模型考虑了合作伙伴的内生选择，并估算了各方中心性和投入质量对绩效的影响。我们在纯种马产业这一新场景中应用了这一方法，研究买家与供应商之间的马驹共享联盟。研究发现，与供应商中心性相比，买家的中心性对联盟绩效的边际影响更大，因为在这类情境中，买家通常处于较低的中心地位，但他们更有可能向最终市场传递有价值的信息。  

管理总结  
联盟合作伙伴常常难以明确自己的贡献以及合作伙伴对联盟绩效的贡献。我们采用了一种新方法来确定各方对联盟的贡献。我们的研究结果为企业形成类似联盟提供了一些建议。首先，我们发现，在商业网络中处于较低中心地位的合作伙伴，由于能够向市场传递更多有价值的信息，因此对联盟绩效的影响更大。其次，研究结果表明，相对不为人知的产品投入质量对联盟绩效的影响大于低质量或中等质量的产品。联盟合作伙伴可以从尝试使用未知投入中获益更多。第三，如果有价值的信息通过处于较低中心地位的合作伙伴传播到市场，那么处于较高中心地位的参与者可能会减少大规模传播的成本。

abstract.text: The Portuguese National Health System is composed of all public entities offering health services. There has been a successive increase in expenditure in recent years due to various factors that have contributed to a high degree of uncertainty about the evolution of operating costs in Public Business Hospitals. This research's main objective is to study the relationship between operational costs and waiting times as well as costs with healthcare professionals and waiting times in both external consultations and hospital surgeries. Furthermore, we will empirically assess the presence of U-shaped behaviour in both of these two relationships. We have included a sample of 38 hospitals considered in the Portuguese National Health System. We also included, in our analysis, five groups of public business hospitals, according to the Administrative Central Agency of Portugal's Health Service, considering the period between January 2015 and December 2019. To validate the two relationships proposed, the Autoregressive Distributed Lag panel model was used. This study highlights that longer waiting times for external consultation and surgery significantly affect hospital costs and suggest that longer waiting times do not merely increase absence rates. The study also proves that there are long-term effects that last beyond the short-term waiting period.

10.1007/s10198-021-01331-y.abstractZh: 葡萄牙国家卫生系统由所有提供卫生服务的公共实体组成。近年来，由于多种因素的影响，公共医院运营成本的变动性显著增加。本研究的主要目标是探讨运营成本与等待时间之间的关系，以及医疗专业人员费用与等待时间之间的关系，包括外部咨询和医院手术环节。此外，我们将实证分析这两种关系是否存在U形行为。我们选取了葡萄牙国家卫生系统中38家医院作为样本，并在分析中纳入了葡萄牙卫生服务行政中央机构的五组公共医院，研究时间范围为2015年1月至2019年12月。为了验证这两种关系，我们使用了自回归分布滞后面板模型。研究表明，较长的等待时间对医院成本有显著影响，并且较长的等待时间不仅会增加缺勤率，还表明存在长期影响，这些影响会持续超过短期等待期。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: Large reductions in inpatient length of stay and inpatient bed supply have occurred across health systems in recent years. However, the direction of causation between length of stay and bed supply is often overlooked. This study examines the impact of changes to inpatient bed supply, as a result of recession-induced healthcare expenditure changes, on emergency inpatient length of stay in Ireland between 2010 and 2015. STUDY DESIGN: We analyse all public hospital emergency inpatient discharges in Ireland from 2010 to 2015 using the administrative Hospital In-Patient Enquiry dataset. We use changes to inpatient bed supply across hospitals over time to examine the impact of bed supply on length of stay. Linear, negative binomial, and hospital-month-level fixed effects models are estimated. RESULTS: U-shaped trends are observed for both average length of stay and inpatient bed supply between 2010 and 2015. A consistently large positive relationship is found between bed supply and length of stay across all regression analyses. Between 2010 and 2012 while length of stay fell by 6.4%, our analyses estimate that approximately 42% (2.7% points) of this reduction was associated with declines in bed supply. CONCLUSION: Changes in emergency inpatient length of stay in Ireland between 2010 and 2015 were closely related to changes in bed supply during those years. The use of length of stay as an efficiency measure should be understood in the contextual basis of other health system changes. Lower length of stay may be indicative of the lack of resources or available bed supply as opposed to reduced demand for care or the shifting of care to other settings.

10.1007/s10198-021-01373-2.abstractZh:
目的：近年来，各医疗系统的住院时间缩短和住院床位供应减少已成为普遍现象。然而，住院时间与床位供应之间的因果关系往往被忽视。本研究探讨了由于经济衰退导致的医疗支出变化对2010年至2015年间爱尔兰急诊住院时间的影响。  
研究设计：我们使用行政数据“Hospital In-Patient Enquiry”数据集，分析了2010年至2015年间爱尔兰所有公立医院的急诊住院出院数据。通过对比不同医院之间的床位供应变化，来研究床位供应对住院时间的影响。我们采用了线性模型、负二项模型以及医院月级别固定效应模型进行分析。  
结果：在2010年至2015年间，平均住院时间和床位供应都呈现出U形趋势。所有回归分析均显示，床位供应与住院时间之间存在显著的正相关关系。在2010年至2012年间，尽管住院时间减少了6.4%，但我们的分析表明，这一减少中有约42%（2.7个百分点）与床位供应的减少有关。  
结论：2010年至2015年间，爱尔兰急诊住院时间的变化与当年床位供应的变化密切相关。将住院时间作为效率指标时，应结合其他医疗系统变化的情况来理解。较短的住院时间可能表明资源不足或床位供应不足，而不是因为护理需求减少或护理被转移到其他场所。

abstract.text: Many healthcare report cards provide information to consumers but do not represent a constraint on the behavior of healthcare providers. This is not the case with the report cards utilized in kidney transplantation. These report cards became more salient and binding, with additional oversight, in 2007 under the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services Conditions of Participation. This research investigates whether the additional oversight based on report card outcomes influences patient selection via waiting-list registrations at transplant centers that meet regulatory standards. Using data from a national registry of kidney transplant candidates from 2003 through 2010, we apply a before-and-after estimation strategy that isolates the impact of a binding report card. A sorting equilibrium model is employed to account for center-level heterogeneity and the presence of congestion/agglomeration effects and the results are compared to a conditional logit specification. Our results indicate that patient waiting-list registrations change in response to the quality information similarly on average if there is additional regulation or not. We also find evidence of congestion effects when spatial choice sets are smaller: new patient registrations are less likely to occur at a center with a long waiting list when fewer options are available.

10.1007/s10729-020-09530-4.abstractZh: 许多医疗保健报告卡为消费者提供信息，但并不对医疗服务提供者的行为构成约束。而用于肾脏移植的报告卡则不同，2007年根据医疗保险和医疗补助服务机构的参与条件，这些报告卡变得更加重要且具有约束力。本研究探讨了基于报告卡结果的额外监管是否会影响符合监管标准的移植中心在等待名单上的患者选择。通过利用2003年至2010年间全国肾脏移植候选者的登记数据，我们采用了前后对比的估计方法，以分离约束性报告卡的影响。同时，我们采用排序均衡模型来考虑中心层面的异质性以及拥堵/聚集效应，并将结果与条件Logit模型进行比较。我们的研究结果表明，无论是否存在额外监管，患者等待名单上的注册情况都会因质量信息而发生变化。此外，当空间选择集较小时，我们发现了拥堵效应的证据：在等待名单较长且选择较少的情况下，新患者的注册可能性较低。

abstract.text: Quality competition among hospitals, induced by patients freely choosing their hospital in a price regulated market, can only be realized if quality differences between hospitals are transparent, understandable, and thus influence patients' hospital choice. We use data from ~145,000 German patients and ~ 900 hospitals for colorectal resections and knee replacements to investigate whether patients value quality and specialization when choosing their hospital. Using a random utility choice model, we estimate patients' marginal utilities, willingness to travel and change in hospital demand for quality improvements. Patients respond to service quality and specialization and thus, quality competition seems to be present. Colorectal resection patients are willing to travel longer for more specialized hospitals (+9% for procedure volume, +9% for certification). Knee replacement patients travel longer for hospitals with better service quality (+6%) and higher procedure volume (+12%). However, clinical quality indicators, often difficult to access and interpret, barely play a role in patients' hospital choice. Furthermore, we find that competition on quality for colorectal resection is rather local, whereas for knee replacement we observe regional competition patterns.

10.1007/s10729-020-09540-2.abstractZh: 在价格受管制的市场中，患者可以自由选择医院，因此医院之间的质量竞争只有在医院之间的质量差异是透明且易于理解的条件下才能实现，从而影响患者的医院选择。我们使用了约145,000名德国患者和约900家医院的数据，这些数据涉及结直肠癌切除术和膝关节置换手术，以研究患者在选择医院时是否重视质量和专业化。通过随机效用选择模型，我们估算了患者的边际效用、出行意愿以及因质量改进而变化的医院需求。患者对服务质量和专业化有较高要求，因此质量竞争似乎确实存在。结直肠癌切除术患者愿意为了更专业的医院而延长出行距离（手术量每增加1单位，愿意出行增加9%；认证等级每提高1级，愿意出行增加9%）。膝关节置换手术患者则愿意为了服务质量更好且手术量更大的医院而延长出行距离（服务质量每提高1单位，愿意出行增加6%；手术量每增加1单位，愿意出行增加12%）。然而，临床质量指标往往难以获取和解读，在患者的医院选择中几乎不起作用。此外，我们发现结直肠癌切除术的质量竞争较为局部化，而膝关节置换手术则呈现出区域性的竞争模式。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between patient choices and provider quality in a rehabilitation service for disabled patients who receive the service frequently but do not have access to quality information. Previous research has found a positive relationship between patient choices and provider quality in health services that patients typically do not have previous experience or use frequently. We contribute by examining choices of new patients and experienced patients who were either forced to switch or actively switched their provider. In the analysis, we combine register data on patients' choices and switches with provider quality data from a competitive bidding, and estimate conditional logit choice models. The results show that all patients prefer high-quality providers within short distances. We find that the willingness to travel for quality is highest among new patients and active switchers. These results suggest that new patients and active switchers compare different alternatives more thoroughly, whereas forced switchers choose their new provider in limited time leading into poorer choices.

10.1007/s10754-020-09293-z.abstractZh: 我们研究了残疾患者在接受康复服务时的选择行为与服务提供者质量之间的关系。这类服务通常患者并不经常使用，因此缺乏相关经验。先前的研究发现，在医疗服务中，患者的选择行为与服务提供者质量之间存在正相关关系。我们通过分析新患者和已有经验患者的选择行为，发现那些被迫更换或主动更换服务提供者的患者，其选择行为更为明确。在分析中，我们将患者选择行为和更换行为的数据与竞争性招标中的服务提供者质量数据相结合，并采用条件Logit选择模型进行建模。研究结果表明，所有患者都更倾向于选择距离较近且服务质量高的服务提供者。研究发现，新患者和主动更换服务提供者的患者，对服务质量的需求最为强烈。这些结果表明，新患者和主动更换服务提供者的患者会更为全面地比较不同的选择方案，而被迫更换服务提供者的患者在有限的时间内做出选择，从而导致较差的选择结果。

abstract.text: Location spillovers are a common theme in real estate and urban economics research, but this is the first test on the relationship between hospital service quality and the demand for proximate medical office space. We hypothesize that hospitals with reputations for high quality service represent an opportunity for physicians, and other service providers, to benefit from reputation spillovers. Further, the reputation benefit is capitalized into the practices' willingness to pay for proximate office locations, thereby driving up the rental rates for nearby space. We find that distance from, and overall quality ranking of the hospital, both independent and in concert, are significantly linked to the base rents. The degradation in rent with distance is significantly greater when the hospital is ranked high in overall service quality, supporting the notion that a rent premium is linked to the high-quality hospital rather than simply an artifact of the neighborhood.

10.1007/s11146-021-09855-z.abstractZh: 区位溢出效应在房地产和城市经济学研究中是一个常见的主题，但这是首次对医院服务质量与附近医疗办公空间需求之间的关系进行实证研究。我们假设，以高质量服务著称的医院为医生和其他服务提供者提供了获取声誉溢价的机会。此外，这种声誉优势会转化为这些机构愿意为附近的办公空间支付更高的租金，从而推高附近空间的租金水平。研究发现，医院的距离以及整体服务质量排名，无论是单独还是共同作用，都与基础租金显著相关。当医院在整体服务质量方面排名较高时，租金随距离下降的幅度更大，这支持了租金溢价与高质量医院相关，而不仅仅是与周边环境相关的现象。

abstract.text: The Mini-ICF-APP is an established instrument in social medicine, especially in the context of work ability assessment. In this study, the 13 capacity dimensions of Mini-ICF-APP were tested for its inter-rater reliability in the context of a vocational training program for persons with chronic and mental health problems in Switzerland. Also, the development of capacity impairments was investigated over the course of the long-term vocational training programs. 61 training reports on chronically ill persons with mental health impairments were collected within a vocational training program in 2018–2019. Capacity impairment of the trainees were assessed at the beginning of the intervention (t0), after three months (t1) and after 6 to 9 months (t2) by a job attendant and a consultant at each of the three time points. Inter-rater reliabilities for each time point have been calculated. Development of capacity impairment over the course of the vocational training were investigated by variance analysis with repeated measurements. The inter-rater reliability increased in all 13 Mini-ICF-APP capacity dimensions over the course from t0 to t2. Spearman correlation in each capacity dimension reached sufficient values (r = 0.55*–0.97**). There was no statistically significant change of capacity impairment over the course of the vocational training. Ten capacity dimensions showed a decreasing tendency, three showed a tendency to improve capacity levels. Through repeated application and training programs the capacity raters seem to be able to improve reliability of their assessments. The phenomenon of slight increase of capacity impairments over the time may be due to the fact that context and rater’s knowledge on participants and context demands changed over the time.

10.1007/s40737-021-00216-w.abstractZh: Mini-ICF-APP是社会医学中一项成熟的工具，尤其适用于工作能力评估。本研究在瑞士针对患有慢性疾病和心理健康问题的人群的职业培训项目中，测试了Mini-ICF-APP的13个能力维度在不同评估者之间的可靠性。同时，还研究了在长期职业培训过程中能力受损的发展情况。2018-2019年间，收集了61份关于患有心理健康问题的慢性病人的培训报告。在干预开始时（t0）、三个月后（t1）以及6到9个月后（t2），由一名工作评估员和一名顾问对受训者的能力进行评估。计算了每个时间点的评估者间可靠性。通过方差分析，研究了职业培训过程中能力受损的发展情况。从t0到t2，Mini-ICF-APP的13个能力维度在评估者间的可靠性都有所提高。每个能力维度的Spearman相关系数达到了足够高的水平（r = 0.55*–0.97**）。在职业培训过程中，能力受损没有显著变化。十个能力维度呈现下降趋势，三个维度则显示出能力水平有所改善的趋势。通过反复的应用和培训计划，评估者似乎能够提高评估的可靠性。能力受损在一段时间内略有增加的现象，可能是由于环境和评估者对参与者及环境要求的了解随时间发生了变化所致。

abstract.text: Economic incentives in the context of a particular type of market failure-asymmetric information (which takes place when quality information relating to treatment is not available to patients before purchasing the treatment)-are highly relevant to the understanding of the lack of clinics' incentives to disclose reliable evidence (relating to treatment quality) in the practice of evidence-based medicine. Based on the case study of the UK in vitro fertilisation (IVF) sector, I show that inadequate quality provision (relating to treatment effectiveness and safety) can be associated with a lack of voluntary disclosure of reliable evidence in the practice of evidence-based medicine. In the absence of sufficient economic incentives on clinics to voluntarily acquire and disclose evidence, I discuss the rationale for legislation requiring mandatory evidence disclosure as a possible mechanism to facilitate the acquisition and revelation of evidence. I do so by drawing evidence from the economic literature relating to the impact of such legislation on firms' quality improvement. Practical implications for implementation are discussed (and illustrated with examples in the context of the UK IVF sector) with the purpose to facilitate the role of regulators in setting the standards for evidence disclosure to improve interpretability of such evidence, together with the role of patients in engaging with clinics and verifying such evidence to improve its reliability and, ultimately, quality of care.

10.1007/s41669-021-00285-4.abstractZh: 在某种市场失灵的背景下，经济激励措施——尤其是信息不对称的情况（即患者在购买治疗服务之前无法获得与治疗效果相关的信息）——对于理解诊所缺乏披露可靠证据的动力具有非常重要的意义。以英国体外受精行业为例，我发现治疗效果和安全性的不足与证据基础医学实践中缺乏自愿披露可靠证据的现象密切相关。在缺乏足够的经济激励措施促使诊所主动获取和披露证据的情况下，我探讨了通过立法要求强制披露证据作为促进证据获取和揭示的一种可能机制。我借鉴了相关经济文献，分析了此类立法对提高企业质量的影响。同时，我也讨论了实施这些措施的实践意义（并以英国体外受精行业的例子为例），旨在帮助监管机构设定证据披露的标准，从而提高证据的可解释性。此外，我还强调了患者在与诊所互动以及验证证据方面的作用，以进一步提升证据的可靠性，最终提高医疗服务的质量。

abstract.text: Burnout among general practitioners (GPs) is a problem in many countries. Research indicates that burnout is less likely to occur among intrinsically motivated employees. Based on self-determination theory, we investigate 1) whether intrinsically motivated GPs are less burned out than their colleagues, and 2) whether the most intrinsically motivated GPs are more likely to burn out when exposed to an external regulatory accreditation programme. General practices in Denmark were cluster randomized to mandatory accreditation in 2016, 2017 or 2018. We measure GPs' intrinsic motivation and burnout levels one and two years into the accreditation process. We use a balanced panel of GPs (n = 846) to estimate mixed effects ordered logit models. We find that GPs with high intrinsic motivation are less burned out than their colleagues. However, the most intrinsically motivated GPs are significantly more burned out when exposed to accreditation compared to their colleagues. We conclude that being intrinsically motivated may not shield from burnout when external regulation is imposed.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2021.01.004.abstractZh: 全科医生的工作倦怠在许多国家都是一个问题。研究表明，具有内在动机的员工不太可能出现工作倦怠。基于自我决定理论，我们研究了两个问题：1) 具有内在动机的全科医生是否比他们的同事更不容易出现工作倦怠；2) 当面临外部监管认证计划时，最具内在动机的全科医生是否更有可能出现工作倦怠。2016年、2017年和2018年，丹麦的全科诊所被随机分配到必须接受认证的不同年份。我们在认证过程开始的一年和两年后，测量了全科医生的内在动机和工作倦怠水平。我们使用一个包含846名全科医生的平衡面板数据，建立了混合效应有序逻辑回归模型。研究发现，具有高度内在动机的全科医生比他们的同事更不容易出现工作倦怠。然而，当面临认证时，最具内在动机的全科医生比他们的同事明显更容易出现工作倦怠。我们的结论是，当外部监管施加时，内在动机并不能有效保护医生免受工作倦怠的影响。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic revealed fundamental problems with the structure of long-term care financing and payment in the United States. The piecemeal system that exists suffers from several key problems, including underfunding, fragmentation across types and sites of care, and substantial variation in payment across states and populations. These problems result in inefficient allocation of resources, limited access to care, substandard quality, and inequities in both access and quality. We propose a new federal benefit for long-term care, most likely as part of the Medicare program. Essential features of this benefit include taxpayer subsidies, along the lines of other Medicare benefits, and coverage across the range of long-term care services, including both residential and home- and community-based care. A new federal benefit has the most potential to break down administrative barriers and improve resource allocation, to ensure adequate payment rates across all states, to expand access to care by spreading risk across the entire Medicare population, and to improve equity by extending coverage to all Medicare beneficiaries who want it. A new federal benefit is politically challenging, requiring bold action by Congress, and entails the risks of administrative challenges and unintended consequences. However, in this case, retaining the status quo remains the far greater risk.

10.1016/j.jamda.2021.11.030.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情揭示了美国长期护理融资和支付结构存在根本性问题。现有的零散体系存在多个关键问题，包括资金不足、不同类型护理机构的分散化，以及各州和不同人群之间的支付差异巨大。这些问题导致资源分配效率低下、护理服务获取受限、服务质量低下，以及获取和服务质量方面的不平等现象。我们建议设立一项新的联邦长期护理福利，这项福利很可能会作为Medicare计划的一部分实施。该福利的核心特征包括纳税人补贴，类似于其他Medicare福利，并且涵盖各种长期护理服务，包括住院护理以及家庭和社区为基础的护理。新的联邦福利最有可能打破行政障碍，改善资源分配，确保所有州都有足够的支付标准，通过在整个Medicare人群中分散风险来扩大护理服务的获取，并通过为所有希望获得该福利的Medicare受益人提供覆盖来提升公平性。然而，设立新的联邦福利在政治上具有挑战性，需要国会采取大胆的行动，并且伴随着行政上的挑战和意外后果的风险。不过，维持现状所带来的风险要大得多。

abstract.text: This study investigates the causal effect of hospital volume on health gains from hip replacement surgery in the English National Health Service. We exploit a unique dataset, which links routine hospital records and patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) for all public hospitals in England between 2011 and 2015. PROMs assess patients’ health along key dimensions of pain and mobility shortly before and six months after the surgery. We investigate whether higher hospital volume increases patient health six months post-surgery, conditioning on severity through an accurate measure of pre-surgery health, other patient medical and socioeconomic indicators and a rich set of hospital characteristics. We address possible reverse-causality bias due to hospital demand being responsive to quality by constructing a measure of predicted hospital volumes based on a patient choice model, in line with approaches adopted in the hospital competition literature. Results from a pooled OLS model show that the observed effect of volume on health outcomes in hip replacement surgery is positive and clinically small, but no longer statistically significant once we account for the endogeneity of volume. Results from an alternative specification with hospital fixed effects further confirm that hospital volume does not have a causal effect on health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jebo.2021.08.014.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了医院诊疗量对英格兰国家卫生服务体系中进行髋关节置换手术所带来健康改善的因果效应。我们利用了独特的数据集，该数据集将英格兰所有公立医院的常规医院记录与患者报告的结果指标（PROMs）进行了关联，时间跨度为2011年至2015年。PROMs在手术前后及手术后六个月，通过关键维度如疼痛程度和行动能力来评估患者的健康状况。我们探讨了在手术前健康状况、其他患者医疗和社会经济指标以及丰富的医院特征条件下，较高的医院诊疗量是否能在手术后六个月增加患者的健康水平。为了应对因医院需求受服务质量影响的反向因果关系偏差，我们基于患者选择模型构建了一种预测医院诊疗量的方法，这与医院竞争领域采用的方法一致。汇总OLS模型的结果显示，医院诊疗量对髋关节置换手术健康结果的效应是积极的且临床意义较小，但在考虑诊疗量的内生性后，这种效应不再具有统计学意义。采用医院固定效应进行替代分析的结果进一步证实了医院诊疗量对健康结果没有因果效应。

abstract.text: As the prevalence of chronic diseases rises, improving self-management has become an important determinant of the productivity of healthcare delivery. Recently, Mexico's largest healthcare provider began issuing automatic-refill prescriptions to stable hypertensive patients, thus reducing the frequency of health monitoring from 30- to 90-day intervals. Exploiting this change, I find that less monitoring implies no drawbacks in health outcomes and actually improves self-management of disease by increasing medication adherence when baseline monitoring is relatively frequent. The number of days when patients are out of medication between fillings falls by 2.2 days-an improvement in adherence of 6.4%. Furthermore, patients appear to value being on a low-frequency regime as they improve adherence in order to remain on it, suggesting that lower monitoring could be used as a "reward" to promote medication adherence or, potentially, other health behaviors. Finally, I find evidence of positive spillovers on adherence, as clinic congestion falls.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102387.abstractZh: 随着慢性疾病的发病率上升，提高自我管理能力已成为提升医疗服务效率的重要因素。最近，墨西哥最大的医疗服务机构开始为稳定的高血压患者提供自动续方服务，从而将健康监测的频率从30天缩短至90天。通过研究这一变化，我发现减少健康监测并不会对健康结果产生负面影响，反而可以通过增加用药依从性来提升疾病自我管理能力，尤其是在基线健康监测频率较高的情况下。患者在补方期间缺药的天数减少了2.2天，用药依从性提高了6.4%。此外，患者似乎更重视采用低频率的监测方式，因为他们会努力保持这种监测方式，这表明较低的监测频率可以作为促进用药依从性或其他健康行为的“奖励”。最后，我发现随着诊所拥堵情况的减少，用药依从性也出现了积极的溢出效应。

abstract.text: Evidence for the effectiveness of population health screenings to reduce the burden of non-communicable diseases in low-income countries remains very limited. We investigate the sustained effects of a health screening in Malawi where individuals received a referral letter if they had elevated blood pressure. Using a regression discontinuity design and a matching estimator, we find that receiving a referral letter reduced blood pressure and the probability of being hypertensive by about 22 percentage points four years later. These lasting effects are explained by a 20 percentage points increase in the probability of being diagnosed with hypertension. There is also evidence of an increase in the uptake of medication, while we do not identify improvements in hypertension-related knowledge or risk behaviors. On the contrary, we find an increase in sugar intake and a decrease in physical activity both of which are considered risky behaviors in Western contexts. The health screening had some positive effects on mental health. Overall, this study suggests that population-based hypertension screening interventions are an effective tool to improve health in low-income contexts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102388.abstractZh: 关于人群健康筛查在低收入国家减少非传染性疾病负担的有效性证据仍然非常有限。我们研究了马拉维一项健康筛查项目的持续效果，该项目中，如果个人血压偏高，就会收到提醒信。通过回归不连续设计和匹配估计方法，我们发现四年后，收到提醒信的人血压和患高血压的概率分别降低了约22个百分点。这些持久效果可以通过患高血压诊断概率增加20个百分点来解释。此外，还有证据表明用药的接受度有所提高，但我们并未发现与高血压相关的知识或风险行为方面的改善。相反，我们发现糖摄入量增加，体力活动减少，而这两者在西方背景下都被视为危险行为。这项健康筛查项目对心理健康也有一些积极影响。总体而言，本研究表明，基于人群的高血压筛查干预措施在低收入国家是改善健康的有效手段。

abstract.text: We examine responses to the ACA subsidy for Marketplace health insurance in the first year of subsidy availability. Drawing on federal tax data and focusing on a notch in the schedule where eligibility is lost, we document that taxpayers lowered their income to remain eligible for the subsidy. The observed bunching is modest relative to the size of the notch, which, consistent with larger responses we detect in additional analyses among certain subgroups, is likely explained by significant optimization frictions. Finally, we find suggestive evidence that increased deductions drive some of the response, while reduced labor supply also plays a role.
