10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102396.abstractZh: 我们研究了在补贴政策实施的第一年，人们对市场健康保险补贴的反应。通过联邦税务数据，并重点关注资格丧失的临界点，我们发现纳税人为了维持补贴资格而降低了自己的收入。观察到的聚集现象相对于资格丧失的幅度来说较为轻微。这一现象与我们在其他分析中发现的某些子群体中的更大反应一致，很可能是由于显著的优化摩擦所导致的。最后，我们发现，增加扣除额是部分导致这种反应的原因，而劳动力供应减少也起到了一定作用。

abstract.text: Drug control policy can have unintended consequences by pushing existing users to alternative, possibly more dangerous substances. Policies that target only new users may therefore be especially promising. Using commercial insurance claims data, we provide the first evidence on a set of new policies intended to reduce opioid initiation in the form of limits on initial prescription length. We also provide the first evidence on the impact of must-access prescription drug monitoring programs (MA-PDMPs), laws that do not target new users, on initial opioid use. Although initial limit policies reduce the average length of initial prescriptions, they do so primarily by raising the frequency of short prescriptions, resulting in increases in opioids dispensed to new users. In contrast, we find that MA-PDMPs reduce opioids dispensed to new users, even though they do not explicitly set out to do so. Neither policy significantly affects extreme use such as doctor shopping among new patients, because such behavior is very rare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102397.abstractZh: 药物管制政策可能会带来意想不到的后果，因为它可能会促使现有用户转向其他、可能更危险的物质。因此，仅针对新用户的政策可能具有特别的前景。利用商业保险理赔数据，我们首次提供了关于旨在减少阿片类药物使用的新政策的证据，这些政策包括限制首次处方的时长。我们还首次提供了关于必须访问的处方药物监测计划（MA-PDMPs）对首次阿片类药物使用的影响的证据，这些法律并不针对新用户。尽管首次处方时长限制政策确实减少了首次处方的平均时长，但它们主要是通过增加短期处方的频率来实现的，从而导致向新用户提供的阿片类药物数量增加。相比之下，我们发现必须访问的处方药物监测计划确实减少了向新用户提供的阿片类药物数量，尽管这些计划并没有明确为此目的而设立。这两种政策都不会显著影响新患者的极端用药行为，因为这种行为非常罕见。

abstract.text: This paper empirically investigates the long-run effects of major health improvements on income growth in the United States. To isolate exogenous changes in health, the econometric model uses quasi-experimental variation in cardiovascular disease mortality across states over time. Based on data for the white population, the results show that there is a causal link between health and income per person, and they provide novel evidence that health dynamics shape life-cycle incomes. Life-cycle income profiles slope more strongly at the beginning and at the end of work life in 2000 than in 1960, indicating that age becomes a more prominent determinant of income dynamics over this period. The channels for this transformation include better health, higher educational attainment, and changing labor supply.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102398.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了重大健康改善对美国收入增长的长期影响。为了分离出健康方面的外生变化，计量经济模型利用了各州之间心血管疾病死亡率的准实验性变化。基于白人人口的数据，研究结果表明健康状况与个人收入之间存在因果关系，并且提供了新的证据，表明健康状况的变化会影响生命周期中的收入。2000年时，生命周期收入在工作的开始和结束时呈现出比1960年更为明显的趋势，这表明在这一时期，年龄成为影响收入动态的一个更为重要的因素。促成这一变化的因素包括更好的健康状况、更高的教育水平以及劳动力供应的变化。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of day-to-day variation in maternity ward crowding on medical procedure use and the health of infants and mothers. Exploiting data on the universe of Danish admissions to maternity wards in the years 2000-2014, we first document substantial day-to-day variation in admissions. Exploiting residual variation in crowding, we find that maternity wards change the provision of medical procedures and care on crowded days relative to less crowded days, and they do so in ways that alleviate their workload. We find very small and precisely estimated effects of crowding on child and maternal health. Thus our results suggest that, for the majority of uncomplicated births, maternity wards in Denmark can cope with the observed inside-ward variation in daily admissions without detectable health risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102399.abstractZh: 本文研究了产科病房日常拥挤程度变化对医疗程序使用以及婴儿和母亲健康的影响。通过利用2000至2014年间丹麦产科病房入院数据，我们首先记录了入院数量的显著日常变化。进一步分析拥挤程度的残差变化后，我们发现产科病房在拥挤日会调整医疗程序和护理服务，以缓解其工作量。我们发现拥挤程度对儿童和母亲健康的影響非常小且估计值非常精确。因此，我们的研究结果表明，对于大多数无并发症的分娩情况，丹麦的产科病房能够应对日常入院数量的波动，而不会对健康造成明显风险。

abstract.text: We use comprehensive administrative data from Rhode Island to measure the impact of early-life interventions for low birth weight newborns. Our analysis relies on a regression discontinuity design based on the 1,500 g threshold for Very Low Birth Weight (VLBW) status. We find that threshold crossing causes more intense in-hospital care, in line with prior studies. In terms of later-life outcomes, we show that threshold crossing causes a 0.34 standard deviation increase in test scores in elementary and middle school, a 17.1 percentage point increase in the probability of college enrollment, and a $66,997 decrease in social program expenditures by age 14.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102400.abstractZh: 我们利用罗德岛州的综合行政数据来衡量对低出生体重新生儿进行早期干预的影响。我们的分析基于1500克这一阈值，采用回归不连续设计。研究发现，跨越这一阈值会导致更密集的住院护理，这与先前的研究结果一致。在后期生活结果方面，我们发现跨越这一阈值会导致小学和初中阶段的测试成绩增加0.34个标准差，大学入学概率增加17.1个百分点，以及14岁时的社会项目支出减少66,997美元。

abstract.text: Modern technology empowers human beings to cope with various extreme weather events. Using Chinese historical data, we examine the impact of extreme weather on long-term human mortality in an environment where individuals had no access to modern technology. By combining life-course data on 5000 Chinese elites with historical weather data over the period 1-1840 AD, we find a significant and robust negative impact of droughts in childhood on the longevity of elites. Quantitatively, encountering three years of droughts in childhood reduces an elite's life span by about two years.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102401.abstractZh: 现代技术使人类能够应对各种极端天气事件。利用中国历史数据，我们研究了在无法使用现代技术的环境下，极端天气对长期人类死亡率的影响。通过结合5000名中国精英的生命历程数据以及公元1至1840年间的历史天气数据，我们发现童年时期遭遇干旱对精英的寿命有显著且显著的负面影响。从数量上看，童年时期遭遇三年干旱会使精英的寿命缩短约两年。

abstract.text: Air pollution has a detrimental impact on population health, but the effectiveness of policy measures targeting pollution is underexplored. I exploit the natural experiment generated by the staggered implementation of low emission zones in large cities across Germany to assess their impact on health. Using register data on outpatient and inpatient health care, I find that low emission zones reduce the number of patients with cardiovascular disease by 2-3%. This effect is particularly pronounced for those over the age of 65. The findings suggest that low emission zones can be an effective way to reduce air pollution and improve health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102402.abstractZh: 空气污染对人群健康有负面影响，但针对污染的政策措施的有效性尚未得到充分研究。我利用德国大城市分阶段实施低排放区这一自然实验，来评估其对健康的影响。通过利用门诊和住院医疗的登记数据，我发现低排放区使心血管疾病患者的数量减少了2-3%。这一效应在65岁以上的人群中尤为明显。研究结果表明，低排放区可以成为减少空气污染和改善健康的有效手段。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of an income-based mandate on the demand for private hospital insurance and its dynamics in Australia. The mandate, known as the Medicare Levy Surcharge (MLS), is a levy on taxable income that applies to high-income individuals who choose not to buy private hospital insurance. Our identification strategy exploits changes in MLS liability arising from both year-to-year income fluctuations, and a reform where income thresholds were increased significantly. Using data from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia longitudinal survey, we estimate dynamic panel data models that account for persistence in the decision to purchase insurance stemming from unobserved heterogeneity and state dependence. Our results indicate that being subject to the MLS penalty in a given year increases the probability of purchasing private hospital insurance by between 2 to 3 percent in that year. If subject to the penalty permanently, this probability grows further over the following years, reaching 13 percent after a decade. We also find evidence of a marked asymmetric effect of the MLS, where the effect of the penalty is about twice as large for individuals becoming liable compared with those going from being liable to not being liable. Our results further show that the mandate has a larger effect on individuals who are younger.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102403.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于收入的强制保险对澳大利亚私人医院保险需求及其动态的影响。这种强制保险被称为医疗保险附加税（MLS），是对高收入个人征收的税项，这些个人选择不购买私人医院保险。我们的研究利用年度收入波动以及收入门槛大幅上调的改革所带来的MLS负担变化，来识别这种影响。通过澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动力动态纵向调查的数据，我们建立了动态面板数据模型，以考虑由于未观察到的异质性和状态依赖性而导致的购买保险决策的持续性。研究结果表明，在某一年度面临MLS处罚时，购买私人医院保险的概率会上升2%至3%。如果这种处罚永久实施，这一概率会在后续几年进一步上升，十年后达到13%。我们还发现MLS具有显著的不对称效应，即对于从负有责任变为无责任的个人来说，处罚的影响大约是负有责任的个人的两倍。研究结果还显示，这种强制保险对较年轻的人群影响更大。

abstract.text: Low-income children are less likely to receive recommended health services than their high-income counterparts. This paper examines whether the design of parental Medicaid benefit packages could serve as a mechanism for reducing income-based disparities in unmet health care needs, considering dental benefits as a case study. Leveraging state-level changes to adult dental benefits over time, I find that coverage is associated with increases of 14 and 5 percentage points, respectively, in the likelihood of a recent dental visit among parents and children directly exposed to the policy. Child effects appear to be concentrated among younger children under age 12.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102404.abstractZh: 低收入儿童获得推荐的健康服务的可能性低于高收入儿童。本文探讨了父母医疗补助计划的设计是否可以作为减少基于收入的医疗需求差异的机制，以牙科福利为例进行研究。通过分析各州成人牙科福利随时间的变化情况，我发现牙科福利覆盖率的提高分别使父母和直接受益于该政策的儿童近期进行牙科就诊的可能性增加了14个百分点和5个百分点。儿童效应似乎主要集中在12岁以下的年幼儿童身上。

abstract.text: Estimates of the benefits of antifraud enforcement in health care typically focus on direct monetary damages. Deterrence effects are acknowledged but unquantified. We evaluate the impact of a Department of Justice investigation of hospitals accused of billing Medicare for unnecessary implantable cardiac defibrillator (ICD) procedures on their use. Using 100 % inpatient and outpatient procedure data from Florida, we estimate that the investigation caused a 22 % decline in ICD implantations. The present value of savings nationally over a 10 year period is $2.7 billion, nearly 10 times larger than the $280 million in settlements the Department of Justice recovered from hospitals. The investigation had a large and long-lasting effect on physician behavior, indicating the utility of antifraud enforcement as a tool for reducing wasteful medical care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102405.abstractZh: 关于医疗领域反欺诈执法带来的效益评估，通常重点关注直接的金钱损失。虽然威慑效应得到了认可，但并未进行量化分析。我们评估了司法部对涉嫌向医疗保险系统虚报不必要的植入式心脏除颤器手术的医院进行调查的影响，以及这一调查对医院使用此类手术的影响。利用佛罗里达州100%的住院和门诊手术数据，我们估计该调查导致植入式心脏除颤器手术数量减少了22%。在10年时间内，全国因该调查而节省的成本为27亿美元，几乎是司法部从医院处获得的2.8亿美元和解金额的近10倍。该调查对医生的行为产生了巨大且持久的影响，这表明反欺诈执法作为减少浪费性医疗服务的手段具有实际效用。

abstract.text: We place an upper bound on the degree to which policies aimed at improving the information deficiencies of patients may lead to greater adherence to clinical guidelines and recommended practices. To do so, we compare the degree of adherence attained by a group of patients that should have the best possible information on health care practices-i.e., physicians as patients-with that attained by a comparable group of non-physician patients, taking various steps to account for unobservable differences between the two groups. Our results suggest that physicians, at best, do only slightly better in adhering to both low- and high-value care guidelines than non-physicians.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102406.abstractZh: 我们确定了旨在改善患者信息不足的政策的上限，这些政策可能带来的临床指南和推荐实践的遵守程度。为此，我们比较了那些拥有最佳医疗实践信息的患者群体——即作为患者的医生——与另一组非医生患者所达到的遵守程度，同时考虑了两组之间不可观测差异的影响。我们的研究结果表明，医生在遵守低价值和高价值护理指南方面的表现，最多只能略优于非医生患者。

abstract.text: Why do individuals engage in self-defeating behaviors like self-harm, addiction, and risky sexual behaviors? Why do they experience the apathy of depression or inaction when trapped by multiple competing problems? We propose a framework for explaining these and other related behaviors based on the insight that individuals can only experience a limited number of latent stimuli to which they are exposed. We conduct an experiment to test this model and find that more than two thirds of the subjects behave consistent with our theoretical framework.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102407.abstractZh: 为什么人们会从事自我伤害、成瘾和危险性行为等自我挫败行为？当面临多重竞争问题时，他们为什么会表现出抑郁或无所作为的冷漠态度？我们提出了一个框架来解释这些行为以及其他相关行为，该框架基于这样一个观点：个体只能接触到有限数量的潜在刺激。我们通过实验来验证这一模型，发现超过三分之二的受试者其行为与我们的理论框架一致。

abstract.text: Although supply-side drug policies that limit access to legal opioids have reduced prescription opioid abuse, growing evidence shows that these policies have had the unintended consequence of increasing use of illegal opioids, including heroin. I add to this literature by studying the consequences of must-access prescription drug monitoring programs (PDMPs), which legally require providers to access a state-level database with a patient's prescription history before prescribing controlled substances under certain circumstances. Using a difference-in-differences specification, I find strong evidence that must-access PDMPs have increased heroin death rates. My estimates indicate that two years after implementation, must-access PDMPs were associated with 0.9 more heroin deaths per 100,000 in a half-year period, relative to control states. My results suggest that even if must-access PDMPs reduce prescription opioid deaths, the decrease is offset by a large increase in illegal opioid deaths.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102408.abstractZh: 尽管限制合法阿片类药物获取的供给侧药物政策减少了处方阿片类药物滥用，但越来越多的证据表明，这些政策产生了意想不到的后果，即增加了非法阿片类药物的使用，包括海洛因。我通过研究必须访问处方药物监控计划（PDMPs）的后果来补充这一研究。该计划要求医疗机构在特定情况下必须访问州级数据库，以获取患者的处方历史信息，从而开具管制药物。利用差异-差异模型，我发现必须访问PDMPs确实导致了海洛因死亡人数的增加。我的估计显示，在实施两年后，与对照州相比，必须访问PDMPs在半年内导致每10万人多发生0.9起海洛因死亡事件。我的结果表明，即使必须访问PDMPs能够减少处方阿片类药物导致的死亡人数，但这种减少被非法阿片类药物死亡人数的大幅增加所抵消。

abstract.text: We build a new database documenting the evolution of physician migration over a period of 25 years (1990-2014), and use it to empirically shed light on its determinants. In relative terms, the highest emigration rates are observed in small island nations and low-income countries, where needs-based deficits of healthcare workers are often estimated to be most severe. Over time, we identify rising trends in Caribbean islands, Central Asia and Eastern Europe. On the contrary, despite increasing migration flows to Western Europe, physician migration rates from sub-Saharan Africa have been stable or even decreasing. Our empirical analysis reveals that physician migration is a complex phenomenon that results from a myriad of push, pull, and dyadic factors. It is strongly affected by the economic characteristics of origin and destination countries. The sensitivity to these push and pull factors is governed by linguistic and geographic ties between countries. Interestingly, we find that the evolution of medical brain drain is affected by immigration policies aimed at attracting high-skilled workers. In particular, physician migration is sensitive to visa restrictions, diploma recognition, points-based system, tax breaks towards migrants, and the option of obtaining a permanent resident status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102409.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个新的数据库，记录了25年（1990-2014年）内医生迁移的演变情况，并利用该数据库从实证角度探讨其决定因素。相对而言，小岛屿国家和低收入国家的医生迁移率最高，这些地区的医疗工作者短缺问题通常最为严重。随着时间的推移，我们在加勒比群岛、中亚和东欧地区发现了迁移率的上升趋势。相反，尽管向西欧的迁移流量不断增加，来自撒哈拉以南非洲的医生迁移率却保持稳定甚至有所下降。我们的实证分析表明，医生迁移是一个复杂的现象，由多种推力、拉力以及双因素共同作用的结果。这一现象受到原籍国和目的地国经济特征的影响。对这些推力和拉力因素的敏感性则受到国家间语言和地理联系的影响。有趣的是，我们发现医疗人才流失的演变受到旨在吸引高技能工人的移民政策的影响。特别是，医生迁移对签证限制、文凭认可、积分制度、对移民的税收优惠以及获得永久居留权的可能性都十分敏感。

abstract.text: I analyze the long-term health impacts of Nepal's 1996-2006 civil conflict. I use information on monthly conflict incidents at the village level, which allows me to identify the effects of exposure to conflict more accurately than prior studies. I exploit the heterogeneity in conflict intensity across villages and birth cohorts to document the impacts on adult stature and intergenerational health. I find that childhood exposure to conflict and, in particular, exposure starting in infancy, negatively impacts attained adult height. Each additional month of exposure decreases a women's adult height by 1.36 millimeters. The impacts are not limited to first-generation - I find that a mother's exposure to conflict in her childhood is also detrimental to her child's health. Mothers exposed to conflict during their childhood have more children and live in less wealthy households, likely reducing their ability to invest during their children's critical period of physical development.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102410.abstractZh: 我分析了尼泊尔1996-2006年内战的长期健康影响。我使用了村级每月冲突事件的信息，这使得我能够比以往的研究更精确地识别冲突暴露的影响。我利用不同村庄和出生队列之间冲突强度的差异，来记录对成人身高和代际健康的影响。我发现，童年时期接触冲突，尤其是从婴儿期开始的接触，会对成年身高产生负面影响。每增加一个月的冲突暴露，女性的成年身高就会减少1.36毫米。这些影响不仅限于第一代人群——我发现，母亲在童年时期接触冲突也会对其孩子的健康产生不利影响。在童年时期接触冲突的母亲通常会有更多的孩子，并且生活在较不富裕的家庭中，这可能降低了她们在子女身体发育的关键时期进行投资的能力。

abstract.text: We study the demand-smoothing incentives for private hospitals to perform c-sections. First, we show that a policy change in Chile that increased delivery at private hospitals by reducing the out-of-pocket cost for women with public insurance increased the probability of a c-section by 8.6 percentage points despite private hospitals receiving the same price for a vaginal or cesarean delivery. Second, to understand hospitals' incentives to perform c-sections, we present a model of hospital decisions about the mode of delivery without price incentives. The model predicts that, because c-sections can be scheduled, a higher c-section rate increases total deliveries, compensating the forgone higher margin of vaginal deliveries. Finally, we provide evidence consistent with the demand-smoothing mechanism: hospitals with higher c-section rates are more likely to reschedule deliveries when they expect a high-demand week.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102411.abstractZh: 我们研究了私立医院进行剖宫产手术的需求平滑激励机制。首先，我们发现在智利的一项政策变化中，通过降低公共保险患者的自付费用，增加了私立医院的分娩数量，这使得进行剖宫产手术的概率增加了8.6个百分点，尽管私立医院提供阴道分娩和剖宫产手术的价格相同。其次，为了了解医院进行剖宫产手术的动机，我们建立了一个不考虑价格激励的医院决策模型。该模型预测，由于剖宫产手术可以预约，较高的剖宫产手术率会增加总分娩数量，从而弥补因阴道分娩而损失的利润。最后，我们提供了与需求平滑机制一致的证据：剖宫产手术率较高的医院在预期需求较高的时期更有可能重新安排分娩时间。

abstract.text: The social value of risk reduction (SVRR) is the marginal social value of reducing an individual's fatality risk, as measured by some social welfare function (SWF). This Article investigates SVRR, using a lifetime utility model in which individuals are differentiated by age, lifetime income profile, and lifetime risk profile. We consider both the utilitarian SWF and a "prioritarian" SWF, which applies a strictly increasing and strictly concave transformation to individual utility. We show that the prioritarian SVRR provides a rigorous basis in economic theory for the "fair innings" concept, proposed in the public health literature: as between an older individual and a similarly situated younger individual (one with the same income and risk profile), a risk reduction for the younger individual is accorded greater social weight even if the gains to expected lifetime utility are equal. The comparative statics of prioritarian and utilitarian SVRRs with respect to age, and to (past, present, and future) income and baseline survival probability, are significantly different from the conventional value per statistical life (VSL). Our empirical simulation based upon the U.S. population survival curve and income distribution shows that prioritarian SVRRs with a moderate degree of concavity in the transformation function conform to widely held views regarding lifesaving policies: the young should take priority but income should make no difference.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102412.abstractZh: 风险降低的社会价值（SVRR）是指减少个体死亡风险的边际社会价值，这一价值是通过某种社会福利函数来衡量的。本文研究了SVRR，采用了一种终身效用模型，该模型根据年龄、终身收入状况和终身风险状况对个体进行区分。我们考虑了功利主义社会福利函数以及一种“优先主义”社会福利函数，后者对个体效用应用了一种严格递增且严格凹形的转换方式。我们表明，优先主义的SVRR为公共卫生文献中提出的“公平进入”概念提供了经济理论上的严谨基础：在年长个体与处于相似状况的年轻个体之间（即具有相同收入和风险状况的个体），即使预期终身效用的增加相同，对年轻个体的风险降低应赋予更大的社会权重。优先主义与功利主义SVRR在年龄、过去、现在和未来的收入以及基线生存概率方面的比较静态特性，与传统统计生命价值存在显著差异。基于美国人口生存曲线和收入分布的实证模拟表明，具有适度凹度的转换函数的优先主义SVRR符合关于救生政策的广泛观点：年轻个体应享有优先权，但收入不应成为决定因素。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of progressive and regressive abortion legislation on women's health in Mexico. Following a 2007 reform in the Federal District of Mexico which decriminalised and subsidised early-term elective abortion, multiple other Mexican states increased sanctions on illegal abortion. We observe that the original legalisation resulted in a sharp decline in maternal morbidity, particularly morbidity due to haemorrhage early in pregnancy. We observe small or null impacts on women's health from increasing sanctions on illegal abortion. These results quantify the considerable improvements in non-mortal health outcomes flowing from legal access to abortion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102413.abstractZh: 我们研究了渐进式与回归式堕胎立法对墨西哥女性健康的影响。2007年墨西哥联邦区对早期选择性堕胎进行非刑事化处理并提供了补贴后，墨西哥其他多个州也加强了针对非法堕胎的制裁。我们发现，最初的合法化措施显著降低了孕产妇的发病率，尤其是妊娠早期因出血导致的发病率。然而，对非法堕胎的制裁增加对女性健康的影响甚微或根本没有影响。这些结果表明，合法堕胎的普及带来了显著的健康改善。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal effects of household income on self-reported health status by exploiting random variations in the amount of lottery prizes won. We find that a S$10,000 (US$7,245) increase in income via lottery wins improves individuals' health by a standard deviation of 0.18. As possible mechanisms, we find that lottery wins increase household consumption spending and improve overall life satisfaction, but do not change healthcare spending, labor supply, and risky health behavior. Previous studies, which focused on the health effects of lottery prizes in Western European countries with strong social safety nets, do not find positive effects other than those on mental health. By contrast, the current study contributes to the literature by providing new evidence of the positive health effect of income via lottery wins in a country without strong social safety nets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102414.abstractZh: 我们通过利用彩票中奖金额随机变化来估计家庭收入对自我报告健康状况的因果效应。研究发现，通过彩票获得10,000瑞士法郎（约合7,245美元）的收入，可使个人的健康状况改善0.18个标准差。作为可能的机制，我们发现彩票中奖会增加家庭消费支出并提高整体生活满意度，但不会改变医疗保健支出、劳动力供给以及风险健康行为。以往的研究主要集中在西欧国家中拥有强大社会保障网的情况下彩票奖金对健康的积极影响，这些研究并未发现除心理健康之外的其他积极影响。相比之下，本研究通过提供新的证据，证明了在没有强大社会保障网的国家中，通过彩票获得收入对健康的积极影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of patient-generated ratings of primary care physicians in Norway. Norway has a universal health care system, with no available objective quality indicators. In May 2012, an online review platform that allows patients to rate their physician was launched. Relying on a difference-in-differences approach we show that higher-rated physicians see an increase in demand relative to lower-rated physicians. The effect is primarily driven by females and patients with high socioeconomic status. We find no indications that physicians change their practice style or supply of patient capacity in response to the ratings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2020.102415.abstractZh: 本文研究了挪威患者对初级保健医生评价的影响。挪威实行全民医疗体系，缺乏客观的质量评价指标。2012年5月，一个允许患者评价医生的在线平台上线。通过差异-差异方法分析发现，评价较高的医生其需求相对增加，这一效应主要由女性患者和高社会经济地位的患者所驱动。我们没有发现医生因评价而改变其执业方式或患者服务能力的情况。

abstract.text: Prices negotiated between payers and providers affect a health insurance contract's value via enrollees' cost-sharing and self-insured employers' costs. However, price variation across payers is difficult to observe. We measure negotiated prices for hospital-payer pairs in Massachusetts and characterize price variation. Between-payer price variation is similar in magnitude to between-hospital price variation. Administrative-services-only contracts, in which insurers do not bear risk, have higher prices. We model negotiation incentives and show that contractual form and demand responsiveness to negotiated prices are important determinants of negotiated prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102423.abstractZh: 支付方与提供方之间协商的价格会通过参保人的费用分摊以及自保雇主的成本来影响健康保险合同的价值。然而，不同支付方之间的价格差异难以观察。我们测量了马萨诸塞州医院与支付方之间协商的价格，并分析了价格差异的特点。不同支付方之间的价格差异与不同医院之间的价格差异在幅度上相似。仅包含行政服务的合同，即保险公司不承担风险的合同，其价格较高。我们对协商激励进行了建模分析，并表明合同形式以及对协商价格的响应程度是决定协商价格的重要因素。

abstract.text: Enrollment in plans with high deductibles has increased more than seven-fold in the last decade. Proponents of these plans argue that high deductibles could reduce wasteful spending by providing patients with incentives to limit use of low-value services that offer little or no clinical benefit. Others are concerned that patients may respond to these incentives by reducing their use of medical services indiscriminately and regardless of clinical benefit, which may negatively impact health outcomes. This study uses individual-level insurance claims data (2008-2013) and plausibly exogenous changes in plan offerings within firms over time to estimate the intent-to-treat and local-average treatment effects of high-deductible plan offerings on spending on 24 low-value services received in the outpatient setting. We find that firm offer of a high-deductible plan leads to a 13.7% ($5.23) reduction in average enrollee spending on low-value outpatient services and a 5.2% ($105.77) reduction in overall outpatient spending. We also find reductions in spending on measures of low-value imaging and laboratory services. We find some evidence that offering high-deductible plans disproportionately reduces low-value spending relative to overall spending, indicating that deductibles may be a way to incentivize value-based decision making.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102424.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，参加高免赔额计划的人数增加了七倍以上。这些计划的支持者认为，高免赔额可以通过激励患者限制使用那些几乎没有临床益处的低价值服务，从而减少浪费性支出。但也有人担心，患者可能会因为这些激励而随意减少医疗服务的使用，而不考虑其临床效益，这可能会对健康结果产生负面影响。本研究利用个体层面的保险索赔数据（2008-2013年），并基于企业内计划提供的变化，估计了高免赔额计划对24种低价值门诊服务的支出影响。研究发现，企业提供高免赔额计划可使平均参保人在低价值门诊服务上的支出减少13.7美元（5.23美元），整体门诊支出减少5.2美元（105.77美元）。我们还发现，在低价值影像检查和实验室服务方面的支出也有所减少。研究还发现，提供高免赔额计划确实能够相对减少整体支出中的低价值支出，这表明免赔额可能是激励基于价值进行决策的一种方式。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of biased health perceptions as a potential driving force of risky health behaviors. We define absolute and relative health perception biases, illustrate their measurement in surveys and provide evidence on their relevance. Next, we decompose the theoretical effect into its extensive and intensive margin: When the extensive margin dominates, people (wrongly) believe they are healthy enough to "afford" unhealthy behavior. Finally, using three population surveys, we provide robust empirical evidence that respondents who overestimate their health are less likely to exercise and sleep enough, but more likely to eat unhealthily and drink alcohol daily.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102425.abstractZh: 本文探讨了偏见的健康认知作为引发风险健康行为的潜在驱动力的作用。我们定义了绝对和相对健康认知偏差，说明了在调查中测量这些偏差的方法，并提供了关于其相关性的证据。接下来，我们将理论效应分解为广延边际和强度边际：当广延边际占主导地位时，人们会错误地认为自己足够健康，可以“负担”不健康的行为。最后，通过三项人口调查，我们获得了稳健的实证证据，表明高估自己健康状况的受访者更可能不运动、睡眠不足，但更可能饮食不健康并每天饮酒。

abstract.text: We analyze the relationship between birth order, parental health investment and children's health using administrative data from Austria. We show that later-born children have better health endowments at birth. They are less likely born preterm or with a low birth weight, and less likely hospitalized for perinatal conditions. We also find significant birth order differences in parental health investment in early childhood. Later-born children are less likely to participate in preventive medical screenings and their vaccine uptake rates are lower. Our analysis indicates that these birth order differences in parental health investments are not driven by children's health endowments. Thus, we do not find evidence for compensatory behavior of parents. We discuss alternative explanations, such as the role of resource constraints. Furthermore, we show, that the initial health inequalities extend into middle childhood. Later-born children show a better health status in school health checks, they consume less medication and are less often hospitalized.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102426.abstractZh: 我们利用奥地利的行政数据分析了出生顺序、父母健康投入与儿童健康之间的关系。研究发现，后出生的儿童在出生时拥有更好的健康禀赋。他们早产或低体重出生的可能性较低，因围产期疾病住院的可能性也较低。我们还发现，在儿童早期，不同出生顺序的父母在健康投入上存在显著差异。后出生的儿童参与预防性医学筛查的可能性较低，疫苗接种率也较低。我们的分析表明，这些出生顺序差异并非由儿童的健康禀赋所驱动。因此，我们没有发现父母采取补偿行为的证据。我们还探讨了其他可能的解释，例如资源限制的作用。此外，我们发现，最初的健康不平等现象会持续到儿童中期。后出生的儿童在学校健康检查中的健康状况更好，他们使用的药物较少，住院次数也较少。

abstract.text: We study where privately insured individuals receive planned MRI scans. Despite significant out-of-pocket costs for this undifferentiated service, privately insured patients often receive care in high-priced locations when lower priced options were available. The median patient in our data has 16 MRI providers within a 30-minute drive of her home. On average, patients bypass 6 lower-priced providers between their homes and their actual treatment locations. Referring physicians heavily influence where patients receive care. The share of the variance in the prices of patients' MRI scans that referrer fixed effects (52 percent) explain is dramatically greater than the share explained by patient cost-sharing (< 1 percent), patient characteristics (< 1 percent), or patients' home HRR fixed effects (2 percent). In order to access lower cost providers, patients must generally diverge from physicians' established referral patterns.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102427.abstractZh: 我们研究了私人保险客户接受计划内MRI扫描的地点。尽管这项无差别服务的自付费用较高，但私人保险患者往往会在价格较低的选择可用时，选择到价格较高的医疗机构接受治疗。我们数据中的患者，在距离其住所30分钟车程范围内，有16家MRI医疗机构可供选择。平均而言，患者在从住所到实际治疗地点之间，会绕过6家价格较低的医疗机构。转诊医生对患者在何处接受治疗有着重要影响。在患者MRI扫描价格差异中，由转诊医生固定效应导致的解释比例高达52%，远高于患者自付费用占比（<1%）、患者特征占比（<1%）或患者家庭收入固定效应占比（2%）。为了获得价格较低的医疗机构，患者通常需要偏离医生既定的转诊模式。

abstract.text: This paper examines how the recent transition of the opioid crisis from prescription opioids to more prevalent misuse of illicit opioids, such as heroin and fentanyl, altered labor supply behavior and disability insurance claiming rates. We exploit differential geographic exposure to the reformulation of OxyContin, the largest reduction in access to abusable prescription opioids to date, to study the effects of substitution to illicit markets. We observe meaningful reductions in labor supply measured in terms of employment-to-population ratios, hours worked, and earnings in states more exposed to reformulation relative to those less exposed. We also find evidence of increases in disability applications and beneficiaries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102430.abstractZh: 本文探讨了阿片类药物危机从处方阿片类药物向非法阿片类药物（如海洛因和芬太尼）滥用趋势的转变，如何改变了劳动力供应行为和残疾保险索赔率。我们利用奥施康定重新配方的地理分布差异，以及迄今为止可滥用处方阿片类药物获取渠道的最大缩减，来研究替代到非法市场的效应。我们发现，在那些更容易受到重新配方影响的州，劳动力供应在就业人口比例、工作时间和收入方面都有显著下降。此外，我们还发现了残疾保险申请和受益人数量增加的证据。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the impact of the length of maternity leave on children's health outcomes in the long-run. My quasi-experimental design evaluates an expansion in maternity leave coverage from two to six months, which occurred in the Federal Republic of Germany in 1979. The expansion came into effect after a sharp cutoff date and significantly increased the time working mothers stayed at home with their newborns during the first six months after childbirth. Using this cutoff date as a source of exogenous variation, I exploit German hospital registry data, which contains detailed information on the universe of inpatients' diagnoses from 1995-2014. By tracking the health of treated and control children from age 16 up to age 35, this study provides new insights into the trajectory of health differentials over the life-cycle. I find that the legislative change generated positive long-term health effects: My intention-to-treat estimates show that children born after the implementation of the reform experience fewer hospital admissions and are less likely to be diagnosed with mental and behavioral disorders.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102431.abstractZh: 本文评估了产假时长对儿童长期健康结果的影响。我的准实验设计评估了1979年德国联邦共和国将产假时长从两个月延长至六个月的改革。该改革在特定的截止日期后生效，显著增加了职业母亲在产后前六个月留在家中的时间。我利用德国医院登记数据作为外生变量的来源，这些数据包含了1995至2014年间住院患者的详细诊断信息。通过追踪从16岁到35岁的受治疗儿童与对照组儿童的健康状况，本研究为生命周期内健康差异的演变提供了新的见解。我发现，这一立法变革产生了积极的长期健康效应：我的处理组估计结果显示，在改革实施后出生的儿童，住院次数较少，且被诊断出患有心理和行为障碍的可能性也较低。

abstract.text: In this paper, I propose a life cycle model of painkiller consumption that combines the theory of health deficit accumulation with the theory of addiction. Chronic pain is conceptualized as a persistent negative shock to lifetime utility that can be treated by pain relief medication. Individuals treated with opioid pain relievers (OPR) develop addiction, which increases their demand for opioids and reduces their welfare and life expectancy through side effects and potential overdose. I calibrate the model for a benchmark American and investigate the comparative dynamics of alternative drug characteristics, pain intensities, and ages of onsets of pain as well as their implications for welfare and life expectancy. Computational experiments are used to identify fully rational and imperfectly rational addiction behavior. Fully rational addicts reduce OPR use when new information about the addictive potential of these drugs arrives. Imperfectly rational addicts further develop their addiction and switch to illicit opioid use. Likewise, a discontinued prescription helps fully rational addicts to quit quickly, while it induces imperfectly rational individuals to take up heroin. I also discuss treatment of OPR addiction and the use of opioids in palliative care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102432.abstractZh: 在本文中，我提出了一个关于止痛药消费的生命周期模型，该模型结合了健康缺陷积累理论与成瘾理论。慢性疼痛被概念化为对终身效用的持续负面冲击，可以通过止痛药来缓解。使用阿片类止痛药治疗的人会发展出成瘾行为，这会增加他们对阿片类药物的需求，并通过副作用和潜在过量风险降低他们的福利和预期寿命。我对该模型进行了针对美国情况的校准，并研究了不同药物特性、疼痛强度以及疼痛发病年龄的对比动态，以及这些因素对福利和预期寿命的影响。通过计算实验，我们识别出完全理性与不完全理性的成瘾行为。当有关这些药物成瘾潜力的新信息出现时，完全理性的成瘾者会减少阿片类止痛药的使用。不完全理性的成瘾者则会进一步发展成瘾，并转向非法使用阿片类药物。同样，停止处方药物的使用有助于完全理性的成瘾者快速戒除成瘾，而会促使不完全理性的个体转而使用海洛因。我还讨论了阿片类止痛药成瘾的治疗问题，以及阿片类药物在姑息治疗中的应用。

abstract.text: We apply a mixed-payer economy model to study the effects of changes in the generosity of children's public health insurance programs - measured by Medicaid and Children's Health Insurance Program income thresholds - on substance use disorder (SUD) treatment provider behavior. Using government data on specialty SUD treatment providers over the period 1997-2011 combined with a two-way fixed-effects model and local event study, we show that increases in the generosity of children's public health insurance induce providers to participate in some, but not all, public markets. Our effects appear to be driven by non-profit and government providers. Non-profit providers also appear to increase treatment quantity slightly in response to coverage expansions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102434.abstractZh: 我们采用混合支付者经济模型来研究儿童公共健康保险计划慷慨程度的变化——以Medicaid和儿童健康保险计划的收入门槛为衡量标准——对物质使用障碍治疗提供者行为的影响。通过利用1997年至2011年间关于特殊物质使用障碍治疗提供者的政府数据，并结合双向固定效应模型和局部事件研究，我们发现儿童公共健康保险计划的慷慨程度提高会促使提供者参与部分而非全部的公共市场。我们的研究发现似乎是由非营利性和政府提供者驱动的。非营利性提供者似乎也会在覆盖范围扩大的情况下略微增加治疗数量。

abstract.text: Road traffic accidents mean lost productivity and medical expenditures. We explain trends in traffic accidents as a function of the political cycle using municipal data from Italy. We show that during municipal election years, the accident rate increases by 1.5%, with a 2% increase in the injury rate but no effect on the fatality rate. The effects are stronger in the quarter prior to the election quarter, when the electoral campaign is at its zenith, and in the second quarter after the election for the new elected mayor. We show that this is the result of a decrease in tickets for traffic violations (rate and revenues) during election years. Our results are robustly driven by the municipal political cycle defined in different ways, and their magnitude and direction are not explained by the spillover effects between municipalities. Proximity to a national police station reduces the impact of local elections on injury rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102435.abstractZh: 道路交通事故会导致生产力损失和医疗支出增加。我们通过使用意大利的市政数据，分析了政治周期对交通事故趋势的影响。研究发现，在市政选举年，事故率会上升1.5%，受伤率则上升2%，但死亡率则没有变化。这种影响在选举季之前的季度最为明显，此时竞选活动达到顶峰；而在新当选市长就职后的第二季度，这种影响则有所减弱。我们认为，这一现象是由于选举年期间交通违规的罚款金额减少所致。我们的研究结果在不同方式下定义的市政政治周期中依然显著，其大小和方向并非由不同市政单位之间的溢出效应所解释。距离国家警察局的距离则有助于减轻地方选举对受伤率的影响。

abstract.text: The effect of high-skill immigration remains central to many US industries and policy debates. Beginning in 2009, the federal government heightened enforcement of existing laws and increased employer fees for the cost of obtaining certain common immigration visas. The change can be viewed as a de facto tax on immigrant labor. I estimate the extent to which high-skill non-citizen workers, in the form of international medical school graduates seeking residency training in US teaching hospitals, are displaced by US citizens who received their medical school training abroad. Changes in immigration policy can have important effects in this labor market with implications for the larger health care system. I find that demand for medical residents among teaching hospitals based on immigration status is highly responsive to increased regulatory cost.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102436.abstractZh: 高技能移民的影响仍然是许多美国行业和政策讨论的核心问题。自2009年起，联邦政府加强了对现有法律的执行力度，并提高了雇主为获取某些常见移民签证所支付的费用。这一变化可以被视为对移民劳动力的一种实际征税。我估计了以国际医学院毕业生在美国教学医院寻求住院医师培训的形式出现的、高技能的非公民工人，被在国外接受医学院培训的美国公民所取代的程度。移民政策的变化可能会在这个劳动力市场上产生重要影响，并对整个医疗保健系统产生连锁反应。我发现，基于移民身份的教学医院对住院医师的需求对增加的监管成本反应非常敏感。

abstract.text: New government health insurance programs may affect participation in existing safety-net benefits that provide health insurance as a secondary aim. We examine whether the outside options for health insurance made available by the Affordable Care Act affected Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) application decisions. Using the universe of U.S. individual income tax records spanning 2007-2016, we first estimate the effect of Medicaid expansions using a state difference-in-differences identification strategy, but find small and statistically insignificant estimates. However, when we estimate the effect of being eligible for high vs. low Marketplace subsidies based on geography, we find some evidence consistent with subsidies increasing DI claiming among those with prior access to Employer Sponsored Insurance, and decreasing DI claiming otherwise. Overall, we find suggestive evidence that outside options for health insurance do matter, though magnitudes are small and results are statistically precise only for Marketplace coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102437.abstractZh: 新的政府健康保险计划可能会影响人们参与现有的安全网福利，这些福利将健康保险作为次要目标。我们研究了《平价医疗法案》提供的健康保险外部选择是否影响了人们申请社会保障残疾保险的决定。利用2007-2016年间美国个人所得税记录数据，我们首先使用州差异识别策略估计了医疗补助扩展的影响，但发现估计值较小且统计上不显著。然而，当我们根据地理位置估计获得高市场补贴与低市场补贴的影响时，我们发现一些证据表明，对于那些之前有雇主赞助保险的人，市场补贴会增加他们申请残疾保险的行为，而对于其他情况则会减少这种行为。总体而言，我们发现有证据表明健康保险外部选择确实重要，尽管影响幅度较小，且结果仅在市场覆盖方面具有统计上的精确性。

abstract.text: This paper uses Danish register data to examine the effect of relative age for grade on women's risky health behavior. I exploit an administrative rule that creates a discontinuous jump in relative age for grade for children born around January 1. Being young-for-grade leads to a higher probability of an abortion and alcohol poisoning in adolescence and earlier births, cohabitation and contraceptive use. The results show how relative age for grade is a determinant of adolescent women's risky sex and heavy drinking. For men, being young-for-grade have no effect on alcohol poisonings, fatherhood and cohabitation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102438.abstractZh: 本文利用丹麦的登记数据，研究年级相对年龄对女性风险健康行为的影响。通过一项行政规定，该规定使得1月1日前后出生的儿童在年级上出现不连续的跳跃。年级相对年龄较小会导致青少年时期流产、酒精中毒以及更早生育、同居和避孕使用的风险增加。研究结果表明，年级相对年龄是青少年女性冒险性行为及大量饮酒行为的一个决定因素。而对于男性来说，年级相对年龄较小并不会影响酒精中毒、成为父亲以及同居行为。

abstract.text: This paper studies non-adherence in the Danish Childhood Vaccination Program using a nationwide introduction of a vaccination reminder letter policy and administrative data from 2011-2017. First, I provide causal estimates of how the reminder letter policy affects vaccination adherence using a Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD). Second, I link parental responses to the reminder letter to parents' causes for being non-adherent. I find that the reminder letter policy positively affects adherence. However, 72% of non-adherent parents are non-responsive to the reminder letter indicating that reluctance and not inattention is the leading cause for non-adherence. Thus, other policies beyond reminder letters - such as mandatory vaccination laws - are necessary to substantially increase vaccination coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102439.abstractZh: 本文研究了丹麦儿童疫苗接种计划中的不遵守行为，通过2011-2017年的全国范围疫苗接种提醒函政策以及行政数据进行了分析。首先，我使用回归不连续设计方法，对提醒函政策如何影响疫苗接种遵守情况进行了因果估计。其次，我将父母对提醒函的回应与他们的不遵守行为原因联系起来。研究发现，提醒函政策对遵守行为有积极影响。然而，72%的不遵守行为的父母对提醒函没有作出回应，这表明犹豫和不注意是主要的不遵守原因。因此，除了提醒函之外，还需要其他政策，如强制性的疫苗接种法律，才能显著提高疫苗接种覆盖率。

abstract.text: We integrate time-inconsistent decision making due to hyperbolic discounting into a gerontologically founded life cycle model with endogenous aging and longevity. Individuals can slow down aging and postpone death by health investments and by reducing unhealthy consumption, conceptualized as smoking. We show that individuals continuously revise their original plans to smoke less and invest more in their health. Consequently, they accumulate health deficits faster and die earlier than originally planned. This fundamental health consequence of time-inconsistency has not been addressed in the literature so far. Because death is endogenous, any attempt to establish the time-consistent first-best solution by manipulating the first order conditions through (sin-) taxes and subsidies is bound to fail. We calibrate the model with U.S. data for an average American in the year 2012 and estimate that time-inconsistent health behavior causes a loss of about 4 years of life. We show how price policy can nudge individuals to behave more healthy such that they actually realize the longevity and value of life planned at age 20.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102440.abstractZh: 我们将由于双曲贴现效应导致的时不一致决策行为纳入了一个基于老年学的生命周期模型中，该模型包含内生性的衰老和长寿因素。个体可以通过健康投资以及减少不健康消费（如吸烟）来减缓衰老和推迟死亡。我们发现，个体会不断调整原本的吸烟计划，增加健康投资。然而，这导致他们更快地积累健康缺陷，并比原计划更早死亡。这种时不一致行为带来的健康后果在现有文献中尚未被提及。由于死亡是内生性的，任何试图通过（负）税收和补贴来操纵一阶条件以建立时一致的最优解的做法都注定会失败。我们使用2012年美国数据对模型进行了校准，估计时不一致的健康行为会导致大约4年的生命损失。我们展示了如何通过价格政策来引导个体采取更健康的行为，从而真正实现在20岁时所计划的长寿和生命价值。

abstract.text: We examine public policy toward the use of genetic tests by insurers when a positive test makes actuarially fair insurance too expensive for some consumers. With state-dependent utility, consumers may decline actuarially fair insurance if the probability of becoming ill exceeds a threshold. In markets with adverse selection, a positive genetic test may cause all or some high risks to drop out of the market (complete and partial genetic discrimination, respectively). Full participation in the market by all consumers requires cross-subsidization. We show that the consent law and mandatory testing are equivalent. Under complete genetic discrimination, the duty to disclose is never Pareto dominated, but either the code of conduct or consent law can yield the same outcome. Under partial genetic discrimination, the duty to disclose is never Pareto dominated. However, partial genetic discrimination and cross-subsidization imply the information ban is noncomparable to the other policy alternatives.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102441.abstractZh: 我们研究了在基因检测结果呈阳性时，保险公司是否应允许消费者选择保险政策。当保险费用对某些消费者来说过高时，他们可能会拒绝接受保险。考虑到状态依赖效用，如果患病的概率超过某个阈值，消费者可能会拒绝保险。在存在逆向选择的市场中，基因检测结果呈阳性可能导致所有或部分高风险消费者退出市场（分别称为完全基因歧视和部分基因歧视）。所有消费者要完全参与市场，就需要进行交叉补贴。我们指出，同意法则和强制检测是等效的。在完全基因歧视的情况下，披露信息的义务从帕累托意义上讲并不占优势，但行为准则或同意法则同样可以达到相同的效果。在部分基因歧视的情况下，披露信息的义务从帕累托意义上讲也不占优势。然而，部分基因歧视和交叉补贴意味着信息禁令与其他政策选择相比并不具有可比性。

abstract.text: This paper examines how time pressure, an important constraint faced by medical care providers, affects productivity in primary care. We generate empirical predictions by incorporating time pressure into a model of physician behavior by Tai-Seale and McGuire (2012). We use data from the electronic health records of a large integrated delivery system and leverage unexpected schedule changes as variation in time pressure. We find that greater time pressure reduces the number of diagnoses recorded during a visit and increases both scheduled and unscheduled follow-up care. We also find some evidence of increased low-value care, decreased preventive care, and decreased opioid prescribing.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102442.abstractZh: 本文探讨了时间压力——医疗提供者面临的一个重要制约因素——对初级保健生产力的影响。我们通过将时间压力纳入Tai-Seale和McGuire（2012年）提出的医生行为模型中，得出实证预测。我们利用了大型综合医疗系统的电子健康记录数据，并将意外的日程变更作为时间压力变化的来源。研究发现，更大的时间压力会减少就诊期间记录的诊断数量，同时增加计划内和计划外的后续护理。此外，我们还发现了一些证据，表明低价值护理有所增加，预防性护理减少，阿片类药物处方也有所减少。

abstract.text: Incentives are used to improve many health-related behaviors, but evidence is mixed for their effectiveness both during the incentivization period and, even more so, on the persistence of the behavior after incentives are withdrawn. In this paper, we present the results of a randomized controlled trial that successfully uses incentives to improve medication adherence among HIV-infected patients in Uganda over 20 months, and follows the sample for another 6 months to measure the persistence of these behavioral improvements. Our study contributes to the literature on habit formation by identifying a behavioral strategy that is associated with persistently high medication adherence after controlling for observable individual-level characteristics and the receipt of incentives. We find evidence supporting a psychological theory of habits as reflexive context-behavior associations, which suggests new ways of designing incentive-based interventions for better promoting persistent, healthier behaviors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102443.abstractZh: 激励措施被广泛用于改善许多与健康相关的行为，但关于其效果的证据并不一致，无论是在激励实施期间，还是更关键的是，在激励措施取消后行为的持续性方面。在本文中，我们展示了一次随机对照试验的结果，该试验成功地在乌干达对HIV感染患者实施了激励措施，以改善他们的药物依从性，时间长达20个月，并在接下来的6个月里继续跟踪样本，以评估这些行为改善的持续性。我们的研究通过识别一种行为策略，为习惯形成理论做出了贡献，这种策略在控制了可观察到的个体层面特征和激励措施的实施后，仍然能够保持较高的药物依从性。我们发现有证据支持一种关于习惯的心理理论，即反射性情境-行为关联，这为设计基于激励的干预措施提供了新的思路，以更好地促进持久且健康的行为。

abstract.text: The past decade has witnessed a new wave of hospital-physician integration, with the fraction of hospitals owning any office-based physician practice increasing from 28% in 2009 to 53% in 2015 nationwide. We offer one of the first hospital-level longitudinal analyses in examining how hospital-physician integration affects hospital prices in the modern healthcare environment. We find a robust 3-5% increase in hospital prices following integration. There is little indication that hospital quality is commensurately higher or that patient mix has changed following integration. Our supplementary analyses point to stronger bargaining leverage and foreclosure of rival hospitals as potential mechanisms for the estimated price effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102444.abstractZh: 过去十年中，医院与医生之间的整合出现了新的趋势。全国范围内，拥有诊所的医院的占比从2009年的28%上升到2015年的53%。我们进行了首次的医院层面纵向分析，探讨医院与医生整合对现代医疗环境中的医院价格的影响。研究发现，整合后医院价格平均上涨了3%至5%。几乎没有迹象表明医院的服务质量有所提升，患者的构成也没有发生变化。我们的补充分析指出，更强的议价能力和竞争对手的医院被排除在外可能是导致价格上升的潜在机制。

abstract.text: Recent studies suggest ridesharing services, such as Uber and Lyft, may reduce instances of intoxicated driving. However, such services may reduce the costs, and thus increase the frequency and intensity, of drinking activity. To examine whether ridesharing affects alcohol consumption, we leverage spatial and temporal variation in the presence of Uber's taxi-like service, UberX, across the United States. Using self-reported measures of alcohol consumption in the past 30 days among individuals aged 21 to 64, we find that UberX is associated with a 3.6% increase in number of drinks per drinking day, a 2.7% increase in drinking days, a 5.4% increase in total drinks, a 4.3% increase in the maximum number of drinks in a single occasion, and a 1.3% increase in those who report drinking any alcohol. For certain groups, such as males, individuals aged 21-34, and students, UberX is associated with even larger increases in drinking. For example, among those aged 21-34, total drinks increase by 7.4% and binge drinking instances increase by 9.5%. We also find that the marginal impact of Uber on drinking is larger in areas that have weaker public transit. Using administrative employment data, we find that some of the additional alcohol consumption is occurring at bars. Specifically, we estimate that UberX is associated with a 3.5% increase in employment and a 3.7% increase in total earnings among workers at NAICS-designated "drinking places".

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102451.abstractZh: 最近的研究表明，像Uber和Lyft这样的拼车服务可能会减少醉酒驾驶的发生。然而，这类服务可能会降低饮酒成本，从而增加饮酒的频率和强度。为了研究拼车服务是否会影响酒精消费，我们利用了Uber的出租车类似服务UberX在美国各地的时空变化数据。通过对21至64岁人群在过去30天内酒精消费情况的自我报告数据进行分析，我们发现UberX与每天饮酒杯数增加3.6%、饮酒天数增加2.7%、总饮酒量增加5.4%、单次饮酒量最大杯数增加4.3%，以及报告饮酒人数增加1.3%有关。对于某些群体，如男性、21至34岁的人群和学生，UberX与更大的饮酒量增加相关。例如，在21至34岁的人群中，总饮酒量增加了7.4%，酗酒行为增加了9.5%。我们还发现，在公共交通较为落后的地区，Uber对饮酒的边际影响更大。通过行政就业数据分析，我们发现部分额外的酒精消费发生在酒吧中。具体来说，我们估计UberX与NAICS分类的“饮酒场所”中工人的就业人数增加3.5%，总收入增加3.7%有关。

abstract.text: The milk addiction paradox refers to an empirical finding in which consumption of non-addictive commodities such as milk appears to be consistent with the theory of rational addiction. This paradoxical result seems more likely when consumption is persistent and with aggregate data. Using both simulated and real data, we show that the milk addiction paradox disappears when estimating the data using an AR(1) linear specification that describes the saddle-path solution of the rational addiction model, instead of the canonical AR(2) model. The AR(1) specification is able to correctly discriminate between rational addiction and simple persistence in the data, to test for the main features of rational addiction, and to produce unbiased estimates of the short and long-run elasticity of demand. These results hold both with individual and aggregated data, and they imply that the AR(1) model is a better empirical alternative for testing rational addiction than the canonical AR(2) model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102452.abstractZh: “牛奶成瘾悖论”指的是一个实证发现，即非成瘾性商品如牛奶的消费似乎与理性成瘾理论相符。当消费行为具有持续性且数据具有总体性时，这种悖论现象似乎更为可能。通过模拟数据和真实数据的研究，我们发现，当使用描述理性成瘾模型鞍点解的AR(1)线性模型来估计数据时，牛奶成瘾悖论就会消失。AR(1)模型能够准确区分数据中的理性成瘾现象与简单的持续性行为，从而能够测试理性成瘾的主要特征，并得出无偏见的短期和长期需求弹性估计值。这些结果在个体数据和总体数据上均成立，这表明AR(1)模型是测试理性成瘾的更好实证替代方案，优于传统的AR(2)模型。

abstract.text: We study the role of person- and place-specific factors in explaining geographic variation in emergency department utilization using detailed data on 150,000 patients who moved regions within Israel. We document that about half of the destination-origin differences in the average emergency department utilization rate across districts translates to the change (up or down) in movers' propensity to visit the emergency department. In contrast, we find no change in the probability of having a hospital admission through the emergency department. Similar results are obtained in a complementary event study, which uses hospital entry as a source of variation. The results from both approaches suggest that supply-side variation in emergency department access affects only the less severe cases-for which close substitutes likely exist-and that variation across emergency physicians in their propensity to admit patients is not explained by place-specific factors, such as differences in incentives, capacity, or diagnostic quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102453.abstractZh: 我们研究了个人和地点特定因素在解释急诊部门使用地理差异中的作用，使用了150,000名在以色列境内迁移的患者详细数据。我们发现，不同地区之间平均急诊部门使用率的变化大约有一半可以转化为迁移者就诊急诊部门的倾向性变化。相比之下，通过急诊部门住院的概率则没有变化。在一项补充的事件研究中，以医院入院情况作为变异来源，也得到了类似的结果。这两种方法的结果表明，急诊部门访问的供应侧差异仅影响那些较不严重的病例——因为这些病例可能存在相近的替代方案，而急诊医生在患者收治倾向上的差异则无法用地点特定因素来解释，如激励措施、容量或诊断质量的差异。

abstract.text: This paper studies the labor market effects of the most significant public health insurance expansion in the Americas: Mexico's Seguro Popular (SP). To identify its impact, I exploit the staggered rollout of SP across municipalities. I find that SP increases labor supply by reducing the likelihood of informal workers exiting the labor market. This reduction is driven by women, who experience a 15% decrease in the probability of transitioning from informal employment to inactivity. I also find that this reduction is concentrated among female secondary earners residing in households with dependents. These findings suggest that SP may operate through a novel channel, namely that health insurance enables caregivers to continue working by reducing health shocks among dependents.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102454.abstractZh: 本文研究了美洲最重要的公共健康保险改革——墨西哥的Seguro Popular（SP）对劳动力市场的影响。为了评估其效果，我分析了SP在不同城市地区的逐步实施情况。研究发现，SP通过降低非正式工人退出劳动力市场的可能性来增加劳动力供给。这一减少现象主要出现在女性群体中，女性从非正式就业转为不工作的概率降低了15%。此外，这种减少现象主要集中在有受抚养人的家庭中的女性中收入较低的家庭成员身上。这些发现表明，SP可能通过一种新颖的机制发挥作用，即健康保险使护理人员能够继续工作，从而减轻受抚养人的健康风险。

abstract.text: We measure the effect of a large nationwide tax reform on sugar-added drinks and caloric-dense food introduced in Mexico in 2014. Using scanner data containing weekly purchases of 47,973 barcodes by 8,130 households and an RD design, we find that calories purchased from taxed drinks and taxed food decreased respectively by 2.7% and 3%. However, this was compensated by increases from untaxed categories, such that total calories purchased did not change. We find increases in cholesterol (12.6%), sodium (5.8%), saturated fat (3.1%), carbohydrates (2%), and proteins (3.8%).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102455.abstractZh: 我们研究了2014年墨西哥实施的大规模全国性税收改革对含糖饮料和热量密集型食品的影响。通过扫描数据，我们记录了8,130户家庭每周购买47,973个商品条形码的购买情况，并采用随机对照设计进行研究。结果发现，从征税饮料和征税食品中获取的热量分别减少了2.7%和3%。然而，这一减少被未征税类别的增加所抵消，因此总热量摄入并未发生变化。此外，我们发现胆固醇（12.6%）、钠（5.8%）、饱和脂肪（3.1%）、碳水化合物（2%）和蛋白质（3.8%）的摄入量都有所增加。

abstract.text: Poor sanitation and its consequent negative health outcomes continue to plague the developing world. Drawing on the finding that financial subsidies have changed behaviour in other health contexts, we conducted a clustered randomised trial in 160 villages in Lao PDR to evaluate the effectiveness of combining financial incentives with Community-Led Total Sanitation (CLTS), a widely-conducted behaviour change program. Villages were randomly allocated to four groups, all of which received CLTS but differed in the type of subsidy offered (none, household, village or both). Using data from a random sample of households with young children and village administrative data, we show that household incentives increased sanitation take-up among the poor, whereas a village incentive increased take-up primarily among the non-poor. Improved sanitation produced positive health spillovers - a 10 percentage point increase in village sanitation coverage decreased the probability of childhood stunting by 3 percentage points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102456.abstractZh: 恶劣的卫生条件及其导致的负面健康后果继续困扰着发展中国家。基于金融补贴能够改变其他健康领域的行为的发现，我们在老挝的160个村庄进行了随机对照试验，以评估将金融激励与社区主导的全面卫生计划相结合的有效性。这些村庄被随机分为四组，每组都接受了社区主导的全面卫生计划，但提供的补贴类型有所不同（无补贴、家庭补贴、村庄补贴或两者兼有）。通过收集有年幼儿童的家庭的随机样本数据以及村庄行政数据，我们发现家庭层面的激励措施增加了贫困群体的卫生设施使用率，而村庄层面的激励措施则主要增加了非贫困群体的使用率。改善卫生条件带来了积极的健康效益——村庄卫生设施覆盖率的提高10个百分点，使得儿童发育迟缓的概率降低了3个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper explores police operations "pacifying" Rio de Janeiro's favelas to estimate if positive shocks of policing affect birth outcomes. Estimates show that pregnancies residing within official "pacification" borders had 0.07 standard deviation better birth outcomes than pregnancies on the same street but giving birth shortly before the police's arrival. Pacification effects concentrate in the third trimester of gestation and are followed by increases in the number of prenatal visits. No evidence of spillovers is found in areas immediately circumventing pacification borders. Hospital-level estimates indicate no impacts on the supply of health services, stress/anxiety among women, or abortions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102457.abstractZh: 本文探讨了警方在里约热内卢贫民窟的“安抚”行动，以评估 policing 的积极影响是否会影响出生结果。研究结果显示，位于官方“安抚”边界内的孕妇，其出生结果比在同一街道上但在警方到达前不久分娩的孕妇要好0.07个标准差。安抚效果主要集中在妊娠的第三孕期，随后产前就诊次数也会增加。在紧邻安抚边界的区域，并未发现溢出效应。医院层面的研究结果表明，这种安抚措施并未对医疗服务供应、女性的压力/焦虑或堕胎率产生任何影响。

abstract.text: For informal caregivers in certain demographic groups, the tradeoff between childcare and informal care may be as significant as the tradeoff between informal care and labor supply. We shed light on this tradeoff empirically, by combining detailed time use data with a natural experiment created by differential access to publicly funded kindergarten across households and states. We find a substantial elasticity between informal care supply and kindergarten access, especially for female carers. In fact, for women, kindergarten access appears to largely increase their care supply rather than labor supply.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102458.abstractZh: 对于某些人口群体的非正式照顾者来说，育儿与非正式照顾之间的权衡可能与非正式照顾与劳动力供应之间的权衡一样重要。我们通过结合详细的时间使用数据以及由不同家庭和州对公共资助的幼儿园教育的差异性获取所创造的自然实验，从实证角度揭示了这一权衡。我们发现，非正式照顾的供给与幼儿园教育的获取之间存在显著的弹性，尤其是对于女性照顾者而言。实际上，对于女性来说，获得幼儿园教育似乎主要增加了她们的照顾供给，而非劳动力供给。

abstract.text: This paper presents findings from an experimental evaluation of the Teen Options to Prevent Pregnancy (TOPP) program, an 18-month intervention that consists of a unique combination of personalized contraceptive counseling, facilitated access to contraceptive services, and referrals to social services. We find that TOPP led to large and statistically significant increases in the use of long-acting reversible contraceptives (LARCs), accompanied by substantial reductions in repeat and unintended pregnancy among adolescent mothers. We provide an exploratory analysis of the channels through which TOPP achieved its impacts on contraceptive behavior and pregnancy outcomes. A back-of-the-envelope decomposition implies that the increase in LARC use can explain at most one-third of the reduction in repeat pregnancy. We provide suggestive evidence that direct access to contraceptive services was important for increasing LARC use and reducing repeat pregnancy. We did not find any spillover effects on non-targeted outcomes, such as educational attainment and benefit receipt.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102459.abstractZh: 本文介绍了对“青少年避孕选择计划”（TOPP）项目的实验性评估结果。该计划是一项为期18个月的干预项目，包含个性化避孕咨询、便捷避孕服务获取以及社会服务转介等特色内容。研究发现，TOPP项目显著增加了长效可逆避孕措施的使用率，同时大幅降低了青少年母亲的重复妊娠和意外妊娠发生率。我们对TOPP项目影响避孕行为和妊娠结果的具体机制进行了分析。初步的分解结果显示，长效避孕措施使用率的提升最多只能解释三分之一的重复妊娠减少现象。我们有证据表明，直接获取避孕服务对于增加长效避孕措施的使用率和降低重复妊娠具有重要意义。此外，我们并未发现其对非目标结果（如教育水平和社会福利获取）有任何溢出效应。

abstract.text: For the vulnerable, even small shocks can have significant short- and long-term impacts. Beneficial shock-coping mechanisms are not widely available in sub-Saharan Africa. We test whether an individual precautionary savings intervention can reduce a shock-coping behavior common in sub-Saharan Africa that has negative spillovers: transactional sex. Among a set of vulnerable women, we randomly assigned an intervention that promoted savings in a mobile banking account labeled for goals and emergency expenses. We find that a majority of individuals adopt the mobile account and the intervention led to reductions in transactional sex as a shock-coping response, and a decrease in symptoms of sexually transmitted infections. Changes are sustained in the medium-term among sex workers, but not among other vulnerable women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102460.abstractZh: 对于弱势群体而言，即使是微小的冲击也可能产生显著的短期和长期影响。在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，有效的应对冲击的机制并不普遍。我们测试了个体预防性储蓄干预措施是否可以减少撒哈拉以南非洲地区常见的、具有负面溢出效应的应对冲击行为——即交易性性行为。在一系列弱势女性中，我们随机分配了一种干预措施，该措施鼓励她们在移动银行账户中储存资金，用于目标和应急开支。我们发现，大多数个体都采用了移动银行账户，该干预措施使得交易性性行为的频率下降，同时性传播感染的症状也有所减轻。这些改变在中期对性工作者仍然有效，但对其他弱势女性则没有这种效果。

abstract.text: We investigate how the prescribing behavior of physicians reacts to scientific information and recommendations released by public authorities. Taking the example of antidepressant drugs, we use French panel data on exhaustive prescriptions made by a representative sample of general practitioners to more than 110,000 depressed patients between 2000 and 2008. New results revealing an increase in suicidal thinking among children taking selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) were reported in 2004 and prompted the release of new guidelines by public health authorities. We identify the effect of this unexpected warning on physicians' drug choices while addressing the possibility that patients heterogeneity may be correlated with unobserved physician characteristics. While the warning decreased the average probability of prescribing SSRIs, we find that physicians' responses to the warning were very heterogeneous and larger if the physician had a higher preference for prescribing SSRIs before the warning.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102461.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生的处方行为如何对公共机构发布的科学信息和建议作出反应。以抗抑郁药物为例，我们使用了法国面板数据，这些数据记录了2000年至2008年间，代表性全科医生为超过110,000名抑郁症患者开具的处方情况。2004年，有新的研究结果指出，服用选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（SSRIs）的儿童中出现了自杀念头增加的趋势，这促使公共卫生机构发布了新的指南。我们分析了这一意外警告对医生用药选择的影响，同时探讨了患者异质性可能与医生未观察到的特征相关的可能性。虽然这一警告降低了开具SSRIs的平均概率，但我们发现医生对警告的反应存在很大差异，如果医生在警告发布前更倾向于开具SSRIs，他们的反应则更为强烈。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of French town hall elections held in mid-March 2020 on the mortality of 163,000 male candidates aged above 60. Their excess mortality during March and April was similar to the general population. We compare candidates in cities with two candidate lists to those in cities with only one list, as elections are more intense in contacts in the former group. We also use a regression discontinuity design and investigate mortality in 2020 depending on how candidates fared in the 2014 election. We cannot detect any causal effect of active participation in the 2020 elections on mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102462.abstractZh: 我们估计了2020年3月中旬举行的法国市政选举对16.3万名60岁以上男性候选人的死亡率的影响。他们在3月和4月的超额死亡率与普通人群相似。我们比较了拥有两个候选人名单的城市中的候选人与仅有一个候选人名单的城市中的候选人，因为前者在选举过程中的接触更为频繁。我们还采用了回归不连续设计，根据候选人在2014年选举中的表现来研究2020年的死亡率。我们没有发现积极参与2020年选举对死亡率有任何因果效应。

abstract.text: Self-assessed health (SAH) is often used in health econometric models as the key explanatory variable or as a control variable. However, there is evidence questioning its test-retest reliability, with up to 30% of individuals changing their response. Building on recent advances in the econometrics of misclassification, we develop a way to consistently estimate and account for misclassification in reported SAH by using data from a large representative longitudinal survey where SAH was elicited twice. From this we gain new insights into the nature of SAH misclassification and its potential for biasing health econometric estimates. The results from applying our approach to nonlinear models of long-term mortality and chronic morbidities reveal that there is substantial heterogeneity in misclassification patterns. We find that adjusting for misclassification is important for estimating the impact of SAH. For other explanatory variables of interest, we find significant but generally small changes to their estimates when SAH misclassification is ignored.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102463.abstractZh: 自我评估健康状况（SAH）常被用作健康经济计量模型中的关键解释变量或控制变量。然而，有证据表明其重测信度存在疑问，高达30%的受访者会更改其回答。基于近期在误分类经济计量学领域的研究进展，我们提出了一种方法，通过利用一项大型代表性纵向调查的数据来一致地估计和解释SAH的误分类情况。该调查对SAH进行了两次调查。由此，我们对SAH误分类的本质及其对健康经济计量估计的潜在偏差有了新的认识。将我们的方法应用于长期死亡率和慢性疾病的非线性模型后，我们发现误分类模式存在显著的异质性。我们发现，调整误分类对估计SAH的影响非常重要。对于其他感兴趣的解释变量，我们发现当忽略SAH的误分类时，其估计值会有显著但一般较小的变化。

abstract.text: Nonmedical exemptions from school-entry vaccine mandates are receiving increased policy and public health scrutiny. This paper examines how expanding the availability of exemptions influences vaccination rates in early childhood and academic achievement in middle school. We leverage 2003 legislation that granted personal belief exemptions (PBE) in Texas and Arkansas, two states that previously allowed exemptions only for medical or religious regions. We find that PBE decreased vaccination coverage among Black and low-income preschoolers by 16.1% and 8.3%, respectively. Furthermore, we find that those cohorts affected by the policy change in early childhood performed less well on standardized tests of academic achievement in middle school. Estimated effects on test scores were largest for Black students and economically disadvantaged students.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102464.abstractZh: 非医疗理由的入学疫苗强制要求正在受到政策和公共卫生方面的更多关注。本文探讨了扩大豁免范围对幼儿疫苗接种率以及中学学业成绩的影响。我们参考了2003年的立法，该立法在德克萨斯州和阿肯色州允许基于个人信仰的豁免，这两个州此前仅允许基于医疗或宗教原因的豁免。研究发现，基于个人信仰的豁免使黑人和低收入幼儿的疫苗接种覆盖率分别下降了16.1%和8.3%。此外，我们发现，受这一政策变化影响的幼儿群体在中学的学业成绩测试中表现较差。估计的影响在黑人学生和经济条件较差的学生中最为显著。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of indoor face mask mandates and other non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPI) on COVID-19 case growth in Canada. Mask mandate introduction was staggered from mid-June to mid-August 2020 in the 34 public health regions in Ontario, Canada's largest province by population. Using this variation, we find that mask mandates are associated with a 22 percent weekly reduction in new COVID-19 cases, relative to the trend in absence of mandate. Province-level data provide corroborating evidence. We control for mobility behaviour using Google geo-location data and for lagged case totals and case growth as information variables. Our analysis of additional survey data shows that mask mandates led to an increase of about 27 percentage points in self-reported mask wearing in public. Counterfactual policy simulations suggest that adopting a nationwide mask mandate in June could have reduced the total number of diagnosed COVID-19 cases in Canada by over 50,000 over the period July-November 2020. Jointly, our results indicate that mandating mask wearing in indoor public places can be a powerful policy tool to slow the spread of COVID-19.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102475.abstractZh: 我们估算了室内口罩强制令及其他非药物干预措施对加拿大COVID-19病例增长的影响。在加拿大人口最多的省份安大略省，口罩强制令的实施时间从2020年6月中旬逐步推迟至8月中旬。通过这种时间上的差异，我们发现口罩强制令使每周的新增COVID-19病例减少了22%，这一效果与没有强制令的情况相比更为显著。省级数据也提供了类似的证据。我们使用谷歌地理定位数据来控制移动行为，并将病例总数和病例增长作为信息变量。对额外调查数据的分析表明，口罩强制令导致公众自我报告的佩戴口罩率增加了约27个百分点。反事实政策模拟显示，如果在2020年6月全国范围内实施口罩强制令，那么2020年7月至11月期间，加拿大确诊的COVID-19病例总数可以减少超过50,000例。综上所述，我们的研究结果表明，在室内公共场所强制佩戴口罩是一种有效的政策工具，可以减缓COVID-19的传播。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the willingness to pay for reductions in health risks within a framework of anticipated regret. We show that ex post information provision can be a relevant factor for regret theory to account for why people are sometimes so inclined to protect themself against certain types of health risks but not others. In particular, we find that under full resolution of uncertainty disproportionate aversion to large regrets exaggerates willingness to pay estimates. The effect induced by this notion of regret aversion can be interpreted as if regret-averse people overweight risk reductions due to prevention. However, as feedback over forgone acts is missing, the regret aversion effect disappears. Finally, we show that information avoidance induced by regret aversion can significantly bias our evaluation to prefer those health programs that completely eliminate a risk, i.e., the certainty effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102476.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了在预期后悔的框架下，人们愿意为降低健康风险而支付的费用。我们发现，事后信息的提供是后悔理论解释人们为何有时倾向于保护自己免受某些类型健康风险而忽视其他类型风险的一个相关因素。具体而言，我们发现，在不确定性完全解决的情况下，对巨大后悔的不成比例厌恶会夸大人们愿意支付的费用估计。这种后悔厌恶效应可以被解释为，后悔厌恶的人会高估通过预防措施所能降低的风险。然而，由于缺乏关于放弃行为的反馈，这种后悔厌恶效应会消失。最后，我们表明，由后悔厌恶引起的信息回避可能会显著影响我们的评估，使我们更倾向于选择那些能够完全消除风险的健康项目，即确定性效应。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of changes in public long-term care spending on the use of public hospitals among the older population in England. Mean per-person long-term care spending fell by 31% between 2009/10 and 2017/18, but cuts varied considerably geographically. We instrument public long-term care spending with predicted spending based on historical national funding shares and national spending trends. We find that reductions in public long-term care spending led to substantial increases in the number of emergency department (ED) visits made by patients aged 65 and above, explaining between a quarter and a half of the growth in ED use among this population over this period, and to an increase in the share of patients revisiting the ED within seven days. However, there was no impact on wider use of inpatient or outpatient services (which are more expensive to provide), and consequently little impact on overall hospital costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102477.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共长期护理支出变化对英格兰老年人口使用公立医院的影响。2009/10年度至2017/18年度期间，人均长期护理支出下降了31%，但各地降幅差异显著。我们通过基于历史国家资金分配比例和国家支出趋势预测的支出数据，来量化公共长期护理支出变化的影响。研究发现，公共长期护理支出的减少导致65岁及以上患者到急诊科就诊的次数显著增加，这一因素解释了该年龄段人群急诊科使用率增长的四分之一到一半，并导致患者在七天内再次就诊的比例上升。然而，这并未对住院或门诊服务的整体使用产生影响（因为这些服务成本更高），因此对整个医院成本的影响也较小。

abstract.text: We investigate the heterogeneous effects of particle pollution on Italian daily hospitalizations and their costs by exploiting public transportation strikes as plausibly-exogenous shocks in pollution exposure. We find that a one standard deviation increase in PM 10 causes additional 0.79 hospitalizations per 100,000 residents, and the effect is stronger for the elderly, low educated individuals and migrants. Furthermore, we find that young individuals, an arguably healthy age group, exhibit economically meaningful responses to air pollution with an effect ranging between 0.45 and 1.04. Our results imply a large role of avoidance behavior driving heterogeneous marginal health effects. Total daily costs of a one standard deviation increase in PM 10 represent 0.5% of the total daily health expenditure, and 85% of this additional spending comes from more patients hospitalized, while the remaining 15% can be attributable to more costly, and likely more complex, hospitalizations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102478.abstractZh: 我们研究了颗粒物污染对意大利每日住院人数及其成本的异质影响，通过将公共交通罢工视为污染暴露的可信外生冲击。研究发现，PM 10浓度增加一个标准差会导致每10万居民额外增加0.79次住院，且这一影响在老年人、教育程度较低的人群以及移民中更为显著。此外，我们发现年轻人群作为健康年龄组，对空气污染表现出具有经济意义的反应，其影响范围在0.45到1.04之间。我们的结果表明，避免行为在驱动这些异质健康效应中起着重要作用。PM 10浓度增加一个标准差所带来的每日总成本占每日健康总支出的0.5%，其中85%的额外支出来自更多患者住院，而剩余的15%则可能归因于更昂贵且更复杂的住院治疗。

abstract.text: Over the past decade, large-scale HIV antiretroviral therapy (ART) programs have proven hugely successful in improving the life expectancy of people living with HIV. However, the extent to which treatment allows patients to maintain a productive work life remains an open question. We applied an instrumental variable method based on individual CD4 counts and exogenously changing treatment guidelines to identify the causal effect of ART on health-related absenteeism rates among workers living with HIV. We used monthly data from the occupational health program of one of the world's largest mining companies in South Africa (128,052 observations among 1,924 workers, from 2009 to 2017). Eighteen months after ART initiation, the treatment significantly reduced absenteeism by 1.033 days per worker and month. Using publicly available wage and treatment cost data, we find that the cost savings due to the absenteeism effect of ART alone outweigh treatment costs in the mining sector in several sub-Saharan African countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102479.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，大规模的抗逆转录病毒疗法项目在提高HIV感染者的预期寿命方面取得了巨大成功。然而，治疗在多大程度上能够帮助患者维持富有成效的工作生活，仍然是一个未解之谜。我们采用了基于个体CD4计数和外部变化的治疗指南的工具变量方法，来研究抗逆转录病毒疗法对HIV感染者工作相关缺勤率的影响。我们使用了南非一家大型矿业公司职业健康项目的月度数据（2009年至2017年间，1,924名工人，共128,052个观测值）。在开始抗逆转录病毒疗法十八个月后，治疗显著减少了每位工人每月1.033天的缺勤情况。通过公开可用的工资和治疗成本数据，我们发现，在几个撒哈拉以南非洲国家，仅由于抗逆转录病毒疗法带来的缺勤节省所带来的成本收益，就超过了该行业的治疗成本。

abstract.text: Recent increases in vaccine-preventable diseases have led policymakers to reconsider the scope of vaccine requirement exemptions. Yet eliminating these provisions is politically difficult. Beginning in 2009, sixth grade girls in Washington, DC were required to receive the HPV vaccine or submit a one-time opt-out form. In 2014, the requirement was expanded to all students grades 6-12, and those not vaccinating were required to opt-out annually. I show that the movement from a one-time opt-out provision to an annual requirement increased the probability that teen girls in Washington, DC initiated HPV vaccination by 11 percentage points. Teen boys were 20 percentage points more likely to be vaccinated. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest 7 fewer cases of cervical cancer and 41 fewer cases of oropharyngeal cancer for the 33,000 enrolled during the 2017/2018 year. Using the initial value of cancer care and the value of a statistical life year, my estimates imply nearly $36 million in savings compared to $1.5 million spent on vaccination. In generalizing these results to other states, effect sizes even one-tenth the size of my most conservative estimate would imply meaningful reductions in the nationwide incidence of HPV-related cancers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102480.abstractZh: 近期，一些可通过疫苗预防的疾病发病率上升，促使政策制定者重新考虑疫苗接种豁免的适用范围。然而，取消这些规定在政治上存在困难。自2009年起，华盛顿特区的六年级女生被要求接种HPV疫苗，否则需要填写一次性的退出表格。2014年，这一要求扩展到所有6至12年级的学生，未接种疫苗的学生每年都需要选择退出接种。研究表明，从一次性退出改为年度接种要求后，华盛顿特区的少女接种HPV疫苗的概率增加了11个百分点。男童接种率则增加了20个百分点。粗略计算显示，在2017/2018年度，33,000名学生中，宫颈癌和口咽癌的病例分别减少了7例和41例。根据癌症治疗的初始成本和统计上一年的生命价值计算，与疫苗费用相比，这一措施可节省近3600万美元。如果将这些结果推广到其他州，即使效果大小仅为我最保守估计的十分之一，也能显著减少全国范围内与HPV相关的癌症发病率。

abstract.text: Researchers have found that machine learning methods are typically better at prediction than econometric models when the choice environment is stable. We study hospital demand models, and evaluate the relative performance of machine learning algorithms when the choice environment changes substantially due to natural disasters that closed previously available hospitals. While machine learning algorithms outperform traditional econometric models in prediction, the gain they provide shrinks when patients' choice sets are more profoundly affected. We show that traditional econometric methods provide important additional information when there are major changes in the choice environment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102481.abstractZh: 研究人员发现，在选择环境稳定的情况下，机器学习方法在预测方面通常优于计量经济模型。我们研究了医院需求模型，并评估了在因自然灾害导致先前可用的医院关闭时，机器学习算法在变化较大的选择环境中的相对表现。虽然机器学习算法在预测方面优于传统的计量经济模型，但当患者的选择集受到更深远的影响时，它们带来的优势就会减弱。我们表明，在选择环境发生重大变化时，传统的计量经济方法能够提供重要的额外信息。

abstract.text: The 2010 Patient Protection & Affordable Care Act (ACA) significantly expanded access to private and public health insurance for low-income individuals through income-based subsidies and income-based eligibility expansions, respectively. In this paper, we use the universe of hospitals from 2009 to 2015 to characterize how these expansions affected the financing of hospital visits, along with price, utilization, and potential spillovers in the quality of care. The insurance coverage expansions generated a shift in the composition of payers and a modest increase in the utilization of hospital outpatient services. While concerns have been raised that these shifts in utilization could cause negative spillovers to the already insured population (e.g., Medicare enrollees), we find no significant change in the quality of care experienced by those already insured. The primary result of both federally funded insurance expansions was to increase the profits generated and prices charged by the hospitals providing such services.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102482.abstractZh: 2010年《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》通过基于收入的补贴和扩大收入资格范围，显著增加了低收入人群获得私人及公共健康保险的机会。本文以2009至2015年的医院数据为基础，分析了这些政策变化对医院就诊融资方式的影响，以及价格、就诊率以及护理质量潜在的影响。保险覆盖范围的扩大导致了支付方的结构变化，并略微增加了医院门诊服务的使用率。尽管有人担心这些使用率的变化可能会对已投保人群（如Medicare参保者）产生负面影响，但我们发现，已投保人群所享受的护理质量并未发生显著变化。这两项联邦资助保险政策的扩展主要带来了提供此类服务的医院利润和收费价格的上升。

abstract.text: This paper exploits the randomized research design of a large welfare program-PROGRESA-to study the existence in rural Mexico of spillover effects in the propensity to screen for gender- and non-gender-specific conditions. I find significant evidence of increased demand for Papanicolaou cervical-cancer screening among women ineligible for the Conditional Cash Transfer, yet no evidence of similar externalities in non-gender specific tests, such as blood-pressure and blood-sugar checks. Certain pieces of evidence are suggestive of the weakening of the social norm related to husbands' opposition to screening of their wives as one of the possible drivers of the indirect effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102483.abstractZh: 本文利用大型福利项目PROGRESA的随机研究设计，探讨墨西哥农村地区在性别及非性别特定条件筛查方面的溢出效应是否存在。研究发现，对于无法享受有条件现金转移的女性来说，对巴帕尼科拉乌宫颈癌筛查的需求显著增加，但并未发现类似的非性别特定检查（如血压和血糖检测）存在类似的外部性。某些证据表明，丈夫反对妻子接受筛查的社会规范可能是导致这种间接效应减弱的一个因素。

abstract.text: Hospital 'report cards' policies involve governments publishing information about hospital quality. Such policies often aim to improve hospital quality by stimulating competition between hospitals. Previous empirical literature lacks a comprehensive theoretical framework for analysing the effects of report cards. We model a report card policy in a market where two hospitals compete for patients on quality under regulated prices. The report card policy improves the accuracy of the quality signal observed by patients. Hospitals may improve their published quality scores by costly quality improvement or by selecting healthier patients to treat. We show that increasing information through report cards always increases quality and only sometimes induces selection. Report cards are more likely to increase patient welfare when quality scores are well risk-adjusted, where the cost of selecting patients is high, and the cost of increasing quality is low.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102484.abstractZh: 医院“报告卡”政策涉及政府发布关于医院质量的信息。此类政策通常旨在通过促进医院之间的竞争来提高医院质量。以往的实证文献缺乏分析报告卡效应的全面理论框架。我们在一个市场中模拟了报告卡政策，该市场中有两家医院在受监管的价格下竞争患者。报告卡政策提高了患者所观察到质量信号的准确性。医院可以通过昂贵的品质改进或选择更健康的病人来治疗来提高其公布的质量评分。我们表明，通过报告卡增加信息总是能提升质量，并且只有在某些情况下才会引发选择行为。当质量评分经过充分的风险调整，且选择病人的成本较高，而提升质量的成本较低时，报告卡更有可能提高患者的福利。

abstract.text: Cigarette smokers earn significantly less than nonsmokers, but the magnitude of the smoking wage gap and the pathways by which it originates are unclear. Proposed mechanisms often focus on spot differences in employee productivity or employer preferences, neglecting the dynamic nature of human capital development and addiction. In this paper, we formulate a dynamic model of young workers as they transition from schooling to the labor market, a period in which the lifetime trajectory of wages is being developed. We estimate the model with data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, 1997 Cohort, and we simulate the model under counterfactual scenarios that isolate the contemporaneous effects of smoking from dynamic differences in human capital accumulation and occupational selection. Results from our preferred model, which accounts for unobserved heterogeneity in the joint determination of smoking, human capital, labor supply, and wages, suggest that continued heavy smoking in young adulthood results in a wage penalty at age 30 of 15.9% and 15.2% for women and men, respectively. These differences are much smaller than the raw difference in means in wages at age 30. We show that the contemporaneous effect of heavy smoking net of any life-cycle effects explains 62.9% of the female smoking wage gap but only 20.4% of the male smoking wage gap.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102485.abstractZh: 吸烟者的收入明显低于不吸烟者，但吸烟导致的工资差距的具体程度以及其产生机制尚不明确。现有的研究机制往往集中在员工生产力或雇主偏好的差异上，而忽视了人力资本发展和成瘾行为的动态特性。在本文中，我们构建了一个动态模型，模拟年轻工人在从学校到劳动力市场的过渡期间工资轨迹的变化。我们使用1997年青年纵向调查的数据来估计该模型，并在反事实情景下模拟模型，以分离吸烟对工资的影响与人力资本积累和职业选择动态差异的影响。我们的模型考虑了吸烟、人力资本、劳动力供给和工资共同决定的未观测异质性，结果表明，在年轻成年期持续大量吸烟会导致女性在30岁时面临15.9%的工资损失，男性则为15.2%的工资损失。这些差异远小于30岁时工资平均值的原始差异。我们的研究表明，扣除生命周期效应后，吸烟对工资的即时影响可以解释女性吸烟工资差距的62.9%，而男性吸烟工资差距的解释比例仅为20.4%。

abstract.text: We leverage the onset of type 1 diabetes (T1D) in childhood to estimate the impact of a childhood health shock on parental labor supply. T1D is the second most common childhood chronic physical health condition, inheritability is low, the exact cause is unknown, the onset is unpredictable, and receiving treatment is crucial to survival. Using Danish administrative registry data with both an event study and difference-in-differences analysis shows that mothers shift to part-time work, marginally shift from the private to public sector, and experience a long-term 4-5% decrease in wage income. The dynamic effects reveal large initial impacts, but the magnitudes decrease (although are not eliminated) over time. Fathers do not experience any long-term reduction in wage income. This suggests part of the motherhood penalty is likely due to mothers bearing the economic burden when their child is diagnosed with a chronic health condition.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102486.abstractZh: 我们利用1型糖尿病在儿童时期发病的特点，来估算儿童健康危机对父母劳动力供应的影响。1型糖尿病是儿童时期第二常见的慢性身体疾病，其遗传性较低，确切病因不明，发病时间难以预测，因此治疗对生存至关重要。通过丹麦行政登记数据进行的事件研究和差异-差异分析表明，母亲们会转向兼职工作，从私营部门转向公共部门，并且工资收入会长期减少4-5%。动态效应显示，初期影响较大，但随着时间的推移，影响幅度逐渐减小（尽管并未完全消失）。父亲们则没有经历工资收入的长期减少。这表明，母亲角色带来的经济负担可能是导致母亲收入减少的部分原因。
