abstract.text: Reducing drink drive limits is generally regarded an effective strategy to save lives on the road. Using several new administrative data sources, we evaluate the effect of a stricter limit introduced in Scotland in 2014. This reduction had no effect on drink driving and road collisions. Estimates from a supply-of-offenses function suggests that the reform did not have much ex-ante scope for sizeable effects. The unavailability of cheaper alternative means of transportation and weak law enforcement seem to have been the main channels behind the lack of an impact. We find no externality on a wide range of domains, from alcohol consumption to criminal activities other than drink driving.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102487.abstractZh: 降低酒驾限制通常被视为拯救道路生命的有效策略。通过利用多个新的行政数据来源，我们评估了2014年苏格兰引入更严格限制措施的效果。这一限制措施对酒驾和道路碰撞事件并没有产生显著影响。根据“犯罪供应函数”的估计，该改革在事前并没有产生显著效果。缺乏更便宜的替代交通方式以及薄弱的执法力度似乎是缺乏效果的主要原因。我们在从酒精消费到除酒驾之外的其他犯罪活动等多个领域均未发现外部性影响。

abstract.text: This paper empirically investigates how competition affects physicians' opportunistic behavior in the context of the utilization of MRI scanners. We examine micro-panel data on Japanese hospitals, where we observe how physicians change their usage of MRI scanners in response to MRI adoption by nearby hospitals. We identify competition-driven physician-induced demand: Hospitals lose patients because of MRI adoption by nearby hospitals, and, to compensate for this loss, physicians perform more MRI scans per patient. Although competition may benefit consumers through better access to MRI scanners, it also causes additional physician-induced demand.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102488.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究探讨了竞争如何影响医生在MRI扫描仪使用情境下的机会主义行为。我们分析了日本医院的微观面板数据，观察医生如何因附近医院采用MRI技术而调整其MRI扫描仪的使用方式。我们发现，竞争驱动了医生的需求变化：由于附近医院采用MRI技术，医院失去了患者，为了弥补这一损失，医生为患者进行的MRI扫描次数增加。尽管竞争可能通过改善对MRI扫描仪的获取途径使消费者受益，但它也会引发额外的医生需求。

abstract.text: Social programs and mandates are usually studied in isolation, but unintended spillovers to other areas can impact individual behavior and social welfare. We examine the presence of spillovers from health care policy to the education sector by studying how health insurance coverage affects the education of students with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). We leverage a state mandate that increased insurance coverage of ASD-related services, which often are provided by both the private sector and within public schools. The mandate primarily affected coverage for children with private health insurance, so we proxy for private insurance coverage with students' economic disadvantage status and estimate effects via triple-differences. While we find little change in ASD identification, the mandate crowds-out special education supports for students with ASD. A lack of short-run impact on achievement supports our crowd-out interpretation and indicates that the mandate had little net effect on the academic achievement of ASD students.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102489.abstractZh: 社会项目和强制政策通常单独进行研究，但它们可能无意中对其他领域产生影响，进而改变个人行为和社会福利。我们通过研究医疗保险覆盖对自闭症谱系障碍学生教育的影响，来探讨医疗保健政策对其他领域的溢出效应。我们利用了一项州级强制政策，该政策增加了与自闭症谱系障碍相关的服务的保险覆盖，这些服务通常由私营部门和公立学校提供。该政策主要影响拥有私人健康保险的儿童的保险覆盖情况，因此我们用学生的经济劣势状况来替代私人保险覆盖，并通过三重差分法估计效应。虽然我们发现自闭症谱系障碍的识别率几乎没有变化，但该政策导致了对自闭症谱系障碍学生的特殊教育支持减少。缺乏对学业成绩的短期影响支持了我们的“排斥”解释，表明该政策对自闭症谱系障碍学生的学业成绩几乎没有净影响。

abstract.text: We present evidence on the impacts of a large-scale iodine supplementation program in Tanzania on individuals' long-term economic outcomes. Exploiting the timing and location of the intervention, we document that in utero exposure to the program increased completed years of education and income scores in adulthood. We find no increase in total employment, but a significant change in the occupational structure. Cohorts exposed to the program are less likely to work in agricultural self-employment and more likely to hold skilled jobs that typically demand higher levels of education. Together, these results demonstrate that iodine deficiency can have long-run implications for occupational choices and labor market incomes in low-income regions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102490.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于坦桑尼亚一项大规模碘补充计划对个体长期经济成果影响的证据。通过研究干预措施的实施时间和地点，我们发现，在胎儿时期接触该计划后，个体完成的教育年限和成年后的收入得分都有所增加。我们没有发现总就业人数的增加，但职业结构发生了显著变化。参与该计划的群体更不可能从事农业自雇工作，而更有可能从事需要较高教育水平的技能型工作。这些结果表明，碘缺乏可能对低收入地区的职业选择和劳动力市场收入产生长期影响。

abstract.text: We examine the role of Venezuelan forced migration on the propagation of 15 infectious diseases in Colombia. For this purpose, we use rich municipal-monthly panel data. We exploit the fact that municipalities closer to the main migration entry points have a disproportionate exposure to infected migrants when the cumulative migration flows increase. We find that higher refugee inflows are associated with increments in the incidence of vaccine-preventable diseases, such as chickenpox and tuberculosis, as well as sexually transmitted diseases, namely syphilis. However, we find no significant effects of migration on the propagation of vector-borne diseases. Contact with infected migrants upon arrival seems to be the main driving mechanism.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102491.abstractZh: 我们研究了委内瑞拉强制移民对哥伦比亚15种传染病传播的影响。为此，我们使用了丰富的市级月度面板数据。我们发现，随着移民流动量的增加，靠近主要移民入口的市镇面临感染移民的风险更高。研究发现，更多的难民涌入与疫苗可预防疾病（如水痘、结核病）以及性传播疾病（如梅毒）的发病率上升有关。然而，我们发现移民对虫媒疾病传播的影响并不显著。抵达时与感染移民的接触似乎是主要的传播机制。

abstract.text: We provide the first quasi-experimental evidence on the relationship between cigarette taxes and smoking among sexual minority adults, a group that has been understudied in past research. We use large samples of individuals in same-sex households (a large share of whom are sexual minorities in same-sex romantic relationships) from the 1996-2018 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System. We find that cigarette taxes significantly reduced smoking among men and women in same-sex households, and the effects we find for men in same-sex households are very robust and significantly larger than the associated effects for men in different-sex households (the vast majority of whom are heterosexual married or partnered men). For men in same-sex households, we find no unintended consequences of higher cigarette taxes on other risky behaviors, and in fact we find that cigarette taxes are associated with significant improvements in self-rated health for men in same-sex households. These results suggest that the sizable disparities in adult smoking rates between heterosexual and sexual minority men would have been even larger in the absence of stricter tobacco control policy. However, in line with previous research indicating that cigarette taxes have 'lost their bite', we find no significant relationship between cigarette taxes and sexual minority smoking in more recent years.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102492.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于香烟税与性少数成年人吸烟行为之间关系的准实验性证据。这一群体在过去的研究中一直被忽视。我们利用了1996年至2018年行为风险因素监测系统中的大量同性家庭样本，其中许多家庭中的成员属于性少数，且处于同性恋爱关系之中。研究发现，香烟税显著降低了同性家庭中的男女吸烟率，且这一效应在男性中尤为显著，其幅度远大于异性家庭中的男性吸烟率（绝大多数异性家庭中的男性为异性婚姻或伴侣关系）。对于同性家庭中的男性而言，我们没有发现较高的香烟税对其他风险行为的意外影响；实际上，我们发现香烟税与同性家庭中年男性自我健康感的显著改善有关。这些结果表明，如果没有更严格的烟草控制政策，异性恋与性少数男性之间的吸烟率差异将会更大。然而，与之前的研究一致，我们发现近年来香烟税与性少数群体的吸烟行为之间并没有显著关系。

abstract.text: We study the intergenerational transmission of health using registered data from China between 1789 and 1906. We first document the intergenerational correlations in lifespans, and we find much higher correlations for mothers, compared to fathers. We then compare children born from brother and twin fathers, and the intergenerational transmission from fathers becomes weaker and is likely to be mostly driven by genetic factors. On the contrary, our results suggest a strong role of women in affecting their children's health outcomes across generations in developing countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102493.abstractZh: 我们利用1789年至1906年中国登记的数据，研究了健康代际传递的现象。我们首先记录了代际间寿命的相关性，发现母亲与父亲相比，代际相关性要高得多。随后，我们比较了由兄弟和双胞胎父亲所生育的子女，发现父亲对代际健康影响的传递作用较弱，且可能主要由遗传因素驱动。相反，我们的研究结果表明，在发展中国家，女性在影响子女健康结果方面发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: We examine whether the least educated population groups experienced the worst mortality trends at the beginning of the 21st century by measuring changes in mortality across education quartiles. We document sharply differing gender patterns. Among women, mortality trends improved fairly monotonically with education. Conversely, male trends for the lowest three education quartiles were often similar. For both sexes, the gap in mortality between the top 25 percent and the bottom 75 percent is growing. However, there are many groups for whom these patterns are reversed - with better experiences for the less educated - or where the differences are statistically indistinguishable.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102494.abstractZh: 我们研究了在21世纪初，受教育程度最低的人群是否经历了最糟糕的死亡率趋势，通过测量不同教育等级之间的死亡率变化来进行分析。我们发现性别方面的模式存在显著差异。在女性中，死亡率随着教育程度的提高而逐渐改善。相反，在受教育程度最低的三个教育等级中，男性的死亡率趋势往往相似。对于两性而言，收入最高的25%与收入最低的75%之间的死亡率差距正在扩大。然而，也有许多群体的这种模式是相反的——受教育程度较低的人群反而有更好的生存状况，或者这些差异在统计上无法区分。

abstract.text: The time at which a rational patient chooses to undergo an elective medical procedure for a non-life-threatening ailment is contemplated. The resulting model is purposely uncomplicated but general, and accounts for several basic factors that might affect such a decision. One such factor is that a patient cannot know with certainty the degree to which the medical procedure will be successful. Even so, patients have information about the expected outcome of the procedure and its risk, and about how the expected outcome and risk are affected by medical technological progress and surgeon experience. The effect of changes in exogenous variables on the timing of the medical procedure and on patient expected lifetime utility are investigated. It is shown that risk averse and prudent patients behave in an unambiguous manner in response to changes in all of the exogenous variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102495.abstractZh: 本文探讨了理性患者选择进行非致命性疾病的选择性医疗程序的时间点。所构建的模型旨在保持简洁性，同时涵盖了可能影响此类决策的几个基本因素。其中一个因素是，患者无法确切知道医疗程序的成功程度。尽管如此，患者仍然能够了解程序的预期结果及其风险，以及医疗技术进步和外科医生经验如何影响这些预期结果和风险。研究还探讨了外生变量变化对医疗程序时机以及患者预期寿命效用的影响。结果表明，风险规避且谨慎的患者在所有外生变量变化的情况下，都会表现出一致的行为模式。

abstract.text: We assess the impact of exogenous variation in oral contraceptives prices-a year-long decline followed by a sharp increase due to a documented collusion case-on fertility decisions and newborns' outcomes. Our empirical strategy follows an interrupted time-series design, which is implemented using multiple sources of administrative information. As prices skyrocketed (45% within a few weeks), the Pill's consumption plunged, and weekly conceptions increased (3.2% after a few months). We show large effects on the number of children born to unmarried mothers, to mothers in their early twenties, and to primiparae women. The incidence of low birth weight and fetal/infant deaths increased (declined) as the cost of birth control pills rose (fell). In addition, we document a disproportional increase in the weekly miscarriage and stillbirth rates. As children reached school age, we find lower school enrollment rates and higher participation in special education programs. Our evidence suggests these "extra" conceptions were more likely to face adverse conditions during critical periods of development.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102496.abstractZh: 我们评估了口服避孕药价格的外生变化对生育决策和新生儿结果的影响。这种变化包括一年的价格下降，随后由于一起记录在案的串通行为导致价格急剧上升。我们的实证研究采用了中断时间序列设计，并利用了多种行政信息来源。随着价格飞涨（几周内上涨了45%），口服避孕药的使用量大幅下降，而每周的受孕率则有所上升（几个月后上升了3.2%）。我们发现，未婚母亲、二十出头的母亲以及初产妇所生育的孩子的数量显著增加。随着避孕药成本的增加（减少），低出生体重和胎儿/婴儿死亡的发生率也相应增加（减少）。此外，我们还发现每周的流产和死胎率出现了不成比例的增加。随着孩子达到学龄，我们发现学校的入学率降低，而参加特殊教育项目的比例则上升。我们的证据表明，这些“额外”的受孕更可能在发育的关键时期面临不利条件。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of early state and local COVID-19 policies to encourage social distancing. Outcomes are daily foot traffic at establishments spanning ten key industries, across which transmission risk varies substantially. Policies include state of emergency declarations, blunt general restrictions such as stay-at-home (SAH) orders, and targeted rules such as restrictions on bars, restaurants, entertainment venues, and schools. Exploiting variation in the timing of policies in difference-in-difference models, we show that much of the decline in foot traffic early in the pandemic was due to private precautionary behavior. SAH orders explain almost none of the foot traffic decline in industries with high risk of virus transmission, but they do explain a substantial share of the decline in moderate- to low-risk industries such as outdoor sports and visits to parks. Targeted restrictions tend to impact intended industries, as well as complementary ones. We show that the impact of targeted restrictions is largest in counties with no SAH restrictions, suggesting that better targeting of public restrictions can have important efficiency gains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102497.abstractZh: 我们研究了早期州和地方政府为鼓励社交距离而实施的COVID-19政策的影响。研究结果显示了十个关键行业中的日客流量变化，这些行业的传播风险差异显著。这些政策包括紧急状态宣言、诸如居家令之类的直接普遍限制措施，以及针对酒吧、餐馆、娱乐场所和学校的特定限制措施。通过利用差异分解模型中的政策实施时间差异，我们发现疫情初期客流量下降很大程度上是由于私人预防行为所致。居家令几乎无法解释高风险行业客流量下降的原因，但在户外运动和公园游览等中等至低风险行业中，居家令确实解释了相当一部分客流量下降。特定限制措施往往会对目标行业以及相关行业产生影响。我们的研究表明，在没有居家令限制的县中，特定限制措施的影响最大，这表明更好地针对特定目标实施公共限制措施可以带来显著的效率提升。

abstract.text: I study how family spillovers shape healthcare consumption through two main sources: a learning channel whereby family members share information about their health insurance and the effectiveness of healthcare, and a behavioral channel whereby risk perception and habits are shared and transmitted. I exploit two types of sudden health shocks to identify a causal effect operating through each channel: a spouse's non-fatal heart attack or stroke and a severe injury to a child. I incorporate these shocks into an event-study framework to quantify the effect of spillovers on healthcare consumption of a non-injured adult family member. I find a significant behavioral spillover effect of an increase of more than 200% in medical expenditure of preventive care over a four-year horizon. Moreover, I find a strong and persistent learning spillover that amounts to an average increase of more than 150% in medical expenditure relative to prior to the health shock, and I demonstrate that this effect promotes health investment. While the first result is in line with previous findings in the literature, the second is novel.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102505.abstractZh: 我通过两个主要途径研究家庭溢出效应如何影响医疗保健消费：一是通过信息分享渠道，家庭成员可以交流关于健康保险和医疗保健效果的信息；二是通过行为传播渠道，风险感知和习惯得以共享和传递。我利用两种突发健康冲击来识别通过每种渠道产生的因果效应：配偶的非致命性心脏病发作或中风，以及儿童遭受严重伤害的情况。我将这些冲击纳入事件研究框架，以量化溢出效应对非受伤成年家庭成员医疗保健消费的影响。研究发现，在四年时间内，预防性医疗支出的增加幅度超过200%，存在显著的行为溢出效应。此外，我还发现一种强烈且持久的学习溢出效应，即医疗支出平均增加了超过150%，并且这种效应有助于促进健康投资。虽然第一个结果与文献中的先前研究结果一致，但第二个结果是全新的发现。

abstract.text: I provide new evidence on how price changes of nutritionally similar foods, such as those rich in sugar or fats, change obesity and diet-related diseases in the context of Mexico between 1996-2010. I merge a bar-code level price dataset with product-specific nutritional composition to two datasets with health outcomes: state-level administrative and nationally representative individual-level panel data. Exploiting within-city variation in prices using fixed effects models, I show that decreased prices of sugar-rich foods increase obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension prevalence; yet the prices of foods rich in other nutrients do not. Health responses to price changes are the largest for those abdominally obese or at the highest risk for chronic disease. The association between prices of sugary foods and chronic disease is meaningful: I estimate that in Mexico, price reductions of sugary foods explain roughly 15 percent of the rise in obesity and diabetes during the 15-year study period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102506.abstractZh: 我提供了新的证据，揭示了在1996年至2010年期间，墨西哥市场上营养相似食品（如含糖或脂肪较高的食品）价格变化对肥胖和饮食相关疾病的影响。我将条形码级别的价格数据与特定产品的营养成分数据合并，形成两个包含健康结果的数据库：一个是州级行政数据，另一个是具有全国代表性的个体级面板数据。通过固定效应模型分析城市内部价格差异，我发现含糖食品价格下降会增加肥胖、2型糖尿病和高血压的患病率；而富含其他营养素的食品价格下降则不会产生类似影响。对于腹部肥胖或慢性疾病高风险人群来说，价格变化对健康的冲击最为显著。含糖食品价格与慢性疾病之间的关联是显著的：我估计，在15年的研究期间，墨西哥市场上含糖食品价格的下降解释了大约15%的肥胖和糖尿病发病率上升。

abstract.text: This paper provides novel evidence of the unintended health effects stemming from the halt in nuclear power production after the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. After the accident, nuclear power stations ceased operation and nuclear power was replaced by fossil fuels, causing an increase in electricity prices. We find that this increase led to a reduction in energy consumption, which caused an increase in mortality during very cold temperatures, given the protective role that climate control plays against the elements. Our results contribute to the debate surrounding the use of nuclear as a source of energy by documenting a yet unexplored health benefit from using nuclear power, and more broadly to regulatory policy approaches implemented during periods of scientific uncertainty about potential adverse effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102507.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于福岛第一核电站事故后停止核能生产所带来的非预期健康影响的新的证据。事故发生后，核电站停止运行，核能被化石燃料取代，导致电价上涨。我们发现，这一价格上涨导致能源消耗减少，而在极寒天气条件下，能源消耗减少反而导致了死亡率的增加，因为气候调节在抵御恶劣环境方面具有保护作用。我们的研究结果有助于探讨将核能作为能源来源的争议，并记录了核能使用所带来的尚未被充分探索的健康益处。此外，这些结果也为在科学对潜在不良影响存在不确定性的时期制定监管政策提供了参考。

abstract.text: Many children in low- and middle-income countries are growing up during a rapid nutrition transition. Experimental evidence on food choice in developing countries is scarce, while it is unclear to what extent evidence from high-income countries can be generalized. Children participated in a snack choice experiment. We expose some children to emoji labels encouraging healthy snacks, while others observe healthy or unhealthy snacking by peers. While emoji labels moderately promote healthy snacking, the adverse effect of observing a peer eating the unhealthy snack is very large. The effect associated with observing a healthy peer is insignificant. Additionally, cross-randomized blocks of children watched a nutrition video to study the interaction of information provision and nudging. The video independently improves healthy choices but does not aid the emoji nudge and cannot counter the strong negative peer effect. We compare our findings to studies conducted in developed countries and discuss policy implications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102508.abstractZh: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家的儿童成长过程中，营养状况正在经历快速变化。关于发展中国家儿童食物选择的研究证据较为匮乏，而来自高收入国家的研究结果能否普遍适用尚不清楚。研究人员让一些儿童接触带有鼓励健康零食的emoji标签，同时让另一些儿童观察同伴的零食选择行为。结果显示，emoji标签在一定程度上促进了健康零食的选择，但观察同伴食用不健康零食的负面影响却非常显著。而观察健康同伴的行为则几乎没有影响。此外，研究人员还让一些儿童观看营养相关视频，以研究信息提供与引导行为之间的相互作用。视频本身确实有助于改善健康选择，但无法替代emoji标签的引导作用，也无法抵消强烈的负面同伴效应。我们将研究结果与发达国家的研究结果进行了比较，并讨论了相关政策启示。

abstract.text: We study the impact of exposing hospitals in a National Health Service (NHS) to non-price competition by exploiting a patient choice reform in Norway in 2001. The reform facilitates a difference-in-difference approach due to plausibly exogenous (geographical) variation in pre-reform market structure. Employing rich, administrative data, covering the universe of hospital admissions from 1998 to 2005, we estimate models with hospital and treatment (DRG) fixed-effects and use only emergency admissions to limit patient selection issues. The results show that hospitals in more competitive areas have a sharper reduction in AMI mortality but no effect on stroke mortality. We also find that exposure to competition reduces all-cause mortality, shortens length of stay, but increases readmissions, though the effects are small in magnitude. In years with high (DRG) prices, the negative effect on readmissions almost vanishes. Finally, exposure to competition tends to reduce waiting times and increase admissions, but the effects must be interpreted with care as the outcomes include elective treatments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102509.abstractZh: 我们研究了将医院置于国家卫生服务系统（NHS）中，通过利用2001年挪威的一项患者选择改革来消除价格竞争的影响。由于改革前市场结构的地理差异可能是外生的，因此采用了差异-差异方法进行分析。我们利用丰富的行政数据，涵盖了1998年至2005年的所有医院入院记录，建立了包含医院和治疗分类（DRG）固定效应的模型，并仅使用急诊入院数据来限制患者选择问题。研究结果表明，在竞争更激烈的地区，医院的心肌梗死死亡率显著下降，但对中风死亡率没有影响。我们还发现，竞争的存在降低了全因死亡率，缩短了住院时间，但增加了再入院率，尽管这些影响的幅度较小。在DRG价格较高的年份，再入院率的负面影响几乎消失。最后，竞争的存在倾向于减少等待时间并增加入院次数，但这些效应需要谨慎解读，因为结果中包含了选择性治疗的情况。

abstract.text: Islamophobia has increased in the last years, in part, due to terrorist attacks perpetrated by jihadist groups. This phenomenon might be a source of stress, being particularly problematic for pregnant (Muslim) women. We examine how stress generated by the 2017 Catalonia (Spain) attacks affected the health of newborns whose mothers are from a Muslim country (as the perpetrators). We use a difference-in-differences-in-differences model comparing newborns whose mothers come from a Muslim country and are residing in a municipality directly affected by the attacks, to other newborns, before-after the attacks. Results show that the share of low-birth-weight babies and deliveries with complications raise significantly by 23.77%, and 13.02%. We document a significant increase in Islamophobia and in emotional distress in our group of interest. We conclude that Islamophobia-related stress is possibly one of the channels affecting health at birth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102510.abstractZh: 近年来，伊斯兰恐惧症有所加剧，部分原因是由于圣战组织实施的恐怖袭击。这一现象可能成为压力的来源，尤其是对怀孕的穆斯林女性而言尤为严重。我们研究了2017年西班牙加泰罗尼亚袭击事件所引发的压力对新生儿健康的影响，这些新生儿的母亲来自穆斯林国家，而袭击的肇事者正是来自这些国家的穆斯林。我们采用差异-差异-差异模型，比较了母亲来自穆斯林国家且居住在受袭击直接影响地区的新生儿与未受袭击地区的新生儿在袭击前后的健康状况。结果显示，低出生体重婴儿的比例以及分娩并发症的发生率分别显著上升了23.77%和13.02%。我们的研究还发现，伊斯兰恐惧症以及情绪压力在相关群体中显著增加。我们得出结论，与伊斯兰恐惧症相关的压力可能是影响出生健康的一个因素。

abstract.text: Conventional wisdom suggests that marginal damages from particulate matter pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are highly polluted. Using administrative data on the universe of births and deaths, we explore birthweight and mortality effects of gestational particulate matter exposure in high-pollution yet high-income Hong Kong. The marginal effects of particulates on birthweight are large but we fail to detect an effect on neonatal mortality. We interpret our stark mortality results in a comparative analysis of pollution-mortality relationships across studies. We provide early evidence that marginal mortality damages from pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are less developed, not because they are more polluted.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102511.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，由于污染严重，欠发达国家因颗粒物污染造成的边际损害较高。我们利用出生和死亡登记数据，研究了香港这种污染严重但经济发达地区的妊娠期颗粒物暴露对出生体重和死亡率的影响。颗粒物对出生体重的边际影响较大，但我们未能发现其对新生儿死亡率的影响。通过对不同研究中的污染与死亡率关系进行比较分析，我们得出了这一结论：欠发达国家因污染造成的边际死亡率损害较高，原因是这些地区的经济发展水平较低，而非污染更为严重。

abstract.text: We exploit a quasi-experiment created when New York State began in 2011 to tax cigarettes sold on Native American Reservations. The regime change represents a unique opportunity to quantify brand loyalty because it almost doubled the price of premium-brand cigarettes, while Native brands were still untaxed. We use data from two different sources-the New York State Adult Tobacco Survey and the Nielsen Homescan Panel. We find that the increase in relative prices led to substantial declines in premium cigarette purchases. However, even among the premium consumers with the most to gain from switching, about three-quarters remained brand loyal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102512.abstractZh: 我们利用了2011年纽约州开始对美洲原住民保留地销售的香烟征税时创建的准实验数据。这一政策变化为量化品牌忠诚度提供了独特的机会，因为该政策几乎使高端品牌香烟的价格翻倍，而原住民品牌则仍然免税。我们使用了来自两个不同来源的数据——纽约州成人烟草调查和Nielsen Homescan面板调查。研究发现，相对价格的增加导致高端香烟的购买量大幅下降。然而，即使是在那些从转换中获益最多的高端消费者中，也有大约四分之三的人仍然保持对品牌的忠诚度。

abstract.text: We examine the contribution of information transmission among pregnant women to geographic variation in C-sections in Lombardy, Italy. Defining networks as pregnant women living in the same municipality, we observe that if the incidence of C-sections within the womans network is one standard deviation higher over the 12 months preceding delivery, then her probability of delivering by C-section is 0.007 percentage points (3%) higher. This result is mainly a network effect on Italian women, while it arises from both network and neighborhood effects on foreign women. Both groups respond to additional information, such as the incidence of C-section complications. The selection of pregnant women across hospitals does not uniquely explain our results, which are robust to alternative sample selections and specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102513.abstractZh: 我们研究了意大利伦巴第地区孕妇之间信息传输对剖宫产手术地理分布的影响。将网络定义为居住在同一市镇的孕妇，我们发现，如果某位孕妇所在网络内剖宫产手术的发生率在分娩前12个月内高出一个标准差，那么她通过剖宫产分娩的概率就会高出0.007个百分点（3%）。这一结果主要源于对意大利女性的网络效应，而对外国女性则同时受到网络效应和社区效应的影响。两组女性都对额外信息有反应，例如剖宫产并发症的发生率。医院之间孕妇的选择并不能唯一解释我们的研究结果，而该结果在采用其他样本选择和假设条件下仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effect of a major health care policy in public hospitals which changed the demand and supply side incentives for c-section procedures in 2014 in Iran, where the c-section rate at the time was 55%. Following the reform, vaginal delivery became free for patients. The policy also introduced financial incentives to doctors for performing vaginal deliveries and set a cap on their maximum c-section rate. We show that supply side incentives had a major role in the effectiveness of the programme, after which the national rate reduced by 6 percentage points. This reduction was mainly driven by first-birth mothers. The reform also shifted doctors with high c-section rates out of public hospitals. We cannot find any adverse effect on Apgar score, hospitalisation or mortality; however, gestation length and birth weight significantly increased.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102514.abstractZh: 我们评估了2014年伊朗一项重大医疗政策的影响，该政策改变了公立医院中剖宫产手术的供需激励措施。当时，剖宫产率约为55%。改革后，阴道分娩对孕妇免费。该政策还为进行阴道分娩的医生提供了经济激励，并设定了剖宫产的最大比例上限。研究表明，供给侧的激励措施对政策的实施效果起到了重要作用，此后全国剖宫产率下降了6个百分点。这一下降主要得益于初产妇。改革还使剖宫产率较高的医生离开了公立医院。我们没有发现对Apgar评分、住院率和死亡率有任何负面影响；然而，妊娠长度和出生体重显著增加。

abstract.text: We study the impact of endogenous longevity on optimal tax progressivity and inequality in an overlapping generations model with skill heterogeneity. Higher tax progressivity decreases both the longevity gap and net income inequality, but at the expense of lower average lifetime and income. We find that the welfare-maximizing income tax is less progressive in our model with endogenous longevity than in our model with exogenous longevity. In a highly stylized calibration of the US economy, we show that optimal tax progressivity is less than what prevails under the current US tax system. Our results are robust to the range of empirical labor supply elasticity and the assumptions of missing annuity markets and stochastic health. Our conclusion for the optimal progressivity of the US tax system can be altered by the adoption of a more egalitarian welfare function or by increases in prevailing levels of wage inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102515.abstractZh: 我们研究了内生寿命对最优税收累进性和不平等的影响，研究模型为具有技能异质性的重叠代模型。较高的税收累进性可以降低寿命差距和净收入不平等，但代价是平均寿命和收入降低。我们发现，在具有内生寿命的模型中，实现福利最大化的所得税累进性低于具有外生寿命的模型。在对美国经济进行高度简化的校准中，我们发现最优税收累进性低于当前美国税收制度下的水平。我们的研究结果不受实证劳动供给弹性范围以及缺失年金市场和随机健康假设的影响。对于美国税收制度的最优累进性，可以通过采用更平等的福利函数或提高当前存在的工资不平等程度来加以改变。

abstract.text: Certificate of need (CON) regulations requires that health care providers obtain state approval before offering a new service or expanding existing facilities. The purported goal of CON regulations is to reduce health care costs by generating regional economies of scale and reducing redundant investments resulting from excessive competition. Critics of CON regulations note that the regulatory environment increases the costs of expansion and may incentivize health care providers to forgo capital investment, which can have a negative effect on health outcomes. To estimate the net effect of CON regulations, I use a border discontinuity design to measure within-regional heart attack mortality spanning 1968 to 1982. I estimate that CON regulations led to an increase in heart attack deaths, by 6%-10%, three years after the policy was enacted.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102518.abstractZh: 《需求认证》法规要求医疗保健提供者在提供新服务或扩展现有设施之前获得州政府的批准。该法规的初衷是通过实现区域规模经济以及减少因过度竞争导致的重复投资来降低医疗保健成本。但《需求认证》法规的批评者指出，这一监管环境会增加扩张成本，并可能促使医疗保健提供者放弃资本投资，从而对健康结果产生负面影响。为了评估《需求认证》法规的净效应，我采用边界不连续设计方法来衡量1968年至1982年间区域内的心脏病发作死亡率变化。我的估计是，该法规在政策实施三年后导致心脏病发作死亡人数增加了6%至10%。

abstract.text: Physician ownership of hospitals involves several competing economic forces. Physician-owners may be incentivized to "cherry-pick" and treat profitable patients at their facilities. However, physician-owned hospitals are often specialized and may provide higher-quality care for well-matched patients. Using multiple identification approaches, I document no significant mortality improvement for cardiac patients treated at physician-owned hospitals. Using aggregate data on ownership to infer physician-owner preferences in a hospital choice model, my results rule out significant cherry-picking within physician-owners' patient populations. However, both facility location and a healthier overall patient population among physician-owners drive advantageous selection of patients into physician-owned hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102519.abstractZh: 医生拥有医院涉及多种相互竞争的经济因素。医生所有者可能会受到激励，在其医院中选择并治疗盈利性较高的患者。然而，医生拥有的医院通常具有专业特色，能够为匹配良好的患者提供更高质量的医疗服务。通过多种研究方法，我发现医生拥有的医院在心脏病患者治疗方面并没有显著改善死亡率。利用关于医院所有权的综合数据，在医院选择模型中分析医生所有者的偏好，我的研究结果排除了医生所有者在患者群体中进行选择性治疗的可能性。不过，医院的位置以及医生所有者所拥有的更健康的患者群体，都促使患者更倾向于选择医生拥有的医院。

abstract.text: Understanding how health care utilization responds to cost-sharing is of central importance for providing high quality care and limiting the growth of costs. We study whether the framing of cost-sharing incentives has an effect on health care utilization. For this we make use of a policy change in the Netherlands. Until 2007, patients received a refund if they consumed little or no health care; the refund was the lower the more care they had consumed. From 2008 onward, there was a deductible. This means that very similar economic incentives were first framed in terms of smaller gains and later as losses. We find that patients react to incentives much more strongly when they are framed in terms of losses. The effect on yearly spending is 8.6 percent. This suggests that discussions on the optimal design of cost-sharing incentives should also revolve around the question how these are presented to patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102520.abstractZh: 了解医疗保健利用对费用分摊的反应对于提供高质量的医疗服务和限制成本增长至关重要。我们研究了费用分摊激励机制的设定方式是否会对医疗保健利用产生影响。为此，我们选取了荷兰的一项政策变化作为研究案例。在2007年之前，如果患者消耗的医疗服务很少或没有消耗任何医疗服务，他们可以获得退款；退款金额随着他们消耗的医疗服务数量的增加而减少。从2008年开始，引入了免赔额制度。这意味着，原本类似的经济激励机制最初是以较小的收益来设定的，后来则被转化为损失的形式。我们发现，当激励机制以损失的形式呈现时，患者对激励的反应更为强烈。这一变化对年度支出的影响为8.6%。这表明，关于费用分摊激励机制的最佳设计，还需要考虑这些机制如何向患者传达。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D plans provide prescription drug coverage to 45 million seniors. The recent past has seen significant consolidation amongst plan providers, notable CVS's 2018 acquisition of Aetna and Cigna's 2018 acquisition of Express Scripts. In this paper, we analyze the effect of consolidation of standalone Part D plan providers on premiums using plausibly exogenous variation in concentration induced by the 2011 merger between CVS and Universal American. We find that the increase in concentration for standalone Medicare Part D plans that resulted from this merger led to higher average premiums, a total of nearly $170 million per year. We find further that, consistent with the assumptions behind standard antitrust practice, the effects of the increase in concentration were heterogeneous: moderately (or more) concentrated markets that saw a meaningful increase in concentration saw significant increases in premiums, while premiums in other markets did not change significantly.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102521.abstractZh: Medicare Part D计划为4500万老年人提供处方药保险。近年来，计划提供商之间发生了显著的合并，例如CVS在2018年收购了Aetna，Cigna在2018年收购了Express Scripts。本文分析了独立Part D计划提供商合并对保费的影响，通过2011年CVS与Universal American合并导致的集中度变化来模拟这种影响。研究发现，由于此次合并导致独立Medicare Part D计划的集中度增加，平均保费上升了近1.7亿美元/年。此外，与标准反垄断实践假设一致，集中度的增加效果存在差异：集中度较高或更高的市场保费显著上升，而其他市场的保费则没有明显变化。

abstract.text: Since the early 80s, incentives have been introduced to stimulate R&D for rare diseases. We develop a theoretical model to study the impact of push and pull incentives on the intensive and extensive margin of optimal R&D investments. The model describes the mechanisms by which the type of incentives provided may favor R&D for orphan diseases with comparatively high prevalence. In our empirical analysis, we merge data on orphan drug designations by the Food and Drug Administration with Orphanet data on disease characteristics. In line with the theoretical results, we find evidence supporting the idea that the incentives adopted may have contributed substantially to widening the gap between more and less rare diseases classified as orphan. Our theoretical and empirical findings together suggest that, if providing some therapeutic option to patients with very rare diseases is a priority, a revision of the current system of incentives should be considered.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102522.abstractZh: 自20世纪80年代初以来，政府开始引入激励措施以刺激对罕见疾病的研发。我们开发了一个理论模型，研究推动性和拉动力激励对最优研发投资集约化与广化边际的影响。该模型描述了激励类型如何有利于对患病率较高的孤儿病的研发。在实证分析中，我们将美国食品药品监督管理局对孤儿药的分类数据与Orphanet的疾病特征数据进行了整合。与理论结果一致，我们发现有证据表明，所采用的激励措施可能显著缩小了被归类为孤儿病的罕见疾病与非罕见疾病之间的差距。我们的理论和实证发现共同表明，如果为极罕见疾病患者提供治疗选择是优先事项，那么应该考虑对现行激励制度进行修订。

abstract.text: Switching costs and persistent preferences generate demand inertia and link current and future choices of hospital. Using a model of hospital competition with demand inertia, we investigate the effect of patient expectations on quality. We consider three types of expectations. Myopic patients choose a hospital based on current variables alone, forward-looking but naïve patients consider the future but assume that quality remains constant, and forward-looking and rational patients foresee the evolution of quality. We rank quality provision and show that it is higher under naïve than myopic expectations, while quality under rational expectations may be highest or lowest. This result also holds for patients' health gains, suggesting that rationality may hurt patients. Additionally, policies to reduce switching costs lead to lower quality, possibly unless patients are rational and cost substitutability between output and quality is sufficiently strong. Finally, we show how optimal price regulation depends on expectations and switching costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102529.abstractZh: 转换成本与持续偏好会产生需求惯性，并将当前与未来的医院选择联系起来。通过构建具有需求惯性的医院竞争模型，我们研究了患者预期对医院质量的影响。我们考虑了三种类型的预期：目光短浅的患者仅基于当前变量选择医院；具有前瞻性但天真的患者考虑未来情况，但假设质量保持不变；具有前瞻性和理性的患者预见质量的演变。我们对医院质量进行了排序，发现天真预期下医院质量较高，而理性预期下质量可能最高或最低。这一结果同样适用于患者的健康收益，表明理性可能对患者不利。此外，降低转换成本的政策会导致较低的质量，除非患者具有理性，且产出与质量之间的成本替代性足够强。最后，我们展示了最优价格调控如何取决于预期和转换成本。

abstract.text: We investigate how the anticipation of COVID-19 vaccines affects voluntary social distancing. In a large-scale preregistered survey experiment with a representative sample, we study whether providing information about the safety, effectiveness, and availability of COVID-19 vaccines affects the willingness to comply with public health guidelines. We find that vaccine information reduces peoples' voluntary social distancing, adherence to hygiene guidelines, and their willingness to stay at home. Getting positive information on COVID-19 vaccines induces people to believe in a swifter return to normal life. The results indicate an important behavioral drawback of successful vaccine development: An increased focus on vaccines can lower compliance with public health guidelines and accelerate the spread of infectious disease. The results imply that, as vaccinations roll out and the end of a pandemic feels closer, policies aimed at increasing social distancing will be less effective, and stricter policies might be required.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102530.abstractZh: 我们研究了对COVID-19疫苗的期待如何影响人们的自愿社交距离行为。通过一项大规模的预注册调查实验，我们选取了具有代表性的样本，研究提供有关COVID-19疫苗的安全性、有效性和可用性的信息是否会影响人们遵守公共卫生指南的意愿。研究发现，疫苗信息会降低人们的自愿社交距离行为、卫生准则的遵守程度以及留在家的意愿。关于COVID-19疫苗的积极信息使人们更相信能够更快地恢复正常生活。研究结果表明，成功的疫苗开发存在一个重要的行为缺陷：过度关注疫苗可能会降低人们对公共卫生指南的遵守程度，并加速传染病的传播。这意味着，随着疫苗接种的推进以及疫情结束的临近，旨在增加社交距离的政策将变得不那么有效，可能需要采取更严格的政策。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of social capital on health outcomes during the Covid-19 pandemic in independent analyses for Austria, Germany, Great Britain, Italy, the Netherlands, Sweden and Switzerland. Exploiting detailed geographical variation within countries, we show that a one-standard-deviation increase in social capital leads to between 14% and 34% fewer Covid-19 cases per capita accumulated from mid-March until end of June 2020, as well as between 6% and 35% fewer excess deaths per capita. Our results highlight the positive health returns of strengthening social capital.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102531.abstractZh: 我们研究了在新冠疫情期间，社会资本对健康结果的影响，对奥地利、德国、英国、意大利、荷兰、瑞典和瑞士进行了独立分析。通过利用各国内部的详细地理差异，我们发现，从3月中旬到6月底，社会资本每增加一个标准差，人均新冠病例数就会减少14%至34%，人均超额死亡人数也会减少6%至35%。我们的研究结果强调了加强社会资本对健康的积极影响。

abstract.text: Growing evidence from evolutionary biology demonstrates how early life shocks trigger physiological changes designed to be adaptive in challenging environments. We examine the implications of one type of physiological adaptation - immunity formation - for human capital accumulation. Using variation in early life malaria risk generated by an interrupted disease control program in Zambia, we show that exposure to infectious diseases during the first two years of life can reduce the harmful effects of malaria exposure on cognitive development during the preschool years. These findings suggest a non-linear and trajectory-dependent relationship between early life adversity and human capital formation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102532.abstractZh: 来自进化生物学的越来越多的证据表明，生命早期的冲击会引发生理变化，这些变化在具有挑战性的环境中具有适应性。我们研究了其中一种生理适应机制——免疫系统的形成——对人类资本积累的影响。通过研究赞比亚一项中断的疾病控制计划导致的生命早期疟疾风险的变化，我们发现，在生命的前两年接触传染病可以减少疟疾对学龄前儿童认知发展的负面影响。这些发现表明，生命早期的逆境与人力资本形成之间存在非线性且依赖轨迹的关系。

abstract.text: Beyond a handful of studies examining early-adopting states in the early 1990s, little is known about the causal effects of mandatory waiting periods for abortion. In this study we evaluate the effects of a Tennessee law enacted in 2015 that requires women to make an additional trip to abortion providers for state-directed counseling at least 48 hours before they can obtain an abortion. Our difference-in-differences and synthetic-control estimates indicate that the introduction of the mandatory waiting period caused a 53-69 percent increase in the share of abortions obtained during the second trimester. Our analysis examining overall abortion rates is less conclusive but suggests a reduction caused by the waiting period. To put these estimates into context, we provide back-of-the-envelope calculations on the additional monetary costs that Tennessee's MWP imposes on women seeking abortions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102533.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代初仅有少数研究关注早期采用该政策的州，关于强制等待期对堕胎的因果效应知之甚少。本研究评估了2015年田纳西州的一项法律的影响，该法律要求女性在堕胎前至少48小时前往堕胎机构接受州政府提供的咨询。我们的差异比较和合成控制分析表明，强制等待期的引入导致第二孕期堕胎的比例增加了53%至69%。对我们的整体堕胎率分析来说，结论并不那么明确，但表明等待期确实导致了堕胎率的下降。为了将这些估计结果置于具体背景中，我们提供了关于田纳西州强制等待期给寻求堕胎的女性带来的额外经济成本的估算。

abstract.text: As of the end of 2017, 3.4 million Syrian refugees lived in Turkey. These refugees left a country where the health system was utterly broken. Several studies report that Syrian refugees faced numerous diseases during their exodus, brought certain infectious diseases to the hosting communities, and have a high incidence of health care utilization. Moreover, they have much higher fertility rates than natives. We examine the effect of Syrian refugees on the health care resources in Turkey and on natives' mortality-with a focus on infant, child, and elderly mortality. Our OLS results yield suggestive evidence of an adverse effect of the refugee shock on infant and child mortality. However, we find that this is a result of endogenous settlement patterns of refugees. Once we account for the endogeneity using a plausibly exogenous instrument, we find no evidence of an effect on native mortality for any age group. We also analyze the refugees' pressure on the health care services in Turkey and the government's response to understand our findings on mortality outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102534.abstractZh: 截至2017年底，有340万叙利亚难民居住在土耳其。这些难民离开了一个医疗体系完全崩溃的国家。多项研究指出，叙利亚难民在逃离过程中面临多种疾病，他们将某些传染病带到了接收他们的社区，并且医疗服务的利用率很高。此外，他们的生育率远高于当地居民。我们研究了叙利亚难民对土耳其医疗资源的影响，以及他们对当地居民死亡率的影响——重点关注婴儿、儿童和老年人的死亡率。我们的OLS分析结果表明，难民的涌入对婴儿和儿童死亡率产生了负面影响。然而，我们发现这一结果是由于难民的定居模式而产生的内生效应。当我们使用一个合理的外生性工具变量来考虑内生性问题时，我们发现没有任何年龄组的当地居民死亡率受到负面影响。我们还分析了难民对土耳其医疗服务的压力以及政府对此的应对措施，以进一步理解我们的死亡率研究结果。

abstract.text: This paper studies a general kidney exchange model with compatible patient-donor pairs, incompatible patient-donor pairs, single donors, and patients on the waiting list. We derive an explicit formula of the maximal number of feasible kidney transplants under several sizes of cycles and chains of exchange, analyze the effect of different ways of exchange on efficiency, and provide substantial simulation results based on the USA data. Our results further show that kidney exchange can be decentralized for relatively large populations, and that allowing compatible pairs and single donors to exchange with incompatible pairs can significantly increase the number of feasible kidney transplants. A more general model of two-category type-compatible exchanges is also established.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102536.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个通用的肾脏交换模型，涉及兼容的患者-捐赠者配对、不兼容的患者-捐赠者配对、单个捐赠者以及等待名单上的患者。我们推导出了在多种交换规模和链条下，可行肾脏移植的最大数量的计算公式，分析了不同交换方式对效率的影响，并基于美国数据提供了大量模拟结果。我们的研究进一步表明，对于相对较大的人群来说，肾脏交换可以实行分散式管理；同时，允许兼容配对和不兼容配对之间的交换，可以显著增加可行肾脏移植的数量。此外，我们还建立了一个更通用的两类别类型兼容交换模型。

abstract.text: We studied the effect of marijuana liberalization policies on perinatal health with a multiperiod difference-in-differences estimator that exploited variation in effective dates of medical marijuana laws (MML) and recreational marijuana laws (RML). We found that the proportion of maternal hospitalizations with marijuana use disorder increased by 23% (0.3 percentage points) in the first three years after RML implementation, with larger effects in states authorizing commercial sales of marijuana. This growth was accompanied by a 7% (0.4 percentage points) decline in tobacco use disorder hospitalizations, yielding a net zero effect over all substance use disorder hospitalizations. RMLs were not associated with statistically significant changes in newborn health. MMLs had no statistically significant effect on maternal substance use disorder hospitalizations nor on newborn health and fairly small effects could be ruled out. In absolute numbers, our findings implied modest or no adverse effects of marijuana liberalization policies on the array of perinatal outcomes considered.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102537.abstractZh: 我们研究了大麻自由化政策对围产期健康的影响，使用了多期差异-差异估计方法，该方法利用了医用大麻法律与娱乐性大麻法律生效日期的变化。研究发现，在娱乐性大麻法律实施后的三年内，因大麻使用障碍而住院的母亲比例增加了23个百分点（0.3个百分点），在允许商业销售大麻的州，这一影响更为显著。这一增长伴随着烟草使用障碍住院人数的7%下降（0.4个百分点），总体上对所有物质使用障碍住院人数没有显著影响。娱乐性大麻法律并未对新生儿健康产生统计学上的显著影响。医用大麻法律对母亲物质使用障碍住院人数以及新生儿健康也没有统计学上的显著影响，且可以排除较小的效应。从绝对数字来看，我们的研究结果表明，大麻自由化政策对所考虑的多种围产期结果几乎没有或没有负面影响。

abstract.text: Recent research in the U.S. links trade-induced job displacement to deaths of despair. Should we expect the same mortality response in developing countries? This paper analyzes the effect of a trade-induced negative shock to manufacturing employment on leading causes of mortality in Mexico between 1998 and 2013. I exploit cross-municipality variation in trade exposure based on differences in industry specialization before China's accession to the WTO in 2001 to identify labor-demand shocks that are concentrated in manufacturing. I find trade-induced job loss increased mortality from diabetes, raised obesity rates, reduced physical activity, and lowered access to health insurance. These deaths were offset by declines in mortality from ischemic heart disease and chronic pulmonary disease. These findings highlight that negative employment shocks have heterogeneous impacts on mortality in developing countries, where falling incomes lead to less access to health care and nutritious food, but also reduce alcohol and tobacco use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102538.abstractZh: 美国的最新研究将贸易引起的就业流失与绝望导致的死亡联系起来。我们是否应该预期在发展中国家也会出现同样的死亡反应呢？本文分析了1998年至2013年间贸易对制造业就业的负面影响对墨西哥主要死因的影响。我利用2001年中国加入世界贸易组织前后不同行业专业化程度导致的贸易暴露差异，识别出集中在制造业领域的劳动力需求冲击。研究发现，贸易引起的就业流失增加了糖尿病的死亡率，提高了肥胖率，减少了体力活动，并降低了医疗保险的获取率。然而，这些死亡现象被缺血性心脏病和慢性肺部疾病的死亡率下降所抵消。这些发现表明，在发展中国家，负面的就业冲击对死亡率的影响具有异质性，收入下降会导致医疗保健和营养食品的获取减少，但同时也减少了酒精和烟草的使用。

abstract.text: Health systems globally face increasing morbidity and mortality from chronic diseases, yet many - especially in low- and middle-income countries - lack strong chronic disease management in primary health care (PHC). We provide evidence on China's efforts to promote PHC management using unique five-year panel data in a rural county, including health care utilization from medical claims and health outcomes from biomarkers. Utilizing plausibly exogenous variation in management intensity generated by administrative and geographic boundaries, we compare hypertension/diabetes patients in villages within two kilometers distance but managed by different townships. Results show that, compared to patients in townships with median management intensity, patients in high-intensity townships have 4.8% more PHC visits, 5.2% fewer specialist visits, 11.7% lower likelihood of having an inpatient admission, and 3.6% lower medical spending. They also tend to have better medication adherence and better control of blood pressure. The resource savings from avoided inpatient admissions substantially outweigh the costs of the program.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102539.abstractZh: 全球各地的卫生系统面临着慢性疾病导致的发病率和死亡率不断增加的问题，然而许多地区，尤其是低收入和中等收入国家，在初级卫生保健方面缺乏有效的慢性疾病管理。我们基于中国一个农村地区的五年面板数据，提供了关于如何促进初级卫生保健管理的证据。这些数据包括医疗索赔中的医疗服务利用情况以及通过生物标志物得出的健康结果。通过利用行政和地理边界产生的管理强度变化，我们比较了距离两公里以内但由不同乡镇管理的村庄中的高血压/糖尿病患者。结果显示，与管理强度居中的乡镇患者相比，高强度乡镇的患者就诊次数多4.8次，专科就诊次数减少5.2次，住院的可能性降低11.7%，医疗费用也减少了3.6%。此外，这些患者的药物依从性更好，血压控制也更为良好。避免住院所带来的资源节省远远超过了该项目的成本。

abstract.text: Recent literature has documented a widening gap in mortality between older individuals of high versus low socioeconomic status (SES) in the U.S. This paper investigates whether this trend will continue. We analyze the health status of successive cohorts of 54-60-year-old U.S. individuals born between 1934 and 1959 and use a rich set of health indicators to forecast life expectancies. The detailed health measures come from the longitudinal Health and Retirement Study. We find that many health indicators have worsened recently. For example, rates of obesity, diabetes, and self-reported levels of pain sharply increased between 1992 and 2016. Directly relevant for mortality, recent cohorts report lower subjective survival probabilities. Using Social Security wealth as an SES indicator, we find strong evidence for increasing health inequalities. We predict overall life expectancy to increase further; but the increase will be concentrated among higher SES individuals and mortality inequality will continue to increase.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102540.abstractZh: 近期的研究记录了美国中，高社会经济地位与低社会经济地位的老年人之间的死亡率差距正在扩大。本文探讨了这一趋势是否会持续。我们分析了1934年至1959年间出生的54至60岁美国人的健康状况，并利用一系列健康指标来预测预期寿命。这些详细的健康数据来自纵向健康与退休研究。我们发现，许多健康指标近期有所恶化。例如，肥胖率、糖尿病发病率以及自我报告的疼痛程度在1992年至2016年间急剧上升。与死亡率直接相关的是，近期的人群报告了较低的主观生存概率。通过将社会保障财富作为社会经济地位的指标，我们发现健康不平等现象正在加剧。我们预计整体预期寿命将进一步增加；但这一增长将主要集中在高社会经济地位的人群中，而死亡率的不平等现象将继续加剧。

abstract.text: Evidence of increased health care utilization associated with the Medicaid expansion suggests that clinicians increased capacity to meet demand. However, little is known about the mechanism underlying this response. Using a novel source of all-payer data, we quantified clinicians' response to the Medicaid expansion - examining whether and how they changed their Medicaid participation decisions, payer mix, and overall labor supply. Primary care clinicians in expansion states provided an average of 49 additional appointments per year (a 21% relative increase) for patients insured by Medicaid, compared to clinicians in non-expansion states - with new-patient visits representing half (25 appointments) of this overall increase. Clinicians did not increase their labor supply to accommodate these additional appointments. They instead offset the 1.7 percentage point average increase in Medicaid payer mix with an equivalent reduction in commercial payer mix. However, this reduction in commercial patient share represented only a 2.8% relative decrease, with commercially insured patients still comprising the majority of the average clinician's patient panel. Subsample analyses revealed a larger increase in care for Medicaid patients among clinicians with high Medicaid participation preceding the eligibility expansion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102541.abstractZh: 有证据表明，医疗补助计划的扩展增加了医疗服务的利用，这表明临床医生有能力满足更多的需求。然而，关于这一反应背后的机制知之甚少。通过一种新颖的全方数据来源，我们量化了临床医生对医疗补助计划扩展的反应——考察他们是否以及如何改变参与医疗补助计划的决策、支付方的组合以及整体劳动力供应。在扩展州的初级保健临床医生，每年为医疗补助保险患者提供了平均额外49次预约（相对增加了21%），而非扩展州的临床医生则减少了这一数量。新患者的就诊次数占整体增加的25次预约。临床医生并没有增加劳动力供应来应对这些额外的预约。相反，他们通过减少商业支付方的组合来抵消医疗补助支付方组合平均增加1.7个百分点的影响。然而，商业保险患者的比例仅减少了2.8%，而商业保险患者仍然占临床医生患者群体的大多数。子样本分析显示，在医疗补助计划扩展资格之前，参与医疗补助计划的临床医生为医疗补助患者提供的服务有所增加。

abstract.text: When consumers gain Medicaid, their cost of healthcare changes. The direction of this change determines how utilization changes. The previously uninsured see a stark decrease in the price of primary care after gaining public insurance. Due to charity care, they may face an increase in the price of emergency department care. The previously insured see a reduction in emergency department prices and decreased access to primary care. We examine the impact of the prior insurance status of the newly publicly insured on substitution between healthcare. We base our identification on California's LIHP and ACA Medicaid expansions. One challenge we face is estimating crowd-out. We use machine learning techniques to predict prior insurance status based on observable covariates in cross-sectional data. We find an increase in emergency department utilization caused entirely by those crowded-out whose access to primary care has decreased. We find the opposite utilization patterns for the previously uninsured.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102542.abstractZh: 当消费者获得医疗补助后，他们的医疗保健成本会发生变化。这种变化的方向决定了医疗服务的利用情况如何变化。以前没有保险的人在获得公共保险后，初级保健的价格显著下降。但由于慈善性质的医疗服务，他们可能会面临急诊服务价格上升的问题。而以前有保险的人则发现急诊服务价格下降，同时初级保健的获取机会也减少了。我们研究了新获得公共保险的人之前是否有保险状况对医疗服务替代性的影响。我们的研究基于加利福尼亚州的LIHP和ACA医疗补助扩展政策。我们面临的一个挑战是估计被挤出的风险。我们使用机器学习技术，基于横截面数据中的可观测变量来预测之前是否有保险状况。我们发现，急诊服务的利用率上升完全是由于那些原本无法获得初级保健服务的人被挤出来导致的。而对于以前没有保险的人来说，其医疗服务利用情况则相反。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of screen-based activities on obesity and mental well-being for children, using a large survey dataset representative of the UK population and an event study model that exploits exogenous variation in the entry date of the digital television transition in the UK. The digital transition increased the number of available free television channels from 5 to 40, leading to a rise in television viewing time. Our results show that receiving access to digital television signal considerably increases the mental health total difficulties score among children, and that this impact grows over time. We also find suggestive evidence that the digital transition could have increased BMI for children. Underlying the net effects appear to be decreases in participation in social and physical activities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102543.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于屏幕的活动对儿童肥胖和心理健康的影响，使用了代表英国人口的大型调查数据集，并采用了一个事件研究模型，该模型利用了英国数字电视转型开始时间的外部变化。数字电视的转型使得可使用的免费电视频道从5个增加到了40个，从而导致电视观看时间增加。我们的结果显示，能够接收数字电视信号显著增加了儿童的心理健康总困难评分，而且这种影响随着时间的推移而加剧。我们还发现了一些迹象表明，数字电视的转型可能增加了儿童的体重指数。这些净效应背后的原因可能是参与社交和体育活动的减少。

abstract.text: Mothers' lack of knowledge about child nutrition and limited resources lead to poor diets among children in developing countries, increasing their risk of chronic undernutrition. We implemented a cluster randomized control trial that randomly provides four-month-long Behavior Change Communication (BCC) and food vouchers in Ethiopia. We find improvements in child-feeding practices and a reduction in chronic child undernutrition only when BCC and vouchers are provided together. BCC or voucher alone had limited impacts. Our results highlight the importance of adding an effective educational component to existing transfer programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102545.abstractZh: 母亲对儿童营养知识的缺乏以及有限的资源导致发展中国家儿童饮食状况不佳，从而增加了他们患慢性营养不良的风险。我们在埃塞俄比亚实施了一项群体随机对照试验，随机分配四个月的行为改变沟通和食品券。我们发现，只有当行为改变沟通和食品券同时提供时，儿童喂养行为才有所改善，慢性营养不良也有所减少。单独使用行为改变沟通或食品券的效果有限。我们的研究结果强调了在现有转移项目中加入有效的教育成分的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper addresses one of the main empirical problems associated with rational addiction theory, namely, that its derived demand equation is not empirically distinguishable from those of models with forward-looking behavior but with time-inconsistent preferences. Using an encompassing general specification of the rational addiction model we derive a microfounded test of time-consistency. The test allows us to distinguish between time-consistent versus time-inconsistent naïve agents. The results obtained from a panel of Russian individuals conform to the theoretical predictions of the rational addiction model and the proposed test for time-consistency does not reject the hypothesis that Russian cigarette consumers are time-consistent.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102546.abstractZh: 本文探讨了与理性成瘾理论相关的一个主要实证问题，即其推导出的需求方程在经验上无法与那些具有前瞻性行为但偏好时间不一致的模型的需求方程区分开来。通过采用涵盖性的一般理性成瘾模型规范，我们推导出一个基于微观层面的时间一致性检验方法。该检验使我们能够区分时间一致性与时间不一致性的简单理性行为者。来自俄罗斯个体的样本结果符合理性成瘾理论的理论预测，而提出的关于时间一致性的检验并未否定俄罗斯香烟消费者具有时间一致性的假设。

abstract.text: We model the observed smoking outcomes of an individual and her social contact - a spouse, friend, sibling, parent or adult child - as a simultaneous move game with complete information. We allow an individual's smoking behavior to depend on her previous behavior and carefully account for observed and unobserved heterogeneity. Our econometric model addresses simultaneity, homophily, health endogeneity, non-random attrition, and multiplicity of equilibria together. Using network data from the Framingham Heart Study, we find smaller social interaction effects among spouses and friends than Christakis and Fowler (2008) who pioneered such exploration with these data. We also find that social interaction impacts of the endogenous behaviors of siblings or a parent and an adult child are not statistically significant after disentangling them from homophily. In addition, we find that the effects of social contacts' cardiovascular disease shocks on individual smoking behavior are not statistically significant.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102547.abstractZh: 我们将个体及其社交关系中的成员（如配偶、朋友、兄弟姐妹、父母或成年子女）的吸烟行为结果建模为一个具有完全信息的同步移动博弈。我们允许个体的吸烟行为受到其先前行为的影响，并仔细考虑了观察到的和未观察到的异质性。我们的计量经济模型同时考虑了同步性、同质性、健康内生性、非随机流失以及多个均衡等问题。利用弗雷明汉心脏研究的数据，我们发现配偶和朋友之间的社交互动效应小于Christakis和Fowler（2008）在使用这些数据时发现的效应。我们还发现，在将兄弟姐妹或父母与成年子女之间的内生行为从同质性中分离出来后，这些行为的社交互动影响并不显著。此外，我们发现社交关系对个体吸烟行为的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: The capitated payment model has been used to address the high cost of health care. Under capitation, physicians are compensated with a fixed amount per patient, regardless of the services generated. We provide new evidence on how the capitation payment model changes physicians behaviors by studying the treatment of lower back pain, as this type of treatment provides substantial scope for physicians discretion. We use data from 2003 to 2006 from a large database of employer-sponsored health insurance claims and leverage capitation variation within the plan and physician to mitigate selection concerns. The results show that the treatment intensity-primarily derived from therapy and diagnostic testing -of patients under a capitation system is 7-12% lower than that of similar patients in a non-capitated plan. Furthermore, we find no evidence of increased relapse rates for patients in a capitated plan.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102548.abstractZh: 固定支付模式被用于应对高昂的医疗保健成本。在固定支付模式下，医生根据每位患者的固定金额获得报酬，而不考虑所提供的服务数量。我们通过研究下背痛的治疗情况，为固定支付模式如何改变医生的行为提供了新的证据。这种治疗方式为医生提供了较大的自由裁量空间。我们使用了2003至2006年的数据，这些数据来自一个大型的雇主赞助健康保险索赔数据库，并利用计划内和医生之间的支付差异来减轻选择问题。研究结果表明，在固定支付模式下，患者的治疗强度——主要来自治疗和诊断测试——比在非固定支付模式下类似的患者低7-12%。此外，我们没有发现固定支付模式下患者的复发率有所增加的证据。

abstract.text: Stated preference studies on the value of health risk reductions have found valuations elicited from a private perspective to be both higher and lower compared to valuations elicited from a public perspective. Although relevant, the individual's ability to correctly predict the valuation that other individuals assign to the risk reduction has been insufficiently researched. We aim to verify whether individuals exhibit pure altruistic preferences and if this is the case, whether the presence of pure altruism leads to biased valuation of public risk reductions due to misjudgement about other individuals' preferences. We conduct a large-scale online incentivised experiment as a variant of a public good game in which the individual's final endowment is determined by choices made in the experiment. Results suggest that individuals act as pure altruists and hence try to account for the benefits obtained by others of being insured. The results also suggest that individuals fail to correctly predict other individuals' benefits from the insurance, which leads to non-optimal outcomes and biased valuations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102550.abstractZh: 关于健康风险降低价值的偏好研究发现，从私人角度出发得出的估值与从公共角度出发得出的估值相比，既有较高的估值，也有较低的估值。尽管这一点很重要，但个体正确预测其他个体对风险降低价值的评估能力尚未得到充分研究。我们的目的是验证个体是否表现出纯粹的利他主义偏好，如果确实如此，那么纯粹的利他主义是否会导致由于对其他人偏好的误判而使得对公共风险降低价值的评估出现偏差。我们开展了一项大规模的在线激励实验，作为公共物品博弈的一种变体，其中个体的最终收益由实验中的选择决定。结果表明，个体表现出纯粹的利他主义行为，因此会考虑他人因投保而获得的利益。研究结果还表明，个体无法正确预测其他个体从保险中获得的利益，这导致了非最优的结果和偏见的估值。

abstract.text: We evaluate the consequences for patients of being matched to a new primary care provider due to practice closures. Using an event study and population-level data of patients and providers in Denmark, we find that the transition between providers is smooth; among re-matched patients, there is little change in primary care utilization at the extensive margin. Second, we document a 17% increase in fee-for-service per visit and a large increase in the probability that the patient initiates drug therapy targeting chronic and underdiagnosed diseases (hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and diabetes). Additionally, the re-matched patients are more likely to be admitted to inpatient care for these diseases. The increase in therapeutic initiation is not primarily because the new providers are relatively predisposed to prescribing these drugs. Instead, it appears that when patients match to new providers, there is a consequential reassessment of patients' medical needs which leads to the initiation of new treatment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102551.abstractZh: 我们评估了由于诊所关闭而需要更换初级保健提供者对患者的影响。通过事件研究和丹麦患者及提供者的群体数据，我们发现提供者的更换过程较为顺利；在重新匹配的患者中，初级保健的使用情况几乎没有变化。其次，我们发现每次就诊的费用增加了17%，并且患者开始针对慢性及未被充分诊断的疾病（如高血压、高脂血症和糖尿病）进行药物治疗的概率也显著上升。此外，重新匹配的患者更有可能因这些疾病而接受住院治疗。治疗开始的增多并非主要因为新提供者更倾向于开具这些药物，而是因为当患者更换了提供者时，会对自身的医疗需求进行重新评估，从而促使新的治疗方法的启动。

abstract.text: This study examines how maternal education shapes the life and health of their children. Causal effects are identified from a Danish school reform that increased minimum compulsory schooling from 7 to 9 years in 1972 and estimates are based on large administrative registers. We find that the reform as well as maternal education when instrumented by it, has significant, positive effects on mothers' age at first birth and maternal health. Nevertheless, maternal education has no systematic causal effects on child health, neither at birth, during childhood, or in adolescence. This null finding is robust to a wide range of model specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102552.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了母亲的教育水平如何影响其子女的生活和健康。通过1972年丹麦的一项教育改革，义务教育年限从7年增加到9年，以此识别因果效应，并基于大型行政登记数据进行了估算。研究发现，这项改革以及母亲的教育水平对母亲初育年龄和母亲健康有显著的积极影响。然而，母亲的教育水平对儿童健康并没有系统性影响，无论是在出生时、儿童时期还是青少年时期。这一无效应结果在多种模型设定下依然成立。

abstract.text: In many countries, exports are highly concentrated among a few “superstar” firms. We estimate the export decisions of superstar firms as the result of a complete information, simultaneous, discrete choice, static entry game. We employ a dataset on the universe of Danish trade transactions by firm, product and destination. We also obtain detailed information on applied, preferential tariff protection from the MAcMap-HS6 database. We find evidence of strong negative competitive effects of entry: in the absence of strategic competitive effects, firms would be 53.2 percentage points more likely to export to a given market. Next, we run two counterfactual exercises. We show that failing to account for the strategic interaction among superstar exporters leads to: (i) overstating the probability that firms would start exporting to a market following tariff elimination by a factor of two; and, (ii) overstating the probability that firms would stop exporting to a market if tariffs were imposed by a factor of more than five.

10.1016/j.jinteco.2020.103405.abstractZh: 在许多国家，出口高度集中在少数“超级明星”企业手中。我们将这些超级明星企业的出口决策视为完全信息、同时发生、离散选择、静态进入博弈的结果。我们使用了丹麦企业、产品和目的地之间的贸易交易数据集。同时，我们还从MACMap-HS6数据库中获得了关于优惠关税保护的详细信息。我们发现，企业进入市场的竞争效应非常显著：在没有战略竞争效应的情况下，企业向特定市场出口的可能性会高出53.2个百分点。接下来，我们进行了两个反事实模拟实验。结果显示，如果不考虑超级明星出口商之间的战略互动，会导致：(i) 企业开始向市场出口的概率被高估了两倍；(ii) 如果征收关税，企业停止向市场出口的概率被高估了五倍以上。

abstract.text: We use the Japanese Management and Organizational Practices Survey (JP MOPS) across six industries to understand the unique and general features of Japanese management practices and their impact on productivity. This study uses management scores, constructed from survey questions about management practices, that intend to measure the quality of operational efficiency embedded in a set of management practices. Our analyses reveal several interesting and shared features of Japanese management practices. First, there is substantial variation in management scores across establishments in each industry. Second, the patterns of management practices and their association with potential drivers are quite similar across the six industries. Third, management scores are high when establishments recognize that they face many competitors. Fourth, management scores are positively associated with labor productivity in most industries. Finally, labor shares decline with management scores. This study shows important roles played by management practices in establishment and firm activities.

10.1016/j.jjie.2021.101152.abstractZh: 我们采用日本管理与组织实践调查（JP MOPS）在六个行业中的数据，以了解日本管理实践的独特特征及其对生产力的影响。本研究利用从管理实践相关调查中得出的管理评分指标，旨在衡量管理实践中所体现的运营效率水平。我们的分析揭示了日本管理实践的一些有趣且普遍存在的特征。首先，不同行业中的各企业管理评分存在显著差异。其次，六种行业中的管理实践模式及其与潜在驱动因素的关联方式非常相似。第三，当企业意识到面临众多竞争对手时，其管理评分较高。第四，在大多数行业中，管理评分与劳动生产率呈正相关。最后，管理评分与劳动力占比呈负相关。本研究表明，管理实践在企业和机构活动中发挥着重要作用。

abstract.text: We investigate the marginal value of information in the context of health signals that people receive after checkups. Although underlying health status is similar for individuals just below and above a clinical threshold, treatments differ according to the checkup signals they receive. For the general population, whereas health warnings about diabetes increase healthcare utilization, health outcomes do not improve. However, among high-risk individuals, outcomes do improve, and improved health is worth its cost. These results indicate that the marginal value of health information depends on setting appropriate thresholds for health warnings and targeting individuals most likely to benefit from follow-up medical care.

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2021.104368.abstractZh: 我们研究了在体检后人们收到的健康信号中信息的边际价值。尽管接近临床阈值前后的个体基本健康状况相似，但根据他们收到的体检信号，治疗方法会有所不同。对于普通人群而言，关于糖尿病的健康警告虽然增加了医疗利用，但健康结果并未改善。然而，在高风险人群中，健康结果确实有所改善，而且改善的健康状况是值得付出成本的。这些结果表明，健康信息的边际价值取决于为健康警告设定适当的阈值，以及针对最有可能从后续医疗护理中受益的个体进行定向宣传。

abstract.text: Consumer choice policies may improve the matching of consumers and providers, and may spur competition over quality dimensions relevant to consumers. However, the gains from choice may fail to materialise in markets characterised by information frictions and switching costs. We use two large-scale randomised field experiments in primary health care to examine if individuals reconsider their provider choice when receiving leaflets with comparative information and pre-paid choice forms by postal mail. The first experiment targeted a representative subset of the 1.3 million residents in a Swedish region. The second targeted new residents in the same region, a group expected to have less prior information and lower switching costs than the general population. The propensity to switch providers increased after the interventions in both the population-representative sample (by 0.6–0.8 percentage points, 10–14%) and among new residents (2.3 percentage points, 26%). The results demonstrate that there are demand side frictions in the primary care market. Exploratory analyses indicate that the effects on switching were larger in urban markets and that the interventions had heterogeneous effects on the type of providers chosen, and on health care and drug consumption.

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2021.104390.abstractZh: 消费者选择政策可能有助于改善消费者与提供者的匹配，并可能促进与消费者相关的质量方面的竞争。然而，在信息摩擦和转换成本较高的市场中，选择带来的好处可能无法实现。我们通过在初级卫生保健领域进行两项大规模随机实地实验，来研究当个人收到包含比较信息的传单并通过邮政邮件收到预先付费的选择表格时，是否会重新考虑其提供者的选择。第一项实验针对的是瑞典某个地区130万居民中的代表性子集。第二项实验则针对同一地区的新居民，这些新居民通常比普通人群拥有较少的信息和较低的转换成本。在这两个样本群体中，转换提供者的倾向性都有所增加——在代表性样本群体中增加了0.6-0.8个百分点，在新增居民中增加了2.3个百分点。结果表明，初级卫生保健市场存在需求方面的摩擦。探索性分析表明，在城市市场中，转换的影响更为显著，而且这些干预措施对选择的服务提供者类型以及医疗保健和药物消费产生了不同的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper we explore the geographical scope of hospital competition on quality, using Italian data on over 207,000 patients admitted to 174 hospitals located in the Lombardy region in the years 2008–2014. We propose an economic framework that incorporates both local and global forms of quality competition among hospitals, the latter emerging from periodically released hospital performance rankings. Under this framework, we derive the hospital reaction functions and, accordingly, we characterize the structure of interdependence among hospital qualities. We employ recent methods from the graphical modelling literature to estimate the set of local rivals for each hospital, as well as the degree of global interdependence among hospitals. Consistently with our micro-founded framework, our results show a significant positive degree of short- and long-range dependence, suggesting the existence of forms of local and global competition amongst hospitals with relevant implications for health care policy.

10.1016/j.regsciurbeco.2021.103696.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了医院在质量方面的竞争地理范围，使用了2008至2014年间伦巴第地区174家医院收治的207,000名患者的意大利数据。我们提出了一个经济框架，该框架包含了医院之间的本地和全球形式的质量竞争，后者源自定期发布的医院绩效排名。在这个框架下，我们推导出了医院的反应函数，并据此描述了医院质量之间的相互依赖结构。我们采用了图形建模领域的最新方法，来估计每家医院当地的竞争对手数量，以及医院之间的全球相互依赖程度。与我们的微观基础框架一致，我们的结果显示出显著的短期和长期依赖性，这表明医院之间存在本地和全球形式的竞争，这对医疗保健政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This article reviews experience curve applications in energy technology studies to illustrate best practices in analyzing technological learning. Findings are then applied to evaluate future performance projections of three emerging offshore energy technologies, namely, offshore wind, wave & tidal, and biofuel production from seaweed. Key insights from the review are: First, the experience curve approach provides a strong analytical construct to describe and project technology cost developments. However, disaggregating the influences of individual learning mechanisms on observed cost developments demands extensive data requirements, e.g., R&D expenditures, component level cost information, which are often not publicly available/readily accessible. Second, in an experience curve analysis, the LR estimate of the technology is highly sensitive towards the changes in model specifications and data assumptions.. Future studies should evaluate the impact of these variations and inform the uncertainties associated with using the observed learning rates. Third, the review of the literature relevant to offshore energy technology developments revealed that experience curve studies have commonly applied single-factor experience curve model to derive technology cost projections. This has led to an overview of the role of distinct learning mechanisms (e.g., learning-by-doing, scale effects), and factors (site-specific parameters) influencing their developments. To overcome these limitations, we propose a coherent framework based on the findings of this review. The framework disaggregates the technological development process into multiple stages and maps the expected data availability, characteristics, and methodological options to quantify the learning effects. The evaluation of the framework using three offshore energy technologies signals that the data limitations that restrict the process of disaggregating the learning process and identifying cost drivers can be overcome by utilizing detailed bottom-up engineering cost modeling and technology diffusion curves; with experience curve models.

10.1016/j.rser.2021.111084.abstractZh: 本文回顾了经验曲线在能源技术研究中的应用，以说明分析技术学习的最佳实践。随后，研究结果被应用于评估三种新兴海上能源技术的未来性能预测，即海上风能、波浪与潮汐能，以及海藻生物燃料的生产。回顾得出的关键见解包括：首先，经验曲线方法为描述和技术成本发展提供了强有力的分析框架。然而，要分解各个学习机制对观察到的成本发展的影响，需要大量的数据支持，例如研发支出、组件级成本信息，而这些数据往往无法公开获取或容易获得。其次，在经验曲线分析中，技术的LR估计值对模型参数和数据假设的变化非常敏感。未来的研究应评估这些变化的影響，并揭示使用观察到的学习率所带来的不确定性。第三，对与海上能源技术发展相关的文献的回顾显示，经验曲线研究通常采用单因素经验曲线模型来推导技术成本预测。这导致了对不同学习机制（如实践学习、规模效应）以及影响技术发展的因素（特定地点参数）的概述。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种基于本次回顾结果的连贯框架。该框架将技术发展过程分解为多个阶段，并根据预期的数据可用性、特征和方法论选项来量化学习效应。通过对三种离岸能源技术框架的评估发现，通过利用详细的自下而上的工程成本建模和技术扩散曲线，以及经验曲线模型，可以克服限制学习过程分解和识别成本驱动因素的数据限制。

abstract.text: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic highlights the importance of strong and resilient health systems. Yet how much a society should spend on healthcare is difficult to determine because additional health expenditures imply lower expenditures on other types of consumption. Furthermore, the welfare-maximizing ("efficient") aggregate amount and composition of health expenditures depend on efficiency concepts at three levels that often get blurred in the debate. While the understanding of efficiency is good at the micro- and meso-levels-that is, relating to minimal spending for a given bundle of treatments and to the optimal mix of different treatments, respectively-this understanding rarely links to the efficiency of aggregate health expenditure at the macroeconomic level. While micro- and meso-efficiency are necessary for macro-efficiency, they are not sufficient. We propose a novel framework of a macro-efficiency score to assess welfare-maximizing aggregate health expenditure. This allows us to assess the extent to which selected major economies underspend or overspend on health relative to their gross domestic products per capita. We find that all economies under consideration underspend on healthcare with the exception of the United States. Underspending is particularly severe in China, India, and the Russian Federation. Our study emphasizes that the major and urgent issue in many countries is underspending on health at the macroeconomic level, rather than containing costs at the microeconomic level.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2021.114270.abstractZh: 2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行凸显了强大且具有韧性的卫生系统的重要性。然而，一个社会在医疗保健上的支出应该是多少却难以确定，因为额外的卫生支出意味着其他类型的消费支出会减少。此外，旨在最大化福利的卫生支出总量和构成取决于三个层面的效率概念，而这些概念在讨论中常常被混淆。虽然对微观和 Meso 层面的效率理解很好——即针对给定治疗组合的最小支出以及不同治疗的最佳组合——但这种理解很少与宏观经济层面的总体卫生支出效率相关联。虽然微观和 Meso 层面的效率对宏观效率是必要的，但它们并不足够。我们提出了一个新的框架，即宏观效率评分，来评估旨在最大化福利的总体卫生支出。这使我们能够评估主要经济体相对于其人均国内生产总值在卫生支出上的不足或过度支出情况。我们发现，所有被考虑的经济体在卫生支出上都存在不足，除了美国。在China、India和俄罗斯联邦，这种不足尤为严重。我们的研究强调，许多国家在宏观经济层面的卫生支出不足是一个主要且紧迫的问题，而不是在微观经济层面控制成本的问题。

abstract.text: Formal structure is often considered important for the growth and survival of firms. Within the literature focused on the institutional antecedents of formalization, less attention has been paid to the drivers of formal management practices. To help fill this gap, we study how state and market institutional logics affect the adoption and utility of formal management practices in manufacturing firms. We theorize how institutional complexity, resulting from coexistent, conflicting state and market institutional logics, may exert differential pressure on state-owned and private firms’ decisions to adopt these practices, diverging from prior studies that focus primarily on the role of market logics in their adoption. We then test these propositions in a representative sample of 390 manufacturing firms in China with uniquely detailed data on structured management practices using regression analysis. Variation in ownership differentiates the relative influence of state and market institutional logics on firms in China’s transition economy. We find that measures of structured management practices are higher for state-owned firms, while scores are significantly lower for domestic private firms. We further show that, on average, a firm’s overall management practice score is positively and significantly related to total factor productivity (TFP) in state-owned firms, but the correlation is no different from zero in both domestic and foreign private firms. Our findings support a role for structured management practices as a response to institutional complexity, by enabling firms to satisfy multiple imperatives from distinct audiences.

10.1016/j.worlddev.2020.105386.abstractZh: 形式结构通常被认为对企业的成长和生存至关重要。在关于形式化制度性前提的文献中，对正式管理实践的驱动因素关注较少。为了填补这一空白，我们研究了国家和市场制度逻辑如何影响制造企业中正式管理实践的采用和效用。我们理论化地探讨了由于国家和市场制度逻辑共存且相互冲突而导致的制度复杂性，如何对国有和私营企业的决策产生不同的压力，这与之前主要关注市场逻辑在正式管理实践采用中的作用的研究有所不同。随后，我们利用回归分析，对中国390家制造企业的代表性样本进行了研究，这些企业拥有关于结构化管理实践的独特详细数据。所有权结构的不同使得国家和市场制度逻辑对企业的影响程度有所不同。我们发现，国有企业的结构化管理实践得分较高，而国内私营企业的得分则明显较低。进一步分析表明，平均而言，国有企业的整体管理实践得分与全要素生产率呈正相关，但这种相关性在国内外私营企业中均为零。我们的研究结果支持了结构化管理实践作为应对制度复杂性的一种方式，它能够帮助企业满足来自不同群体的多种需求。

abstract.text: The governments of China and the United States - despite profound differences in history, culture, economic structure, and political ideology - both engage the private sector in the pursuit of public value. This book employs the term collaborative governance to describe relationships where neither the public nor private party is fully in control, arguing that such shared discretion is needed to deliver value to citizens. This concept is exemplified across a wide range of policy arenas, such as constructing high speed rail, hosting the Olympics, building human capital, and managing the healthcare system. This book will help decision-makers apply the principles of collaborative governance to effectively serve the public, and will enable China and the United States to learn from each other's experiences. It will empower public decision-makers to more wisely engage the private sector. The book's overarching conclusion is that transparency is the key to the legitimate growth of collaborative governance.

10.1017/9781108938167.abstractZh: 中国和美国政府尽管在历史、文化、经济结构和政治理念上存在巨大差异，但都积极引导私营部门参与公共价值的创造。本书采用“协作治理”这一概念来描述那些双方都无法完全掌控的局面，认为这种共享决策权对于为公民创造价值至关重要。这一理念在多个政策领域都有体现，例如建设高速铁路、举办奥运会、培养人力资本以及管理医疗体系。本书将帮助决策者运用协作治理的原则来有效服务公众，并使中美两国能够从彼此的经验中汲取教训。它将提升公共决策者明智地引导私营部门的能力。本书的最终结论是，透明度是协作治理合法发展的关键。

abstract.text: Few, if any, areas of endeavor show a more complicated, and more consequential, tangle of publicness and privateness than health care. It is a prominent, but for the most part, poorly performing arena of public–private interaction in the United States. The governance of this vital sector of the economy – more than one-sixth of GDP – is collaborative; public funds pay for roughly half of medical services (with most of the private spending subsidized through tax preferences), while the vast majority of providers are private. America’s public leaders often fail to recognize the dynamic of shared discretion at the heart of the health-care system, and this failure contributes to the private sector delivering care that is less effective, affordable, and accessible than it should be.

10.1017/9781108938167.007.abstractZh: 在所有的领域当中，几乎没有哪个领域比医疗保健领域更显得公共性与私密性之间的复杂关系如此错综复杂，且后果更为严重。在美国，这是公共与私人互动的一个重要领域，但大多数情况下，这一领域的运作效率并不高。这一经济重要部门的治理方式是协作性的；公共资金大约支付了医疗服务费用的一半（而大部分私人支出则通过税收优惠得到补贴），而绝大多数医疗服务提供者都是私营机构。美国的公共领导层往往未能认识到医疗保健体系核心的共享决策机制，这种忽视导致私营部门提供的医疗服务效果不如预期，价格也不如人意，且难以获得。

abstract.text: Early in this book, we describe the cycle that successful collaboration requires: analyze, assign, design, and assess (AADA). The chapters that followed dissected the experiences of China and the United States in using, misusing, or mistakenly not using collaborative governance across a broad spectrum of policy areas. Those accounts reveal, for both nations, many successes and more than a few failures. The successes tend to occur when collaborators devise by creative effort, or improvise by trial and error, the proper alloy of public and private responsibilities and the proper sharing of discretion. In many cases, reassuringly, initial failure is the overture to later triumph; when one set of arrangements works badly, collaborators try again.

10.1017/9781108938167.008.abstractZh: 在本书的初段，我们描述了成功合作所要求的循环：分析、分配、设计以及评估。后续章节分别探讨了中国和美国在广泛政策领域中使用、滥用或错误地不采用合作治理的经验。这些案例揭示了两国在合作中的诸多成功与失败。成功的案例往往发生在合作方通过创造性努力或试错来调配公共与私人责任的适当比例，以及实现适当的信息共享时。令人欣慰的是，最初的失败往往为后来的成功铺平道路；当某种安排效果不佳时，合作方会再次尝试。

abstract.text: The literature on stochastic programming typically restricts attention to problems that fulfill constraint qualifications. The literature on estimation and inference under partial identification frequently restricts the geometry of identified sets with diverse high-level assumptions. These superficially appear to be different approaches to closely related problems. We extensively analyze their relation. Among other things, we show that for partial identification through pure moment inequalities, numerous assumptions from the literature essentially coincide with the Mangasarian–Fromowitz constraint qualification. This clarifies the relation between well-known contributions, including within econometrics, and elucidates stringency, as well as ease of verification, of some high-level assumptions in seminal papers.

10.1017/s0266466621000207.abstractZh: 关于随机规划的研究通常只关注满足约束条件的问题。而在部分识别下的估计与推断研究中，研究者们常常通过各种高级假设来限制已识别集合的几何特性。这些看似不同的方法实际上针对的是密切相关的问题。我们对此进行了深入分析。我们发现，对于通过纯矩不等式进行部分识别的情况，文献中的许多假设实际上与Mangasarian–Fromowitz约束条件是一致的。这阐明了一些著名研究成果之间的关系，包括经济学领域内的研究成果，并揭示了某些高级假设的严格性以及验证的便利性。

abstract.text: Public reporting of clinical performance is increasingly used in many countries to improve quality and enhance accountability of the health system. The assumption is that greater transparency will stimulate improvements by clinicians in response to peer pressure, patient choice or competition. The international diffusion of public reporting might suggest greater similarity between health systems. Alternatively, national and local contexts (including health system imperatives, professional power and organisational culture) might continue to shape its form and impact, implying continued divergence. The paper considers public reporting in the USA and England through the lens of Scott's 'pillars' institutional framework. The USA was arguably the first country to adopt public reporting systematically in the late 1980s. England is a more recent adopter; it is now being widely adopted through the National Health Service (NHS). Drawing on qualitative data from California and England, this paper compares the behavioural and policy responses to public reporting by health system stakeholders at micro, meso and macro levels and through the intersection of ideas, interests, institutions and individuals through. The interplay between the regulative, normative and cultural-cognitive pillars helps explain the observed patterns of on-going divergence.

10.1017/s1744133120000444.abstractZh: 在许多国家，公开披露临床绩效越来越被用作提高医疗质量、增强医疗系统问责性的手段。人们认为，更高的透明度会促使临床医生在同伴压力、患者选择或竞争的作用下进行改进。国际范围内公开披露实践的普及可能表明，不同医疗系统之间存在一定的相似性。然而，国家或地方层面的因素（包括医疗系统的需求、专业权力以及组织文化）仍可能继续影响公开披露的形式和效果，从而导致持续的分化。本文通过斯科特的“支柱”制度框架来探讨美国和英国的公开披露实践。美国可能是第一个在20世纪80年代末系统性采用公开披露制度的国家。英国则是一个较新的采用者，目前正通过国民健康服务系统广泛推广这一做法。本文基于加利福尼亚州和英国的定性数据，比较了医疗系统各利益相关者在微观、中观和宏观层面对公开披露的反应，以及这些反应如何受到观念、利益、制度和个体等因素的影响。监管性、规范性和文化认知性支柱之间的相互作用有助于解释这种持续分化现象背后的原因。
