abstract.text: Zusammenfassung Ein zentrales Anliegen für ein funktionierendes Gesundheitswesen ist die Frage, ob der Wettbewerb zwischen Leistungserbringern und dessen Regulierung bestmögliche Versorgungsqualität erbringt. Aktuell wird Qualität oft uneinheitlich und unzureichend erbracht, umfassende Ansätze für die Definition und Messung von Qualität, sowohl aus klinischer als auch Patientenperspektive, existieren nicht. Zudem gilt die Gesundheitsversorgung in der Ökonomie als Vertrauensgut und ist durch starke Informationsasymmetrien zwischen Patienten, Leistungserbringern und Kostenträgern gekennzeichnet. Der vorliegende Beitrag diskutiert anhand gesundheitsökonomischer Ansätze die Einflussfaktoren auf Behandlungsqualität sowohl auf Nachfrage- als auch auf Angebotsseite und beleuchtet aktuelle gesundheitspolitische Maßnahmen zur Unterstützung bestmöglicher Ergebnisqualität im Wettbewerb zwischen Leistungserbringern.

10.1055/a-1543-4831.abstractZh: 摘要 一个正常运转的医疗保健体系的核心问题是，医疗服务提供者之间的竞争以及相关监管是否能够确保最佳的医疗服务质量。目前，质量的提供往往缺乏统一性和充分性，无论是从临床还是患者角度出发，都缺乏全面的质量定义和衡量方法。此外，在经济学中，医疗服务被视为一种信任资产，而患者、医疗服务提供者和费用承担者之间的信息不对称现象十分严重。本文通过健康经济学的视角，讨论了影响治疗质量的因素，包括需求端和供给端，并探讨了当前旨在促进医疗服务提供者之间竞争以取得最佳治疗质量的卫生政策措施。

abstract.text: We shed light on the importance of government disclosure in public emergency management. During the outbreak of COVID-19, provinces in China entered a government disclosure regime, which mandated the disclosure of the number of people infected with the virus on a daily basis. Each province also voluntarily disclosed its own virus situation. We find that various forms of province-level government disclosure generally reduced the number of trips made by the infected and sped up their diagnosis. They also raised attention paid to the virus and self-protection awareness as well as reduced mobility among the susceptible. Finally, government voluntary disclosure helped to reduce the duration of local epidemics. We conclude that government disclosure can be effective in instilling the correct human behaviors that are conducive to fighting the pandemic.

10.1057/s41599-021-00986-5.abstractZh: 我们揭示了政府在公共应急管理中信息披露的重要性。在COVID-19疫情爆发期间，中国的各省实施了政府信息披露制度，要求每日公开感染病毒的人数。每个省份还自愿公开自身的病毒情况。我们发现，各种形式的省级政府信息披露通常减少了感染者的出行次数，并加快了诊断速度。它们还提高了人们对病毒的关注和自我防护意识，同时减少了易感人群的活动范围。最后，政府自愿信息披露有助于缩短地方疫情的持续时间。我们得出结论，政府信息披露能够有效引导人们采取正确的行为，从而有助于抗击疫情。

abstract.text: Although the literature has found that targeted poverty alleviation (TPA) policy has many positive effects, whether it has a negative impact on farmers’ credit has been under-analyzed. A regression discontinuity approach has been employed to estimate the TPA policy’s causal effects on credit default because the registered poor farmer was primarily determined by whether a farmer’s pre-policy income fell below a given poverty line. Using data from China Household Finance Survey in 2015 and 2017, we have found that China’s registered poor farmers have a higher probability of credit default. This is because registered poor farmers protected by TPA policy pursue higher risk economic activities, leading to a higher credit default. Further analysis has shown that credit default broadly occurs in married registered poor farmers. In contrast, it rarely occurs among those with high social capital. Our empirical results have suggested the Chinese government should improve the identification rules of registered poor farmers, such as subjective psychology, and strengthen the monitoring system of their participation in economic activities.

10.1080/00036846.2021.2016585.abstractZh: 尽管文献发现定向扶贫政策具有许多积极效果，但其对农民信贷的负面影响是否明显，尚未得到充分分析。本研究采用回归不连续方法，通过登记在册的贫困农民是否其政策实施前的收入低于特定贫困线来估计定向扶贫政策对信贷违约的因果效应。利用2015年和2017年中国家庭金融调查的数据，我们发现登记在册的贫困农民发生信贷违约的概率更高。这是因为受定向扶贫政策保护的贫困农民更倾向于从事高风险经济活动，从而导致更高的信贷违约率。进一步分析表明，信贷违约主要发生在已婚登记在册的贫困农民中，而在具有较高社会资本的群体中则很少发生这种情况。我们的实证结果提示，中国政府应改进对贫困农民的身份认定标准，如考虑主观心理因素，并加强对其参与经济活动的监管。

abstract.text: Nearest-neighbor matching is a popular nonparametric tool to create balance between treatment and control groups in observational studies. As a preprocessing step before regression, matching reduces the dependence on parametric modeling assumptions. In current empirical practice, however, the matching step is often ignored in the calculation of standard errors and confidence intervals. In this article, we show that ignoring the matching step results in asymptotically valid standard errors if matching is done without replacement and the regression model is correctly specified relative to the population regression function of the outcome variable on the treatment variable and all the covariates used for matching. However, standard errors that ignore the matching step are not valid if matching is conducted with replacement or, more crucially, if the second step regression model is misspecified in the sense indicated above. Moreover, correct specification of the regression model is not required for consistent estimation of treatment effects with matched data. We show that two easily implementable alternatives produce approximations to the distribution of the post-matching estimator that are robust to misspecification. A simulation study and an empirical example demonstrate the empirical relevance of our results. Supplementary materials for this article are available online.

10.1080/01621459.2020.1840383.abstractZh: 最近邻匹配是一种常用的非参数工具，用于在观察性研究中平衡处理组和对照组。作为回归前的预处理步骤，匹配可以减少对参数建模假设的依赖。然而，在当前的实证实践中，匹配步骤往往被忽略在标准误差和置信区间的计算中。本文表明，如果匹配是无替换的，并且回归模型相对于结果变量对处理变量以及所有用于匹配的协变量的总体回归函数而言是正确的，那么忽略匹配步骤可以得到渐近有效标准误差。然而，如果匹配是带有替换的，或者更关键的是，如果第二步回归模型存在上述错误指定，那么忽略匹配步骤得到的标准误差则无效。此外，对于使用匹配数据来一致估计处理效应来说，正确的回归模型指定并不是必需的。我们展示了两种易于实施的替代方法，这些方法能够产生对匹配后估计量分布的近似，并且对模型错误指定具有鲁棒性。一项模拟研究和一个实证案例证明了我们结果的实证相关性。本文的补充材料可在线获取。

abstract.text: Using data from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study–Kindergarten Class of 1999, we show that parental beliefs about a child’s cognitive skill relative to children of the same age are distorted by a child’s cognitive skill relative to children in the same school. Parents of children attending schools with low (high) average skills tend to believe their child is higher (lower) in the overall skill distribution than they actually are. Teacher evaluations of child skill also exhibit local distortions, providing a channel through which parental biases might arise. Finally, we relate parental beliefs and investment, providing insight on how local distortions may impact the skill distribution.

10.1086/711347.abstractZh: 利用1999年幼儿纵向研究幼儿园班级的数据，我们发现父母对孩子与同龄孩子的认知能力的看法会受到孩子相对于同校其他孩子的认知能力的影响而扭曲。那些孩子就读于平均能力较低的学校（或较高的学校）的父母，往往认为自己的孩子在整个能力分布中处于较高（或较低）的位置，而实际上并非如此。教师对孩子能力的评估也表现出局部扭曲，这为父母偏见的产生提供了途径。最后，我们将父母的信念与投入联系起来，从而洞察局部扭曲如何影响能力分布。

abstract.text: Standard measures of productivity display enormous dispersion across farms in Africa. Crop yields and input intensities appear to vary greatly, seemingly in conflict with a model of efficient allocation across farms. In this paper, we present a theoretical framework for distinguishing between measurement error, unobserved heterogeneity, and potential misallocation. Using rich panel data from farms in Tanzania and Uganda, we estimate our model using a flexible specification in which we allow for several kinds of measurement error and heterogeneity. We find that measurement error and heterogeneity together account for a large fraction of the dispersion in measured productivity.

10.1086/711369.abstractZh: 非洲各农场的生产力标准指标显示出巨大的差异。作物产量和投入强度似乎存在很大差异，这与农场间有效分配的模式似乎并不一致。在本文中，我们提出了一个理论框架，用于区分测量误差、未观察到的异质性以及潜在的错配分配。利用坦桑尼亚和乌干达农场的丰富面板数据，我们通过一个灵活的模型框架来估计模型，该框架考虑了多种类型的测量误差和异质性。我们发现，测量误差和异质性共同导致了测量到生产力差异的很大一部分。

abstract.text: We study whether gender influences credit attribution for group work using observational data and two experiments. We use data from academic economists to test whether coauthorship matters differently for tenure for men and women. We find that, conditional on quality and other observables, men are tenured similarly regardless of whether they coauthor or solo author. Women, however, are less likely to receive tenure the more they coauthor. We then conduct two experiments that demonstrate that biases in credit attribution in settings without confounds exist. Taken together, our results are best explained by gender and stereotypes influencing credit attribution for group work.

10.1086/711401.abstractZh: 我们研究了性别是否会影响团队工作的信用分配，通过观察和两项实验进行了研究。我们使用学术经济学家的数据来测试共同作者身份对男性与女性获得终身教职的影响是否存在差异。研究发现，在质量和其他可观测因素相同的情况下，无论男性是共同作者还是单独作者，他们获得终身教职的方式是相同的。然而，女性如果更频繁地参与共同创作，获得终身教职的可能性则较低。随后，我们进行了两项实验，证明在没有混淆因素的情况下，信用分配中的偏见确实存在。综合来看，我们的研究结果最好解释为性别和刻板印象对团队工作信用分配的影响。

abstract.text: This paper performs a structural analysis of sequential auctions with both synergy and affiliation across auctions. I propose a flexible yet tractable sequential auction model under the private value paradigm and establish its nonparametric identification, demonstrating an intuitive and general method for disentangling synergy from affiliation. After developing an estimation procedure closely tied to the identification steps, I apply it to data on adjacent oil and gas leases that are auctioned sequentially. I assess the role played by affiliation versus synergy in the observed allocation patterns and evaluate the counterfactual policy of bundled auctions.

10.1086/711402.abstractZh: 本文对具有协同效应和关联性的连续拍卖进行了结构分析。在私人价值范式下，我提出了一个灵活且可行的连续拍卖模型，并建立了其非参数识别方法，从而提供了一种直观且通用的方法来区分协同效应和关联性。在开发了一种与识别步骤紧密相关的估计程序后，我将其应用于连续拍卖的相邻石油和天然气租赁数据。我评估了关联性与协同效应在观察到的分配模式中所起的作用，并评估了捆绑拍卖的反事实政策。

abstract.text: Using data on liquidity shortfalls generated by the fraud and failure of a cash-in-transit firm, we demonstrate effects on firms’ trade credit usage. We find that firms manage liquidity shortages by increasing the amount of credit drawn from suppliers and decreasing the amount issued to customers. The compounded trade credit adjustments are on average of similar magnitude as corresponding adjustments in cash holdings, suggesting that trade credit positions are economically important sources of reserve liquidity for firms. The underlying mechanism in trade credit adjustments is in part due to shifts in overdue payments.

10.1086/711403.abstractZh: 通过研究一家现金运输公司因欺诈和倒闭而产生的流动性短缺数据，我们探讨了这一现象对企业贸易信用使用的影响。研究发现，企业通过增加从供应商处获得的信用额度，并减少向客户提供的信用额度来应对流动性短缺。这些贸易信用的调整幅度平均与现金持有量的相应调整幅度相当，这表明贸易信用状况是企业储备流动性的重要经济来源。贸易信用调整背后的机制部分源于逾期付款的变化。

abstract.text: How much do a manager’s interpersonal skills with subordinates, which we call people management skills, affect employee outcomes? Are managers rewarded for having such skills? Using personnel data from a large high-tech firm, we show that survey-measured people management skills have a strong negative relation to employee turnover. A causal interpretation is reinforced by several research designs, including those exploiting new workers joining the firm and workers switching managers. However, people management skills do not consistently improve most observed nonattrition outcomes. Better people managers themselves receive higher subjective performance ratings, higher promotion rates, and larger salary increases.

10.1086/711409.abstractZh: 经理与下属之间的人际关系能力，我们称之为人员管理技能，对员工的结果有何影响？经理是否因为具备这样的技能而获得奖励？通过一家大型高科技公司的人员数据，我们发现调查得出的人员管理技能与员工流动率之间存在强烈的负相关关系。多项研究设计进一步证实了这一因果关系，包括那些针对新加入公司的员工和更换经理的员工的调查。然而，人员管理技能并未持续改善大多数观察到的非倦怠结果。更优秀的人员管理者本身也会获得更高的主观绩效评分、更高的晋升机会以及更大的薪资增长。

abstract.text: This paper studies information frictions between parents and children and their effect on human capital investments. I provide biweekly information to a random sample of parents about their child’s missed assignments. Parents have upwardly biased beliefs about their child’s effort. Providing information attenuates this bias and improves student achievement. Using data from the experiment, I estimate a persuasion game between parents and their children that shows that the treatment effect is due to more accurate beliefs and reduced monitoring costs. Policy simulations from the model demonstrate that improving school reporting or providing more information to parents can increase learning at low cost.

10.1086/711410.abstractZh: 本文研究了父母与子女之间的信息摩擦及其对人力资本投资的影响。我每周向随机选取的家长提供其孩子缺课的信息。父母对于孩子的努力程度持有向上偏见的看法。提供这些信息可以削弱这种偏见，并提高学生的学业成绩。通过实验数据，我估计了父母与子女之间的一种说服博弈，结果表明这种影响源于更准确的判断和降低的监控成本。模型中的政策模拟表明，改善学校报告或向家长提供更多信息可以以较低的成本提升学习效果。

abstract.text: Online contests have become a prominent form of innovation procurement. Contest platforms often display a real-time public leaderboard to provide performance feedback. The impact of information disclosure on players’ decisions is theoretically ambiguous: some players may get discouraged and quit, while others may decide to keep working to remain competitive. We investigate the impact of a leaderboard on contest outcomes using two complementary approaches. First, we estimate a dynamic model using observational data and compare the equilibria with and without a leaderboard. Second, we present experimental evidence from student competitions. We find that a leaderboard on average improves competition outcomes.

10.1086/711762.abstractZh: 在线竞赛已成为创新采购的一种重要形式。竞赛平台通常会实时展示公共排行榜，以提供性能反馈。信息公开对玩家决策的影响在理论上存在不确定性：一些玩家可能会因此气馁而退出，而另一些玩家则可能会继续努力以保持竞争力。我们采用两种互补的方法来研究排行榜对竞赛结果的影响。首先，我们使用观察数据估计了一个动态模型，并比较了有无排行榜下的均衡状态。其次，我们从学生竞赛中获得了实验性证据。我们发现，排行榜平均而言能够提升竞赛结果。

abstract.text: Water fluoridation is a common but debated public policy. In this paper, we use Swedish registry data to study the causal effects of fluoride in drinking water. We exploit exogenous variation in natural fluoride stemming from variation in geological characteristics at water sources to identify its effects. First, we reconfirm the long-established positive effect of fluoride on dental health. Second, we estimate a zero effect on cognitive ability in contrast to several recent debated epidemiological studies. Third, fluoride is furthermore found to increase labor income. This effect is foremost driven by individuals from a lower socioeconomic background.

10.1086/711915.abstractZh: 水氟化是一项常见但存在争议的公共政策。在本文中，我们利用瑞典的登记数据来研究饮用水中氟化物对健康的因果效应。我们通过利用水源地质特征变化所导致的自然氟化物变化，来识别其影响。首先，我们再次证实了氟化物对口腔健康的长期积极影响。其次，与一些近期备受争议的流行病学研究相比，我们估计氟化物对认知能力的影响为零。此外，我们还发现氟化物能够增加劳动收入，这一效应主要受到来自较低社会经济背景的个体的影响。

abstract.text: We propose a methodology exploiting time diary data and “leisure Engel curves” to infer quality changes across leisure activities and measure the effects on the marginal return to leisure. We study leisure returns for men aged 21–30, who have shifted leisure toward video gaming and recreational computing and have had larger market work hour declines than older men or women since 2004. We show that recreational computing is distinctly a leisure luxury for younger men. By increasing the value of time, innovations to this leisure technology have lowered young men's work hours by 2%, or much of their work hours decline compared to older men's.

10.1086/711916.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法，利用时间日记数据和“休闲 Engel 曲线”来推断不同休闲活动之间的质量变化，并衡量其对休闲边际收益的影响。我们研究了21至30岁男性的休闲状况，自2004年以来，这些男性的休闲活动转向了视频游戏和娱乐计算，其工作小时数的减少幅度比年长男性或女性更大。我们发现，对于年轻男性来说，娱乐计算明显是一种休闲奢侈品。通过提升时间的价值，这项休闲技术的创新使年轻男性的工作小时数减少了2%，其工作小时数的减少幅度远远超过了年长男性。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new framework for studying multiproduct intermediaries when consumers demand multiple products and face search frictions. We show that a multiproduct intermediary is profitable even when it does not improve consumer search efficiency. The intermediary optimally stocks high-value products exclusively to attract consumers to visit and then profits by selling nonexclusive products that are relatively cheap to buy from upstream suppliers. Relative to the social optimum, the intermediary tends to be too big and stock too many products exclusively. We use the framework to study the design of shopping malls and the impact of direct-to-consumer sales by upstream suppliers on the retail market.

10.1086/711917.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个新的框架，用于研究当消费者需要多种产品且面临搜索障碍时，多产品中介机构的运作情况。我们证明，即使多产品中介机构无法提升消费者的搜索效率，它们仍然能够盈利。这些中介机构会优先储备高价值产品，以吸引消费者光顾，然后通过向上游供应商购买相对便宜的非独占性产品来获利。与社会的优化状态相比，这些中介机构往往规模过大，并且只储备过多的产品。我们利用这一框架来研究购物中心的设计，以及上游供应商直接面向消费者销售对零售市场的影响。

abstract.text: We estimate the economic surplus created by the Medicare Advantage program under its reformed competitive bidding rules. We use data on the universe of Medicare beneficiaries and develop a model of plan bidding that accounts for both market power and risk selection. We estimate that the Medicare Advantage program generates substantial surplus to participants (of $217 per enrollee-month), but that approximately two-thirds of this surplus is captured by insurers. We use the model to evaluate the impact of possible program changes, including changes that could increase competition and lead to lower profits and higher consumer surplus without raising taxpayer costs.

10.1086/711951.abstractZh: 我们估算了在改革后的竞争性招标规则下，Medicare Advantage计划所创造的经济剩余。我们使用Medicare受益人的数据，建立了一个考虑市场力量和风险选择的计划招标模型。我们估计，Medicare Advantage计划为参与者创造了可观的经济剩余，每名参保人每月为217美元，但大约三分之二的剩余收益被保险公司获取。我们利用该模型来评估可能的计划变更对剩余收益的影响，包括那些可能增加竞争、降低利润但提高消费者剩余，同时不增加纳税人负担的变更。

abstract.text: We study the optimal design of student financial aid as a function of parental income. We derive optimal financial aid formulas in a general model. We estimate a model of selection into college for the United States that comprises multidimensional heterogeneity, endogenous parental transfers, dropout, labor supply in college, and uncertain returns. We quantify optimal financial aid in the estimated model and find it is strongly declining in parental income even without distributional concerns. Equity and efficiency go hand in hand.

10.1086/711952.abstractZh: 我们研究了学生经济援助的最优设计，这一设计取决于父母的收入。我们在一般模型中推导出了最优经济援助公式。我们为美国建立了一个选择进入大学的模型，该模型包含多维异质性、父母的内生转移支付、辍学、大学劳动力供应以及不确定的回报等因素。我们在估算的模型中量化了最优经济援助的数额，并发现即使不考虑分配问题，最优经济援助在父母收入较低时也会显著减少。公平与效率是相辅相成的。

abstract.text: We study an R&D race between an established firm and a startup under asymmetric information. R&D investment brings success stochastically, but only if the innovation is feasible. The only asymmetry is that the established firm has better information about the feasibility of the innovation. We show that there is an equilibrium in which the poorly informed startup wins more often, and has higher expected profits, than the better-informed incumbent. When the informational asymmetry is large, this is the unique equilibrium outcome. The channel by which better information becomes a competitive disadvantage appears to be new and stems from the fact that better information dulls the incentive to learn from one’s rival.

10.1086/711953.abstractZh: 我们研究了一家成熟企业与一家处于信息不对称的初创企业之间的研发竞赛。研发投资会随机带来成功，但前提是创新是可行的。唯一的信息不对称之处在于，成熟企业拥有关于创新可行性的更多信息。我们发现，存在一个均衡状态，在这种状态下，信息不足的初创企业更频繁地获胜，并且其预期利润也高于信息更充分的企业。当信息不对称性较大时，这种均衡是唯一的。信息优势成为竞争劣势的渠道似乎是一个新的现象，其原因在于更好的信息会削弱从竞争对手那里学习的动力。

abstract.text: The use of order-flow information by financial firms has come to the forefront of the regulatory debate. Should a dealer who acquires information by taking client orders be allowed to use or share that information? We explore how information sharing affects dealers, clients, and issuer revenues in US Treasury auctions, in a model calibrated to auction results data, which we use to quantify counterfactuals. Sharing information reduces uncertainty about future value. With less uncertainty, risk-averse bidders bid more. For investors, the welfare effects of information sharing depend on how information is shared and how it affects asymmetry. The model shows that investors can benefit when dealers share information with each other, not when they share more with clients.

10.1086/711954.abstractZh: 金融公司利用订单流信息的行为已成为监管讨论的焦点。那些通过接收客户订单来获取信息的交易商是否应该被允许使用或分享这些信息？我们在一个根据拍卖结果数据校准的模型中探讨了信息共享如何影响交易商、客户以及发行机构的收入。信息共享可以减少对未来价值的不确定性。不确定性降低后，风险厌恶的投标者会出更高的价格。对于投资者而言，信息共享的福利效应取决于信息的分享方式以及它如何影响信息不对称问题。模型显示，当交易商之间共享信息时，投资者可以受益，而不是当他们与客户共享信息时。

abstract.text: We extend the standard intergenerational mobility literature by examining the relationship between adult outcomes of children and the timing of parental income during their childhood years, using data from Norway. We find first that, conditional on permanent household income, the child’s human capital is higher in households where income is balanced between the early childhood and late childhood years than in households with a more imbalanced income profile. Second, compared to that in the early and late periods of childhood, income in the middle period has relatively low productivity.

10.1086/712443.abstractZh: 我们通过使用挪威的数据，扩展了关于代际流动性的标准研究。研究发现，在永久家庭收入的前提下，如果家庭在儿童早期和后期都有均衡的收入，那么儿童的人力资本就会更高；而如果家庭收入在这两个时期存在不平衡，那么儿童的人力资本就会较低。此外，与儿童早期和后期相比，中期收入的生产力相对较低。

abstract.text: Large firms play a pivotal role in international trade. We develop a multisector granular model of trade where sectors host a finite number of firms. Both aggregate and granular firm-level forces shape comparative advantage. The model is estimated using French microdata on firm domestic and export sales. We find that granularity accounts for about 20% of the sectoral variation in export intensity and is more pronounced in highly export-intensive sectors. An extension to a dynamic environment with both idiosyncratic and aggregate shocks reveals that firm dynamics plays a central role in shaping comparative advantage reversals observed in the data.

10.1086/712444.abstractZh: 大型企业在国际贸易中发挥着关键作用。我们建立了一个多部门细观模型，该模型中每个部门都拥有有限数量的企业。无论是整体层面还是个体企业层面的因素，都影响着企业的比较优势。该模型是基于法国企业国内销售和出口销售的微观数据进行的估计。我们发现，企业层面的细观特征解释了约20%的部门出口强度差异，这一效应在出口密集型部门更为明显。在考虑动态环境的情况下，包括特殊冲击和整体冲击因素后，我们发现企业动态因素在塑造数据中观察到的比较优势逆转方面起着核心作用。

abstract.text: We report a continuous-time experiment studying the Burdett-Judd model, whose unique Nash equilibrium (NE) features dispersed prices. Adaptive dynamics predict that the NE is stable for one of our parameter sets and unstable for another. The empirical price distribution is close to the NE distribution for the stable parameter set, but for the unstable parameter set it skews toward higher prices in its NE support interval. We offer an empirical definition of price cycles in terms of changes over time in robust measures of central tendency and dispersion, by which the data exhibit persistent cycles in both treatments but larger cycles for the unstable parameters. Results are roughly similar for professional and student sellers and for limited-information treatments.

10.1086/712445.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项连续时间实验，研究Burdett-Judd模型，该模型的唯一纳什均衡具有分散价格的特点。自适应动力学预测，在我们的某个参数组合下，该均衡是稳定的；而在另一个参数组合下则是不稳定的。对于稳定的参数组合，实证价格分布接近纳什均衡分布；而对于不稳定的参数组合，价格分布则倾向于在其纳什均衡支持区间内出现更高的价格。我们提出了一种基于时间变化的稳健中心趋势和离散度指标来定义价格周期的方法，结果显示，在两种参数组合下，数据都表现出持续的价格周期，但不稳定参数的周期更为显著。对于专业卖家和学生卖家，以及信息有限的情况，研究结果大致相似。

abstract.text: We show that family background matters significantly for children’s accumulation of wealth and investor behavior as adults, even when removing the genetic connection between children and the parents raising them. The analysis is made possible by linking Korean-born children who were adopted at infancy by Norwegian parents to a population panel data set with detailed information on wealth and socioeconomic characteristics. The mechanism by which these Korean-Norwegian adoptees were assigned to adoptive families is known and effectively random. This mechanism allows us to estimate the causal effects from an adoptee being raised in one type of family versus another.

10.1086/712446.abstractZh: 我们的研究表明，家庭背景对子女财富积累及成年后的投资行为具有显著影响，即使排除了子女与抚养他们父母之间的遗传联系。这项研究通过将挪威父母在婴儿时期收养的韩国出生的儿童与包含详细财富和社会经济特征的人口数据库进行关联，得以实现。这些韩国-挪威收养儿童被分配到不同收养家庭的方式是已知的，并且是随机的。这一机制使我们能够估算出在不同类型的家庭中成长对收养儿童的影响。

abstract.text: This paper derives conditions under which preferences and technology are nonparametrically identified in hedonic equilibrium models. With products differentiated along a quality index and agents characterized by scalar unobserved heterogeneity, single-crossing conditions on preferences and technology provide identifying restrictions in previous work. We develop similar shape restrictions in the multiattribute case. These shape restrictions, based on optimal transport theory and generalized convexity, allow us to identify preferences for goods differentiated along multiple dimensions from the observation of a single market. We thereby derive identification results for nonseparable simultaneous equations and multiattribute hedonic equilibrium models with (possibly) multiple dimensions of unobserved heterogeneity. One of our results is a proof of absolute continuity of the distribution of endogenously traded qualities, which is of independent interest.

10.1086/712447.abstractZh: 本文推导了在享乐均衡模型中，偏好和技术非参数识别的条件。假设产品沿质量指标进行差异化，且代理人具有标量未观测的异质性，先前的研究中，偏好和技术的单交叉条件提供了识别限制。我们在多属性情况下提出了类似的形状限制。这些基于最优运输理论和广义凸性的形状限制，使我们能够从单一市场观测中识别出沿多个维度差异化的商品的偏好。因此，我们得出了对于不可分离的同时方程和多属性享乐均衡模型的识别结果，这些模型具有（可能）多个未观测的异质性维度。我们的一个结果是证明了内生交易质量的分布的绝对连续性，这一结果本身也具有一定的研究价值。

abstract.text: This paper argues that incumbent firms may acquire innovative targets solely to discontinue the target’s innovation projects and preempt future competition. We call such acquisitions “killer acquisitions.” We develop a model illustrating this phenomenon. Using pharmaceutical industry data, we show that acquired drug projects are less likely to be developed when they overlap with the acquirer’s existing product portfolio, especially when the acquirer’s market power is large because of weak competition or distant patent expiration. Conservative estimates indicate that 5.3%–7.4% of acquisitions in our sample are killer acquisitions. These acquisitions disproportionately occur just below thresholds for antitrust scrutiny.

10.1086/712506.abstractZh: 本文认为，现有企业可能会收购具有创新性的目标企业，仅仅是为了终止该企业的创新项目并抢占未来的竞争市场。我们将这种收购行为称为“杀手收购”。我们建立了一个模型来阐释这一现象。通过医药行业的数据分析，我们发现，当被收购的药物项目与收购方的现有产品组合存在重叠时，这些项目被开发的可能性会降低，尤其是在收购方市场力量较大、竞争较弱或专利到期时间较远的情况下。保守估计显示，在我们研究的样本中，有5.3%至7.4%的收购行为属于杀手收购。这些收购行为往往发生在反垄断监管的关注阈值之下。

abstract.text: I examine the distributional consequences of technological change in a framework that nests Roy’s (1951) and Becker’s (1973) classical models: workers self-select into two sectors and then match with heterogeneous firms within each sector. In this model, technological change can be decomposed into changes in (i) the degree to which sectors covet the same skill sets and (ii) the extent to which output varies with skill in each sector. By deriving monotone comparative statics results for each of these two types of changes, I am able to provide a comprehensive account of the distributional consequences of technological change.

10.1086/712507.abstractZh: 我在一个结合了Roy（1951）和Becker（1973）经典模型的框架内，研究技术变革的分配后果。在这个模型中，工人自选择进入两个行业，然后与每个行业内的异质企业配对。技术变革可以分解为两个方面：一是各个行业对相同技能需求的程度；二是每个行业中产出随技能变化的程度。通过对这两种变化的单调比较静态分析结果，我能够全面阐述技术变革的分配后果。

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence of a novel facet of peer effects by showing that peer personality influences academic achievement. We exploit random assignment of students to university sections and find that students perform better in the presence of persistent peers. The impact of peer persistence is enduring, as students exposed to persistent peers at the beginning of their studies continue to achieve higher grades in subsequent periods. The personality peer effects that we document are distinct from other observable peer characteristics and suggest that peer personality traits affect human capital accumulation.

10.1086/712638.abstractZh: 本文通过研究表明，同伴性格对学术成就有着重要影响，从而揭示了同伴效应的一个新方面。我们利用学生随机分配到不同大学班级的方式，发现学生在持续存在的同伴影响下表现更好。同伴持续性的影响是持久的，因为那些在学业初期就与持续存在的同伴相处的学生，在后续的学习阶段依然能够取得更高的成绩。我们观察到的同伴性格效应与其他可观察到的同伴特征不同，这表明同伴性格特征会影响人力资本的积累。

abstract.text: A central challenge in securing property rights is the subversion of justice. We present a model of a polluter whose discharges harm multiple owners, and we compare property rules, liability rules, and regulation on efficiency grounds. We provide conditions under which property rules are preferred to liability rules, thus verifying the Calabresi-Melamed conjecture. Regulation that enforces partial abatement may be preferred to either of the extreme rules. An empirical analysis of water quality in the United States before and after the Clean Water Act shows that the effects of regulation are consistent with several predictions of the model.

10.1086/712733.abstractZh: 在保障财产权的过程中，一个核心挑战就是如何维护正义。我们提出了一个污染者的模型，该模型中的排放行为会损害多个所有者的利益。我们基于效率原则，比较了不同的财产规则、责任规则以及监管措施。我们找到了一些条件，在这些条件下，财产规则比责任规则更优，从而验证了Calabresi-Melamed的猜想。对于部分减排的监管措施，可能比这两种极端规则更为可取。对美国《清洁水法》实施前后水质的实证分析表明，监管措施的效果与模型中的几个预测结果是一致的。

abstract.text: We derive the symmetric, revenue-maximizing allocation of several units among agents who take costly actions that influence their values. The problem is equivalent to a reduced-form model where agents have nonexpected utility. The uniform-price auction and the discriminatory pay-your-bid auction with reserve prices that react to both demand and supply constitute symmetric, optimal mechanisms. We also identify a condition under which the overall optimal mechanism is indeed symmetric and illustrate the structure of the optimal asymmetric mechanism when the condition fails. The main tool in our analysis is an integral inequality based on Fan and Lorentz (1954).

10.1086/712735.abstractZh: 我们推导了在代理人采取影响其价值的昂贵行动时，实现收益最大化的对称分配方法。该问题等价于一个简化形式的模型，其中代理人的效用是未预期的。统一价格拍卖和带有反应供需变化的保留价格的歧视性出价拍卖，都是对称的最优机制。我们还确定了一个条件，在该条件下，整体最优机制确实为对称；并说明了当该条件不成立时，最优非对称机制的结构。我们分析的主要工具是基于Fan和Lorentz（1954年）提出的积分不等式。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a theory of endogenous differences in liquidity of assets based on the interaction between differences in their risk and differences in liquidity needs of agents. An equilibrium of the model displays a class structure, where agents sort themselves across different types of assets according to their types. High-liquidity-need agents hold on to safer portfolios than lower-liquidity-need agents whenever the variation in the value of liquidity across states raises the value of safe assets more than that of riskier assets, and vice versa. I also derive capital asset pricing model–like formulas for excess returns where the risk and liquidity premia are interdependent and specific to each type of agent.

10.1086/712736.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于资产风险差异与流动性需求差异相互作用的内生流动性差异理论。该模型的均衡状态呈现出一种类结构，即各主体会根据自身的流动性需求类型来配置资产。当不同状态下的流动性价值变化使得安全资产的价值上升幅度大于风险资产时，流动性需求较高的主体会持有更安全的资产组合；反之则相反。此外，本文还推导出了类似资本资产定价模型的超额回报公式，其中风险和流动性溢价是相互依存的，并且适用于不同类型的主体。

abstract.text: Are identities fungible? How do people come to identify with specific groups? This paper proposes a revealed preference approach, using food consumption to uncover ethnic and religious identity choices in India. We first show that consumption \of identity goods responds to forces suggested by social identity research: group status and group salience. Moreover, identity choices respond to the cost of following the group’s prescribed behaviors. We propose and estimate a demand system to quantify the identity changes that followed India’s 1991 reforms. While social identity research has focused on status and salience, our results suggest that economic costs also play an important role.

10.1086/712761.abstractZh: 身份是可以互换的吗？人们是如何认同特定群体的？本文提出了一种揭示性偏好方法，通过食物消费来揭示印度中民族和宗教身份的选择。我们首先表明，身份商品的消费反映了社会身份研究所提出的因素：群体地位和群体显著性。此外，身份选择还受到遵循群体规定行为的成本的影响。我们提出并估计了一个需求系统，以量化1991年印度改革后身份的变化。虽然社会身份研究主要关注地位和显著性，但我们的结果表明，经济成本也起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We study the adoption, diffusion, and impacts of the Universal Product Code (UPC) between 1975 and 1992, during the initial years of the bar code system. We find evidence of network effects in the diffusion process. Matched-sample difference-in-differences estimates show that firm size and trademark registrations increase following UPC adoption by manufacturers. Industry-level import penetration also increases with domestic UPC adoption. Our findings suggest that bar codes, scanning, and related technologies helped stimulate variety-enhancing product innovation and encourage the growth of international retail supply chains.

10.1086/712762.abstractZh: 我们研究了通用产品代码（UPC）在1975年至1992年间的采用、传播及其影响，这一时期正是条形码系统的初期阶段。我们发现，在传播过程中存在网络效应。匹配样本差异估计表明，随着制造商采用UPC，企业规模和商标注册数量有所增加。行业层面的进口渗透率也随着国内UPC的采用而增加。我们的研究结果表明，条形码、扫描及相关技术有助于促进产品创新，并推动国际零售供应链的发展。

abstract.text: The existing economics literature on international trade agreements focuses on tariff agreements covering trade in goods and explains core features of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Tariffs play almost no role in services markets, however, and the literature cannot account for the strikingly different approach to trade liberalization in agreements such as the World Trade Organization’s General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS). We develop a model through which key features of GATS, including its emphasis on “deep integration” can be understood. And we use this model to suggest that there may also be a middle ground for services trade liberalization between the GATS deep-integration approach and the traditional “shallow-integration” approach of GATT.

10.1086/712786.abstractZh: 现有的关于国际贸易协定的经济学文献主要关注涵盖商品贸易的关税协定，并解释了《关税与贸易总协定》的核心特征。然而，关税在服务业市场中几乎不起作用，相关文献无法解释诸如世界贸易组织《服务贸易总协定》等协定在贸易自由化方面的显著差异。我们建立了一个模型，通过该模型可以理解《服务贸易总协定》的关键特征，包括其对“深度整合”的强调。我们还利用该模型提出，在服务贸易自由化方面，可能存在一种介于《服务贸易总协定》的“深度整合”方法和《关税与贸易总协定》传统的“浅层整合”方法之间的中间方案。

abstract.text: In economies with a continuum of agents of different types, pecuniary externalities are removed with market exchanges. Agents choose from among various possible prices they want to prevail in the future and buy or sell rights in these market exchanges for future trade. Each agent can choose the exchange it wants without regard to what any other agent is doing. But crucially, the right to trade in each and every exchange is priced. The fee structure has a per-unit price and quantity decomposition: a price, as determined by the exchange chosen, times the quantity of rights acquired.

10.1086/712787.abstractZh: 在具有多种类型代理人的经济体中，金钱性外部性通过市场交易得以消除。各代理人可以在未来选择自己希望占主导地位的多种价格，并在这些市场交易中买卖权利以进行未来的交易。每个代理人都可以选择自己想要的交易所进行交易，而不必考虑其他代理人的行为。但关键在于，每个交易所的交易权利都有价格。费用结构包含单位价格和数量分解：价格由所选交易所决定，乘以所获得的权利数量。

abstract.text: We study the impact of simplification, deterrence, and tax morale on tax compliance. We ran four natural field experiments varying the communication of the tax administration with the universe of income taxpayers in Belgium throughout the tax process. A consistent picture emerges across experiments: (i) simplifying communication substantially increases compliance, (ii) deterrence messages have an additional positive effect, (iii) invoking tax morale is not effective and often backfires. A discontinuity in enforcement intensity, combined with the experimental variation, allows us to compare simplification with standard enforcement measures. We find that simplification is far more cost-effective, allowing for substantial savings on enforcement costs.

10.1086/713096.abstractZh: 我们研究了简化、威慑和税收道德对税收遵从度的影响。我们在比利时的税收过程中，进行了四项自然实地实验，分别考察了税务机关与收入纳税人之间的沟通方式对税收遵从度的影响。实验结果表明：(i) 简化沟通方式能显著提升税收遵从度；(ii) 威慑性信息还有额外的正面效果；(iii) 强调税收道德观念并不有效，反而可能适得其反。通过对比简化措施与标准执法手段，我们发现简化措施在成本效益方面更为优越，能够大幅降低执法成本。

abstract.text: I build an investment-and-marriage model to provide a new explanation for the reversed college gender gap; that is, more women than men are going to college. The explanation is based on differential fecundity and an equilibrium marriage-market effect. The model also sheds light on gender-specific relationships between age at marriage and midlife personal income for American men and women and the evolving relationship between age at marriage and spousal income for American women.

10.1086/713097.abstractZh: 我构建了一个投资与婚姻模型，以期为大学性别差距的反转提供新的解释。即，上大学的女性比男性多。这一解释基于不同的生育率差异以及婚姻市场的均衡效应。该模型还揭示了美国男女在结婚年龄与中年个人收入之间的性别特定关系，以及美国女性在结婚年龄与配偶收入之间的演变关系。

abstract.text: Use of Internal Revenue Service (IRS) tax records improves researchers’ ability to track income trends, although the focus on taxable market income in this research excludes important income sources. Using IRS data in combination with other data sources, we explore the effect of measuring inequality levels and trends with income, including real accrued capital gains based on Haig-Simons principles. While median market income fell 10% from 1989 to 2016, median economic income increased by 26% using our Haig-Simons-based measure. Top 1% income shares were lower and increased by only about one-third of that estimated using previous approaches over this period.

10.1086/713098.abstractZh: 使用美国国税局（IRS）的税务记录能够提升研究人员追踪收入趋势的能力，尽管本研究主要关注应税市场收入，而忽略了其他重要的收入来源。通过结合使用IRS数据与其他数据来源，我们探讨了以收入来衡量不平等程度和趋势的效果，其中包括基于Haig-Simons原则的实得资本收益。虽然市场收入中位数从1989年到2016年下降了10%，但使用我们的Haig-Simons方法衡量时，经济收入中位数却增加了26%。在此期间，收入最高的1%人群的收入份额较低，仅增加了约三分之一，这一比例低于之前方法的估计值。

abstract.text: A large literature has shown that asset quality may be signaled by retention or, in a separate literature, screened by liquidity. I present a general framework to analyze both instruments, offering conditions that characterize which instrument will be used in equilibrium. I then expand the private information to include not only asset quality but also seller patience, showing that both retention and liquidity may be used to fully separate both dimensions of private information. The expanded model offers new predictions about how price, quantity, and liquidity covary with each other and with seller private information.

10.1086/713099.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，资产质量可能通过保留行为来体现，或者，在另一类文献中，可以通过流动性来筛选。我提出了一个通用框架来分析这两种工具，并提出了描述在均衡状态下将使用哪种工具的条件。随后，我将私人信息扩展到不仅包括资产质量，还包括卖方的耐心，表明保留行为和流动性都可以用来完全分离这两种私人信息维度。这个扩展的模型提供了关于价格、数量和流动性如何相互关联以及与卖方私人信息相互关联的新预测。

abstract.text: We conducted a survey of high-ability college students and elicited beliefs about how their choice of major, and of whether to complete their degree, would affect an array of future events: earnings, employment, marriage prospects, potential spousal characteristics, and fertility. We find that students perceive large “returns” to human capital not only in their own future earnings but also in other dimensions (e.g., potential spouse’s earnings and fertility). We find evidence of students sorting into majors on the basis of these perceived returns. Family expectations are particularly important for female students’ major choices. In a follow-up survey conducted 6 years after the initial data collection, we find a close connection between expectations and current realizations.

10.1086/713100.abstractZh: 我们对高能力的大学生进行了调查，了解他们对于选择专业以及是否完成学位会对一系列未来事件的影响的看法，这些事件包括收入、就业、婚姻前景、潜在配偶的特征以及生育能力。我们发现，学生们认为人力资本带来的“回报”不仅体现在他们自身的未来收入上，还体现在其他方面（例如潜在配偶的收入和生育能力）。我们有证据表明，学生们会根据这些感知到的回报来选择专业。对于女学生来说，家庭期望对她们的专业选择尤为重要。在初次数据收集后的6年进行的后续调查中，我们发现期望与现实之间的关联非常紧密。

abstract.text: Why are the east sides of formerly industrial cities more deprived? To answer this question, we use individual-level census data and create historical pollution patterns derived from the locations of 5,000 industrial chimneys and an atmospheric model. We show that this observation results from path-dependent neighborhood sorting that began during the Industrial Revolution, as prevailing winds blew pollution eastward. Past pollution explains up to 20% of observed neighborhood segregation in 2011, even though coal pollution stopped in the 1970s. We develop a quantitative model to identify the role of neighborhood effects and relocation rigidities underlying this persistence.

10.1086/713101.abstractZh: 为什么曾经是工业城市的东部区域更贫困？为了回答这个问题，我们使用个体层面的普查数据，并基于5,000个工业烟囱的位置以及大气模型，构建出历史上的污染模式。我们发现，这种现象是由于路径依赖性的邻里排序所导致的，这种排序始于工业革命时期，当时盛行风向将污染向东输送。尽管煤炭污染在20世纪70年代就已经停止，但过去的污染仍然解释了2011年观察到的邻里隔离现象中高达20%的原因。我们开发了一个定量模型，以识别邻里效应和迁移刚性在这种现象持续存在中的作用。

abstract.text: We present a new model of charitable giving where individuals regard out-of-pocket donations and the matches they induce as different. We show that match-price elasticities combine conventional price effects with the strength of warm glow, so that a match-price elasticity alone is insufficient to characterize preferences for giving. Match- and rebate-price elasticities will be different, but together they lead to new tests of underlying giving preferences. We estimate, for the first time, a match-price elasticity in a high-stakes setting together with a rebate elasticity induced by tax policy. The estimates reject extant models of giving but are consistent with the new theory.

10.1086/713190.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的慈善捐赠模型，在该模型中，个体将自掏腰包的捐赠及其引发的积极效应视为不同的事物。我们指出，匹配价格弹性结合了传统的价格效应与捐赠带来的温暖感，因此仅用匹配价格弹性来描述捐赠偏好是不够的。匹配价格弹性和折扣价格弹性是不同的，但它们共同构成了测试捐赠偏好基础的新方法。我们首次在一个高风险环境中估计了匹配价格弹性，以及由税收政策引发的折扣弹性。这些估计结果否定了现有的捐赠模型，但与新理论是一致的。

abstract.text: According to the Lucas-Stokey result, a government can structure its debt maturity to guarantee commitment to optimal fiscal policy by future governments. In this paper, we overturn this conclusion, showing that it does not generally hold in the same model and under the same definition of time consistency as in Lucas-Stokey. Our argument rests on the existence of an overlooked commitment problem that cannot be remedied with debt maturity: a government in the future will not necessarily tax above the peak of the Laffer curve, even if it is ex ante optimal to do so.

10.1086/713191.abstractZh: 根据卢卡斯-斯托基的结果，政府可以通过调整债务到期时间来确保未来政府能够坚持最优的财政政策。在本文中，我们推翻了这一结论，表明在相同的模型和对时间一致性的定义下，这一结论通常并不成立。我们的论点基于一个被忽视的承诺问题，这个问题无法通过调整债务到期时间来解决：未来的政府不一定会超过拉弗曲线的峰值进行征税，即使从事前来看这样做是最优的。

abstract.text: Consumers rely on the price changes of goods in their grocery bundles when forming expectations about aggregate inflation. We use micro data that uniquely match individual expectations, detailed information about consumption bundles, and item-level prices. The weights consumers assign to price changes depend on the frequency of purchase, rather than expenditure share, and positive price changes loom larger than negative price changes. Prices of goods offered in the same store but not purchased do not affect inflation expectations, nor do other dimensions. Our results provide empirical guidance for models of expectations formation with heterogeneous consumers.

10.1086/713192.abstractZh: 消费者在形成整体通货膨胀预期时，会依据其购物篮中商品的价格变化来进行预期。我们利用了能够唯一匹配个体预期、详细消费篮信息以及商品级价格微观数据。消费者对价格变化的权重取决于购买频率，而非支出份额；且正向价格变化的重要性高于负向价格变化。同一商店内未购买的商品价格并不会影响通货膨胀预期，其他维度也是如此。我们的研究结果为具有异质消费者的预期形成模型提供了实证指导。

abstract.text: This paper provides stark evidence of hysteresis—the failure of an effect to reverse itself as its underlying cause is reversed—in energy demand. We estimate that half of the 23% reduction in residential electricity use caused by a 9-month-long policy that was imposed on millions of Brazilians has persisted for at least 12 years. We examine the implications of our finding by extending the traditional welfare analysis of corrective policies to allow for hysteresis. Our estimate highlights that failing to take hysteresis into account could severely bias the welfare evaluation of policies aimed at reducing (long-run) energy demand.

10.1086/713729.abstractZh: 本文提供了能源需求中存在滞后效应的明确证据——即当导致能源需求变化的根本原因被逆转时，这种变化却无法自行逆转。我们估计，由于巴西数百万人实施的为期9个月的政策，住宅用电量减少了23%，其中一半的减少效应至少持续了12年。我们通过将传统的福利分析框架扩展到考虑滞后效应，来探讨这一发现的意义。我们的估计表明，如果不考虑滞后效应，可能会对旨在减少（长期）能源需求的政策的福利评估产生严重偏差。

abstract.text: Evidence from the cognitive sciences suggests that some choices are conscious and reflect individual volition, while others tend to be automatic. Under these circumstances, standard economic modeling might not always be applicable because not all choices are the result of individual tastes. We propose a behavioral model that can be used in standard economic analysis that formalizes the way in which conscious and automatic choices arise. We then present a novel method capable of identifying a set of conscious choices from observed behavior and discuss its usefulness as a framework for studying asymmetric pricing and empirical puzzles in different settings.

10.1086/713730.abstractZh: 认知科学的研究表明，某些选择是意识驱动的，反映了个体的意愿，而另一些选择则往往是自动化的。在这种情况下，标准的经济模型可能并不总是适用，因为并非所有选择都是个体偏好的结果。我们提出了一种行为模型，该模型可以用于标准的经济分析，并形式化意识和自动选择是如何产生的。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，能够从观察到的行为中识别出一组意识选择，并讨论这种方法作为研究不同情境下不对称定价和实证难题的框架的实用性。

abstract.text: We conjecture that suppliers offer trade credit to ease competition in downstream markets. We show theoretically that suppliers that have to transfer surplus to high-bargaining-power customers would want to offer an increasing price schedule to preserve sales to other buyers. Suppliers can implement this using trade credit. Empirically, we find that suppliers grant trade credit to high-bargaining-power customers when they fear the cannibalization of sales to other customers. Exploiting a law that lowered the cost of offering trade credit, we show that higher provision of trade credit to high-bargaining-power customers leads to an expansion of the suppliers’ customer base.

10.1086/713731.abstractZh: 我们推测，供应商提供贸易信贷是为了缓解下游市场的竞争压力。理论上，那些需要将剩余产品转移给议价能力较强的客户的供应商，会希望提供更高的价格策略，以保持对其他买家的销售。供应商可以通过贸易信贷来实现这一点。实证研究表明，当供应商担心对其他客户的销售受到侵蚀时，他们会向议价能力较强的客户提供贸易信贷。利用一项降低提供贸易信贷成本的法律，我们发现，向议价能力较强的客户提供更多的贸易信贷，会扩大供应商的客户基础。

abstract.text: When choice is stochastic, revealed preference analysis often relies on random utility models. However, it is impossible to infer preferences without assumptions on the distribution of utility noise. We show that this difficulty can be overcome by using response time data. A simple condition on response time distributions ensures that choices reveal preferences without distributional assumptions. Standard models from economics and psychology generate data fulfilling this condition. Sharper results are obtained under symmetric or Fechnerian noise, where response times allow uncovering preferences or predicting choice probabilities out of sample. Application of our tools is simple and generates remarkable prediction accuracy.

10.1086/713732.abstractZh: 当选择是随机的时，揭示偏好分析通常依赖于随机效用模型。然而，如果不对效用噪声的分布做出假设，就无法推断出偏好。我们证明，通过使用反应时间数据可以克服这一困难。对反应时间分布的一个简单条件可以确保选择能够揭示偏好，而无需对分布做出假设。经济学和心理学中的标准模型能够生成满足这一条件的数据。在对称或费希纳噪声条件下，可以获得更精确的结果，因为反应时间可以揭示偏好或预测样本外的选择概率。我们工具的应用非常简单，并且能够产生非常准确的预测结果。

abstract.text: Hotter years are associated with lower economic output in developing countries. We show that the effect of temperature on labor is an important part of the explanation. Using microdata from selected firms in India, we estimate reduced worker productivity and increased absenteeism on hot days. Climate control significantly mitigates productivity losses. In a national panel of Indian factories, annual plant output falls by about 2% per degree Celsius. This response appears to be driven by a reduction in the output elasticity of labor. Our estimates are large enough to explain previously observed output losses in cross-country panels.

10.1086/713733.abstractZh: 较热的年份与发展中国家较低的经济产出相关。我们发现，温度对劳动力的影响是解释这一现象的重要部分。通过印度部分企业的微观数据，我们估计在炎热天气下，工人的生产率下降和缺勤率增加。气候控制显著减轻了生产率的损失。在印度工厂的全国范围内，每年每升高1摄氏度，工厂产出就会下降约2%。这种反应似乎是由劳动力产出弹性降低所驱动的。我们的估计结果足以解释之前在跨国面板数据中观察到的产出损失。

abstract.text: We study optimal income taxation when workers’ productivity is stochastic and evolves endogenously because of learning by doing. Learning by doing calls for higher wedges and alters the relation between wedges and tax rates. In a calibrated model, we find that reforming the US tax code brings significant welfare gains and that a simple tax code invariant to past incomes is approximately optimal. We isolate the role of learning by doing by comparing the aforementioned tax code to its counterpart in an economy that is identical to the calibrated one except for the exogeneity of the productivity process. Ignoring learning by doing calls for fundamentally different proposals.

10.1086/713745.abstractZh: 我们研究了在工人生产力具有随机性且因实践学习而内生变化的情况下的最优所得税制度。实践学习会导致更高的边际税率，并改变边际税率与税率之间的关系。在一个经过校准的模型中，我们发现改革美国税法能够带来显著的福利收益，而一个简单且不受过去收入影响的税法方案大致是最优的。我们通过将上述税法方案与另一个与校准模型相同但生产力过程具有外生性的经济模型进行比较，来分离出实践学习的作用。如果忽略实践学习的影响，则需要提出根本不同的政策建议。

abstract.text: Standard estimators of risk premia in linear asset pricing models are biased if some priced factors are omitted. We propose a three-pass method to estimate the risk premium of an observable factor, which is valid even when not all factors in the model are specified or observed. The risk premium of the observable factor can be identified regardless of the rotation of the other control factors if together they span the true factor space. Our approach uses principal components of test asset returns to recover the factor space and additional regressions to obtain the risk premium of the observed factor.

10.1086/714090.abstractZh: 在线性资产定价模型中，如果遗漏了一些定价因子，标准的风险溢价估计方法会存在偏差。我们提出了一种三步骤的方法来估计可观测因子的风险溢价，该方法即使在模型中的所有因子未被指定或观测到的情况下也是有效的。如果其他控制因子的旋转不影响可观测因子风险溢价的识别，那么即使其他控制因子共同覆盖了真实的因子空间，可观测因子的风险溢价仍然可以被识别。我们的方法利用测试资产回报的主成分来恢复因子空间，并通过额外的回归分析来获得观测因子的风险溢价。

abstract.text: How are resources allocated across different R&D areas (i.e., problems to be solved)? As a result of dynamic congestion externalities, the competitive market allocates excessive resources into those of high return, being those with higher private (and social) payoffs. Good problems are tackled too soon, and as a result the distribution of open research problems in the socially optimal solution stochastically dominates that of the competitive equilibrium. A severe form of rent dissipation occurs in the latter, where the total value of R&D activity equals the value of allocating all resources to the least valuable problem solved. Resulting losses can be substantial.

10.1086/714093.abstractZh: 资源是如何在不同研发领域之间分配的（即，需要解决的问题）？由于动态拥堵的外部性，竞争市场会将过多的资源分配到回报较高的领域，因为这些领域能带来更高的私人（和社会）收益。好的问题往往过早得到解决，因此，在社会的优化解决方案中，开放研究问题的分配情况在随机意义上优于竞争均衡下的分配情况。在竞争均衡中，会出现严重的租金消耗现象，此时研发活动的总价值等于将所有资源分配给最不值得解决的问题所带来的价值。由此导致的损失可能是相当大的。

abstract.text: We develop a novel graphical paradigm of a strict-dominance-solvable game to study the developmental trajectory of steps of reasoning between 8 years old and adulthood. Most participants play the equilibrium action either always or only when they have a dominant strategy. Although age is a determinant of equilibrium choice, some very young participants display an innate ability to play at equilibrium. Finally, the proportion of equilibrium play increases significantly until fifth grade and stabilizes afterward, suggesting that the contribution of age to equilibrium play vanishes early in life.

10.1086/714118.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的图形化模型，用于研究在8岁到成年期间，严格支配性可解游戏的推理步骤的发展轨迹。大多数参与者要么总是选择均衡行动，要么仅在拥有支配策略时才会选择均衡行动。尽管年龄是均衡选择的一个决定因素，但一些非常年幼的参与者表现出天生具备在均衡状态下进行游戏的能力。最终，均衡游戏的占比在五年级之前显著增加，之后趋于稳定，这表明年龄对均衡游戏的影响在生命早期就逐渐消失。

abstract.text: Africa’s demand for urban housing is soaring, even as it faces a proliferation of slums. In this setting, can modest infrastructure investments in greenfield areas where people subsequently build their own houses facilitate long-run neighborhood development? We study Sites and Services projects implemented in seven Tanzanian cities during the 1970s and 1980s, and we use a spatial regression discontinuity design to compare greenfield areas that were treated (de novo) with nearby greenfield areas that were not. We find that by the 2010s, de novo areas developed into neighborhoods with larger, more regularly laid-out buildings and better-quality housing.

10.1086/714119.abstractZh: 非洲对城市住房的需求正在急剧上升，尽管同时面临着贫民窟的激增。在这种情况下，是否可以在人们随后自行建造房屋的新建区域进行适度的基础设施投资，以促进社区的长期发展？我们研究了20世纪70年代和80年代在坦桑尼亚七个城市实施的“场地与服务”项目，并采用空间回归不连续设计方法来比较那些被重新开发的新建区域与附近未被重新开发的区域。研究发现，到2010年代，重新开发的区域已经发展成了拥有更大、布局更整齐的建筑和更高质量住房的社区。

abstract.text: The effects of large banks on the real economy are theoretically ambiguous and politically controversial. I identify quasi-exogenous increases in bank size in postwar Germany. I show that firms did not grow faster after their relationship banks became bigger. In fact, opaque borrowers grew more slowly. The enlarged banks did not increase profits or efficiency but worked with riskier borrowers. Bank managers benefited through higher salaries and media attention. The results are based on newly digitized microdata on German firms and their banks. Overall, the findings reveal that bigger banks do not always raise real growth and can actually harm some borrowers and the real economy.

10.1086/714120.abstractZh: 大型银行对实体经济的影响在理论上存在争议，在政治上也颇具争议。我研究了战后德国银行规模扩大的现象。研究发现，银行规模扩大后，企业的增长速度并未加快，相反，风险较高的借款人增长速度反而放缓。规模扩大的银行并未提升利润或效率，反而与风险更高的借款人合作。银行管理者则通过更高的薪资和媒体关注获得了利益。这些研究结果基于德国企业及其银行的新数字化微观数据。总体而言，研究结果表明，规模较大的银行并不总能促进实际经济增长，反而可能对某些借款人和实体经济造成负面影响。

abstract.text: Privacy is a feature inherent to the use of cash. With steadily increasing market shares of digital payment platforms, privacy in payments may no longer be attainable in the future. We explore the potential welfare impacts of reductions in privacy in payments. In our framework, firms may use data collected through payments to price discriminate future consumers. A public good aspect arises because individuals do not internalize the full cost of failing to protect their privacy and reduce social welfare by suboptimally choosing not to protect their privacy in payments. We discuss potential remedies, including the issuance of electronic cash.

10.1086/714133.abstractZh: 隐私是现金使用的一个固有特性。随着数字支付平台市场份额的稳步增长，支付中的隐私可能在未来变得难以实现。我们探讨了支付隐私减少可能带来的福利影响。在我们的框架中，企业可以利用通过支付收集的数据来实施价格歧视，以区分未来的消费者。由于个人没有充分意识到未能保护隐私所带来的全部成本，因此会导致社会福利的降低，因为他们在支付隐私保护方面做出了次优的选择。我们讨论了可能的解决方案，包括发行电子现金。

abstract.text: Efforts to improve the efficiency of the US health-care system involve both provider payment reform and efforts to give consumers the information they need to choose efficient providers and a financial incentive to do so. An example of the latter type of initiative is tiered cost-sharing. We analyze data from a long-standing tiered cost-sharing system for primary care gatekeeper clinics. These clinics control access to specialists and hospitals and are held accountable for their patients’ total annual risk-adjusted spending on covered health-care services. Consumers choosing higher cost clinics face higher levels of deductibles, copayments, and out-of-pocket maximums. We find that when choosing a primary care clinic, consumers are responsive to the clinic’s tier. Consumers exhibit a high level of inertia, but nonetheless, many clinics voluntarily reduce their fees to move to, or retain placement in, lower cost tiers.

10.1086/714360.abstractZh: 提高美国医疗系统效率的努力包括提供者的支付改革，以及为消费者提供所需信息以选择高效提供者的措施，同时还需给予他们经济激励。后一种举措的一个例子就是分层费用分担制度。我们分析了长期存在的初级保健诊所的分层费用分担制度数据。这些诊所负责控制患者获取专科医生和医院服务的机会，并需对其患者年度在覆盖医疗服务上的总风险调整支出负责。选择成本较高的诊所的消费者将面临更高的免赔额、共付额和自付最高限额。我们发现，在选择初级保健诊所时，消费者会对诊所的分级表现出一定的响应。尽管消费者表现出较高的惰性，但许多诊所仍会主动降低费用，以进入或保持在成本较低的等级。

abstract.text: Health-care providers are increasingly subject to measurement of noisy performance signals. I show that shrinkage estimation, commonly used to improve the accuracy of performance measures, blunts performance incentives. I study this phenomenon in the setting of hospital performance measurement for heart attack mortality. Analysis of Medicare claims shows that shrinkage estimation substantially dilutes incentives, particularly for smaller hospitals, whose measured performance increases by only 20–40 percent of true performance improvements. Alternative methods like increasing the time-span of measurement can improve accuracy without reducing incentives.

10.1086/714374.abstractZh: 医疗保健提供者越来越多地面临对嘈杂绩效信号的测量。我发现，通常用于提高绩效测量准确性的收缩估计方法，实际上削弱了绩效激励。我研究了这一现象在心脏病发作死亡率的医院绩效测量中的表现。对Medicare索赔数据的分析表明，收缩估计大大削弱了激励，尤其是对于规模较小的医院而言，其测量到的绩效仅提高了真实绩效的20%到40%。其他方法，如延长测量时间，可以在不降低激励的情况下提高准确性。

abstract.text: Cross-sectional estimates of hedonic price functions theoretically recover marginal values for characteristics but face endogeneity problems. Consequently, economists have introduced difference-in-differences and other quasi-experimental econometric methods into hedonic models. Unfortunately, the welfare interpretation of these estimands has not been clear. This paper shows that quasi-experimental hedonics can identify the movement along the ex post price function. It further shows that this effect is a lower bound on general equilibrium welfare. Thus, nonmarginal welfare can be recovered using transparent designs without Rosen’s second stage or more structural models. The paper illustrates these results with an application to toxic facilities and housing prices.

10.1086/714442.abstractZh: 横截面估计的享乐价格函数理论上能够恢复特征的边际价值，但面临内生性问题。因此，经济学家将差异-差异法和其他准实验计量经济学方法引入享乐模型。不幸的是，这些估计量的福利解释并不明确。本文表明，准实验享乐模型能够识别沿事后价格函数的变动。进一步研究表明，这种效应是一般均衡福利的下限。因此，无需使用罗森的第二阶段或更复杂的结构模型，就可以通过透明设计恢复非边际福利。本文以有毒设施和房价为例，说明了这些结果的应用价值。

abstract.text: Consider a market with identical firms offering a homogeneous good. For any given ex ante distribution of the price count (the number of firms from which a consumer obtains a quote), we derive a tight upper bound on the equilibrium distribution of sales prices. The bound holds across all models of firms’ common-prior higher-order beliefs about the price count, including the extreme cases of full information and no information. One implication of our results is that a small ex ante probability that the price count is equal to one can lead to a large increase in the expected price. The bound also applies in a large class of models where the price count distribution is endogenously determined.

10.1086/714443.abstractZh: 考虑一个由同质企业提供同质产品的市场。对于任何给定的价格数量分布（消费者从哪些企业提供报价），我们都能推导出均衡销售价格分布的严格上界。该上界适用于所有模型，包括企业关于价格数量的共同先验高阶信念的情况，包括完全信息和无信息这两种极端情况。我们的结果表明，如果价格数量等于一的概率很小，那么预期价格会有较大的增加。该上界也适用于价格数量分布是内生决定的大量模型。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of the Green Revolution in the developing world by exploiting exogenous heterogeneity in the timing and extent of the benefits derived from high-yielding crop varieties (HYVs). We find that HYVs increased yields by 44% between 1965 and 2010, with further gains coming through reallocation of inputs. Higher yields increased income and reduced population growth. A 10-year delay of the Green Revolution would in 2010 have cost 17% of GDP (gross domestic product) per capita and added 223 million people to the developing-world population. The cumulative GDP loss over 45 years would have been US$83 trillion, corresponding to approximately one year of current global GDP.

10.1086/714444.abstractZh: 我们通过利用高产作物品种带来的收益在时间和范围上的异质性，来估算绿色革命对发展中国家的影响。研究发现，从1965年到2010年间，高产作物品种的种植使产量增加了44%，而进一步的收益则来自于投入资源的重新分配。更高的产量增加了收入，并减缓了人口的增长。如果绿色革命推迟10年实施，到2010年，这将导致人均GDP损失17%，并使发展中国家的人口增加2.23亿。在45年的时间里，由此造成的累计GDP损失将达到83万亿美元，相当于当前全球GDP的一年总量。

abstract.text: We propose a model that uses the exchange rate of Bitcoin against the US dollar to predict the computing power of Bitcoin’s network. We show that free entry places an upper bound on mining revenues and explain how it can be identified. Calibrating the model’s parameters allows us to accurately forecast the evolution of the network computing power over time. We find that a significant share of mining rewards was invested in mining equipment and that the seigniorage income of miners was limited.

10.1086/714445.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，该模型利用比特币兑美元的汇率来预测比特币网络的算力。我们发现，免费参与行为对挖矿收入设定了上限，并解释了如何识别这一上限。通过校准模型参数，我们可以准确预测网络算力的随时间变化。我们发现，大量挖矿奖励被用于购买挖矿设备，而矿工的铸币收益是有限的。

abstract.text: The elasticity of taxable income is vital when predicting the effect of taxes. Bunching at kinks/notches has been used to estimate this elasticity. We show that when the preference distribution is unrestricted, bunching at a kink or a notch is not informative about the size of the elasticity, and neither is the entire distribution of taxable income. Bunching identifies the taxable income elasticity when the preference distribution is correctly specified across the kink and provides bounds under restrictions on the preference distribution. We find wide bounds in an empirical example based on upper and lower bounds for the preference density.

10.1086/714446.abstractZh: 在预测税收影响时，应税收入的弹性至关重要。人们通常使用在拐点或转折点处进行捆绑处理的方法来估算这一弹性。我们发现，当偏好分布不受限制时，在拐点或转折点处进行捆绑处理并不能提供关于弹性大小的准确信息，整个应税收入分布也是如此。当偏好分布在拐点处被正确指定时，捆绑处理能够确定应税收入的弹性，并在偏好分布有限制的情况下提供界限。基于偏好密度的上下界限，我们在实证案例中发现了较宽的界限。

abstract.text: We propose a dynamic general equilibrium model of exchange rate determination that accounts for all major exchange rate puzzles, including Meese-Rogoff, Backus-Smith, purchasing power parity, and uncovered interest rate parity puzzles. We build on a standard international real business cycle model with home bias in consumption, augmented with shocks in the financial market that result in a volatile near-martingale behavior of exchange rates and ensure their empirically relevant comovement with macroeconomic variables, both nominal and real. Combining financial shocks with conventional productivity and monetary shocks allows the model to reproduce the exchange rate disconnect properties without compromising the fit of the business cycle moments.

10.1086/714447.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态一般均衡模型，用于解释所有主要的汇率问题，包括Meese-Rogoff、Backus-Smith、购买力平价以及未覆盖的利率平价问题。该模型基于一个标准的国际实际商业周期模型，该模型包含消费方面的本土偏好，并增加了金融市场中的冲击，这些冲击导致汇率出现波动的近鞅行为，同时确保了汇率与名义和实际宏观经济变量之间的实证相关性。通过将金融冲击与传统的生产力和货币冲击结合起来，该模型能够再现汇率的分离特性，同时不损害商业周期时刻的拟合度。

abstract.text: The expansion of ranking systems has increased public access to information about organizations, but there is burgeoning concern that rankings reduce the accessibility of goods and services for individuals from lower socioeconomic status backgrounds. The evidence and underlying theory for this claim, however, remain unclear. This article develops two possibilities: (1) positional advantage, where rankings increase demand for better-ranked organizations and crowd out disadvantaged individuals; and (2) algorithmic trade-offs, where rankings lead organizations to optimize on criteria that are in tension with serving individuals from disadvantaged backgrounds. Scope conditions for these theories are established, and key predictions are tested with administrative data matched with U.S. News & World Report college rankings between 1997 and 2015. This research clarifies how the consequences of ranking systems spill over from organizations to broader social inequalities and demonstrates when and how rankings contribute to structural barriers to upward mobility.

10.1086/714916.abstractZh: 排名系统的扩展增加了公众获取组织信息的机会，但人们越来越担心，排名会降低来自较低社会经济背景的个人的商品和服务获取能力。然而，这一说法的证据和理论基础仍然不明确。本文提出了两种可能性：(1) 位置优势，即排名增加了对排名较高的组织的需求，从而排挤了处于不利地位的个体；(2) 算法权衡，即排名促使组织在与服务处于不利背景的个体相冲突的标准上做出优化。本文为这些理论建立了适用范围条件，并通过1997年至2015年间《美国新闻与世界报道》大学排名的行政数据进行了关键预测测试。这项研究阐明了排名系统的后果如何从组织层面扩散到更广泛的社会不平等现象，并揭示了排名何时以及如何导致向上流动的结构性障碍。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of information disclosure on consumer knowledge in an important context: the calorie content of restaurant food. We conduct a randomized controlled experiment of calorie labels on restaurant menus, and find that information disclosure improves consumer knowledge but does not eliminate the problem of imperfect information. Calorie labels improve consumers’ post-meal estimates of the number of calories they ordered by 4.0 percent and reduce by 28.9 percent the probability that consumers underestimate the calories in their meal by half or more. However, even after information disclosure, the absolute value of percent error averages 34.2 percent.

10.1086/714987.abstractZh: 我们在一个重要的背景下评估了信息披露对消费者认知的影响：餐厅食物的卡路里含量。我们进行了一项关于餐厅菜单卡路里标签的随机对照实验，发现信息披露确实提高了消费者的认知水平，但并未完全消除信息不完善的状况。卡路里标签使消费者餐后对所点食物的卡路里估计值提高了4.0%，并将消费者低估餐食卡路里的概率降低了28.9%。然而，即使进行了信息披露，误差百分比的平均值仍为34.2%。

abstract.text: This paper explores inequalities in IQ and economic preferences between children from families of high and low socioeconomic status (SES). We document that children from high-SES families are more intelligent, patient, and altruistic as well as less risk seeking. To understand the underlying mechanisms, we propose a framework of how SES, parental investments, as well as maternal IQ and preferences influence a child’s IQ and preferences. Our results indicate that disparities in the level of parental investments hold substantial importance. In light of the importance of IQ and preferences for behaviors and outcomes, our findings offer an explanation for social immobility.

10.1086/714992.abstractZh: 本文探讨了来自高社会经济地位（SES）和家庭背景的低收入家庭的孩子在智商和经济偏好方面的不平等现象。我们发现，来自高SES家庭的孩子更聪明、更有耐心、更无私，且风险寻求行为较少。为了理解这些现象背后的机制，我们提出了一个框架，说明SES、父母的投资行为以及母亲的智商和偏好如何影响孩子的智商和偏好。我们的研究结果表明，父母投资水平的差异具有非常重要的意义。鉴于智商和偏好对行为和结果的影响，我们的发现为社会的停滞不前提供了一种解释。

abstract.text: We study the set of possible joint posterior belief distributions of a group of agents who share a common prior regarding a binary state and who observe some information structure. For two agents, we introduce a quantitative version of Aumann’s agreement theorem and show that it is equivalent to a characterization of feasible distributions from a 1995 work by Dawid and colleagues. For any number of agents, we characterize feasible distributions in terms of a “no-trade” condition. We use these characterizations to study information structures with independent posteriors. We also study persuasion problems with multiple receivers, exploring the extreme feasible distributions.

10.1086/714993.abstractZh: 我们研究了一组代理人在共享一个关于二元状态的共同先验知识，并观察到某种信息结构的情况下，可能的联合后验信念分布。对于两个代理人，我们引入了Aumann一致性定理的定量版本，并证明它与Dawid及其同事在1995年提出的一个关于可行分布的表征是等价的。对于任意数量的代理人，我们通过“不交易”条件来表征可行分布。我们利用这些表征来研究具有独立先验的信息结构。我们还研究了具有多个接收者的说服问题，探索极端可行的分布。

abstract.text: Large-scale increases in discrimination can lead to dismissals of highly qualified managers. We investigate how expulsions of senior Jewish managers, due to rising discrimination in Nazi Germany, affected large corporations. Firms that lost Jewish managers experienced persistent reductions in stock prices, dividends, and returns on assets. Aggregate market value fell by roughly 1.8% of German GNP because of the expulsions. Managers who served as key connectors to other firms and managers who were highly educated were particularly important for firm performance. The findings imply that individual managers drive firm performance. Discrimination against qualified business leaders causes first-order economic losses.

10.1086/714994.abstractZh: 大规模的歧视行为可能导致高素质管理人才的被解雇。我们研究了在纳粹德国，由于歧视加剧而解雇高级犹太管理人才对大型企业的影响。失去犹太管理人才的企业经历了股价、股息和资产回报的持续下降。由于这些解雇行为，整体市场价值减少了大约1.8%的德国国民生产总值。那些作为企业间关键联系人的管理者，以及受教育程度较高的管理者，对企业的绩效尤为重要。研究结果表明，个别管理者能够推动企业的绩效。对合格商业领袖的歧视会导致严重的经济损失。

abstract.text: We analyze the extent to which citing practices may be driven by strategic considerations. The discontinuation of the Journal of Business (JB) in 2006 for extraneous reasons serves as an exogenous shock for analyzing strategic citing behavior. Using a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that articles published in JB before 2006 experienced a relative reduction in citations of approximately 20% after 2006. Since the discontinuation of JB is unrelated to the scientific contributions of its articles, the results imply that the referencing of articles is systematically affected by strategic considerations, which hinders scientific progress.

10.1086/715021.abstractZh: 我们分析了引用行为在多大程度上受到战略考虑的影响。2006年《商业杂志》因外部原因停刊，这一事件成为分析战略引用行为的外生冲击。通过差异-差异分析，我们发现2006年之前发表在《商业杂志》上的文章，在2006年之后引用次数减少了约20%。由于《商业杂志》的停刊与其文章的科学贡献无关，这些结果表明，文章的引用行为受到战略考虑的系统性影响，这阻碍了科学的进步。

abstract.text: We study optimal provision of unemployment insurance in a model where agents privately observe arrival of job opportunities and government’s ability to commit is imperfect. Imperfect commitment implies that full information revelation is generally suboptimal. Social welfare is convex in the probability with which agents reveal their private information. In the optimum, each agent is provided with incentives to either fully reveal his private information or not reveal it at all. The optimal contract can be decentralized by a joint system of unemployment and disability benefits in a way that resembles how these systems are used in practice.

10.1086/715022.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个模型中失业保险的最优供给问题，在该模型中，代理人私下观察着就业机会的到来，而政府的承诺能力并不完美。不完美的承诺意味着完全信息的披露通常是不理想的。社会福利在代理人披露私人信息的概率上呈凸性。在最优状态下，每个代理人都有激励去完全披露自己的私人信息，或者根本不披露。最优契约可以通过失业和残疾救济金的联合体系来实现去中心化，这种实施方式类似于实际中这些体系的运作方式。

abstract.text: We study the repeated prisoner’s dilemma with random matching, a canonical model of community enforcement with decentralized information. We assume that (1) with small probability, each player is a “bad type” who never cooperates, (2) players observe and remember their partners’ identities, and (3) each player interacts with others frequently but meets any particular partner infrequently. We show that these assumptions preclude cooperation in the absence of explicit communication but that introducing within-match cheap talk communication restores cooperation. Thus, communication is essential for community enforcement.

10.1086/715023.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有随机匹配机制的重复囚徒困境，这是具有去中心化信息的社区执行的典型模型。我们假设：(1) 以很小的概率，每个玩家都是“坏类型”，从不合作；(2) 玩家能够观察到并记住其他玩家的身份；(3) 每个玩家频繁与其他玩家互动，但很少与特定玩家见面。我们证明，在这些假设下，如果没有明确的沟通，合作是难以实现的，但引入在匹配过程中的廉价沟通可以恢复合作。因此，沟通对于社区执行来说至关重要。

abstract.text: This paper shows that liquidity regulation can trigger unintended credit booms in the presence of interbank market power. We consider a price setter and a continuum of price takers who trade reserves after the realization of idiosyncratic liquidity shocks. The price takers are endogenously less liquid and circumvent regulation by engaging in shadow banking, which leads to a reallocation of funding away from the more liquid price setter. This reallocation channel underlies the credit boom. Endogenous responses in bank liquidity ratios also affect the magnitude of the boom. We discuss extensions of the model and illustrate its quantitative performance with an application to China.

10.1086/715074.abstractZh: 本文指出，在银行间市场存在权力的情况下，流动性调节可能会引发意外的信贷繁荣。我们设想了一个价格设定者和一个连续的价格接受者群体，他们在特定流动性冲击发生后进行储备交易。这些价格接受者由于内生性原因流动性较低，通过影子银行活动规避监管，导致资金从流动性较高的价格设定者处重新分配。这种资金重新分配的过程是信贷繁荣的基础。银行流动性比率的内生性反应也会影响信贷繁荣的幅度。我们讨论了模型的扩展，并通过对中国的情况进行应用，展示了该模型的定量表现。

abstract.text: Environmental markets are widely prescribed as an alternative to open access regimes for natural resources. We develop a model of dynamic groundwater extraction to demonstrate how a spatial regression discontinuity design that exploits a spatially incomplete market for groundwater rights recovers a lower bound on the market’s net benefit. We apply this estimator to a major aquifer in water-scarce southern California and find that a groundwater market generated substantial net benefits, as capitalized in land values. Heterogeneity analyses point to gains arising in part from rights trading, enabling more efficient water use across sectors. Additional findings suggest that the market increased groundwater levels.

10.1086/715075.abstractZh: 环境市场被广泛认为是自然资源开放获取制度的替代方案。我们建立了一个动态地下水开采模型，以展示如何利用空间不完全的地下水权利市场，通过空间回归不连续设计来估算市场的净收益下限。我们将这一估算方法应用于加利福尼亚州南部水资源匮乏地区的一个主要含水层，发现地下水市场带来了显著的净收益，这些收益体现在土地价值的增值上。异质性分析表明，收益部分来源于权利交易，从而促进了不同行业之间更高效的用水。此外，研究还发现，市场提高了地下水位。

abstract.text: We propose a new nonparametric approach to estimate the production function for housing. Our estimation treats output as a latent variable and relies on a first-order condition for profit maximization combined with a zero-profit condition. More desirable locations command higher land prices and, in turn, more capital to build houses. For parcels of a given size, we compute housing production by summing across the marginal products of capital. For newly built single-family homes in France, the production function for housing is close to constant returns and is well, though not perfectly, approximated by a Cobb-Douglas function with a capital elasticity of 0.65.

10.1086/715076.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的非参数方法来估计住房的生产函数。我们的估计将产出视为一个潜在变量，并基于利润最大化的一阶条件以及零利润条件来进行计算。更理想的地理位置意味着更高的土地价格，进而需要更多的资本来建造房屋。对于给定面积的地块，我们通过汇总资本的边际产品来计算住房的生产量。在法国新建的单户住宅中，住房的生产函数接近常数回报，虽然不能完美地用Cobb-Douglas函数来近似，但其资本弹性为0.65。

abstract.text: This paper develops a dynamic general equilibrium model on the interaction of bankers’ asset and liability management with liquidity concerns. Bankers screen real production projects and issue deposit contracts. Liquidity concerns stem from endogenized early withdrawals of deposits. To fulfill early withdrawals, bankers sell assets in a secondary market. The paper argues that ex post asymmetric information in the secondary market distorts bankers’ incentive to screen ex ante, as bad assets are easier to sell and generate liquidity benefits. Moreover, the general equilibrium feature of the model implies that exogenous aggregate productivity shocks are amplified and that booms may lead to busts.

10.1086/715144.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，研究银行家资产管理和负债管理与流动性问题之间的相互作用。银行家筛选实际生产项目并发行存款合同。流动性问题源于存款的提前提取行为。为了应对提前提取需求，银行家在二级市场上出售资产。文章指出，二级市场中的事后信息不对称会扭曲银行家的事前筛选行为，因为不良资产更容易出售并带来流动性收益。此外，该模型的一般均衡特性意味着外部总生产率冲击会被放大，经济繁荣可能导致经济崩溃。

abstract.text: This paper quantifies the benefits of discretion in the enforcement of environmental regulations. We identify and estimate a structural model of regulator-discharger interactions, exploiting an increase in the enforcement stringency of water pollution regulations in California. Our estimates indicate that most of the heterogeneity in punishments for observably similar violations is due to heterogeneity in discharger compliance costs rather than heterogeneity in regulator preferences. We find that removing the discretion of regulators to tailor punishments to discharger attributes would raise enforcement costs and decrease compliance by dischargers with high social harms of violations.

10.1086/715415.abstractZh: 本文量化了在环境法规执行中赋予监管者自由裁量权所带来的好处。我们构建并估计了一个监管者与排放者互动的结构模型，以分析加州水污染法规执行严格程度的变化对两者的影响。我们的估计结果显示，对于明显相似的违规行为，惩罚差异的主要原因在于排放者合规成本的差异，而非监管者偏好的差异。我们发现，如果取消监管者根据排放者属性调整惩罚的自由裁量权，将会增加执法成本，并降低那些违规行为对社会危害较大的排放者的合规行为。

abstract.text: We investigate the transmission of monetary policy to household consumption using administrative data on the universe of households in Norway. On the basis of identified monetary policy shocks, we estimate the dynamic responses of consumption, income, and saving along the liquid asset distribution of households. For low-liquidity but also for high-liquidity households, changes in disposable income are associated with a sizable consumption reaction. The impact consumption response is closely linked to interest rate exposure, which is negative at the bottom but positive at the top of the distribution. Indirect effects of monetary policy gradually build up and eventually outweigh the direct effects.

10.1086/715416.abstractZh: 我们研究了货币政策对家庭消费的影响，使用了挪威家庭群体的行政数据进行分析。在识别出货币政策冲击的基础上，我们估计了消费、收入和储蓄在家庭流动资产分布中的动态反应。无论是低流动性家庭还是高流动性家庭，可支配收入的变化都会引发显著的消费反应。消费反应的这种影响与利率风险密切相关，在收入分布较低端时利率风险为负，而在较高端时则为正。货币政策的间接效应逐渐累积，最终可能超过直接效应。

abstract.text: This paper studies the formation of math and verbal skills during compulsory education and their impact on educational attainment. Using longitudinal data that follow students in England from elementary school to university, we find that the production functions of math and verbal skills are inherently different, where cross effects are present only in the production of math skills. Results on long-term educational outcomes indicate that verbal skills play a substantially greater role in explaining university enrollment than math skills. This finding, combined with the large female advantage in verbal skills, has key implications for gender gaps in college enrollment.

10.1086/715417.abstractZh: 本文研究了义务教育期间数学和语言技能的形成及其对教育成就的影响。通过追踪英格兰学生从小学到大学的纵向数据，我们发现数学和语言技能的生产函数本质上不同，而交叉效应仅存在于数学技能的生产过程中。关于长期教育成果的研究表明，语言技能在解释大学入学率方面的作用远大于数学技能。这一发现，加上女性在语言技能方面存在的显著优势，对大学入学中的性别差距具有关键意义。

abstract.text: We provide an econometric framework for estimating a game of simultaneous entry and pricing decisions while allowing for correlations between unobserved cost and demand shocks. We use our framework to account for selection in the pricing stage. We estimate the model using data from the US airline industry and find that not accounting for endogenous entry leads to biased estimation of demand elasticities. We simulate a merger between American and US Airways and find that product repositioning and postmerger outcomes depend on how we model the characteristics of the merged firm as a function of the premerger firms’ characteristics.

10.1086/715848.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个计量经济框架，用于估计同时进行的进入和定价决策，同时允许未观察到的成本和需求冲击之间的相关性。我们使用该框架来解释定价阶段的选择性。我们通过美国航空业的数据来估计模型，发现如果不考虑内生性进入因素，会导致需求弹性估计出现偏差。我们模拟了美国航空公司与US Airways的合并，发现产品重新定位和合并后的结果取决于我们如何根据合并前公司的特征来建模合并后公司的特征。

abstract.text: We develop a quantitative macroeconomic theory of input-saving technical change to analyze how markets economize on scarce natural resources, with an application to fossil fuel. We find that aggregate US data call for a very low short-run substitution elasticity between energy and the capital/labor inputs. Our estimates imply that energy-saving technical change took off when the oil shocks hit in the 1970s. This response implies significant substitutability with the other inputs in the long run: even under ever-rising energy prices, long-run consumption growth is still possible, along with a modest factor share of energy.

10.1086/715849.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种定量宏观经济理论，用于分析市场如何节约稀缺的自然资源，并将这一理论应用于化石燃料领域。研究发现，美国的总体数据表明，能源与资本/劳动力投入之间的短期替代弹性非常低。我们的估计表明，能源节约型技术变革在20世纪70年代石油危机爆发时开始兴起。这一反应意味着从长期来看，能源与其他投入之间存在显著的替代性：即使能源价格不断上升，长期消费增长仍然是可能的，同时能源的要素份额也会保持适度。

abstract.text: Expert advice often extends beyond a simple recommendation, including information about alternative options. To explore the role of this referential advice, we enrich the expert’s informational advantage in a canonical model of communication with hard information. We show that when constructed just right, referential advice dissuades the decision maker from choosing options other than the recommendation, thereby making the recommendation itself more persuasive. We identify an equilibrium in which, with probability 1, the expert is strictly better off providing referential advice than she is in any equilibrium in which she provides a recommendation alone.

10.1086/715850.abstractZh: 专家的建议往往不仅仅包含简单的推荐，还包含关于其他选择的信息。为了探讨这种参考性建议的作用，我们在一个包含硬信息的典型沟通模型中，丰富了专家的信息优势。我们发现，当参考性建议设计得恰到好处时，它会阻止决策者选择推荐之外的其他选项，从而使推荐本身更具说服力。我们找到了一种均衡状态，在这种状态下，专家提供参考性建议时的收益，在概率上绝对优于她单独提供推荐时的收益。

abstract.text: We explore the optimal shape of the income tax and transfer schedule in an environment with distinct roles for public and private insurance. In a calibration to the United States, we find that the optimal system features marginal tax rates that increase in income. When we increase pressure on the government to raise revenue, the optimal marginal tax schedule becomes first flatter and then U-shaped, reconciling various findings in the literature. A power function parametric tax schedule outperforms an affine one, indicating that tax progressivity is more important than lump-sum transfers. We also explore various social welfare objectives and Pareto-improving reforms.

10.1086/715851.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在公共保险与私人保险角色分明的情况下，所得税和转移支付制度的最佳形态。通过对美国情况的校准，我们发现，最优制度的特点是边际税率随收入增加而上升。当政府面临增加收入的压力时，最优的边际税率曲线最初呈现平坦状，随后变为U形，这与文献中的各种研究结果相吻合。幂函数形式的税收制度优于仿射函数形式，这表明税收的累进性比固定金额的转移支付更为重要。我们还探讨了各种社会福利目标以及能够提升帕累托改进的改革措施。

abstract.text: We take the perspective of an econometrician who wants to determine which of two experiments provides higher expected utility but only knows the decisions under each experiment. To compare these decisions, the econometrician must make inferences about what the experiment might have been for each set of decisions. We provide a necessary and sufficient condition that identifies when every experiment consistent with one set of decisions has a higher value of information than every experiment consistent with the other set of decisions.

10.1086/716104.abstractZh: 我们从一个计量经济学家角度出发，该经济学家想要确定两个实验中哪一个能提供更高的预期效用，但他只知道在每种实验下的决策结果。为了比较这些决策，计量经济学家必须推断出在每种决策下，每个实验可能具有的信息价值。我们提出了一个必要且充分的条件，用于判断在符合一组决策的实验下，其信息价值是否高于符合另一组决策的实验。

abstract.text: We propose a new model of legislative bargaining in which coalitions may have different values, reflecting the fact that the policies they can pursue are constrained by the identity of the coalition members. As the delay between offers goes to zero, the equilibrium allocation of the model converges to a generalized version of a Nash bargaining solution in which—in contrast to the standard solution—the winning coalition is endogenous and determined by the relative coalitional values. A form of the holdup problem specific to these bargaining games contributes to generate significant inefficiencies in the selection of the coalition.
