The model helps rationalize well-known empirical facts that are in conflict with the predictions of standard noncooperative models of bargaining.

10.1086/716105.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的立法谈判模型，在该模型中，各联盟可能持有不同的价值观，这反映了它们所能追求的政策受到联盟成员身份的限制。随着提议之间的延迟趋近于零，模型的均衡分配会收敛到一种纳什谈判解的广义形式——与标准解不同，获胜联盟是内生的，并由相对联盟价值观决定。这种谈判游戏特有的“拖延问题”会导致联盟选择过程中出现显著的效率低下。该模型有助于解释一些众所周知的实证事实，这些事实与标准非合作谈判模型的预测相矛盾。

abstract.text: Modifications of risk adjustment systems used to pay health plans in individual health insurance markets typically seek to reduce selection incentives at the individual and group levels by adding variables to the payment formula. Adding variables can be costly and can lead to unintended incentives for upcoding or service utilization. While these drawbacks are recognized, they are hard to quantify and difficult to balance against the concrete, measurable improvements in fit that may be achieved by adding variables to the formula. This paper takes a different approach to improving the performance of health plan payment systems. Using the HHS-HHC V0519 model from the Marketplaces as a starting point, we constrain fit at the individual and group levels to be as good or better than the current payment model while reducing the number of variables in the model. We introduce three elements in the design of plan payment: reinsurance, constrained regressions, and machine learning methods for variable selection. The fit performance of our alternative formulas with many fewer variables is as good or better than the current HHS-HHC V0519 formula.

10.1086/716199.abstractZh: 在个人健康保险市场中，用于支付健康计划的风险调整系统的修改通常旨在通过向支付公式中添加变量来减少个人和群体层面的选择激励。添加变量可能会带来高昂的成本，并可能导致不希望出现的过度编码或服务利用行为。尽管这些缺点已被认识到，但它们难以量化，也难以与通过添加变量到公式中可能实现的更精确、可测量的改进相平衡。本文采取了不同的方法来改善健康计划支付系统的性能。以HHS-HHC V0519模型为起点，我们限制了个人和群体层面的拟合度，使其与当前支付模型相当或更好，同时减少了模型中的变量数量。我们在计划支付设计中引入了三个要素：再保险、约束回归以及用于变量选择的机器学习方法。我们的替代公式在变量数量减少的情况下，其拟合性能与当前的HHS-HHC V0519公式相当或更好。

abstract.text: Calibration means that forecasts and average realized frequencies are close. We develop the concept of forecast hedging, which consists of choosing the forecasts so as to guarantee that the expected track record can only improve. This yields all the calibration results by the same simple basic argument while differentiating between them by the forecast-hedging tools used: deterministic and fixed point based versus stochastic and minimax based. Additional contributions are an improved definition of continuous calibration, ensuing game dynamics that yield Nash equilibria in the long run, and a new calibrated forecasting procedure for binary events that is simpler than all known such procedures.

10.1086/716559.abstractZh: 校准意味着预测结果与实际平均频率接近。我们提出了预测对冲的概念，即选择预测结果以确保预期表现只能改善。这一方法通过相同的简单基础论点得出所有校准结果，而不同之处在于所使用的预测对冲工具：确定性方法和基于固定点的方法，以及随机性和极小化方法。此外，我们还提出了连续校准的改进定义，以及能够长期产生纳什均衡的游戏动态，并提出了一种针对二元事件的新型校准预测方法，该方法比所有已知的此类方法更为简单。

abstract.text: We build a multicountry dynamic general equilibrium model to study the economic effects of the 2004 enlargement of the European Union. In our model, trade is costly and households of different skills and nationalities face costly forward-looking migration decisions. We exploit the timing of migration policy changes to identify the changes in migration costs. We find that the changes in migration and trade policy resulted in aggregate welfare gains but with heterogeneous effects across skill groups. We study the interaction between trade and migration policies and highlight the importance of trade for quantifying the welfare and migration effects of labor market integration.

10.1086/716560.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个多国动态一般均衡模型，以研究2004年欧盟扩大所带来的经济影响。在我们的模型中，贸易是昂贵的，不同技能和国籍的家庭面临昂贵的前瞻性迁移决策。我们利用迁移政策变化的时机来识别迁移成本的变化。我们发现，迁移和贸易政策的变化带来了总体福利收益，但不同技能群体之间的影响存在差异。我们研究了贸易与迁移政策之间的相互作用，并强调了贸易在量化劳动力市场整合的福利和迁移效应方面的重要性。

abstract.text: We study the causal effect of incarceration on reoffending using discontinuities in North Carolina’s sentencing guidelines. A regression discontinuity analysis shows that 1 year of incarceration causes a reduction in the likelihood of being reincarcerated within 3, 5, and 8 years from sentencing by 44%, 29%, and 21%, respectively. To parse the potentially heterogeneous dose response relationship underlying these effects, we develop an econometric model of prison sentences and recidivism. We find that incarceration has meaningful reoffending-reducing average effects that diminish in incarceration length. As a result, budget-neutral reductions in sentence length combined with increases in incarceration rates can decrease recidivism.

10.1086/716561.abstractZh: 我们研究了监禁对再犯罪行为的因果效应，通过北卡罗来纳州量刑指南中的不连续性来进行分析。回归不连续性分析显示，监禁一年会使在判决后3年、5年和8年内再次被监禁的可能性分别降低44%、29%和21%。为了解析这些效应背后的可能异质剂量反应关系，我们建立了一个关于监禁刑期与再犯罪行为的计量经济模型。我们发现，监禁确实具有显著的再犯罪减少效应，且这种效应随着监禁时间的延长而减弱。因此，在保持判决长度不变的情况下，增加监禁率可以降低再犯罪率。

abstract.text: Men who father their first child at a very young age are convicted of significantly fewer crimes in the first years after birth if the child is a son rather than a daughter. This leads to behavioral spillovers that reduce criminal convictions among other young men living in the same neighborhood, with the resulting crime multipliers affecting peers’ crime even after the primary impact on the focal individual has dissipated. Through social multipliers, prevention policies that target potential criminals at an early stage, therefore, lead to larger reductions in the cost of crime than suggested by primary effects alone.

10.1086/716562.abstractZh: 在非常年轻的时候生下第一个孩子的男性，如果生的是儿子而不是女儿，那么在孩子出生后的最初几年中，他们被判犯下的罪行会显著减少。这种行为效应会波及同一社区中的其他年轻男性，导致犯罪率进一步下降。这种犯罪乘数效应即使在主要影响个体消失后，仍会对同龄人的犯罪产生影响。因此，针对潜在犯罪者的早期预防政策，能够比单纯依靠主要效应带来更大的犯罪成本降低效果。

abstract.text: In many industries, upstream manufacturers pay downstream retailers for achieving quantity or market share targets. These “vertical rebates” may mitigate downstream moral hazard by inducing greater retail effort but may also incentivize retailers to drop competing products. We study these offsetting effects empirically for a rebate paid to one retailer. Using a field experiment, we exogenously vary the outcome of retailer effort. We estimate models of consumer choice and retailer behavior to quantify the rebate’s effect on retail assortment and effort. We find that the rebate is designed to exclude a competing product and fails to maximize social surplus.

10.1086/716563.abstractZh: 在许多行业中，上游制造商向下游零售商支付费用，以换取实现数量或市场份额目标。这些“垂直回扣”可能会通过促使零售商更加努力地经营来减轻下游的道德风险，但也可能激励零售商放弃竞争产品。我们通过实证研究，针对向某一零售商支付的回扣，探讨了这些相互抵消的影响。通过实地实验，我们人为地改变了零售商的努力程度。我们建立了消费者选择和零售商行为的模型，以量化回扣对零售商品组合和努力程度的影响。研究发现，回扣的目的是排除竞争产品，但并未能最大化社会总收益。

abstract.text: This paper studies the industry-level and aggregate implications of financial development on international trade. I set up a multi-industry general equilibrium model of international trade with input-output linkages and heterogeneous firms subject to financial frictions. Industries differ in capital intensity, which leads to differences in external finance dependence. The model is parameterized to match key features of firm-level data. Financial development leads to substantial reallocation of international trade shares from labor- to capital-intensive industries, with minor effects at the aggregate level. These findings are consistent with estimates from cross-country industry-level and aggregate data.

10.1086/716564.abstractZh: 本文研究了金融发展对国际贸易的行业级和总体影响。我们建立了一个包含投入产出联系的多行业国际贸易一般均衡模型，其中企业具有异质性，并受到金融摩擦的影响。不同行业在资本强度上存在差异，这导致外部融资依赖性的不同。该模型经过参数化调整，以匹配企业级数据的关键特征。金融发展导致国际贸易份额从劳动密集型行业向资本密集型行业大幅转移，对总体水平的影响较小。这些发现与跨国行业级和总体数据的估计结果一致。

abstract.text: Recent increases in mortality are at the forefront of the public health debate in the United States. This paper takes a comparative international perspective and documents the poor relative performance of life expectancy in the United States. We characterize its age and cause of death profiles over time and estimate its welfare implications. We show that this poor performance is not recent, not restricted to very particular causes of death, but mostly driven by adults and older ages. We calculate that recent welfare gains could have been 19%–28% higher had the United States been able to reproduce the life expectancy performance of the average member of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development.

10.1086/717543.abstractZh: 近期死亡率的上升成为美国公共卫生讨论的焦点。本文从国际比较的角度出发，记录了美国预期寿命的较差表现。我们分析了其年龄和死亡原因的变化趋势，并估算了其对福利的影响。研究表明，这种较差的表现并非近期才出现，也不局限于某些特定的死亡原因，而主要是由成年人和高龄人群导致的。我们计算发现，如果美国能够重现经济合作与发展组织成员国平均预期寿命的水平，那么最近的福利改善幅度可能会高出19%至28%。

abstract.text: Although countries have implemented pro-competitive reforms in health care to reduce costs and improve quality, there is limited evidence on the effect of competition on quality of care provided by physicians. We study the effect of competition on the provision of low-value—ineffective or harmful—health care by general practitioners (GPs). We use rich patient-level data on GP consultations in Australia and measure competition as distance to other GPs. Our study found that GPs facing more competition provide lower quality of care by ordering more imaging for low back pain and uncomplicated acute bronchitis. We find similar but smaller and insignificant effects of competition on prescribing antibiotics for coughs and colds. Competition can have mixed effects across different conditions because of differences in GPs’ beliefs and patient expectations about the effectiveness of care, as well as differences in demand, costs, and profit.

10.1086/718509.abstractZh: 尽管各国在医疗保健领域实施了有利于竞争的改革，以降低成本并提高质量，但关于竞争对医生提供的医疗服务质量影响的研究却很少。本研究探讨了竞争对全科医生提供的低质量——即无效或有害的——医疗服务的影响。我们利用了澳大利亚关于全科医生咨询的丰富患者级数据，并通过与其他全科医生的距离来衡量竞争程度。研究发现，面临更多竞争的全科医生会为低背痛和单纯性急性支气管炎患者开具更多影像学检查，从而导致医疗服务质量下降。对于咳嗽和感冒的抗生素处方，竞争的影响则类似，但程度较小且不显著。由于全科医生对医疗服务有效性的看法、患者的期望以及需求、成本和利润的差异，竞争在不同情况下可能会产生不同的效果。

abstract.text: In this article the effects of cartelization on firms’ efficiency are investigated using the example of an early twentieth century coal-mining cartel in Upper Silesia: the Upper Silesian Coal Convention. Established in 1898, the cartel comprised various types of private, as well as state-owned, mining enterprises. Using a microeconomic dataset based on firm-level data of the Upper Silesian mines, I focus on the cartel’s effect on efficiency. The cartel did not significantly reduce technical efficiency among mines. This finding confirms previous research on cartels’ effects on efficiency.

10.1093/ereh/heab006.abstractZh: 本文以20世纪早期上西里西亚地区的一个煤炭矿业卡特尔为例，探讨了卡特尔化对企业效率的影响。该卡特尔成立于1898年，由各种类型的私营及国有矿业企业组成。基于上西里西亚矿区企业层面的微观经济数据，本文重点研究了卡特尔对效率的影响。研究发现，卡特尔并未显著降低各矿区的技术效率。这一结论证实了先前关于卡特尔对效率影响的研究结果。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: In recent years, countries have increasingly relied on markets to improve efficiency, contain costs, and maintain quality in aged care. Under the right conditions, competition can spur providers to compete by offering better prices and higher quality of services. However, in aged care, market failures can be extensive. Information about prices and quality may not be readily available and search costs can be high. This study undertakes a scoping review on competition in the nursing home sector, with an emphasis on empirical evidence in relation to how competition affects prices and quality of care. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: Online databases were used to identify studies published in the English language between 1988 and 2020. A total of 50 studies covering 9 countries are reviewed. RESULTS: The review finds conflicting evidence on the relationship between competition and quality. Some studies find greater competition leading to higher quality, others find the opposite. Institutional features such as the presence of binding supply restrictions on nursing homes and public reporting of quality information are important considerations. Most studies find greater competition tends to result in lower prices, although the effect is small. DISCUSSION AND IMPLICATIONS: The literature offers several key policy lessons, including the relationship between supply restrictions and quality, which has implications on whether increasing subsidies can result in higher quality and the importance of price transparency and public reporting of quality.

10.1093/geront/gnab050.abstractZh:
背景与目的：近年来，各国越来越依赖市场来提高效率、控制成本并维持老年护理服务的质量。在合适的条件下，竞争可以促使提供者通过提供更低的价格和更高质量的服务来竞争。然而，在老年护理领域，市场失灵现象可能较为普遍。关于价格和质量的信息可能并不容易获得，搜索成本也可能很高。本研究对养老院领域的竞争进行了范围审查，重点探讨了竞争如何影响护理服务的价格和质量。

研究设计与方法：通过在线数据库检索1988年至2020年间以英语发表的相关研究。共回顾了9个国家内的50项研究。

结果：研究结果表明，关于竞争与质量之间的关系存在矛盾的结论。一些研究发现，更多的竞争会导致更高的质量，而另一些研究则得出相反的结论。诸如对养老院施加的供应限制以及公开报告质量信息等制度因素是重要的考虑因素。大多数研究认为，更多的竞争往往会导致更低的价格，尽管这种影响相对较小。

讨论与启示：文献提供了一些重要的政策启示，包括供应限制与质量之间的关系，这涉及到增加补贴是否能带来更高的质量，以及价格透明度和公开报告质量信息的重要性。

abstract.text: This study examines the impacts of high-speed railway (HSR) transportation on the healthcare-seeking behaviour of patients along newly integrated areas of Sichuan province, China. The opening of the Cheng-Mian-Le intercity HSR is considered as quasi-experimental evidence from China, and we make a propensity score matching the difference in differences research design, using data from the monthly report database of the Sichuan Province health statistical data collection and Decision Support System from 2014 to 2015. We find that, first, the opening of the HSR resulted in significant healthcare-seeking behaviour with great heterogeneity. Second, patients are more likely to go to areas with high-density healthcare resources, in which case HSR may mitigate the diagnostic inaccuracies that patients face locally. Third, the 'distance enhancement effect' was present, and its marginal effect is more significant for long-distance patients. Fourth, the tiered-network healthcare policy has no significant restrictive impact on patients seeking high-level medical services. Our results show that HSR establishment has a substantial impact on the behaviour of people seeking medical treatment and medicine. Furthermore, we discuss the results' policy implications for the allocation and integration of China's healthcare market, and the accessibility of medical and health services.

10.1093/heapol/czab018.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了高速铁路（HSR）交通对中国四川省新整合地区患者就医行为的影响。以成绵乐城际HSR的开通为例，作为中国准实验性研究的依据，我们采用了倾向得分匹配法，利用2014至2015年间四川省健康统计数据收集与决策支持系统的月度报告数据库数据，进行了差异组间比较研究。研究发现：首先，HSR的开通显著影响了患者的就医行为，且这种影响具有显著的异质性；其次，患者更倾向于前往医疗资源丰富的地区，此时HSR可能有助于减少患者在当地遇到的诊断不准确问题；第三，存在“距离增强效应”，其对远距离患者的边际影响更为显著；第四，分级网络医疗政策对寻求高级医疗服务的患者没有显著的限制作用。我们的研究结果表明，HSR的设立对寻求医疗服务的人的行为及医疗市场产生了实质性影响。此外，我们还讨论了这些研究结果对中国医疗市场布局与整合以及医疗服务可及性的政策意义。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Risk-scoring tools for perioperative mortality adjustment are essential for inter-hospital quality comparisons, which are still lacking in China. Existing scores had significant disadvantages when applied in managerial practice. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop a simple risk score using highly accessible information that could appropriately adjust the perioperative mortality from major surgeries across tertiary Chinese public hospitals and provide a reference for other underdeveloped countries with the same need. METHODS: A study cohort from 19 hospitals was randomly split into a development set and an internal validation set in the ratio of 7:3. Another cohort from six hospitals was used as an external validation set. All data were obtained from the military-hospital public services database of the National Engineering Laboratory of Application Technology in Medical Big Data. Patients aged above 18 years undergoing one of the five categories of major surgical procedures between 1 January 2010 and 31 December 2020 were identified. The multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to predict the risk of mortality and derive the risk score. The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and the Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test were used to assess the discrimination and calibration of the model, respectively. RESULTS: The study set included 45 558 cases, divided into a development set containing 31 891 cases and an internal validation set with 13 667 cases. Another cohort with 14 956 cases was used as an external validation set. The final included predictor variables were age, Elixhauser Comorbidity Index, condition at admission, admission route and the procedure. The predicted risk score ranged from -21.5 to 37.0 points. The model discriminated well in the development set, internal validation set, and external validation set. The AUC for them were 0.753 (Standard Error(SE) 0.016, 95% Confidence Interval(CI): 0.721,0.784), 0.790 (SE 0.025, 95% CI: 0.742,0.839), and 0.766(SE 0.019, 95% CI: 0.728, 0.804), respectively. P values in the Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test were all above 0.05, indicating a good calibration. CONCLUSIONS: This risk-scoring model was proved to have satisfactory performance, allowing the rapid and effective risk adjustment of perioperative mortality when comparing the surgical quality in tertiary hospitals in China and other underdeveloped regions.

10.1093/intqhc/mzab080.abstractZh: 背景：用于调整围手术期死亡率的风险评分工具对于医院间质量的比较至关重要，但在中国这一方面仍然缺乏相关措施。现有的评分方法在管理实践中存在显著缺陷。目的：本研究旨在利用易于获取的信息开发一种简单的风险评分方法，以合理调整中国三级公立医院重大手术的围手术期死亡率，并为其他需求相似的发展中国家提供参考。方法：从19家医院选取的研究对象随机分为开发组和内部验证组，比例为7:3。另外，从6家医院选取的另一组对象作为外部验证组。所有数据来自国家医学大数据应用技术工程实验室的军队医院公共服务数据库。研究范围包括2010年1月1日至2020年12月31日期间接受五种重大手术的患者。采用多变量逻辑回归分析来预测死亡风险并得出风险评分。通过接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和Hosmer-Lemeshow拟合优度检验分别评估模型的区分能力和校准效果。结果：研究组包含45,558例病例，其中开发组包含31,891例，内部验证组包含13,667例。外部验证组包含14,956例病例。最终确定的预测变量包括年龄、Elixhauser合并症指数、入院时的状况、入院途径以及手术类型。预测的风险评分范围在-21.5至37.0分之间。该模型在开发集、内部验证集和外部验证集上的区分能力表现良好。其AUC分别为0.753（标准误差SE为0.016，95%置信区间CI：0.721,0.784）、0.790（SE为0.025，95% CI：0.742,0.839）和0.766（SE为0.019，95% CI：0.728, 0.804）。Hosmer-Lemeshow拟合优度检验的P值均高于0.05，表明模型具有良好的校准效果。结论：该风险评分模型表现出令人满意的性能，能够在比较中国及其他欠发达地区三级医院的手术质量时，快速有效地调整围手术期风险。

abstract.text: In the late 2000s, a regulatory reform dramatically strengthened the incentives of French nonprofit (NP) hospitals to attract patients. Exploiting exhaustive data for surgery treatments between 2005 and 2008, and modeling hospitals as supplying utility to patients, we show that increased competitive pressure on NP hospitals caused them to perform more procedures, but did not inflate overall activity at the industry level. Although they have gained market shares over their for-profit (FP) counterparts, NP hospitals have been significantly worse off after the reform. To adjust to stronger financial incentives, they incurred an additional effort (pecuniary and non-pecuniary costs) equivalent to about a quarter of their annual revenue.

10.1093/jeea/jvab031.abstractZh: 在2000年代末，一项监管改革显著增强了法国非营利医院吸引患者的动力。通过利用2005至2008年间手术治疗的详尽数据，并将医院视为向患者提供公共服务的机构，我们发现，对非营利医院的竞争压力增加导致它们进行了更多的手术，但并未导致整个行业的活动量上升。尽管非营利医院在市场份额上超过了营利性医院，但改革后它们的状况明显恶化。为了适应更强的财务激励，它们不得不承担相当于年度收入约四分之一的额外成本，包括经济和非经济方面的费用。

abstract.text: Quasi-markets that introduce choice and competition between public service providers are intended to improve quality and efficiency. This article demonstrates that quasi-market competition may also affect the distribution of users. First, we develop a simple theoretical framework that distinguishes between user sorting and cream-skimming as mechanisms through which quasi-markets may lead to high-ability users becoming more concentrated among one group of providers and low-ability users among a different group. Second, we empirically examine the impact of a nationwide quasi-market policy that introduced choice and activity-based budgeting into Danish public high schools. We exploit variation in the degree of competition that schools were exposed to, based on the concentration of providers within a geographical area. Using a differences-in-differences design—and register data containing the full population of students over a 9-year period (N = 207,394)—we show that the composition of students became more concentrated in terms of intake grade point average after the reform in high-competition areas relative to low-competition areas. These responses in high-competition regions appear to be driven both by changes in user sorting on the demand side and by cream-skimming behavior among public providers on the supply side.

10.1093/jopart/muab002.abstractZh: 引入公共服务提供者之间选择和竞争的准市场旨在提高质量和效率。本文表明，准市场竞争也可能影响用户分布。首先，我们建立了一个简单的理论框架，区分了用户排序和“奶油撇取”这两种机制，通过这两种机制，准市场可能导致高能力用户更集中在一类服务提供者中，而低能力用户则更集中在另一类服务提供者中。其次，我们实证研究了在丹麦公立高中引入选择和基于活动的预算编制这一全国性准市场政策的影响。我们依据学校所在地理区域内服务提供者的集中度，来考察学校所面临的竞争程度的变化。通过差异对差异的设计——并利用包含9年时间内所有学生信息的登记数据（N = 207,394）——我们发现，在高竞争区域，学生的年级平均分数在改革后变得更加集中，而低竞争区域则没有这种趋势。这些在高竞争区域出现的反应，似乎既是由需求端用户的排序变化所驱动的，也是由供应端公共服务提供者中的“奶油撇取”行为所引发的。

abstract.text: The Swedish welfare state is known for providing extensive services to its citizens. Much less well known is that a fair amount of the services are delivered by private for-profit firms. The first steps of privatization were taken in the mid-1980s for childcare services at the municipal level, and the government often found itself scrambling to introduce regulation afterwards. Other sectors were subsequently privatized, most notably through an extensive voucher scheme to provide choice in compulsory and upper-secondary education. A key question throughout this process has been how to maintain the Swedish egalitarian ethos while undergoing extensive privatization. How has the country managed to reap the benefits from market forces without endangering equitable outcomes? The Swedish system is no middle road between socialism and capitalism. Instead, it is more akin to a large-scale laboratory for institutional design with lessons that should be of broad relevance to other countries aiming to get high-quality welfare services while containing costs. Focusing on what others can learn from Sweden, the book makes accessible original research on schools, health care, and elderly care. The privatization of service production has occurred despite major political controversy between two competing visions for the welfare state. Successful experiments have spread organically to neighbouring municipalities. What was done well in this process and what were the mistakes? The book addresses the fundamental economic challenges, the trends of the future, and the implications for institutional design

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.001.0001.abstractZh: 瑞典的福利国家以为其公民提供广泛的服务而闻名。但鲜为人知的是，相当多的服务是由私营营利性企业提供的。私有化的第一步是在20世纪80年代中期在市级层面进行的儿童保育服务领域，而政府随后常常不得不努力引入监管措施。随后，其他领域也进行了私有化，最著名的是通过一项广泛的代金券计划，为义务教育及高中教育提供了选择。在整个过程中，一个关键问题是如何在大规模私有化的同时维持瑞典的平等主义精神。该国是如何在利用市场力量的同时不危及公平结果的呢？瑞典的体系并非介于社会主义和资本主义之间，而是更像是一个大规模的制度设计实验室，其经验对其他国家在寻求高质量福利服务的同时控制成本具有广泛意义。本书通过介绍瑞典在教育、医疗保健和老年护理方面的原创研究，帮助读者了解其他国家可以从瑞典借鉴的经验。尽管存在两种对立的福利国家愿景之间的重大政治争议，服务生产的私有化仍然得以实施。成功的经验自然传播到了邻近的市镇。在这个过程中，哪些做法取得了成功，又存在哪些错误呢？本书探讨了根本性的经济挑战、未来的趋势以及制度设计的意义。

abstract.text: This chapter describes why the Swedish tax-financed service sector is of interest to other countries. While the Swedish welfare state is among the largest in the rich world, most countries face similar policy trade-offs because of rising demands and demographic challenges. It is a challenge for all democracies to achieve cost efficiency without sacrificing quality and fairness. We introduce the main elements of the Swedish model and explain how major reforms in the last decades have turned the country into a giant laboratory from which others can learn. The extensive use of private for-profit firms in tax-financed service provision might surprise many readers. But it is precisely this combination of social ambitions and market forces that has created unique experiences. The chapter introduces the Swedish development and its underlying forces.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0001.abstractZh: 本章探讨了为何瑞典由税收资助的服务行业能吸引其他国家关注。虽然瑞典的福利国家是富裕国家中规模最大的之一，但大多数国家都面临着类似的政策权衡，原因包括需求上升和人口挑战。对于所有民主国家来说，实现成本效率的同时不牺牲质量和公平性是一项挑战。我们介绍了瑞典模式的主要要素，并解释了过去几十年中的主要改革如何使瑞典成为一个可供其他国家借鉴的“巨大实验室”。在税收资助的服务提供中广泛使用私人营利性企业，这一做法可能会让许多读者感到惊讶。但正是这种社会目标与市场力量的结合，创造了独特的经验。本章还介绍了瑞典的发展及其背后的驱动力。

abstract.text: This chapter discusses the conceptual foundations of introducing market forces in the public sector, drawing on pioneering work by the British academic Julian Le Grand. Creating market-like conditions in tax-financed welfare services (so-called quasi-markets) is a way to empower users and introduce competition among providers. Ideally, service provision will be efficient, responsive, equitable, and of high quality. Such ideal outcomes are, however, far from guaranteed to materialize. A crucial and defining characteristic of quasi-markets is that the end-users do not pay for the services consumed. As a result, care needs to be taken that the incentives of the buyer (the public sector) and the sellers (private firms) are properly aligned. The chapter also brings out the main challenges for quality and contract design that are discussed in depth in later chapters. A fundamental challenge for the government is to assess and monitor quality in welfare services, be they provided directly by the public sector or by the private sector.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0002.abstractZh: 本章探讨了在公共部门引入市场力量的概念基础，借鉴了英国学者朱利安·勒格兰的开创性研究。在由税收资助的福利服务中创造类似市场的条件（所谓的准市场）是一种赋予用户权力并引入提供者之间竞争的方式。理想情况下，服务提供应当高效、响应迅速、公平且质量高。然而，这样的理想结果远非必然实现。准市场的一个关键特征在于，最终用户无需支付所消费服务的费用。因此，必须确保买方（公共部门）和卖方（私营企业）的激励措施能够恰当协调。本章还指出了在质量与合同设计方面的主要挑战，这些挑战将在后续章节中深入探讨。对于政府而言，一个根本性的挑战是评估和监控福利服务的质量，无论这些服务是由公共部门直接提供还是由私营部门提供。

abstract.text: Extensive welfare services require corresponding revenue. Large spending commitments imply that Sweden’s public sector finances are particularly sensitive to changing trends in demography and hours worked. A particular concern is that productivity growth in labour-intensive services is relatively difficult to uphold, the so-called Baumol effect. Increasing costs and spending pose a severe risk to the welfare state, but a risk that should be possible to handle. Though Sweden’s public finances remain among the strongest in the OECD, it will be a delicate balance to increase spending on welfare services at the desired rate. A continued focus on improving public sector efficiency will need to be coupled by a suitable balance between tax-funded services and parts that people will have to pay for privately.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0003.abstractZh: 广泛的福利服务需要相应的收入支持。大规模的支出承诺意味着瑞典的公共部门财政对人口结构和工作时间的变化特别敏感。一个需要特别关注的问题是，劳动密集型服务领域的生产率增长相对难以维持，这就是所谓的Baumol效应。成本与支出的增加对福利国家构成了严重风险，但这种风险是可以应对的。尽管瑞典的公共财政在OECD中仍然处于最强劲的水平，但以期望的速度增加福利服务的支出需要一种微妙的平衡。持续关注提高公共部门效率的同时，还需要在税收资助的服务项目与人们需要自费承担的部分之间找到合适的平衡。

abstract.text: This chapter summarizes the main events and reforms in Swedish welfare services 1970–2019 and explains the rise of private involvement and for-profit firms. Throughout these years, the country rapidly expanded the scope and generosity of the welfare state and in many instances had difficulties in meeting strong demand, especially for childcare services. In particular, the chapter charts the rise of private production shares in health care, elderly care, preschools and schools, as well as personal assistance for the disabled. The chapter is thematic in order to make the major trends accessible outside of Sweden. For the interested reader, critical policy decisions and legislation are provided in tables and figures. A birds-eye timeline showcases the major reforms, most of which were initiated at the local (municipal) level rather than from the national government. Underneath the transformation of the welfare state, there has been an ongoing political battle. The chapter explains why those in favour of privatizing welfare services have been more successful in that battle. In particular, there is a discussion of why the large and powerful Social Democrats have not reversed the development.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0004.abstractZh: 本章总结了1970年至2019年间瑞典福利服务领域的主要事件和改革，并解释了私人参与和营利性企业的崛起。在这些年里，瑞典迅速扩大了福利国家的范围和规模，但在满足强烈需求方面遇到了困难，尤其是在儿童保育服务方面。本章特别描述了在医疗保健、老年人护理、学前教育以及为残疾人提供个人援助等领域，私人生产份额的上升。为了便于理解，本章按照主题进行划分，以便让非瑞典读者也能了解主要趋势。对于感兴趣的读者，文中通过表格和图表展示了重要的政策决策和立法。时间线展示了主要的改革，其中大部分改革是由地方层面发起的，而非由中央政府主导。在福利国家转型的过程中，一直存在着政治斗争。本章解释了为何支持私有化福利服务的人士在这场斗争中更为成功。文中特别讨论了为什么强大而庞大的社会民主党未能扭转这一发展趋势。

abstract.text: This chapter draws on recent empirical work and summarizes the quantitative research on the effects of privatization, for-profit firms, choice, and competition in the Swedish welfare sector. By treating the effect studies together, the chapter presents a coherent picture of the lessons learned across the major welfare areas of education, health care, and elderly care. Overall, private providers appear on average to be a bit better in terms of quality and are also more productive. Choice and competition have improved several services, most notably compulsory education and elderly care. The evidence is more mixed for education at the upper-secondary level, where students at independent schools are more likely to finish on time and continue to tertiary education, but also perform worse on externally graded tests and benefit from lenient grading. A key takeaway is that the design of regulation and quality control matters greatly for outcomes. Each welfare service brings its lessons and mechanisms for quality control of both private and public providers should be strengthened. A general observation is that the playing field is often tilted against private providers since local governments are both arbiters of quality for private providers and a competing service provider. Widespread loss-making among municipal providers suggests that municipalities often treat their own in-house providers more leniently than private providers. In education, attempts at cream-skimming have been more evident at independent schools than at municipal schools. In other services, there is no systematic evidence that private providers practice cream-skimming to the detriment of weak groups, which is also illegal.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0005.abstractZh: 本章基于最新的实证研究，总结了关于私有化、营利性企业、选择以及竞争对瑞典福利部门影响的定量研究。通过整合这些研究结论，本章呈现了教育、医疗保健和老年护理等主要福利领域所吸取的经验教训。总体而言，私人提供者平均而言在服务质量方面表现稍优，且生产力也更高。选择和竞争改善了多项服务，尤其是义务教育与老年护理。然而，在高中阶段，情况则较为复杂：私立学校的学生更有可能按时完成学业并继续接受高等教育，但在外部评估中的表现较差，同时还能享受较为宽松的评分标准。一个关键结论是，监管和质量控制的设计对服务效果至关重要。每项福利服务都应总结其经验教训，并加强对私营和公共提供者的质量控制。一个普遍现象是，由于地方政府既是私营提供者的质量评判者，又是竞争性的服务提供者，私营提供者往往处于不利地位。许多市政提供者的经营状况不佳，这表明市政当局往往对内部提供者的要求更为宽松。在教育领域，私立学校中出现的“挤占优质资源”现象更为明显，而在其他服务领域，则没有系统证据表明私营提供者存在挤占优质资源的行为，而这种行为是违法的。

abstract.text: This chapter highlights insights from pioneering work on management practices by Nicholas Bloom and John Van Reenen for the performance of tax-financed welfare services. Research has demonstrated that good management matters not only in the private sector but also in traditional public services, such as schools and hospitals. Studies on Swedish data confirm the importance of management practices in the welfare sector but also point the direction to potential improvements. A pervasive pattern is that private providers have better management quality than public providers, suggesting that the privatization of service production has contributed to better services. High management quality goes together with shorter waiting times at primary care centres and with higher process-oriented quality measures at nursing homes. There is, however, no relationship between management quality and patient satisfaction.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0006.abstractZh: 本章重点介绍了Nicholas Bloom和John Van Reenen在税收资助的福利服务绩效管理实践方面的开创性研究。研究表明，良好的管理不仅对私营部门重要，对传统公共服务领域如学校和医院也同样重要。针对瑞典数据的研究证实，管理实践在福利领域的重要性，同时也指出了改进的方向。普遍现象是，私人提供者的管理质量优于公共提供者，这表明服务生产的私有化有助于提升服务质量。高管理质量伴随着初级护理中心的等待时间缩短以及护理院更注重流程质量的情况。然而，管理质量与患者满意度之间并无关联。

abstract.text: The steady privatization of welfare service production has been a longstanding source of political conflict and debate. For-profit providers have met particularly harsh resistance from the left and only mild support from the right. Public opinion is largely skewed against private providers and affects the welfare sector by influencing implemented and expected regulation. In addition to the left–right divide, opinions on private production are split in several other ways. Notably, elected politicians are more supportive of privatization than the voters. The Social Democrats have been a dominant force in Sweden and have long been split on how to address privatization. The party contains a vocal left-wing with ideological objections that wants to stop and reverse course. Another wing of the party is more market-oriented and in some circumstances in favour of choice and competition. A key finding is that public opinion is fairly negative towards for-profit providers, while simultaneously very supportive of opportunities to choose between providers. To an astounding extent, people tend to overestimate the profits of private providers. As a result, the negative opinion against for-profit providers is partly based on misperceptions. Transparency and information are fundamental underpinnings for the public support of privatization.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0007.abstractZh: 福利服务生产的持续私有化一直是政治冲突和辩论的长期根源。营利性提供者遭到了左翼的强烈抵制，而右翼则仅给予有限的支持。公众舆论普遍对私人提供者持负面态度，这种态度影响了福利领域的监管实施和预期。除了左右翼的分歧之外，关于私人生产的意见还存在其他多种分歧。值得注意的是，当选政治家对私有化的支持程度往往高于选民。瑞典社会民主党长期以来一直是该国的主导力量，但在如何处理私有化问题上存在分歧。该党内部有一部分左翼人士持有意识形态上的反对意见，希望停止或逆转私有化进程。该党的另一派则更倾向于市场导向，在某些情况下支持选择和竞争。一个关键发现是，公众舆论对营利性提供者持相当负面的态度，但同时又非常支持人们能够在不同提供者之间做出选择。令人惊讶的是，人们往往高估了私人提供者的利润。因此，对营利性提供者的负面意见部分基于误解。透明度和信息是公众支持私有化的基础。

abstract.text: Despite political controversy, the growth of private providers has been steady since the 1990s. The Swedish municipalities have often been more practically inclined—willing to experiment and adopt what works. The expansion of private provision has increased choice opportunities, accessibility, and in many cases service quality. The benefits have mostly been accomplished without increasing costs, although there are examples, including care of the disabled, of spiralling total costs. User choice is popular, but its impact on total costs needs to be handled. A complication is that there must be some excess capacity for user choice to have economic consequences for the providers. Market design and regulation are crucial for the functioning of quasi-markets. Private and public providers should receive the same treatment when it comes to permissions, financing, inspections, and audits. As another general policy conclusion, we emphasize a resolute focus on quality control. This is most evident in education—where there is need for external restrictions on grades or a return to traditional final, and centralized, exams. The soft aspects of quality should not be neglected. An important lesson when it comes to management is that the same management practices that are successful in the private sector work in the public sector too. Entry barriers can be useful in quasi-markets by dissuading unwanted providers and incentivizing the serious ones. The Swedish experiment with quasi-markets and privatized service production provides a rich experience for other countries to determine what works as well as what pitfalls to avoid.

10.1093/oso/9780198867210.003.0008.abstractZh: 尽管存在政治争议，自20世纪90年代以来，私人提供者的增长一直保持稳定。瑞典的市政当局往往更倾向于实践操作——愿意尝试新方法并采用有效的做法。私人提供服务的扩展增加了选择机会、服务可及性，并在许多情况下提升了服务质量。这些好处大多是在不增加成本的情况下实现的，不过也有例子表明，例如对残疾人的护理服务，总成本出现了上升。用户选择很受欢迎，但其对总成本的影响需要加以考虑。一个复杂的问题是，必须存在一定的过剩产能，用户选择才能对提供者产生经济影响。市场设计和监管对于准市场的运作至关重要。在许可、融资、检查和审计方面，私人提供者与公共提供者应受到同等对待。作为另一个一般性的政策结论，我们强调对质量控制的严格重视。这一点在教育领域尤为明显——需要对外在评分进行限制，或者回归传统的、集中式的期末考试。不应忽视质量的软性方面。在管理方面的一个重要教训是，在私营部门成功的那些管理实践同样适用于公共部门。进入壁垒在准市场中可以起到作用，通过阻止不希望进入的提供者，激励那些认真经营的企业。瑞典在准市场和私有化服务生产方面的经验为其他国家提供了丰富的经验，帮助他们确定哪些做法有效，以及应避免哪些陷阱。

abstract.text: Understanding how differences in management ‘best practices’ affect organizational outcomes has been a focus of both theoretical and empirical work in the fields of management, sociology, economics, and public policy. The World Management Survey (WMS) project was born almost two decades ago with the main goal of developing a new systematic measure of management practices being used in organizations. The WMS has contributed to a body of knowledge around how managerial structures, not just managerial talent, relate to organizational performance. Over 18 years of research, a set of consistent patterns have emerged and spurred new questions. We present a brief overview of what we have learned in terms of measuring and understanding management practices and condense the implications of these findings for policy. We end with an outline of what we see as the path forward for both research and policy implications of this research programme.

10.1093/oxrep/grab009.abstractZh: 理解管理“最佳实践”的差异如何影响组织成果，一直是管理学、社会学、经济学和公共政策领域理论研究和实证工作的重点。世界管理调查项目诞生于近二十年前，其主要目标是开发一种系统性的衡量方法，以评估组织中使用的管理实践。该项目为关于管理结构如何与组织绩效相关联的知识体系做出了贡献。经过18年的研究，一些一致的模式逐渐显现，同时也引发了新的问题。我们简要概述了在衡量和理解管理实践方面所取得的研究成果，并总结了这些发现对政策的影响。最后，我们提出了对该研究项目的研究和政策意义的发展方向。

abstract.text: We study the causal impact of religiosity through a randomized evaluation of an evangelical Protestant Christian values and theology education program delivered to thousands of ultrapoor Filipino households. Six months after the program ended, treated households have higher religiosity and income; no statistically significant differences in total labor supply, consumption, food security, or life satisfaction; and lower perceived relative economic status. Exploratory analysis suggests that the income treatment effect may operate through increasing grit. Thirty months after the program ended, significant differences in the intensity of religiosity disappear, but those in the treatment group are less likely to be Catholic and more likely to be Protestant, and there is some mixed evidence that their consumption and perceived relative economic status are higher.

10.1093/qje/qjaa023.abstractZh: 我们通过对数千个极度贫困的菲律宾家庭实施的福音派新教价值观和神学教育项目的随机评估，来研究宗教性对因果影响的效应。项目结束后六个月，接受教育的家庭表现出更高的宗教性和收入；但在劳动力供应、消费、食品安全或生活满意度方面，没有统计学上的显著差异；同时，他们感知到的相对经济地位也有所下降。探索性分析表明，收入处理效应可能通过提升韧性来实现。项目结束后三十个月，宗教性的强度差异消失，但接受教育的群体更可能信仰新教，而非天主教；此外，他们的消费水平和感知到的相对经济地位有所提升，但证据并不一致。

abstract.text: I study how a credit crunch affects output price dynamics. I build a unique micro-level data set that combines scanner-level prices and quantities with producer information, including the producer’s banking relationships, inventory, and cash holdings. I exploit the Lehman Brothers failure as a quasi-experiment and find that the firms facing a negative credit supply shock decrease their output prices approximately 15% more than their unaffected counterparts. I hypothesize that such firms reduce prices to liquidate inventory and generate additional cash flow from the product market. I find strong empirical support for this hypothesis: (i) the firms that face a negative bank shock temporarily decrease their prices and inventory and increase their market share and cash holdings relative to their counterparts, and (ii) this effect is stronger for the firms and sectors with a high initial inventory or small initial cash holdings.

10.1093/qje/qjaa025.abstractZh: 我研究信贷紧缩如何影响产出价格动态。我构建了一个独特的微观层面数据集，该数据集结合了扫描仪级别的价格和数量信息，以及生产者的相关信息，包括生产者的银行关系、库存和现金持有情况。我以雷曼兄弟的破产事件作为准实验，发现面临负面信贷供应冲击的企业，其产出价格下降幅度比未受影响的同类企业高出约15%。我假设这些企业降低价格是为了清算库存，并从产品市场中获得额外的现金流。我发现这一假设得到了强有力的实证支持：(i) 面临负面银行冲击的企业会暂时降低价格和库存，同时相对于同类企业增加市场份额和现金持有量；(ii) 对于初始库存较高或现金持有量较少的企业和行业，这种效应更为明显。

abstract.text: We study how long-lived rational agents learn from repeatedly observing a private signal and each others’ actions. With normal signals, a group of any size learns more slowly than just four agents who directly observe each others’ private signals in each period. Similar results apply to general signal structures. We identify rational groupthink—in which agents ignore their private signals and choose the same action for long periods of time—as the cause of this failure of information aggregation.

10.1093/qje/qjaa026.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期存在的理性代理人如何通过反复观察私人信号和他人的行为来学习。对于普通信号，任何规模的小组学习速度都比仅由四个直接观察彼此私人信号的代理人要慢。类似的结果也适用于一般的信号结构。我们发现，理性群体思维——即代理人长时间忽略自己的私人信号并选择相同的行动——是这种信息聚合失败的原因。

abstract.text: Nearly 1,000 officer-involved killings occur each year in the United States. This article documents the large, racially disparate effects of these events on the educational and psychological well-being of Los Angeles public high school students. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in how close students live to a killing, I find that exposure to police violence leads to persistent decreases in GPA, increased incidence of emotional disturbance, and lower rates of high school completion and college enrollment. These effects are driven entirely by black and Hispanic students in response to police killings of other minorities and are largest for incidents involving unarmed individuals.

10.1093/qje/qjaa027.abstractZh: 在美国，每年大约有1000起涉及警察的杀人事件。本文记录了这些事件对洛杉矶公立高中学生教育和心理健康的巨大且具有种族差异的影响。通过研究学生与杀人事件的距离这一超局部变量，我发现接触警察暴力会导致学生的平均绩点持续下降、情绪障碍的发生率增加，以及高中毕业率和大学入学率降低。这些影响主要出现在黑人和西班牙裔学生身上，尤其是在涉及无武装个体的事件时，这种影响最为显著。

abstract.text: This article argues that accounting for capital-embodied technology greatly increases the importance of capital in explaining cross-country differences in agricultural labor productivity. To do so, we draw on a novel data set of agricultural capital prices. We document that new capital is more expensive in richer countries, both in absolute terms and relative to old capital. A model of endogenous adoption of capital of different quality links these price differences to the path of capital-embodied technology. In particular, our model recovers the level of embodied technology from the price of new capital and the growth rate of embodied technology from the price of new capital relative to old capital. We then measure the stocks of quality-adjusted capital in agriculture for a sample of 16 countries at different stages of development. We find that adjusting for differences in quality almost doubles the importance of capital in accounting for cross-country differences in agricultural labor productivity: from 21% to 37%. In addition, improvements in capital quality have been an important source of agricultural labor productivity growth over the past 25 years, accounting for 21% and 35% of the productivity growth in poor and rich countries, respectively.

10.1093/qje/qjaa028.abstractZh: 本文认为，将资本蕴含的技术因素纳入考量，能够显著增强资本在解释跨国农业劳动生产率差异中的重要性。为此，我们采用了新的农业资本价格数据集。研究发现，在富裕国家，新资本的投入成本无论是绝对值还是相对于旧资本而言都更高。一个关于不同质量资本内生采纳的模型将这种价格差异与资本蕴含技术的路径联系起来。具体而言，我们的模型能够从新资本的价格中推断出蕴含技术的水平，并从新资本相对于旧资本的价格中推断出蕴含技术的增长率。随后，我们对16个处于不同发展阶段的国家的农业质量调整资本存量进行了测量。研究发现，调整质量差异后，资本在解释跨国农业劳动生产率差异中的重要性几乎翻倍：从21%增加到37%。此外，在过去25年中，资本质量的提升一直是农业劳动生产率增长的重要来源，分别占贫困国家和富裕国家劳动生产率增长的21%和35%。

abstract.text: We evaluate a randomized outreach study in which the IRS sent informational letters to 3.9 million households that paid a tax penalty for lacking health insurance coverage under the Affordable Care Act. Drawing on administrative data, we study the effect of this intervention on taxpayers’ subsequent health insurance enrollment and mortality. We find the intervention led to increased coverage during the subsequent two years and reduced mortality among middle-aged adults over the same time period. The results provide experimental evidence that health insurance coverage can reduce mortality in the United States.

10.1093/qje/qjaa029.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项随机化推广研究，该研究由美国国税局进行，向390万户因违反《平价医疗法案》而面临税收罚款的家庭发送了信息函。通过利用行政数据，我们研究了这一干预措施对纳税人后续健康保险投保率和死亡率的影响。研究发现，在随后的两年里，该干预措施增加了人们的健康保险覆盖率，并降低了中年成年人的死亡率。这些结果提供了实验性证据，表明健康保险覆盖可以在美国降低死亡率。

abstract.text: Macro-finance analyses commonly link firms’ borrowing constraints to the liquidation value of physical assets. For U.S. nonfinancial firms, we show that 20% of debt by value is based on such assets (asset-based lending in creditor parlance), whereas 80% is based predominantly on cash flows from firms’ operations (cash flow–based lending). A standard borrowing constraint restricts total debt as a function of cash flows measured using operating earnings (earnings-based borrowing constraints). These features shape firm outcomes on the margin: first, cash flows in the form of operating earnings can directly relax borrowing constraints; second, firms are less vulnerable to collateral damage from asset price declines, and fire sale amplification may be mitigated. Taken together, our findings point to new venues for modeling firms’ borrowing constraints in macro-finance studies.

10.1093/qje/qjaa030.abstractZh: 宏观金融分析通常将企业的借贷限制与实物资产的清算价值联系起来。对于美国的非金融企业而言，我们发现20%的债务基于此类资产（用债权人的术语来说就是基于资产的借贷），而80%的债务则主要基于企业运营产生的现金流（基于现金流的借贷）。标准的借贷限制将总债务与以运营收益衡量的现金流联系起来（基于收益的借贷限制）。这些特征影响了企业的经营结果：首先，以运营收益形式出现的现金流可以直接缓解借贷限制；其次，企业受到资产价格下跌带来的附带损害的影响较小，且可能被缓解因资产抛售而引发的负面影响。综合来看，我们的研究结果为宏观金融研究中对企业借贷限制的建模提供了新的思路。

abstract.text: The earnings difference between white and black workers fell dramatically in the United States in the late 1960s and early 1970s. This article shows that the expansion of the minimum wage played a critical role in this decline. The 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act extended federal minimum wage coverage to agriculture, restaurants, nursing homes, and other services that were previously uncovered and where nearly a third of black workers were employed. We digitize over 1,000 hourly wage distributions from Bureau of Labor Statistics industry wage reports and use CPS microdata to investigate the effects of this reform on wages, employment, and racial inequality. Using a cross-industry difference-in-differences design, we show that earnings rose sharply for workers in the newly covered industries. The impact was nearly twice as large for black workers as for white workers. Within treated industries, the racial gap adjusted for observables fell from 25 log points prereform to 0 afterward. We can rule out significant disemployment effects for black workers. Using a bunching design, we find no aggregate effect of the reform on employment. The 1967 extension of the minimum wage can explain more than 20% of the reduction in the racial earnings and income gap during the civil rights era. Our findings shed new light on the dynamics of labor market inequality in the United States and suggest that minimum wage policy can play a critical role in reducing racial economic disparities.

10.1093/qje/qjaa031.abstractZh: 在20世纪60年代末和70年代初，美国的白人工人与黑人工人的收入差距显著缩小。本文指出，最低工资标准的扩大在这一变化中起到了关键作用。1966年《公平劳动标准法》将联邦最低工资覆盖范围扩展至农业、餐饮、养老院以及其他此前未被涵盖的服务行业，这些行业雇用了近三分之一的黑人工人。我们数字化了劳工统计局行业工资报告中的1000多份时薪数据，并利用CPS微观数据来研究这一改革对工资、就业和种族不平等的影响。通过跨行业差异设计，我们发现新纳入覆盖范围的行业的工人收入显著上升，而黑人工人的收入增长幅度几乎是白人工人的两倍。在受影响的行业中，经过调整的可观测因素后，种族收入差距从改革前的25个对数点降至0。我们可以排除黑人工人出现大规模失业的可能性。通过捆绑设计，我们发现这一改革对就业没有总体影响。1967年最低工资标准的扩大可以解释民权时代种族收入差距缩小超过20%的原因。我们的研究结果揭示了美国劳动力市场不平等的动态变化，并表明最低工资政策在减少种族经济差异方面可以发挥关键作用。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of criminalizing sex work, exploiting an event in which local officials unexpectedly criminalized sex work in one district in East Java, Indonesia, but not in neighboring districts. We collect data from female sex workers and their clients before and after the change. We find that criminalization increases sexually transmitted infections among female sex workers by 58 percent, measured by biological tests. This is driven by decreased condom access and use. We also find evidence that criminalization decreases earnings among women who left sex work due to criminalization and decreases their ability to meet their children’s school expenses while increasing the likelihood that children begin working to supplement household income. Although criminalization has the potential to improve population STI outcomes if the market shrinks permanently, we show that five years postcriminalization the market has rebounded and the probability of STI transmission in the general population is likely to have increased.

10.1093/qje/qjaa032.abstractZh: 我们研究了将性工作定为犯罪行为的影响，通过研究印度尼西亚东爪哇省一个地区突然将性工作定为犯罪，而邻近地区则未受影响的事件。我们收集了该地区女性性工作者及其客户在政策变更前后的数据。研究发现，犯罪化导致女性性工作者的性传播感染率上升了58%，这一数据是通过生物检测得出的。这一变化主要是由于避孕套的获取和使用减少所致。我们还发现，由于犯罪化而放弃性工作的女性，其收入下降，支付子女学费的能力也减弱，同时子女开始工作以补充家庭收入的可能性增加。尽管犯罪化有可能通过永久性地缩小市场来改善性传播感染状况，但我们发现，在犯罪化实施五年后，市场已经恢复，普通人群中的性传播感染传播概率反而可能有所增加。

abstract.text: We relate gender differences in willingness to commute to the gender wage gap. Using French administrative data on job search criteria, we first document that unemployed women have a lower reservation wage and a shorter maximum acceptable commute than their male counterparts. We identify indifference curves between wage and commute using the joint distributions of reservation job attributes and accepted job bundles. Indifference curves are steeper for women, who value commute around 20% more than men. Controlling in particular for the previous job, newly hired women are paid after unemployment 4% less per hour and have a 12% shorter commute than men. Through the lens of a job search model where commuting matters, we estimate that gender differences in commute valuation can account for a 0.5 log point hourly wage deficit for women, that is, 14% of the residualized gender wage gap. Finally, we use job application data to test the robustness of our results and to show that female workers do not receive less demand from far-away employers, confirming that most of the gender gap in commute is supply-side driven.

10.1093/qje/qjaa033.abstractZh: 我们将女性在通勤意愿上的差异与性别工资差距联系起来。利用法国关于求职标准的行政数据，我们首先发现失业女性的保留工资较低，且可接受的最大通勤距离也较短。我们通过保留工作属性与可接受工作组合的联合分布，确定了工资与通勤距离之间的无差异曲线。女性对应的无差异曲线更为陡峭，她们对通勤距离的重视程度比男性高出约20%。特别考虑到之前的工作经历，新聘用的女性失业后的每小时工资比男性低4%，且通勤距离也短12%。通过求职模型的分析，我们估计女性对通勤距离的偏好差异可以解释女性每小时工资低0.5个对数点的原因，即性别工资差距的14%。最后，我们利用求职数据来检验我们的结果的稳健性，并发现女性工人并未从距离较远的雇主那里获得更低的需求，这证实了性别工资差距中的大部分是由供应方面因素驱动的。

abstract.text: We examine historical banking crises through the lens of bank equity declines, which cover a broad sample of episodes of banking distress with and without banking panics. To do this, we construct a new data set on bank equity returns and narrative information on banking panics for 46 countries over the period of 1870 to 2016. We find that even in the absence of panics, large bank equity declines are associated with substantial credit contractions and output gaps. Although panics are an important amplification mechanism, our results indicate that panics are not necessary for banking crises to have severe economic consequences. Furthermore, panics tend to be preceded by large bank equity declines, suggesting that panics are the result, rather than the cause, of earlier bank losses. We use bank equity returns to uncover a number of forgotten historical banking crises and create a banking crisis chronology that distinguishes between bank equity losses and panics.

10.1093/qje/qjaa034.abstractZh: 我们通过银行股权下降这一视角来研究历史上的银行危机，涵盖了包括有银行恐慌和无银行恐慌在内的多种银行困境案例。为此，我们构建了一个包含1870年至2016年间46个国家银行股权回报及银行恐慌相关信息的全新数据集。研究发现，即使在没有银行恐慌的情况下，大规模的银行股权下降也伴随着严重的信贷收缩和产出缺口。虽然银行恐慌是加剧危机的重要因素，但我们的结果表明，银行恐慌并非银行危机产生严重经济后果的必要条件。此外，银行恐慌往往伴随着大规模的银行股权下降，这表明银行恐慌是早期银行损失的结果，而非原因。我们利用银行股权回报来揭示一些被遗忘的历史银行危机，并创建了一个银行危机时间线，以区分银行股权损失与银行恐慌。

abstract.text: Communication facilitates cooperation by ensuring that deviators are collectively punished. We explore how players might misuse communication to threaten one another, and we identify ways that organizations can deter misuse and restore cooperation. In our model, a principal plays trust games with a sequence of short-run agents who communicate with each other. An agent can shirk and then extort pay by threatening to report that the principal deviated. We show that these threats can completely undermine cooperation. Investigations of agents’ efforts, or dyadic relationships between the principal and each agent, can deter extortion and restore some cooperation. Investigations of the principal’s action, on the other hand, typically do not help. Our analysis suggests that collective punishments are vulnerable to misuse unless they are designed with an eye toward discouraging it.

10.1093/qje/qjaa035.abstractZh: 沟通通过确保违规者受到集体惩罚来促进合作。我们探讨了玩家如何滥用沟通来威胁彼此，并提出了组织可以采取措施来防止滥用并恢复合作的方法。在我们的模型中，一个主体与一系列短期代理进行信任游戏，这些代理之间会进行沟通。一个代理可以逃避责任，然后通过威胁举报主体违规来勒索报酬。我们表明，这些威胁完全能够破坏合作。对代理的行为或主体与每个代理之间的双边关系进行研究，可以阻止勒索行为并恢复部分合作。然而，对主体行为的单独研究通常无济于事。我们的分析表明，除非集体惩罚的设计旨在防止其被滥用，否则它们很容易受到滥用。

abstract.text: We explore the interplay between trade-invoicing patterns and the pricing of safe assets in different currencies. Our theory highlights the following points: (i) a currency’s role as a unit of account for invoicing decisions is complementary to its role as a safe store of value; (ii) this complementarity can lead to the emergence of a single dominant currency in trade invoicing and global banking, even when multiple large candidate countries share similar economic fundamentals; (iii) firms in emerging-market countries endogenously take on currency mismatches by borrowing in the dominant currency; and (iv) the expected return on dominant-currency safe assets is lower than that on similarly safe assets denominated in other currencies, thereby bestowing an “exorbitant privilege” on the dominant currency. The theory thus provides a unified explanation for why a dominant currency is so heavily used in both trade invoicing and in global finance.

10.1093/qje/qjaa036.abstractZh: 我们探讨了贸易发票模式与不同货币安全资产定价之间的相互作用。我们的理论指出以下几点：(i) 货币作为发票记账单位的作用与其作为价值储存手段的作用相辅相成；(ii) 这种互补性可能导致在贸易发票和全球金融领域出现单一主导货币，即使多个具有相似经济基础的大国也存在这种情况；(iii) 新兴市场经济体中的企业会通过以主导货币借款来自然解决货币不匹配的问题；(iv) 以主导货币计价的安全资产的预期回报低于以其他货币计价的类似安全资产，从而赋予主导货币一种“过度特权”。因此，该理论为为什么主导货币在贸易发票和全球金融领域被广泛使用提供了统一的解释。

abstract.text: How does unemployment insurance (UI) affect unemployed workers’ search behavior? Search models predict that until benefit exhaustion, UI depresses job search effort and increases reservation wages. Over an unemployment spell, search effort should increase up to benefit exhaustion and stay high thereafter. Meanwhile, reservation wages should decrease up to benefit exhaustion and stay low thereafter. To test these predictions, we link administrative registers to data on job search behavior from a major online job search platform in France. We follow over 400,000 workers, as long as they remain unemployed. We analyze the changes in search behavior around benefits exhaustion and take two steps to isolate the individual response to unemployment benefits. First, our longitudinal data allows us to correct for changes in sample composition over the spell. Second, we exploit data on workers eligible for 12–24 months of UI as well as workers ineligible for UI, to control for behavior changes over the unemployment spell that are independent of UI. Our results confirm the predictions of search models. We find that search effort (the number of job applications) increases by at least 50% during the year preceding benefits exhaustion and remains high thereafter. The target monthly wage decreases by at least 2.4% during the year preceding benefits exhaustion and remains low thereafter. In addition, we provide evidence for duration dependence: workers decrease the wage they target by 1.5% over each year of unemployment, irrespective of their UI status.

10.1093/qje/qjaa037.abstractZh: 失业保险如何影响失业工人的求职行为？搜索模型预测，在福利耗尽之前，失业保险会抑制求职努力，并增加保留工资。在失业期间，求职努力应增加到福利耗尽为止，之后保持较高水平。同时，保留工资应减少到福利耗尽为止，之后保持较低水平。为了验证这些预测，我们将行政登记数据与法国一家主要在线求职平台上的求职行为数据进行了关联。我们跟踪了超过40万名工人，只要他们仍然处于失业状态。我们分析了福利耗尽前后求职行为的变化，并采取了两个步骤来分离对失业福利的个人反应。首先，我们的纵向数据使我们能够纠正失业期间样本构成的变化。其次，我们利用了对12-24个月有资格享受失业保险的工人以及没有资格享受失业保险的工人的数据，以控制与失业保险无关的求职行为变化。我们的结果证实了搜索模型的预测。我们发现，在福利耗尽前的这一年里，求职努力（求职申请数量）增加了至少50%，之后保持较高水平。目标月工资在福利耗尽前的这一年里减少了至少2.4%，之后保持较低水平。此外，我们还发现了持续时间依赖性：无论失业者的失业保险状态如何，他们在每一年失业期间都会将目标工资降低1.5%。

abstract.text: We estimate the wage effects of shared governance, or codetermination, in the form of a mandate of one-third of corporate board seats going to worker representatives. We study a reform in Germany that abruptly abolished this mandate for stock corporations incorporated after August 1994, while it locked the mandate for the slightly older cohorts. Our research design compares firm cohorts incorporated before the reform and after; in a robustness check we draw on the analogous difference in unaffected firm types (LLCs). We find no effects of board-level codetermination on wages and the wage structure, even in firms with particularly flexible wages. The degree of rent sharing and the labor share are also unaffected. We reject that disinvestment could have offset wage effects through the canonical hold-up channel, as shared governance, if anything, increases capital formation.

10.1093/qje/qjaa038.abstractZh: 我们研究了共享治理或共同决策对工资影响的效应，具体表现为将企业董事会三分之一的席位分配给工人代表。我们研究的是德国的一项改革，该改革在1994年8月之后成立的股份公司中突然取消了这一席位分配，但对稍早成立的公司则保留了这一制度。我们的研究设计比较了改革前后成立的公司群体；在稳健性检验中，我们还参考了未受影响的有限责任公司之间的类似差异。我们发现，即使是在工资机制特别灵活的公司中，董事会层面的共同决策对工资和工资结构也没有产生任何影响。租金分享的程度和劳动力份额也并未受到影响。我们否定了这种资本转移可能通过典型的“保留效应”抵消工资效应的观点，因为共享治理实际上增加了资本形成。

abstract.text: Skepticism about the quality of health systems and their consequent underuse are thought to contribute to high rates of mortality in the developing world. The perceived quality of health services may be especially critical during epidemics, when people choose whether to cooperate with response efforts and frontline health workers. Can improving the perceived quality of health care promote community health and ultimately help to contain epidemics? We leverage a field experiment in Sierra Leone to answer this question in the context of the 2014 West African Ebola crisis. Two years before the outbreak, we randomly assigned two interventions to government-run health clinics—one focused on community monitoring, and the other conferred nonfinancial awards to clinic staff. Prior to the Ebola crisis, both interventions increased clinic utilization and patient satisfaction. Community monitoring additionally improved child health, leading to 38% fewer deaths of children under age five. Later, during the crisis, the interventions also increased reporting of Ebola cases by 62%, and community monitoring significantly reduced Ebola-related deaths. Evidence on mechanisms suggests that both interventions improved the perceived quality of health care, encouraging patients to report Ebola symptoms and receive medical care. Improvements in health outcomes under community monitoring suggest that these changes partly reflect a rise in the underlying quality of administered care. Overall, our results indicate that promoting accountability not only has the power to improve health systems during normal times, but can also make them more resilient to emergent crises.

10.1093/qje/qjaa039.abstractZh: 对卫生系统质量的怀疑以及由此导致的使用不足，被认为是发展中国家高死亡率的原因之一。在流行病期间，人们对卫生服务的质量感知可能尤为重要，因为此时人们会决定是否配合应对工作以及选择与一线卫生工作者合作。能否提高人们对医疗保健质量的感知，从而促进社区健康，并最终帮助控制流行病？我们利用塞拉利昂的一项实地实验来回答这个问题，该实验发生在2014年西非埃博拉危机期间。在疫情爆发前两年，我们随机对政府运营的卫生诊所实施了两项干预措施：一项是加强社区监测，另一项则是向诊所工作人员提供非经济奖励。在埃博拉危机之前，这两项干预措施都提高了诊所的利用率和患者的满意度。社区监测还改善了儿童健康，导致5岁以下儿童死亡人数减少了38%。在危机期间，这两项干预措施还使埃博拉病例报告数量增加了62%，并且社区监测显著减少了与埃博拉相关的死亡人数。相关研究表明，这两项干预措施都提高了人们对医疗保健质量的感知，促使患者报告埃博拉症状并接受医疗护理。在社区监测下，健康结果的改善表明，这些变化部分反映了所提供护理的基本质量的提升。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，促进问责制不仅能够在正常时期改善卫生系统，还能使其在面对突发危机时更具韧性。

abstract.text: How does mobile broadband internet affect approval of government? Using Gallup World Poll surveys of 840,537 individuals from 2,232 subnational regions in 116 countries from 2008 to 2017 and the global expansion of 3G mobile networks, we show that on average, an increase in mobile broadband internet access reduces government approval. This effect is present only when the internet is not censored, and it is stronger when the traditional media are censored. 3G helps expose actual corruption in government: revelations of the Panama Papers and other corruption incidents translate into higher perceptions of corruption in regions covered by 3G networks. Voter disillusionment had electoral implications. In Europe, 3G expansion led to lower vote shares for incumbent parties and higher vote shares for the antiestablishment populist opposition. Vote shares for nonpopulist opposition parties were unaffected by 3G expansion.

10.1093/qje/qjaa040.abstractZh: 移动宽带互联网如何影响政府对政府的认可？通过2008年至2017年间对116个国家2,232个次国家级地区的840,537名个体的盖洛普世界民意调查，以及3G移动网络的全球扩展，我们发现平均而言，移动宽带互联网接入的增加会降低政府对政府的认可度。这一效应仅在互联网未被审查的情况下存在，而在传统媒体被审查的情况下，这种效应更为明显。3G网络有助于揭露政府中的实际腐败行为：巴拿马文件等腐败事件的曝光使得3G网络覆盖地区的腐败感知度上升。选民的失望情绪对选举结果产生了影响。在欧洲，3G网络的扩展导致执政党的得票率下降，而反建制民粹主义反对党的得票率上升。非民粹主义反对党的得票率并未受到3G网络扩展的影响。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of sweat equity—the value of business owners’ time and expenses to build customer bases, client lists, and other intangible assets. We discipline the theory using data from U.S. national accounts, business censuses, and brokered sales to estimate a value for sweat equity in the private business sector equal to 1.2 times U.S. GDP, which is about the same magnitude as the value of fixed assets in use in these businesses. For a typical owner, 26% of the sweat equity is transferable through inheritance or sale. The equity values are positively correlated with business incomes and standard measures of markups based on accounting data, but not with owners’ financial assets or standard measures of business total factor productivity. We use our theory to show that abstracting from sweat activity leads to a significant understatement of the effects of lowering business income tax rates on private business activity for both the extensive and intensive margins. Despite finding larger responses, our model’s implied tax elasticities of establishments and owner hours are in line with empirical estimates in the public finance literature. Allowing for financial constraints and superstar firms does not overturn our main findings.

10.1093/qje/qjaa041.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于“汗滴权益”的理论——即企业主为建立客户基础、客户名单以及其他无形资产所投入的时间和成本的价值。我们通过美国国民账户、企业普查以及中介销售数据来验证这一理论，估计私营企业领域的汗滴权益价值相当于美国GDP的1.2倍，这一数值与这些企业使用的固定资产价值大致相当。对于典型的企业主而言，26%的汗滴权益可以通过继承或出售的方式转移。这些权益价值与企业的收入以及基于会计数据的标准加价指标呈正相关，但与企业主的金融资产或企业总要素生产率的标准指标并无关联。我们利用这一理论表明，忽视汗滴权益活动会导致对降低企业所得税税率对私营企业活动影响的低估，无论是在广度还是深度方面都是如此。尽管我们发现企业规模更大的响应更为显著，但我们的模型所预测的企业和企业主工作时间的税收弹性与公共财政文献中的实证估计结果一致。考虑到财务限制和超级明星企业的情况，并不会推翻我们的主要发现。

abstract.text: This article describes a new fact, then analyzes its causes and consequences: in most countries, import tariffs and nontariff barriers are substantially lower on dirty than on clean industries, where an industry’s “dirtiness” is defined as its carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per dollar of output. This difference in trade policy creates a global implicit subsidy to CO2 emissions in internationally traded goods and contributes to climate change. This global implicit subsidy to CO2 emissions totals several hundred billion dollars annually. The greater protection of downstream industries, which are relatively clean, substantially accounts for this pattern. The downstream pattern can be explained by theories where industries lobby for low tariffs on their inputs but final consumers are poorly organized. A quantitative general equilibrium model suggests that if countries applied similar trade policies to clean and dirty goods, global CO2 emissions would decrease and global real income would change little.

10.1093/qje/qjaa042.abstractZh: 本文描述了一种新现象，并分析了其成因与后果：在大多数国家，对清洁行业的进口关税和非关税壁垒要远低于对污染行业的壁垒。这里的“污染程度”是指每单位产出产生的二氧化碳排放量。这种贸易政策差异导致国际贸易商品中存在一种全球性的隐性补贴，这种补贴对二氧化碳排放产生了负面影响，并加剧了气候变化。这种全球性的隐性补贴每年高达数千亿美元。对相对清洁的下游产业实施更严格的保护，正是造成这种现象的主要原因。下游产业的这种保护模式可以用一些理论来解释，即这些产业为自身投入品的低关税进行游说，而最终消费者则缺乏有效的组织力量。一个定量的一般均衡模型表明，如果各国对清洁产品和污染产品采用类似的贸易政策，全球二氧化碳排放量将会减少，而全球实际收入的变化则不大。

abstract.text: When a Bayesian learns new information and changes her beliefs, she must on average become concomitantly more certain about the state of the world. Consequently, it is rare for a Bayesian to frequently shift beliefs substantially while remaining relatively uncertain, or, conversely, become very confident with relatively little belief movement. We formalize this intuition by developing specific measures of movement and uncertainty reduction given a Bayesian’s changing beliefs over time, showing that these measures are equal in expectation and creating consequent statistical tests for Bayesianess. We then show connections between these two core concepts and four common psychological biases, suggesting that the test might be particularly good at detecting these biases. We provide support for this conclusion by simulating the performance of our test and other martingale tests. Finally, we apply our test to data sets of individual, algorithmic, and market beliefs.

10.1093/qje/qjaa043.abstractZh: 当一位贝叶斯学派的学习者获得新信息并改变自己的信念时，她平均而言会变得更加确信世界的状态。因此，贝叶斯学派的学习者很少会在保持相对不确定性的同时频繁地大幅改变信念，或者相反地，在信念变化幅度较小的情况下变得非常自信。我们通过开发特定的衡量指标来形式化这一直觉，这些指标可以衡量随着时间推移贝叶斯学派的学习者信念的变化以及不确定性的减少情况，并证明这些指标在期望上是一致的，同时还能创建用于检测贝叶斯效应的统计检验。接着，我们展示了这两个核心概念与四种常见心理偏差之间的联系，表明该检验可能特别擅长检测这些偏差。我们通过模拟我们的检验以及其他鞅检验的性能来支持这一结论。最后，我们将我们的检验应用于个体、算法以及市场信念的数据集。

abstract.text: Exploiting the exogenous and regional nature of the Great East Japan Earthquake of 2011, this article provides a quantification of the role of input-output linkages as a mechanism for the propagation and amplification of shocks. We document that the disruption caused by the disaster propagated upstream and downstream along supply chains, affecting the direct and indirect suppliers and customers of disaster-stricken firms. Using a general equilibrium model of production networks, we then obtain an estimate for the overall macroeconomic impact of the disaster by taking these propagation effects into account. We find that the earthquake and its aftermaths resulted in a 0.47 percentage point decline in Japan’s real GDP growth in the year following the disaster.

10.1093/qje/qjaa044.abstractZh: 本文利用2011年东日本大震灾的外源性和区域性特征，量化了投入产出联系作为冲击传播和放大机制的作用。我们观察到，这场灾难造成的破坏沿着供应链向上游和下游传播，影响了受灾企业的直接和间接供应商及客户。通过采用生产网络的一般均衡模型，我们综合考虑了这些传播效应，得出了该灾难对整体宏观经济影响的估计值。研究发现，地震及其后续影响导致日本实际GDP在灾难发生后的第二年下降了0.47个百分点。

abstract.text: Should policy communications aim at anchoring expectations of the policy instrument (“keep interest rates at zero until date τ”) or of the targeted outcome (“do whatever it takes to bring unemployment down to $y\%$”)? We study how the optimal approach depends on a departure from rational expectations. People have limited depth of knowledge and rationality, or form otherwise distorted beliefs about the behavior of others and the general equilibrium (GE) effects of policy. The bite of this distortion on implementability and welfare is minimized by target-based guidance if and only if GE feedback is strong enough. This offers a rationale for why central banks should shine the spotlight on unemployment when faced with a prolonged liquidity trap, a steep Keynesian cross, or a large financial accelerator.

10.1093/qje/qjaa045.abstractZh: 政策沟通应当旨在稳定人们对政策工具的预期（“将利率维持在零直至日期τ”），还是针对特定结果预期（“不惜一切手段将失业率降至y％”）？我们研究了最优策略如何取决于对理性预期的偏离。人们的知识深度和理性水平有限，或者他们对他人行为以及政策对整体均衡影响的认知存在扭曲。只有当整体均衡反馈足够强时，基于目标的指导才能将这种扭曲对实施效果和福利的影响降到最低。这解释了为什么在面临长期流动性陷阱、严重的凯恩斯交叉曲线或巨大的金融加速器时，中央银行应该重点关注失业率问题。

abstract.text: Most convicted offenders serve their sentences under “community supervision” at home instead of in prison. Under supervision, however, a technical rule violation, such as not paying fees, can result in incarceration. Rule violations account for 25% of prison admissions nationally and are significantly more common among black offenders. I test whether technical rules are effective tools for identifying likely reoffenders and deterring crime and examine their disparate racial impacts using administrative data from North Carolina. Analysis of a 2011 reform reducing prison punishments for technical violations on probation reveals that 40% of rule breakers would go on to commit crimes if spared harsh punishment. The same reform also closed a 33% black-white gap in incarceration rates without substantially increasing the black-white reoffending gap. These effects combined imply that technical rules target riskier probationers overall but disproportionately affect low-risk black offenders. To justify black probationers’ higher violation rate on efficiency grounds, their crimes must be roughly twice as socially costly as that of white probationers. Exploiting the repeat spell nature of the North Carolina data, I estimate a semiparametric competing risks model that allows me to distinguish the effects of particular types of technical rules from unobserved probationer heterogeneity. Rules related to the payment of fees and fines, which are common in many states, are ineffective in tagging likely reoffenders and drive differential effects by race. These findings illustrate the potentially large influence of ostensibly race-neutral policies on racial disparities in the justice system.

10.1093/qje/qjaa046.abstractZh: 大多数被定罪的罪犯是在家中接受“社区监管”而非监禁。然而，在监管下，即使是轻微的技术性违规行为，如未支付罚款，也可能导致入狱。在全国范围内，技术性违规行为占监狱入狱人数的25%，而在黑人罪犯中更为常见。我测试了技术性规则是否是识别潜在再犯和威慑犯罪的有效工具，并利用北卡罗来纳州的行政数据来研究其不同的种族影响。对2011年一项减少技术性违规行为惩罚的改革进行分析后发现，如果避免严厉的惩罚，40%的违规者仍会再次犯罪。同一改革还消除了33%的黑人白人之间的监禁率差距，同时并没有显著增加黑人白人之间的再犯率差距。这些效应综合表明，技术性规则总体上针对的是风险较高的缓刑犯，但对低风险的黑人罪犯的影响尤为显著。为了从效率角度解释黑人缓刑犯更高的违规行为率，他们的犯罪在社会上的成本必须大约是白人缓刑犯的两倍。利用北卡罗来纳州数据的重复记录特性，我估计了一个半参数竞争风险模型，该模型使我能够区分特定类型技术性规则的效果与未观察到的缓刑犯异质性。与许多州常见的支付罚款相关的规则在识别潜在再犯方面无效，并且导致了种族间的差异效应。这些发现说明了表面上中立的政策在司法系统中对种族差异的巨大影响。

abstract.text: We examine whether integrating men and women in a traditionally male-dominated environment can change men's attitudes about mixed-gender productivity, gender roles, and gender identity. Our context is the military in Norway, where we randomly assigned female recruits to some squads but not others during boot camp. We find that living and working with women for eight weeks causes men to have more egalitarian attitudes. There is a 14 percentage point higher fraction of men who think mixed-gender teams perform as well or better than same-gender teams, an 8 percentage point increase in men who think household work should be shared equally, and a 14 percentage point increase in men who do not completely disavow feminine traits. Moreover, men in mixed-gender teams are more likely to choose military occupations immediately after boot camp that have a higher fraction of women in them. But these effects do not persist once treatment stops. Treated men’s attitudes converge to those of the controls in a six-month follow-up survey, and there is no long-term effect on choosing fields of study, occupations, or workplaces with a higher fraction of women after military service ends. Contrary to the predictions of many policy makers, we do not find that integrating women into squads hurt male recruits’ performance or satisfaction with service, either during boot camp or their subsequent military assignment. These findings provide evidence that even in a highly gender-skewed environment, gender stereotypes are malleable and can be altered by integrating members of the opposite sex. But they also suggest that without continuing intensive exposure, effects are unlikely to persist.

10.1093/qje/qjaa047.abstractZh: 我们研究在传统上男性主导的环境中，让男女共同参与是否会影响男性对混合性别团队生产力、性别角色和性别认同的态度。我们的研究背景是挪威的军队，我们在新兵训练期间随机将女性新兵分配到某些队伍中，而其他队伍则没有。研究发现，与女性一起生活和工作八周后，男性的态度变得更加平等。认为混合性别团队的表现与同性别团队相当或更好的男性比例增加了14个百分点，认为家务劳动应该平等分配的男性比例增加了8个百分点，认为不会完全否定女性特质男性的比例也增加了14个百分点。此外，在混合性别团队中工作的男性更有可能在训练结束后选择那些女性比例较高的军事职业。然而，这些效应在训练结束后就消失了。在为期六个月的后续调查中，接受处理的男性的态度又回到了对照组的状态，而且他们在服役结束后选择学习领域、职业或工作场所时，也没有出现长期的影响。与许多政策制定者的预测相反，我们发现让女性参与队伍并没有降低男性新兵的表现或对服役的满意度，无论是在训练期间还是之后的军事任务中。这些发现表明，即使在高度性别差异明显的环境中，性别刻板印象也是可以改变的，通过让异性成员参与进来可以改变这些刻板印象。不过，这些发现也表明，如果没有持续的强化作用，这些效应不太可能持续下去。

abstract.text: How does competition affect market outcomes when formal contracts are not enforceable and parties resort to relational contracts? Difficulties with measuring relational contracts and dealing with the endogeneity of competition have frustrated attempts to answer this question. We make progress by studying relational contracts between upstream farmers and downstream mills in Rwanda’s coffee industry. First, we identify salient dimensions of their relational contracts and measure them through an original survey of mills and farmers. Second, we take advantage of an engineering model for the optimal placement of mills to construct an instrument that isolates geographically determined variation in competition. Conditional on the suitability for mills’ placement in the catchment area, we find that mills surrounded by more suitable areas (i) face more competition from other mills, (ii) use fewer relational contracts with farmers, and (iii) exhibit worse performance. An additional competing mill also (iv) reduces the aggregate quantity of coffee supplied to mills by farmers and (v) makes farmers worse off. Competition hampers relational contracts directly by increasing farmers’ temptation to default on the relational contract and indirectly by reducing mills’ profits.

10.1093/qje/qjaa048.abstractZh: 当正式合同无法强制执行时，当各方转向关系合同时，竞争如何影响市场结果？在衡量关系合同和处理竞争的内生性方面存在的困难，使得回答这个问题变得困难。我们通过研究卢旺达咖啡产业中上游农民与下游磨坊之间的关系合同，取得了进展。首先，我们确定了他们关系合同的显著特征，并通过一项针对磨坊和农民的原创调查来测量这些特征。其次，我们利用一个工程模型来构建一种工具，以分离地理上决定的竞争差异。在考虑到磨坊在集水区位置的适宜性之后，我们发现，被更适宜的区域包围的磨坊：(i) 面临更多的竞争；(ii) 与农民的关系合同数量较少；(iii) 表现较差。此外，另一个竞争的磨坊还：(iv) 减少了农民向磨坊供应的咖啡总量；(v) 使农民的情况更加恶化。竞争直接通过增加农民违约的诱惑来阻碍关系合同，间接则通过降低磨坊的利润来影响关系合同。

abstract.text: The labor share in U.S. manufacturing declined from 61% in 1967 to 41% in 2012. The labor share of the typical U.S. manufacturing establishment, in contrast, rose by over 3 percentage points during the same period. Using micro-level data, we document five salient facts: (i) since the 1980s, there has been a dramatic reallocation of value added toward the lower end of the labor share distribution; (ii) this aggregate reallocation is not due to entry/exit, to “superstars” growing faster, or to large establishments lowering their labor shares, but is instead due to units whose labor share fell as they grew in size; (iii) low labor share (LL) establishments benefit from high revenue labor productivity, not low wages; (iv) they also enjoy a product price premium relative to their peers; and (v) they have only temporarily lower labor shares that rebound after five to eight years. This transient pattern has become more pronounced over time, and the dynamics of value added and employment are increasingly disconnected. Taken together, we interpret these facts as pointing to a significant role for demand-side forces.

10.1093/qje/qjab002.abstractZh: 美国制造业中的劳动份额从1967年的61%下降到2012年的41%。相比之下，典型的美国制造业企业的劳动份额在同一时期上升了超过3个百分点。通过微观层面的数据，我们发现了五个重要事实：(i)自20世纪80年代以来，附加值显著地向劳动份额分布较低的部分重新分配；(ii)这种整体重新分配并非由于企业进入或退出、“超级明星”企业的快速增长，或是大型企业的劳动份额降低所致，而是由于那些随着规模扩大而劳动份额下降的企业；(iii)劳动份额较低的企業受益于高收入劳动生产力，而非低工资；(iv)它们还享有相对于同行更高的产品价格优势；(v)它们的劳动份额只是暂时下降，在五到八年后会恢复。这种短暂的模式随着时间的推移变得更加明显，增值和就业的动态越来越不相关。综合这些事实，我们认为这表明需求侧力量发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: Folklore is the collection of traditional beliefs, customs, and stories of a community passed through the generations by word of mouth. We introduce to economics a unique catalog of oral traditions spanning approximately 1,000 societies. After validating the catalog's content by showing that the groups' motifs reflect known geographic and social attributes, we present two sets of applications. First, we illustrate how to fill in the gaps and expand upon a group's ethnographic record, focusing on political complexity, high gods, and trade. Second, we discuss how machine learning and human classification methods can help shed light on cultural traits, using gender roles, attitudes toward risk, and trust as examples. Societies with tales portraying men as dominant and women as submissive tend to relegate their women to subordinate positions in their communities, both historically and today. More risk-averse and less entrepreneurial people grew up listening to stories wherein competitions and challenges are more likely to be harmful than beneficial. Communities with low tolerance toward antisocial behavior, captured by the prevalence of tricksters being punished, are more trusting and prosperous today. These patterns hold across groups, countries, and second-generation immigrants. Overall, the results highlight the significance of folklore in cultural economics, calling for additional applications.

10.1093/qje/qjab003.abstractZh: 民间传说是一群社区的传统信仰、习俗和故事的集合，这些故事通过口口相传的方式代代相传。我们向经济学领域介绍了一份独特的口头传统目录，涵盖了大约1000个社会。通过验证该目录的内容，我们发现这些群体的主题反映了已知的地理和社会特征。接下来，我们提出了两个应用案例。首先，我们展示了如何填补空白并扩展某个群体的民族志记录，重点关注政治复杂性、高级神灵以及贸易等方面。其次，我们讨论了如何利用机器学习和人类分类方法来揭示文化特征，以性别角色、对风险的态度以及信任为例。那些将男性描绘为主导者、女性为从属者的故事，往往使女性在社区中处于从属地位，无论是在历史上还是今天都是如此。那些更倾向于规避风险、缺乏创业精神的人，往往是在听那些认为竞争和挑战可能带来更多危害而非好处的故事中成长起来的。而那些对反社会行为容忍度低的社区，由于骗子受到惩罚的现象普遍存在，如今则更加信任他人，也更加繁荣。这些模式在不同群体、国家和第二代移民中都有体现。总体而言，这些结果凸显了民间传说在文化经济学中的重要性，并呼吁进一步开展相关研究。

abstract.text: We use large-scale federal survey data linked to administrative death records to investigate the relationship between Medicaid enrollment and mortality. Our analysis compares changes in mortality for near-elderly adults in states with and without Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansions. We identify adults most likely to benefit using survey information on socioeconomic status, citizenship status, and public program participation. We find that prior to the ACA expansions, mortality rates across expansion and nonexpansion states trended similarly, but beginning in the first year of the policy, there were significant reductions in mortality in states that opted to expand relative to nonexpanders. Individuals in expansion states experienced a 0.132 percentage point decline in annual mortality, a 9.4% reduction over the sample mean, as a result of the Medicaid expansions. The effect is driven by a reduction in disease-related deaths and grows over time. A variety of alternative specifications, methods of inference, placebo tests, and sample definitions confirm our main result.

10.1093/qje/qjab004.abstractZh: 我们利用大规模的联邦调查数据以及行政死亡记录，来研究Medicaid参保与死亡率之间的关系。我们的分析比较了在有和没有《平价医疗法案》Medicaid扩展政策的州中，接近老年群体的成年人死亡率的变化。我们通过调查中的社会经济状况、公民身份以及公共计划参与情况，识别出最有可能从中受益的成年人。我们发现，在《平价医疗法案》扩展政策实施之前，扩展州和未扩展州的死亡率趋势相似，但从政策实施的第一年开始，选择扩展政策的州的死亡率显著低于未扩展州。在扩展州的个体，由于Medicaid的扩展，其年度死亡率下降了0.132个百分点，比样本平均值降低了9.4%。这一效应主要源于与疾病相关的死亡人数的减少，并且随着时间的推移而持续增强。多种替代的模型设定、推断方法、安慰剂测试以及样本定义都证实了我们的主要结论。

abstract.text: We implement a new survey of firms, focusing on their higher-order macroeconomic expectations. The survey provides a novel set of stylized facts regarding the relationship between first-order and higher-order expectations of economic agents, including how they adjust their beliefs in response to a variety of information treatments. We show how these facts can be used to calibrate key parameters of noisy-information models with infinite regress as well as to test predictions made by this class of models. We also consider a range of extensions to the basic noisy-information model that can potentially better reconcile theory and empirics. Although some extensions like level-k thinking are unsuccessful, incorporating heterogeneous long-run priors can address the empirical shortcomings of the basic noisy-information model.

10.1093/qje/qjab005.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项针对企业的新调查，重点关注它们对宏观经济的高阶预期。该调查提供了一组新颖的实证数据，揭示了经济主体的一阶预期与高阶预期之间的关系，包括它们如何根据各种信息处理方式调整自己的信念。我们展示了如何利用这些数据来校准具有无限回归的噪声信息模型的关键参数，并验证这类模型所做出的预测。我们还考虑了对基本噪声信息模型的一系列扩展，这些扩展可能有助于更好地整合理论与实证结果。尽管某些扩展如k级思维模型并不成功，但纳入异质性的长期先验信息可以弥补基本噪声信息模型的实证缺陷。

abstract.text: Family and social networks are widely believed to influence important life decisions, but causal identification of those effects is notoriously challenging. Using data from Chile, Croatia, Sweden, and the United States, we study within-family spillovers in college and major choice across a variety of national contexts. Exploiting college-specific admissions thresholds that directly affect older but not younger siblings’ college options, we show that in all four countries a meaningful portion of younger siblings follow their older sibling to the same college or college-major combination. Older siblings are followed regardless of whether their target and counterfactual options have large, small, or even negative differences in quality. Spillover effects disappear, however, if the older sibling drops out of college, suggesting that older siblings’ college experiences matter. That siblings influence important human capital investment decisions across such varied contexts suggests that our findings are not an artifact of particular institutional detail but a more generalizable description of human behavior.
