Causal links between the postsecondary paths of close peers may partly explain persistent college enrollment inequalities between social groups, and this suggests that interventions to improve college access may have multiplier effects.

10.1093/qje/qjab006.abstractZh: 家庭和社交网络被广泛认为会影响重要的生活决策，但确定这些影响的因果关系却非常困难。我们利用智利、克罗地亚、瑞典和美国的データ，研究了不同国家背景下家庭内部对大学选择和专业选择的影响。通过利用与大学录取直接相关的门槛，这些门槛直接影响年长的兄弟姐妹而非年幼的兄弟姐妹的大学选择，我们发现在所有四个国家中，相当一部分年幼的兄弟姐妹会跟随年长的兄弟姐妹选择同一所大学或相同的专业组合。无论年长的兄弟姐妹的目标和替代选项在质量上是否存在较大、较小甚至负面的差异，年幼的兄弟姐妹仍然会跟随他们。然而，如果年长的兄弟姐妹退学，这种溢出效应就会消失，这表明年长的兄弟姐妹的大学经历确实很重要。兄弟姐妹在如此不同的背景下对重要的人力资本投资决策产生影响，这表明我们的发现并非特定制度细节的产物，而是对人类行为的更普遍的描述。亲密同龄人在高等教育路径上的因果关系可能部分解释了不同社会群体之间持续的大学入学不平等现象，这也表明改善大学机会的干预措施可能会产生乘数效应。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of indebted demand, capturing the idea that large debt burdens lower aggregate demand, and thus the natural rate of interest. At the core of the theory is the simple yet underappreciated observation that borrowers and savers differ in their marginal propensities to save out of permanent income. Embedding this insight in a two-agent perpetual-youth model, we find that recent trends in income inequality and financial deregulation lead to indebted household demand, pushing down the natural rate of interest. Moreover, popular expansionary policies—such as accommodative monetary policy—generate a debt-financed short-run boom at the expense of indebted demand in the future. When demand is sufficiently indebted, the economy gets stuck in a debt-driven liquidity trap, or debt trap. Escaping a debt trap requires consideration of less conventional macroeconomic policies, such as those focused on redistribution or those reducing the structural sources of high inequality.

10.1093/qje/qjab007.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种债务需求理论，该理论指出巨大的债务负担会降低总需求，从而影响到自然利率。该理论的核心是一个简单但被忽视的观察：借款者和储蓄者在从永久收入中储蓄的边际倾向上存在差异。将这一见解融入一个双代理人永生模型后，我们发现近期收入不平等加剧和金融放松管制趋势导致了债务驱动的家庭需求，进而压低了自然利率。此外，诸如宽松货币政策这样的扩张性政策会催生短期的债务融资繁荣，但未来却会牺牲债务驱动的需求。当需求过度依赖债务时，经济就会陷入债务驱动的流动性陷阱或债务陷阱。要摆脱这种困境，需要考虑一些非传统的宏观经济政策，比如那些侧重于再分配或减少高不平等结构性根源的政策。

abstract.text: Consideration set models generalize discrete-choice models by relaxing the assumption that consumers consider all available options. Determining which options were considered has previously required either survey data or restrictions on how attributes affect consideration or utility. We provide an alternative route. In full-consideration models, choice probabilities satisfy a symmetry property analogous to Slutsky symmetry in continuous-choice models. This symmetry breaks down in consideration set models when changes in characteristics perturb consideration. We show that consideration probabilities are constructively identified from the resulting asymmetries. We validate our approach in a lab experiment where consideration sets are known and then apply our framework to study a “smart default” policy in Medicare Part D, wherein consumers are automatically reassigned to lower-cost prescription drug plans with the option of opting out. Full-consideration models imply that such a policy will be ineffective because consumers will opt out to avoid switching costs. Allowing for inattention, we find that defaulting all consumers to lower-cost options produces negligible welfare benefits on average, but defaulting only consumers who would save at least $300 produces large benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjab008.abstractZh: 考虑集模型通过放宽消费者会考虑所有可用选项的假设，从而将离散选择模型推广到一般情况。此前，要确定哪些选项被考虑，要么需要调查数据，要么需要对属性如何影响考虑或效用进行限制。我们提供了一种替代方法。在完全考虑模型中，选择概率满足一种类似于连续选择模型中Slutsky对称性的性质。然而，在考虑集模型中，当特征发生变化时，这种对称性会被打破。我们证明了考虑概率可以从由此产生的不对称性中构建性地确定出来。我们在一项实验室实验中验证了我们的方法，其中考虑集是已知的，然后我们将我们的框架应用于研究Medicare Part D中的“智能默认”政策，即消费者会自动被重新分配到成本较低的处方药计划，同时他们可以选择退出。完全考虑模型表明，这样的政策将是无效的，因为消费者会为了避免转换成本而选择退出。考虑到忽略的情况，我们发现，默认所有消费者选择较低成本选项平均而言对福利的贡献微乎其微，但仅默认那些至少能节省300美元的消费者则会产生较大的福利收益。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effect of an educational program that aims to build social cohesion in ethnically mixed schools by developing perspective-taking ability in children. The program is implemented in Turkish elementary schools affected by a large influx of Syrian refugee children. We measure a comprehensive set of outcomes that characterize a cohesive school environment, including peer violence incidents, the prevalence of interethnic social ties, and prosocial behavior. Using randomized variation in program implementation, we find that the program significantly lowers peer violence and victimization on school grounds. The program also reduces the likelihood of social exclusion and increases interethnic social ties in the classroom. We find that the program significantly improves prosocial behavior, measured by incentivized tasks: treated students exhibit significantly higher trust, reciprocity, and altruism toward each other as well as toward anonymous out-school peers. We show that this enhanced prosociality is welfare improving from the ex post payoff perspective. We investigate multiple channels that could explain the results, including ethnic bias, impulsivity, empathetic concern, emotional intelligence, behavioral norms, and perspective taking. Children’s increased effort to take others’ perspectives emerges as the most robust mechanism to explain our results.

10.1093/qje/qjab009.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项旨在通过在儿童中培养换位思考能力来构建种族混合学校社会凝聚力的教育计划的效果。该计划在受到大量叙利亚难民儿童涌入影响的土耳其小学实施。我们衡量了一组全面的结果，这些结果体现了学校环境的凝聚力，包括同伴暴力事件、种族间社会联系的普遍性以及亲社会行为。通过随机分配计划实施方式，我们发现该计划显著降低了校园内的同伴暴力和受害情况。该计划还减少了社会排斥的可能性，并增加了课堂上的种族间社会联系。我们发现，该计划显著改善了亲社会行为，通过激励性任务可以衡量：接受该计划的学生在彼此之间以及与非同校的匿名同伴之间表现出更高的信任、互惠性和利他性。我们表明，这种增强的亲社会行为从事后收益的角度来看是有利于福利的。我们研究了多种可能解释这些结果的渠道，包括种族偏见、冲动性、同理心、情绪智力、行为规范以及换位思考。儿童在尝试理解他人观点方面付出的更多努力，被证明是解释我们结果的最有力机制。

abstract.text: We examine how owning a good affects learning and beliefs about its quality. We show that people have more extreme reactions to information about a good they own compared with the same information about a nonowned good: ownership causes more optimistic beliefs after receiving a positive signal and more pessimistic beliefs after receiving a negative signal. Comparing learning to normative benchmarks reveals that people overextrapolate from signals about goods they own, which leads to an overreaction to information; in contrast, learning is close to Bayesian for nonowned goods. We provide direct evidence that this effect is driven by ownership channeling greater attention toward associated information, which leads people to overweight recent signals when forming beliefs. The relationship between ownership and beliefs has testable implications for trade and market expectations. In line with these predictions, we show that the endowment effect doubles in response to positive information and disappears with negative information, and demonstrate a significant relationship between ownership and overextrapolation in survey data about stock market expectations.

10.1093/qje/qjab010.abstractZh: 我们研究了拥有某种商品如何影响人们对该商品质量的认知和信念。研究发现，与不了解该商品的情况相比，人们对其拥有商品的信息反应更为极端：当收到积极信号时，人们会持有更乐观的信念；而当收到负面信号时，则会持有更悲观的信念。通过比较学习行为与规范基准，我们发现人们会根据自己拥有的商品的信息过度解读信号，从而导致对信息的过度反应；相比之下，对于不了解的商品，人们的学习行为更接近贝叶斯推断。我们直接证明了这种效应是由拥有商品这一因素导致的，即拥有商品使得人们更加关注相关信息，从而在形成信念时过度依赖近期信号。拥有商品与信念之间的关系对于贸易和市场预期具有可验证的意义。与这些预测一致，我们发现禀赋效应在收到积极信息时会翻倍，而在收到负面信息时则会消失。此外，调查数据还显示，拥有商品与过度解读之间存在显著关系，尤其是在股市预期方面。

abstract.text: Long-term nominal interest rates are surprisingly sensitive to high-frequency (daily or monthly) movements in short-term rates. Since 2000, this high-frequency sensitivity has grown even stronger in U.S. data. By contrast, the association between low-frequency changes (at 6- or 12-month horizons) in long- and short-term rates, which was also strong before 2000, has weakened substantially. This puzzling post-2000 pattern arises because increases in short rates temporarily raise the term premium component of long-term yields, leading long rates to temporarily overreact to changes in short rates. The frequency-dependent excess sensitivity of long-term rates that we observe in recent years is best understood using a model in which (i) declines in short rates trigger “rate-amplifying” shifts in investor demand for long-term bonds, and (ii) the arbitrage response to these demand shifts is both limited and slow. We study, theoretically and empirically, how such rate-amplifying demand can be traced to mortgage-refinancing activity, investors who extrapolate recent changes in short rates, and investors who “reach for yield” when short rates fall. We discuss the implications of our findings for the validity of event study methodologies and the transmission of monetary policy.

10.1093/qje/qjab011.abstractZh: 长期名义利率对短期利率的高频（每日或每月）变动表现出惊人的敏感性。自2000年以来，这种高频敏感性在美国的数据中变得更加明显。相比之下，长期和短期利率在6个月或12个月时间跨度内的低频变化之间的关联在2000年之前就已经很强，但此后显著减弱。这种令人困惑的现象的出现是因为短期利率的上升会暂时提高长期收益率中的期限溢价部分，导致长期利率对短期利率的变化产生过度反应。我们在近年来观察到的长期利率的频率依赖性过度敏感性，可以通过一个模型来最好地解释：该模型认为，短期利率的下降会触发投资者对长期债券的“利率放大”需求，而对这种需求变化的套利反应既有限又缓慢。我们从理论和实证角度研究了这种利率放大需求是如何与抵押贷款再融资活动、推断近期短期利率变化的投资者以及当短期利率下降时寻求收益的投资者相关联的。我们讨论了我们的发现对事件研究方法有效性的影响，以及货币政策传导机制的相关问题。

abstract.text: U.S. income inequality has varied inversely with union density over the past 100 years. But moving beyond this aggregate relationship has proven difficult, in part because of limited microdata on union membership prior to 1973. We develop a new source of microdata on union membership dating back to 1936, survey data primarily from Gallup (N ≈ 980,000), to examine the long-run relationship between unions and inequality. We document dramatic changes in the demographics of union members: when density was at its mid-century peak, union households were much less educated and more nonwhite than other households, whereas pre-World War II and today they are more similar to nonunion households on these dimensions. However, despite large changes in composition and density since 1936, the household union premium holds relatively steady between 10 and 20 log points. We use our data to examine the effect of unions on income inequality. Using distributional decompositions, time series regressions, state-year regressions, as well as a new instrumental-variable strategy based on the 1935 legalization of unions and the World War II–era War Labor Board, we find consistent evidence that unions reduce inequality, explaining a significant share of the dramatic fall in inequality between the mid-1930s and late 1940s.

10.1093/qje/qjab012.abstractZh: 在过去100年中，美国的收入不平等与工会密度呈负相关关系。但要超越这一总体关系却相当困难，部分原因是1973年之前关于工会成员数据的微观数据非常有限。我们开发了一个新的微观数据来源，这些数据可以追溯到1936年，主要来自盖洛普的调查数据（样本量约为980,000户），以研究工会与收入不平等之间的长期关系。我们发现工会成员的人口结构发生了显著变化：在工会密度达到中期的顶峰时，工会家庭的教育水平较低，非白人比例较高，而二战前和今天，这些特征与非工会家庭更为相似。然而，尽管自1936年以来工会成员构成和密度发生了巨大变化，但家庭对工会的依赖程度仍然保持在10到20个对数点之间。我们利用这些数据来研究工会对收入不平等的影响。通过分布分解、时间序列回归、州年回归分析，以及基于1935年工会合法化政策和二战时期的战争劳工委员会的新工具变量策略，我们发现工会确实有助于减少不平等，并解释了从20世纪30年代中期到40年代末收入不平等显著下降的原因。

abstract.text: The urban poor in developing countries face challenging living environments, which may interfere with good sleep. Using actigraphy to measure sleep objectively, we find that low-income adults in Chennai, India, sleep only 5.5 hours a night on average despite spending 8 hours in bed. Their sleep is highly interrupted, with sleep efficiency-sleep per time in bed-comparable to those with disorders such as sleep apnea or insomnia. A randomized three-week treatment providing information, encouragement, and improvements to home sleep environments increased sleep duration by 27 minutes a night by inducing more time in bed. Contrary to expert predictions and a large body of sleep research, increased nighttime sleep had no detectable effects on cognition, productivity, decision making, or well being, and led to small decreases in labor supply. In contrast, short afternoon naps at the workplace improved an overall index of outcomes by 0.12 standard deviations, with significant increases in productivity, psychological well-being, and cognition, but a decrease in work time.

10.1093/qje/qjab013.abstractZh: 发展中国家的城市贫困人口面临着恶劣的生活环境，这可能会干扰良好的睡眠。通过活动记录法客观测量睡眠，我们发现印度钦奈的低收入成年人每晚平均只睡5.5小时，尽管他们在床上花费了8小时。他们的睡眠被频繁打断，睡眠效率——即每单位时间内睡眠的时间——与患有睡眠呼吸暂停或失眠等疾病的人相当。一项为期三周的随机治疗项目，通过提供信息、鼓励措施以及改善家庭睡眠环境，使每晚的睡眠时间增加了27分钟。与专家预测和大量睡眠研究的结果相反，夜间睡眠时间的增加对认知、生产力、决策能力或幸福感没有显著影响，反而导致劳动力供应略有减少。相比之下，在工作场所进行短暂的午后小憩，使整体结果指标提高了0.12个标准差，生产力、心理福祉和认知能力均有显著提升，但工作时间有所减少。

abstract.text: Global firms finance themselves through foreign subsidiaries, often shell companies in tax havens, which obscures their true economic location in official statistics. We associate the universe of traded securities issued by firms in tax havens with their issuer's ultimate parent and restate bilateral investment positions to better reflect the financial linkages connecting countries around the world. Bilateral portfolio investment from developed countries to firms in large emerging markets is dramatically larger than previously thought. The national accounts of the United States, for example, understate the U.S. position in Chinese firms by nearly $600 billion. Further, we demonstrate how offshore issuance in tax havens affects our understanding of the currency composition of external portfolio liabilities and the nature of foreign direct investment. Finally, we provide additional restatements of bilateral investment positions, including one based on the geographic distribution of sales.

10.1093/qje/qjab014.abstractZh: 全球企业通过海外子公司进行融资，这些子公司通常是位于避税天堂的空壳公司，这掩盖了它们在官方统计中的真实经济位置。我们将避税天堂内企业发行的交易证券与这些企业的最终母公司联系起来，并重新计算双边投资头寸，以更好地反映连接全球各国的金融联系。发达国家对大型新兴市场的企业进行的双边证券投资规模比之前认为的要大得多。例如，美国的国民账户低估了美国在中国企业中的投资规模，约达6000亿美元。此外，我们进一步展示了在避税天堂进行离岸发行如何影响我们对外部投资组合负债的货币构成以及外国直接投资的本质的理解。最后，我们提供了额外的双边投资头寸重新计算结果，其中一项基于销售的地理分布。

abstract.text: Governments go to great lengths to attract foreign multinationals because they are thought to raise the wages paid to their employees (direct effects) and to improve outcomes at local domestic firms (indirect effects). We construct the first U.S. employer-employee data set with foreign ownership information from tax records to measure these direct and indirect effects. We find the average direct effect of a foreign multinational firm on its U.S. workers is a 7% increase in wages. This premium is larger for higher-skilled workers and for the employees of firms from high GDP per capita countries. We find evidence that it is membership in a multinational production network—instead of foreignness—that generates the foreign-firm premium. We leverage the past spatial clustering of foreign-owned firms by country of ownership to identify the indirect effects. An expansion in the foreign-multinational share of commuting-zone employment substantially increases the employment, value added, and—for higher-earning workers—wages at local domestic-owned firms. Per job created by a foreign multinational, our estimates suggest annual gains of US$13,400 to the aggregate wages of local incumbents, two-thirds of which are from indirect effects. Our estimates suggest that—via mega-deals for subsidies from local governments—foreign multinationals are able to extract a sizable fraction of the local surplus they generate.

10.1093/qje/qjab015.abstractZh: 政府竭尽全力吸引外国跨国公司，因为人们认为这些公司能够提高员工工资（直接效应），并改善本地国内企业的业绩（间接效应）。我们构建了首个基于税务记录的美国雇主-员工数据集，以衡量这些直接和间接效应。研究发现，外国跨国公司对其美国员工的平均直接效应是工资增加7%。对于高技能工人以及来自高人均GDP国家的企业员工来说，这一溢价更高。我们发现，跨国生产网络中的成员资格——而非企业的外国属性——才是产生外国公司溢价的原因。我们利用过去外国企业按国家归属地的空间聚类数据来识别间接效应。外国跨国公司占通勤区就业份额的扩大，显著增加了本地国内企业的就业人数、增加值，以及高收入工人的工资。根据我们的估计，每个由外国跨国公司创造的就业机会，会使当地本土企业的总工资增加13,400美元，其中三分之二来自间接效应。我们的估计表明，通过地方政府提供的巨额补贴，外国跨国公司能够获取其创造的局部剩余的大部分。

abstract.text: In October 2010, the state government of Andhra Pradesh, India, issued an emergency ordinance, bringing microfinance activities in the state to a complete halt and causing a nationwide shock to the liquidity of lenders, especially those with loans in the affected state. We use this massive dislocation in the microfinance market to identify the causal impacts of a reduction in credit supply on consumption, earnings, and employment in general equilibrium in rural labor markets. Using a proprietary district-level data set from 25 separate, for-profit microlenders matched with household data from the National Sample Survey, we find that district-level reductions in credit supply are associated with significant decreases in casual daily wages, household wage earnings, and consumption. We find a substantial consumption multiplier from credit that is likely driven by two channels—aggregate demand and business investment. We calibrate a simple two-period, two-sector model of the rural economy that incorporates both channels and show that the magnitude of our wage results is consistent with the model’s predictions.

10.1093/qje/qjab016.abstractZh: 2010年10月，印度安得拉邦政府发布了一项紧急法令，全面暂停了该州的微金融活动，这在全国范围内对贷款机构的流动性造成了冲击，尤其是那些在该州有贷款的机构。我们利用这一微金融市场的重大变动，来研究信贷供应减少对农村劳动力市场中的消费、收入和就业的整体影响。通过利用来自25家独立营利性微金融机构的区级数据集，并与全国样本调查中的家庭数据相结合，我们发现区级信贷供应的减少与日常工资、家庭工资收入以及消费水平的显著下降有关。我们发现信贷对消费的影响具有显著的乘数效应，这可能是由于两种渠道共同作用的结果——总体需求和商业投资。我们构建了一个包含这两种渠道的农村经济两期两部门模型，并证明我们的工资分析结果与该模型的预测一致。

abstract.text: Competition in health insurance markets may fail to improve health outcomes if consumers are not able to identify high quality plans. We develop and apply a novel instrumental variables framework to quantify the variation in causal mortality effects across plans and how much consumers attend to this variation. We first document large differences in the observed mortality rates of Medicare Advantage plans within local markets. We then show that when plans with high (low) mortality rates exit these markets, enrollees tend to switch to more typical plans and subsequently experience lower (higher) mortality. We derive and validate a novel "fallback condition" governing the subsequent choices of those affected by plan exits. When the fallback condition is satisfied, plan terminations can be used to estimate the relationship between observed plan mortality rates and causal mortality effects. Applying the framework, we find that mortality rates unbiasedly predict causal mortality effects. We then extend our framework to study other predictors of plan mortality effects and estimate consumer willingness to pay. Higher spending plans tend to reduce enrollee mortality, but existing quality ratings are uncorrelated with plan mortality effects. Consumers place little weight on mortality effects when choosing plans. Good insurance plans dramatically reduce mortality, and redirecting consumers to such plans could improve beneficiary health.

10.1093/qje/qjab017.abstractZh: 在医疗保险市场中，如果消费者无法识别高质量的保险计划，竞争可能无法改善健康结果。我们开发并应用了一种新的工具变量框架，来量化不同保险计划之间的因果死亡效应差异，以及消费者对这些差异的关注程度。我们首先记录了Medicare Advantage计划在本地市场内的死亡率存在较大差异。然后我们发现，当死亡率较高的保险计划退出这些市场时，参保者往往会转向更典型的保险计划，从而导致死亡率降低或升高。我们推导并验证了一种新的“回退条件”，用于描述受保险计划退出影响的人的后续选择。当满足回退条件时，可以通过计划终止来估计观察到的计划死亡率与因果死亡效应之间的关系。应用这一框架，我们发现死亡率能够无偏地预测因果死亡效应。随后，我们将这一框架扩展到研究其他影响计划死亡效应的因素，并估算消费者愿意支付的费用。支出较高的保险计划往往能降低参保者的死亡率，但现有的质量评级与计划死亡效应并无相关性。消费者在选择保险计划时，对死亡效应的重视程度较低。优质的保险计划能显著降低死亡率，将消费者引导至这类保险计划可能有助于改善受益人的健康状况。

abstract.text: U.S. states increasingly require identification to vote—an ostensible attempt to deter fraud that prompts complaints of selective disenfranchisement. Using a difference-in-differences design on a panel data set with 1.6 billion observations, 2008–2018, we find that the laws have no negative effect on registration or turnout, overall or for any group defined by race, gender, age, or party affiliation. These results hold through a large number of specifications. Our most demanding specification controls for state, year, and voter fixed effects, along with state and voter time-varying controls. Based on this specification, we obtain point estimates of −0.1 percentage points for effects both on overall registration and turnout (with 95% confidence intervals of [−2.3; 2.1 percentage points] and [−3.0; 2.8 percentage points], respectively), and +1.4 percentage points for the effect on the turnout of nonwhite voters relative to whites (with a 95% confidence interval of [−0.5; 3.2 percentage points]). The lack of negative impact on voter turnout cannot be attributed to voters’ reaction against the laws, measured by campaign contributions and self-reported political engagement. However, the likelihood that nonwhite voters were contacted by a campaign increases by 4.7 percentage points, suggesting that parties’ mobilization might have offset modest effects of the laws on the participation of ethnic minorities. Finally, strict ID requirements have no effect on fraud, actual or perceived. Overall, our findings suggest that efforts to improve elections may be better directed at other reforms.

10.1093/qje/qjab019.abstractZh: 美国各州越来越要求选民必须携带身份证件才能投票，这看似是为了防止欺诈行为，但也引发了关于选择性剥夺公民权利的抱怨。我们利用包含16亿条观测数据的面板数据集，在2008至2018年间进行差异比较分析，发现这些法律对登记率或投票率没有负面影响，无论针对哪个由种族、性别、年龄或政党归属定义的群体。这些结果在多次参数调整中依然成立。我们采用最严格的参数设置，控制了州、年份和选民的固定效应，以及州和选民的时间变化因素。根据这一参数设置，我们得到的估计值为：对整体登记率和投票率的负面影响为-0.1个百分点（95%置信区间为[-2.3; 2.1个百分点]和[-3.0; 2.8个百分点]），而非白人选民相对于白人的投票率提升为+1.4个百分点（95%置信区间为[-0.5; 3.2个百分点]）。投票率没有负面影响并不能归因于选民对法律的反应，后者可以通过竞选捐款和自报的政治参与度来衡量。然而，非白人选民被联系到竞选活动的可能性增加了4.7个百分点，这表明政党的动员可能抵消了法律对少数民族参与的轻微影响。最后，严格的身份证件要求对实际或感知到的欺诈行为没有任何影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，改善选举制度的努力可能更应该集中在其他改革上。

abstract.text: All colonial powers granted concessions to private companies to extract natural resources during the colonial era. In Africa, these concessions were characterized by indirect rule and violence. We use the arbitrarily defined borders of rubber concessions granted in the north of the Congo Free State to examine the causal effects of this form of economic organization on development. We find that historical exposure to the concessions causes significantly worse education, wealth, and health outcomes. To examine mechanisms, we collect survey and experimental data from individuals near a former concession boundary. We find that village chiefs inside the former concessions provide fewer public goods, are less likely to be elected, and are more likely to be hereditary. However, individuals in the concessions are more trusting, more cohesive, and more supportive of sharing income. We interpret our results as reflecting how institutions and culture may act as substitutes in the context of the widespread colonial concession system.

10.1093/qje/qjab021.abstractZh: 在殖民时期，所有殖民势力都向私人公司授予特许权，以开采自然资源。在非洲，这些特许权以间接统治和暴力为特征。我们利用刚果自由邦北部授予的橡胶特许权的划定边界，来研究这种经济组织形式对发展的因果效应。我们发现，历史上长期接触特许权会导致教育、财富和健康状况显著恶化。为了研究机制，我们收集了位于前特许权边界附近的个体的调查和实验数据。我们发现，前特许权区域内的村长提供的公共产品较少，当选的可能性较低，且更可能实行世袭制。然而，特许权区域内的个体则更信任他人，更具凝聚力，也更愿意分享收入。我们将这些结果解释为制度和文化如何在广泛的殖民特许权体系背景下起到替代作用。

abstract.text: Information is central to designing effective policy, and policy makers often rely on competing interests to separate useful from biased information. We show how this logic of virtuous competition can break down, using a new and comprehensive data set on U.S. federal regulatory rulemaking for 2003–2016. For-profit corporations and nonprofit entities are active in the rulemaking process and are arguably expected to provide independent viewpoints. Policy makers, however, may not be fully aware of the financial ties between some firms and nonprofits—grants that are legal and tax-exempt but hard to trace. We document three patterns that suggest that these grants may distort policy. First, we show that shortly after a firm donates to a nonprofit, the nonprofit is more likely to comment on rules on which the firm has also commented. Second, when a firm comments on a rule, the comments by nonprofits that recently received grants from the firm’s foundation are systematically closer in content to the firm’s own comments, relative to comments submitted by other nonprofits. Third, the final rule’s discussion by a regulator is more similar to the firm’s comments on that rule when the firm’s recent grantees also commented on it.

10.1093/qje/qjab023.abstractZh: 信息对于制定有效政策至关重要，而政策制定者往往依赖各种利益关系来区分有用信息与有偏信息。我们通过使用一套关于2003年至2016年美国联邦监管规则制定的新且全面的数据集，揭示了这种“良性竞争”的逻辑如何可能失效。营利性企业和非营利组织都积极参与规则制定过程，人们普遍认为它们能够提供独立的观点。然而，政策制定者可能并不完全了解一些企业与非营利组织之间的财务联系——这些拨款虽然合法且免税，但却难以追踪。我们发现三种模式表明这些拨款可能会扭曲政策。首先，我们发现当一家企业向非营利组织捐款后，该非营利组织更有可能对这家企业也发表过评论的规则进行评论。其次，当一家企业对某条规则发表评论时，最近从该企业基金会获得拨款的非营利组织的评论在内容上系统性地更接近这家企业自己的评论，相对于其他非营利组织提交的评论而言。第三，当该企业的近期受助者也对该规则发表评论时，监管机构对该规则的最终讨论也更倾向于与这家企业的评论相似。

abstract.text: We design a field experiment to study how the allocation of authority between frontline procurement officers and their monitors affects performance both directly and through the response to incentives. In collaboration with the government of Punjab, Pakistan, we shift authority from monitors to procurement officers and introduce financial incentives in a sample of 600 procurement officers in 26 districts. We find that autonomy alone reduces prices by 9% without reducing quality and that the effect is stronger when the monitor tends to delay approvals for purchases until the end of the fiscal year. In contrast, the effect of performance pay is muted, except when agents face a monitor who does not delay approvals. Time use data reveal agents’ responses vary along the same margin: autonomy increases the time devoted to procurement, and this leads to lower prices only when monitors cause delays. By contrast, incentives work when monitors do not cause delays. The results illustrate that organizational design and anti-corruption policies must balance agency issues at different levels of the hierarchy.

10.1093/qje/qjab029.abstractZh: 我们设计了一项实地实验，研究一线采购官员与其监督人员之间权力分配如何影响绩效，以及这种分配如何通过激励措施间接影响绩效。与巴基斯坦旁遮普省政府合作，我们将权力从监督人员转移给采购官员，并在26个地区的600名采购官员中引入财务激励措施。我们发现，仅赋予采购官员自主权就能使价格降低9%，同时不会降低质量；当监督人员倾向于将采购审批推迟到财政年度末时，这种效果更为显著。相比之下，绩效奖励的效果则较为微弱，除非监督人员不会延迟审批。时间使用数据表明，代理人的行为变化遵循相同的规律：自主权增加了用于采购的时间，而只有当监督人员导致审批延迟时，这才会带来更低的价格。相反，当监督人员不延迟审批时，激励措施才有效。研究结果表明，组织设计和反腐败政策必须平衡不同层级中的代理问题。

abstract.text: We use the effect of the Dissolution of the English Monasteries after 1535 to test the commercialization hypothesis about the roots of long-run English economic development. Before the Dissolution, monastic lands were relatively unencumbered by inefficient feudal land tenure but could not be sold. The Dissolution created a market for formerly monastic lands, which could now be more effectively commercialized relative to nonmonastic lands, where feudal tenure persisted until the twentieth century. We show that parishes affected by the Dissolution subsequently experienced a rise of the gentry and had more innovation and higher yield in agriculture, a greater share of the population working outside of agriculture, and ultimately higher levels of industrialization. Our results are consistent with explanations of the Agricultural and Industrial Revolutions which emphasize the commercialization of society as a key precondition for taking advantage of technological change and new economic opportunities.

10.1093/qje/qjab030.abstractZh: 我们利用1535年后英国修道院解散的影响，来检验关于英国长期经济发展根源的商业化假说。在修道院解散之前，修道院土地相对不受低效封建土地制度的束缚，但无法出售。修道院解散后，这些原本属于修道院的土地形成了市场，可以比非修道院土地更有效地进行商业化经营，而封建土地制度则一直持续到20世纪。我们发现，受修道院解散影响的教区随后出现了地主阶层的崛起，农业领域的创新与产量都有所提高，从事农业以外工作的人口比例也增加了，最终实现了更高的工业化水平。我们的研究结果与那些强调社会商业化是充分利用技术变革和新经济机会的关键前提的农业与工业革命解释相一致。

abstract.text: I study how people understand, reason, and learn about two major tax policies: income taxation and estate taxation. Using large-scale social economics surveys issued to representative U.S. samples and associated experiments, I elicit respondents’ factual knowledge about tax policy and the income or wealth distributions. Most important, I study their understanding of the mechanisms of tax policy and the reasoning that underlies their policy views. In decomposing policy views, I find that support for income and estate taxes is most strongly correlated with social preferences, that is, the perceived benefits of redistribution and concerns around the fairness of inequality and taxation, as well as with broader views of the government. Efficiency concerns play a more minor role. These correlational patterns are confirmed by the experimental approach, which shows people instructional videos that explain the workings and consequences of one of the aspects of tax policy (the Redistribution and the Efficiency treatments) or that bring the two together and focus on the trade-off (the Economist treatment). The Redistribution and Economist treatments significantly increase support for more progressive income or estate taxes, while the Efficiency treatment has no effect. There are large partisan gaps in both the final policy views and at every step of the reasoning about the underlying mechanisms of taxes. Democrats’ and Republicans’ divergences in tax policy views can ultimately be traced back to different normative criteria (social preferences) and views of the government, rather than to different perceptions of the efficiency implications of taxation.

10.1093/qje/qjab033.abstractZh: 我研究人们如何理解、推理和了解两项主要的税收政策：所得税和遗产税。通过针对美国代表性样本进行的大规模社会经济学调查以及相关的实验，我收集了受访者对税收政策以及收入或财富分布的事实性知识。最重要的是，我研究他们对税收政策机制的理解以及支撑其政策观点的推理过程。在分解政策观点时，我发现对所得税和遗产税的支持与社会偏好密切相关，即人们对再分配带来的好处以及对不平等和税收公平性的担忧，同时也与对政府的更广泛看法有关。效率问题则起着更次要的作用。这些相关模式通过实验方法得到了验证，实验向人们展示了解释税收政策某一方面的运作和后果的教学视频（再分配和效率处理），或者将两者结合起来，重点讨论权衡问题（经济学家处理）。再分配和经济学家的处理显著增加了对更进步的所得税或遗产税的支持，而效率处理则没有这种效果。在最终的政策观点以及关于税收机制推理的每一步中，都存在较大的党派差异。民主党和共和党在税收政策观点上的分歧，最终可以归因于不同的规范标准（社会偏好）以及对政府的不同看法，而不是对税收效率影响的认知差异。

abstract.text: We present a theory of identity politics that builds on two ideas. First, when policy conflict renders a certain social divide—economic or cultural—salient, a voter identifies with her economic or cultural group. Second, the voter slants her beliefs toward the stereotype of the group she identifies with. We obtain three implications. First, voters’ beliefs are polarized along the distinctive features of salient groups. Second, if the salience of cultural policies increases, cultural conflict rises, redistributive conflict falls, and polarization becomes more correlated across issues. Third, economic shocks hurting conservative voters may trigger a switch to cultural identity, causing these voters to demand less redistribution. We discuss U.S. survey evidence in light of these implications.

10.1093/qje/qjab034.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于身份政治的理论，该理论基于两个观点。首先，当政策冲突导致某种社会分歧——无论是经济上的还是文化上的——变得明显时，选民会认同自己所属的经济或文化群体。其次，选民的信仰会倾向于与其所认同的群体相关的刻板印象。我们得出三个结论：第一，选民的信仰会沿着不同群体的特征而两极分化；第二，如果文化政策的显著性增加，文化冲突会上升，再分配冲突会下降，且不同议题之间的两极分化程度会增强；第三，对保守派选民造成影响的经济冲击可能会促使他们转向文化身份认同，导致这些选民对再分配的要求减少。我们结合美国的相关调查数据对这些结论进行了讨论。

abstract.text: This study empirically quantifies the efficiency of a real-world bargaining game with two-sided incomplete information. Myerson and Satterthwaite (1983) and Williams (1987) derived the theoretical ex-ante efficient frontier for bilateral trade under two-sided uncertainty and demonstrated that it falls short of ex-post efficiency, but little is known about how well bargaining performs in practice. Using about 265,000 sequences of a game of alternating-offer bargaining following an ascending auction in the wholesale used-car industry, this study estimates (or bounds) distributions of buyer and seller values and evaluates where realized bargaining outcomes lie relative to efficient outcomes. Results demonstrate that the ex-ante and ex-post efficient outcomes are close to one another, but that the real bargaining falls short of both, suggesting that the bargaining is indeed inefficient but that this inefficiency is not solely due to the information constraints highlighted in Myerson and Satterthwaite (1983). Quantitatively, findings indicate that over one-half of failed negotiations are cases where gains from trade exist, leading an efficiency loss of 12–23% of the available gains from trade.

10.1093/restud/rdaa007.abstractZh: 本研究通过实证方法量化了在双边信息不完全条件下的现实 bargaining 游戏的效率。Myerson 和 Satterthwaite（1983年）以及 Williams（1987年）推导出了在双边不确定性下的双边贸易理论上的最优边界，并表明该边界未能达到实际效率，但关于 bargaining 在实践中的表现却知之甚少。本研究利用批发二手车行业中的约265,000个交替报价 bargaining 序列，估计了买卖双方价值的分布，并评估了实际 bargaining 结果相对于最优结果的位置。研究结果表明，理论上的最优结果与实际最优结果非常接近，但实际 bargaining 结果却未能达到最优，这表明 bargaining 确实存在效率低下的问题，但这种效率低下并非仅仅由于 Myerson 和 Satterthwaite（1983年）所强调的信息限制。从数量上看，研究发现超过一半的谈判失败案例中存在贸易收益，导致效率损失了12-23%的潜在收益。

abstract.text: The structural-change literature typically assumes that investment is produced in manufacturing. We establish that this assumption is counterfactual: in the postwar U.S., the share of services value added in investment expenditure has been steadily growing. We develop a new model that features structural change in investment and consumption, characterize its equilibrium properties, and provide empirical support for it. We establish that modelling structural change in investment leads to three novel insights: constant TFP growth in all sectors is inconsistent with the existence of aggregate balanced growth with structural change; the sector with the slowest TFP growth absorbs all resources asymptotically; technical change is endogenously investment-biased.

10.1093/restud/rdaa013.abstractZh: 结构性变革的相关文献通常假设投资是由制造业产生的。我们证明这一假设是反事实的：在战后美国，服务增加值在投资支出中的比例一直在稳步增长。我们开发了一个新模型，该模型考虑了投资和消费的结构性变化，描述了其均衡特性，并提供了实证支持。我们证明，对投资的结构性变化进行建模可以带来三个新的见解：所有行业中的技术效率增长是与结构性变化下的总体平衡增长不一致的；技术效率增长最慢的行业会逐步吸收所有资源；技术变革是内生性的，并且倾向于投资。

abstract.text: The willingness to pay for insurance captures the value of insurance against only the risk that remains when choices are observed. This article develops tools to measure the ex ante expected utility impact of insurance subsidies and mandates when choices are observed after some insurable information is revealed. The approach retains the transparency of using reduced-form willingness to pay and cost curves, but it adds one additional sufficient statistic: the percentage difference in marginal utilities between insured and uninsured. I provide an approach to estimate this additional statistic that uses only the reduced-form willingness to pay curve, combined with a measure of risk aversion. I compare the approach to structural approaches that require fully specifying the choice environment and information sets of individuals. I apply the approach using existing willingness to pay and cost curve estimates from the low-income health insurance exchange in Massachusetts. Ex ante optimal insurance prices are roughly 30% lower than prices that maximize observed market surplus. While mandates reduce market surplus, the results suggest they would actually increase ex ante expected utility.

10.1093/restud/rdaa015.abstractZh: 支付保险费用的意愿仅反映了在选择被观察到时剩余风险所带来的保险价值。本文开发了工具，用于衡量在部分可保险信息被揭示后，保险补贴和强制要求对事前预期效用的影响。该方法保留了使用简化形式的支付意愿和成本曲线的透明性，但增加了另一个充分统计量：被保险者与未被保险者之间的边际效用差异百分比。我提供了一种估算这一额外统计量的方法，该方法仅使用简化形式的支付意愿曲线，并结合风险厌恶度量。我将该方法与需要完全指定选择环境和个体信息集的结构性方法进行了比较。我使用马萨诸塞州低收入健康保险交易所现有的支付意愿和成本曲线估算数据来应用该方法。事前最优保险价格比最大化观察到的市场剩余的价格低约30%。虽然强制要求会减少市场剩余，但结果表明它们实际上会增加事前预期效用。

abstract.text: Little is known about whether people make good choices when facing important decisions. This article reports on a large-scale randomized field experiment in which research subjects having difficulty making a decision flipped a coin to help determine their choice. For important decisions (e.g. quitting a job or ending a relationship), individuals who are told by the coin toss to make a change are more likely to make a change, more satisfied with their decisions, and happier six months later than those whose coin toss instructed maintaining the status quo. This finding suggests that people may be excessively cautious when facing life-changing choices.

10.1093/restud/rdaa016.abstractZh: 关于人们在面临重要决策时是否做出正确的选择，目前了解甚少。本文报道了一项大规模的随机实地实验，实验对象在难以做出决策时，通过抛硬币来辅助决定选择。对于重要决策（例如辞职或结束关系），被硬币投掷指示做出改变的人更有可能做出改变，他们对决策也更加满意，六个月后也更快乐。这一发现表明，人们在面临改变生活的决策时可能会过于谨慎。

abstract.text: We model a decentralized, dynamic auction market platform in which a continuum of buyers and sellers participate in simultaneous, single-unit auctions each period. Our model accounts for the endogenous entry of agents and the impact of intertemporal optimization on bids. We estimate the structural primitives of our model using Kindle sales on eBay. We find that just over one-third of Kindle auctions on eBay result in an inefficient allocation with deadweight loss amounting to 14% of total possible market surplus. We also find that partial centralization—for example, running half as many 2-unit, uniform-price auctions each day—would eliminate a large fraction of the inefficiency, but yield lower seller revenues. Our results also highlight the importance of understanding platform composition effects—selection of agents into the market—in assessing the implications of market redesign. We also prove that the equilibrium of our model with a continuum of buyers and sellers is an approximate equilibrium of the analogous model with a finite number of agents.

10.1093/restud/rdaa017.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个去中心化的动态拍卖市场平台模型，在这个平台上，大量的买家和卖家在每个时期同时进行单件拍卖。我们的模型考虑了代理人的内生性进入以及跨时域优化对出价的影响。我们通过eBay上的Kindle拍卖数据来估计模型的结构基础。研究发现，eBay上超过三分之一的Kindle拍卖导致了无效的分配，所产生的无谓损失占总市场剩余量的14%。我们还发现，部分集中化策略——例如，每天进行一半数量的2件统一价格拍卖——可以消除大部分无效性，但会导致卖家收入降低。我们的研究结果还强调了理解平台构成效应——即选择哪些代理人进入市场——在评估市场重新设计的影响中的重要性。此外，我们还证明了，在大量买家和卖家参与的情况下，我们的模型均衡实际上是具有有限数量代理人的类似模型的近似均衡。

abstract.text: We provide new time-varying estimates of the housing wealth effect back to the 1980s. We use three identification strategies: ordinary least squares with a rich set of controls, the Saiz housing supply elasticity instrument, and a new instrument that exploits systematic differences in city-level exposure to regional house price cycles. All three identification strategies indicate that housing wealth elasticities were if anything slightly smaller in the 2000s than in earlier time periods. This implies that the important role housing played in the boom and bust of the 2000s was due to larger price movements rather than an increase in the sensitivity of consumption to house prices. Full-sample estimates based on our new instrument are smaller than recent estimates, though they remain economically important. We find no significant evidence of a boom–bust asymmetry in the housing wealth elasticity. We show that these empirical results are consistent with the behaviour of the housing wealth elasticity in a standard life-cycle model with borrowing constraints, uninsurable income risk, illiquid housing, and long-term mortgages. In our model, the housing wealth elasticity is relatively insensitive to changes in the distribution of loan-to-value (LTV) for two reasons: first, low-leverage homeowners account for a substantial and stable part of the aggregate housing wealth elasticity; second, a rightward shift in the LTV distribution increases not only the number of highly sensitive constrained agents but also the number of underwater agents whose consumption is insensitive to house prices.

10.1093/restud/rdaa018.abstractZh: 我们提供了自1980年代以来的住房财富效应随时间变化的新的估计结果。我们采用了三种识别策略：普通最小二乘法结合丰富的控制变量、Saiz住房供应弹性工具，以及一种利用城市层面对区域房价周期系统性差异的新工具。这三种识别策略均表明，在2000年代，住房财富弹性略低于早期时期。这意味着2000年代住房在经济繁荣与衰退中所起的重要作用，是由于价格变动较大，而非消费对房价敏感性的增加。基于我们新工具的全样本估计结果虽低于近期估计值，但依然具有重要的经济意义。我们没有发现住房财富弹性存在显著的不对称现象。我们的研究结果表明，这些实证结果与一个标准生命周期模型中的住房财富弹性行为一致，该模型包含借贷限制、不可保险的收入风险、流动性不足的住房以及长期抵押贷款等因素。在我们的模型中，住房财富弹性对贷款价值比分布的变化相对不敏感，原因有二：首先，低杠杆率的房主在总体住房财富弹性中占很大且稳定的比例；其次，贷款价值比分布的右移不仅增加了高度敏感的受限个体的数量，也增加了那些消费对房价不敏感的 underwater个体的数量。

abstract.text: This article establishes the existence of multiple equilibria in infinite-horizon open economy models in which the value of tradable and non-tradable endowments serves as collateral. In this environment, the economy displays self-fulfilling financial crises in which pessimistic views about the value of collateral induce agents to deleverage. Under plausible calibrations, there exist equilibria with underborrowing. This result stands in contrast to the overborrowing result stressed in the related literature. Underborrowing emerges in the present context because in economies that are prone to self-fulfilling financial crises, individual agents engage in excessive precautionary savings as a way to self-insure.

10.1093/restud/rdaa023.abstractZh: 本文证明了在无限时域开放经济模型中，存在多个均衡状态，其中可交易与非可交易的资产都充当了抵押品。在这种环境下，经济会出现自我实现的金融危机，对抵押品价值的悲观看法会促使代理人减少杠杆使用。在合理的参数设定下，存在借款不足的平衡状态。这一结果与相关文献中强调的过度借款现象形成对比。在当前这种环境下，借款不足的出现是因为在容易出现自我实现金融危机的经济体中，个体代理人会进行过度的预防性储蓄，以此作为自我保险的方式。

abstract.text: This article studies how the monetary policy regime affects the relative importance of nominal exchange rates and inflation rates in shaping the response of real exchange rates to shocks. We document two facts about inflation-targeting countries. First, the current real exchange rate predicts future changes in the nominal exchange rate. Second, the real exchange rate is a poor predictor of future inflation rates. We estimate a medium-size, open-economy DSGE model that accounts quantitatively for these facts as well as other empirical properties of real and nominal exchange rates. The key estimated shocks that drive the dynamics of exchange rates and their covariance with inflation are disturbances to the foreign demand for dollar-denominated bonds.

10.1093/restud/rdaa024.abstractZh: 本文研究货币政策制度如何影响名义汇率和通胀率的相对重要性，以及这些因素如何影响实际汇率对冲击的响应。我们发现了关于通胀目标国家两个现象：首先，当前的实际汇率能够预测名义汇率的未来变化；其次，实际汇率对未来的通胀率预测能力较弱。我们建立了一个中等规模的开放经济DSGE模型，该模型能够定量解释这些现象，以及实际和名义汇率的其他实证特性。模型中关键的冲击因素包括对外国投资者对美元计价债券的需求的扰动，这些因素驱动了汇率的动态变化及其与通胀的协方差。

abstract.text: This article shows that the intensity of violence in Rwanda’s recent past can be traced back to the initial establishment of its pre-colonial state. Villages that were brought under centralized rule one century earlier experienced a doubling of violence during the state-organized 1994 genocide. Instrumental variable estimates exploiting differences in the proximity to Nyanza—an early capital—suggest that these effects are causal. Before the genocide, when the state faced rebel attacks, with longer state presence, violence is lower. Using data from several sources, including a lab-in-the-field experiment across an abandoned historical boundary, I show that the effect of the historical state is primarily sustained by culturally transmitted norms of obedience. The persistent effect of the pre-colonial state interacts with government policy: where the state developed earlier, there is more violence when the Rwandan government mobilized for mass killing and less violence when the government pursued peace.

10.1093/restud/rdaa028.abstractZh: 本文指出，卢旺达近代暴力行为的强度可以追溯到其前殖民时期国家的建立。一个世纪前被纳入中央集权统治的村庄，在1994年由国家组织的种族灭绝期间，暴力行为增加了两倍。通过利用与早期首都尼扬扎的距离差异进行工具变量估计，我们发现这些效应具有因果关系。在种族灭绝之前，当国家面临叛乱袭击时，随着国家的存在时间延长，暴力行为会有所减少。通过多种来源的数据，包括在一个废弃的历史边界进行的实地实验，我表明，历史国家的效应主要是由文化上传承的服从规范所维持的。前殖民时期国家的持续影响与政府政策相互作用：在国家建立较早的地区，当卢旺达政府动员进行大规模屠杀时，暴力行为会增多；而当政府致力于和平时，暴力行为则会减少。

abstract.text: This article studies the impact of immigration on wages, internal migration, and welfare. Using U.S. Census data, I estimate a spatial equilibrium model where labour differs by skill level, gender, and nativity. Workers are heterogeneous in city preferences. Cities vary in productivity levels, housing prices, and amenities. I use the estimated model to assess the distributional consequences of several immigration policies. The results show that a skill selective immigration policy leads to welfare gains for low skill workers, but welfare losses for high skill workers. The negative impacts are more substantial among the incumbent high skill immigrants. Internal migration mitigates the initial negative impacts, particularity in cities where housing supplies are inelastic. However, the negative wage impacts on some workers intensify. This is because an out-migration of workers of a given type may raise the local wages for workers of that type, while reducing the local wages of workers with complementary characteristics. Overall, there are substantial variations in the welfare effects of immigration across and within cities. Further, I use the model to assess the welfare effects of the border wall between Mexico and the U.S. The results show that the potential benefits are significantly smaller than the proposed cost of construction.

10.1093/restud/rdaa029.abstractZh: 本文研究了移民对工资、国内迁移和福利的影响。利用美国人口普查数据，我建立了一个空间均衡模型，该模型根据技能水平、性别和国籍来区分劳动力。不同城市的工人在城市偏好上存在差异。各城市在生产力水平、房价和设施方面存在差异。我利用该模型评估几种移民政策的分配后果。结果表明，选择性移民政策为低技能工人带来了福利收益，而高技能工人则遭受了福利损失。对于现有高技能移民来说，这种负面影响更为显著。国内迁移可以缓解最初的负面影响，尤其是在住房供应缺乏弹性的城市。然而，某些工人的工资受到负面影响更为严重。这是因为某种类型工人的外迁可能会提高该类型工人的当地工资，同时降低具有互补特征的工人的当地工资。总体而言，不同城市以及同一城市内，移民对福利的影响存在显著差异。此外，我利用该模型评估了墨西哥与美国之间修建边境墙的福利影响。结果表明，潜在的收益远低于修建边境墙所设想的成本。

abstract.text: This article provides the first causal estimates on the popular, cost-saving practice of diversion in the criminal justice system, an intervention that provides offenders with a second chance to avoid a criminal record. We exploit two natural experiments in Harris County, Texas where first-time felony defendants faced abrupt changes in the probability of diversion. Using administrative data and regression discontinuity methods, we find robust evidence across both experiments that diversion cuts reoffending rates in half and grows quarterly employment rates by nearly 50% over 10 years. The change in trajectory persists even 20 years out and is concentrated among young black men. An investigation of mechanisms strongly suggests that stigma associated with a felony conviction plays a key role in generating these results. Other possible mechanisms including changes in incarceration, other universal adjustments in policy or practice, and differences in criminal processing are ruled out empirically.

10.1093/restud/rdaa030.abstractZh: 本文首次对刑事司法系统中广受欢迎且能节省成本的“分流”措施进行了因果分析。这种干预措施为罪犯提供了第二次机会，以避免留下犯罪记录。我们利用了德克萨斯州哈里斯县的两项自然实验数据，这些实验中的初犯重罪罪犯面临分流概率的突然变化。通过行政数据和回归 discontinuity 方法分析，我们发现这两项实验均提供了强有力的证据：分流措施可将再犯罪率降低一半，并在10年内使季度就业率增加近50%。这一变化趋势在20年后依然持续，且主要集中在年轻的黑人男性身上。对机制的研究表明，与重罪定罪相关的污名在产生这些结果中起着关键作用。其他可能的机制，包括监禁时间的改变、政策或实践中的其他普遍调整，以及刑事处理方式的差异，均被实证排除。

abstract.text: We characterize trade policies that result from political competition when assessments of well-being include both material and psychosocial components. The material component reflects, as usual, satisfaction from consumption. Borrowing from social identity theory, we take the psychosocial component as combining the pride and self-esteem an individual draws from the status of groups with which she identifies and a dissonance cost she bears from identifying with those that are different from herself. In this framework, changes in social identification patterns that may result, for example, from increased income inequality or heightened class or ethnic tensions, lead to pronounced changes in trade policy. We analyse the nature of these policy changes.

10.1093/restud/rdaa031.abstractZh: 我们描述了由于政治竞争而产生的贸易政策，这些政策在评估福祉时同时考虑了物质和心理社会因素。物质因素通常表现为消费带来的满足感。借鉴社会认同理论，我们将心理社会因素视为个体从与其认同的群体所获得的自豪感和自尊心，以及因认同与自己不同的群体而承担的失调成本之和。在这种框架下，社会认同模式的变化，例如由于收入不平等加剧或阶级或种族紧张关系加剧所导致的变化，会导致贸易政策的显著变化。我们分析了这些政策变化的性质。

abstract.text: We study the first-order asymptotic properties of a class of estimators of the structural parameters in dynamic discrete choice games. We consider $K$-stage policy iteration (PI) estimators, where $K$ denotes the number of PIs employed in the estimation. This class nests several estimators proposed in the literature. By considering a “pseudo likelihood” criterion function, our estimator becomes the $K$-pseudo maximum likelihood (PML) estimator in Aguirregabiria and Mira (2002, 2007). By considering a “minimum distance” criterion function, it defines a new $K$-minimum distance (MD) estimator, which is an iterative version of the estimators in Pesendorfer and Schmidt-Dengler (2008) and Pakes et al. (2007). First, we establish that the $K$-PML estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal for any $K \in \mathbb{N}$. This complements findings in Aguirregabiria and Mira (2007), who focus on $K=1$ and $K$ large enough to induce convergence of the estimator. Furthermore, we show under certain conditions that the asymptotic variance of the $K$-PML estimator can exhibit arbitrary patterns as a function of $K$. Second, we establish that the $K$-MD estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal for any $K \in \mathbb{N}$. For a specific weight matrix, the $K$-MD estimator has the same asymptotic distribution as the $K$-PML estimator. Our main result provides an optimal sequence of weight matrices for the $K$-MD estimator and shows that the optimally weighted $K$-MD estimator has an asymptotic distribution that is invariant to $K$. The invariance result is especially unexpected given the findings in Aguirregabiria and Mira (2007) for $K$-PML estimators. Our main result implies two new corollaries about the optimal $1$-MD estimator (derived by Pesendorfer and Schmidt-Dengler (2008)). First, the optimal $1$-MD estimator is efficient in the class of $K$-MD estimators for all $K \in \mathbb{N}$. In other words, additional PIs do not provide first-order efficiency gains relative to the optimal $1$-MD estimator. Second, the optimal $1$-MD estimator is more or equally efficient than any $K$-PML estimator for all $K \in \mathbb{N}$. Finally, the Appendix provides appropriate conditions under which the optimal $1$-MD estimator is efficient among regular estimators.

10.1093/restud/rdaa032.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类用于动态离散选择博弈中结构参数估计量的一阶渐近性质。我们考虑了$K$阶段策略迭代估计量，其中$K$表示估计中使用的迭代次数。这类估计量包含了文献中提出的几种估计量。通过考虑“伪似然”标准函数，我们的估计量成为Aguirregabiria和Mira在2002年和2007年提出的$K$-伪最大似然估计量。通过考虑“最小距离”标准函数，它定义了一个新的$K$-最小距离估计量，这是Pesendorfer和Schmidt-Dengler在2008年以及Pakes等人2007年提出的估计量的迭代版本。首先，我们证明了对于任何$K \in \mathbb{N}$，$K$-PML估计量是一致且渐近正态的。这补充了Aguirregabiria和Mira在2007年关于$K=1$以及足够大的$K$使得估计量收敛的研究结果。此外，我们在某些条件下证明了$K$-PML估计量的渐近方差可以随着$K$的变化呈现出任意模式。其次，我们证明了对于任何$K \in \mathbb{N}$，$K$-MD估计量是一致且渐近正态的。对于特定的权重矩阵，$K$-MD估计量的渐近分布与$K$-PML估计量相同。我们的主要结果提供了一个最优的权重矩阵序列，用于$K$-MD估计量，并表明最优加权的$K$-MD估计量的渐近分布对$K$是不变的。考虑到Aguirregabiria和Mira在2007年对$K$-PML估计量的研究结果，这一不变性结果尤其令人意外。我们的主要结果还意味着关于最优$1$-MD估计量的两个新推论（由Pesendorfer和Schmidt-Dengler在2008年提出）。首先，最优的$1$-MD估计量在$K$-MD估计量类中是高效的，对于所有$K \in \mathbb{N}$都成立。换句话说，额外的隐私保护措施并不能提供相对于最优$1$-MD估计量的第一阶效率提升。其次，最优的$1$-MD估计量在任何$K \in \mathbb{N}$的情况下，都比任何$K$-PML估计量更高效或至少同样高效。最后，附录中提供了在哪些条件下，最优的$1$-MD估计量在常规估计量中表现出高效性。

abstract.text: This article investigates the effects of development projects on economic networks. To this end, we study the impact that a randomly allocated Community-Driven Development program in The Gambia has on economic interactions within rural villages. The program provides an exogenous source of variation to village-level stocks of productive capital and to village-wide collective activities. Based on detailed data on economic and social networks, we find a significant reduction of transfers in these networks in treatment villages. Guided by a theoretical framework, we investigate several possible mechanisms and find evidence that is consistent with two channels. First, the evidence points to modest wealth effects and a village-level transformation process towards a more formal economy. Second, we also find evidence that is consistent with elite capture, favouritism, and unequally distributed benefits leading to reductions in social capital and thus economic transactions. Overall, our findings suggest changes in networks as an avenue through which development interventions may have unintended consequences.

10.1093/restud/rdaa033.abstractZh: 本文探讨了发展项目对经济网络的影响。为此，我们研究了在冈比亚实施的社区驱动发展计划对农村村庄内部经济互动的影响。该计划为村级生产资本和村级集体活动提供了外部变异来源。基于关于经济和社会网络的详细数据，我们发现实验村中的网络转移显著减少。在理论框架的指导下，我们调查了几种可能的机制，并发现了与两个渠道一致的证据。首先，证据表明财富效应有所减弱，且村级经济向更正式的经济形态转变。其次，我们还发现了与精英攫取、偏袒以及利益分配不均相关的证据，这些因素导致社会资本减少，进而影响了经济交易。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，网络的变化可能是发展干预措施产生意外后果的一个途径。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use two comprehensive micro-data sets to study how the distribution of mortgage debt evolved during the 2000s housing boom. We show that the allocation of mortgage debt across the income distribution remained stable, as did the allocation of real estate assets. Any theory of the boom must replicate these facts, and a general equilibrium model shows that doing so requires two elements: (1) an exogenous shock that increases expected house price growth or, alternatively, reduces interest rates and (2) financial markets that endogenously relax borrowing constraints in response to the shock. Empirically, the endogenous relaxation of constraints was largely accomplished with subprime lending, which allowed the mortgage debt of low-income households to increase at the same rate as that of high-income households.

10.1093/restud/rdaa034.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用两个全面的微观数据集来研究2000年代房地产繁荣期间抵押贷款分布的变化情况。我们发现，抵押贷款在收入分布中的分配保持稳定，房地产资产的分配也是如此。任何关于这一繁荣的理论都必须能够复制这些事实。一个一般均衡模型表明，要做到这一点需要两个要素：（1）一个外生冲击，该冲击会增加预期房价增长，或者降低利率；（2）金融市场对冲击作出反应，从而放松借款约束。从经验上看，这种内生性的约束放松主要是通过次级贷款实现的，这使得低收入家庭的抵押贷款增长速度与高收入家庭相当。

abstract.text: Markov regime-switching models are very common in economics and finance. Despite persisting interest in them, the asymptotic distributions of likelihood ratio-based tests for detecting regime switching remain unknown. This study examines such tests and establishes their asymptotic distributions in the context of nonlinear models, allowing multiple parameters to be affected by regime switching. The analysis addresses three difficulties: (i) some nuisance parameters are unidentified under the null hypothesis, (ii) the null hypothesis yields a local optimum, and (iii) the conditional regime probabilities follow stochastic processes that can only be represented recursively. Addressing these issues permits substantial power gains in empirically relevant settings. This study also presents the following results: (1) a characterization of the conditional regime probabilities and their derivatives with respect to the model’s parameters, (2) a high-order approximation to the log-likelihood ratio, (3) a refinement of the asymptotic distribution, and (4) a unified algorithm to simulate the critical values. For models that are linear under the null hypothesis, the elements needed for the algorithm can all be computed analytically. Furthermore, the above results explain why some bootstrap procedures can be inconsistent, and why standard information criteria can be sensitive to the hypothesis and the model structure. When applied to US quarterly real gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate data, the methods detect relatively strong evidence favouring the regime-switching specification. Lastly, we apply the methods in the context of dynamic stochastic equilibrium models and obtain similar results as the GDP case.

10.1093/restud/rdaa035.abstractZh: 马尔可夫制度转换模型在经济学和金融学中非常常见。尽管人们对这些模型仍保持着浓厚的兴趣，但基于似然比检验来检测制度转换的渐近分布仍然未知。本研究探讨了此类检验，并在非线性模型的背景下建立了其渐近分布，从而允许多个参数受到制度转换的影响。分析解决了三个难题：(i) 在零假设下，某些干扰参数无法被识别；(ii) 零假设导致局部最优解；(iii) 条件制度概率遵循只能递归表示的随机过程。解决这些问题可以在具有实际意义的情境下显著提高检验功效。本研究还得到了以下结果：(1) 对条件制度概率及其相对于模型参数的导数的描述；(2) 对数似然比的高阶近似；(3) 渐近分布的改进；以及(4) 用于模拟临界值的统一算法。对于在零假设下为线性的模型，算法所需的元素都可以通过分析计算得出。此外，上述结果解释了为什么某些自举程序可能不一致，以及为什么标准信息准则可能对假设和模型结构敏感。当将这些方法应用于美国季度实际国内生产总值增长率数据时，这些方法能够检测到支持制度转换假设的较强证据。最后，我们将这些方法应用于动态随机均衡模型，并获得了与国内生产总值数据类似的结果。

abstract.text: We study price competition and entry of platforms in multi-sided markets. Utilizing the simplicity of the equilibrium pricing formula in our setting with heterogeneity of customers’ membership benefits, we demonstrate that in the presence of externalities, the standard effects of competition can be reversed: as platform competition increases, prices, and platform profits can go up and consumer surplus can go down. We identify economic forces that jointly determine the social inefficiency of the free-entry equilibrium and provide conditions under which free entry is socially excessive as well as an example in which free entry is socially insufficient.

10.1093/restud/rdaa036.abstractZh: 我们研究了多边市场中平台的竞争与进入行为。利用我们设定中均衡定价公式的简洁性，并结合顾客会员福利的异质性，我们证明了在存在外部性的情况下，竞争的标准效应可以被逆转：随着平台竞争的加剧，价格和平台利润可能会上升，而消费者剩余可能会下降。我们识别出共同决定自由进入均衡社会低效率的经济因素，并提出了自由进入在社会上过度的条件，以及一个自由进入在社会上不足的例子。

abstract.text: We identify a new mechanism through which cultural diversity affects economic outcomes, based on a model of culture as shared cognition. Under this view, cultural diversity matters because it increases strategic uncertainty. The model can help better understand a variety of disparate evidence, including why homogeneous societies can be more conformist, why diverse societies may get stuck in a low-trust trap, why companies with a strong culture may fail to adopt superior work practices, and why autocratic rulers in diverse societies may overinvest in state capacity.

10.1093/restud/rdaa037.abstractZh: 我们发现了一种新的机制，通过这种机制，文化多样性会影响经济成果，这一机制基于将文化视为共享认知的模型。在这种观点下，文化多样性之所以重要，是因为它增加了战略不确定性。该模型有助于更好地理解各种不同的现象，包括为什么同质化社会可能更加顺从，为什么多样化社会可能会陷入信任低下的困境，为什么具有强大文化的公司可能无法采用更优的工作实践，以及为什么在多样化社会中，专制统治者可能会过度投资国家能力。

abstract.text: Should the generosity of unemployment benefits and the progressivity of income taxes depend on the presence of business cycles? This paper proposes a tractable model where there is a role for social insurance against uninsurable shocks to income and unemployment, as well as business cycles that are inefficient due to the presence of matching frictions and nominal rigidities. We derive an augmented Baily–Chetty formula showing that the optimal generosity of the social insurance system depends on a macroeconomic stabilization term. This term pushes for an increase in generosity when the level of economic activity is more responsive to social programmes in recessions than in booms. A calibration to the US economy shows that taking concerns for macroeconomic stabilization into account substantially raises the optimal unemployment insurance replacement rate but has a negligible impact on the optimal progressivity of the income tax. More generally, the role of social insurance programmes as automatic stabilizers affects their optimal design.

10.1093/restud/rdaa038.abstractZh: 失业救济金的慷慨程度以及所得税的累进性是否取决于商业周期的存在？本文提出了一个可行的模型，其中社会保险在应对无法保险的收入和失业冲击方面具有重要作用，同时由于匹配摩擦和名义刚性因素的影响，商业周期也显得效率低下。我们推导出一个扩展的Baily–Chetty公式，表明社会保险体系的最佳慷慨程度取决于一个宏观经济稳定项。当经济活动的响应程度在衰退期比繁荣期更依赖于社会政策时，这一稳定项会促使慷慨程度增加。对美国经济的校准表明，考虑到宏观经济稳定问题，最佳失业保险替代率会显著提高，但对所得税的最佳累进性影响微乎其微。更一般地说，社会保险计划作为自动稳定器的作用会影响其最佳设计。

abstract.text: Can attitudes towards minorities, an important cultural trait, be changed? We show that the presence of African American soldiers in the UK during World War II reduced anti-minority prejudice, a result of the positive interactions which took place between soldiers and the local population. The change has been persistent: in locations in which more African American soldiers were posted there are fewer members of and voters for the UK’s leading far-right party, less implicit bias against blacks and fewer individuals professing racial prejudice, all measured around 2010. Our results point towards intergenerational transmission from parents to children as the most likely explanation.

10.1093/restud/rdaa039.abstractZh: 对于少数群体这一重要的文化特征，人们的态度能否改变呢？我们的研究表明，在第二次世界大战期间，非裔美国士兵在英国的存在减少了针对少数群体的偏见，这一变化是由于士兵与当地居民之间的积极互动所导致的。这种变化是持续存在的：在驻扎有更多非裔美国士兵的地区，英国主要极右翼政党的成员和选民数量较少，对黑人的隐性偏见也较低，同时表达种族偏见的个体数量也较少，这些数据都是截至2010年左右的情况。我们的研究结果表明，父母向子女传递观念是最有可能解释这一现象的原因。

abstract.text: What is the relationship between bank capital, the risk of a financial crisis, and its severity? This article introduces the first comprehensive analysis of the long-run evolution of the capital structure of modern banking using newly constructed data for banks’ balance sheets in 17 countries since 1870. In addition to establishing stylized facts on the changing funding mix of banks, we study the nexus between capital structure and financial instability. We find no association between higher capital and lower risk of banking crisis. However, economies with better capitalized banking systems recover faster from financial crises as credit begins to flow back more readily.

10.1093/restud/rdaa040.abstractZh: 银行资本、金融危机的风险与其严重程度之间有何关系？本文首次对1870年以来17个国家银行资产负债表数据进行了全面分析，探讨了现代银行资本结构的长期演变。除了总结出银行融资结构变化的典型特征外，我们还研究了资本结构与金融不稳定性的关联。研究发现，较高的资本水平与较低的银行危机风险之间没有关联。然而，资本更充足的银行体系能够在信贷重新流动时更快地从金融危机中恢复。

abstract.text: The communication revelation principle (RP) of mechanism design states that any outcome that can be implemented using any communication system can also be implemented by an incentive-compatible direct mechanism. In multistage games, we show that in general the communication RP fails for the solution concept of sequential equilibrium (SE). However, it holds in important classes of games, including single-agent games, games with pure adverse selection, games with pure moral hazard, and a class of social learning games. For general multistage games, we establish that an outcome is implementable in SE if and only if it is implementable in a canonical Nash equilibrium in which players never take codominated actions. We also prove that the communication RP holds for the more permissive solution concept of conditional probability perfect Bayesian equilibrium.

10.1093/restud/rdaa041.abstractZh: 机制设计的沟通启示原则指出，任何可以通过任何通信系统实现的结果，也可以通过一个激励兼容的直接机制实现。在多阶段博弈中，我们证明了通常情况下，沟通启示原则不适用于序贯均衡的解决方案概念。然而，在包括单代理博弈、纯逆向选择博弈、纯道德风险博弈以及一类社会学习博弈等重要类型的博弈中，该原则仍然成立。对于一般的多阶段博弈，我们证明了一个结果只有在以规范纳什均衡的形式实现时才可以在序贯均衡中实现，而规范纳什均衡要求玩家从不采取共同占优的行动。我们还证明了，对于更为宽松的条件概率完美贝叶斯均衡解决方案概念，沟通启示原则仍然成立。

abstract.text: We model the building of a city, estimate parameters of the model, and calculate welfare losses from institutional frictions encountered in changing land-use. We distinguish formal and slum construction technologies; in contrast to slums, formal structures can be built tall, are durable, and non-malleable. As the city grows areas are initially developed informally, then formally, and then redeveloped periodically. Slums are modelled as a technology choice; however, institutional frictions in land markets may hinder their conversion to formal usage that requires secure property rights. Using unique data on Nairobi for 2003 and 2015, we develop a novel set of facts that support assumptions of the model, estimate all parameters of the model, and calculate welfare losses of conversion frictions. We track the dynamic evolution of the city and compare it with model predictions. In the core city formal sector, about a third of buildings were torn down over 12 years and replaced by buildings on average three times higher. For slums in older areas near the centre, even after buying out slumlords, overcoming institutional frictions would yield gains amounting to about ${\$}$18,000 per slum household, thirty times typical annual slum rent payments.

10.1093/restud/rdaa042.abstractZh: 我们模拟了城市的建设过程，估计了模型的参数，并计算了因土地使用变更而产生的福利损失。我们区分了正式建筑与贫民窟建筑的技术特点；与贫民窟相比，正式建筑可以建得更高、更耐用且不易损坏。随着城市的扩张，最初是采用非正式方式开发区域，随后转为正式开发，最后再定期进行重新开发。贫民窟则被建模为一种技术选择；然而，土地市场的制度性摩擦可能会阻碍其转变为需要稳定产权保护的正式用途。利用2003年和2015年对内罗毕的独有数据，我们构建了一套新的事实支持模型假设，估计了模型的所有参数，并计算了转换过程中产生的福利损失。我们追踪了城市的动态演变，并将其与模型预测结果进行了比较。在核心城市的正式部门，大约三分之一的建筑在12年内被拆除，取而代之的是平均高度是原有建筑三倍的建筑。对于中心附近较老区域的贫民窟来说，即使通过收购贫民窟房东来克服制度性摩擦，也能为每个贫民窟家庭带来约18,000美元的收益，这相当于贫民窟居民通常每年租金的30倍。

abstract.text: This article characterizes optimal compensation contracts in principal-agent settings in which the consequences of the agent’s action are only observed over time. The optimal timing of pay trades off the costs of deferred compensation arising from the agent’s relative impatience and potential consumption smoothing needs against the benefit of exploiting additional informative signals. By capturing this information benefit of deferral in terms of the likelihood ratio dynamics, our characterization covers general signal processes in a unified setting. With bilateral risk neutrality and agent limited liability, optimal contracts are high-powered and stipulate at most two payout dates. If the agent is additionally risk-averse, payouts are contingent on performance exceeding a hurdle that is increasing over time. We obtain clear-cut predictions on how the duration of optimal compensation depends on the nature of information arrival as well as agent characteristics and derive implications for the maturity structure of securities in financial contracting settings.

10.1093/restud/rdaa043.abstractZh: 本文描述了在主体代理设置中最优补偿合同的特点，其中代理人的行为后果仅随时间被观察到。支付的最佳时机是在代理人的相对急躁和潜在消费平滑需求所带来的延迟补偿成本与利用额外信息信号的收益之间进行权衡。通过以可能性比率动态来捕捉这种延迟信息的好处，我们的描述涵盖了统一设置下的一般信号过程。在双边风险中性和代理人有限责任的情况下，最优合同具有高度灵活性，最多规定两个支付日期。如果代理人还表现出风险厌恶，则支付取决于绩效是否超过一个随时间增加的门槛。我们得出了关于最优补偿持续时间如何取决于信息到达性质以及代理人特征的具体预测，并得出了对金融契约设置中证券到期结构的影响。

abstract.text: Observed choices between risky lotteries are difficult to reconcile with expected utility maximization, both because subjects appear to be too risk averse with regard to small gambles for this to be explained by diminishing marginal utility of wealth, as stressed by Rabin (2000), and because subjects’ responses involve a random element. We propose a unified explanation for both anomalies, similar to the explanation given for related phenomena in the case of perceptual judgments: they result from judgments based on imprecise (and noisy) mental representations of the decision situation. In this model, risk aversion results from a sort of perceptual bias—but one that represents an optimal decision rule, given the limitations of the mental representation of the situation. We propose a quantitative model of the noisy mental representation of simple lotteries, based on other evidence regarding numerical cognition, and test its ability to explain the choice frequencies that we observe in a laboratory experiment.

10.1093/restud/rdaa044.abstractZh: 观察到的在风险彩票之间的选择难以与期望效用最大化理论相调和，一方面是因为受试者似乎对小额赌博过于规避风险，这无法用拉宾（2000年）所强调的财富边际效用的递减来解释；另一方面是因为受试者的反应包含随机因素。我们提出了一个统一的解释，类似于对感知判断相关现象的解释：这些异常现象源于基于决策情境的不精确（且带有噪声）的心理表征做出的判断。在这个模型中，风险规避是一种感知偏差，但这是一种在情境的心理表征有限的情况下代表最优决策规则的现象。我们基于其他关于数字认知的证据，提出了一个关于简单彩票的噪声心理表征的定量模型，并测试了该模型能否解释我们在实验室实验中观察到的选择频率。

abstract.text: What is the role of monetary policy in a bubbly world? To address this question, we study an economy in which financial frictions limit the supply of assets. The ensuing scarcity generates a demand for “unbacked” assets, i.e., assets that are backed only by the expectation of their future value. We consider two types of unbacked assets: bubbles, which are created by the private sector, and money, which is created by the central bank. Bubbles and money share many features, but they also differ in two crucial respects. First, while the rents from the creation of bubbles accrue to entrepreneurs and foster investment, the rents from money creation accrue to the central bank. Second, while bubbles are driven by market psychology, and can rise and fall according to the whims of the market, money is under the control of the central bank. We characterize the optimal monetary policy and show that, through its ability to supply assets, monetary policy plays a key role in the bubbly world. The model sheds light on the recent expansion of central bank liabilities in response to the bursting of bubbles.

10.1093/restud/rdaa045.abstractZh: 在泡沫世界中，货币政策扮演了怎样的角色？为了回答这个问题，我们研究了一个金融摩擦限制资产供应的经济模型。由此产生的稀缺性催生了对“无支撑”资产的需求，即那些仅以未来价值预期为支撑的资产。我们区分了两种无支撑资产：由私人部门创造的泡沫，以及由中央银行创造的货币。泡沫和货币有许多共同特征，但在两个关键方面有所不同。首先，创造泡沫所带来的收益归企业家所有，促进投资；而货币创造带来的收益则归中央银行所有。其次，泡沫受市场心理驱动，可以随市场情绪波动而涨跌，而货币则处于中央银行的控制之下。我们描述了最优货币政策，并表明通过提供资产，货币政策在泡沫世界中发挥着关键作用。该模型还揭示了近期中央银行负债因泡沫破裂而增加的趋势。

abstract.text: We introduce a robust approach to study dynamic monopoly pricing of a durable good in the face of buyer learning. A buyer receives information about her willingness-to-pay for the seller’s product over time, and decides when to make a one-time purchase. The seller does not know how the buyer learns but commits to a pricing strategy to maximize profits against the worst-case information arrival process. We show that a constant price path delivers the robustly optimal profit, with profit and price both lower than under known values. Thus, under the robust objective, intertemporal incentives do not arise at the optimum, despite the possibility for information arrival to influence the timing of purchases. We delineate whether constant prices remain optimal (or not) when the seller seeks robustness against a subset of information arrival processes. As part of the analysis, we develop new techniques to study dynamic Bayesian persuasion.

10.1093/restud/rdaa046.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种稳健的方法，用于研究在买家学习的情况下耐用商品的动态垄断定价问题。买家会随着时间的推移获得关于其愿意为卖家产品支付的价格信息，并决定何时进行一次性购买。卖家并不知道买家是如何获取这些信息的，但会采取一种定价策略来最大化利润，以应对最坏情况下的信息获取过程。我们证明，恒定的价格路径能够实现稳健最优的利润，此时利润和价格都低于已知情况下的数值。因此，在稳健目标下，尽管信息获取可能会影响购买时机，但在最优情况下并不会出现跨时激励。我们进一步探讨了当卖家试图应对部分信息获取过程时，恒定价格是否仍然是最优的。作为分析的一部分，我们开发了新的技术来研究动态贝叶斯说服问题。

abstract.text: What is the aggregate and distributional impact of microfinance? To answer this question, we develop a quantitative macroeconomic framework of entrepreneurship and financial frictions in which microfinance is modelled as guaranteed small-size loans. We discipline and validate our model using recent empirical evaluations of small-scale microfinance programs. We find that the long-run general equilibrium impact is substantially different from the short-run effect. In the short-run partial equilibrium, output and capital increase with microfinance but total factor productivity (TFP) falls. In the long run, when general equilibrium effects are considered, as should be for economy-wide microfinance interventions, scaling up microfinance has only a small impact on per-capita income, because an increase in TFP is offset by lower capital accumulation. However, the vast majority of the population benefits from microfinance directly and indirectly. The welfare gains are larger for the poor and the marginal entrepreneurs, although higher interest rates in general equilibrium tilt the gains toward the rich.

10.1093/restud/rdaa047.abstractZh: 小额信贷的总体和分布影响是什么？为了回答这个问题，我们建立了一个关于创业和金融摩擦的定量宏观经济框架，其中小额信贷被建模为有担保的小额贷款。我们使用最近对小额信贷项目的实证评估来检验和验证我们的模型。我们发现，长期的一般均衡影响与短期效应有很大不同。在短期部分均衡中，小额信贷会促进产出和资本的增长，但全要素生产率却下降。从长期来看，当考虑一般均衡效应时，正如经济范围内的小额信贷干预所应该的那样，扩大小额信贷规模对人均收入的影响很小，因为全要素生产率的增加被较低的资本积累所抵消。然而，绝大多数人口都能直接和间接地从小额信贷中受益。对于贫困者和边缘创业者来说，福利收益更大，尽管一般均衡下的较高利率使得收益向富人倾斜。

abstract.text: We study the Markov perfect equilibrium in a dynamic game where agents have non-constant time preference, decentralized households determine aggregate savings, and a planner chooses climate policy. The article is the first to solve this problem with general discounting and general functional forms. With time-inconsistent preferences, a commitment device that allows a planner to choose climate policy for multiple periods is potentially very valuable. Nevertheless, our quantitative results show that while a permanent commitment device would be very valuable, the ability to commit policy for “only” 100 years adds less than 2% to the value of climate policy without commitment. We solve a log-linear version of the model analytically, generating a formula for the optimal carbon tax that includes the formula in Golosov et al. (2014, Econometrica, 82, 41–88) as a special case. More importantly, we develop new algorithms to solve the general game numerically. Convex damages lead to strategic interactions across generations of planners that lower the optimal carbon tax by 45% relative to the scenario without strategic interactions.

10.1093/restud/rdaa048.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡问题，其中参与者的时间偏好是非恒定的，分散的 Household 决定总体储蓄，而规划者则负责选择气候政策。本文首次采用一般折扣机制和一般函数形式来解决这一问题。在时间不一致偏好的情况下，一个能够允许规划者为多个时期选择气候政策的承诺机制可能非常有价值。然而，我们的定量结果显示，虽然永久性的承诺机制非常有价值，但仅承诺100年的政策却不会增加气候政策价值的2%以上。我们解析地解决了该模型的对数线性版本，并推导出了最优碳税的公式，该公式包含了 Golosov等人（2014年，《Econometrica》，82卷，41-88页）中的公式作为特例。更重要的是，我们开发了新的算法来数值求解一般博弈问题。凸性损害导致不同世代的规划者之间存在策略互动，这使得最优碳税比没有策略互动的情景降低了45%。

abstract.text: In this article, we provide mechanisms for exchange economies with private information and interdependent values, which are ex post individually rational, incentive compatible, generate budget surplus, and are ex post nearly efficient, with many agents. Our framework is entirely prior-free, and we make no symmetry restrictions. The mechanisms can be implemented using a novel discriminatory conditional double auction, without knowledge of information structure or utility functions. We also show that no other mechanism satisfying the constraints can generate inefficiency of smaller order.

10.1093/restud/rdaa049.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种适用于具有私人信息和相互依赖价值的交换经济体的机制。这些机制在事后上是个体理性的，能够产生预算盈余，并且在许多参与者的背景下几乎是高效的。我们的框架完全不需要先验信息，并且没有对称性限制。这些机制可以通过一种新颖的歧视性条件双拍卖来实施，无需了解信息结构或效用函数。我们还表明，没有其他机制能够满足这些约束条件，并且不会产生更严重的低效率问题。

abstract.text: Macroeconomists traditionally ignore temporary price markdowns (“sales”) under the assumption that they are unrelated to aggregate phenomena. We revisit this view. First, we provide robust evidence from the U.K. and U.S. CPI micro data that the frequency of sales is strongly countercyclical, as much as doubling during the Great Recession. Second, we build a general equilibrium model in which cyclical sales arise endogenously as retailers try to attract bargain hunters. The calibrated model fits well the business cycle co-movement of sales with consumption and hours worked, and the strong substitution between market work and shopping time documented in the time-use literature. The model predicts that after a monetary contraction, the heightened use of discounts by firms amplifies the fall in the aggregate price level, attenuating by a third the one-year response of real consumption.

10.1093/restud/rdaa050.abstractZh: 宏观经济学家传统上忽视了临时性的价格折扣（“促销”），认为它们与总体经济现象无关。我们重新审视了这一观点。首先，我们从英国和美国的CPI微观数据中获得了有力的证据，表明促销的频率具有强烈的反周期性特征，在大衰退期间，促销频率甚至翻了一番。其次，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，在该模型中，周期性促销是零售商为了吸引 bargain hunters而内生产生的。经过校准的模型很好地解释了促销与消费和工作时间之间的经济周期联动关系，同时也符合时间使用文献中记录的市场工作时间和购物时间之间的强烈替代关系。该模型预测，在货币紧缩之后，企业增加折扣行为会加剧总体价格水平的下降，从而使一年内的实际消费下降三分之一。

abstract.text: In dynamic games, players may observe a deviation from a pre-play, possibly incomplete, non-binding agreement before the game is over. The attempt to rationalize the deviation may lead players to revise their beliefs about the deviator’s behaviour in the continuation of the game. This instance of forward induction reasoning is based on interactive beliefs about not just rationality, but also the compliance with the agreement itself. I study the effects of such rationalization on the self-enforceability of the agreement. Accordingly, outcomes of the game are deemed implementable by some agreement or not. Conclusions depart substantially from what the traditional equilibrium refinements suggest. A non-subgame perfect equilibrium outcome may be induced by a self-enforcing agreement, while a subgame perfect equilibrium outcome may not. The incompleteness of the agreement can be crucial to implement an outcome.

10.1093/restud/rdaa051.abstractZh: 在动态博弈中，玩家可能会在游戏结束前观察到与游戏开始前的不完全、非约束性协议的偏差。试图合理化这种偏差可能会促使玩家修正他们对偏差行为在游戏继续中的认知。这种前瞻性推理基于关于理性以及协议遵守情况的互动性认知。我研究了这种合理化行为对协议自我执行能力的影响。据此，游戏的结果会被认为是可以按照某些协议来实施的，或者无法实施。这些结论与传统的均衡改进所提出的观点有很大不同。一个非子博弈完美均衡的结果可能由自我执行的协议引发，而一个子博弈完美均衡的结果则可能无法由这样的协议引发。协议的不完全性对于实现某种结果可能是至关重要的。

abstract.text: We characterize when a stable and strategy-proof mechanism is guaranteed to exist in the setting of many-to-one matching with contracts. We introduce three novel conditions—observable substitutability, observable size monotonicity, and non-manipulability via contractual terms—and show that when these conditions are satisfied, the cumulative offer mechanism is the unique mechanism that is stable and strategy-proof (for workers). Moreover, we show that our three conditions are, in a sense, necessary: if the choice function of some firm fails any of our three conditions, we can construct unit-demand choice functions for the other firms such that no stable and strategy-proof mechanism exists. Thus, our results provide a rationale for the ubiquity of cumulative offer mechanisms in practice.

10.1093/restud/rdaa052.abstractZh: 我们描述了在多对一匹配与合同情境下，是否存在一种稳定且不受策略影响的机制。我们提出了三个新的条件：可观测的替代性、可观测的规模单调性，以及无法通过合同条款进行操纵。我们证明，当这些条件得到满足时，累积报价机制是唯一既稳定又不受策略影响的机制（对于工人而言）。此外，我们还表明，这三个条件在某种意义上是必要的：如果某家公司的选择函数不满足其中任何一个条件，我们可以为其他公司构建单位需求选择函数，从而确保不存在稳定且不受策略影响的机制。因此，我们的研究结果为累积报价机制在实践中的普遍性提供了理论依据。

abstract.text: We study when pure bundling, i.e., offering only the grand bundle of all products, is optimal for a multi-product monopolist. Pure bundling is optimal if consumers with higher values for the grand bundle have higher relative values for smaller bundles compared to the grand bundle. Conversely, pure bundling is not optimal if consumers with higher values for the grand bundle have lower relative values. We prove the results by decomposing the problem into simpler ones in which types can be ranked according to their values for the grand bundle.

10.1093/restud/rdaa053.abstractZh: 我们研究了在多种产品垄断者的情况下，仅提供所有产品的综合套餐是否是最优选择。如果消费者对于综合套餐的偏好程度较高，那么他们对于较小套餐的相对偏好也会更高；反之，如果消费者对于综合套餐的偏好程度较低，那么他们对于较小套餐的相对偏好也会更低。我们通过将问题分解为更简单的子问题来证明这些结论，在这些子问题中，产品类型可以根据其对综合套餐的偏好程度进行排序。

abstract.text: Motivated by wide cross-sectional variations in intensity of care that are unrelated to quality of care, researchers and policymakers commonly claim that healthcare providers waste considerable resources, engaging in so-called “flat-of-the-curve” medicine. A key yet elusive prediction of this hypothesis is that providers ought to be able to cut back on care without sacrificing quality. This article examines the effects of a particular form of provider cutbacks—those generated by physicians working in high-pressure peer group environments. Using expansive, time-stamped discharge data from 137 hospital-based emergency departments, I document that physicians systematically alter their pace and intensity of care across frequently shuffled peer groups. Peer groups that induce a physician to work faster also induce her to order fewer tests and spend less money. Contrary to the flat-of-the-curve hypothesis, these cutbacks lead to large reductions in quality of care. This evidence, paired with the fact that slower physicians do not produce better average outcomes, suggests that cross-physician differences in resource utilization reflect substantial differences in physician productivity within a hospital.

10.1093/restud/rdaa054.abstractZh: 由于护理强度的广泛横向差异与护理质量无关，研究人员和政策制定者通常认为医疗服务提供者浪费了大量资源，这种现象被称为“平坦曲线”医疗。这一假设的一个关键但难以捉摸的预测是，医疗服务提供者应该能够在不牺牲质量的情况下减少护理量。本文研究了一种特定形式的削减措施——由在高压同行群体环境中工作的医生所实施的削减措施。通过利用来自137家医院急诊部门的详细、带有时间戳的出院数据，我发现医生在频繁更换的同行群体中系统性地调整了护理的速度和强度。那些促使医生加快工作节奏的同行群体，也促使医生减少检查次数并花费更少的资金。与“平坦曲线”假设相反，这些削减措施实际上导致了护理质量的显著下降。这一证据，加上较慢的医生并不能带来更好的平均治疗效果的事实，表明不同医生在资源利用方面的差异反映了医院内部医生生产力的显著差异。

abstract.text: Fixed differences loom smaller when compared to large differences. We propose a model of relative thinking where a person weighs a given change along a consumption dimension by less when it is compared to bigger changes along that dimension. In deterministic settings, the model predicts context effects such as the attraction effect but predicts meaningful bounds on such effects driven by the intrinsic utility for the choices. In risky environments, a person is less likely to sacrifice utility on one dimension to gain utility on another that is made riskier. For example, a person is less likely to exert effort for a fixed monetary return if there is greater overall income uncertainty. We design and run experiments to test basic model predictions and find support for these predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdaa055.abstractZh: 与较大的差异相比，固定的差异显得微不足道。我们提出了一个相对思维模型，该模型认为，在消费维度上，与更大的变化相比，某一变化的重要性会降低。在确定性环境中，该模型预测了诸如吸引力效应这样的情境效应，并预测了这些效应受到选择内在效用驱动的有意义的界限。在风险环境中，一个人不太可能为了在一个风险更高的维度上获得效用而牺牲另一个维度上的效用。例如，如果整体收入的不确定性更大，一个人就不太可能为固定的金钱回报付出更多的努力。我们设计并进行了实验来测试该模型的基本预测，并发现了这些预测得到支持的证据。

abstract.text: We identify a competition-policy-based argument for regulating the secondary features of complex or complexly priced products when consumers have limited attention. Limited attention implies that consumers can only “study” a small number of complex products in full, while—by failing to check secondary features—they can superficially “browse” more. Interventions limiting ex post consumer harm through safety regulations, caps on certain fees, or other methods induce consumers to do more or more meaningful browsing, enhancing competition. We show that for a pro-competitive effect to obtain, the regulation must apply to the secondary features, and not to the total price or value of the product. As an auxiliary positive prediction, we establish that because low-value consumers are often more likely to study—and therefore less likely to browse—than high-value consumers, the average price consumers pay can be increasing in the share of low-value consumers.
