We discuss applications of our insights to health-insurance choice, the European Union’s principle on unfair contract terms, food safety in developing countries, and the shopping behaviour of (and prices paid by) low-income and high-income consumers.

10.1093/restud/rdaa056.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于竞争与政策的论点，用于规范复杂产品或价格复杂的产品的次要特征，尤其是在消费者注意力有限的情况下。注意力有限意味着消费者只能全面“研究”少数几种复杂产品，而由于未能关注次要特征，他们只能进行浅尝辄止的浏览。通过安全法规、限制某些费用或其他方式来限制消费者实际受到的损害，可以促使消费者进行更深入或更有意义的浏览，从而增强竞争。我们指出，为了获得促进竞争的效果，监管必须针对次要特征，而不是产品的整体价格或价值。作为辅助性的积极预测，我们进一步证明，由于低价值消费者往往更有可能进行深入研究，因此支付的平均价格可能会随着低价值消费者比例的增加而上升。我们还将这一洞察应用于健康保险选择、欧盟关于不公平合同条款的原则、发展中国家的食品安全问题，以及低收入和高收入消费者的购物行为及支付价格。

abstract.text: We show that helping young job seekers signal their skills to employers generates large and persistent improvements in their labour market outcomes. We do this by comparing an intervention that improves the ability to signal skills (the “job application workshop”) to a transport subsidy treatment designed to reduce the cost of job search. In the short run, both interventions have large positive effects on the probability of finding a formal job. The workshop also increases the probability of having a stable job with an open-ended contract. Four years later, the workshop significantly increases earnings, job satisfaction, and employment duration, but the effects of the transport subsidy have dissipated. Gains are concentrated on individuals who generally have worse labour market outcomes. Overall, our findings highlight that young people possess valuable skills that are unobservable to employers. Making these skills observable generates earnings gains that are far greater than the cost of the intervention.

10.1093/restud/rdaa057.abstractZh: 我们表明，帮助年轻的求职者向雇主展示他们的技能，能够显著且持久地改善他们的劳动力市场状况。我们通过比较一种能够提升技能展示能力的干预措施（“求职培训研讨会”）与一种旨在降低求职成本的交通补贴措施，来研究这一点。短期内，这两种干预措施都对找到正式工作的可能性产生了积极的影响。培训研讨会还增加了获得无固定期限合同的稳定工作的可能性。四年后，培训研讨会的收益、工作满意度和就业持续时间都有所提升，而交通补贴的效果则已经消失。这些收益主要集中在对劳动力市场状况通常较差的个体身上。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，年轻人拥有雇主难以观察到的宝贵技能。将这些技能显性化所带来的收益远远超过了干预措施的成本。

abstract.text: This article studies the introduction of an EU-wide emission standard on the automobile market. Using panel data from 1998 to 2011, I find that firms decreased emission ratings by 14%. Firms use technology adoption and gaming of emission tests to decrease emissions, rather than shifting the sales mix or downsizing. I find that the standard missed its emission target, and from estimating a structural model, I find that the standard was not welfare improving. The political environment in the EU shaped the design and weak enforcement and resulted in firms’ choices for abatement by technology adoption and gaming.

10.1093/restud/rdaa058.abstractZh: 本文研究了欧盟范围内汽车市场排放标准的实施情况。通过1998至2011年的面板数据分析，我发现企业排放评级降低了14%。企业通过技术采用和操纵排放测试来减少排放，而非调整销售策略或缩减规模。研究还发现，该标准未能实现其排放目标，并通过结构模型分析表明，该标准并未带来福利改善。欧盟的政治环境影响了标准的设计，且执法力度不足，导致企业选择通过技术采用和操纵排放测试来减少排放。

abstract.text: Traditional banking is built on four pillars: small and medium enterprise lending, insured deposit taking, access to lender of last resort (LOLR), and prudential supervision. This article unveils the logic of the quadrilogy by showing that it emerges naturally as an equilibrium outcome in a game between banks and the government. A key insight is that regulation and public insurance services (LOLR, deposit insurance) are complementary. The model also shows how prudential regulation must adjust to the emergence of shadow banking and rationalizes structural remedies to counter bogus liquidity hoarding and financial contagion: ring-fencing between regulated and shadow banking and the sharing of liquidity in centralized platforms.

10.1093/restud/rdaa059.abstractZh: 传统银行体系建立在四个支柱之上：中小企业贷款、保险性存款吸收、获得最后贷款人服务，以及审慎监管。本文揭示了这一四重关系的逻辑，指出它是在银行与政府之间的博弈中自然形成的均衡结果。一个关键的见解是，监管与公共保险服务（如最后贷款人机制和存款保险）是互补的。该模型还展示了审慎监管如何适应影子银行的出现，并合理化了对抗虚假流动性囤积和金融传染的结构性措施：在受监管银行和影子银行之间建立隔离机制，以及在集中平台中共享流动性。

abstract.text: Communication is integral to organizations and yet field evidence on the relation between communication and worker productivity remains scarce. We argue that a core role of communication is to transmit information that helps co-workers do their job better. We build a simple model in which workers choose the amount of communication by trading off this benefit against the time cost incurred by the sender, and use it to derive a set of empirical predictions. We then exploit a natural experiment in an organization where problems arrive and must be sequentially dealt with by two workers. For exogenous reasons, the first worker can sometimes communicate face-to-face with their colleague. Consistently with the predictions of our model, we find that: (1) the second worker works faster (at the cost of the first worker having less time to deal with incoming problems) when face-to-face communication is possible, (2) this effect is stronger when the second worker is busier and for homogenous and closely located teams, and (3) the (career) incentives of workers determine how much they communicate with their colleagues. We also find that workers partially internalise social outcomes in their communication decisions. Our findings illustrate how workers in teams adjust the amount of mutual communication to its costs and benefits.

10.1093/restud/rdaa060.abstractZh: 沟通是组织不可或缺的一部分，然而关于沟通与员工生产力之间关系的实证研究仍然十分有限。我们认为，沟通的核心作用在于传递有助于同事更好地完成工作的信息。我们构建了一个简单的模型，其中员工通过权衡这种好处与发送者所承担的时间成本来选择沟通量，并利用该模型得出一系列实证预测。随后，我们在某组织中开展了一项自然实验，观察两个员工如何依次处理问题。由于某些外部因素，第一个员工有时可以与同事进行面对面沟通。与模型预测一致，我们发现：(1)当可以进行面对面沟通时，第二个员工的工作效率会更高（但第一个员工处理新问题的时间会减少）；(2)当第二个员工工作更忙，且团队成员同质且位置相近时，这种效应更为明显；(3)员工的职业激励因素决定了他们与同事的沟通程度。我们还发现，员工在沟通决策中部分地将社会结果内部化。我们的研究说明了团队中的员工如何根据沟通的成本和收益来调整相互沟通的频率。

abstract.text: This article introduces a general equilibrium model of endogenous technical change through basic and applied research. Basic research differs from applied research in the nature and the magnitude of the generated spillovers. We propose a novel way of empirically identifying these spillovers and embed them in a framework with private firms and a public research sector. After characterizing the equilibrium, we estimate our model using micro-level data on research expenditures by French firms. Our key finding is that uniform research subsidies can accentuate the dynamic misallocation in the economy by oversubsidizing applied research. Policies geared towards public basic research and its interaction with the private sector are significantly welfare-improving.

10.1093/restud/rdaa061.abstractZh: 本文通过基础研究和应用研究，介绍了一种内生技术变革的一般均衡模型。基础研究与应用研究在产生的溢出效应的性质和规模上有所不同。我们提出了一种实证识别这些溢出效应的新方法，并将它们纳入一个包含私人企业和公共研究部门的框架中。在描述了均衡状态之后，我们使用法国企业研究支出的微观数据来估计我们的模型。我们的主要发现是，统一的研究补贴会通过过度补贴应用研究，加剧经济中的动态资源配置不均现象。针对公共基础研究及其与私营部门互动的政策，能够显著改善福利状况。

abstract.text: We examine how many and what kind of firms ultimately rely on foreign inputs, sell to foreign markets, and are affected by trade shocks. To capture that firms can trade indirectly by buying from or selling to domestic firms that import or export, we use Belgian data with information on both domestic firm-to-firm sales and foreign trade transactions. We find that most firms use a lot of foreign inputs, but only a small number of firms show that dependence through direct imports. While direct exporters are rare, a majority of firms are indirectly exporting. In most firms, however, indirect export is quantitatively modest, and sales at home are the key source of revenue. We show that what matters for the transmission of foreign demand shocks to a firm’s revenue is how much the firm ultimately sells to foreign markets, not whether these sales are from direct or indirect export.

10.1093/restud/rdaa062.abstractZh: 我们研究了究竟有多少以及哪些类型的企业最终依赖外国投入、向外国市场销售，并受到贸易冲击的影响。为了捕捉企业通过向国内进口或出口的企业购买或销售来间接进行贸易的情况，我们使用了比利时数据，这些数据包含了国内企业之间的销售情况以及对外贸易交易的信息。我们发现，大多数企业大量依赖外国投入，但只有少数企业通过直接进口表现出这种依赖性。虽然直接出口的企业很少，但大多数企业都在进行间接出口。然而，在大多数企业中，间接出口的数量相当有限，而国内销售仍然是收入的主要来源。我们指出，对于外国需求冲击对企业收入的影响而言，关键在于企业最终向外国市场销售的数量，而不是这些销售是通过直接出口还是间接出口实现的。

abstract.text: Strategies of players in a population are updated according to the behavioural rules of agents, where each agent is a player or a coalition of players. It is known that classic results on the stochastic stability of conventions are due to an asymmetry property of the strategy updating process. We show that asymmetry can be defined at the level of the behavioural rule and that asymmetric rules can be mixed and matched whilst retaining asymmetry of the aggregate process. Specifically, we show robustness of asymmetry to heterogeneity within an agent (Alice follows different rules at different times); heterogeneity between agents (Alice and Bob follow different rules); and heterogeneity in the timing of strategy updating. These results greatly expand and convexify the domain of behavioural rules for which results on the stochastic stability of conventions are known.

10.1093/restud/rdaa063.abstractZh: 玩家在群体中的策略会根据代理人的行为规则进行更新，每个代理人都是一名玩家或一组玩家。众所周知，关于惯例的随机稳定性的经典研究结果源于策略更新过程的不对称性。我们证明了可以在行为规则层面定义这种不对称性，并且可以在保持整体过程不对称性的同时，混合和搭配不同的不对称规则。具体来说，我们展示了不对称性对代理人内部异质性（如爱丽丝在不同时间遵循不同的规则）的鲁棒性；对代理人之间的异质性（如爱丽丝和鲍勃遵循不同的规则）的鲁棒性；以及对策略更新时机异质性的鲁棒性。这些结果极大地扩展和凸化了已知关于惯例随机稳定性结果的的行为规则领域。

abstract.text: We explain how the common practice of size-discovery trade detracts from overall financial market efficiency. At each of a series of size-discovery sessions, traders report their desired trades, generating allocations of the asset and cash that rely on the most recent exchange price. Traders can thus mitigate exchange price impacts by waiting for size-discovery sessions. This waiting causes socially costly delays in the rebalancing of asset positions across traders. As the frequency of size-discovery sessions is increased, exchange market depth is further lowered by the traders’ reduced incentive to bid aggressively on the exchange, further delaying the rebalancing of positions, and more than offsetting the gains from trade that occur at each of the size-discovery sessions.

10.1093/restud/rdaa064.abstractZh: 我们解释了规模发现交易这一常见做法如何降低整体金融市场的效率。在一系列规模发现会议中，交易者会报告他们希望进行的交易，从而根据最新的交易价格分配资产与现金。交易者可以通过等待规模发现会议来减轻交易价格的影响。但这种等待会导致交易者之间重新平衡资产头寸时出现社会成本较高的延迟。随着规模发现会议的频率增加，由于交易者减少了对交易市场的积极出价动机，交易所的市场深度进一步降低，从而进一步延迟了头寸的重新平衡过程，这抵消了每次规模发现会议中发生的交易带来的收益。

abstract.text: An agent may privately learn which aspects of his job are more important by shirking on some of them, and use that information to shirk more effectively in the future. In a model of long-term employment relationship, we characterize the optimal relational contract in the presence of such learning-by-shirking and highlight how the performance measurement system can be managed to sharpen incentives. Two related policies are studied: intermittent replacement of existing measures, and adoption of new ones. In spite of the learning-by-shirking effect, the optimal contract is stationary, and may involve stochastic replacement/adoption policies that dilute the agent’s information rents from learning how to game the system.

10.1093/restud/rdaa065.abstractZh: 代理人可以通过对某些任务敷衍了事来私下了解哪些工作方面更为重要，并利用这些信息在未来更有效地敷衍工作。在一个长期雇佣关系的模型中，我们描述了在这种“通过敷衍学习”现象存在的情况下最优关系契约的特点，并强调了如何管理绩效评估系统以强化激励措施。我们研究了两种相关的政策：间歇性替换现有评估方式，以及采用新的评估方式。尽管存在通过敷衍学习的影响，最优契约仍然是稳定的，并且可能涉及随机性的替换/采用政策，这些政策会稀释代理人从学习如何操纵系统中获得的信息租金。

abstract.text: In most of the developed world, skilled women marry at a lower rate than less skilled ones. We document heterogeneity across countries in how the marriage gap between skilled and unskilled women has evolved over time. As labour market opportunities for women have improved, the marriage gap has been growing in some countries but shrinking in others. We discuss the comparative statics of a theoretical model in which the (negative) social attitudes toward working women might contribute to the relatively lower marriage rate of skilled women and might also induce a non-monotonic relationship between their labour market prospects and their marriage outcomes. The model delivers predictions about how the skilled–unskilled marriage gap should react to changes in labour market opportunities across economies with more or less conservative attitudes toward working women. We verify the key predictions of this model in a panel of 26 developed countries, as well as in a panel of U.S. states.

10.1093/restud/rdaa066.abstractZh: 在大部分发达国家，技术熟练的女性结婚率低于技术不熟练的女性。我们记录了各国在技术熟练与非技术熟练女性之间的婚姻差距随时间演变的情况。随着女性在劳动力市场中的机会增加，某些国家的婚姻差距有所扩大，而在其他国家则有所缩小。我们讨论了一个理论模型的比较静态分析，该模型认为，对职业女性的负面社会态度可能导致技术熟练女性的结婚率相对较低，并且可能使她们在劳动力市场前景与婚姻结果之间产生非单调关系。该模型预测了技术熟练与非技术熟练女性之间的婚姻差距如何响应不同经济体中劳动力市场机会的变化，这些经济体对职业女性的态度可能更为保守或更为开放。我们在26个发达国家的面板数据以及美国各州的面板数据中验证了该模型的关键预测。

abstract.text: A long-standing question about consumer behaviour is whether individuals’ observed purchase decisions satisfy the revealed preference (RP) axioms of the utility maximization theory (UMT). Researchers using survey or experimental panel data sets on prices and consumption to answer this question face the well-known problem of measurement error. We show that ignoring measurement error in the RP approach may lead to overrejection of the UMT. To solve this problem, we propose a new statistical RP framework for consumption panel data sets that allows for testing the UMT in the presence of measurement error. Our test is applicable to all consumer models that can be characterized by their first-order conditions. Our approach is non-parametric, allows for unrestricted heterogeneity in preferences and requires only a centring condition on measurement error. We develop two applications that provide new evidence about the UMT. First, we find support in a survey data set for the dynamic and time-consistent UMT in single-individual households, in the presence of nonclassical measurement error in consumption. In the second application, we cannot reject the static UMT in a widely used experimental data set in which measurement error in prices is assumed to be the result of price misperception due to the experimental design. The first finding stands in contrast to the conclusions drawn from the deterministic RP test of Browning (1989, International Economic Review, 979–992). The second finding reverses the conclusions drawn from the deterministic RP test of Afriat (1967, International Economic Review, 8, 6–77) and Varian (1982, Econometrica, 945–973).

10.1093/restud/rdaa067.abstractZh: 关于消费者行为的一个长期问题是，个体观察到的购买决策是否满足效用最大化理论中的揭示偏好公理。使用调查或实验面板数据来回答这个问题的人们面临着众所周知的测量误差问题。我们指出，在揭示偏好方法中忽略测量误差可能导致对效用最大化理论的过度拒绝。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的统计揭示偏好框架，该框架允许在存在测量误差的情况下测试效用最大化理论。我们的测试适用于所有可以通过一阶条件来描述的消费者模型。我们的方法是非参数的，允许偏好中的无限多样性，并且只需要对测量误差进行中心化条件的要求。我们提出了两个应用案例，为效用最大化理论提供了新的证据。首先，我们在一项调查数据中发现了在存在非经典测量误差的情况下，单个家庭中的动态且时间一致的效用最大化理论得到了支持。在第二个应用中，我们无法在一项广泛使用的实验数据集中拒绝静态效用最大化理论，在该数据集中，假设价格的测量误差是由于实验设计导致的价格误解。第一个发现与Browning（1989年，《国际经济评论》，979-992页）从确定性揭示偏好测试中得出的结论相反。第二个发现则反驳了Afriat（1967年，《国际经济评论》，8, 6-77页）和Varian（1982年，《经济计量学》，945-973页）从确定性揭示偏好测试中得出的结论。

abstract.text: We study competitive equilibria in a signalling economy with heterogeneously informed buyers. In terms of the classic Spence (1973, The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 87, 355—374) model of job market signalling, firms have access to direct but imperfect information about worker types, in addition to observing their education. Firms can be ranked according to the quality of their information, i.e., their expertise. In equilibrium, some high-type workers forgo signalling and are hired by better informed firms, which make positive profits. Workers’ education decisions and firms’ use of their expertise are strategic complements, allowing for multiple equilibria that can be Pareto ranked. We characterize wage dispersion and the extent of signalling as a function of the distribution of expertise among firms. Our model can also be applied to a variety of other signalling problems, including securitization, corporate financial structure, insurance markets, or dividend policy.

10.1093/restud/rdaa068.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有异质信息购买者的信号传递经济中的竞争均衡问题。根据经典的Spence（1973年，《经济学季刊》，87卷，355-374页）关于就业市场信号传递的模型，企业除了能够了解工人的教育背景外，还能直接但不完全地了解工人的类型。企业可以根据其信息的质量来排序，即其专业知识水平。在均衡状态下，一些高技能工人选择不进行信号传递，从而被信息更充分的企业雇佣，这些企业因此获得正收益。工人的教育决策与企业对其专业知识的利用是战略性的互补关系，这允许存在多个帕累托最优均衡。我们描述了工资差异以及信号传递程度如何随着企业间专业知识分布的变化而变化。我们的模型还可以应用于其他多种信号传递问题，包括证券化、企业财务结构、保险市场或股息政策等。

abstract.text: This article develops a theory of the balance sheet channel that places a central emphasis on the liquidity of secondary markets for macro-contingent claims. We show that the presence of dispersed information and imperfect competition in secondary markets, interacted with financial constraints, results in mispricing and misallocation of aggregate risk, distorts aggregate investment, and exacerbates asset price and output volatility. The magnitude of balance sheet amplification effects becomes endogenously tied to the severity of market frictions, which likely vary over time and across economies. The laissez-faire equilibrium is constrained inefficient due to a novel externality originating from rent-extracting behaviour of agents in secondary markets. Optimal corrective policy boosts secondary market liquidity through subsidies to trade in macro-contingent claims, which enhances aggregate risk-sharing and stabilizes the business cycle.

10.1093/restud/rdaa069.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种资产负债表渠道理论，该理论重点关注宏观不确定性索赔的二级市场的流动性。我们指出，二级市场中分散的信息和不完全竞争的存在，加上金融约束，会导致整体风险的错误定价和错配，从而扭曲整体投资，并加剧资产价格和产出波动。资产负债表放大效应的程度与市场摩擦的严重程度密切相关，而市场摩擦的严重程度可能会随时间以及不同经济体间发生变化。由于二级市场中代理人的租金提取行为所带来的新型外部性，自由放任的均衡是低效的。通过补贴宏观不确定性索赔的交易，可以提升二级市场的流动性，从而增强整体风险分担，并稳定经济周期。

abstract.text: Performance evaluation (“rating”) systems not only provide information to users but also motivate the rated worker. This article solves for the optimal (effort-maximizing) rating within the standard career concerns framework. We prove that this rating is a linear function of past observations. The rating, however, is not a Markov process, but rather the sum of two Markov processes. We show how it combines information of different types and vintages. An increase in effort may adversely affect some (but not all) future ratings.

10.1093/restud/rdaa070.abstractZh: 绩效评估（“评分”）系统不仅为用户提供信息，还能激励被评定的员工。本文在标准的职业考量框架下，求解了最优的、能够最大化员工努力程度的评分方法。我们证明，这种评分是过去观察结果的线性函数。然而，这种评分并非马尔可夫过程，而是由两个马尔可夫过程相加而成。我们展示了它是如何结合不同类型及年代的信息的。增加努力可能会对某些（但不是所有）未来的评分产生不利影响。

abstract.text: This article develops a tractable theoretical framework for the Top Trading Cycles (TTC) mechanism for school choice that allows quantifying welfare and optimizing policy decisions. We compute welfare for TTC and Deferred Acceptance (DA) under different priority structures and find that the choice of priorities can have larger welfare implications than the choice of mechanism. We solve for the welfare-maximizing distributions of school quality for parametrized economies and find that optimal investment decisions can be very different under TTC and DA. Our framework relies on a novel characterization of the TTC assignment in terms of a cutoff for each pair of schools. These cutoffs parallel prices in competitive equilibrium, with students’ priorities serving the role of endowments. We show that these cutoffs can be computed directly from the distribution of preferences and priorities in a continuum model and derive closed-form solutions and comparative statics for parameterized settings. The TTC cutoffs not only clarify the role of priorities in determining the TTC assignment but also demonstrate that TTC is more complicated than DA.

10.1093/restud/rdaa071.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个可行的理论框架，用于描述“顶级交易周期”机制在择校中的应用，该机制能够量化福利并优化政策决策。我们针对不同的优先级结构，计算了“顶级交易周期”和“延期接受”机制下的福利情况，发现优先级的选择对福利的影响可能比机制的选择更为显著。我们为参数化经济模型求解了使福利最大化的学校质量分布，并发现“顶级交易周期”和“延期接受”机制下的最优投资决策可能存在显著差异。我们的框架基于一种新颖的“顶级交易周期”分配方法，该方法通过每对学校之间的临界值来表征分配过程。这些临界值类似于竞争均衡中的价格，而学生的优先级则起到了资源分配的作用。我们证明，这些临界值可以直接从连续模型中的偏好和优先级分布计算得出，并为参数化设置推导出了封闭形式的解和比较静态结果。“顶级交易周期”的临界值不仅阐明了优先级在决定分配过程中的作用，还表明“顶级交易周期”机制比“延期接受”机制更为复杂。

abstract.text: This article examines the impact of a property rights reform in rural China that allowed farmers to lease out their land. We find the reform led to increases in land rental activity in rural households. Our results indicate that the formalization of leasing rights resulted in a redistribution of land toward more-productive farmers. Consequently, output and aggregate productivity increased by 8$\%$ and 10$\%$, respectively. We also find that the reform increased the responsiveness of land allocation across crops to changes in crop prices.

10.1093/restud/rdaa072.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在中国农村实施的一项产权改革的影响，该改革允许农民出租土地。我们发现，这一改革导致农村家庭的土地租赁活动增加。研究结果表明，租赁权利的正式化使得土地重新分配向更富生产力的农民倾斜。因此，产出和总体生产率分别增加了8%和10%。我们还发现，这一改革提高了土地分配对农作物价格变化的响应能力。

abstract.text: This article investigates stable and efficient networks in the context of risk sharing, when it is costly to establish and maintain relationships that facilitate risk sharing. We find a novel trade-off between efficiency and equality: the most stable efficient networks also generate the most inequality. We then suppose that individuals can be split into groups, assuming that incomes across groups are less correlated than within a group but relationships across groups are more costly to form. The tension between efficiency and equality extends to these correlated income structures. More-central agents have stronger incentives to form across-group links, reaffirming the efficiency benefits of having highly central agents. Our results are robust to many extensions. In general, endogenously formed networks in the risk-sharing context tend to exhibit highly asymmetric structures, which can lead to stark inequalities in consumption levels.

10.1093/restud/rdaa073.abstractZh: 本文研究了在风险共享背景下稳定且高效的网络结构，尤其是在建立和维护有助于风险共享的关系成本高昂的情况下。我们发现效率与平等之间存在一种新颖的权衡：最稳定且高效的网络往往也伴随着最大的不平等。接着，我们假设个体可以被划分为不同的群体，并假设各群体之间的收入相关性低于群体内部，但群体间关系的建立成本更高。这种效率与平等之间的矛盾也适用于这种相关性的收入结构。更中心化的个体有更强的动机去建立跨群体的联系，这再次证明了拥有高度中心化个体的效率优势。我们的研究结果在多种扩展情况下仍然成立。总体而言，在风险共享背景下形成的网络往往呈现出高度不对称的结构，这可能导致消费水平上的严重不平等。

abstract.text: We examine a determinant of cultural persistence that has emerged from a class of models in evolutionary anthropology: the similarity of the environment across generations. Within these models, when the environment is more stable across generations, the traits that have evolved up to the previous generation are more likely to be suitable for the current generation. In equilibrium, a greater value is placed on tradition and there is greater cultural persistence. We test this hypothesis by measuring the variability of climatic measures across 20-year generations from 500 to 1900. Employing a variety of tests that use different samples and empirical strategies, we find that populations with ancestors who lived in environments with more cross-generational instability place less importance on maintaining tradition today and exhibit less cultural persistence.

10.1093/restud/rdaa074.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由进化人类学模型提出的文化持久性决定因素：世代间环境的相似性。在这些模型中，当环境在世代间更加稳定时，前一代演化出的特征更有可能适用于当前一代。在均衡状态下，人们对传统的重视程度更高，文化持久性也更强。我们通过测量从500年到1900年这20代人的气候变化差异来验证这一假设。采用多种测试方法，结合不同的样本和实证策略，我们发现那些祖先生活在世代间环境更加不稳定的群体，今天对保持传统的重视程度较低，文化持久性也较弱。

abstract.text: We examine intergenerational mobility in the very long run, across generations that are six centuries apart. We exploit a unique dataset containing detailed information at the individual level for all people living in the Italian city of Florence in 1427. These individuals have been associated, using their surnames, with their pseudo-descendants living in Florence in 2011. We find that long-run earnings elasticity is about 0.04; we also find an even stronger role for real wealth inheritance and evidence of persistence in belonging to certain elite occupations. Our results are confirmed when we account for the quality of the pseudo-links and when we address the potential selectivity bias behind the matching process. Finally, we frame our results within the existing evidence and argue that the quasi-immobility of preindustrial society and the existence of multigenerational effects might explain the long-lasting effects of ancestors’ socioeconomic status.

10.1093/restud/rdaa075.abstractZh: 我们研究了跨代际流动性在非常长期上的表现，涉及相隔六个世纪的不同世代。我们利用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集包含了1427年居住在意大利佛罗伦萨的每个人的详细信息。这些个体通过他们的姓氏与2011年居住在佛罗伦萨的伪后代建立了关联。我们发现，长期收入弹性约为0.04；我们还发现，实际财富继承在解释代际流动性方面起着更重要的作用，同时也有证据表明某些精英职业的归属具有持久性。当我们考虑伪关联的质量以及匹配过程背后的潜在选择性偏差时，我们的研究结果得到了进一步确认。最后，我们将我们的研究结果置于现有证据框架内，认为前工业社会的准固定性以及多代际效应的存在，可能解释了祖先社会经济地位对代际流动性的长期影响。

abstract.text: We use survey questions about spending in hypothetical scenarios to investigate features of propensities to consume that are useful for distinguishing between consumption theories. We find that (1) responses to unanticipated gains are vastly heterogeneous (either zero or substantially positive); (2) responses increase in the size of the gain, driven by the extensive margin of spending adjustments; (3) responses to losses are much larger and more widespread than responses to gains; and (4) even those with large responses to gains do not respond to news about future gains. These four findings suggest that limited access to disposable resources, and frictions in adjusting consumption, are important determinants of consumption behaviour. We also find that (5) households do not respond to the offer of a one-year interest-free loan, suggesting that this is not a consequence of short-term credit constraints; and (6) people do cut spending in response to news about future losses, suggesting that neither is this a consequence of myopia. A calibrated precautionary savings model with utility costs of changing consumption, and a sufficient fraction of low-wealth households, can account for these features of propensities to consume on both the extensive and intensive margins.

10.1093/restud/rdaa076.abstractZh: 我们通过调查关于假设情景下的消费行为，来研究有助于区分不同消费理论的消费倾向特征。我们发现：(1)对于未预料到的收益，人们的反应差异很大，可能是零或显著为正；(2)收益的大小会影响人们的反应，这种影响由消费的广泛调整机制所驱动；(3)对于损失的反应比对于收益的反应更为强烈且更为普遍；(4)即使那些对收益反应强烈的人，也不会对未来收益的消息做出反应。这四项发现表明，可支配资源的有限性以及调整消费的摩擦是消费行为的重要决定因素。我们还发现：(5)家庭不会对一年无息贷款的提议做出反应，这表明这不是短期信贷约束的结果；(6)人们确实会在听到未来损失的消息后减少消费，这表明这也不是短视行为的后果。一个经过校准的预防性储蓄模型，考虑到改变消费的效用成本，以及一定比例的低财富家庭，可以解释这些消费倾向在广泛和密集层面的特征。

abstract.text: This article develops a search and matching model of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and uses it to evaluate the implications of merger activity for aggregate economic outcomes. The theory is consistent with a rich set of facts on U.S. M&A, including sorting among merging firms, a substantial merger premium and serial acquisition. It provides a sharp link between these facts and the nature of merger gains. At the micro-level, both complementarities between merging firms and productivity improvements of target firms are important in generating gains. At the macro-level, the model suggests a significant beneficial impact of M&A on aggregate outcomes—the contribution to steady state output is 14$\%$ and 4$\%$ for consumption—which occurs through the reallocation of resources across firms and equilibrium effects on firm selection and new entrepreneurship. Nevertheless, the economy is not efficient, suggesting a scope for policy improvements—a simple flat tax on M&A can raise steady state consumption as much as 2$\%$ relative to the laissez-faire equilibrium. In short, the boundaries of the firm can matter for macroeconomic outcomes.

10.1093/restud/rdaa077.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个并购的搜索与匹配模型，并利用该模型来评估并购活动对总体经济结果的影响。该理论与美国并购领域的丰富事实相一致，包括并购企业之间的排序、显著的并购溢价以及连续收购现象。这些事实与并购带来的收益性质之间存在着密切的联系。在微观层面上，并购企业之间的互补性以及目标企业的生产效率提升对于产生收益至关重要。在宏观层面上，该模型表明并购对总体结果具有显著的正面影响——对稳态产出的贡献分别为14%和4%的消费需求——这种影响是通过资源在企业和企业之间的重新分配以及对企业选择和新兴创业活动的均衡效应来实现的。尽管如此，经济并未达到最优状态，这表明有改进政策的可能性——对并购征收简单的统一税可以将稳态消费提高2%，相对于自由放任的均衡状态而言。简而言之，企业的边界对宏观经济结果具有重要影响。

abstract.text: This article tests for bias in consumer lending using administrative data from a high-cost lender in the U.K. We motivate our analysis using a new principal-agent model of bias where loan examiners are incentivized to maximize a short-term outcome, not long-term profits, leading to bias against illiquid applicants at the margin of loan decisions. We identify the profitability of marginal applicants using the quasi-random assignment of loan examiners, finding significant bias against immigrant and older applicants when using the firm’s preferred measure of long-run profits but not when using the short-run measure used to evaluate examiner performance. In this case, market incentives based on characteristics that vary across groups lead to inefficient group-based bias.

10.1093/restud/rdaa078.abstractZh: 本文利用英国一家高成本贷款机构的行政数据，检验了消费贷款中的偏见现象。我们采用一种新的委托-代理模型来解释这一现象，即贷款审查员被激励去追求短期收益而非长期利润，这导致他们在贷款决策过程中对流动性较差的申请人存在偏见。我们通过随机分配贷款审查员的方式，评估边际申请人的盈利能力，发现使用该公司偏爱的长期利润指标时，对移民和老年申请人的偏见显著，但使用评估审查员绩效的短期指标时则不存在这种偏见。在这种情况下，基于不同群体特征的市场激励导致了基于群体的低效偏见。

abstract.text: We formalize the idea that house price changes may drive rational waves of optimism and pessimism in the economy. In our model, a house price increase caused by aggregate disturbances may be misinterpreted as a sign of higher local permanent income, leading households to demand more consumption and housing. Higher demand reinforces the initial price increase in an amplification loop that drives comovement in output, labour, residential investment, land prices, and house prices even in response to aggregate supply shocks. The qualitative implications of our otherwise frictionless model are consistent with observed business cycles and it can explain the economic impact of apparently autonomous changes in sentiment without resorting to non-fundamental shocks or nominal rigidity.

10.1093/restud/rdaa079.abstractZh: 我们将房价变动可能引发经济中理性乐观与悲观情绪的观点进行了形式化描述。在我们的模型中，由总体扰动引起的房价上涨可能会被误认为是当地永久性收入增加的迹象，从而导致家庭增加消费和住房需求。较高的需求会强化初始的房价上涨，形成一个放大循环，进而推动产出、劳动力、住宅投资、土地价格以及房价的共同变动，即使是在面对总供给冲击的情况下也是如此。我们这个原本无摩擦的模型所揭示的定性结论与观察到的商业周期现象一致，它能够解释那些看似由情绪变化引起的经济影响，而无需依赖非基本性冲击或名义刚性。

abstract.text: Most fiscal rules can be overridden by consensus. We show that this does not make them ineffectual. Since fiscal rules determine the outside option in case of disagreement, the opposition uses them as “bargaining chips” to obtain spending concessions. We show that under some conditions this political bargain mitigates the debt-accumulation problem. We analyse various rules and find that when political polarization is high, harsh fiscal rules (e.g. government shutdown) maximize the opposition’s bargaining power and lead to lower debt accumulation. When polarization is low, less strict fiscal limits (e.g. balanced-budget rule) are preferable. Moreover, we find that the optimal fiscal rules could arise in equilibrium by negotiation. Finally, by insuring against power fluctuations, negotiable rules yield higher welfare than hard ones.

10.1093/restud/rdaa080.abstractZh: 大多数财政规则可以通过共识被推翻。我们表明，这并不会使这些规则失去效力。由于财政规则在分歧时决定了外部选择，反对派会将这些规则作为“谈判筹码”以获得支出上的让步。我们发现在某些条件下，这种政治谈判能够缓解债务积累问题。我们分析了各种规则，发现当政治两极分化严重时，严格的财政规则（例如政府停摆）会最大化反对派的谈判力量，从而导致较低的债务积累。而当两极分化较低时，较宽松的财政限制（例如预算平衡规则）更为合适。此外，我们发现最优的财政规则可以通过谈判在均衡状态下形成。最后，通过防范权力波动，可协商的规则能够带来更高的福利。

abstract.text: The growth of the “gig” economy generates worker flexibility that, some have speculated, will favour women. We explore this by examining labour supply choices and earnings among more than a million rideshare drivers on Uber in the U.S. We document a roughly 7% gender earnings gap amongst drivers. We show that this gap can be entirely attributed to three factors: experience on the platform (learning-by-doing), preferences and constraints over where to work (driven largely by where drivers live and, to a lesser extent, safety), and preferences for driving speed. We do not find that men and women are differentially affected by a taste for specific hours, a return to within-week work intensity, or customer discrimination. Our results suggest that, in a “gig” economy setting with no gender discrimination and highly flexible labour markets, women’s relatively high opportunity cost of non-paid-work time and gender-based differences in preferences and constraints can sustain a gender pay gap.

10.1093/restud/rdaa081.abstractZh: “零工”经济的增长带来了劳动力的灵活性，一些人推测这可能会有利于女性。我们通过研究美国Uber平台上超过一百万零工司机的工作供应选择和收入情况来探讨这一问题。我们发现司机之间的性别收入差距约为7%。我们认为这一差距主要归因于三个因素：在平台上积累的经验（通过实践学习）、对工作地点的偏好和限制（主要由司机居住地决定，其次才是安全性），以及对驾驶速度的偏好。我们没有发现男性和女性对特定工作时间的偏好、对一周内工作强度的回归，或客户歧视对性别收入差距的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在不存在性别歧视且劳动力市场高度灵活的情况下，女性因无偿工作时间而面临较高的机会成本，以及基于性别的偏好和限制差异，可能会持续存在性别工资差距。

abstract.text: In this article, we quantify the effects of nurses on health care delivery and patient health in the context of an unintended and policy-induced nurse shortage. Our empirical strategy takes advantage of a parental-leave program in Denmark, which offered any parent the opportunity to take up to one year’s absence per child aged 0–8. Combining the policy variation with administrative employer–employee match data, we document substantial program take-up among nurses, who could not be replaced on net despite public education and immigration expansion efforts to mitigate the employment effects. We find that the parental leave program reduced hospital and nursing home nurse employment by 15% and 10%, respectively. Using detailed patient health records, we find detrimental effects on hospital-care delivery as indicated by a large increase in 30-day readmission rates among acute myocardial infarction patients. We find no evidence for an increase in hospital mortality. In nursing homes, we estimate a large increase in mortality.

10.1093/restud/rdaa082.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们量化了护士在政策导致的护士短缺背景下对医疗保健提供和患者健康的影响。我们的实证策略利用了丹麦的一项育儿假计划，该计划为每位0-8岁的儿童提供了最多一年的休假机会。结合政策差异与雇主与员工之间的匹配数据，我们发现护士对这一计划的参与度很高，尽管采取了公共教育和移民政策来缓解就业影响，但护士在净数量上仍无法被替代。我们发现，育儿假计划使医院和护理院的护士就业人数分别减少了15%和10%。通过详细的患者健康记录，我们发现医院护理服务的提供受到了负面影响，急性心肌梗塞患者的30天再入院率显著上升。我们没有发现医院死亡率增加的证据。在护理院中，我们估计死亡率大幅增加。

abstract.text: In order to share risk, protection buyers trade derivatives with protection sellers. Protection sellers’ actions affect the riskiness of their assets, which can create counterparty risk. Because these actions are unobservable, moral hazard limits risk sharing. To mitigate this problem, privately optimal derivative contracts involve variation margins. When margins are called, protection sellers must liquidate some assets, depressing asset prices. This tightens the incentive constraints of other protection sellers and reduces their ability to provide insurance. Despite this fire-sale externality, equilibrium is information-constrained efficient. Investors, who benefit from buying assets at fire-sale prices, optimally supply insurance against the risk of fire sales.

10.1093/restud/rdaa083.abstractZh: 为了分担风险，保护买方与保护卖方进行衍生品交易。保护卖方的行为会影响其资产的风险性，这可能会引发交易对手风险。由于这些行为难以观察，道德风险限制了风险分担。为了缓解这一问题，私人最优衍生品合约包含保证金制度。当保证金被要求时，保护卖方必须清算部分资产，从而压低资产价格。这进一步限制了其他保护卖方的激励约束，降低了他们提供保险的能力。尽管存在这种“火卖”外部性，均衡仍然是在信息受限的情况下实现的高效状态。从火卖价格中获益的投资者，会最优地提供针对火卖风险的保险。

abstract.text: I consider the aggregate impact of low intermediate input intensity in the agricultural sector of developing countries. In a dynamic general equilibrium model with idiosyncratic shocks, incomplete markets, and subsistence requirements, farmers in developing countries use fewer intermediate inputs because it limits their exposure to uninsurable shocks. The calibrated model implies that Indian agricultural productivity would increase by 16% if markets were complete, driven by quantitatively important increases in both the average real intermediate share and measured TFP through lower misallocation. I then extend the results to consider the importance of risk in other contexts. First, the introduction of insurance decreases cross-country differences in agricultural labour productivity by 14%. Second, scaling the introduction of improved seeds to decrease downside risk reduces inequality by reallocating resources from rich to poor farmers via equilibrium effects. This reallocation substantially increases aggregate productivity relative to what would be expected from extrapolating the partial equilibrium impact.

10.1093/restud/rdaa084.abstractZh: 我研究了发展中国家农业部门低中间投入强度的总体影响。在一个包含特异性冲击、不完全市场以及生存需求的动态一般均衡模型中，发展中国家的农民使用较少的中间投入，因为这限制了他们面临不可保险的冲击的风险。经过校准的模型表明，如果市场是完整的，印度的农业生产力将提高16%，这得益于平均实际中间投入份额和衡量到的全要素生产率均有所提升，从而减少了资源的不合理配置。随后，我将这一结果扩展到其他情境，以考虑风险的重要性。首先，引入保险可以将各国农业劳动生产率的差异减少14%。其次，推广改良种子以减少风险损失，可以通过均衡效应将资源从富裕农民重新分配到贫困农民，从而大幅提高总体生产力，这一效果远超从局部均衡影响推断出的预期。

abstract.text: We study production in advance in a setting where firms first source inventories that remain unobservable to rivals, and then simultaneously set prices. In the unique equilibrium, each firm occasionally holds a sale relative to its reference price, resulting in firms sometimes being left with unsold inventory. In the limit as inventory costs become fully recoverable, the equilibrium converges to an equilibrium of the game where firms only choose prices and produce to order—the associated Bertrand game (examples of which include fully asymmetric clearinghouse models). Thus, away from that limit, our work generalizes Bertrand-type equilibria to production in advance, and challenges the commonly held view associating production in advance with Cournot outcomes. The analysis involves, as an intermediate step, mapping the price-inventory game into an asymmetric all-pay contest with outside options and non-monotonic winning and losing functions. We apply our framework to public policy towards information sharing, mergers, cartels, and taxation.

10.1093/restud/rdaa085.abstractZh: 我们研究了提前生产的情况，其中企业首先采购那些对竞争对手来说不可观测的库存，然后同时设定价格。在唯一的均衡状态下，每个企业偶尔会进行相对于其参考价格的销售，导致有时企业会留下未售出的库存。当库存成本能够完全回收时，均衡会收敛到一种博弈均衡，在这种均衡中，企业只选择价格并按订单生产——这就是相关的伯特兰博弈（例如，完全不对称的清算所模型）。因此，在偏离该极限的情况下，我们的工作将伯特兰型均衡推广到提前生产的情况，并挑战了将提前生产与库诺结果联系起来的普遍观点。分析过程中，我们首先将价格-库存博弈映射到一个具有外部选项和非单调胜负函数的不对称全支付竞赛中。我们将我们的框架应用于关于信息共享、合并、卡特尔和税收的公共政策分析。

abstract.text: Due to the absence of unemployment insurance (UI) choices, the traditional approach to estimating the value of UI is to infer it from the observed consumption response to job loss under some assumption on risk preferences. Exploiting the rich data and unique policy context in Sweden, we propose two alternative approaches that relax this assumption and we implement all three methods on the same sample of workers. The first approach considers the difference in marginal propensity to consume (MPC) when unemployed versus employed, which allows to identify the difference in prices to smooth consumption in the respective states. The second approach exploits UI choices embedded in the Swedish UI system in a Revealed Preference approach. While the drop in consumption expenditures is relatively small ($\sim$13%), we find that the MPC is around 25% higher when unemployed than employed, translating into a marginal value of transfers that is at least $60$% higher when unemployed than employed. This high value of UI is confirmed by our RP estimates and indicates substantial risk aversion given the relatively small drop in consumption expenditures.

10.1093/restud/rdaa086.abstractZh: 由于缺乏失业保险选择，传统上估算失业保险价值的做法是基于对风险偏好的某些假设，从观察到的失业后的消费反应来推断。利用瑞典丰富的数据和独特的政策背景，我们提出了两种替代方法，这些方法放宽了这一假设，并在同一样本工人上实施了所有三种方法。第一种方法考虑了失业与就业时消费边际倾向的差异，这有助于识别价格差异，以平滑相应状态下的消费。第二种方法采用瑞典失业保险系统中的选择数据，采用显示偏好法进行分析。虽然消费支出的下降幅度相对较小（约13%），但我们发现失业时的消费边际倾向比就业时高出约25%，这意味着失业时的转移支付边际价值至少比就业时高出60%。这一较高的失业保险价值得到了我们的显示偏好估计的证实，并表明鉴于消费支出的相对较小下降幅度，存在显著的风险规避现象。

abstract.text: We exploit recent molecular genetics evidence on the genetic basis of arsenic excretion and unique information on family links among respondents living in different environments from a large panel survey to uncover the hidden costs of arsenic poisoning in Bangladesh. We provide for the first time estimates of the effects of the ingestion and retention of inorganic arsenic on direct measures of cognitive and physical capabilities as well as on the schooling attainment, occupational structure, entrepreneurship, and incomes of the rural Bangladesh population. We also provide new estimates of the effects of the consumption of foods grown and cooked in arsenic-contaminated water on individual arsenic concentrations. The estimates are based on arsenic biomarkers obtained from a sample of members of rural households in Bangladesh who are participants in a long-term panel survey following respondents and their coresident household members over a period of 26 years.

10.1093/restud/rdaa087.abstractZh: 我们利用最新的分子遗传学证据来研究砷排泄的遗传基础，并通过大规模面板调查收集不同环境中居民之间的家庭关系信息，以揭示孟加拉国砷中毒的隐性成本。我们首次估算了无机砷的摄入和滞留对孟加拉国农村人口认知和体能能力、教育水平、职业结构、创业能力和收入的影响。我们还估算了在受砷污染的水中种植和烹饪的食物对个体砷浓度的影响。这些估算基于从孟加拉国农村家庭样本中获得的砷生物标志物数据，这些样本是长期面板调查的一部分，对受访者及其核心家庭成员进行了26年的跟踪研究。

abstract.text: Asymmetric information in the marriage market may cause adverse selection and delay marriage if partner quality is revealed over time. Sexual safety is an important but hidden partner attribute, especially in areas where HIV is endemic. A model of positive assortative matching with both observable (attractiveness) and hidden (sexual safety) attributes predicts that removing the asymmetric information about sexual safety accelerates marriage and pregnancy for safe respondents, and more so if they are also attractive. Frequent HIV testing may enable safe people to signal and screen. Consistent with these predictions, we show that a high-frequency, "opt-out" HIV testing intervention changed beliefs about partner's safety and accelerated marriage and pregnancy, increasing the probabilities of marriage and pregnancy by 26 and 27 percent for baseline-unmarried women over 28 months. Estimates are larger for safe and attractive respondents. Conversely, a single-test intervention lacks these effects, consistent with other HIV testing evaluations in the literature. Our findings suggest that an endogenous response to HIV risk may explain why the HIV/AIDS epidemic has coincided with systematic marriage and pregnancy delays.

10.1093/restud/rdaa088.abstractZh: 婚姻市场中信息不对称可能导致不良选择，如果伴侣质量随时间显现，则会导致婚姻推迟。性安全是一个重要但隐藏的伴侣属性，尤其是在HIV流行地区。一个包含可观察（吸引力）和隐藏（性安全）属性的正向选择匹配模型表明，消除性安全方面的信息不对称可以加速安全伴侣的婚姻和怀孕进程，尤其是当他们同时具有吸引力时。频繁的HIV检测可以让安全的人进行信号传递和筛查。与这些预测一致的是，我们发现高频率的“选择退出”式HIV检测干预改变了人们对伴侣安全的看法，并加速了婚姻和怀孕进程，使得基线未婚女性在28个月内结婚和怀孕的概率分别增加了26%和27%。对于安全且有吸引力的伴侣来说，这种影响更为显著。相反，单次检测干预则缺乏这些效果，这与文献中其他HIV检测评估的结果一致。我们的研究结果表明，对HIV风险的内生反应可能解释了为什么HIV/AIDS疫情与系统性婚姻和怀孕延迟同时出现。

abstract.text: This article provides a revealed preference characterisation of quasi-hyperbolic discounting which is designed to be applied to readily available expenditure surveys. We describe necessary and sufficient conditions for the leading forms of the model and also study the consequences of the restrictions on preferences popularly used in empirical lifecycle consumption models. Using data from a household consumption panel dataset, we explore the prevalence of time-inconsistent behaviour. The quasi-hyperbolic model provides a significantly more successful account of behaviour than the alternatives considered. We estimate the joint distribution of time preferences and the distribution of discount functions at various time horizons.

10.1093/restud/rdaa089.abstractZh: 本文对准超线性折扣行为进行了揭示性偏好分析，旨在将其应用于易于获取的消费调查数据。我们描述了该模型主要形式的必要充分条件，并研究了在实证生命周期消费模型中常用的偏好限制所带来的影响。通过家庭消费面板数据集的数据分析，我们探讨了时间不一致行为的普遍性。与现有模型相比，准超线性模型在解释行为方面表现得更为成功。我们估计了时间偏好分布以及不同时间范围内折扣函数分布的综合情况。

abstract.text: Unlike in standard models, decision makers often narrowly bracket and make each decision in isolation. I develop a new approach, which I term narrow thinking, to systematically model narrow bracketing. The definition of narrow thinking is that different decisions are based on different, non-nested, information. As a result, the narrow thinker makes each decision with imperfect knowledge of other decisions and faces difficulties coordinating her multiple decisions. The narrow thinker effectively cares less about her other decisions when making each decision. The main application of narrow thinking is to provide a smooth model of mental accounting without requiring the decision maker to have explicit budgets. My approach generates unique predictions about how the degree of mental accounting depends on expenditure shares and cognitive limitations. It also illustrates how narrow bracketing and mental accounting can be explained by the same underlying friction.

10.1093/restud/rdaa090.abstractZh: 与标准模型不同，决策者往往将每个决策限定在一个狭窄的范围内，并独立地做出决策。我提出了一种新的方法，称之为“狭窄思维”，用于系统地建模这种狭窄的决策方式。狭窄思维的定义是指不同的决策基于不同的、非嵌套的信息。因此，狭窄思维者在做出每个决策时，对其他决策的了解并不完善，并且在协调多个决策时面临困难。在做出每个决策时，狭窄思维者实际上不太关心其他决策。狭窄思维的主要应用是提供一个平滑的心理账户模型，而不需要决策者拥有明确的预算。我的方法能够得出关于心理账户程度如何依赖于支出份额和认知限制的独特预测。它还说明了狭窄的决策方式和心理账户是如何由相同的潜在摩擦所解释的。

abstract.text: In this article, we ask how bankruptcy law affects the financial decisions of corporations and its implications for firm dynamics. According to current U.S. law, firms have two bankruptcy options: Chapter 7 liquidation and Chapter 11 reorganization. Using Compustat data, we first document capital structure and investment decisions of non-bankrupt, Chapter 11, and Chapter 7 firms. Using those data moments, we then estimate parameters of a general equilibrium firm dynamics model with endogenous entry and exit to include both bankruptcy options. Finally, we evaluate a bankruptcy policy change similar to one recommended by the American Bankruptcy Institute that amounts to a “fresh start” for bankrupt firms. We find that changes to the law can have sizable consequences for borrowing costs and capital structure which via selection affects productivity, as well as long run welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdaa091.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了破产法如何影响企业的财务决策以及其对企业动态的影响。根据当前的美国法律，企业有两种破产选择：第七章清算和第十一章重组。利用Compustat数据，我们首先记录了非破产企业、第十一章重组企业和第七章重组企业的资本结构和投资决策。然后，利用这些数据，我们估计了一个包含内生进入和退出机制的一般均衡企业动态模型的参数，以涵盖两种破产选择。最后，我们评估了一项类似于美国破产协会推荐的破产政策变更，即让破产企业“重新开始”。我们发现，法律的变化会对借贷成本和资本结构产生重大影响，而这些影响又会通过选择效应影响生产率以及长期福利。

abstract.text: Procuring an innovation involves motivating a research effort to generate a new idea and then implementing that idea efficiently. If research efforts are unverifiable and implementation costs are private information, a trade-off arises between the two objectives. The optimal mechanism resolves the trade-off via two instruments: a cash prize and a follow-on contract. It primarily uses the latter, by favouring the innovator at the implementation stage when the value of the innovation is above a certain threshold and handicapping the innovator when the value of the innovation is below that threshold. A cash prize is employed as a supplementary incentive only when the value of innovation is sufficiently high. These features are consistent with current practices in the procurement of innovation and the management of unsolicited proposals.

10.1093/restud/rdaa092.abstractZh: 获取创新涉及激励研究活动以产生新想法，然后高效地实施该想法。如果研究活动无法验证，且实施成本属于私人信息，那么两个目标之间就会出现权衡。最优机制通过两种手段来解决这种权衡：现金奖励和后续合同。该机制主要使用后者，即在创新价值超过一定阈值时支持创新者，而在创新价值低于该阈值时限制创新者的行为。只有在创新价值足够高时，才会采用现金奖励作为补充激励。这些特点与当前在获取创新以及管理非邀约提案方面的实践是一致的。

abstract.text: In the standard herding model, privately informed individuals sequentially see prior actions and then act. An identical action herd eventually starts and public beliefs tend to “cascade sets” where social learning stops. What behaviour is socially efficient when actions ignore informational externalities? We characterize the outcome that maximizes the discounted sum of utilities. Our four key findings are: (1) cascade sets shrink but do not vanish, and herding should occur but less readily as greater weight is attached to posterity. (2) An optimal mechanism rewards individuals mimicked by their successor. (3) Cascades cannot start after period one under a signal log-concavity condition. (4) Given this condition, efficient behaviour is contrarian, leaning against the myopically more popular actions in every period. We make two technical contributions: as value functions with learning are not smooth, we use monotone comparative statics under uncertainty to deduce optimal dynamic behaviour. We also adapt dynamic pivot mechanisms to Bayesian learning.

10.1093/restud/rdab001.abstractZh: 在标准的羊群模型中，私人知情个体会依次观察先前的行动然后采取行动。最终会形成一个相同的行动群体，而公共信念往往会形成“级联效应”，社会学习在此停止。当行动忽略信息外部性时，哪种行为才是社会上有效的？我们描述了一种最大化折现效用总和的结果。我们的四个关键发现是：(1) 级联效应会缩小但不会消失，羊群行为应该会发生，但随着对后代的重视程度增加，这种行为发生得会不那么频繁。(2) 一种最优机制会奖励被其继任者模仿的个体。(3) 在信号对数凹条件下，级联效应在第一时期之后无法开始。(4) 在这种条件下，有效行为表现为逆向行为，即总是倾向于反对那些在每一个时期都更受欢迎的行为。我们提出了两项技术贡献：由于带有学习的值函数并不平滑，我们采用不确定性下的单调比较静态分析来推导最优动态行为。我们还将动态转向机制适应于贝叶斯学习。

abstract.text: We derive a fully non-linear optimal income tax schedule in the presence of private insurance. We fill the gap in the literature by studying the optimal tax formula with a comprehensive structure of the private markets—including incomplete markets models—both theoretically and quantitatively. As in the standard taxation literature without private insurance, the optimal tax formula can still be expressed in terms of standard sufficient statistics. With private insurance, however, the formula involves additional terms that reflect how the private market interacts with public insurance. For example, the optimal tax formula should also consider asset distribution and pecuniary externalities as well as the welfare effects of borrowing constraints.

10.1093/restud/rdab003.abstractZh: 我们在存在私人保险的情况下，推导出了一个完全非线性的最优所得税税率表。我们通过理论和定量研究，填补了相关文献中的空白，涵盖了包括不完全市场模型在内的私人市场结构。与没有私人保险的标准税收文献一样，最优税收公式仍然可以用标准的充分统计量来表示。然而，在存在私人保险的情况下，公式中包含了反映私人市场与公共保险互动的额外项。例如，最优税收公式还应考虑资产分配、金钱外部性以及借贷约束对福利的影响。

abstract.text: This article studies equilibrium dynamics in consumer durable goods markets after aggregate credit shocks. We introduce two novel features into a general-equilibrium model of durable consumption with heterogeneous households facing idiosyncratic income risk and borrowing constraints: (1) indivisible durable goods are vertically differentiated in their quality and (2) trade on secondary markets at market-clearing prices, with households endogenously choosing when to trade or scrap their durables. The model highlights a new transmission mechanism for macroeconomic shocks and successfully matches several empirical patterns that we document using data on U.S. car markets around the Great Recession. After a tightening of the borrowing limit, debt-constrained households postpone the decision to scrap and upgrade their low-quality cars, which depresses mid-quality car prices. In turn, this effect reduces wealthy households’ incentives to replace their mid-quality cars with high-quality ones, thereby decreasing new-car sales. We further use our framework to evaluate targeted fiscal stimulus policies such as the Car Allowance Rebate System in 2009 (“Cash for Clunkers”).

10.1093/restud/rdab004.abstractZh: 本文研究了在总体信贷冲击之后，耐用消费品市场的均衡动态。我们在一般均衡模型中引入了两个新特征：首先，不可分割的耐用商品在质量上存在垂直差异；其次，交易在市场清算价格下进行，家庭自主决定何时交易或报废其耐用商品。该模型揭示了宏观经济冲击的新传导机制，并成功匹配了我们在美国汽车市场大衰退期间收集到的若干实证数据。在借贷限制收紧后，债务受限的家庭推迟了报废和升级低质量汽车的决策，这导致中等质量汽车的价格下降。反过来，这一效应降低了富裕家庭用高质量汽车替换中等质量汽车的动机，从而减少了新车销量。我们进一步利用该框架评估了诸如2009年“汽车报废补贴计划”等有针对性的财政刺激政策的效果。

abstract.text: This article studies the optimal design of rules in a dynamic model when there is a time inconsistency problem and uncertainty about whether the policy maker can commit to follow the rule ex post. The policy maker can either be a commitment type, which can always commit to follow rules, or an optimizing type, which sequentially decides whether to follow rules or not. This type is unobservable to private agents, who learn about it through the actions of the policy maker. Higher beliefs that the policy maker is the commitment type (i.e. the policy maker’s reputation) help promote good behaviour by private agents. We show that in a large class of economies, preserving uncertainty about the policy maker’s type is preferable from an ex ante perspective. If the initial reputation is not too high, the optimal rule is the strictest one that is incentive compatible for the optimizing type. We show that reputational considerations imply that the optimal rule is more lenient than the one that would arise in a static environment. Moreover, opaque rules are preferable to transparent ones if reputation is high enough.

10.1093/restud/rdab006.abstractZh: 本文研究了在存在时间不一致问题以及政策制定者能否承诺遵守规则存在不确定性的动态模型中，规则的最优设计问题。政策制定者可以是承诺型，即总是能够遵守规则；也可以是优化型，即依次决定是否遵守规则。这种类型对私人代理人来说是不可观测的，代理人通过政策制定者的行为来了解这一类型。认为政策制定者是承诺型的信念（即政策制定者的声誉）有助于促进私人代理人的良好行为。我们证明，在大部分经济体系中，从事前角度来看，保持对政策制定者类型的不确定性更为可取。如果初始声誉不是过高，那么对优化型来说，最优规则应该是最严格的、且与之相容的。我们还证明，考虑到声誉因素，最优规则比在静态环境下可能出现的规则更为宽松。此外，如果声誉足够高，不透明的规则比透明的规则更为可取。

abstract.text: Does the pattern of social connections between individuals matter for macroeconomic outcomes? If so, where do differences in these patterns come from and how large are their effects? Using network analysis tools, we explore how different social network structures affect technology diffusion and thereby a country’s rate of growth. The correlation between high-diffusion networks and income is strongly positive. But when we use a model to isolate the effect of a change in social networks on growth, the effect can be positive, negative, or zero. The reason is that networks diffuse both ideas and disease. Low-diffusion networks have evolved in countries where disease is prevalent because limited connectivity protects residents from epidemics. But a low-diffusion network in a low-disease environment compromises the diffusion of good ideas. In general, social networks have evolved to fit their economic and epidemiological environment. Trying to change networks in one country to mimic those in a higher-income country may well be counterproductive.

10.1093/restud/rdab008.abstractZh: 个体之间的社会联系模式是否对宏观经济结果有影响？如果有影响，这些模式的差异源自何处，其影响程度如何？通过网络分析工具，我们探讨了不同的社会网络结构如何影响技术扩散，进而影响一个国家的经济增长率。高扩散网络与收入之间存在强烈的正相关关系。但当我们使用模型来分离社会网络变化对经济增长的影响时，这种影响可能是正面的、负面的，也可能是零。原因在于，网络既传播思想，也传播疾病。在疾病普遍存在的国家，由于连接性有限，低扩散网络得以形成，这有助于保护居民免受流行病的侵害。但在低疾病环境下，低扩散网络会阻碍良好思想的传播。总体而言，社会网络已经适应了其经济和流行病学环境。试图改变一个国家的网络结构以模仿高收入国家的网络结构，可能会适得其反。

abstract.text: I propose to identify an SVAR, up to shock ordering, using the autocovariance structure of the squared innovations implied by an arbitrary stochastic process for the shock variances. These higher moments are available without parametric assumptions on the variance process. In contrast, previous approaches exploiting heteroskedasticity rely on the path of innovation covariances, which can only be recovered from the data under specific parametric assumptions on the variance process. The conditions for identification are testable. I compare the identification scheme to existing approaches in simulations and provide guidance for estimation and inference. I use the methodology to estimate fiscal multipliers peaking at 0.86 for tax cuts and 0.75 for government spending. I find that tax shocks explain more variation in output at longer horizons. The empirical implications of my estimates are more consistent with theory and the narrative record than those based on some leading approaches.

10.1093/restud/rdab009.abstractZh: 我建议利用任意随机过程所蕴含的平方创新的自协方差结构，来识别一个SVAR，直至冲击排序。这些高阶矩可以在不对方差过程进行参数假设的情况下得到。相比之下，以往利用异方差性的方法依赖于创新协方差的路径，而这一路径只有在对方差过程进行特定参数假设的情况下才能从数据中恢复。识别的条件是可检验的。我通过模拟比较了这种识别方法与现有方法，并为估计和推断提供了指导。我使用该方法估计了财政乘数，减税的财政乘数达到0.86，政府支出的财政乘数达到0.75。我发现，税收冲击在更长的时期内能够解释更多的产出变化。我的估计结果与理论和历史记录更为一致，而不是基于某些主流方法的估计结果。

abstract.text: This article documents that parents accumulate savings to insure their children against income risk. I refer to this behaviour as dynastic precautionary saving. Using a sample of matched parent–child pairs from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, I test for dynastic precautionary savings by examining the response of parental consumption to the child’s permanent income uncertainty. I exploit variation in permanent income risk across age and industry–occupation groups to confirm that, all else equal, higher uncertainty in the child’s permanent income depresses parental consumption, indicating a precautionary saving motive across generations.

10.1093/restud/rdab012.abstractZh: 本文记录了父母为子女规避收入风险而积累储蓄的行为。我将这种行为称为“王朝式预防性储蓄”。通过《收入动态面板研究》中匹配的亲子样本，我通过考察父母消费对孩子永久收入不确定性的反应，来检验这种“王朝式预防性储蓄”现象。我利用不同年龄和职业群体之间永久收入风险的变化，证实在其他条件不变的情况下，孩子永久收入的不确定性会抑制父母的消费，这表明存在跨代际的预防性储蓄动机。

abstract.text: We study a real small open economy with two key ingredients (1) partial segmentation of home and foreign bond markets and (2) a pecuniary externality that makes the real exchange rate excessively volatile in response to capital flows. Partial segmentation implies that, by intervening in the bond markets, the central bank can affect the exchange rate and the spread between home- and foreign-bond yields. Such interventions allow the central bank to address the pecuniary externality, but they are also costly, as foreigners make carry trade profits. We analytically characterize the optimal intervention policy that solves this trade-off: (1) the optimal policy leans against the wind, stabilizing the exchange rate; (2) it involves smooth spreads but allows exchange rates to jump; (3) it partly relies on “forward guidance,” with non-zero interventions even after the shock has subsided; (4) it requires credibility, in that central banks do not intervene without commitment. Finally, we shed light on the global consequences of widespread interventions, using a multi-country extension of our model. We find that, left to themselves, countries over-accumulate reserves, reducing welfare and leading to inefficiently low world interest rates.

10.1093/restud/rdab013.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有两个关键特征的实际小型开放经济体：(1) 本国和外国债券市场的部分分割；(2) 一种货币外部性，使得实际汇率对资本流动反应过度波动。部分分割意味着，通过干预债券市场，中央银行可以影响汇率以及本国和外国债券收益率之间的差距。这种干预措施有助于中央银行解决货币外部性问题，但也会带来成本，因为外国人会从中获利。我们从分析上确定了解决这一权衡的最优干预政策：(1) 最优政策是逆风而行，以稳定汇率；(2) 它要求收益率的差距保持平稳，但允许汇率出现波动；(3) 它部分依赖于“前瞻性指导”，即使在冲击消退后仍需进行非零干预；(4) 这需要可信度，即中央银行在缺乏承诺的情况下不会进行干预。最后，我们通过模型的多国扩展研究，揭示了广泛干预的全球后果。我们发现，如果任由市场自行运作，各国会过度积累储备，从而降低福利，并导致全球利率过低且效率低下。

abstract.text: Bitcoin provides its users with transaction-processing services which are similar to those of traditional payment systems. This article models the novel economic structure implied by Bitcoin’s innovative decentralized design, which allows the payment system to be reliably operated by unrelated parties called miners. We find that this decentralized design protects users from monopoly pricing. Competition among service providers within the platform and free entry imply no entity can profitably affect the level of fees paid by users. Instead, a market for transaction-processing determines the fees users pay to gain priority and avoid transaction-processing delays. The article (i) derives closed-form formulas of the fees and waiting times and studies their properties, (ii) compares pricing under the Bitcoin Payment System to that under a traditional payment system operated by a profit-maximizing firm, and (iii) suggests protocol design modifications to enhance the platform’s efficiency. The Appendix describes and explains the main attributes of Bitcoin and the underlying blockchain technology.

10.1093/restud/rdab014.abstractZh: 比特币为其用户提供类似于传统支付系统的交易处理服务。本文对比特币创新的去中心化设计所蕴含的新经济结构进行了建模，这种设计使得支付系统可以由称为矿工的无关联方可靠地运营。我们发现，这种去中心化设计能够保护用户免受垄断定价的影响。平台内服务提供商的竞争以及自由进入机制意味着没有任何实体能够盈利性地影响用户支付的费用水平。相反，交易处理市场决定了用户为获得优先权并避免交易处理延迟而支付的费用。本文首先推导出了费用与等待时间的封闭形式公式，并研究了它们的特性；其次，比较了比特币支付系统下的定价与由追求利润最大化的企业运营的传统支付系统的定价；最后，提出了一些协议设计修改建议，以提高平台的效率。附录中描述了比特币的主要特性以及其背后的区块链技术。

abstract.text: This article explores the consequences of extremely low real interest rates in a world with integrated but heterogeneous capital markets, nominal rigidities, and an effective lower bound [a zero lower bound (ZLB) for simplicity]. We establish four main results: (1) At the ZLB, creditor countries export their recession abroad, which we illustrate with a new Metzler diagram in quantities; (2) Beggar-thy-neighbour currency and trade wars provide stimulus to the undertaking country at the expense of other countries; (3) (Safe) public debt issuances and increases in government spending anywhere are expansionary everywhere; and (4) When there is a scarcity of safe assets, net issuers of these assets import the recession from abroad.

10.1093/restud/rdab015.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有整合但异质资本市场、名义刚性以及有效下限（为简化起见，设定为零下限）的世界中，极低实际利率所带来的后果。我们得出了四个主要结论：(1) 在零下限时，债权国会将经济衰退输出到其他国家，我们通过新的Metzler图表以具体数量进行了说明；(2) 邻国贸易战以牺牲其他国家为代价刺激本国经济；(3) 任何地方的（安全）公共债务发行和政府支出增加都会引发各地的经济扩张；(4) 当安全资产稀缺时，这些资产的净发行国会将经济衰退从国外引入本国。

abstract.text: We introduce a new model of repeated games in large populations with random matching, overlapping generations, and limited records of past play. We prove that steady-state equilibria exist under general conditions on records. When the updating of a player’s record can depend on the actions of both players in a match, any strictly individually rational action can be supported in a steady-state equilibrium. When record updates can depend only on a player’s own actions, fewer actions can be supported. Here, we focus on the prisoner’s dilemma and restrict attention to strict equilibria that are coordination-proof, meaning that matched partners never play a Pareto-dominated Nash equilibrium in the one-shot game induced by their records and expected continuation payoffs. Such equilibria can support full cooperation if the stage game is either “strictly supermodular and mild” or “strongly supermodular,” and otherwise permit no cooperation at all. The presence of “supercooperator” records, where a player cooperates against any opponent, is crucial for supporting any cooperation when the stage game is “severe.”

10.1093/restud/rdab016.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的重复博弈模型，该模型适用于大规模人群，包含随机匹配、重叠世代以及有限的过去博弈记录。我们证明了在一般记录条件下，稳态均衡是存在的。当玩家记录的更新可能取决于双方的行为时，任何严格个体理性的行为都可以在稳态均衡中得到支持。而当记录更新仅取决于玩家自身的行为时，能够支持的行为数量就会减少。在这里，我们重点关注囚徒困境，并关注那些能够抵抗协调性的严格均衡，即匹配的搭档在由他们的记录和预期持续收益引发的单次博弈中，永远不会选择帕累托支配的纳什均衡。如果阶段博弈是“严格超模且温和”的，或者“强超模”的，这样的均衡可以支持完全合作；否则，则完全不允许合作。在阶段博弈为“严峻”的情况下，存在“超级合作者”记录的情况至关重要，即玩家无论面对哪个对手都会选择合作，这种情况对于支持任何合作是至关重要的。

abstract.text: We develop a search model of informal labour markets with realistic labour regulations, including minimum wage, and heterogeneous workers and firms. Smaller firms and lower wages in the informal sector emerge endogenously as firms and workers decide whether to comply with regulations. Because skilled and unskilled workers are imperfect substitutes in production, the model uniquely captures the informality consequences of shocks that affect returns to skill, such as rising educational levels. The model also reproduces empirical patterns incompatible with other frameworks: the presence of skilled and unskilled workers in the formal and informal sectors, the rising share of skilled workers by firm size, and formal and firm-size wage premiums that vary by skill level. We estimate the model using 2003 data from Brazil and show that it successfully predicts labour market changes observed between 2003 and 2012. Under a range of different assumptions, changes in workforce composition appear as the main drivers of the reduction in informality over this period. Policy simulations using the estimated model suggest that progressive payroll taxes are a cost-effective way to reduce informality.

10.1093/restud/rdab017.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有现实劳动法规的非正式劳动力市场的搜索模型，其中包括最低工资规定，以及异质性的工人和企业。在非正式部门中，小型企业和较低的工资是企业和工人决定是否遵守法规的结果。由于熟练工人和非熟练工人在生产中的替代性并不完美，该模型能够独特地捕捉到影响技能回报的冲击所带来的非正式性后果，例如教育水平的提高。该模型还再现了与其他框架不兼容的实证现象：熟练工人和非熟练工人在正式和非正式部门中的存在，随着企业规模扩大，熟练工人的比例上升，以及不同技能水平下的正式工资和企業规模工资差异。我们使用2003年巴西的数据对该模型进行了估计，结果显示该模型能够成功预测2003年至2012年间劳动力市场的变化。在一系列不同的假设下，劳动力构成的变化被认为是这一时期非正式性减少的主要驱动因素。使用估计模型进行的政策模拟表明，累进工资税是减少非正式性的一种具有成本效益的方式。

abstract.text: We study default effects in the context of a residential electricity-pricing program. In the large-scale randomized controlled trial we analyse, one treatment group was given the option to opt-in to time-varying pricing while another was defaulted into the program but allowed to opt-out. We provide dramatic evidence of a default effect on program participation, consistent with previous research. A novel feature of our study is that we also observe how the default manipulation impacts customers’ subsequent electricity consumption. Passive consumers who did not opt-out but would not have opted in—comprising more than 70$\%$ of the sample—nonetheless reduce consumption in response to higher prices. Observing of this follow-on behaviour enables us to assess competing explanations for the default effect. We draw conclusions about the likely welfare effects of defaulting customers onto time-varying pricing.

10.1093/restud/rdab018.abstractZh: 我们研究了在住宅电力定价计划背景下违约效应的影响。在大规模随机对照试验中，我们分析了其中一个处理组被允许选择采用时变定价方式，而另一个处理组则被默认加入该计划，但允许选择退出。我们获得了关于违约效应对计划参与率影响的显著证据，这与先前的研究结果一致。我们研究的一个新颖之处在于，我们还观察到了违约行为对消费者后续电力消费的影响。那些没有选择退出但也不会选择加入的被动消费者——占样本总数的70%以上——尽管不愿意选择加入，但在价格上升的情况下仍然减少了电力消费。通过观察这种后续行为，我们能够评估违约效应存在的其他可能解释。我们得出了关于违约消费者在时变定价下可能带来的福利效应的结论。

abstract.text: Bloom et al. (2016) find that Chinese import competition induced a rise in patenting, IT adoption, and total factor productivity (TFP) by up to 30% of the total increase in Europe in the late 1990s and early 2000s. We uncover several coding errors in an important robustness check of their patent results. When corrected, we find no statistically significant relationship between Chinese competition and patents. Other specifications in the original paper use a problematic $ \log(1+\rm patents) $ transformation. This normalization induces bias given low average patent counts for firms in China-competing sectors and rapidly declining patents across the sample.

10.1093/restud/rdab037.abstractZh: Bloom等人（2016年）的研究发现，中国的进口竞争导致专利数量、信息技术采用率以及总要素生产率的增长幅度，分别比欧洲在1990年代末至2000年代初的增长幅度高出30%。我们在对他们的专利数据进行的关键稳健性检验中发现了几个编码错误。修正这些错误后，我们发现中国的竞争与专利数量之间并没有统计学上的显著关系。原论文中使用的$ \log(1+\rm patents) $转换方法存在问题。这种标准化处理方式会导致偏差，因为中国竞争领域的企业平均专利数量较低，且整个样本中的专利数量也在迅速下降。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: Acute otitis media (AOM) is the most common reason for pediatric antibiotic prescriptions. The 2013 American Academy of Pediatrics' AOM guidelines recommend observation for nonsevere AOM. Our aim was to increase the percentage safety-net antibiotic prescription (SNAP) offered to patients 6 months of age or older diagnosed with AOM in 2 pediatric emergency departments (EDs) from a baseline of 0.5% to 15% in 20 months. METHODS: This is a quality improvement study at a quaternary pediatric medical center with 2 locations, both with EDs. A random chart review revealed that 27.5% of patients diagnosed with AOM in the ED would qualify for a SNAP, but only 0.5% were offered it. Quality improvement interventions were designed to improve safety-net antibiotic prescribing. Both EDs conducted multiple interventions, including algorithm development, provider education, and electronic medical record aids. The primary outcome measure was the percentage of patients offered a SNAP for AOM. RESULTS: A total of 8226 children 6 months of age or older were diagnosed with AOM in our 2 EDs during the 20-month intervention period. The percentage offered a SNAP increased at both EDs. One ED had a single shift in the mean to 7.9%, whereas the other had 2 shifts in the mean, an initial shift to 5.1% and a second to 7.3%. Providers consistently used the algorithm and electronic medical record aids. CONCLUSIONS: Safety-net antibiotic prescriptions in conjunction with parent education was effective in reducing the use of immediate antibiotic prescriptions in children with AOM in 2 pediatric EDs. Offering a SNAP can reduce unnecessary use of antibiotics, which in turn may decrease antibiotic-related adverse events and antibiotic resistance.

10.1097/pec.0000000000002525.abstractZh:
目标：急性中耳炎是儿童使用抗生素的最常见原因。2013年美国儿科学会的指南建议对非严重急性中耳炎患者进行观察治疗。我们的目标是在20个月内，将6个月及以上被诊断为急性中耳炎的患者的安全网络抗生素处方比例从0.5%提高到15%。  

方法：这是一项在一家拥有两个分院的综合性儿科医疗中心进行的质量改进研究。通过随机图表审查发现，在急诊室中被诊断为急性中耳炎的27.5%的患者符合安全网络抗生素处方的条件，但只有0.5%的患者获得了该处方。我们设计了多项质量改进措施来优化抗生素处方。两个急诊室都采取了多种措施，包括制定算法、对医护人员进行培训以及利用电子病历辅助工具。主要评估指标是获得安全网络抗生素处方的患者比例。  

结果：在20个月的研究期间，我们的两个急诊室共有8226名6个月及以上被诊断为急性中耳炎的儿童。两个急诊室获得安全网络抗生素处方的比例都有所提高。其中一个急诊室的平均比例达到了7.9%，而另一个急诊室则分别达到了5.1%和7.3%。医护人员始终遵循了制定的算法和电子病历辅助工具。  

结论：在两家儿科急诊室中，结合家长教育的安全网络抗生素处方措施有效地减少了急性中耳炎患儿的即时抗生素使用。提供安全网络抗生素处方可以减少不必要的抗生素使用，进而降低与抗生素相关的不良事件和抗生素耐药性。

abstract.text: Purpose The sharing economy has enjoyed rapid growth in recent years, and entered many traditional industries such as accommodation, transportation and lending. Although researchers in information systems and marketing have attempted to examine the impacts of the sharing economy on traditional businesses, they have not yet studied the rental housing market. Thus, this research aims to investigate the impact of the sharing economy (i.e. home-sharing) on traditional businesses (i.e. rental housing market). Design/methodology/approach The authors assemble rich data from multiple sources about the entry of a leading Chinese home-sharing platform (i.e. Xiaozhu.com) and local housing rental price index. Then, econometric models (i.e. linear panel-level data models) are employed for empirical investigation. Instrumental variables are used to account for potential endogeneity issues. Various robustness checks are adopted to establish the consistency of the findings. Findings Overall, the estimation results show that the entry of a home-sharing platform will decrease the local housing rental price. Moreover, this impact would be strengthened in a more developed city. Additionally, this impact would be strengthened with higher prices of new houses or second-hand houses. Originality/value First, this research is one of the first to study the impact of the sharing economy (i.e. home-sharing) on traditional markets (i.e. housing rentals). Second, it contributes to the relevant literature by documenting that the impact of a platform's entry is not uniform but contingent on city and housing market characteristics. Third, practically, the findings also offer important implications for platform operators and policy makers.

10.1108/intr-03-2021-0190.abstractZh:
目的  近年来，共享经济取得了快速增长，并进入了住宿、交通和借贷等许多传统行业。尽管信息系统和营销领域的研究者试图研究共享经济对传统行业的影响，但尚未研究租赁市场。因此，本研究旨在探讨共享经济（即房屋共享）对传统行业（即租赁市场）的影响。  
设计/方法/途径  作者从多个来源收集了关于中国领先房屋共享平台（如Xiaozhu.com）进入当地租赁市场的相关数据，并使用了计量经济模型进行实证分析。同时，通过工具变量法解决了潜在的内生性问题，并采用了多种稳健性检验来确保研究结果的可靠性。  
研究结果  总体而言，估计结果显示，房屋共享平台的进入会降低当地租赁价格。此外，这种影响在更发达的城市更为明显。同时，新房或二手房的价格越高，这种影响越显著。  
原创性/价值  首先，本研究是首次研究共享经济对传统市场（如租赁市场）影响的实证研究。其次，通过研究平台进入的影响并非均匀，而是取决于城市及住房市场特征，为相关文献提供了补充。第三，从实践角度来看，这些研究结果对平台运营商和政策制定者具有重要的启示意义。

abstract.text: Purpose There has been little empirical research focused on the effect of lean on hospital performance in the form of a consolidated methodology. This paper aims to apply a more sophisticated approach to examine whether hospitals’ decision for lean implementation is endogenous and test the effects of lean on hospital performance. Design/methodology/approach This study uses a publicly available data set of hospitals across the USA from 2002 to 2019 and performs two-stage least squares (2SLS) analysis. In the first stage, a probit model is used to estimate hospitals’ decision to implement lean. The fitted probability values from the first stage are used in the second stage to test the relationship between lean and hospital performance. Ordinary least squares (OLS) regression results are compared with those of the 2SLS approach. Findings The decision to implement lean is significantly associated with hospital-specific characteristics (the complexity of care, size and cost-to-charge ratio), indicating hospitals’ decision for lean implementation is endogenous. Moreover, there is strong evidence that lean implementation is positively associated with hospital financial and operational performance. The Hausman F-tests confirm the presence of endogeneity and this, in turn, suggests that OLS regressions result in unreliable estimates. Practical implications The findings of this study can help hospital managers benchmark performance and explore opportunities for profit and efficiency improvement. The findings are also relevant to policymakers who strive to lower health-care spending. Originality/value This study is motivated by the challenges facing the health-care industry. This study is among the first to investigate endogeneity in lean implementation and the association between lean and hospital performance using large-scale archival panel data. The use of the 2SLS approach provides more confidence in statistical findings.

10.1108/jaoc-05-2020-0062.abstractZh:
目的  目前关于精益管理对医院绩效影响的实证研究较少，且缺乏统一的研究方法。本文旨在采用更为复杂的方法，探讨医院实施精益管理的决策是否具有内生性，以及精益管理对医院绩效的影响。  
设计/方法/途径  本研究使用了2002至2019年间美国医院公开数据，采用两阶段最小二乘法进行分析。第一阶段使用概率积分模型来估计医院实施精益管理的决策。第二阶段则利用第一阶段得到的概率值，检验精益管理与医院绩效之间的关系。普通最小二乘法回归结果与两阶段最小二乘法的结果进行了比较。  
发现  实施精益管理的决策与医院特定特征（如护理复杂性、规模及成本与收费比例）显著相关，表明医院实施精益管理的决策具有内生性。此外，有充分证据表明，精益管理对医院的财务和运营绩效有积极影响。Hausman F检验证实了内生性的存在，这进一步说明普通最小二乘法回归结果不可靠。  
实践意义  本研究的结果有助于医院管理者评估绩效，并探索提高利润和效率的机会。对于致力于降低医疗支出的政策制定者来说，这些发现也具有参考价值。  
原创性/价值  本研究的动机源于医疗行业面临的挑战。本研究是首批利用大规模档案面板数据来探讨精益实施的内生性以及精益实施与医院绩效之间关系的研究之一。采用2SLS方法能够增强统计结果的可靠性。

abstract.text: Purpose: In this chapter, we examine the National Health Service (NHS) and Adult Social Care (ASC) in England, focussing on policies that have been introduced since 2000 and considering the challenges that providers face in their quest to provide a high standard and affordable health service in the near future. Methodology/Approach: We discuss recent policy developments and published analysis covering innovations within major aspects of health care (primary, secondary and tertiary) and ASC, before considering future challenges faced by providers in England, highlighted by a 2017 UK Parliament Select Committee. Findings: The NHS and ASC system have experienced tightening budgets and serious financial pressure, with historically low real-terms growth in health funding from central government and local authorities. Policymakers have tried to overcome these challenges with several policy innovations, but many still remain. With large-scale investment and reform, there is potential for the health and social care system to evolve into a modern service capable of dealing with the needs of an ageing population. However, if these challenges are not met, then it is set to continue struggling with a lack of appropriate facilities, an overstretched staff and a system not entirely appropriate for its patients.

10.1108/s0573-855520210000295008.abstractZh:
目的：在本章中，我们研究了英格兰的国家健康服务系统（NHS）和成人社会护理系统（ASC），重点关注自2000年以来引入的政策，并探讨服务提供者在未来实现高标准且负担得起的医疗服务过程中所面临的挑战。  
方法/途径：我们讨论了近期政策发展和已发表的分析结果，涵盖了医疗保健（初级、二级和三级）以及成人社会护理的主要方面，随后探讨了英格兰服务提供者面临的未来挑战，这些挑战由2017年英国议会特别委员会指出。  
研究发现：NHS和ASC系统面临着预算紧缩和严重的财政压力，中央政府和地方当局对医疗保健的资金实际增长一直处于较低水平。政策制定者试图通过多项政策创新来克服这些挑战，但仍有许多问题尚未解决。通过大规模投资和改革，医疗保健和社会护理系统有潜力发展成为能够应对老龄化人口需求的现代服务系统。然而，如果这些挑战得不到解决，该系统将继续面临设施不足、人员超负荷以及系统不适合患者需求等问题。

abstract.text: Policy Points In two respects, quality of care tends to be higher at major teaching hospitals: process of care and long-term survival of cancer patients following initial diagnosis. There is also evidence that short-term (30-day) mortality is lower on average at such hospitals, although the quality of evidence is somewhat lower. Quality of care is mulitdimensional. Empirical evidence by teaching status on dimensions other than survival is mixed. Higher Medicare payments for care provided by major teaching hospitals are partially offset by lower payments to nonhospital providers. Nevertheless, the payment differences between major teaching and nonteaching hospitals for hospital stays, especially for complex cases, potentially increase prices other insurers pay for hospital care. CONTEXT: The relative performance of teaching hospitals has been discussed for decades. For private and public insurers with provider networks, an issue is whether having a major teaching hospital in the network is a "must." For traditional fee-for-service Medicare, there is an issue of adequacy of payment of hospitals with various attributes, including graduate medical education (GME) provision. Much empirical evidence on relative quality and cost has been published. This paper aims to (1) evaluate empirical evidence on relative quality and cost of teaching hospitals and (2) assess what the findings indicate for public and private insurer policy. METHODS: Complementary approaches were used to select studies for review. (1) Relevant studies highly cited in Web of Science were selected. (2) This search led to studies cited by these studies as well as studies that cited these studies. (3) Several literature reviews were helpful in locating pertinent studies. Some policy-oriented papers were found in Google under topics to which the policy applied. (4) Several papers were added based on suggestions of reviewers. FINDINGS: Quality of care as measured in process of care studies and in longitudinal studies of long-term survival of cancer patients tends to be higher at major teaching hospitals. Evidence on survival at 30 days post admission for common conditions and procedures also tends to favor such hospitals. Findings on other dimensions of relative quality are mixed. Hospitals with a substantial commitment to graduate medical education, major teaching hospitals, are about 10% to 20% more costly than nonteaching hospitals. Private insurers pay a differential to major teaching hospitals at this range's lower end. Inclusive of subsidies, Medicare pays major teaching hospitals substantially more than 20% extra, especially for complex surgical procedures. CONCLUSIONS: Based on the evidence on quality, there is reason for patients to be willing to pay more for inclusion of major teaching hospitals in private insurer networks at least for some services. Medicare payment for GME has long been a controversial policy issue. The actual indirect cost of GME is likely to be far less than the amount Medicare is currently paying hospitals.

10.1111/1468-0009.12502.abstractZh:
政策要点：在两个方面，大型教学医院的护理质量通常更高：护理过程以及癌症患者在初次诊断后的长期生存情况。也有证据表明，这类医院的短期（30天）死亡率平均较低，尽管相关证据的质量稍低。护理质量是多维度的。关于教学地位对生存以外维度的影响的实证证据并不一致。大型教学医院因护理服务而获得的更高医疗保险支付，部分被非医院提供者的较低支付所抵消。然而，大型教学医院与非教学医院在住院费用上的支付差异，尤其是在复杂病例的情况下，可能会增加其他保险公司支付医院护理费用的成本。

背景：几十年来，人们一直在讨论教学医院的相对表现。对于拥有供应商网络的私营和公共保险公司来说，一个问题是网络中是否必须包含大型教学医院。对于传统的按服务收费的医疗保险制度，还有一个问题是如何充分支付具有不同属性的医院的费用，包括研究生医学教育（GME）提供情况。已经发表了大量关于相对质量和成本的实证证据。本文旨在（1）评估关于教学医院相对质量和成本的实证证据；（2）分析这些发现对公共和私营保险公司政策的影响。

方法：采用互补的方法来选择研究进行评审。（1）选择了在Web of Science中引用次数较高的相关研究。（2）这一搜索过程找到了被这些研究引用的研究，以及引用这些研究的研究。（3）一些文献综述有助于找到相关的研究。在谷歌上，通过筛选相关政策主题，发现了一些以政策为导向的论文。根据审稿人的建议，又增加了几篇论文。研究发现：在护理过程研究和癌症患者长期生存的长期研究中，主要教学医院的护理质量通常较高。对于常见疾病和手术，30天后的存活率数据也倾向于支持这些医院的优势。其他方面的相对质量则存在争议。对研究生医学教育有高度投入的医院，尤其是主要教学医院，其费用比非教学医院高出约10%到20%。私人保险公司对主要教学医院支付的费用略低一些。包括补贴在内，医疗保险对主要教学医院支付的费用比额外费用高出20%以上，尤其是在复杂的手术项目中。结论：根据质量方面的证据，患者有理由愿意为在私人保险公司网络中使用主要教学医院服务而支付更高的费用。医疗保险对研究生医学教育的支付长期以来一直是一个有争议的政策问题。实际上，研究生医学教育的间接成本可能远低于医疗保险目前支付给医院的金额。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To estimate health care systems' value in treating major illnesses for each US state and identify system characteristics associated with value. DATA SOURCES: Annual condition-specific death and incidence estimates for each US state from the Global Burden Disease 2019 Study and annual health care spending per person for each state from the National Health Expenditure Accounts. STUDY DESIGN: Using non-linear meta-stochastic frontier analysis, mortality incidence ratios for 136 major treatable illnesses were regressed separately on per capita health care spending and key covariates such as age, obesity, smoking, and educational attainment. State- and year-specific inefficiency estimates were extracted for each health condition and combined to create a single estimate of health care delivery system value for each US state for each year, 1991-2014. The association between changes in health care value and changes in 23 key health care system characteristics and state policies was measured. DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: Not applicable. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: US state with relatively high spending per person or relatively poor health-outcomes were shown to have low health care delivery system value. New Jersey, Maryland, Florida, Arizona, and New York attained the highest value scores in 2014 (81 [95% uncertainty interval 72-88], 80 [72-87], 80 [71-86], 77 [69-84], and 77 [66-85], respectively), after controlling for health care spending, age, obesity, smoking, physical activity, race, and educational attainment. Greater market concentration of hospitals and of insurers were associated with worse health care value (p-value ranging from <0.01 to 0.02).
