Higher hospital geographic density and use were also associated with worse health care value (p-value ranging from 0.03 to 0.05). Enrollment in Medicare Advantage HMOs was associated with better value, as was more generous Medicaid income eligibility (p-value 0.04 and 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Substantial variation in the value of health care exists across states. Key health system characteristics such as market concentration and provider density were associated with value.

10.1111/1475-6773.13676.abstractZh:
目的：估算美国各州在治疗重大疾病方面的医疗系统价值，并识别与价值相关的系统特征。  
数据来源：来自《2019年全球疾病负担研究》的年度特定疾病死亡和发病率数据，以及《国家健康支出账户》中各州的年度人均医疗支出数据。  
研究设计：采用非线性元随机前沿分析方法，分别基于人均医疗支出和年龄、肥胖、吸烟、教育水平等关键变量，对136种可治疗疾病的死亡率和发病率进行了回归分析。提取各健康状况的州级和年度效率不效率估计值，综合得出1991至2014年间各州医疗系统价值的单一估算值。同时，研究了医疗价值变化与23种关键医疗系统特征和州政策变化之间的关联。  
数据收集/提取方法：不适用。  
主要发现：人均支出较高或健康结果较差的州，其医疗系统价值较低。在控制医疗支出、年龄、肥胖、吸烟、体力活动、种族和教育水平等因素后，新泽西州、马里兰州、佛罗里达州、亚利桑那州和纽约州在2014年的医疗系统价值得分最高，分别为81（95%置信区间72-88）、80（72-87）、80（71-86）、77（69-84）和77（66-85）。医院和保险公司的市场集中度越高，医疗价值越低（p值小于0.01至0.02）。医院地理密度和利用率越高，医疗价值也越低（p值介于0.03至0.05之间）。参加Medicare Advantage HMO计划与更高的价值相关，而更宽松的Medicaid收入资格标准也与之相关（p值分别为0.04和0.01）。结论：各州在医疗保健的价值上存在显著差异。市场集中度和医疗服务提供者密度等关键医疗系统特征与价值相关。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: Guidelines recommend emergency medical services (EMS) patients to be transported to the nearest appropriate emergency department (ED). Our objective was to estimate the prevalence of EMS transport to an ED other than the nearest ED ("potential bypassing"). DATA SOURCES: Illinois Prehospital Patient Care Report Data of EMS transports (July 2019 to December 2019). DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: We identified all EMS ground transports with an advanced life-support (ALS) paramedic to an ED for patients aged 21 years and older. Using street address of incident location, we performed geocoding and driving route analyses and obtained estimated driving distance and time to the destination ED and alternative EDs. MAIN OUTCOME AND MEASURES: Our main outcomes were dichotomous indicators of potential bypassing of the nearest ED based on distance and time. As secondary outcomes we examined potential bypassing indicators based on excess driving distance and time. STUDY DESIGN: We used Poisson regression models to obtain adjusted relative rates of potential bypassing indicators by acuity level, primary impression, patient demographics and geographic characteristics. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Our study cohort of 361,051 EMS transports consisted of 5.8% critical, 37.2% emergent and 57.0% low acuity cases transported to 222 EDs. The observed rate of potential bypassing was approximately 34% of cases for each acuity level. Treating the cardiovascular primary impression code group as the reference case, we found small to no differences in potential bypassing rates across other primary impression code groups of all acuity levels, with the exception of critical acuity trauma cases for which potential bypassing rate was 64% higher (incidence rate ratio = 1.64, 95% confidence interval, 1.54-1.74). Compared to zip codes with one ED within a 5-mile vicinity, potential bypassing was higher in areas with no ED or multiple EDs within a 5-mile vicinity. CONCLUSION: Approximately one-third of EMS transports potentially bypassed the nearest ED. EMS transport destination may be motivated by factors other than proximity.

10.1111/1475-6773.13903.abstractZh:
目的：指南建议将紧急医疗服务（EMS）患者送往最近的合适急诊科。我们的目的是估算将EMS患者送往非最近急诊科的潜在情况的发生率。  
数据来源：伊利诺伊州院前患者护理报告中的EMS运输数据（2019年7月至12月）。  
数据收集/提取方法：我们识别出所有由高级生命支持护理人员将21岁及以上的患者送往急诊科的地面运输情况。通过事件发生的街道地址进行地理编码和驾驶路线分析，计算出到达目的地急诊科及其他替代急诊科的预计行驶距离和时间。  
主要结果及测量指标：我们的主要结果是基于距离和时间对最近急诊科潜在 bypassing 情况的二分指标。次要结果则基于过度驾驶距离和时间来考察潜在 bypassing 指标。  
研究设计：我们使用泊松回归模型，根据病情严重程度、主要诊断、患者人口统计信息和地理特征，得出调整后的潜在 bypassing 指标的相对比率。  
主要发现：我们的研究样本包括361,051次EMS运输，其中5.8%为危重病例，37.2%为急诊病例，57.0%为轻度病例，这些病例被送往222个急诊科。各病情严重程度下的潜在 bypassing 发生率约为34%。将心血管系统为主要诊断的病例作为参考案例，我们发现其他所有主要诊断组的潜在 bypassing 发生率差异不大，但危重创伤病例的潜在 bypassing 发生率高出64%（发病率比率为1.64，95%置信区间：1.54-1.74）。与在5英里范围内只有一个急诊室的邮政编码相比，在5英里范围内没有急诊室或多个急诊室的地区，潜在的绕行次数更高。结论：大约三分之一的急救医疗服务运输可能绕过了最近的急诊室。急救医疗服务运输的目的地可能受到除距离因素之外的其他因素的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether and how individual auditors are disciplined for audit errors. Taking advantage of the long history of auditor identity data from China, we find that signing auditors with client restatements are likely to lose the privilege of signing the audit reports of public clients. However, auditors can avoid this consequence by issuing a modified audit opinion to warn of the potential misstatement. We show that auditors are more likely to be disciplined when their firms operate in less concentrated audit markets. Finally, we find positive outcomes from the disciplinary action of the audit firms. Firms that discipline their auditors for restatements have a larger decrease in the rate of client restatements and a larger increase in market share, compared to nondisciplining firms. Their clients have a higher earnings response coefficient after the disciplinary action. In summary, our results suggest that individual auditors in China can face career setbacks when they produce poor quality audits.

10.1111/1475-679x.12399.abstractZh: 本文探讨了个体审计师是否以及如何因审计错误而受到惩戒。利用中国丰富的审计师身份数据，我们发现，与客户存在重述行为的审计师很可能会失去为公共客户签署审计报告的权利。然而，审计师可以通过发表修正的审计意见来避免这一后果，以警示潜在的错误陈述。我们发现，当审计师所在的审计市场不够集中时，他们更有可能受到惩戒。此外，我们发现审计师受到惩戒后，客户重述率会下降，市场份额则会上升。在惩戒行动之后，客户的收益反应系数也会提高。总之，我们的研究结果表明，在中国，个体审计师在出具质量不佳的审计报告时可能会面临职业上的挫折。

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of hospital mergers, using detailed data containing medical supply transactions (representing 23% of operating costs) from a sample of US hospitals, 2009–2015. Pre‐merger price variation across hospitals (Gini coefficient 7%) suggests significant opportunities for cost decreases. However, we observe limited evidence of actual savings. In this retrospective study, targets realized 1.9% savings; acquirers realized no significant savings. Examining treatment effect heterogeneity to shed light on theories of “buyer power,” we find that savings, when they occur, tend to be local, and potential benefits of savings may be offset by managerial costs of merging.

10.1111/1756-2171.12365.abstractZh: 我们利用2009至2015年间美国医院样本中的详细医疗供应交易数据（占运营成本的23%），估算了医院合并的效应。合并前医院之间的价格差异（基尼系数为7%）表明存在显著的降低成本机会。然而，我们观察到实际节省的成本证据有限。在这项回顾性研究中，目标医院实现了1.9%的成本节省；而收购方则未实现显著节省。通过研究治疗效果的异质性，以探讨“买方力量”理论，我们发现当节省成本发生时，往往局限于局部地区，且节省带来的潜在收益可能会被合并的管理成本所抵消。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect on the quality of three high‐volume non‐emergency treatments of a reform that relaxed restrictions on patient choice of hospital. We employ a quasi difference‐in‐difference strategy and use control functions allowing for patient selection into providers correlated with unobserved morbidity. Public hospitals facing more rivals reduced quality, increased waiting times, and reduced length of stay for hip and knee replacements. This is likely due to regulated prices implying larger losses on these treatments compared to coronary artery bypass grafts, where no effects were found. Our findings are robust to estimation methods and competition measures, allowing for private providers’ entry.

10.1111/1756-2171.12373.abstractZh: 我们研究了放宽患者选择医院限制的改革对三种高流量非紧急治疗项目质量的影响。我们采用准差异差异策略，并使用控制函数来考虑与患者未观察到的发病率相关的医疗服务提供者选择。面临更多竞争对手的公立医院，其治疗项目的质量下降，等待时间延长，髋关节和膝关节置换手术的住院时间也相应减少。这可能是由于管制价格导致这些治疗项目的损失更大，而冠状动脉旁路移植手术则没有发现类似影响。我们的研究结果不受估计方法和竞争程度的影响，即使允许私人医疗服务提供者的进入，结果依然成立。

abstract.text: We model a two‐level supply chain where Nash bargaining occurs upstream and firms compete in a logit setting downstream, either via Bertrand price setting or an auction. The parameters can be calibrated with a discrete set of data on prices, margins, and market shares, facilitating use by antitrust practitioners. We perform numerical simulations to identify cases where modelling the full vertical structure is important and where harm is likely. We also examine the thwarted Anthem/Cigna merger and show how the model weighs the various arguments made by the government and the defendants.

10.1111/1756-2171.12385.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个双层供应链模型，其中上游阶段采用纳什谈判机制，下游阶段则通过伯特兰价格设定或拍卖方式进行竞争。模型参数可以通过一系列关于价格、利润率和市场份额的离散数据来校准，便于反垄断领域的从业者使用。我们通过数值模拟来识别在哪些情况下完整描述垂直结构的重要性，以及哪些情况下可能会出现不利影响。我们还研究了Anthem与Cigna的合并案，并展示了该模型如何权衡政府和被告提出的各种论点。

abstract.text: The diversion ratio for products and is the fraction of consumers who leave product after a price increase and switch to product . Theoretically, it is expressed as the ratio of demand derivatives from a multi‐product firm's Bertrand‐Nash first‐order condition. In practice, diversion ratios are also measured from second‐choice data or customer‐switching surveys. We establish a LATE interpretation of diversion ratios, and show how diversion ratios are obtained from different interventions (price, quality, or assortment changes) and how those measures relate to one another and to underlying properties of demand.

10.1111/1756-2171.12388.abstractZh: 产品转换比率是指价格上涨后放弃某产品并转而选择另一产品的消费者比例。理论上，这一比率可以通过多产品企业Bertrand-Nash一阶条件中的需求导数来表示。在实际应用中，转换比率也可以通过第二选择数据或客户转换调查来测量。我们提出了转换比率的LATE解释，并展示了如何通过对不同干预措施（如价格、质量或产品组合调整）进行量化，从而得出转换比率，以及这些指标之间如何相互关联，以及它们与需求的基本属性之间的关系。

abstract.text: Demand for long‐term care services is growing strongly. Using a rich administrative data set for Germany, we examine strategic interaction between nonprofit and for‐profit nursing homes. The estimated competitive effects imply that competition is much stronger within type, suggesting that they provide differentiated products. Over time, the entry behavior of for‐profit homes has converged to that of the more established nonprofits and between‐type competition has become stronger. Counterfactual simulations of proposed changes in government policy indicate that even moderate changes have a large impact on the fraction of markets that remain unserved or only served by a single type.

10.1111/iere.12544.abstractZh: 对长期护理服务的需求正在迅速增长。我们利用德国丰富的行政数据，研究了非营利组织和营利性养老院之间的战略互动。估计的竞争效应表明，不同类型的养老院之间的竞争更为激烈，这意味着它们提供了差异化的服务。随着时间的推移，营利性养老院的进入行为逐渐与那些更为成熟的非营利性养老院趋同，不同类型养老院之间的竞争也变得更加激烈。对政府政策变化的反事实模拟表明，即使是适度的政策变化，也会对仍未被服务或仅由单一类型养老院提供服务的市场份额产生重大影响。

abstract.text: We compare the online reviews of 221 “Questionable” Illinois and Indiana physicians with multiple paid medical malpractice claims and disciplinary sanctions with matched control physicians with clean records. Across five prominent online rating services, we find small, mostly insignificant differences in star ratings and written reviews for Questionable versus control physicians. Only one rating service (Healthgrades) reports on paid medical malpractice claims and disciplinary actions and it misses more than 90% of these actions. We also evaluate the online ratings of 171 Illinois hospitals and find that their ratings are largely uncorrelated with the share of hospital‐affiliated physicians with paid medical malpractice claims and disciplinary sanctions. Online ratings have limited utility in helping patients avoid physicians with troubled medical malpractice and disciplinary records, and steering patients away from hospitals at which more physicians have paid medical malpractice claims and disciplinary sanctions.

10.1111/jels.12338.abstractZh: 我们比较了221位来自伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的“有问题的”医生在在线评论中的表现，这些医生曾多次因医疗过失行为被起诉并受到纪律处分。我们还将这些医生与那些没有不良记录的对照医生进行了对比。通过五个知名在线评级服务，我们发现“有问题的”医生与对照医生在星级评分和书面评论方面存在较小的、且大多不显著的差异。只有一家评级服务（Healthgrades）会报道医疗过失行为及纪律处分的情况，但其中超过90%的此类信息并未被记录。我们还评估了171家伊利诺伊州医院的在线评级，发现这些医院的评级与医院所属医生是否曾因医疗过失行为及纪律处分而受到处罚之间几乎没有相关性。因此，在线评级在帮助患者避免与有不良记录的医生合作方面作用有限，也无法引导患者远离那些有较多医生因医疗过失行为及纪律处分而受到处罚的医院。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of competition in the nursing‐homes sector with a two‐sided market approach. Using a Hotelling model, our key findings are that (i) the two‐sidedness of the market leads to higher wages for nurses, (ii) this is then passed to residents in the form of higher prices, and (iii) nursing‐homes profits are instead unaffected. In contrast, when nurses wages are regulated, the two‐sidedness of the market implies a transfer between residents and nursing homes. When residents' price is regulated, it implies a transfer between nurses and nursing homes. These key results are generally robust to institutional settings which employ pay‐for‐performance schemes, the presence of altruistic motives of nursing homes and the heterogeneity in residents reservation utility.

10.1111/jems.12415.abstractZh: 我们采用双边市场方法，研究了护理院领域竞争的影响。通过Hotelling模型分析，我们的主要发现包括：(i) 市场的双边性导致护士的薪酬更高；(ii) 这种薪酬提升会转化为居民更高的支付价格；(iii) 护理院的利润则不受影响。相比之下，当护士的薪酬受到监管时，市场的双边性意味着薪酬会在居民与护理院之间转移。而当居民的价格受到监管时，则意味着薪酬会在护士与护理院之间转移。这些关键结果在采用绩效薪酬制度的机构环境中仍然成立，且不受护理院存在利他动机以及居民保留效用异质性的影响。

abstract.text: I examine the relationship between bargaining leverage and capital investment using data on California’s hospital markets. I find evidence that investment increases with bargaining leverage; a hospital whose bargaining position improves by one standard deviation will increase its investment rate by 16 percentage points. A positive causal relationship between bargaining leverage and investment fits the institutional details of the health care sector, where many firms have non‐profit tax status, making it difficult to return monopoly rents to shareholders. Consistent with this explanation, I find that non‐profit hospitals with bargaining leverage invest more than for‐profit ones, all else equal. I do not find strong evidence that financing constraints matter disproportionately for hospitals operating in more competitive markets, supporting the hypothesis that the incremental investment may not be socially efficient.

10.1111/joie.12243.abstractZh: 我利用加州医院市场的数据，研究了议价杠杆与资本投资之间的关系。我发现，随着议价杠杆的增加，投资也会相应增加；如果一家医院的议价地位提高一个标准差，其投资率将增加16个百分点。议价杠杆与投资之间的正相关关系符合医疗保健行业的制度特点，因为许多企业具有非营利性税务地位，这使得将垄断租金返还给股东变得困难。与这一解释一致的是，我发现，在其他条件相同的情况下，具有议价杠杆的非营利性医院比营利性医院投资更多。我没有发现有力的证据表明，融资限制对在竞争更激烈的市场中运营的医院来说尤为重要，这支持了这样一个假设：这种增量投资可能并不具有社会效率。

abstract.text: In retail and health care markets, demand declines with geographic distance to the establishment, but either transport costs or preferences correlated with distance (‘home bias’) could cause this decline. Using hospital choices for childbirth, we find that, after controlling for home bias using fixed effects, estimates of the transport cost disutility fall by 40% relative to a standard logit model. We show that referrals are a likely source of home bias. We then show that home bias matters for policy questions including a simulated hospital merger, network adequacy concerns, and the tradeoff between distance and quality.

10.1111/joie.12258.abstractZh: 在零售和医疗保健市场中，需求随着与医疗机构的地理距离增加而下降，但这种下降可能是由于运输成本或与距离相关的偏好（“家庭偏好”）所导致的。通过研究分娩时的医院选择，我们发现，在控制家庭偏好后，运输成本不满意度相对于标准逻辑模型降低了40%。我们指出，转诊可能是家庭偏好的一个重要来源。此外，我们还发现，家庭偏好对于政策问题具有重要意义，包括模拟的医院合并、网络充足性问题以及距离与质量之间的权衡。

abstract.text: Health service delivery interventions include a range of hospital ‘quality improvement’ initiatives and broader health system policies. These interventions act through multiple causal pathways to affect patient outcomes and they present distinct challenges for evaluation. In this article, we propose an empirical approach to estimating the effect of service delivery interventions on patient length of stay considering three principle issues: (i) informative censoring of discharge times due to mortality; (ii) post-treatment selection bias if the intervention affects patient admission probabilities; and (iii) decomposition into direct and indirect pathways mediated by quality. We propose a Bayesian structural survival model framework in which results from a subsample in which required assumptions hold, including conditional independence of the intervention, can be applied to the whole sample. We evaluate a policy of increasing specialist intensity in hospitals at the weekend in England and Wales to inform a cost-minimisation analysis. Using data on adverse events from a case note review, we compare various specifications of a structural model that allows for observations of hospital quality. We find that the policy was not implemented as intended but would have likely been cost saving, that this conclusion is sensitive to model specification, and that the direct effect accounts for almost all of the total effect rather than any improvement in hospital quality.

10.1111/rssc.12501.abstractZh: 医疗服务提供干预措施包括一系列医院“质量改进”举措以及更广泛的卫生系统政策。这些干预措施通过多种因果途径影响患者结果，同时也带来了评估上的独特挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种实证方法来估计医疗服务提供干预措施对患者住院时间的影响，重点关注三个主要问题：(i) 由于死亡率导致的出院时间的信息缺失；(ii) 如果干预措施影响患者入院概率，则会出现治疗后的选择偏差；(iii) 通过质量因素分解直接和间接的因果路径。我们提出了一种贝叶斯结构生存模型框架，在该框架中，可以从满足特定假设的子样本中获得结果，包括干预措施的条件独立性，并将这些结果应用于整个样本。我们评估了在英格兰和威尔士周末增加专科医院服务密度的政策，以用于成本最小化分析。利用病例记录审查中的不良事件数据，我们比较了多种允许观察医院质量的结构模型规格。我们发现，该政策并未按预期实施，但可能会节省成本；这一结论对模型规格的敏感性较高；直接效应几乎占据了总效应的全部，而不是医院质量的任何改善。

abstract.text: Driven by the rapid growth of content traffic and the demand for service quality, Internet content providers (CPs) have started to bypass transit providers and connect with access providers directly via private peering agreements. This peering relationship often raises disputes, e.g., Netflix vs. Comcast, and is not well understood. In this paper, we build a peering contract model and propose the concept of contractual equilibrium, based on which we study the formation and evolution of peering contracts. By using market data, we emulate the strategic peering behavior of providers and shed light on the understanding of private peering~agreements. We reveal that the superiority and market dominance of providers primarily determine their peering strategies. We show that 1) superior providers tend to engage in peering more aggressively, and 2) non-dominant CPs' optimal peering strategies are negatively correlated due to market cannibalism, while the dominant CP often behaves oppositely. Our findings help explain phenomena such as why Netflix and Comcast signed the first peering contract, and reason whether private peering contracts will strengthen in future.

10.1145/3410220.3456277.abstractZh: 随着内容流量的快速增长和对服务质量的需求增加，互联网内容提供商开始绕过传输提供商，通过私人对等协议直接与接入提供商建立连接。这种对等关系常常引发争议，例如Netflix与Comcast之间的纠纷，其本质尚未得到充分理解。在本文中，我们构建了一个对等合同模型，并提出了契约均衡的概念，基于这一概念，我们研究了对等合同的形成与演变。通过利用市场数据，我们模拟了提供商的策略性对等行为，并有助于理解私人对等协议的本质。我们发现，提供商的竞争优势和市场主导地位主要决定了它们的对等策略。我们指出：1）优势提供商更倾向于积极进行对等合作；2）非主导提供商的最优对等策略因市场竞争而呈现负相关，而主导提供商则往往表现出相反的行为。我们的研究结果有助于解释诸如为什么Netflix和Comcast会签署第一个对等合同，以及未来私人对等协议是否会得到加强等问题。

abstract.text: Adoption of health information and communication technologies ("HICT") has surged over the past two decades.We survey the medical and economic literature on HICT adoption and its impact on clinical outcomes, productivity and labor.We find that HICT improves clinical outcomes and lowers healthcare costs, but (i) the effects are modest so far, (ii) it takes time for these effects to materialize, and (iii) there is much variation in the impact.More evidence on the causal effects of HICT on productivity is needed to guide further adoption.There is little econometric work directly investigating the impact of HICT on labor, but what there is suggests no substantial negative effects on employment and earnings.Overall, while healthcare is "exceptional" in many ways, we are struck by the similarities to the wider findings on ICT and productivity stressing the importance of complementary factors (e.g.management and skills) in determining HICT impacts.

10.1146/annurev-economics-080921-101909.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，健康信息与通信技术（“HICT”）的采用呈上升趋势。我们回顾了关于HICT采用及其对临床结果、生产力和劳动力影响的医学和经济文献。研究发现，HICT能够改善临床结果并降低医疗成本，但（i）目前这些效果仍然较为有限，（ii）这些效果需要时间才能显现，（iii）其影响存在很大差异。需要更多关于HICT对生产力因果效应的研究来指导进一步的采用。关于HICT对劳动力影响的计量经济学研究相对较少，但现有研究表明，它对就业和收入没有显著的负面影响。总体而言，尽管医疗保健在许多方面具有“特殊性”，但我们仍注意到它与更广泛的ICT和生产力研究中的发现存在相似之处，这强调了在决定HICT影响时，管理因素和技能等互补因素的重要性。

abstract.text: This review considers conceptual issues underlying empirical work on markets. It is divided in three parts. The first part reviews the analysis of demand and equilibrium in retail markets and then considers recent advances in the analysis of markets that require different assumptions: markets where adverse selection and moral hazard may be important, vertical markets with bargaining, and markets wherein a centralized allocation mechanism replaces prices. The second part considers the analysis of cost and production. It reviews the simultaneity and selection issues in production function estimation and then considers the distinction between revenue- and quantity-generating functions and its implications for the analysis of markups, as well as the empirical analysis of fixed costs and its implications for the analysis of product repositioning. The review concludes by considering issues that arise due to the complexity of the empirical analysis of market dynamics and appropriate ways of dealing with them.

10.1146/annurev-economics-082019-023513.abstractZh: 本综述探讨了关于市场实证研究中的概念性问题。文章分为三个部分。第一部分回顾了零售市场中需求与均衡的分析，随后探讨了需要不同假设的市场分析的最新进展：包括可能存在逆向选择和道德风险的市场、具有讨价还价机制的纵向市场，以及以集中分配机制替代价格的市场。第二部分讨论了成本与生产的分析。文章回顾了生产函数估计中的同时性问题和选择问题，并探讨了收入生成函数与数量生成函数之间的区别及其对价格加成分析的影响，同时分析了固定成本的实证情况及其对产品重新定位分析的意义。最后，文章探讨了由于市场动态实证分析的复杂性而产生的相关问题，并提出了相应的处理方法。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether higher earnings for frontline workers affects the quality of employees’ output. I leverage increases in the statutory minimum wage, combined with worker, consumer, and firm outcomes in the nursing home sector. I find that higher minimum wages increase income and retention among low-wage employees and improve consumer outcomes, measured by fewer inspection violations; lower rates of adverse, preventable health conditions; and lower resident mortality. Firms maintain profitability by attracting consumers with a greater ability to pay and increasing prices for these individuals.

10.1162/rest_a_01271.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一线员工的更高收入是否会影响员工的工作质量。我研究了法定最低工资的提高对护理行业员工、消费者以及企业的影响。研究发现，最低工资的提高能够增加低薪员工的收入和留任率，并改善消费者状况，表现为检查违规次数减少、可预防的健康问题发生率降低以及居民死亡率下降。企业通过吸引支付能力更强的消费者并提高价格来保持盈利能力。

abstract.text: We use data from the Veterans Administration to examine the efficacy of primary care providers (PCPs). Leveraging quasi-random assignment of veterans to PCPs, we measure effectiveness using ambulatory care sensitive conditions (ACSC) and hospitalizations/emergency department (ED) visits for mental health or circulatory conditions. PCPs variation along these dimensions predicts future outcomes. For example, a one standard deviation improvement in mental health effectiveness reduces patient risk of death by 3.8% and lowers costs by 4.4% over the next three years. More effective PCPs do more with less: their patients have fewer primary care visits, specialist referrals, lab panels, or imaging tests.

10.1162/rest_a_01290.abstractZh: 我们利用退伍军人管理局的数据来研究初级保健提供者的有效性。通过准随机分配退伍军人与初级保健提供者进行配对，我们使用与门诊护理相关的疾病情况以及因心理健康或循环系统疾病而发生的住院/急诊就诊情况来衡量效果。初级保健提供者在这些方面的表现差异可以预测未来的结果。例如，心理健康方面的效果提高一个标准差，可以在未来三年内将患者死亡风险降低3.8%，并将成本降低4.4%。更有效的初级保健提供者能够以更少的资源完成更多的工作：他们的患者需要进行的门诊就诊次数、专科转诊、实验室检查以及影像学检查都更少。

abstract.text: Patients increasingly rely on online physician ratings to select their physicians and make health care decisions. However, it is unclear whether online physician ratings signal physician quality information and affect patients’ physician choices. By combining physician rating data from Yelp with data from Medicare, which covers a large elderly patient group, the authors find that ratings are positively associated with important measures of physician quality, including physicians’ credentials, adherence to clinical guidelines, and patients’ health outcomes. They introduce novel instrumental variables, where reviewers’ leniency in rating other businesses is employed as an instrument for physicians’ ratings. They find that an increase in physicians’ average rating increases physicians’ patient flow. To understand the quality signals that patients respond to, the authors also use the latent Dirichlet allocation model and extract topics from review texts. Patients respond differentially to different information and respond most to information about physicians’ interpersonal and clinical skills. In addition, rating credibility, accessibility, and strength of other existent signals moderate the positive effects of online ratings on patient flow. Overall, online physician rating platforms can promote efficiency by disseminating important quality information to patients and directing patients to higher-quality physicians.

10.1177/00222429221146511.abstractZh: 患者越来越依赖在线医生评价来选择医生并做出医疗决策。然而，尚不清楚在线医生评价是否确实反映了医生的服务质量，并影响患者的选择。作者结合Yelp上的医生评价数据和Medicare的数据，后者涵盖了大量老年患者群体，发现医生评价与医生服务质量的重要指标呈正相关，包括医生的资质、对临床指南的遵循程度以及患者的健康结果。他们引入了新的工具变量，即利用评审者对其他企业的宽容度作为医生评价的替代指标。研究发现，医生平均评价分数的提高会增加医生的患者流量。为了了解患者所响应的质量信号，作者还使用了潜在狄利克雷分配模型，从评论文本中提取主题。患者对不同类型的信息反应不同，而对医生的人际交往能力和临床技能方面的信息反应最为强烈。此外，评价的可信度、可访问性以及其他现有信号的质量对在线评价对患者流量的积极影响起到了调节作用。总体而言，在线医生评价平台可以通过向患者传播重要的质量信息，并引导患者选择更优质的医生，从而提高效率。

abstract.text: Firms use mobile applications to engage with customers, provide services, and encourage customer purchase. Conventional wisdom and previous research indicate that apps have a positive effect on customer spending. The authors critically examine this premise in a highly competitive institutional context by estimating how customers’ multichannel spending changes after adopting a hotel group’s app and identifying the factors contributing to such change. Exploiting the variation in customers’ timing of app adoption and using a difference-in-differences approach, the authors find that the effect of app adoption on customers’ overall spending is significant and negative. Additional analyses suggest the possibility that customers who adopt the focal app also adopt competitor apps and therefore search more and shop around, leading to decreased share of wallet with the focal hotel group. The authors also find that the negative effect on spending is smaller for customers who use the app for mobile check-in service than those who use the app for only searching, highlighting the role of app engagement in mitigating the negative effect.

10.1177/0022243720988257.abstractZh: 企业利用移动应用程序与客户互动、提供服务并鼓励客户购买。传统观点和先前的研究表明，应用程序对客户消费有积极影响。作者在一个竞争激烈的机构环境中对这一假设进行了批判性分析，通过估算客户在采用某酒店集团的应用程序后多渠道消费的变化情况，并识别导致这种变化的因素。利用客户采用应用程序的时间差异，并采用差异-差异方法，作者发现应用程序的采用对客户总体消费有显著的负面影响。进一步分析表明，采用特定应用程序的客户可能会同时采用竞争对手的应用程序，从而进行更多的搜索和比较购物，导致他们对特定酒店集团的消费份额减少。作者还发现，对于仅使用应用程序进行移动登记服务的客户来说，对消费的影响较小，这表明应用程序的互动作用有助于减轻负面影响。

abstract.text: Medicare's Hospital Value-Based Purchasing Program (HVBP) is the first national pay-for-performance program to combine measures of quality of care with a measure of episode spending. We estimated the implicit tradeoffs between mortality reduction and spending reduction. To earn points in HVBP, a hospital can either lower mortality or reduce spending, creating a tradeoff between the 2 measures. We analyzed the quality performance and earned points of 2814 hospitals using publicly available data. We then quantified the tradeoffs between spending and mortality in terms of quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs). If incentives in the program were balanced, then the tradeoff between spending and QALYs should be comparable with those of high-value health interventions, roughly $50,000 to $200,000 per QALY. Instead, the tradeoff in HVBP was about $1.2 million per QALY. HVBP overvalues improvements in quality of care relative to spending reductions. We propose 2 possible policy adjustments that could improve incentives for hospitals to deliver high-value care.

10.1177/0272989x211017105.abstractZh: Medicare的基于医院价值的采购计划（HVBP）是首个将护理质量指标与病例支出指标相结合的全国性绩效支付计划。我们估算了降低死亡率与减少支出之间的隐含权衡。为了获得HVBP的积分，医院可以选择降低死亡率或减少支出，从而在这两个指标之间做出权衡。我们利用公开数据分析了2814家医院的质量表现和获得的积分。随后，我们以质量调整生命年（QALYs）为单位，量化了支出与死亡率之间的权衡。如果该计划的激励措施平衡得当，那么支出与QALYs之间的权衡应与高价值健康干预措施相当，大约每QALY需要5万至20万美元。然而，HVBP中的权衡约为每QALY120万美元。HVBP对护理质量改善的估值高于减少支出的效果。我们提出了两种可能的政策调整方案，以激励医院提供高价值的护理服务。

abstract.text: This study explores whether public personnel systems, particularly their compensation systems, are flexible and responsive to market wages in a competitive labor market. Focusing on registered nurses, we explore whether and how the public, private nonprofit, and for-profit labor markets influence each other in determining wages. We also examine if sector plays a role in determining wages. We use American Community Survey data from 2016 and 2017 to test these expectations. Fixed effects regressions and seemingly unrelated regressions with Chow tests reveal that higher wages in the dominant for-profit sector appear to drive up wages in the other two sectors, and vice versa. The results imply that public personnel systems are not so rigid and inflexible as perceived. Rather, they are sensitive to supply and demand and offer wages responding to competition from other sectors. Moreover, public employees do not ignore competitive opportunities in alternative employment markets in the private sectors. Students of public employment should not overlook the private sectors either. The markets are distinctive but not independent.

10.1177/02750740211032574.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了公共人事系统，尤其是其薪酬体系，在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中是否具备灵活性，能否对市场工资做出响应。以注册护士为例，我们探讨了公共部门、私人非营利部门和营利性部门之间的相互作用如何影响工资水平。我们还考察了行业在决定工资方面的作用。我们使用2016年和2017年的美国社区调查数据来验证这些假设。固定效应回归和看似无关的回归分析结合Chow检验的结果表明，营利性部门较高的工资似乎会推动其他两个部门的工资上升，反之亦然。研究结果表明，公共人事系统并不像人们想象的那样僵化、不灵活。相反，它们对供需情况非常敏感，能够根据其他部门的竞争情况调整工资水平。此外，公共雇员并不会忽视私营部门中的竞争机会。研究公共就业问题的学者也不应忽视私营部门的作用。这些市场虽然有所不同，但并非相互独立。

abstract.text: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services implemented the Inpatient Psychiatric Facility Quality Reporting Program in 2012, which publicly reports facilities' performance on restraint and seclusion (R-S) measures. Using data from Massachusetts, we examined whether nonprofits and for-profits responded differently to the program on targeted indicators, and if the program had a differential spillover effect on nontargeted indicators of quality by ownership. Episodes of R-S (targeted), complaints (nontargeted), and discharges were obtained for 2008-2017 through public records requests to the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Using difference-in-differences estimators, we found no differential changes in R-S between for-profits and nonprofits. However, for-profits had larger increases in overall complaints, safety-related complaints, abuse-related complaints, and R-S-related complaints compared with nonprofits. This is the first study to examine the effects of a national public reporting program among psychiatric facilities on nontargeted measures. Researchers and policymakers should further scrutinize intended and unintended consequences of performance-reporting programs.

10.1177/1077558721998924.abstractZh: 2012年，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心实施了住院精神科设施质量报告计划，该计划公开报告各设施在约束和隔离措施方面的表现。通过马萨诸塞州的数据，我们研究了非营利组织和营利组织对该计划的反应是否存在差异，以及该计划是否对不同所有制性质的精神科设施的非目标质量指标产生了不同的影响。我们通过对马萨诸塞州公共记录请求获取2008-2017年的约束和隔离措施实施情况、投诉情况以及出院数据。利用差异差分估计方法，我们发现营利组织和非营利组织在约束和隔离措施实施情况上没有差异。然而，与非营利组织相比，营利组织在总体投诉、与安全问题相关的投诉、与虐待相关的投诉以及与约束和隔离措施相关的投诉方面有所增加。这是首次研究全国性公共报告计划对精神科设施非目标指标的影响。研究人员和政策制定者应进一步审视绩效报告计划带来的预期和非预期后果。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: County hospitals as the backbone of the China's healthcare system are providing services for over 70% of the total population. However, the hospital management practice (HMP) and its links with quality of care, efficiency and finance in these hospitals are unknown. METHODS: We did two cross-sectional surveys of HMP in 2013 and 2015 among 101 county hospitals across rural China. Three managing roles (hospital director, director of medical affairs office and director of cardiology) and a cardiologist were invited to the surveys. A novel HMP rating scale, with 100 as full score, was used to measure the HMP in 17 indicators under four dimensions (target, operation, performance, and talent management) for each hospital. We analyzed the association of HMP score with variables on quality of care, efficiency and finance using linear mixed models with and without adjustment for potential confounders. FINDINGS: A total of 95 hospitals participated in at least one survey and were included in the analysis. The overall mean HMP score varied dramatically across the hospitals and 84% of them scored less than 60. The dimension mean HMP score was 38.6 (target), 56.4 (operation), 53.2 (performance) and 55.7 (talent), respectively. The pattern of indicator mean HMP score, however, was almost identical between hospitals with high and low overall HMP score, showing the same 'strength' (staff satisfaction, staff performance appraisal, 'hard wares', patient-centered services, etc.) and 'weakness' (target balance, target setting, continuous quality improvement, penalties on staff with dissatisfied performance, etc.). The associations of overall mean HMP score with quality of care and efficiency variables and cost per hospitalization was not statistically significant. The statistical significance in the association with hospital annual total income disappeared after adjusting for region, teaching status, number of competitors, number of staff and number of beds in use. CONCLUSION: The HMP in Chinese county hospitals scores low in general and was not significantly associated with hospital care quality, efficiency and finance. The current healthcare reform in China should address the micro level issues in hospital management practices.

10.1186/s12913-021-06472-7.abstractZh: 背景：作为中国医疗体系的支柱，县级医院为超过70%的人口提供医疗服务。然而，这些医院的管理实践及其与护理质量、效率和财务的关系尚不明确。方法：我们在2013年和2015年对中国农村地区的101家县级医院进行了两次关于管理实践的横断面调查。邀请了三位管理职务人员（医院院长、医务办公室主任和心脏病科主任）以及一名心脏病专家参与调查。我们使用一种新颖的管理实践评分体系，该体系满分为100分，用于评估每家医院在四个维度（目标、运营、绩效和人才管理）下的17个指标。我们通过线性混合模型分析管理实践得分与护理质量、效率和财务变量之间的关联，同时考虑了潜在的混杂因素。结果：共有95家医院至少参与了一项调查并纳入了分析。各医院的整体管理实践得分差异较大，其中84%的医院的得分低于60分。四个维度的平均得分分别为：目标38.6分、运营56.4分、绩效53.2分、人才55.7分。然而，不同管理实践得分的医院在指标平均得分方面几乎没有差异，显示出相同的“优势”（如员工满意度、员工绩效评估、“硬件设施”、以患者为中心的服务等）和“劣势”（如目标平衡、目标设定、持续的质量改进、对表现不佳的员工进行处罚等）。整体管理实践得分与护理质量和效率变量以及每例住院费用之间的关联并不具有统计学意义。在调整了地区、教学状况、竞争对手数量、员工数量以及使用中的床位数量后，医院年度总收入与医院绩效之间的关联统计显著性消失。结论：中国县级医院的绩效指标整体较低，并且与医院护理质量、效率及财务状况之间没有显著关联。当前中国的医疗改革应当关注医院管理实践中的微观层面问题。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Differences in ownership types have attracted considerable interest because of policy implications. Moreover, competition in hospital markets is promoted to reduce health care spending. However, the effects of system membership and competition on treatment choices of hospitals have not been considered in studying hospital ownership types. We examine the treatment choices of hospitals considering ownership types (not-for-profit, for-profit, and government), system membership, patient insurance status (insured, and uninsured) and hospital competition in the United States. METHODS: We estimate the probability of according the procedure as the treatment employing logistic regression. We consider all procedures accorded at hospitals, controlling for procedure type and diagnosis as well as relevant patient and hospital characteristics. Competition faced by hospitals is measured using a distance-weighted approach separately for procedural groups. Patient records are obtained from State Inpatient Databases for 11 states and hospital characteristics come from American Hospital Association Annual Survey. RESULTS: Not-for-profit hospitals facing low for-profit competition that are nonmembers of hospital systems, act like government hospitals, whereas not-for-profits facing high for-profit competition and system member not-for-profits facing low for-profit competition are not statistically significantly different from their for-profit counterparts in terms of treatment choices. Uninsured patients are on average 7% less likely to be accorded the procedure as the treatment at system member not-for-profit hospitals facing high for-profit competition than insured patients. System member not-for-profit hospitals, which account for over half of the observations in the analysis, are on average 16% more likely to accord the procedure as the treatment when facing high for-profit competition than low-for-profit competition. CONCLUSIONS: We show that treatment choices of hospitals differ by system membership and the level of for-profit competition faced by the hospitals in addition to hospital ownership type and health insurance status of patients. Our results support that hospital system member not-for-profits and not-for-profits facing high for-profit competition are for-profits in disguise. Therefore, system membership is an important characteristic to consider in addition to market competitiveness when tax exemption of not-for-profits are revisited. Moreover, higher competition may lead to increasing health care costs due to more aggressive treatment choices, which should be taken into account while regulating hospital markets.

10.1186/s13561-021-00305-3.abstractZh:
背景：所有权类型的差异因政策影响而受到广泛关注。此外，医院市场的竞争旨在减少医疗保健支出。然而，在研究医院所有权类型时，并未考虑系统成员资格和竞争对医院治疗选择的影响。我们研究了美国不同所有权类型（非营利、营利和政府）的医院治疗选择，以及系统成员资格、患者保险状况（有保险和无保险）和医院竞争情况。

方法：我们使用逻辑回归估计将某项手术作为治疗选择的概率。我们考虑了医院提供的所有手术，同时控制了手术类型和诊断情况，以及相关的患者和医院特征。医院面临的竞争通过距离加权方法分别针对不同的手术组进行衡量。患者记录来自11个州的州立住院数据库，医院特征则来自美国医院协会年度调查。

结果：面临低水平营利性竞争且不属于医院系统的非营利医院，其行为类似于政府医院；而面临高水平营利性竞争的非营利医院和属于医院系统的非营利医院，在治疗选择方面与营利性医院没有统计学上的显著差异。与有保险的患者相比，无保险患者在属于医院系统的非营利医院且面临高水平营利性竞争的情况下，接受该手术的概率平均低7%。在分析中，超过一半的观测数据来自系统内的非营利医院。与低营利竞争相比，这些医院在面临高营利竞争时，将某项治疗视为治疗的可能性平均高出16%。结论表明，医院的治疗选择受到系统成员身份以及医院所面临的营利竞争程度的影响，此外还受到医院所有权类型和患者健康保险状况的影响。我们的研究结果支持这一观点：系统内的非营利医院以及在高营利竞争环境下表现出的非营利医院，实际上可能是营利性医院。因此，在重新审视非营利机构的税收豁免政策时，系统成员身份是一个重要的考虑因素，除了市场竞争力之外。此外，较高的竞争程度可能导致更高的医疗成本，因为医院会采取更激进的治疗选择，这一点在监管医院市场时应予以考虑。

abstract.text: This paper studies bargaining with noncommon priors where the buyer projects and exaggerates the probability that her private information may leak to the seller. Letting the buyer name her price first, raises the seller’s payoff above his payoff from posting a price. In seller-offer bargaining, projection implies a partial reversal of classic Coasian comparative static results. Weakening price commitment can benefit the seller and, as long as the relative speed at which imaginary information versus offers arrive does not converge to zero too quickly, frictionless bargaining converges to a fast haggling process which allows the seller to extract all surplus from trade. Bargaining under common prior transparency is instead slow and becomes equivalent to simply waiting. The comparative static predictions are consistent with experimental evidence. (JEL C78, D82)

10.1257/aer.20150004.abstractZh: 本文研究了在非常见先验条件下的讨价还价行为，其中买方会夸大其私人信息可能泄露给卖方的概率。让买方先提出价格，会使卖方的收益高于他直接标价时的收益。在卖方出价的讨价还价过程中，这种预测行为意味着经典Coasian比较静态结果的部分逆转。降低价格承诺的约束力可以有利于卖方，只要想象中的信息到达速度与出价到达的速度不会过快地趋于零，那么无摩擦的讨价还价过程就能快速进行，从而使卖方能够从交易中获取全部收益。而在常见先验条件透明的情况下，讨价还价过程则较为缓慢，最终等同于简单的等待。这些比较静态的预测结果与实验证据是一致的。（JEL C78, D82）

abstract.text: School choice systems aspire to delink residential location and school assignments by allowing children to apply to schools outside of their neighborhood. However, choice programs also affect incentives to live in certain neighborhoods, and this feedback may undermine the goals of choice. We investigate this possibility by developing a model of public school and residential choice. School choice narrows the range between the highest and lowest quality schools compared to neighborhood assignment rules, and these changes in school quality are capitalized into equilibrium housing prices. This compressed distribution generates an ends-against-the-middle trade-off with school choice compared to neighborhood assignment. Paradoxically, even when choice results in improvement in the lowest-performing schools, the lowest type residents need not benefit. (JEL H75, I21, I28, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.20151147.abstractZh: 学校选择制度旨在将居住地点与学校分配分离，通过允许儿童申请社区以外的学校来实现这一目标。然而，选择制度也会影响人们居住在特定社区的动机，这种反馈可能会破坏选择制度的目标。我们通过建立公立学校与居住选择的模型来研究这种可能性。与社区分配规则相比，学校选择缩小了优质学校与劣质学校之间的差距，而这些学校质量的改变会被纳入均衡房价中。这种压缩的分布方式导致学校选择与社区分配之间存在一种“以牺牲中间群体为代价”的权衡。矛盾的是，即使选择制度能够改善表现最差的学校，最低端类型的居民却未必从中受益。（JEL H75, I21, I28, R23, R31）

abstract.text: We study how opening to trade affects economic growth in a model where heterogeneous firms can adopt new technologies already in use by other firms in their home country. We characterize the growth rate using a summary statistic of the profit distribution: the mean-min ratio. Opening to trade increases the profit spread through increased export opportunities and foreign competition, induces more rapid technology adoption, and generates faster growth. Quantitatively, these forces produce large welfare gains from trade by increasing an inefficiently low rate of technology adoption and economic growth. (JEL D21, D24, F14, F43, O33)

10.1257/aer.20151645.abstractZh: 我们研究了对贸易开放如何影响经济增长的问题，所采用的模型允许不同性质的企业采用其本国其他企业已经使用的新技术。我们通过利润分布的汇总统计量来描述经济增长率：均值与最小值的比率。对贸易的开放通过增加出口机会和外国竞争，促使企业更快地采用新技术，从而加速经济增长。从数量上看，这些力量通过提高技术采用率和经济增长率，为贸易带来了巨大的福利收益。（JEL D21, D24, F14, F43, O33）

abstract.text: School policies that cause a large demand shift between public and private schooling may cause some private schools to enter or exit the market. We study how the policy effects differ under a fixed versus changing market structure in the context of a public school funding reform in New York City. We find evidence of a reduction in private schools in response to the reform. Using a model of demand for and supply of private schooling, we estimate that 20 percent of the reform’s effect on school enrollments came from increased private school exit and reduced private school entry. (JEL H75, I21, I22, I28)

10.1257/aer.20151723.abstractZh: 学校政策导致公立与私立教育之间的需求大幅转移，这可能会导致一些私立学校进入或退出市场。我们研究了在纽约市公立学校资金改革背景下，政策效应在固定市场结构与可变市场结构下的差异。我们发现，改革导致私立学校数量减少。通过构建私立教育需求与供给模型，我们估计改革对学校注册量的影响中，有20%来自私立学校的退出增加和进入减少。（JEL H75, I21, I22, I28）

abstract.text: Most individual life insurance policies lapse, with lapsers cross-subsidizing non-lapsers. We show that policies and lapse patterns predicted by standard rational expectations models are the opposite of those observed empirically. We propose two behavioral models consistent with the evidence: (i) consumers forget to pay premiums and (ii) consumers understate future liquidity needs. We conduct two surveys with a large insurer. New buyers believe that their own lapse probabilities are small compared to the insurer’s actual experience. For recent lapsers, forgetfulness accounts for 37.8 percent of lapses while unexpected liquidity accounts for 15.4 percent. (JEL D91, G22, G52)

10.1257/aer.20160868.abstractZh: 大多数个人人寿保险保单会失效，而失效的保单持有人会为未失效的保单持有人提供交叉补贴。我们发现，标准理性预期模型所预测的保单失效模式和实际观察到的模式相反。我们提出了两种与现有证据一致的行为模型：(i) 消费者忘记支付保费；(ii) 消费者低估了未来的流动性需求。我们与一家大型保险公司进行了两项调查。新购买保单的消费者认为，与保险公司实际经历相比，他们自己的失效概率很小。对于最近失效的保单持有人来说，健忘行为导致了37.8%的失效案例，而意外的流动性问题则导致了15.4%的失效案例。(JEL D91, G22, G52)

abstract.text: Do political elites use armed groups to foster civilian participation in genocidal violence? Are armed groups employed strategically? How do they mobilize civilians? I investigate these questions using data from the Rwandan Genocide. To establish causality, I exploit exogenous variation in armed groups’ transport costs induced by weather fluctuations: the shortest distance of each village to the main road interacted with rainfall along the dirt tracks between main road and village. I find (i) 1 additional armed-group member resulted in 7.3 more civilian perpetrators; (ii) armed-group leaders employed their men strategically; and (iii) armed groups invoked civilians’ obedience. (JEL D72, D74, O17, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20160999.abstractZh: 政治精英是否利用武装团体来促进平民参与种族灭绝暴力行为？武装团体是否被战略性地运用？他们是如何动员平民的？我利用卢旺达种族灭绝事件的数据来研究这些问题。为了建立因果关系，我利用了武装团体运输成本因天气波动而产生的外部变化：每个村庄到主干道的最短距离与主干道与村庄之间的土路上的降雨量相互作用。我发现：(i) 每增加一个武装团体成员，就会有7.3名平民实施暴力行为；(ii) 武装团体的领导者会战略性地调动人员；(iii) 武装团体通过施加压力来迫使平民服从。(JEL D72, D74, O17, Q54)

abstract.text: Several K-12 and university systems have adopted race-neutral affirmative action in place of race-based alternatives. This paper explores whether these plans are effective substitutes for racial quotas in Chicago Public Schools (CPS), which now employs a race-neutral, place-based affirmative action system at its selective exam high schools. The CPS plan is ineffective compared to plans that explicitly consider race: about three-quarters of the reduction in average entrance scores at the top schools could have been avoided with the same level of racial diversity. Moreover, the CPS plan is less effective at adding low-income students than was the previous system of racial quotas. We develop a theoretical framework that motivates quantifying the inefficiency of race-neutral policies based on the distortion in student preparedness they create for a given level of diversity and use it to evaluate several alternatives. The CPS plan can be improved in several ways, but no race-neutral policy restores minority representation to prior levels without substantially greater distortions, implying significant efficiency costs from prohibitions on the explicit use of race. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15)

10.1257/aer.20161290.abstractZh: 一些K-12学校和大学系统已经采用了不基于种族的平权措施，以替代基于种族的替代方案。本文探讨了这些计划是否能够有效替代芝加哥公立学校的种族配额制度。目前，芝加哥公立学校在其选拔性考试高中中采用了不基于种族的、基于地区的平权措施。与明确考虑种族的计划相比，芝加哥公立学校的计划效果较差：在顶尖学校中，大约四分之三的平均入学分数降低情况可以通过保持相同的种族多样性水平来避免。此外，芝加哥公立学校的计划在增加低收入学生方面效果不如之前的种族配额制度。我们建立了一个理论框架，用于量化不基于种族的政策在给定多样性水平下的低效性，并利用该框架来评估几种替代方案。芝加哥公立学校的计划可以通过多种方式进行改进，但没有一种不基于种族的政策能够在不造成更大扭曲的情况下恢复少数族裔的代表性，这意味着禁止明确使用种族因素会带来显著的效率成本。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15）

abstract.text: I study the aggregate implications of micro-level lumpy investment in a model consistent with the empirical dynamics of the real interest rate. The elasticity of aggregate investment with respect to shocks is procyclical because more firms are likely to make an extensive margin investment in expansions than in recessions. Matching the dynamics of the real interest rate is key to generating this result because it disciplines the interest-elasticity of investment and avoids counterfactual behavior of the model that would otherwise eliminate most of the procyclical responsiveness. Therefore, data on interest rates place important discipline in aggregating micro-level investment behavior. (JEL D25, E13, E22, E23, E43, G31, H25)

10.1257/aer.20161723.abstractZh: 我研究微观层面非均匀投资对整体影响的机制，该模型与实际利率的动态变化相一致。整体投资对冲击的弹性具有顺周期性，因为在扩张时期，更多的企业可能会进行大规模投资，而在衰退时期则不会。匹配实际利率的动态变化是得出这一结果的关键，因为它限制了投资的利息弹性，避免了模型中出现反事实行为，从而消除了大部分顺周期反应。因此，利率数据在汇总微观层面的投资行为方面起到了重要的约束作用。（JEL D25, E13, E22, E23, E43, G31, H25）

abstract.text: We study subgame-perfect implementation (SPI) mechanisms that have been proposed as a solution to incomplete contracting problems. We show that these mechanisms, which are based on off-equilibrium arbitration clauses that impose large fines for lying and the inappropriate use of arbitration, have severe behavioral constraints because the fines induce retaliation against legitimate uses of arbitration. Incorporating reciprocity preferences into the theory explains the observed behavioral patterns and helps us develop a new mechanism that is more robust and achieves high rates of truth-telling and efficiency. Our results highlight the importance of tailoring implementation mechanisms to the underlying behavioral environment. (JEL C92, D44, D82, D86, D91)

10.1257/aer.20170297.abstractZh: 我们研究了被提出作为解决不完全契约问题的解决方案的子博弈完美实施机制。我们发现，这些基于非均衡仲裁条款的机制，通过设定对撒谎和不当使用仲裁的巨额罚款，实际上带来了严重的行为约束，因为罚款会促使人们抵制合法使用仲裁的行为。将互惠偏好纳入理论分析中，可以解释观察到的行为模式，并帮助我们开发出一种更稳健的新机制，该机制能够实现更高的诚实率和效率。我们的研究结果强调了根据潜在的行为环境来定制实施机制的重要性。（JEL C92, D44, D82, D86, D91）

abstract.text: Consumers’ health plan choices are highly persistent even though optimal plans change over time. This paper separates two sources of inertia, inattention to plan choice and switching costs. We develop a panel data model with separate attention and choice stages, linked by heterogeneity in acuity, i.e., the ability and willingness to make diligent choices. Using data from Medicare Part D, we find that inattention is an important source of inertia but switching costs also play a role, particularly for low-acuity individuals. Separating the two stages and allowing for heterogeneity is crucial for counterfactual simulations of interventions that reduce inertia. (JEL D12, G22, H51, I13, I18, L65)

10.1257/aer.20170471.abstractZh: 消费者的健康计划选择具有高度的持久性，即使最优计划随时间发生变化。本文区分了两种导致惯性的因素：对计划选择的忽视和转换成本。我们建立了一个包含选择阶段和关注阶段的分组数据模型，这两个阶段通过不同程度的能力与意愿来连接，即做出谨慎选择的能力与意愿。利用Medicare Part D的数据，我们发现忽视是惯性的重要来源，但转换成本也起着作用，尤其是在低能力个体中。将这两个阶段分开并考虑异质性，对于模拟减少惯性的干预措施至关重要。（JEL D12, G22, H51, I13, I18, L65）

abstract.text: This paper provides field evidence on how reference points adjust, a degree of freedom in reference-dependence models. Examining this in the context of cabdrivers’ daily labor-supply behavior, we ask how the within-day timing of earnings affects decisions. Drivers work less in response to higher accumulated income, with a strong effect for recent earnings that gradually diminishes for earlier earnings. We estimate a structural model in which drivers work toward a reference point that adjusts to deviations from expected earnings with a lag. This dynamic view of reference dependence reconciles conflicting “neoclassical” and “behavioral” interpretations of evidence on daily labor-supply decisions. (JEL J22, J31, L94)

10.1257/aer.20170768.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于参考点如何调整的证据，这是参考依赖性模型中的一种自由度。在出租车司机日常劳动供应行为的背景下进行考察，我们探讨了收入在一天内的时间分布如何影响决策。司机在收入累积较高时工作时间减少，对于近期收入的影响尤为显著，而对于较早的收入影响则逐渐减弱。我们建立了一个结构模型，其中司机的工作目标是达到一个参考点，该参考点会根据预期收入的偏差而滞后调整。这种对参考依赖性的动态视角，有助于调和“新古典主义”和“行为主义”对日常劳动供应决策的不同解释。（JEL J22, J31, L94）

abstract.text: We examine US children whose parents won the lottery to trace out the effect of financial resources on college attendance. The analysis leverages federal tax and financial aid records and substantial variation in win size and timing. While per-dollar effects are modest, the relationship is weakly concave, with a high upper bound for amounts greatly exceeding college costs. Effects are smaller among low-SES households, not sensitive to how early in adolescence the shock occurs, and not moderated by financial aid crowd-out. The results imply that households derive consumption value from college, and household financial constraints alone do not inhibit attendance. (JEL G51, I22, I23, I24, I26, I28, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20171272.abstractZh: 我们研究了那些父母中有人中彩票的美国儿童，以探究财务资源对大学入学率的影响。分析利用了联邦税收和财政援助记录，并考虑了中奖金额和时间的显著差异。虽然每美元的影响幅度较小，但这种关系呈弱凹性，即中奖金额有很高的上限，远远超过大学学费。在低收入家庭群体中，这种影响较小，且不受青少年时期中奖时间的影响，同时也不受财政援助的挤出效应调节。研究结果表明，家庭从大学教育中获得消费价值，而单纯的家庭财务限制并不能阻止儿童进入大学。（JEL G51, I22, I23, I24, I26, I28, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Historical anecdotes abound of new investors being drawn into a booming asset market, only to suffer when the market turns. While the role of investor contagion in asset bubbles has been explored extensively in the theoretical literature, causal empirical evidence on the topic is much rarer. This paper studies the recent boom and bust in the US housing market and establishes that many novice investors entered the market as a direct result of observing investing activity of multiple forms in their own neighborhoods and that “infected” investors performed poorly relative to other investors along several dimensions. (JEL D84, G12, G51, R31)

10.1257/aer.20171611.abstractZh: 关于新投资者被吸引到繁荣的资产市场，随后在市场逆转时遭受损失的案例屡见不鲜。虽然理论文献已经广泛探讨了投资者传染在资产泡沫中的作用，但关于这一主题的因果实证证据却较为罕见。本文研究了美国房地产市场近期的繁荣与萧条，发现许多新手投资者之所以进入市场，是因为他们观察到了自己所在社区中多种形式的投资活动，而那些“被传染”的投资者在多个维度上表现均不如其他投资者。（JEL D84, G12, G51, R31）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the long-run effects of childhood Medicaid eligibility on adult health and economic outcomes using the program’s original introduction ( 1966–1970) and its mandated coverage of welfare recipients. The design compares cohorts born in different years relative to Medicaid implementation, in states with different preexisting welfare-based eligibility. Early childhood Medicaid eligibility reduces mortality and disability, increases employment, and reduces receipt of disability transfer programs up to 50 years later. Medicaid has saved the government more than its original cost and saved more than 10 million quality adjusted life years. (JEL H51, I12, I18, I32, I38, J13)

10.1257/aer.20171671.abstractZh: 本文利用该计划最初的实施阶段（1966–1970年）以及其对福利领取者的强制覆盖情况，估算了儿童期获得医疗补助资格对成人健康和经济结果的长期影响。研究比较了在医疗补助实施前后出生的不同年份出生的群体，以及在不同福利资格体系下出生的群体。研究发现，儿童期获得医疗补助资格能够降低死亡率和残疾率，增加就业率，并在50年后减少残疾救济金的领取。医疗补助为政府节省的成本超过了最初的成本，并额外节省了超过1000万质量调整生命年。（JEL H51, I12, I18, I32, I38, J13）

abstract.text: Using data on 800,000 corporate publications and patent citations to these publications between 1980 and 2015, we study how corporate investment in research is linked to its use in the firm’s inventions, and to spillovers to rivals. We find that private returns to corporate research depend on the balance between two opposing forces: the benefits from the use of science in own downstream inventions, and the costs of spillovers to rivals. Consistent with this, firms produce more research when it is used internally, but less research when it is used by rivals. As firms become more sensitive to rivals using their science, they are likely to reduce the share of research in R&D. (JEL D22, D25, G31, I23, O31, O33, O34)

10.1257/aer.20171742.abstractZh: 通过研究1980年至2015年间80万份企业出版物及其被引用的数据，我们探讨了企业研发投入与其在自身发明中的应用之间的关系，以及这些研发投入对竞争对手的溢出效应。研究发现，企业研发活动的私人收益取决于两种相反力量的平衡：一方面是利用科学成果进行自身下游发明的收益；另一方面则是向竞争对手进行技术溢出所带来的成本。与此一致的是，当研发成果用于企业内部时，企业会投入更多的研发资源；而当这些成果被竞争对手使用时，企业则会减少研发投入。随着企业越来越关注竞争对手对其技术的使用，它们可能会减少研发投资中的研发占比。（JEL D22, D25, G31, I23, O31, O33, O34）

abstract.text: US policy increasingly ties payments for providers to performance on quality measures, though little empirical evidence guides the design of such incentives. I deploy administrative data to study a large federal program that penalizes hospitals with high readmissions rates. Using policy-driven variation in the penalty incentive across hospitals for identification, I find that hospital responses to the penalty account for two-thirds of the observed decrease in readmissions over this period, as well as a decrease in heart attack mortality. Quality improvement accounts for about one-half of the decrease in readmissions; the remainder is explained by selective admission of returning patients. (JEL G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, I18)

10.1257/aer.20171825.abstractZh: 美国的政策越来越将提供者的支付与质量指标的绩效挂钩，尽管几乎没有实证证据来指导这种激励机制的设计。我利用行政数据研究了一个大型联邦项目，该项目对高再入院率的医院进行处罚。通过政策驱动的惩罚激励在医院之间的差异来识别问题，我发现医院对惩罚的反应解释了这一时期再入院率下降的三分之二，同时也导致了心脏病发作死亡率的下降。质量改进解释了再入院率下降的一半；其余部分则归因于对返回患者进行选择性收治的行为。（JEL G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, I18）

abstract.text: Between 1921 and 1956, French colonial governments organized medical campaigns to treat and prevent sleeping sickness. Villagers were forcibly examined and injected with medications with severe, sometimes fatal, side effects. We digitized 30 years of archival records to document the locations of campaign visits at a granular geographic level for five central African countries. We find that greater campaign exposure reduces vaccination rates and trust in medicine, as measured by willingness to consent to a blood test. We examine relevance for present-day health initiatives; World Bank projects in the health sector are less successful in areas with greater exposure. (JEL F54, I12, I15, I18, N37, N47, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20180284.abstractZh: 在1921年至1956年间，法国殖民政府组织了一系列医疗运动，以治疗和预防睡眠病。村民被强制接受检查，并注射含有严重副作用甚至致命风险的药物。我们数字化了30年的档案记录，详细记录了五个中非国家境内医疗运动的实施地点。研究发现，医疗运动的过度宣传会降低疫苗接种率和对医疗系统的信任度，具体表现为对血液检测的同意率下降。我们进一步探讨了这些现象对现代健康倡议的影响；世界银行在健康领域的项目在医疗运动影响较大的地区成效较差。（JEL F54, I12, I15, I18, N37, N47, Z13）

abstract.text: Economic theory suggests that energy subsidies can lead to excessive consumption and environmental degradation. However, the precise impact of energy subsidies is not well understood. We analyze a large energy subsidy: the California Alternate Rates for Energy (CARE). CARE provides a price reduction for low-income consumers of natural gas and electricity. Using a natural field experiment, we estimate the price elasticity of demand for natural gas to be about −0.35 for CARE customers. An economic model of this subsidy yields three results. First, the natural gas subsidy appears to reduce welfare. Second, the economic impact of various policies, such as cap-and-trade, depends on whether prices for various customers move closer to the marginal social cost. Third, benefits to CARE customers need to increase by 6 percent to offset the costs of the program. (JEL C93, D61, H24, L94, L95, L98, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20180441.abstractZh: 经济理论表明，能源补贴可能导致过度消费和环境恶化。然而，能源补贴的确切影响尚未得到充分理解。我们分析了一项重要的能源补贴——加州替代能源费率计划（CARE）。该计划为低收入消费者提供天然气和电力的价格优惠。通过自然实验，我们估计CARE用户的天然气需求价格弹性约为-0.35。对该补贴的经济模型分析得出三个结果：首先，天然气补贴似乎降低了福利水平；其次，各种政策（如总量控制与交易政策）的经济影响取决于不同消费者的价格是否接近边际社会成本；第三，CARE用户的收益需要增加6%才能抵消该项目的成本。（JEL C93, D61, H24, L94, L95, L98, Q48）

abstract.text: The social cost of carbon is the expected present value of damages from emitting one ton of carbon today. We use perturbation theory to derive an approximate tractable expression for this cost adjusted for climatic and economic risk. We allow for different aversion to risk and intertemporal fluctuations, skewness and dynamics in the risk distributions of climate sensitivity and the damage ratio, and correlated shocks. We identify prudence, insurance, and exposure effects, reproduce earlier analytical results, and offer analytical insights into numerical results on the effects of economic and damage ratio uncertainty and convex damages on the optimal carbon price. (JEL E12, G22, H23, O44, Q35, Q51, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20180517.abstractZh: 碳的社会成本是指今天排放一吨碳所带来的预期现值损失。我们采用扰动理论，推导出一种近似且易于处理的表达式，该表达式考虑了气候和经济风险的影响。我们考虑了不同的风险厌恶程度、时间上的波动、气候敏感度与损失比率风险分布的不对称性及动态变化，以及相关的冲击效应。我们识别了谨慎性、保险和暴露效应，并复现了早期的分析结果，同时对经济不确定性和损失比率不确定性以及凸形损失对最优碳价格的影响提供了分析上的见解。（JEL E12, G22, H23, O44, Q35, Q51, Q54）

abstract.text: Delegating managerial tasks is essential for firm growth. Most firms in developing countries, however, do not hire outside managers but instead rely on family members. In this paper, we ask if this lack of managerial delegation can explain why firms in poor countries are small and whether it has important aggregate consequences. We construct a model of firm growth where entrepreneurs have a fixed time endowment to run their daily operations. As firms grow large, the need to hire outside managers increases. Firms’ willingness to expand therefore depends on the ease with which delegation can take place. We calibrate the model to plant-level data from the United States and India. We identify the key parameters of our theory by targeting the experimental evidence on the effect of managerial practices on firm performance from Bloom et al. (2013). We find that inefficiencies in the delegation environment account for 11 percent of the income per capita difference between the United States and India. They also contribute to the small size of Indian producers, but would cause substantially more harm for US firms. The reason is that US firms are larger on average and managerial delegation is especially valuable for large firms, thus making delegation efficiency and other factors affecting firm growth complements. (JEL D22, G32, L25, L26, O14)

10.1257/aer.20180555.abstractZh: 委派管理任务对于企业成长至关重要。然而，大多数发展中国家的企业并不雇佣外部管理者，而是依赖家族成员来承担管理职责。本文探讨了这种管理委派缺失现象是否能够解释为什么贫困国家的企业规模较小，以及这一现象是否会产生重要的整体影响。我们构建了一个企业成长模型，其中企业家拥有固定的时间来运营日常业务。随着企业规模的扩大，雇佣外部管理者的需求也会增加。因此，企业扩张的意愿取决于委派过程的效率。我们根据美国和印度的工厂级数据对模型进行了校准。通过参考Bloom等人（2013年）关于管理实践对企业绩效影响的实验数据，我们确定了理论中的关键参数。研究发现，委派过程中的低效因素占美国和印度之间人均收入差异的11%。这些因素也导致了印度企业规模较小，但对美国企业则会造成更大的负面影响。原因在于，美国企业平均规模更大，管理委派对大型企业尤其有价值，因此委派效率以及其他影响企业成长的因素是互补的。（JEL D22, G32, L25, L26, O14）

abstract.text: Is credit expansion a sign of desirable financial deepening or the prelude to an inevitable bust? We study this question in modern US data using a structural VAR model of 10 monthly frequency variables, identified by heteroskedasticity. Negative reduced-form responses of output to credit growth are caused by endogenous monetary policy response to credit expansion shocks. On average, credit and output growth remain positively associated. “Financial stress” shocks to credit spreads cause declines in output and credit levels. Neither credit aggregates nor spreads provide much advance warning of the 2008–2009 crisis, but spreads improve within-crisis forecasts. (JEL C51, E23, E31, E43, E44, E52, G01)

10.1257/aer.20180733.abstractZh: 信贷扩张是金融深化发展的标志，还是经济衰退不可避免的前兆？我们采用结构向量自回归模型，基于现代美国数据研究了这一问题，该模型包含10个月度频率变量，并通过异方差性进行了识别。信贷增长对产出产生负向影响，这是由于货币政策对信贷扩张冲击的内生反应所致。总体而言，信贷增长与产出增长呈正相关关系。“金融压力”对信贷利差的影响会导致产出和信贷水平的下降。无论是信贷总量还是利差都无法提前预警2008-2009年的危机，但危机期间的利差预测有所改善。（JEL C51, E23, E31, E43, E44, E52, G01）

abstract.text: This paper estimates intertemporal labor supply responses to two-year long income tax holidays staggered across Swiss cantons. Cantons shifted from an income tax system based on the previous two years’ income to a standard annual pay as you earn system, leaving two years of income untaxed. We find significant but quantitatively very small responses of wage earnings with an intertemporal elasticity of 0.025 overall. High wage income earners and especially the self-employed display larger responses with elasticities around 0.1 and 0.25, respectively, most likely driven by tax avoidance. We find no effects along the extensive margin at all. (JEL H24, H26, J22, J23, J31, R23)

10.1257/aer.20180746.abstractZh: 本文估计了瑞士各州在两年期间实行所得税免税政策时，劳动力供给的跨时反应。各州从基于前两年收入的所得税制度转变为按实际收入征收标准的年度所得税制度，导致前两年的收入不受征税影响。我们发现，工资收入在跨时弹性方面表现出显著但数量上非常微小的变化，整体弹性为0.025。高收入者，尤其是个体经营者，其反应更为明显，弹性分别约为0.1和0.25，这很可能是由于税收规避行为所致。我们并未发现沿广泛边际有任何影响。（JEL H24, H26, J22, J23, J31, R23）

abstract.text: This paper studies whether adverse selection can rationalize a universal mandate for unemployment insurance (UI). Building on a unique feature of the unemployment policy in Sweden, where workers can opt for supplemental UI coverage above a minimum mandate, we provide the first direct evidence for adverse selection in UI and derive its implications for UI design. We find that the unemployment risk is more than twice as high for workers who buy supplemental coverage. Exploiting variation in risk and prices, we show how 25–30 percent of this correlation is driven by risk-based selection, with the remainder driven by moral hazard. Due to the moral hazard and despite the adverse selection we find that mandating the supplemental coverage to individuals with low willingness-to-pay would be suboptimal. We show under which conditions a design leaving choice to workers would dominate a UI system with a single mandate. In this design, using a subsidy for supplemental coverage is optimal and complementary to the use of a minimum mandate. (JEL D82, G22, J65)

10.1257/aer.20180820.abstractZh: 本文研究逆向选择是否能够为普遍强制实施失业保险提供合理性依据。基于瑞典失业保险政策的独特特征——工人可以选择额外获得失业保险保障，我们首次直接证明了失业保险中的逆向选择现象，并探讨了其对失业保险设计的影响。研究发现，购买额外保障的工人面临失业风险是普通工人的两倍以上。通过分析风险与价格的变化，我们发现其中25-30%的关联是由基于风险的选择所驱动的，其余部分则是由道德风险所导致。由于道德风险的存在，尽管存在逆向选择，但对支付意愿较低的个体强制要求额外保障并不理想。我们进一步探讨了在什么条件下，让工人自行选择的设计会比单一强制体系更具优势。在这种设计中，对额外保障提供补贴是最优选择，并且与最低强制标准相辅相成。（JEL D82, G22, J65）

abstract.text: We leverage a large-scale incentivized survey eliciting behaviors from (almost) an entire undergraduate university student population, a representative sample of the US population, and Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to address concerns about the external validity of experiments with student participants. Behavior in the student population offers bounds on behaviors in other populations, and correlations between behaviors are similar across samples. Furthermore, non-student samples exhibit higher levels of noise. Adding historical lab participation data, we find a small set of attributes over which lab participants differ from non-lab participants. An additional set of lab experiments shows no evidence of observer effects. (JEL C83, D90, D91)

10.1257/aer.20181065.abstractZh: 我们利用大规模激励性调查来收集（几乎）整个本科大学生群体的行为数据，这些学生代表了美国人口的一部分，同时借助亚马逊机械土耳其平台来研究实验参与者实验效度的相关问题。大学生群体的行为数据为其他人群的行为提供了参考界限，不同样本间的行为相关性也较为相似。此外，非大学生样本表现出更高的噪声水平。结合历史实验室参与数据，我们发现有一组属性使得实验室参与者与非实验室参与者之间存在差异。另外一些实验室实验并未显示出观察者效应的证据。（JEL C83, D90, D91）

abstract.text: The DeGroot model has emerged as a credible alternative to the standard Bayesian model for studying learning on networks, offering a natural way to model naïve learning in a complex setting. One unattractive aspect of this model is the assumption that the process starts with every node in the network having a signal. We study a natural extension of the DeGroot model that can deal with sparse initial signals. We show that an agent’s social influence in this generalized DeGroot model is essentially proportional to the degree-weighted share of uninformed nodes who will hear about an event for the first time via this agent. This characterization result then allows us to relate network geometry to information aggregation. We show information aggregation preserves “wisdom” in the sense that initial signals are weighed approximately equally in a model of network formation that captures the sparsity, clustering, and small-world properties of real-world networks. We also identify an example of a network structure where essentially only the signal of a single agent is aggregated, which helps us pinpoint a condition on the network structure necessary for almost full aggregation. Simulating the modeled learning process on a set of real-world networks, we find that there is on average 22.4 percent information loss in these networks. We also explore how correlation in the location of seeds can exacerbate aggregation failure. Simulations with real-world network data show that with clustered seeding, information loss climbs to 34.4 percent. (JEL D83, D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20181151.abstractZh: DeGroot模型已成为研究网络学习的一种可信替代方案，它提供了一种自然的方式来模拟复杂环境中的朴素学习过程。该模型的一个不吸引人的方面是假设网络中的每个节点都拥有一个信号。我们研究了DeGroot模型的一个自然扩展版本，该版本可以处理稀疏的初始信号。我们证明了在这个广义的DeGroot模型中，一个代理的社会影响力本质上与那些通过该代理首次听到事件的未知情节点的度加权份额成正比。这一表征结果使我们能够将网络几何结构与信息聚合联系起来。我们表明，信息聚合保留了“智慧”，因为在捕捉现实世界网络的稀疏性、聚类性和小世界特性的网络形成模型中，初始信号被大致同等地加权。我们还找到了一个网络结构的例子，其中基本上只有单个代理的信号被聚合，这帮助我们确定了网络结构上几乎完全聚合所需的条件。在一系列现实世界网络上模拟所建模的学习过程，我们发现这些网络中的信息损失平均达到了22.4%。我们还探讨了种子节点位置的相关性如何加剧聚合失败。使用现实世界网络数据的模拟显示，在节点聚集的情况下，信息损失上升到34.4%。(JEL D83, D85, Z13)

abstract.text: Intermittent monitoring of environmental standards may induce strategic changes in polluting activities. This paper documents local strategic responses to a cyclical, once-every-six-day air quality monitoring schedule under the federal Clean Air Act. Using satellite data of monitored areas, I show that air quality is significantly worse on unmonitored days. This effect is explained by short-term suppression of pollution on monitored days, especially during high-pollution periods when the city’s noncompliance risk is high. Cities’ use of air quality warnings increases on monitored days, which suggests local governments’ role in coordinating emission reductions. (JEL K32, Q35, Q58, R11)

10.1257/aer.20181346.abstractZh: 间歇性监测环境标准可能会引发污染活动的战略性变化。本文记录了在联邦《清洁空气法》下，当地对每六天一次空气质量监测安排的应对策略。通过卫星数据对监测区域进行分析，我们发现未监测的日子里空气质量明显更差。这种现象可以通过在监测日短期内抑制污染来解释，尤其是在污染严重的时期，城市违规的风险较高。在监测日里，城市对空气质量警告的使用频率增加，这表明地方政府在协调减排措施方面发挥了作用。（JEL K32, Q35, Q58, R11）

abstract.text: We dissect the impact of a large and sudden exchange rate appreciation on Swiss border import prices, retail prices, and consumer expenditures on domestic and imported nondurable goods, following the removal of the EUR/CHF floor in January 2015. Cross-sectional variation in border price changes by currency of invoicing carries over to consumer prices and allocations, impacting retail prices of imports and competing domestic goods, as well as import expenditures. We provide measures of the sensitivity of retail import prices to border prices and the sensitivity of import shares to relative prices, which is higher when using retail prices than border prices. (JEL E21, E31, F14, F31, L11)

10.1257/aer.20181415.abstractZh: 我们分析了2015年1月欧元/瑞士法郎汇率下限取消后，汇率大幅上涨对瑞士边境进口商品价格、零售价格以及国内和进口非耐用品消费支出的影响。不同货币计价方式下的边境价格变化在消费者价格和分配上表现出差异，这影响了进口商品及国内同类商品的零售价格，同时也影响了进口支出。我们提供了零售进口价格对边境价格敏感性的衡量指标，以及进口份额对相对价格的敏感性指标，后者在使用零售价格时比使用边境价格时更为敏感。（JEL E21, E31, F14, F31, L11）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effects of the lower bound for interest rates on the distributions of inflation and interest rates. In a New Keynesian model with a lower bound, two equilibria emerge: policy is mostly unconstrained in the “target equilibrium,” whereas policy is mostly constrained in the “liquidity trap equilibrium.” Using options data on interest rates and inflation, we find forecast densities consistent with the target equilibrium and find no evidence in favor of the liquidity trap equilibrium. The lower bound has a sizable effect on the distribution of interest rates, but its impact on inflation is relatively modest. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E43, E52, G13)

10.1257/aer.20181461.abstractZh: 本文分析了利率下限对通货膨胀和利率分布的影响。在一个具有利率下限的新凯恩斯模型中，会出现两种均衡状态：在“目标均衡”状态下，政策基本不受限制；而在“流动性陷阱均衡”状态下，政策则受到较大限制。通过利率和通货膨胀的期权数据，我们发现与目标均衡一致的预测密度，并且没有证据表明存在流动性陷阱均衡。利率下限对利率分布有显著影响，但对通货膨胀的影响相对温和。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E43, E52, G13）

abstract.text: We measure the effects of firm policies on racial pay differences in Brazil. Non-Whites are less likely to be hired by high-wage firms, explaining about 20 percent of the racial wage gap for both genders. Firm-specific pay premiums for non-Whites are also compressed relative to Whites, contributing another 5 percent for that gap. A counterfactual analysis reveals that about two-thirds of the underrepresentation of non-Whites at higher-wage firms is explained by race-neutral skill-based sorting. Non-skill-based sorting and differential wage setting are largest for college-educated workers, suggesting that the allocative costs of discriminatory hiring and pay policies may be relatively large in Brazil. (JEL J15, J24, J31, J41, J46, J71, O15)

10.1257/aer.20181596.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业政策对巴西种族薪酬差异的影响。非白人更不容易被高薪企业录用，这解释了男女种族薪酬差距的约20%。非白人相对于白人而言，企业内部的薪酬优势也有所压缩，这又增加了5%的薪酬差距。反事实分析表明，非白人在高薪企业中的代表性不足，大约三分之二的情况可以通过种族中立的技能排序来解释。非技能排序和差异化的薪酬设定在受过大学教育的工人中最为明显，这表明在巴西，歧视性招聘和薪酬政策所带来的分配成本可能相当高。（JEL J15, J24, J31, J41, J46, J71, O15）

abstract.text: We estimate the degree to which individual police officers practice racial discrimination. Using a bunching estimation design and data from the Florida Highway Patrol, we show that minorities are less likely to receive a discount on their speeding tickets than White drivers. Disaggregating this difference to the individual police officer, we estimate that 42 percent of officers practice discrimination. We then apply our officer- level discrimination measures to various policy-relevant questions in the literature. In particular, reassigning officers across locations based on their lenience can effectively reduce the aggregate disparity in treatment (JEL H76, J15, K42)

10.1257/aer.20181607.abstractZh: 我们估计了个别警察实施种族歧视的程度。通过采用捆绑估计方法，并利用佛罗里达州公路巡逻队的数据，我们发现少数族裔收到超速罚单时更难以获得折扣。进一步将这种差异分解为个别警察的行为，我们发现有42%的警察存在歧视行为。随后，我们将这些关于警察歧视的度量方法应用于文献中涉及政策相关问题的研究。具体而言，根据警察的宽容程度将其重新分配到不同的地点，可以有效减少整体待遇上的差异（JEL H76, J15, K42）。

abstract.text: Incentive problems make securities’ payoffs imperfectly pledgeable, limiting agents’ ability to issue liabilities. We analyze the equilibrium consequences of such endogenous incompleteness in a dynamic exchange economy. Because markets are endogenously incomplete, agents have different intertemporal marginal rates of substitution, so that they value assets differently. Consequently, agents hold different portfolios. This leads to endogenous markets segmentation, which we characterize with optimal transport methods. Moreover, there is a basis going always in the same direction: the price of a security is lower than that of replicating portfolios of long positions. Finally, equilibrium expected returns are concave in factor loadings. (JEL D51, D52, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.20181707.abstractZh: 激励问题使得证券的收益无法被完美地质押，从而限制了代理人发行负债的能力。我们分析了这种内生性不完整性在动态交换经济中的均衡后果。由于市场内生性不完整，代理人具有不同的跨时边际替代率，因此他们对资产的估值也不同。因此，代理人持有不同的投资组合。这导致了市场的内生性分割，我们通过最优传输方法来描述这一现象。此外，存在一个始终朝同一方向变化的基准：一种证券的价格低于其对应的长期头寸的复制投资组合的价格。最后，均衡预期回报在因子载荷上是凹的。（JEL D51, D52, G11, G12）

abstract.text: Analyzing account-level data from an account aggregator, we find that households increase consumption when they receive expected tax refunds, as if they face liquidity constraints. However, these same households smooth consumption when making payments in other years, primarily by transferring funds among liquid accounts. Even households carrying credit card debt smooth consumption when making payments, and even highly liquid households spend out of refunds. This behavior is inconsistent with pure liquidity constraints or hand-to-mouth behavior and is most consistent with a mental accounting life-cycle model. (JEL D12, E21, G51, H24, H31)

10.1257/aer.20181735.abstractZh: 通过对账户聚合器中的账户级数据进行分析，我们发现当家庭收到预期的税收退还时，他们会增加消费，仿佛面临流动性约束。然而，这些家庭在其他年份进行支付时会对消费进行平滑调整，主要是通过将资金转移到流动性较强的账户中来实现。即使是背负信用卡债务的家庭，在进行支付时也会对消费进行平滑调整，甚至流动性非常强的家庭也会将退税资金用于消费。这种行为与纯粹的流动性约束或生存行为不符，更符合心理账户生命周期模型的描述。（JEL D12, E21, G51, H24, H31）

abstract.text: We study a reform that granted European cross-border workers free access to the Swiss labor market and had a stronger effect on regions close to the border. The greater availability of cross-border workers increased foreign employment substantially. Although many cross-border workers were highly educated, wages of highly educated natives increased. The reason is a simultaneous increase in labor demand: the reform increased the size, productivity, and innovation performance of skill-intensive incumbent firms and attracted new firms, creating opportunities for natives to pursue managerial jobs. These effects are mainly driven by firms that reported skill shortages before the reform. (JEL J15, J23, J24, J31, J61, K37)

10.1257/aer.20181779.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项改革，该改革允许欧洲跨境工人自由进入瑞士劳动力市场，并且对靠近边境的地区产生了更大的影响。跨境工人的增加显著提升了外国就业人数。尽管许多跨境工人受教育程度较高，但当地本土人的工资却有所上升。原因在于劳动力需求的同步增加：该改革提升了技能密集型现有企业的规模、生产力和创新表现，同时吸引了新企业，为本土人提供了从事管理工作的机会。这些效应主要来自于那些在改革前就面临技能短缺的企业。（JEL J15, J23, J24, J31, J61, K37）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the long-run effects of Head Start using large-scale, restricted administrative data. Using the county rollout of Head Start between 1965 and 1980 and age-eligibility cutoffs for school entry, we find that Head Start generated large increases in adult human capital and economic self-sufficiency, including a 0.65-year increase in schooling, a 2.7 percent increase in high school completion, an 8.5 percent increase in college enrollment, and a 39 percent increase in college completion. These estimates imply sizable, long-term returns to investments in means-tested, public preschool programs.

10.1257/aer.20181801.abstractZh: 本文利用大规模、受限的行政数据评估“Head Start”项目的长期效应。通过研究1965至1980年间“Head Start”项目的实施情况以及儿童入学年龄的设定，我们发现该项目显著提升了成年人的人力资本和经济自给能力。具体表现为：受教育年限增加了0.65年，高中毕业率提高了2.7%，大学入学率提高了8.5%，大学毕业率则提高了39%。这些估计结果表明，对基于经济状况筛选的公立学前教育项目的投资具有显著的长期回报。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between domestic-demand shocks and exports using data for Spanish manufacturing firms in 2002–2013. Exploiting plausibly exogenous geographical variation caused by the Great Recession, we find that firms whose domestic sales declined by more experienced a larger increase in export flows, controlling for firms’ supply determinants. This result illustrates the capacity of export markets to counteract the negative impact of local demand shocks. By structurally estimating a heterogeneous-firm model of exporting with nonconstant marginal costs of production, we conclude that these firm-level responses accounted for half of the spectacular increase in Spanish goods exports over the period 2009–2013. (JEL D22, E32, F14, L60)

10.1257/aer.20181853.abstractZh: 我们研究了国内需求冲击与出口之间的关系，使用了2002至2013年间西班牙制造企业的数据。通过利用大衰退导致的地理差异，我们发现那些国内销售额下降幅度较大的企业，在控制企业供给因素的情况下，出口流量增长更为显著。这一结果表明，出口市场具有抵消国内需求冲击负面影响的能力。通过构建一个具有非恒定生产边际成本的异质企业出口模型，我们得出结论：这些企业层面的反应解释了2009至2013年间西班牙商品出口显著增长的一半原因。（JEL D22, E32, F14, L60）

abstract.text: How much ability does the Fed have to stimulate the economy by cutting interest rates? We argue that the presence of substantial debt in fixed-rate, prepayable mortgages means that the ability to stimulate the economy by cutting interest rates depends not just on their current level but also on their previous path. Using a household model of mortgage prepayment matched to detailed loan-level evidence on the relationship between prepayment and rate incentives, we argue that recent interest rate paths will generate substantial headwinds for future monetary stimuli. (JEL E32, E43, E52, E58, G21, G51)

10.1257/aer.20181857.abstractZh: 美联储通过降低利率来刺激经济的能力有多大？我们认为，固定利率、预付抵押贷款的巨额债务意味着，通过降低利率来刺激经济的能力不仅取决于当前的利率水平，还取决于其历史走势。基于一个家庭抵押贷款预付模型，并结合关于预付行为与利率激励之间关系的详细贷款数据，我们认为，当前的利率走势将给未来的货币刺激带来重大阻力。（JEL E32, E43, E52, E58, G21, G51）

abstract.text: We study reforms of nonlinear income tax systems from a political economy perspective. We present a median voter theorem for monotonic tax reforms, reforms so that the change in the tax burden is a monotonic function of income. We also provide an empirical analysis of tax reforms, with a focus on the United States. We show that past reforms have, by and large, been monotonic. We also show that support by the median voter was aligned with majority support in the population. Finally, we develop sufficient statistics that enable to test whether a given tax system admits a politically feasible reform. (JEL D72, H21, H24)

10.1257/aer.20190021.abstractZh: 我们从政治经济学的角度研究非线性所得税制度的改革。我们提出了一种针对单调税收改革的“中位选民定理”，即税收负担的变化是收入的单调函数。我们还对税收改革进行了实证分析，重点关注美国的情况。研究表明，过去的改革在很大程度上是单调的。此外，我们还发现中位选民的支持与大众的支持是一致的。最后，我们开发了足够的统计方法，可以用来测试某一税收制度是否允许进行政治上可行的改革。（JEL D72, H21, H24）

abstract.text: Policies may change the incentives that allow cultural practices to persist. To test this, I study matrilocality and patrilocality, kinship traditions that determine daughters’ and sons’ post-marriage residences, and thus, which gender lives with and supports parents in their old age. Two separate policy experiments in Ghana and Indonesia show that pension policies reduce the practice of these traditions. I also show that these traditions incentivize parents to invest in the education of children who traditionally coreside with them. Consequently, when pension plans change cultural practices, they also reduce educational investment. This finding further demonstrates that policy can change culture. (JEL G51, I20, J15, J16, J32, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20190098.abstractZh: 政策可以改变使文化习俗得以延续的激励机制。为了验证这一点，我研究了母系居住和父系居住这两种亲属传统，这些传统决定了女儿和儿子婚后居住的地方，从而决定了哪一类人在父母年老时与其同住并照顾他们。在加纳和印度尼西亚进行的两项独立政策实验表明，养老金政策减少了这些传统的实施。我还发现，这些传统激励父母投资于子女的教育，而传统上这些子女与父母同住。因此，当养老金计划改变文化习俗时，也会减少教育投资。这一发现进一步证明了政策能够改变文化。（JEL G51, I20, J15, J16, J32, Z13）

abstract.text: We present a new estimator for causal effects with panel data that builds on insights behind the widely used difference-in-differences and synthetic control methods. Relative to these methods we find, both theoretically and empirically, that this “synthetic difference-in-differences” estimator has desirable robustness properties, and that it performs well in settings where the conventional estimators are commonly used in practice. We study the asymptotic behavior of the estimator when the systematic part of the outcome model includes latent unit factors interacted with latent time factors, and we present conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality. (JEL C23, H25, H71, I18, L66)

10.1257/aer.20190159.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于面板数据因果效应的新估计方法，该方法基于广泛使用的差异-差异方法和合成控制方法背后的见解。与这些方法相比，我们从理论和实证角度发现，这种“合成差异-差异”估计方法具有理想的稳健性特性，并且在实践中常用传统估计方法的情况下表现良好。我们研究了当结果模型的系统部分包含与潜在时间因素交互作用的潜在单位因子时，该估计方法的渐近行为，并提出了一致性和渐近正态性的条件。（JEL C23, H25, H71, I18, L66）

abstract.text: This paper studies competitive allocations under adverse selection. We first provide a general necessary and sufficient condition for entry on an inactive market to be unprofitable. We then use this result to characterize, for an active market, a unique budget-balanced allocation implemented by a market tariff making additional trades with an entrant unprofitable. Motivated by the recursive structure of this allocation, we finally show that it emerges as the essentially unique equilibrium outcome of a discriminatory ascending auction. These results yield sharp predictions for competitive nonexclusive markets. (JEL D11, D43, D82, D86)
