10.1257/aer.20190189.abstractZh: 本文研究了在逆向选择情境下的竞争性分配问题。首先，我们提出了一种关于活跃市场中进入行为无利可图的一般必要充分条件。随后，我们利用这一结果来描述活跃市场中，由市场定价机制实施的唯一预算平衡分配情况，这种分配方式使得与进入者进行额外交易的行为变得无利可图。基于这种分配方式的递归结构，我们最终证明了它实际上是一个歧视性递增拍卖的唯一定义均衡结果。这些结果对于竞争性的非排他性市场提供了明确的预测。（JEL D11, D43, D82, D86）

abstract.text: Vote-buying mechanisms allow agents to express any level of support for their preferred alternative at an increasing cost. Focusing on large societies with wealth inequality, we prove that the family of binary social choice rules implemented by well-behaved vote-buying mechanisms is indexed by a single parameter, which determines the importance assigned to the agents’ willingness to pay to affect outcomes and to the number of supporters for each alternative. This parameter depends solely on the elasticity of the cost function near its origin: as this elasticity decreases, the intensities of support matter relatively more for outcomes than the supporters’ count. (JEL D63, D71, D72)

10.1257/aer.20190197.abstractZh: 投票购买机制允许代理人以递增的成本表达他们对首选方案的任何支持程度。针对存在财富不平等的大型社会，我们证明了由行为良好的投票购买机制实施的二元社会选择规则族，其性质由一个单一参数决定，该参数决定了赋予代理人支付意愿以影响结果的重要性，以及每个方案的支持者数量。这个参数仅取决于成本函数在其原点附近的弹性：随着这种弹性的降低，支持强度对于结果的影响相对更为重要，而非支持者数量。（JEL D63, D71, D72）

abstract.text: Empirical researchers often combine multiple instrumental variables (IVs) for a single treatment using two-stage least squares (2SLS). When treatment effects are heterogeneous, a common justification for including multiple IVs is that the 2SLS estimand can be given a causal interpretation as a positively weighted average of local average treatment effects (LATEs). This justification requires the well-known monotonicity condition. However, we show that with more than one instrument, this condition can only be satisfied if choice behavior is effectively homogeneous. Based on this finding, we consider the use of multiple IVs under a weaker, partial monotonicity condition. We characterize empirically verifiable sufficient and necessary conditions for the 2SLS estimand to be a positively weighted average of LATEs under partial monotonicity. We apply these results to an empirical analysis of the returns to college with multiple instruments. We show that the standard monotonicity condition is at odds with the data. Nevertheless, our empirical checks reveal that the 2SLS estimate retains a causal interpretation as a positively weighted average of the effects of college attendance among complier groups. (JEL C26, I23, I26, J24, J31, R23)

10.1257/aer.20190221.abstractZh: 实证研究人员经常使用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）来结合多个工具变量（IVs）对单个处理进行建模。当处理效应存在异质性时，包含多个工具变量的常见理由是，2SLS估计量可以被赋予因果解释，即作为局部平均处理效应（LATEs）的正向加权平均值。这一解释需要众所周知的单调性条件。然而，我们表明，在存在多个工具变量的情况下，这一条件只有在选择行为实际上具有同质性时才能满足。基于这一发现，我们考虑在较弱的局部单调性条件下使用多个工具变量。我们描述了在局部单调性条件下，2SLS估计量作为LATEs的正向加权平均值所需的充分条件和必要条件，这些条件可以通过实证验证。我们将这些结果应用于对具有多个工具变量的大学回报的实证分析。我们发现，标准的单调性条件与数据不符。尽管如此，我们的实证检验表明，2SLS估计量仍然可以作为一种因果解释，即作为遵守群体中大学出勤效应的正向加权平均值。（JEL C26, I23, I26, J24, J31, R23）

abstract.text: US federal transfers to individuals are large, countercyclical, vary geographically, and are often credited with helping to stabilize regional economies. This paper estimates the short-run effects of these transfers using plausibly exogenous regional variation in temporary stimulus payments and permanent Social Security benefit increases. States that received larger transfers tended to grow faster contemporaneously, with a multiplier of around 1.5 for permanent transfers and 1/3 for temporary transfers. Results are broadly consistent with an open-economy New Keynesian model. At business cycle frequencies, cross-region transfer multipliers are not large, suggesting only modest gains in regional stabilization from US federal automatic stabilizers. (JEL E12, E32, E62, H23, H55, R12)

10.1257/aer.20190240.abstractZh: 美国对个人的联邦转移支付规模较大，具有反周期性特征，且在不同地区存在差异，通常被认为有助于稳定区域经济。本文利用假设存在的地区性临时刺激支付和永久性社会保障福利增加的差异，估算了这些转移支付的短期效应。接受较大转移支付的州在同期经济增长速度较快，永久性转移支付的乘数约为1.5，临时转移支付的乘数约为1/3。研究结果与开放经济的新凯恩斯模型基本一致。在商业周期频率下，跨地区转移支付乘数并不大，这表明美国联邦自动稳定器对区域稳定的贡献较为有限。（JEL E12、E32、E62、H23、H55、R12）

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with learning decision-makers’ preferences using data on observed choices from a finite set of risky alternatives. We propose a discrete choice model with unobserved heterogeneity in consideration sets and in standard risk aversion. We obtain sufficient conditions for the model’s semi-nonparametric point identification, including in cases where consideration depends on preferences and on some of the exogenous variables. Our method yields an estimator that is easy to compute and is applicable in markets with large choice sets. We illustrate its properties using a dataset on property insurance purchases. (JEL D81, D83, D91, G22, G52)

10.1257/aer.20190253.abstractZh: 本文探讨了如何利用有限风险选择集合中的观测数据来学习决策者的偏好。我们提出了一个离散选择模型，该模型考虑了选择集合的标准风险厌恶特性以及未观测到的异质性。我们得出了模型半非参数点识别的充分条件，包括选择集合依赖于偏好和某些外生变量的情况。我们的方法提供了一种易于计算的估计量，适用于选择集合较大的市场。我们通过一个关于房产保险购买的数据集来说明该方法的特性。（JEL D81, D83, D91, G22, G52）

abstract.text: Using administrative payroll data from the largest US payroll processing company, we measure the extent of nominal wage rigidity in the United States. The data allow us to define a worker’s per-period base contract wage separately from other forms of compensation such as overtime premiums and bonuses. We provide evidence that firms use base wages to cyclically adjust the marginal cost of their workers. Nominal base wage declines are much rarer than previously thought with only 2 percent of job-stayers receiving a nominal base wage cut during a given year. Approximately 35 percent of workers receive no base wage change year over year. We document strong evidence of both time and state dependence in nominal base wage adjustments. In addition, we provide evidence that the flexibility of new hire base wages is similar to that of existing workers. Collectively, our results can be used to discipline models of nominal wage rigidity. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J41)

10.1257/aer.20190318.abstractZh: 我们利用美国最大的薪资处理公司的行政薪资数据，来衡量美国名义工资刚性程度。这些数据使我们能够将一个工人的年度基础工资与其他形式的报酬（如加班津贴和奖金）分开进行定义。我们有证据表明，企业利用基础工资来周期性地调整工人的边际成本。名义基础工资的下降比之前认为的要罕见得多，只有2%的在职员工在一年中面临名义基础工资的削减。大约35%的工人每年的基础工资没有变化。我们发现了名义基础工资调整在时间和州级上的强烈依赖性。此外，我们还发现新雇用员工的基础工资灵活性与现有员工相似。总体而言，我们的研究结果可以用来修正名义工资刚性模型。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J41）

abstract.text: We study the spending profile of workers who experience both a positive transitory income shock (lump-sum severance pay) and a negative permanent income shock (layoff). Using de-identified expenditure and employment data from Brazil, we show that workers increase spending at layoff by 35 percent despite experiencing a 14 percent long-term loss. We find high sensitivity of spending to cash-on-hand across consumption categories and for several sources of variation, including predictable income drops. A model with present-biased workers can rationalize our findings, and highlights the importance of the timing of benefit disbursement for the consumption-smoothing gains of job displacement insurance policies. (JEL D12, G51, J65, J63, O12)

10.1257/aer.20190388.abstractZh: 我们研究了同时经历正向短暂收入冲击（一次性离职补偿）和负向永久性收入冲击（裁员）的工人的消费行为。利用来自巴西的去匿名化支出和就业数据，我们发现尽管工人经历了14%的长期收入损失，但在裁员后他们的消费增加了35%。我们发现，不同消费类别以及包括可预测的收入下降在内的多种变量因素都显著影响了工人的现金持有量。一个以当前为导向的工人模型可以解释我们的研究结果，并强调了福利发放时机对于缓解失业影响的重要性。（JEL D12, G51, J65, J63, O12）

abstract.text: We propose and develop a dynamic theory of endogenous preference formation in which people adopt worldviews that shape their judgments about their experiences. The framework highlights the role of mindset flexibility, a trait that determines the relative weights the decision-maker places on her current and anticipated worldviews when evaluating future outcomes. The theory generates rich behavioral dynamics, thereby illuminating a wide range of applications and providing potential explanations for a variety of observed phenomena. (JEL D11, D81, D91, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20190390.abstractZh: 我们提出并发展了一种动态的内生偏好形成理论，其中人们采纳的世界观会塑造他们对自身经历的判断。该框架强调了心态灵活性的作用，这一特质决定了决策者在评估未来结果时，对当前和预期世界观的相对重视程度。该理论产生了丰富的行为动态，从而揭示了广泛的应用领域，并为多种观察到的现象提供了潜在的解释。（JEL D11, D81, D91, Z13）

abstract.text: Every year, millions of Americans experience the incarceration of a family member. Using 30 years of administrative data from Ohio and exploiting differing incarceration propensities of randomly assigned judges, this paper provides the first quasi-experimental estimates of the effects of parental and sibling incarceration in the United States. Parental incarceration has beneficial effects on some important outcomes for children, reducing their likelihood of incarceration by 4.9 percentage points and improving their adult neighborhood quality. While estimates on academic performance and teen parenthood are imprecise, we reject large positive or negative effects. Sibling incarceration leads to similar reductions in criminal activity. (JEL H76, J13, K42)

10.1257/aer.20190415.abstractZh: 每年，数百万美国人会经历家庭成员被监禁的情况。本文利用俄亥俄州30年的行政数据，并借助随机分配的法官在监禁倾向上的差异，首次进行了准实验性估计，以研究父母和兄弟姐妹被监禁对美国儿童的影响。父母被监禁对儿童的某些重要结果有积极影响，使儿童被监禁的可能性降低4.9个百分点，并提升了他们所在社区的居住质量。虽然关于学业表现和青少年父母身份方面的估计并不精确，但我们并未发现显著的积极或消极影响。兄弟姐妹被监禁同样会导致犯罪活动的减少。（JEL H76, J13, K42）

abstract.text: Public housing benefits are rationed through wait lists. Theoretical work on public housing allocation has debated how much choice applicants should have over units, identifying a possible trade-off between efficiency and redistribution. This paper empirically establishes the existence and economic importance of this trade-off using wait list data from Cambridge, Massachusetts. I estimate a model of public housing preferences in a setting where heterogeneous apartments are rationed through waiting time. Eliminating choice would improve targeting but reduce tenant welfare by more than 30 percent. Such a change is only justified on targeting grounds by a strong social preference for redistribution. (JEL D47, H75, I38, R38)

10.1257/aer.20190516.abstractZh: 公共住房福利是通过等待名单来配给的。关于公共住房分配的理论研究一直争论着申请人应该拥有多少选择权，以确定效率与再分配之间的可能权衡。本文利用马萨诸塞州剑桥市的等待名单数据，实证地证明了这种权衡的存在及其经济重要性。我建立了一个模型，模拟了在异质公寓通过等待时间进行配给的情况下的公共住房偏好。如果取消选择权，虽然能够改善目标定位，但会使租户福利减少超过30%。这样的改变只有在基于再分配的社会偏好时才是合理的。（JEL D47, H75, I38, R38）

abstract.text: We study a major new entry in the French mobile telecommunications market, followed by the introduction of fighting brands by the three incumbents. Using an empirical oligopoly model, we find that the incumbents’ fighting brand strategies are difficult to rationalize as unilateral best responses. Instead, their strategies are consistent with a breakdown of tacit semi-collusion: before entry, the incumbents could successfully coordinate on restricting product variety to avoid cannibalization; after entry, this outcome became harder to sustain because of increased business stealing incentives. Consumers gained considerably from the added variety and, to a lesser extent, from the incumbents’ price responses. (JEL L13, L21, L96, M31)

10.1257/aer.20190540.abstractZh: 我们研究了法国移动电信市场的一个重大新进入者，以及三大现有企业引入的竞争品牌策略。通过实证寡头模型分析，我们发现现有企业的竞争品牌策略难以被解释为单方面的最佳反应。相反，这些策略更符合一种默契的半合作关系的破裂：在进入者出现之前，现有企业能够成功协调限制产品种类以避免恶性竞争；而在进入者出现之后，由于商业窃取动机的增加，这种合作关系变得难以维持。消费者从增加的品种中获得了显著的好处，而在较小程度上，也从现有企业的价格反应中受益。（JEL L13, L21, L96, M31）

abstract.text: We estimate long-run intergenerational persistence in human capital using information on outcomes for the extended family: the dynasty. A dataset including the entire Swedish population, linking four generations, allows us to identify parents’ siblings and cousins, their spouses, and spouses’ siblings. Using various human capital measures, we show that traditional parent-child estimates underestimate long-run intergenerational persistence by at least one-third. By adding outcomes for more distant ancestors, we show that almost all of the persistence is captured by the parental generation. Data on adoptees show that at least one- third of long-term persistence is attributed to environmental factors. (JEL I24, I26, J12, J24, J62)

10.1257/aer.20190553.abstractZh: 我们利用关于大家庭成员结果的信息，估算了人力资本在代际间的长期持久性。该数据集涵盖了整个瑞典人口，连接了四代成员，使我们能够识别父母的兄弟姐妹、堂兄弟姐妹、配偶以及配偶的兄弟姐妹。通过多种人力资本指标的分析，我们发现传统的父母-子女估算方法至少低估了代际间持久性的三分之一。通过增加更远祖辈的结果数据，我们发现几乎所有的持久性都归属于父母一代。关于收养子女的数据表明，至少三分之一的长期持久性归因于环境因素。（JEL I24, I26, J12, J24, J62）

abstract.text: We study how search frictions in the labor market affect firms’ ability to recruit talented workers. In a field experiment in Ethiopia, we show that an employer can attract more talented applicants by offering a small monetary incentive for making a job application. Estimates from a structural model suggest that the intervention is effective because the cost of making a job application is large, and positively correlated with jobseeker ability. We provide evidence that this positive correlation is driven by dynamic selection. In a second experiment, we show that local recruiters underestimate the positive impacts of application incentives. (JEL J23, J24, J31, J64, O15)

10.1257/aer.20190586.abstractZh: 我们研究了劳动力市场的搜寻摩擦如何影响企业招聘人才的能力。在埃塞俄比亚的一项实地实验中，我们发现雇主通过提供少量金钱激励来促使求职者提交求职申请，能够吸引更多有才华的申请人。结构模型的分析表明，这种干预措施是有效的，因为提交求职申请的成本较高，且与求职者的能力呈正相关。我们有证据表明，这种正相关性是由动态选择驱动的。在另一项实验中，我们发现当地招聘人员低估了申请激励措施的正面影响。（JEL J23, J24, J31, J64, O15）

abstract.text: With inefficient bureaucratic institutions, the effects of laws are hard to assess and incompetent politicians may pass laws to build a reputation as skillful reformers. Since too many laws curtail bureaucratic efficiency, this mechanism can generate a steady state with Kafkaesque bureaucracy. Temporary surges in political instability heighten the incentives to overproduce laws and can shift the economy towards the Kafkaesque state. Consistent with the theory, after a surge in political instability in the early 1990s, Italy experienced a significant increase in the amount of poor-quality legislation and a decrease in bureaucratic efficiency. (JEL D72, D73)

10.1257/aer.20190672.abstractZh: 在低效的官僚机构下，法律的效果难以评估，无能的政客可能会通过制定法律来树立自己作为熟练改革者的形象。由于太多法律限制了官僚机构的效率，这种机制可能导致出现一种类似卡夫卡式的官僚体制的稳态状态。政治不稳定的暂时加剧会增强过度制定法律的动机，并可能将经济推向类似卡夫卡式的状态。与理论一致的是，在20世纪90年代初政治不稳定加剧之后，意大利的劣质立法数量显著增加，而官僚机构的效率则有所下降。（JEL D72, D73）

abstract.text: We test whether wage growth slows following employer consolidation by examining hospital mergers. We find evidence of reduced wage growth in cases where both (i) the increase in concentration induced by the merger is large and (ii) workers’ skills are industry-specific. In all other cases, we fail to reject zero wage effects. We consider alternative explanations and find that the observed patterns are unlikely to be explained by merger-related changes besides labor market power. Wage growth slowdowns are attenuated in markets with strong labor unions, and wage growth does not decline after out-of-market mergers that leave local employer concentration unchanged. (JEL G34, I11, J22, J24, J31, J42, R32)

10.1257/aer.20190690.abstractZh: 我们通过研究医院合并来检验工资增长是否因雇主合并而放缓。我们发现，在以下情况下，工资增长有所减缓：(i)合并导致的集中度提升较大；(ii)工人的技能具有行业特定性。在其他所有情况下，我们无法排除零工资效应的可能性。我们考虑了其他可能的解释，并发现观察到的模式不太可能仅由合并相关因素解释，除了劳动力市场力量的影响。在拥有强大工会的市场中，工资增长的放缓被减弱，而在那些导致当地雇主集中度不变、超出市场规律的合并之后，工资增长并未下降。(JEL G34, I11, J22, J24, J31, J42, R32)

abstract.text: About one-half of all startups fail within five years, and those that survive grow at vastly different speeds. Using Census microdata, we estimate that most of these differences are determined by ex ante heterogeneity rather than persistent ex post shocks. Embedding such heterogeneity in a firm dynamics model shows that the presence of ex ante heterogeneity (i) is a key determinant of the firm size distribution and firm dynamics, (ii) can strongly affect the macroeconomic effects of firm-level frictions, and (iii) helps understand the recently documented decline in business dynamism by showing a disappearance of high-growth startups (“gazelles”) since the mid-1980s. (JEL D22, D24, E24, J23, L11, M13)

10.1257/aer.20190748.abstractZh: 大约一半的初创企业在五年内失败，而那些存活下来的企业增长速度却大相径庭。通过人口普查微观数据，我们估计这些差异主要是由事前异质性而非持续的事后冲击所决定的。将这种异质性纳入企业动态模型中可以发现，事前异质性的存在：(i) 是决定企业规模分布和企业动态的关键因素；(ii) 能够显著影响企业层面摩擦的宏观经济效应；(iii) 通过显示自20世纪80年代中期以来高成长初创企业（“猎豹”）的消失，有助于理解最近记录到的商业活力的下降。(JEL D22, D24, E24, J23, L11, M13)

abstract.text: This paper uses job seekers’ elicited beliefs about job finding to disentangle the sources of the decline in job-finding rates by duration of unemployment. We document that beliefs have strong predictive power for job finding, but are not revised downward when remaining unemployed and are subject to optimistic bias, especially for the long-term unemployed. Leveraging the predictive power of beliefs, we find substantial heterogeneity in job finding with the resulting dynamic selection explaining most of the observed negative duration dependence in job finding. Moreover, job seekers’ beliefs underreact to heterogeneity in job finding, distorting search behavior and increasing long-term unemployment. (JEL D83, E24, J22, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20190808.abstractZh: 本文通过研究求职者对于求职的信念，来探讨失业持续时间对求职率下降的影响来源。我们发现，求职者的信念在预测求职结果方面具有强大的预测能力，但在持续失业时这些信念并不会减弱，并且存在乐观偏差，尤其是对于长期失业者而言。利用这些信念的预测能力，我们发现求职行为存在显著的异质性，这种异质性导致动态选择现象，从而解释了求职率随失业时间延长而下降的现象。此外，求职者的信念对求职行为的异质性反应不足，这会扭曲搜索行为并增加长期失业的风险。（JEL D83, E24, J22, J64, J65）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the impact of intermediary concentration on the allocation of revenue in online platforms. We study sponsored search documenting how advertisers increasingly bid through a handful of specialized intermediaries. This enhances automated bidding and data pooling, but lessens competition whenever the intermediary represents competing advertisers. Using data on nearly 40 million Google keyword auctions, we first apply machine learning algorithms to cluster keywords into thematic groups serving as relevant markets. Using an instrumental variable strategy, we estimate a decline in the platform’s revenue of approximately 11 percent due to the average rise in concentration associated with intermediary merger and acquisition activity. (JEL C45, D44, G34, L13, L81, M37)

10.1257/aer.20190811.abstractZh: 本文分析了中介机构集中化对在线平台收入分配的影响。我们研究了赞助搜索现象，发现广告商越来越多地通过少数专业中介机构进行竞标。这提升了自动出价和数据整合的效果，但每当中介机构代表竞争广告商时，竞争就会减弱。基于近4000万条谷歌关键词竞价的数据，我们首先运用机器学习算法将关键词划分为相关市场。通过工具变量策略，我们估计由于中介机构的合并与收购活动导致的中介机构集中化，平台收入平均下降了约11%。（JEL C45, D44, G34, L13, L81, M37）

abstract.text: We experimentally varied information mailed to 87,000 households in California’s health insurance marketplace to study the role of frictions in insurance take-up. Reminders about the enrollment deadline raised enrollment by 1.3 pp (16 percent) in this typically low take-up population. Heterogeneous effects of personalized subsidy information indicate misperceptions about program benefits. Consistent with an adverse selection model with frictional enrollment costs, the intervention lowered average spending risk by 5.1 percent, implying that marginal respondents were 37 percent less costly than inframarginal consumers. We observe the largest positive selection among low income consumers, who exhibit the largest frictions in enrollment. Finally, we estimate the implied value of the letter intervention to be $25 to $53 per month in subsidy dollars. These results suggest that frictions may partially explain low take-up for marketplace insurance, and that interventions reducing them can improve enrollment and market risk in exchanges. (JEL C93, G22, G52, H75, I13)

10.1257/aer.20190823.abstractZh: 我们通过实验方式调整了加州健康保险市场发送给87,000户家庭的信息，以研究摩擦因素在保险购买中的作用。关于注册截止日期的提醒使这一通常购买率较低的人群的注册率提高了1.3个百分点（16%）。个性化补贴信息的不同效果表明人们对项目福利存在误解。与具有摩擦性注册成本的逆向选择模型一致，该干预措施将平均支出风险降低了5.1%，这意味着边际受访者比次边际消费者节省了37%的成本。我们观察到低收入消费者表现出最大的正向选择行为，而他们也是注册过程中摩擦最大的群体。最后，我们估计了这种信件干预措施每月带来的补贴价值在25至53美元之间。这些结果表明，摩擦因素可能部分解释了市场保险的低购买率，而减少这些摩擦的干预措施可以提高注册率和市场风险。（JEL C93, G22, G52, H75, I13）

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of current location on elderly mortality by analyzing outcomes of movers in the Medicare population. We control for movers' origin locations as well as a rich vector of pre-move health measures. We also develop a novel strategy to adjust for remaining unobservables, using the correlation of residual mortality with movers' origins to gauge the importance of omitted variables. We estimate substantial effects of current location. Moving from a 10th to a 90th percentile location would increase life expectancy at age 65 by 1.1 years, and equalizing location effects would reduce cross-sectional variation in life expectancy by 15 percent. Places with favorable life expectancy effects tend to have higher quality and quantity of health care, less extreme climates, lower crime rates, and higher socioeconomic status.

10.1257/aer.20190825.abstractZh: 我们通过分析Medicare人群中的迁移者结果，来估计当前位置对老年人死亡率的影响。我们控制了迁移者的原籍位置以及一系列丰富的迁移前健康指标。我们还开发了一种新的策略来调整剩余不可观测变量，利用剩余死亡率与迁移者原籍地的相关性来衡量遗漏变量的重要性。我们发现当前位置具有显著的影响。从第10百分位迁移到第90百分位的位置，65岁时的预期寿命将增加1.1年；而均衡位置效应可以将横截面上的预期寿命差异减少15%。具有有利预期寿命效应的地区往往拥有更高质量和数量的医疗保健、更温和的气候、更低的犯罪率以及更高的社会经济地位。

abstract.text: Can research findings change political leaders’ beliefs and policies? We use experiments with 2,150 Brazilian municipalities to measure mayors’ demand for and response to research information. In one experiment, we find that mayors are willing to pay to learn the results of evaluation studies, and update their beliefs when informed of the findings. They value larger-sample studies more, while not distinguishing between studies in rich and poor countries. In a second experiment, we find that informing mayors about research on a simple and effective policy, taxpayer reminder letters, increases the probability the policy is implemented by 10 percentage points. (JEL D72, D78, D83, O17, O18)

10.1257/aer.20190830.abstractZh: 研究的结果能否改变政治领导人的信念和政策？我们通过针对2,150个巴西市镇进行的实验来测量市长对研究信息的需求与反应。在一项实验中，我们发现市长愿意支付费用以获取评估研究的结果，并在得知研究结果后更新自己的信念。他们更重视大样本研究，并且不区分研究是在富裕国家还是贫穷国家进行的。在另一项实验中，我们发现向市长提供关于简单有效政策的研究信息，如纳税人提醒信，会使该政策实施的概率增加10个百分点。（JEL D72, D78, D83, O17, O18）

abstract.text: After the Great Recession several central banks started setting negative nominal interest rates in an expansionary attempt, but the effectiveness of this measure remains unclear. Negative rates can stimulate the economy by lowering the rates that commercial banks charge on loans, but they can also erode bank profitability by squeezing deposit spreads. This paper studies the effects of negative rates in a new DSGE model where banks intermediate the transmission of monetary policy. I use bank-level data to calibrate the model and find that monetary policy in negative territory is between 60 and 90 percent as effective as in positive territory. (JEL E12, E32, E43, E52, E58, G21)

10.1257/aer.20190848.abstractZh: 在大衰退之后，一些中央银行开始实施负名义利率政策，以试图刺激经济，但这一措施的有效性仍不明确。负利率可以通过降低商业银行的贷款利率来刺激经济，但同时也会通过压缩存款利差来侵蚀银行的盈利能力。本文在一个新的DSGE模型中研究了负利率的影响，该模型考虑了银行在货币政策传导中的作用。我使用银行层面的数据对模型进行了校准，发现负利率下的货币政策效果与正利率下的效果相当，大约在60%到90%之间。（JEL E12, E32, E43, E52, E58, G21）

abstract.text: We study a repeated game of price leadership in which a firm proposes supermarkups over Bertrand prices to a coalition of rivals. Supermarkups and marginal costs are recoverable from data on prices and quantities using the model’s structure. In an application to the beer industry, we find that price leadership increases profit relative to Bertrand competition by 17 percent in fiscal years 2006 and 2007, and by 22 percent in 2010 and 2011, with the change mostly due to consolidation. We simulate two mergers, which relax binding incentive compatibility constraints and increase supermarkups. These coordinated effects arise even with efficiencies that offset price increases under Bertrand competition. (JEL G34, K21, L13, L14, L41, L66)

10.1257/aer.20190913.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个价格领导重复博弈，其中一家企业向竞争对手联盟提出超过伯特兰价格的高额利润。高额利润和边际成本可以通过模型结构中的价格和数量数据来推断。在啤酒行业的应用中，我们发现，在2006年和2007财年，价格领导使利润比伯特兰竞争方式增加了17%，而在2010年和2011年则增加了22%，这一变化主要归因于企业合并。我们模拟了两次合并，这些合并放宽了强制性的激励相容约束，并提高了高额利润。即使存在能够抵消价格上升的效率，这种协调效应仍然存在。（JEL G34, K21, L13, L14, L41, L66）

abstract.text: We study experimentally when, why, and how people intervene in others’ choices. Choice Architects (CAs) construct opportunity sets containing bundles of time-indexed payments for Choosers. CAs frequently prevent impatient choices despite opportunities to provide advice, believing Choosers benefit. They violate common behavioral welfare criteria by removing impatient options even when all payoffs are delayed. CAs intervene not by removing options they wish they could resist when choosing for themselves (mistakes-projective paternalism), but rather as if they seek to align others’ choices with their own aspirations (ideals-projective paternalism). Laboratory choices predict subjects’ support for actual paternalistic policies. (JEL C92, D12, D15)

10.1257/aer.20191039.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究人们何时、为何以及如何干预他人的选择。选择建筑师为选择者构建包含时间索引支付束的机会集。尽管有提供建议的机会，选择建筑师仍经常阻止选择者做出急躁的选择，认为这样做能让选择者受益。他们通过移除急躁选项来违反常见的行为福利标准，即使所有收益都会延迟。选择建筑师进行干预的方式并非是他们希望自己在做出选择时能够抵抗的选项（错误-主观性利己主义），而是像他们试图使他人的选择与自己的愿望相一致一样。（理想-主观性利己主义）实验室中的选择可以预测受试者对实际利己主义政策的支持程度。（JEL C92, D12, D15）

abstract.text: We present a framework where “model persuaders” influence receivers’ beliefs by proposing models that organize past data to make predictions. Receivers are assumed to find models more compelling when they better explain the data, fixing receivers’ prior beliefs. Model persuaders face a trade-off: better-fitting models induce less movement in receivers’ beliefs. Consequently, a receiver exposed to the true model can be most misled by persuasion when that model fits poorly, competition between persuaders tends to neutralize the data by pushing toward better-fitting models, and a persuader facing multiple receivers is more effective when he can send tailored, private messages. (JEL C50, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20191074.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，其中“模型说服者”通过提出能够组织过去数据以进行预测的模型，来影响接收者的信念。假设接收者认为那些能更好地解释数据的模型更有说服力，从而修正了接收者的先验信念。模型说服者面临一个权衡：更贴合实际的模型会导致接收者信念的变化幅度减小。因此，当接收者接触到真实的模型时，最容易被说服的是那些拟合度较低的模型。说服者之间的竞争往往会通过推动使用更贴合实际的模型来抵消数据的影响。而面对多个接收者的说服者，如果能够发送量身定制的私人信息，则更为有效。（JEL C50, D82, D83）

abstract.text: This paper studies the large concentration of retirement behavior around statutory retirement ages, a puzzling stylized fact. To investigate this fact, I estimate bunching responses to 644 pension benefit discontinuities, using administrative data on the universe of German retirees. Financial incentives alone cannot explain retirement patterns, but there is a large direct effect of statutory retirement ages. I argue that the framing of statutory ages as reference points for retirement provides a plausible explanation. Simulations based on a model with reference dependence highlight that shifting statutory ages via pension reforms is an effective policy to influence retirement behavior. (JEL D91, H55, J26, J32)

10.1257/aer.20191136.abstractZh: 本文研究了法定退休年龄附近退休行为的高度集中现象，这是一个令人困惑的统计数据。为了探究这一现象，我利用德国退休人员的行政数据，对644个养老金福利中断事件的反应进行了分析。单纯的财务激励无法解释退休模式，但法定退休年龄本身具有较大的直接影响。我认为，将法定退休年龄作为退休的参考点这一设定，为这一现象提供了一个合理的解释。基于参考依赖模型的模拟表明，通过养老金改革调整法定退休年龄是一种有效的政策手段，可以影响退休行为。（JEL D91, H55, J26, J32）

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of leaders in the social movement against slavery that culminated in the US Civil War. Our analysis is organized around a natural experiment: leaders of the failed German revolution of 1848–1849 were expelled to the United States and became antislavery campaigners who helped mobilize Union Army volunteers. Towns where Forty-Eighters settled show two-thirds higher Union Army enlistments. Their influence worked through local newspapers and social clubs. Going beyond enlistment decisions, Forty-Eighters reduced their companies’ desertion rate during the war. In the long run, Forty-Eighter towns were more likely to form a local chapter of the NAACP. (JEL D74, J15, J45, J61, N31, N41)

10.1257/aer.20191137.abstractZh: 本文研究了在导致美国内战的奴隶制反对运动中，领导者的作用。我们的分析围绕一个自然实验展开：1848-1849年失败的德国革命的领导者被驱逐到美国，他们成为了反奴隶制运动者，并帮助动员了联邦军志愿者。在那些有“四十战士”定居的城镇，联邦军的入伍人数高出三分之二。他们的影响力通过当地报纸和社会俱乐部得以传播。除了入伍决策之外，“四十战士”还降低了他们在战争期间的逃兵率。从长远来看，这些城镇更有可能成立当地的全国有色人种协进会分会。（JEL D74, J15, J45, J61, N31, N41）

abstract.text: Allocating appointment slots is presented as a new application for market design. Online booking systems are commonly used by public authorities to allocate appointments for visa interviews, driver’s licenses, passport renewals, etc. We document that black markets for appointments have developed in many parts of the world. Scalpers book the appointments that are offered for free and sell the slots to appointment seekers. We model the existing first-come-first-served booking system and propose an alternative batch system. The batch system collects applications for slots over a certain time period and then randomly allocates slots to applicants. The theory predicts and lab experiments confirm that scalpers profitably book and sell slots under the current system with sufficiently high demand, but that they are not active in the proposed batch system. We discuss practical issues for the implementation of the batch system and its applicability to other markets with scalping. (JEL C92, D47)

10.1257/aer.20191204.abstractZh: 预约分配被提出作为市场设计的一种新应用。公共机构通常使用在线预订系统来分配签证面试、驾照办理、护照续签等服务的预约时间。我们发现，全球许多地区都存在预约的黑市交易。黄牛党会预订免费提供的预约时间，并将其出售给其他申请人。我们对现有的先来先服务预订系统进行了建模，并提出了一种替代的批量分配系统。该批量分配系统会在一定时间内收集预约申请，然后随机分配预约时间给申请人。理论预测和实验室实验表明，在需求足够高的情况下，黄牛党可以在现有系统中盈利地预订和出售预约时间，但在提出的批量分配系统中，黄牛党并不活跃。我们讨论了批量分配系统实施的实际问题，以及其在其他存在黄牛行为的市场中的适用性。（JEL C92, D47）

abstract.text: A (partially naïve) quasi-hyperbolic discounter repeatedly chooses whether to complete a task. Her net benefits of task completion are drawn independently between periods from a time-invariant distribution. We show that the probability of completing the task conditional on not having done so earlier increases towards the deadline. Conversely, we establish nonidentifiability by proving that for any time-preference parameters and any dataset with such (weakly increasing) task-completion probabilities, there exists a stationary payoff distribution that rationalizes the agent’s behavior if she is either sophisticated or fully naïve. Additionally, we provide sharp partial identification for the case of observable continuation values. (JEL C14, D11, D15, D90, D91)

10.1257/aer.20191258.abstractZh: A（部分天真）准超bolic折扣者会反复决定是否完成一项任务。她完成任务的净收益在周期内独立地从一个时间不变的分布中抽取。我们证明了在尚未完成任务的条件下，完成任务的概率随着截止日期的临近而增加。相反地，我们通过证明对于任何时间偏好参数以及任何具有这种（逐渐增加的）任务完成概率的数据集，都存在一个稳态收益分布，从而证明了如果代理人是复杂的或完全天真的，其行为是合理的。此外，我们还为可观测的延续价值情况提供了精确的部分识别方法。（JEL C14, D11, D15, D90, D91）

abstract.text: The high-tech sector is concentrated in a small number of cities. The ten largest clusters in computer science, semiconductors, and biology account for 69 percent, 77 percent, and 59 percent of all US inventors, respectively. Using longitudinal data on 109,846 inventors, I find that geographical agglomeration results in significant productivity gains. When an inventor moves to a city with a large cluster of inventors in the same field, she experiences a sizable increase in the number and quality of patents produced. The presence of significant productivity externalities implies that the agglomeration of inventors generates large gains in the aggregate amount of innovation produced in the United States. (JEL D62, J24, L60, O31, 034, R32)

10.1257/aer.20191277.abstractZh: 高科技产业集中在少数几个城市。在计算机科学、半导体技术和生物学领域，排名前十的产业集群分别占美国所有发明者的69%、77%和59%。通过对109,846名发明者的长期数据进行分析，我发现地理上的聚集带来了显著的生产力提升。当一名发明者搬到一个拥有大量同领域发明者的城市时，她所创造的专利数量和质量都会显著增加。这种显著的生产力外部性表明，发明者的聚集能够大幅提升美国整体的创新产出。（JEL D62, J24, L60, O31, 034, R32）

abstract.text: Mistakes and overconfidence in detecting lies could help lies spread. Participants in our experiments observe videos in which senders either tell the truth or lie, and are incentivized to distinguish between them. We find that participants fail to detect lies, but are overconfident about their ability to do so. We use these findings to study the determinants of sharing and its effect on lie detection, finding that even when incentivized to share truthful videos, participants are more likely to share lies. Moreover, the receivers are more likely to believe shared videos. Combined, the tendency to believe lies increases with sharing. (JEL C91, D83, D91, L82)

10.1257/aer.20191295.abstractZh: 在检测谎言时，错误的判断和过度自信可能会促进谎言的传播。我们的实验参与者观看了视频，视频中的说话者要么说真话，要么撒谎，并且他们被激励去区分这两种情况。我们发现，参与者无法准确识别谎言，但对自己能够做到这一点过于自信。我们利用这些发现来研究分享行为的影响因素及其对谎言检测的影响，发现即使受到分享真实视频的激励，参与者也更有可能分享谎言。此外，接收者更有可能相信被分享的视频。综合来看，相信谎言的倾向随着分享行为的增加而增强。（JEL C91, D83, D91, L82）

abstract.text: A more generous consumer bankruptcy system provides greater insurance against financial risks but may also raise the cost of credit. We study this trade-off using the 2005 Bankruptcy Abuse Prevention and Consumer Protection Act (BAPCPA), which increased the costs of filing for bankruptcy. We identify the effects of BAPCPA on borrowing costs using variation in the effects of the reform across credit scores. We find that a one-percentage-point reduction in bankruptcy filing risk decreased credit card interest rates by 70–90 basis points. Conversely, BAPCPA reduced the insurance value of bankruptcy, with uninsured hospitalizations 70 percent less likely to obtain bankruptcy relief after the reform. (JEL D18, G15, I13, K35)

10.1257/aer.20191311.abstractZh: 更宽松的消费者破产制度能够提供更强的财务风险保障，但也可能提高信贷成本。我们通过2005年《破产滥用预防与消费者保护法案》来研究这一权衡关系，该法案增加了申请破产的成本。我们通过不同信用评分下该法案实施效果的变化，来识别其对借贷成本的影响。研究发现，破产申请风险降低一个百分点后，信用卡利率下降了70-90个基点。相反，BAPCPA降低了破产的保险价值，未投保的住院治疗在改革后获得破产救济的可能性降低了70%。（JEL D18, G15, I13, K35）

abstract.text: Can an uninformed mediator improve outcomes in a dynamic reputational bargaining model? I show that a simple communication protocol used by professional mediators, of announcing an agreement only if both parties privately accept its terms, can increase the payoffs of rational bargainers, but only if communication is noisy: the mediator must sometimes fail to suggest a deal even when both bargainers accept it. (JEL C78, D74, D83)

10.1257/aer.20191321.abstractZh: 无经验的调解者能否在动态声誉谈判模型中改善结果？我指出，专业调解者使用的简单沟通协议——只有在双方私下同意协议条款后才宣布协议——可以提高理性谈判者的收益，但前提是沟通存在噪声：调解者有时必须无法提出交易方案，即使双方都同意该方案。（JEL C78, D74, D83）

abstract.text: How does a housing boom affect credit to non-housing firms? Using bank, firm, and loan-level microdata, we show that the Spanish housing boom reduced non-housing credit growth during its first years, but stimulated it later on. These patterns can be rationalized by financial constraints for banks. Constrained banks initially accommodated higher housing credit demand by reducing non-housing credit. Eventually, however, the housing boom increased bank net worth and expanded credit supply. A quantitative model, disciplined by our cross-sectional estimates, indicates that the crowding-out effect was substantial but temporary, and had been fully absorbed by the end of the boom. (JEL E32, E44, G21, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20191410.abstractZh: 住房繁荣如何影响非住房企业的信贷？通过银行、企业和贷款层面的微观数据，我们发现西班牙的住房繁荣在其初期减缓了非住房信贷的增长，但后来又促进了信贷的扩张。这些现象可以通过银行的财务约束来解释。受约束的银行最初通过减少非住房信贷来满足较高的住房信贷需求。然而，最终住房繁荣增加了银行的净资产并扩大了信贷供应。一个经过我们横截面估计验证的定量模型表明，这种挤出效应是显著的，但只是暂时的，并且在繁荣结束时已经完全被吸收完毕。（JEL E32, E44, G21, R21, R31）

abstract.text: The nullification of slave wealth after the US Civil War (1861–1865) was one of the largest episodes of wealth compression in history. We document that White Southern households that owned more slaves in 1860 lost substantially more wealth by 1870, relative to Southern households that had been equally wealthy before the war. Yet, their sons almost entirely recovered from this wealth shock by 1900, and their grandsons completely converged by 1940. Marriage networks and connections to other elite families may have aided in recovery, whereas transmission of entrepreneurship and skills appear less central. (JEL D31, G51, J15, J24, N31, N32)

10.1257/aer.20191422.abstractZh: 美国内战（1861–1865年）后奴隶财富的湮灭是历史上最大的财富压缩事件之一。我们的研究指出，1860年拥有更多奴隶的南方白人家庭，到1870年时其财富损失幅度远大于战前同样富裕的南方家庭。然而，到1900年时，这些家庭的子女几乎完全恢复了因财富冲击造成的损失，而他们的孙子们则在1940年时实现了完全的财富恢复。婚姻网络和其他精英家族的联系可能有助于恢复，而创业能力和技能的传承似乎作用较小。（JEL D31, G51, J15, J24, N31, N32）

abstract.text: We document that the expectations of households, firms, and professional forecasters in standard surveys simultaneously extrapolate from recent events and underreact to new information. Existing models of expectation formation, whether behavioral or rational, cannot account for these observations. We develop a rational theory of extrapolation based on limited attention, which is consistent with this evidence. In particular, we show that limited, asymmetric attention to procyclical variables can explain the coexistence of extrapolation and underreactions. We illustrate these mechanisms in a microfounded macroeconomic model, which generates expectations consistent with the survey data, and show that asymmetric attention increases business cycle fluctuations. (JEL C53, D83, D84, E23, E27, E32)

10.1257/aer.20191432.abstractZh: 我们证明，家庭、企业和专业预测者在标准调查中同时根据近期事件进行预测，但对新信息的反应不足。现有的预期形成模型，无论是行为主义还是理性主义模型，都无法解释这些现象。我们基于有限注意力的发展出一套理性预测理论，这与现有证据是一致的。特别是，我们发现对顺周期变量的有限、不对称注意力可以解释预测与反应不足并存的现象。我们在基于微观基础的宏观经济模型中验证了这些机制，该模型生成的预期与调查数据一致，并表明不对称注意力会增加经济周期的波动。（JEL C53, D83, D84, E23, E27, E32）

abstract.text: We develop an equivalence between the equilibrium effects of incomplete information and those of two behavioral distortions: myopia, or extra discounting of the future; and anchoring of current behavior to past behavior, as in models with habit persistence or adjustment costs. We show how these distortions depend on higher-order beliefs and GE mechanisms, and how they can be disciplined by evidence on expectations. We finally illustrate the use of our toolbox with a quantitative application in the context of inflation, a bridge to the HANK literature, and an extension to networks. (JEL C53, D83, D85, E12, E31, E37)

10.1257/aer.20191436.abstractZh: 我们提出了不完全信息下的均衡效应与两种行为扭曲之间的等价性：近视，即对未来的额外折扣；以及将当前行为锚定于过去的行为，如那些包含习惯持续性或调整成本的模型中。我们展示了这些扭曲如何依赖于更高层次的信念和GE机制，以及它们如何受到关于预期的证据的影响。最后，我们通过一个量化应用来说明我们的工具箱的使用，该应用涉及通货膨胀问题，为HANK文献提供了桥梁，并扩展到了网络领域。（JEL C53, D83, D85, E12, E31, E37）

abstract.text: Using millions of father-son pairs spanning more than 100 years of US history, we find that children of immigrants from nearly every sending country have higher rates of upward mobility than children of the US-born. Immigrants’ advantage is similar historically and today despite dramatic shifts in sending countries and US immigration policy. Immigrants achieve this advantage in part by choosing to settle in locations that offer better prospects for their children. (JEL J15, J18, J62, K37, N31, N32)

10.1257/aer.20191586.abstractZh: 通过利用跨越美国历史超过100年的数百万父子数据，我们发现来自几乎所有发源国的移民子女，其向上流动的概率高于美国出生的子女。尽管发源国和美国的移民政策发生了巨大变化，移民所享有的优势在历史上和今天仍然相似。移民之所以能够取得这种优势，部分原因在于他们选择定居在能为子女提供更好前景的地区。（JEL J15, J18, J62, K37, N31, N32）

abstract.text: We study a simple savings scheme that allows workers to defer receipt of part of their wages for three months at zero interest. The scheme significantly increases savings during the deferral period, leading to higher postdisbursement spending on lumpy goods. Two years later, after two additional rounds of the savings scheme, we find that treated workers have made permanent improvements to their homes. The popularity of the scheme implies a lack of good alternative savings options. The results of a follow-up experiment suggest that demand for the scheme is partly due to its ability to address self-control issues. (JEL D91, G51, J31, O12, O13)

10.1257/aer.20191657.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种简单的储蓄方案，该方案允许工人将部分工资推迟三个月领取，且利息为零。该方案在延期期间显著增加了储蓄，从而导致在支出后的消费更倾向于购买大宗商品。两年后，经过两轮额外的储蓄方案实施，我们发现接受该方案的工人对其住房状况有了显著的改善。该方案的受欢迎程度表明，缺乏其他合适的储蓄选择。后续实验的结果表明，对该方案的需求部分源于其能够解决自我控制问题。（JEL D91, G51, J31, O12, O13）

abstract.text: We evaluate an intervention targeting early life nutrition and well-being for households in extreme poverty in Northern Nigeria. The intervention leads to large and sustained improvements in children’s anthropometric and health outcomes, including an 8 percent reduction in stunting 4 years, post-intervention. These impacts are partly driven by information-related channels. However, the certain and substantial flow of cash transfers is also key. They induce positive labor supply responses among women, and enables them to undertake productive investments in livestock. These provide protein rich diets for children, and generate higher household earnings streams long after the cash transfers expire. (JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J16, J22, O12)

10.1257/aer.20191726.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项针对尼日利亚北部极端贫困家庭早期营养与福祉的干预措施。该干预措施显著且持久地改善了儿童的人体测量指标和健康状况，例如干预后4岁儿童的发育迟缓情况减少了8%。这些影响部分是由信息相关渠道推动的。然而，定期且大量的现金转移也是关键因素。这些现金转移促使女性产生积极的劳动力供给反应，并使她们能够投资于牲畜养殖。这些活动为儿童提供了富含蛋白质的饮食，并在现金转移结束后很长时间内为家庭带来更高的收入来源。（JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J16, J22, O12）

abstract.text: We study a Chinese policy that awards substantial tax cuts to firms with R&D investment over a threshold or “notch.” Quasi-experimental variation and administrative tax data show a significant increase in reported R&D that is partly driven by firms relabeling expenses as R&D. Structural estimates show relabeling accounts for 24.2 percent of reported R&D and that doubling R&D would increase productivity by 9 percent. Policy simulations show that firm selection and relabeling determine the cost-effectiveness of stimulating R&D, that notch-based policies are more effective than tax credits when relabeling is prevalent, and that modest spillovers justify the program from a welfare perspective. (JEL D22, D24, H25, O14, O32, P31, P35)

10.1257/aer.20191758.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项中国政策，该政策对达到一定研发投资门槛以上的企业给予大幅税收减免。准实验变量和行政税收数据表明，企业将费用重新标记为研发支出，导致报告的研发活动显著增加。结构估计显示，重新标记费用占报告研发支出的24.2%，而将研发投资翻倍可使生产率提高9%。政策模拟表明，企业选择及费用重新标记决定了刺激研发的成本效益；在重新标记行为普遍的情况下，基于门槛的政策比税收抵免更为有效；从福利角度来看，适度的溢出效应足以证明该政策的合理性。（JEL D22, D24, H25, O14, O32, P31, P35）

abstract.text: Does the consumption of ideologically congruent news on social media exacerbate polarization? I estimate the effects of social media news exposure by conducting a large field experiment randomly offering participants subscriptions to conservative or liberal news outlets on Facebook. I collect data on the causal chain of media effects: subscriptions to outlets, exposure to news on Facebook, visits to online news sites, and sharing of posts, as well as changes in political opinions and attitudes. Four main findings emerge. First, random variation in exposure to news on social media substantially affects the slant of news sites that individuals visit. Second, exposure to counter-attitudinal news decreases negative attitudes toward the opposing political party. Third, in contrast to the effect on attitudes, I find no evidence that the political leanings of news outlets affect political opinions. Fourth, Facebook’s algorithm is less likely to supply individuals with posts from counter-attitudinal outlets, conditional on individuals subscribing to them. Together, the results suggest that social media algorithms may limit exposure to counter-attitudinal news and thus increase polarization. (JEL C93, D72, L82)

10.1257/aer.20191777.abstractZh: 在社交媒体上消费与意识形态一致的新闻是否会加剧两极分化？我通过一项大型实地实验来估计社交媒体新闻曝露的影响，该实验随机让参与者订阅Facebook上的保守派或自由派新闻机构。我收集了关于媒体效应因果链的数据：对新闻机构的订阅、在Facebook上接触新闻、访问在线新闻网站以及分享帖子，以及政治观点和态度的变化。四个主要发现如下：首先，社交媒体上新闻曝露的随机变化显著影响了个人访问的新闻网站的倾向性。其次，接触与反对意见相左的新闻会降低对反对派政党的负面态度。第三，与态度变化相反，我没有发现新闻机构的政治倾向会影响政治观点。第四，Facebook的算法在参与者订阅了这些新闻机构后，不太可能向他们提供与反对意见相左的新闻。总的来说，这些结果表明社交媒体算法可能会限制接触与反对意见相左的新闻的机会，从而加剧两极分化。（JEL C93, D72, L82）

abstract.text: I estimate the effects of collaborative and adversarial intergroup contact. I randomly assigned Indian men from different castes to participate in cricket leagues or to serve as a control group. League players faced variation in collaborative contact, through random assignment to homogeneous-caste or mixed-caste teams, and adversarial contact, through random assignment of opponents. Collaborative contact increases cross-caste friendships and efficiency in trade, and reduces own-caste favoritism. In contrast, adversarial contact generally reduces cross-caste interaction and efficiency. League participation reduces intergroup differences, suggesting that the positive aspects of intergroup contact more than offset the negative aspects in this setting. (JEL C93, D83, D91, J15, O15, Z13, Z21)

10.1257/aer.20191780.abstractZh: 我研究了合作性与对抗性群体间互动的影响。我随机将不同种姓的印度男性分配到板球联赛中，或者作为对照组。联赛参与者在合作性互动方面存在差异，这取决于他们被随机分配到同种姓或混合种姓的队伍中；而在对抗性互动方面，则取决于他们被随机分配到的对手。合作性互动有助于增进不同种姓之间的友谊和贸易效率，同时减少同种姓内部的偏好行为。相比之下，对抗性互动通常会减少不同种姓之间的互动和效率。参与联赛有助于减少群体间的差异，这表明在这种情境下，群体间互动的积极方面足以抵消其消极方面。（JEL C93, D83, D91, J15, O15, Z13, Z21）

abstract.text: We formalize the editorial role of news media in a multisector economy and show that media can be an independent source of business cycle fluctuations, even when they report accurate information. Public reporting about a subset of sectoral developments that are newsworthy but unrepresentative causes firms across all sectors to hire too much or too little labor. We construct historical measures of US sectoral news coverage and use them to calibrate our model. Time-varying media focus generates demand-like fluctuations that are orthogonal to productivity, even in the absence of non-TFP shocks. Presented with historical sectoral productivity, the model reproduces the 2009 Great Recession. (JEL D22, D83, E32, L82)

10.1257/aer.20191895.abstractZh: 我们明确了新闻媒体在多部门经济中的编辑作用，并表明即使媒体报道的信息准确无误，媒体仍可以成为商业周期波动的独立来源。公众对某些具有新闻价值但缺乏代表性的行业发展的报道，会导致各个行业的企业雇佣过多或过少劳动力。我们构建了美国行业新闻报道的历史数据，并利用这些数据来校准我们的模型。媒体关注随时间的变化会产生与生产率正交的需求波动，即使在没有非技术效率冲击的情况下也是如此。结合历史行业生产率数据，该模型能够再现2009年的大衰退现象。（JEL D22, D83, E32, L82）

abstract.text: This paper reports on a two-tiered experiment designed to separately identify the selection and effort margins of pay for performance (P4P). At the recruitment stage, teacher labor markets were randomly assigned to a “pay-for-percentile” or fixed-wage contract. Once recruits were placed, an unexpected, incentive-compatible, school-level re-randomization was performed so that some teachers who applied for a fixed-wage contract ended up being paid by P4P, and vice versa. By the second year of the study, the within-year effort effect of P4P was 0.16 standard deviations of pupil learning, with the total effect rising to 0.20 standard deviations after allowing for selection. (JEL C93, I21, J23, J33, J41, J45, O15)

10.1257/aer.20191972.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项双层实验，旨在分别确定绩效薪酬（P4P）的选择效应和努力边际。在招聘阶段，教师劳动力市场被随机分配到“按百分比支付薪酬”或固定工资合同两种模式。一旦教师被录用，学校层面会进行一次意外的、符合激励原则的重新随机分配，使得一些申请固定工资合同的教师最终获得P4P薪酬，反之亦然。到研究第二年时，P4P的年度努力效应为0.16个标准差的学生学习成果，而考虑到选择效应后，总效应上升至0.20个标准差。（JEL C93, I21, J23, J33, J41, J45, O15）

abstract.text: Are ordinary citizens or political party leaders better positioned to select candidates? While the American primary system lets citizens choose, most democracies rely instead on party officials to appoint or nominate candidates. The consequences of these distinct design choices are unclear: while officials are often better informed about candidate qualifications, they may value traits, like party loyalty or willingness to pay for the nomination, at odds with identifying the best performer. We partnered with both major political parties in Sierra Leone to experimentally vary how much say voters have in selecting Parliamentary candidates. Estimates suggest that more democratic procedures increase the likelihood that parties select voters’ most preferred candidates and favor candidates with stronger records of public goods provision. (JEL D72, H41, O17)

10.1257/aer.20200125.abstractZh: 普通公民还是政党领袖更能够挑选候选人？美国的初选制度允许公民自行选择，而大多数民主国家则依赖政党官员来任命或提名候选人。这两种不同的设计选择所带来的后果尚不清楚：虽然官员通常对候选人的资质更为了解，但他们可能更看重诸如党派忠诚度或愿意为提名付出代价等特质，而这些特质与识别最优秀的候选人并不一致。我们与塞拉利昂的两大政党合作，实验性地改变了选民在挑选议会候选人方面的发言权。研究表明，更民主的程序会增加政党选择选民最青睐的候选人的可能性，并且更倾向于选择那些在公共服务方面表现更出色的候选人。（JEL D72, H41, O17）

abstract.text: Digitization has led to many new creative products, straining the capacity of professional critics and consumers. Yet, the digitization of retailing has also delivered new crowd-based sources of pre-purchase information. We compare the relative impacts of professional critics and crowd-based Amazon star ratings on consumer welfare in book publishing. Using various fixed effects and discontinuity-based empirical strategies, we estimate their causal impacts on sales. We use these causal estimates to calibrate a structural demand model. The aggregate effect of star ratings on consumer surplus is, in our baseline estimates, more than ten times the effect of traditional review outlets. (JEL D83, L15, L81, L82)

10.1257/aer.20200153.abstractZh: 数字化催生了许多新的创意产品，这给专业评论家和消费者的能力带来了压力。然而，零售业的数字化也带来了新的基于群体的购买前信息来源。我们比较了专业评论家和亚马逊基于群体的星级评分对图书出版业消费者福利的相对影响。通过运用各种固定效应和基于不连续性的实证方法，我们估算了它们对销售的因果影响。我们利用这些因果估计来校准一个结构需求模型。在我们的基线估计中，星级评分对消费者剩余的总体影响是传统评论渠道影响的十倍以上。（JEL D83, L15, L81, L82）

abstract.text: We derive a new cost of information in rational inattention problems, the neighborhood-based cost functions, starting from the observation that many settings involve exogenous states with a topological structure. These cost functions are uniformly posterior separable and capture notions of perceptual distance. This second property ensures that neighborhood-based costs, unlike mutual information, make accurate predictions about behavior in perceptual experiments. We compare the implications of our neighborhood-based cost functions with those of the mutual information in a series of applications: perceptual judgments, the general environment of binary choice, regime-change games, and linear-quadratic-Gaussian settings. (JEL C70, D11, D82, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20200154.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在理性忽视问题中的新信息成本模型，即基于邻域的成本函数。这一模型基于这样一个观察：许多情境中都存在具有拓扑结构的外生状态。这些成本函数具有均匀后验可分离性，并且能够捕捉感知距离的概念。这一特性使得基于邻域的成本函数能够像互信息那样，准确预测感知实验中的行为。我们在一系列应用中比较了基于邻域的成本函数与互信息的影响：感知判断、二元选择的一般环境、政权变更博弈以及线性-二次高斯模型。（JEL C70, D11, D82, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We provide evidence of the stock market consumption wealth effect by using a local labor market analysis. An increase in local stock wealth driven by aggregate stock prices increases local employment and payroll in nontradable industries and in total, with no effect on employment in tradable industries. In a model of geographic heterogeneity in stock wealth, these responses imply an MPC of 3.2 cents per year and that a 20 percent increase in stock valuations, unless countered by monetary policy, increases the aggregate labor bill by at least 1.7 percent and aggregate hours by at least 0.7 percent two years after the shock. (JEL E21, E24, E52, G12, G51, R22, R23 )

10.1257/aer.20200208.abstractZh: 我们通过本地劳动力市场分析提供了股市消费财富效应的证据。由于股票总价格上升而导致的本地股票财富增加，会促进非贸易性行业的本地就业和工资水平，总体上对贸易性行业的就业没有影响。在考虑股票财富地理异质性的模型中，这些反应意味着边际消费倾向为每年3.2美分，而且除非受到货币政策的抑制，否则股票估值增加20%，会在冲击发生两年后使总劳动力成本增加至少1.7%，总工作时间增加至少0.7%。（JEL E21, E24, E52, G12, G51, R22, R23）

abstract.text: We study a newly designed survey administered to a large panel of wealthy retail investors. The survey elicits beliefs that are important for macroeconomics and finance, and matches respondents with administrative data on their portfolio composition, their trading activity, and their login behavior. We establish five facts inthese data. (i) Beliefs are reflected in portfolio allocations. The sensitivity of portfolios to beliefs is small on average, but varies significantly with investor wealth, attention, trading frequency, and confidence. (ii) Belief changes do not predict when investors trade, but conditional on trading, they affect both the direction and the magnitude of trades. (iii) Beliefs are mostly characterized by large and persistent individual heterogeneity. Demographic characteristics explain only asmall part of why some individuals are optimistic and some are pessimistic. (iv) Expected cash flow growth and expected returns are positively related, both within and across investors. (v) Expected returns and the subjective probability of rare disasters are negatively related, both within and across investors. These five facts provide useful guidance for the design of macro-finance models. (JEL D83, E23, G11, G12, G41, G51)

10.1257/aer.20200243.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项针对大量富裕零售投资者的新设计的调查。该调查收集了对宏观经济学和金融领域重要的信念信息，并将受访者与其投资组合构成、交易活动以及登录行为相关的行政数据进行了匹配。我们在这些数据中发现了五个事实：(i) 信念反映在投资组合的分配上。投资组合对信念的敏感性平均来看较小，但会随着投资者财富、注意力、交易频率以及信心的变化而显著不同。(ii) 信念的变化并不能预测投资者何时进行交易，但在交易的前提下，它们会影响交易的方向和规模。(iii) 信念主要表现为个体间的巨大且持续的异质性。人口统计特征只能解释为什么有些个体乐观而有些个体悲观，但作用有限。(iv) 预期现金流增长与预期回报之间存在正相关关系，这种关系在投资者内部和不同投资者之间都存在。(v) 预期回报与罕见灾难的主观概率之间存在负相关关系，这种关系在投资者内部和不同投资者之间都存在。这五个事实为宏观金融模型的设计提供了有用的指导。(JEL D83, E23, G11, G12, G41, G51)

abstract.text: Can targeting information to network-central farmers induce more adoption of a new agricultural technology? By combining social network data and a field experiment in 200 villages in Malawi, we find that targeting central farmers is important to spur the diffusion process. We also provide evidence of one explanation for why centrality matters: a diffusion process governed by complex contagion. Our results are consistent with a model in which many farmers need to learn from multiple people before they adopt themselves. This means that without proper targeting of information, the diffusion process can stall and technology adoption remains perpetually low. (JEL O13, O18, O33, Q12, Q16)

10.1257/aer.20200295.abstractZh: 将信息定向传递给农村中的核心农民是否能够促进新农业技术的采用？通过结合社交网络数据和马拉维200个村庄的实地实验，我们发现针对核心农民进行信息传递对于推动技术扩散过程至关重要。我们还提供了关于为什么核心性重要的一个解释：即扩散过程受到复杂传染效应的影响。我们的研究结果与一种模型相符，该模型认为许多农民在采用新技术之前需要从多个来源学习。这意味着，如果没有对信息进行恰当的定向传递，扩散过程可能会停滞，技术采用率将长期保持在较低水平。（JEL O13, O18, O33, Q12, Q16）

abstract.text: We study two-player games where one-sided asymmetric information can lead to either adverse or advantageous selection. We contrast behavior in these games with settings where both players are uninformed. We find stark differences, suggesting that subjects do account for endogenous selection effects. Removing strategic uncertainty increases the fraction of subjects who account for selection. Subjects respond more to adverse than advantageous selection. Using additional treatments where we vary payoff feedback, we connect this difference to learning. We also observe a significant fraction of subjects who appear to understand selection effects but do not apply that knowledge. (JEL C92, D82, D91)

10.1257/aer.20200304.abstractZh: 我们研究了两方博弈，其中一方的非对称信息可能导致不利或有利的选择。我们将这些博弈中的行为与双方都无信息的情形进行了对比。我们发现存在显著差异，这表明参与者确实会考虑内生选择效应。消除战略不确定性会增加考虑选择效应的参与者比例。参与者对不利选择的反应比对有利选择的反应更为敏感。通过进一步调整收益反馈等处理方式，我们将这种差异与学习联系起来。我们还观察到，有相当一部分参与者似乎理解选择效应，但却没有应用这些知识。（JEL C92, D82, D91）

abstract.text: How do foreign powers disengage from a conflict? We study this issue by examining the recent, large-scale security transition from international troops to local forces in the ongoing civil conflict in Afghanistan. We construct a new dataset that combines information on this transition process with declassified conflict outcomes and previously unreleased quarterly survey data of residents’ perceptions of local security. Our empirical design leverages the staggered roll-out of the transition, and employs a novel instrumental variables approach to estimate the impact. We find a significant, sharp, and timely decline of insurgent violence in the initial phase: the security transfer to Afghan forces. We find that this is followed by a significant surge in violence in the second phase: the actual physical withdrawal of foreign troops. We argue that this pattern is consistent with a signaling model, in which the insurgents reduce violence strategically to facilitate the foreign military withdrawal to capitalize on the reduced foreign military presence afterward. Our findings clarify the destabilizing consequences of withdrawal in one of the costliest conflicts in modern history, and yield potentially actionable insights for designing future security transitions. (JEL D74, F51, F52, O17)

10.1257/aer.20200412.abstractZh: 外国势力如何脱离冲突？我们通过研究阿富汗持续内战中从国际部队向当地部队的大规模安全转移问题来探讨这一问题。我们构建了一个新的数据集，该数据集结合了这一转移过程的信息、已公开的冲突结果以及之前未发布的居民对当地安全的看法调查数据。我们的实证设计利用了转移过程的分阶段实施，并采用了一种新的工具变量方法来估计其影响。我们发现，在最初阶段，即安全转移给阿富汗部队时，叛乱暴力的显著、急剧且及时的下降。随后，在外国部队实际撤出的第二阶段，暴力活动出现了显著上升。我们认为，这种模式与信号模型一致，即叛乱分子通过减少暴力来为外国军队的撤出创造条件，从而利用之后减少的外国军事存在来获利。我们的发现揭示了在现代历史上最昂贵的冲突之一中撤军所带来的不稳定后果，并为未来安全转移的设计提供了潜在的 actionable见解。（JEL D74, F51, F52, O17）

abstract.text: High-achieving, low-income students attend selective colleges at far lower rates than upper-income students with similar achievement. Behavioral biases, intensified by complexity and uncertainty in the admissions and aid process, may explain this gap. In a large-scale experiment we test an early commitment of free tuition at a flagship university. The intervention did not increase aid: rather, students were guaranteed before application the same grant aid that they would qualify for in expectation if admitted. The offer substantially increased application (68 percent versus 26 percent) and enrollment rates (27 percent versus 12 percent). The results suggest that uncertainty, present bias, and loss aversion loom large in students’ college decisions. (JEL I22, I23, I24, D31, I28)

10.1257/aer.20200451.abstractZh: 高成就但低收入的学生进入选择性大学的比例远低于具有相似成就的高收入学生。行为偏差，加上招生和资助过程中的复杂性和不确定性，可能是造成这种差距的原因。在一项大规模实验中，我们测试了在旗舰大学提供免费学费这一举措。该干预措施并未增加资助金额：相反，学生在申请前获得了与录取后预期获得的相同资助金额。这一举措显著增加了申请人数（68%对比26%）和入学率（27%对比12%）。结果表明，不确定性、当前偏差和损失厌恶在学生的大学选择中起着重要作用。（JEL I22, I23, I24, D31, I28）

abstract.text: I study the political impact of the first populist radio personality in American history. Father Charles Coughlin blended populist demagoguery, anti-Semitism, and fascist sympathies to create a hugely popular radio program that attracted 30 million weekly listeners in the 1930s. I find that exposure to Father Coughlin’s anti-Roosevelt broadcast reduced Franklin D. Roosevelt’s vote share in the 1936 presidential election. Coughlin’s effects were larger among Catholics and persisted after Coughlin left the air. Moreover, places more exposed to Coughlin’s broadcast were more likely to form a local branch of the pro-Nazi German-American Bund and sold fewer war bonds during World War II. (JEL D72, L82, N32, N42, Z12)

10.1257/aer.20200513.abstractZh: 我研究了美国历史上第一位民粹主义广播人物的政治影响。查尔斯·科格林牧师将民粹主义煽动、反犹太主义以及法西斯主义倾向融合在一起，打造了一档广受欢迎的广播节目，在20世纪30年代每周吸引了3000万听众。我发现，科格林牧师那些反对罗斯福的广播节目使得富兰克林·D·罗斯福在1936年总统选举中的得票率下降。科格林的影响在天主教徒中更为显著，并且在他离开广播界后这种影响仍然存在。此外，那些更容易接收到科格林广播节目的地方，更有可能成立支持纳粹德国的德国裔美国人联盟，并且在第二次世界大战期间出售的战争债券数量也较少。（JEL D72, L82, N32, N42, Z12）

abstract.text: To investigate barriers to universal health insurance in developing countries, we designed a randomized experiment involving about 6,000 households in Indonesia who are subject to a government health insurance program with a weakly enforced mandate. Time-limited subsidies increased enrollment and attracted lower-cost enrollees, in part by reducing the strategic timing of enrollment to correspond with health needs. Registration assistance also increased enrollment, but increased attempted enrollment much more, as over one-half of households who attempted to enroll did not successfully do so. These findings underscore how weak administrative capacity can create important challenges in developing countries for achieving widespread coverage. (JEL D82, G22, H51, I13, I18, O15)

10.1257/aer.20200523.abstractZh: 为了研究发展中国家全民健康保险的障碍，我们设计了一项随机实验，涉及印度尼西亚约6,000户家庭。这些家庭参加了政府提供的健康保险计划，但该计划的强制实施力度较弱。限时补贴增加了参保人数，并吸引了成本较低的参保者，部分原因是减少了参保时机与健康需求之间的不匹配。注册协助也增加了参保人数，但尝试参保的家庭数量增加了更多，因为超过一半尝试参保的家庭未能成功。这些发现强调了在发展中国家，薄弱的行政能力如何给实现广泛覆盖带来重要挑战。（JEL D82, G22, H51, I13, I18, O15）

abstract.text: A principal incentivizes a team of agents to work by privately offering them bonuses contingent on team success. We study the principal’s optimal incentive scheme that implements work as a unique equilibrium. This scheme leverages rank uncertainty to address strategic uncertainty. Each agent is informed only of a ranking distribution and his own bonus, the latter making work dominant provided that higher-rank agents work. If agents are symmetric, their bonuses are identical. Thus, discrimination is strictly suboptimal, in sharp contrast with the case of public contracts (Winter 2004). We characterize how agents’ ranking and compensation vary with asymmetric effort costs. (JEL D23, D62, D81, D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.20200555.abstractZh: 一个委托人通过私下给予团队成员奖金来激励他们工作，这些奖金取决于团队的成功。我们研究了委托人实施的最优激励方案，该方案将工作视为一种独特的均衡状态。该方案利用排名的不确定性来应对战略上的不确定性。每个代理人仅知道一个排名分布以及自己的奖金，后者的存在使得工作成为主导行为，前提是排名较高的代理人愿意工作。如果代理人是对称的，他们的奖金是相同的。因此，这种歧视行为严格来说是不优的，这与公共合同的情况截然不同（Winter 2004）。我们描述了代理人的排名和补偿如何随着不对称的努力成本而变化。（JEL D23, D62, D81, D82, D86）

abstract.text: Can increasing control over earnings incentivize a woman to work, and thereby influence norms around gender roles? We randomly varied whether rural Indian women received bank accounts, training in account use, and direct deposit of public sector wages into their own (versus husbands') accounts. Relative to the accounts only group, women who also received direct deposit and training worked more in public and private sector jobs. The private sector result suggests gender norms initially constrained female employment. Three years later, direct deposit and training broadly liberalized women's own work-related norms, and shifted perceptions of community norms.

10.1257/aer.20200705.abstractZh: 增加对收入的控制是否能够激励女性工作，从而影响性别角色规范？我们随机改变了农村印度女性是否获得银行账户、账户使用培训以及将公共部门工资直接存入她们自己的账户（而非丈夫的账户）的情况。与仅拥有银行账户的组相比，同时获得直接存款和培训的女性在公共部门和私营部门的工作时间更长。私营部门的研究结果表明，性别规范最初限制了女性的就业。三年后，直接存款和培训使得女性自身的职业规范更加自由，同时也改变了她们对社区规范的认知。

abstract.text: We model a simple market setting in which fragmentation of trade of the same asset across multiple exchanges improves allocative efficiency. Fragmentation reduces the inhibiting effect of price-impact avoidance on order submission. Although fragmentation reduces market depth on each exchange, it also isolates cross-exchange price impacts, leading to more aggressive overall order submission and better rebalancing of unwanted positions across traders. Fragmentation also has implications for the extent to which prices reveal traders’ private information. While a given exchange price is less informative in more fragmented markets, all exchange prices taken together are more informative. (JEL D47, D82, G14)

10.1257/aer.20200829.abstractZh: 我们模拟了一个简单的市场环境，其中同一资产在多个交易所之间的交易分散化可以提高配置效率。分散化减少了价格影响规避对订单提交的影响。尽管分散化降低了每个交易所的市场深度，但它也隔离了不同交易所之间的价格影响，从而导致更积极的整体订单提交，并更好地重新平衡交易者之间的不良头寸。分散化还涉及到价格在多大程度上揭示交易者的私人信息。在更加分散化的市场中，单个交易所的价格信息量较少，但所有交易所的价格综合起来则更具信息量。（JEL D47, D82, G14）

abstract.text: We explore how taste projection—the tendency to overestimate how similar others’ tastes are to one’s own—affects bidding in auctions. In first-price auctions with private values, taste projection leads bidders to exaggerate the intensity of competition and, consequently, to overbid—irrespective of whether values are independent, affiliated, or (a)symmetric. Moreover, the optimal reserve price is lower than the rational benchmark, and decreasing in the extent of projection and the number of bidders. With an uncertain common-value component, projecting bidders draw distorted inferences about others’ information. This misinference is stronger in second-price and English auctions, reducing their allocative efficiency compared to first-price auctions. (JEL D11, D44, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20200988.abstractZh: 我们探讨了品味投射——即高估他人品味与自己相似程度的倾向——如何影响拍卖中的出价行为。在具有私人价值的首价拍卖中，品味投射会导致竞买者夸大竞争强度，从而出价过高——无论价值是否独立、相关还是对称。此外，最优保留价格低于理性基准，并且随着投射程度的降低和竞买者数量的减少而降低。在共同价值不确定的情况下，品味投射会使竞买者对他人的信息做出扭曲的推断。这种误判在次价拍卖和英式拍卖中更为明显，与首价拍卖相比，它们的分配效率更低。（JEL D11, D44, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Corrupt government hiring is common in developing countries. This paper uses original data to document the operation and consequences of corrupt hiring in a health bureaucracy. Hires pay bribes averaging 17 months of salary, but contrary to conventional wisdom, their observable quality is comparable to counterfactual merit-based hires. Exploiting variation across jobs, I show that the consequences of corrupt allocations depend on the correlation between wealth and quality among applicants: service delivery outcomes are good for jobs where this was positive and poor when negative. In this setting, the correlation was typically positive, leading to relatively good performance of hires. (JEL D73, I11, J16, J24, J45, M51, O17)

10.1257/aer.20201062.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，腐败的政府招聘现象十分常见。本文利用原始数据，记录了卫生部门中腐败招聘的运作方式及其后果。行贿的薪酬平均相当于17个月的工资，但与传统观念相反，这些腐败招聘对象的实际表现与基于能力的招聘并无明显差异。通过研究不同岗位之间的差异，我们发现腐败招聘的后果取决于申请者之间的财富与质量相关性：在相关性为正的情况下，招聘效果较好；而在相关性为负的情况下，招聘效果较差。在这种情况下，相关性通常为正，从而导致招聘效果相对较好。（JEL D73, I11, J16, J24, J45, M51, O17）

abstract.text: Autocratic regimes, democratic majorities, private platforms, and religious or professional organizations can achieve social control by managing the flow of information about individuals’ behavior. Bundling the agents’ political, organizational, or religious attitudes with information about their prosocial conduct makes them care about behaviors that they otherwise would not. The incorporation of the individuals’ social graph in their social score further promotes soft control but destroys the social fabric. Both bundling and guilt by association are most effective in a society that has weak ties and is politically docile. (JEL D64, D72, D83, D91, K38, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20201214.abstractZh: 专制政权、民主多数、私人平台以及宗教或专业组织可以通过控制关于个人行为的信息来实现社会控制。将代理人的政治、组织或宗教态度与关于他们亲社会行为的信息结合起来，使他们关心那些原本不会关注的行为。将个人的社交图谱纳入其社会评分中，进一步促进了软性控制，但同时也破坏了社会结构。在关系薄弱且政治上顺从的社会中，这种捆绑行为和关联负罪感的方式最为有效。（JEL D64, D72, D83, D91, K38, Z13）

abstract.text: We compare two approaches to increasing tax revenue: tax administration and tax rates. We show that when Indonesia moved top regional firms into “medium taxpayer offices,” with high staff-to-taxpayer ratios, tax revenue more than doubled. Examining nonlinear changes to corporate income tax rates, we estimate an elasticity of taxable income of 0.579. Combining these estimates, improved tax administration is equivalent to raising top rates on all firms by 8 percentage points. On net, improved tax administration can have significant returns for developing countries. (JEL H25, H26, K34, O17)

10.1257/aer.20201237.abstractZh: 我们比较了两种增加税收收入的方法：税务管理和税率。研究表明，当印度尼西亚将顶级企业转移到“中等纳税人办公室”时，由于员工与纳税人的比例较高，税收收入增加了两倍以上。通过研究企业所得税税率的非线性变化，我们估计了应税收入的弹性为0.579。结合这些估计结果，改进税务管理相当于将所有企业的顶级税率提高8个百分点。总体而言，改进税务管理对发展中国家具有显著的回报作用。（JEL H25, H26, K34, O17）

abstract.text: This paper studies whether team members’ past collaboration creates team-specific human capital and influences current team performance. Using administrative Medicare claims for two heart procedures, I find that shared work experience between the doctor who performs the procedure (“proceduralist”) and the doctors who provide care to the patient during the hospital stay for the procedure (“physicians”) reduces patient mortality rates. A one standard deviation increase in proceduralist-physician shared work experience leads to a 10–14 percent reduction in patient 30-day mortality. Patient medical resource use also declines with shared work experience, even as survival improves. (JEL I10, J24, M12, M54)

10.1257/aer.20201238.abstractZh: 本文研究团队成员过去的合作是否会形成团队特有的人力资本，并影响当前的团队绩效。通过分析两项心脏手术相关的Medicare报销数据，我发现执行手术的医生与患者在住院期间提供护理的医生之间的共同工作经验，能够降低患者的死亡率。当 proceduralist与physicians之间的共同工作经验增加一个标准差时，患者30天内的死亡率可降低10-14%。即使随着生存率的提高，患者的医疗资源使用量也会随着共同工作经验的增加而减少。（JEL I10, J24, M12, M54）

abstract.text: This paper measures excess labor supply in equilibrium. We induce hiring shocks—which employ 24 percent of the labor force in external month-long jobs—in Indian local labor markets. In peak months, wages increase instantaneously and local aggregate employment declines. In lean months, consistent with severe labor rationing, wages and aggregate employment are unchanged, with positive employment spillovers on remaining workers, indicating that over a quarter of labor supply is rationed. At least 24 percent of lean self-employment among casual workers occurs because they cannot find jobs. Consequently, traditional survey approaches mismeasure labor market slack. Rationing has broad implications for labor market analysis. (JEL E24, J22, J23, J31, J64, O15, R23)

10.1257/aer.20201385.abstractZh: 本文研究了均衡状态下劳动力供应的过剩问题。我们通过在印度本地劳动力市场引入雇佣冲击，这些冲击占劳动力市场的24%。在劳动力需求旺盛的月份，工资会突然上升，而本地总就业人数则会下降。在劳动力需求不足的月份，由于严重的劳动力配给，工资和总就业人数保持不变，但剩余工人的就业情况有所改善，这表明有超过四分之一的劳动力供应受到了配给。至少有24%的临时工选择自主创业，因为他们找不到正式的工作。因此，传统的调查方法无法准确衡量劳动力市场的闲置情况。劳动力配给对劳动力市场分析有着广泛的影响。（JEL E24, J22, J23, J31, J64, O15, R23）

abstract.text: We explore how firms grow by adding products. We leverage detailed data from Japan’s cotton spinning industry at the turn of the last century to do so. This setting allows us to fully characterize the type of differentiation (vertical or horizontal) of new product introductions as well as whether the product is within or outside of the firm’s prior technological capabilities. We find that trying to introduce innovative products beyond the firm’s previous technologically feasible set, even if such trials fail, is a key to firm growth. Indeed, it mostly facilitates growth through the firm’s later success in horizontal product diversification. In long-term outcomes, the right tail of the firm size distribution becomes dominated by firms that first moved into technologically challenging products and then later applied their newly acquired technical competence to horizontal expansion of their product portfolios. Two mechanisms through which this knowledge transfer occurs are greater production system flexibility and higher product appeal to downstream buyers. (JEL D22, L11,L67, N65, N85, O31, O33)

10.1257/aer.20201656.abstractZh: 我们探讨了企业如何通过增加产品来增长。我们利用了上个世纪日本棉纺行业详细的数据来进行研究。这一研究背景使我们能够全面描述新产品推出的差异化类型（垂直或水平），以及该产品是否属于企业先前的技术能力范围内。我们发现，即使尝试引入超出企业先前技术可行范围的新产品会失败，这也是企业增长的关键。实际上，这种尝试主要通过企业后来在水平产品多样化方面的成功来促进增长。从长期结果来看，企业规模分布中的高端部分主要由那些首先进入技术挑战性较高的产品领域，随后将新获得的技术能力应用于产品组合水平扩展的企业所主导。实现这种知识转移的机制包括生产系统的更大灵活性以及产品对下游买家的更高吸引力。（JEL D22, L11, L67, N65, N85, O31, O33）

abstract.text: We introduce a set-valued solution concept, M equilibrium, to capture empirical regularities from over half a century of game theory experiments. We show M equilibrium serves as a meta theory for various models that hitherto were considered unrelated. M equilibrium is empirically robust and, despite being set-valued, falsifiable. Results from a series of experiments that compare M equilibrium to leading behavioral game theory models demonstrate its virtues in predicting observed choices and stated beliefs. Data from experimental games with a unique pure-strategy Nash equilibrium and multiple M equilibria exhibit coordination problems that could not be anticipated through the lens of existing models. (JEL C72, C90, D83)

10.1257/aer.20201683.abstractZh: 我们引入了一种集值解概念——M均衡，以捕捉超过半个世纪博弈论实验中的经验规律。我们证明，M均衡可以作为各种模型的元理论，而这些模型此前被认为是不相关的。M均衡在经验上具有稳健性，尽管它是集值的，但也是可证伪的。一系列将M均衡与主流行为博弈论模型进行比较的实验结果表明，M均衡在预测观察到的选择和陈述的信念方面具有优势。在具有独特纯策略纳什均衡和多个M均衡的实验游戏中，出现了通过现有模型无法预见的协调问题。（JEL C72, C90, D83）

abstract.text: Justified communication equilibrium (JCE) is an equilibrium refinement for signaling games with cheap-talk communication. A strategy profile must be a JCE to be a stable outcome of nonequilibrium learning when receivers are initially trusting and senders play many more times than receivers. In the learning model, the counterfactual “speeches” that have been informally used to motivate past refinements are messages that are actually sent. Stable profiles need not be perfect Bayesian equilibria, so JCE sometimes preserves equilibria that existing refinements eliminate. Despite this, it resembles the earlier refinements D1 and NWBR, and it coincides with them in co-monotonic signaling games. (JEL C70, D82, D83, J23, M51)

10.1257/aer.20201692.abstractZh: 合理沟通均衡（JCE）是一种针对具有廉价沟通机制的信号博弈的均衡改进方法。当一个策略组合能够成为非均衡学习下的稳定结果时，它必须是一个JCE。在这种情况下，接收者最初是信任的，而发送者的游戏次数远多于接收者。在学习模型中，那些被非正式地用来推动过去均衡改进的反事实“言论”实际上就是实际发送的信息。稳定的策略组合不必是完美的贝叶斯均衡，因此JCE有时会保留那些现有均衡改进所消除的均衡。尽管如此，它仍然与早期的均衡改进D1和NWBR相似，并且在共单调信号博弈中与它们保持一致。（JEL C70, D82, D83, J23, M51）

abstract.text: We propose a pseudo-market solution to resource allocation problems subject to constraints. Our treatment of constraints is general: including bihierarchical constraints due to considerations of diversity in school choice, or scheduling in course allocation; and other forms of constraints needed to model, for example, the market for roommates, combinatorial assignment problems, and knapsack constraints. Constraints give rise to pecuniary externalities, which are internalized via prices. Agents pay to the extent that their purchases affect the value the of relevant constraints at equilibrium prices. The result is a constrained-efficient market-equilibrium outcome. The outcome is fair to the extent that constraints treat agents symmetrically. (JEL D47, D61, D63, I11, I21)

10.1257/aer.20201769.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对受约束条件约束的资源分配问题的伪市场解决方案。我们对约束条件的处理是通用的：包括由于学校选择多样性或课程分配时间安排的考虑而产生的双层次约束；以及其他形式的约束条件，例如对室友市场、组合分配问题以及背包约束的建模所需。约束条件会产生金钱性外部性，这些外部性通过价格得到内部化。代理人支付的金额取决于他们的购买行为在均衡价格下对相关约束条件的影响程度。最终的结果是一个受约束但高效的市场均衡状态。该结果在约束条件对代理人一视同仁的情况下是公平的。（JEL D47, D61, D63, I11, I21）

abstract.text: A proposer requires a veto player’s approval to change a status quo. Proposer is uncertain about Vetoer’s preferences. We show that Vetoer is typically given a non-singleton menu, or delegation set, of options to pick from. The optimal set balances the extent of compromise with the risk of a veto. We identify conditions for certain delegation sets to emerge, including “full delegation”: Vetoer can choose any action between the status quo and Proposer’s ideal action. By contrast to expertise-based delegation, Proposer gives less discretion to Vetoer when their preferences are more (likely to be) aligned. (JEL D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.20201817.abstractZh: 提案者需要得到否决者的批准才能改变现状。提案者对否决者的偏好并不确定。我们指出，否决者通常面临一个非单点的选项集，或者称为委托集合，可供其选择。最优选项集需要平衡妥协的程度与否决的风险。我们确定了某些委托集合出现的条件，包括“完全委托”：否决者可以在现状与提案者理想行动之间选择任何行动。与基于专业知识的委托不同，当否决者的偏好更有可能一致时，提案者给予否决者的自由裁量权较少。（JEL D72, D82）

abstract.text: Despite the implications for policy, empirical evidence on the relative importance of factors that shape labor supply responses is missing. This paper helps fill this gap and quantifies the role of information frictions versus other frictions by combining notches in the Norwegian welfare system and quasi-experimental variation in access to information about the slope and location of kinks. While we estimate a frictionless elasticity of 0.3, overall frictions attenuate this elasticity by about 70 percent. We find the information letter increased the earnings elasticity from 0.06 to 0.15, implying that information frictions account for at least 30 percent of total attenuation. (JEL D83, H24, I38, J22, J28, J31)

10.1257/aer.20201877.abstractZh: 尽管这对政策有重大影响，但关于影响劳动力供给反应的各因素相对重要性的实证证据仍然缺失。本文通过结合挪威福利体系中的差异以及关于信息获取方面的准实验变化，来量化信息摩擦与其他摩擦的作用。我们估计出无摩擦的弹性为0.3，而总体摩擦使这一弹性降低了约70%。我们发现，信息水平的提高使收入弹性从0.06增加到0.15，这意味着信息摩擦至少占总衰减的30%。（JEL D83, H24, I38, J22, J28, J31）

abstract.text: Life expectancy varies substantially across local regions within a country, raising conjectures that place of residence affects health. However, population sorting and other confounders make it difficult to disentangle the effects of place on health from other geographic differences in life expectancy. Recent studies have overcome such challenges to demonstrate that place of residence substantially influences health and mortality. Whether policies that encourage people to move to places that are better for their health or that improve areas that are detrimental to health are desirable depends on the mechanisms behind place effects, yet these mechanisms remain poorly understood.

10.1257/jep.35.4.147.abstractZh: 一个国家内不同地区的预期寿命存在显著差异，这引发了关于居住地点是否影响健康的猜想。然而，人口分布和其他混杂因素使得难以将居住地点对健康的影响与其他地理差异对预期寿命的影响区分开来。最近的研究克服了这些挑战，证明了居住地点对健康和死亡率有显著影响。是否鼓励人们迁移到对健康更有利的地方，或者改善对健康有害的区域，这些政策是否可取，取决于居住地点效应背后的机制，而这些机制目前仍不清楚。

abstract.text: A principal owns a firm, hires an agent of uncertain productivity, and designs a dynamic policy for evaluating his performance. The agent observes ongoing evaluations and decides when to quit. When not quitting, the agent is paid a wage that is linear in his expected productivity; the principal claims the residual performance. After quitting, the players secure fixed outside options. I show that equilibrium is Pareto efficient. For a broad class of performance technologies, the equilibrium wage deterministically grows with tenure. My analysis suggests that endogenous performance evaluation plays an important role in shaping careers in organizations. (JEL D21, D82, D83, J24, J31, J41, M51)

10.1257/mic.20170405.abstractZh: 一位委托人拥有一家公司，雇佣了一位生产力不确定的代理人，并制定了一项动态政策来评估其表现。代理人会观察持续的评估过程，并决定何时离职。在继续任职期间，代理人获得的工资与其预期生产力呈线性关系；而剩余绩效则由委托人享有。离职后，代理人可以获得固定的外部福利。我证明这种均衡是帕累托有效的。对于大多数绩效技术类型，均衡工资会随着任职时间的延长而确定性地增长。我的分析表明，内生性的绩效评估在塑造组织中的职业生涯方面起着重要作用。（JEL D21, D82, D83, J24, J31, J41, M51）

abstract.text: Selective contracting is an increasingly popular tool for reducing health care costs, but any savings must be weighed against consumer surplus losses from restricted access. Recently, many prescription drug plans (PDPs) utilize preferred pharmacy networks to reduce drug prices. Our results suggest that Medicare Part D plans with preferred pharmacy networks pay lower retail drug prices, while subsidized enrollees’ insensitivity to preferred pharmacy cost-sharing discounts reduces these savings. We then estimate pharmacy demand models to quantify the costs and benefits of preferred pharmacy networks, finding that the average enrollee benefits from preferred pharmacy contracting due to reduced out-of-pocket (OOP) costs at preferred pharmacies. (JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, L65, L81)

10.1257/pol.20180489.abstractZh: 选择性签约是降低医疗成本的一种越来越受欢迎的方法，但任何节省的费用都必须与因限制就医而带来的消费者剩余损失进行权衡。最近，许多处方药计划利用优先药房网络来降低药品价格。我们的研究结果表明，拥有优先药房网络的Medicare Part D计划能够支付更低的零售药品价格，而补贴参保者对优先药房费用减免的不敏感则减少了这些节省效果。我们进一步通过估算药房需求模型来量化优先药房网络的成本和收益，发现平均参保者因在优先药房减少自付费用而受益。（JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, L65, L81）

abstract.text: I study team decisions among physician trainees. Exploiting a discontinuity in team roles across trainee tenure, I find evidence that teams alter decision-making, concentrating influence in the hands of senior trainees. I also demonstrate little convergence in variation of trainee effects despite intensive training. This general pattern of trainee effects on team decision-making exists in all types of decisions and settings that I examine. In analyses evaluating mechanisms behind this pattern, I find support for the idea that significant experiential learning occurs during training and that teams place more weight on judgments of senior trainees in order to aggregate information. (JEL D83, I11, J44, M53, M54)

10.1257/pol.20180501.abstractZh: 我研究了医生培训生之间的团队决策。通过分析培训生任期内团队角色的变化，我发现团队在决策过程中会发生变化，高级培训生的影响力会集中起来。我还发现，尽管培训生接受了密集的培训，但他们的影响差异仍然很小。这种培训生对团队决策的影响模式在我研究的各种决策和环境中都存在。在评估这种模式背后机制的分析中，我发现培训期间确实会发生重要的经验学习，而且团队会更多地依赖高级培训生的判断来汇总信息。（JEL D83, I11, J44, M53, M54）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the long-term impact of growing up in better neighborhoods and attending better schools on educational attainment. First, I use a spatial regression-discontinuity design to estimate school effects. Second, I study students who move across neighborhoods in Montreal during childhood to estimate the causal effect of growing up in a better area (total exposure effects). I find large effects for both dimensions. Combining both research designs in a decomposition framework, and under key assumptions, I estimate that 50–70 percent of the benefits of moving to a better area on educational attainment are due to access to better schools. (JEL H75, I21, R23)

10.1257/pol.20190257.abstractZh: 本文估计了在更好的社区成长和就读更好的学校对教育成就的长期影响。首先，我采用空间回归-不连续设计来估计学校的影响。其次，我研究了在蒙特利尔儿童时期搬离原社区的学生，以评估在更好的区域成长所带来的因果效应（总暴露效应）。我发现这两个维度都有显著的影响。在关键假设下，通过将这两种研究设计结合在一个分解框架中，我估计有50-70%的从更好的区域搬来的好处源于能够就读更好的学校。（JEL H75, I21, R23）

abstract.text: Recent efforts to increase price transparency for American consumers of health care have largely failed to produce savings. At the same time, little effort has been made towards increasing physician-side price transparency, which may be due to limited high-quality research being available on the topic.
