I try to address this limitation in the literature by performing a field experiment on physician price transparency for an area that has received little attention: physician referrals. Working with a group of medical practices linked as an Independent Practice Association (IPA), I randomly selected primary care practices to receive a list of prices for new referrals to six ophthalmology practices that were part of the IPA's provider network. These practices handled the bulk of the IPA's ophthalmology patients and represented substitute providers. Using the IPA's administrative data on referrals, I find that during the first two months following the distribution of the price list, the treatment group primary care physicians (PCPs) increased referral share towards the least expensive ophthalmology practice by 147 percent. These referrals were allocated away from the most expensive practice and those not listed on the report. These effects were only found, however, for patients for whom the PCPs had a cost reduction incentive. The large initial effect dissipated over the following four months. For patients with a limited financial interest for the PCPs, I find little evidence of a treatment response. These contrasting results suggest the PCPs were influenced by cost reduction motives and provide evidence of the potential for savings from physician-side price transparency.

10.1257/rct.8279.abstractZh: 近期为美国消费者提高医疗保健价格透明度的努力大多未能带来实际节省。与此同时，在提高医生端价格透明度方面的努力却很少，这可能是由于关于这一主题的高质量研究有限。我试图通过在一个鲜少被关注的领域——医生转诊——进行实地实验来克服文献中的这一局限性。我与一个作为独立执业协会的医疗机构集团合作，随机选取了一些初级保健诊所，向其提供六家属于该协会医疗服务网络的眼科诊所的新转诊价格清单。这些诊所承担了该协会大部分眼科患者的治疗任务，并作为替代医疗服务提供者。利用该协会关于转诊的行政数据，我发现，在价格清单发放后的两个月内，实验组的初级保健医生将转诊份额增加到了最便宜的眼科诊所的147%。这些转诊被分配到最昂贵的诊所和未列入清单的诊所之外。然而，这些效果仅出现在那些有成本降低动机的患者身上。最初的大规模效果在接下来的四个月内逐渐消失。对于那些对初级保健医生的财务利益有限的患者来说，几乎没有证据表明他们有所响应。这些对比鲜明的结果表明，初级保健医生受到成本降低动机的影响，同时也证明了从医生端价格透明度中节省费用的可能性。

abstract.text: O presente trabalho visa a discutir características da gestão de pessoas no setor público da saúde no Brasil na terceira década do século XXI. Com base na literatura da área foi desenvolvido um roteiro para entrevistas de gestores de organizações da administração direta e da indireta da saúde e aplicado a profissionais de nível central e local que concordaram em participar da pesquisa. Os achados foram discutidos e analisados, embora não tenha sido realizada comparação de sua eficácia em função de resultados obtidos. A conclusão deste trabalho evidencia a relevância do tema gestão de pessoas na saúde e as diferenças de instrumentos disponíveis na gestão direta e nas organizações sociais de saúde.

10.12660/cgpc.v26n84.83080.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨21世纪第三个十年中巴西公共卫生领域人员管理的特点。基于相关文献，我们制定了一份针对公共卫生领域直接或间接管理机构的管理人员的访谈提纲，并应用于那些同意参与研究的中央和地方各级专业人员。研究结果得到了讨论和分析，尽管并未对其效果进行实际结果的比较。本研究的结论表明，人员管理在公共卫生领域的重要性，以及直接管理和社会卫生组织所使用的工具之间的差异。

abstract.text: Background: The relationship between procedural volume and outcomes for percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI) is contentious, with previous reviews suggesting an inverse volume-outcome relationship. The aim of this study was to systematically review contemporary evidence to re-examine this relationship. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis was undertaken to examine the relationship between PCI procedural volume (both at hospital- and operator-levels) and outcomes in adults. The primary outcome was mortality. The secondary outcomes were complications, healthcare utilisation and process outcomes. Searches were conducted from 1 January 2008 to 28 May 2019. Certainty of the evidence was assessed using ‘Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluations’ (GRADE). Screening, data extraction, quality appraisal and GRADE assessments were conducted independently by two reviewers. Results: Of 1,154 unique records retrieved, 22 observational studies with 6,432,265 patients were included. No significant association was found between total PCI hospital volume and mortality (odds ratio [OR]: 0.84, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.69-1.03, I 2 = 86%). A temporal trend from significant to non-significant pooled effect estimates was observed. The pooled effect estimate for mortality was found to be significantly in favour of high-volume operators for total PCI procedures (OR: 0.77, 95% CI: 0.63-0.94, I 2 = 93%), and for high-volume hospitals for primary PCI procedures (OR: 0.77, 95% CI: 0.62-0.94, I 2 = 78%). Overall, GRADE certainty of evidence was ‘very low’. There were mixed findings for secondary outcomes. Conclusions: A volume-outcome relationship may exist in certain situations, although this relationship appears to be attenuating with time, and there is ‘very low’ certainty of evidence. While volume might be important, it should not be the only standard used to define an acceptable PCI service and a broader evaluation of quality metrics should be considered that encompass patient experience and clinical outcomes. Systematic review registration: PROSPERO, CRD42019125288

10.12688/hrbopenres.13203.1.abstractZh:
背景：关于经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的操作量与治疗效果之间的关系存在争议，之前的综述表明两者之间存在反比关系。本研究的目的是系统回顾现有证据，以重新评估这一关系。  
方法：进行了一项系统回顾和荟萃分析，以探讨PCI操作量（包括医院级和操作员级）与成人患者治疗效果之间的关系。主要评估指标为死亡率，次要指标包括并发症、医疗资源利用和过程结果。检索时间范围为2008年1月1日至2019年5月28日。使用“推荐、评估、开发及评价等级系统”（GRADE）来评估证据的确定性。数据提取、质量评估及GRADE评估由两名独立 reviewer 完成。  
结果：在检索到的1,154份独立记录中，纳入了22项观察性研究，涉及6,432,265名患者。未发现PCI操作总量与死亡率之间存在显著关联（比值比[OR]：0.84，95%置信区间[CI]：0.69-1.03，I²=86%）。观察到汇总效应估计值从显著变为不显著的趋势。对于总PCI手术，汇总效应估计值显著支持高操作量操作员的优势（OR：0.77，95% CI：0.63-0.94，I²=93）；对于初级PCI手术，则支持高操作量医院的优势（OR：0.77，95% CI：0.62-0.94，I²=78%）。总体而言，证据的确定性为“非常低”。次要指标的结果则存在混合性发现。  
结论：在某些情况下，操作量与治疗效果之间可能存在关联，但随着时间的推移，这种关联似乎有所减弱。证据的确定性为“非常低”。虽然数量可能很重要，但它不应该是定义合格PCI服务的唯一标准。还应综合考虑其他质量指标，包括患者体验和临床结果。系统性回顾注册：PROSPERO，CRD42019125288

abstract.text: The eXtensible Business Reporting Language (XBRL) can standardize numerical disclosures and make it easier for computers to process and compare financial reports. This perceived benefit of XBRL has prompted the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to mandate that public firms must submit financial statements in the XBRL format as part of their financial reports. Leveraging the research opportunity created by the XBRL mandate, we examine whether financial reporting technologies affect how firms construct textual disclosures. We find that the initial adopters’ HTML-formatted annual reports become harder to read after the XBRL mandate. Further analysis reveals that this effect is concentrated among adopters with more quantitative disclosures, a smaller firm size, or a higher level of financial complexity. Importantly, we show that managers’ reduced attention to preparing HTML-formatted annual reports, rather than increased disclosures, is likely the explanation for this decrease in textual readability. We also find that the negative effect on textual readability persists at least in the subsequent year. Our findings suggest that the XBRL adopters need to pay attention to process optimization and technology enablement to mitigate the possible negative effect of XBRL adoption on the readability of financial reports.

10.1287/isre.2021.1012.abstractZh: 可扩展商业报告语言（XBRL）能够标准化数值披露，使计算机更容易处理并比较财务报告。XBRL的这一优势促使美国证券交易委员会要求上市公司必须以XBRL格式提交财务报表。我们利用XBRL强制要求带来的研究机会，探讨财务报告技术是否会影响企业构建文本披露的方式。我们发现，在XBRL强制要求实施后，最初采用XBRL格式的年报变得难以阅读。进一步分析表明，这种影响主要集中在那些披露内容更为量化、企业规模较小或财务复杂度较高的企业身上。重要的是，我们发现，管理者对准备HTML格式年报的关注减少，而非披露内容的增加，可能是导致文本可读性下降的原因。我们还发现，这种对文本可读性的负面影响至少在随后的一年里仍然存在。我们的研究结果表明，XBRL采用者需要关注流程优化和技术支持，以缓解XBRL采用对财务报告可读性可能产生的负面影响。

abstract.text: This study shows that retailers are likely to exploit their control over product selections as a negotiation tool.

10.1287/mksc.2021.1308.abstractZh: 本研究表明，零售商可能会利用对产品选择的控制作为谈判工具。

abstract.text: Financial constraints can cause firms to reduce product quality when quality is difficult to observe. We test this hypothesis in the context of medical choices at hospitals. Using heart attacks and child deliveries, we ask whether hospitals shift toward more profitable treatment options after a financial shock—the 2008 financial crisis. The crisis was followed by an unprecedented drop in hospital investments, yet the aggregate trends show no discrete shifts in treatment intensity post-2008. For cardiac treatment (but not for child deliveries), we find evidence that hospitals with larger financial losses during the financial crisis subsequently increased their use of intensive treatments relative to hospitals with smaller losses, consistent with the effects of financing constraints. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance.

10.1287/mnsc.2020.3944.abstractZh: 财务限制可能导致企业在产品质量难以监控的情况下降低产品质量。我们在医院的医疗选择背景下对这一假设进行了测试。以心脏病发作和儿童分娩为例，我们探讨了在2008年金融危机之后，医院是否转向了更有利可图的治疗方式。金融危机之后，医院的投资出现了前所未有的下降，但总体趋势显示，2008年之后治疗强度并没有出现明显的转变。对于心脏疾病治疗（而非儿童分娩），我们发现，在金融危机期间遭受较大财务损失的医院，随后增加了重症治疗的使用，这与融资限制的影响一致。这篇论文已被David Simchi-Levi的金融领域接受。

abstract.text: In an influential study, Bender et al. [Bender S, Bloom N, Card D, Van Reenen J, Wolter S (2018) Management practices, workforce selection, and productivity. J. Labor Econom. 36(S1):S371–S409] document consistent relationships between management practices, productivity, and workforce composition using administrative data from German firms matched to ratings of their practices from the World Management Survey. We replicate and extend their analysis using comparable data from Brazil. The main conclusions from their study are supported in ours, strengthening the view that more structured practices affect organizational performance through workforce selection across different institutional settings. However, we find that more structured management practices are linked to greater wage inequality in Brazil, relative to greater wage compression in Germany, suggesting that some of the consequences of adopting structured practices are tied to the local context. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy.

10.1287/mnsc.2021.3960.abstractZh: 在一项具有影响力的研究中，Bender等人[Bender S, Bloom N, Card D, Van Reenen J, Wolter S (2018) 管理实践、员工选拔与生产力. 劳动经济学杂志. 36(S1):S371–S409]利用德国企业的行政数据，并结合世界管理调查对企业管理实践的评估，揭示了管理实践、生产力与员工构成之间的稳定关系。我们采用巴西的可比数据对他们的研究进行了复制和扩展。他们研究的主要结论在我们研究中得到了支持，这进一步证实了更规范的管理实践能够通过不同制度环境下的员工选拔来影响组织绩效的观点。然而，我们发现，在巴西，更规范的管理实践与更高的工资不平等相关，而在德国则表现为工资水平的压缩，这表明采用规范管理实践的一些后果与当地环境有关。这篇论文已被商业战略领域的Joshua Gans接受。

abstract.text: We present evidence that unnecessarily complex disclosure can result from strategic incentives to shroud information. In our laboratory experiment, senders are required to report their private information truthfully but can choose how complex to make their reports. We find that senders use complex disclosure more than half the time. This obfuscation is profitable because receivers make systematic mistakes in assessing complex reports. Regression and structural analysis suggest that these mistakes could be driven by receivers who are naive about the strategic use of complexity or overconfident about their ability to process complex information. This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis.

10.1287/mnsc.2021.4037.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明出于对信息隐藏的战略性动机，不必要的复杂披露现象可能随之产生。在我们的实验室实验中，发送者被要求如实报告他们的私人信息，但可以选择报告的复杂程度。我们发现，发送者超过一半的时间都会使用复杂的披露方式。这种混淆行为是有利可图的，因为接收者在评估复杂报告时会出现系统性错误。回归分析和结构分析表明，这些错误可能是由于接收者对复杂性的战略使用缺乏了解，或者过于自信地认为自己能够处理复杂信息所导致的。这篇论文已被行为经济学和决策分析领域的Yan Chen接受。

abstract.text: There is an inherent tension between standardization and customization of care delivery processes. The challenge for health care systems is to achieve the right balance. At its best, standardized work can create efficiencies that generate the additional time needed for personalized care. Similarly, at its best, customization allows the people within a system to accommodate the needs, preferences, and circumstances of the unique individuals and local communities they serve. We provide examples and offer principles to decide when standardization offers the most successful path and when customization may be preferred. We believe that, in sum, the balance has shifted too far toward standardization and that a rebalancing toward customization will benefit patients, clinicians, and the health care system.

10.1370/afm.2654.abstractZh: 在护理流程的标准化与个性化之间存在着固有的矛盾。医疗系统面临的挑战在于找到恰当的平衡点。在最佳情况下，标准化工作能够提高效率，从而为个性化护理创造更多时间。同样，在最佳情况下，个性化服务能够让系统内的人员满足不同个体和当地社区的需求、偏好和情况。我们提供了一些例子，并提出了一些原则，以判断何时采用标准化方式最为合适，何时则更倾向于个性化服务。我们认为，总体而言，这种平衡已经过度偏向标准化，而重新调整以偏向个性化服务将有利于患者、临床医生以及整个医疗系统。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D has significantly enhanced access to prescription drugs among Medicare beneficiaries. However, the recent rapid rise of utilization management policies in the Medicare Part D program may have adversely affected access to prescription drugs. I study the effects of expected and observed exposure to utilization management in prescription drug utilization using Medicare Part D claims data from 2009 to 2016 and an instrumental variables strategy based on the interaction of lagged health status and the set of plans available to each beneficiary. I find that the expected share of spending subject to utilization management increases the observed share, with the smallest effect for prior authorization. Increases in the expected share of drug spending subject to prior authorization increases Part D spending by $122.27 per percentage point, with almost three-quarters of this increase being paid by the Medicare program, rather than beneficiaries or plans. Comparable increases in step therapy and quantity limit exposure increase spending by $46 and decrease spending by $31, respectively. Interestingly, increased exposure to prior authorization and quantity limits increases the average price per 30-day prescription.

10.1515/fhep-2022-0007.abstractZh: Medicare Part D显著提高了Medicare受益人对处方药的获取能力。然而，Medicare Part D项目中近期对使用管理的快速增加可能了对处方药的获取产生了不利影响。我利用2009至2016年的Medicare Part D索赔数据，并采用基于滞后健康状况与各受益人可选择的计划组合交互作用的工具变量策略，研究了预期和观察到的使用管理对处方药物使用的影响。研究发现，预期受到使用管理影响的支出比例增加了观察到的支出比例，其中预授权的影响最小。预授权导致的药物支出预期比例增加会使Part D支出增加122.27美元每百分点，其中近四分之三的增加是由Medicare项目承担，而非受益人或计划承担。相比之下，阶梯治疗和使用数量限制导致的支出增加分别增加了46美元和减少了31美元。有趣的是，预授权和使用数量限制的增加使得每30天处方药的平均价格上升。

abstract.text: What are the traits of a good local leader? While most studies of local officials focus on the mayors of large cities, 85% of municipalities in the United States have a population of less than 20,000. We conduct in-depth phone interviews with nearly 300 mayors and city managers from predominantly small and mid-sized cities in the United States to learn about their backgrounds. We focus on two standard ability measures (education and prior occupation) and draw from research in public administration and economics to introduce two new dimensions of quality: public service motivation and managerial skill. We paint a comprehensive descriptive portrait of the respondents in our sample and the cities they represent, and we then examine whether these traits matter for the policy goals that local leaders choose to focus on during their time in office. These results offer a promising new approach for researchers studying political leadership and its consequences, both in the local context and beyond.

10.1561/113.00000035.abstractZh: 优秀的本地领导者应具备哪些特质？虽然大多数关于地方官员的研究都集中在大城市的市长身上，但美国有85%的市政当局人口不足20,000人。我们对来自美国小型和中型城市的近300名市长及城市管理者进行了深入的电话访谈，以了解他们的背景。我们重点关注两个标准的能力指标（教育和以往的职业经历），并结合公共行政和经济学的研究，引入了两个新的质量维度：公共服务动机和管理技能。我们对样本中的受访者及其所代表的城市进行了全面的描述性分析，然后探讨这些特质是否对地方领导者在其任职期间所选择的政策目标产生影响。这些研究结果为研究政治领导力及其影响的学者提供了一种有前景的新方法，无论是在地方层面还是其他领域。

abstract.text: The spread of COVID-19 has disrupted firm operations on a global scale. Using a comprehensive data set that observes over 3,000 firms in 16 countries, including several developing countries, shortly before and after the pandemic, we relate firms’ structured management practices to post- COIVD-19 outcomes, and report four main findings. First, structured management practices are associated with more limited downside impacts of the crisis on firm sales and survival in manufacturing but not in services. Better managed manufacturing firms, on average, experience a smaller reduction in sales. Second, in both manufacturing and services, structured management practice scores are correlated with a firm’s ability to adjust or convert product mix and shift to online work arrangements. Third, management scores are not correlated with firm’s ability to adjust on employment margins. Fourth, the resilience of better managed firms is related primarily to incentive practices and is uncorrelated with operations or targeting practices. Monitoring practice scores show a modest correlation with a firm’s ability to switch to remote work arrangements.

10.1596/1813-9450-9514.abstractZh: COVID-19的传播在全球范围内扰乱了企业的运营。我们利用一个包含16个国家、超过3,000家企业的综合数据集，在疫情前后对这些企业进行研究，将企业的结构化管理实践与疫情后的结果联系起来，并得出四个主要发现。首先，结构化管理实践与制造业企业在危机中对销售和生存的负面影响较小相关，但在服务业中则不存在这种关联。管理得更好的制造业企业平均而言，其销售下降幅度较小。其次，在制造业和服务业中，结构化管理实践的得分与企业在调整产品组合和转向在线工作安排方面的能力相关。第三，管理实践的得分与企业在就业边际上的调整能力无关。第四，管理得更好的企业的韧性主要与激励措施有关，与运营或目标定位措施无关。监控实践的得分与企业在转向远程工作安排方面的能力有轻微的相关性。

abstract.text: This paper presents the results of a large-scale randomized experiment conducted across 1,496 public primary schools in Mexico. The experiment identifies the impact on schools' managerial capacity and student test scores of providing schools with: (a) cash grants, (b) managerial training for school principals, or (c) both. The school principals' managerial training focused on improving principals' capacities to collect and use data to monitor students' basic numeracy and literacy skills and provide feedback to teachers on their instruction and pedagogical practices. After two years of implementing these interventions, the study finds that: (a) the cash grant had no impact on the student's test scores or the management capacity of school principals; (b) the managerial training improved school principals' managerial capacity but had no impact on students' test scores; and (c) the combination of cash grants and managerial training amplified the effect on the school principals' managerial capacity and had a positive but statistically insignificant impact on students' test scores.

10.1596/1813-9450-9535.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在墨西哥1,496所公立小学进行的一项大规模随机实验的结果。该实验研究了向学校提供以下措施对学校的管理能力及学生考试成绩的影响：(a)现金补助；(b)校长管理培训；或(c)两者结合。校长管理培训的重点是提升校长收集和使用数据以监测学生的基本数学和读写能力，并为教师的教学方法和教学实践提供反馈的能力。经过两年的干预后，研究发现：(a)现金补助对学生考试成绩或校长的管理能力没有影响；(b)管理培训提升了校长的管理能力，但对学生考试成绩没有影响；(c)现金补助与管理培训的结合增强了校长的管理能力，并对学生考试成绩产生了积极但统计上不显著的影响。

abstract.text: Do incentives matter beyond the information conveyed by pay-for-performance contracts? Does loss framing matter? And do incomplete contracts generate spillovers on unincentivized tasks? This study reports on a framed field experiment with 1,363 maternity care workers in 691 primary health facilities in Nigeria to answer these questions. Participants were randomized into three study arms–(1) information with a flat participation fee, (2) performance-based rewards, and (3) performance-based penalties. In each arm, participants had to identify correct clinical actions based on the records of hypothetical patients receiving maternity care. Five of fifteen possible actions were incentivized but performance was measured on all fifteen. Compared to information alone, both rewards and penalties increase time on task by 11 percent, correct overall performance by 6 to 8 percent, and directly incentivized performance by 20 percent. Incentives also generate positive spillovers of 14 percent on unincentivized tasks. Loss framing does not affect performance. Results suggest that improving health worker effort by 8 percent would have an impact on neonatal mortality at par with the short run effect of adding a physician to a health facility. Finally, findings show that a small incentive captures most of the impact, implying that incentives work by making information more effective and that pay-for-performance contracts can be made significantly more cost-effective.

10.1596/1813-9450-9687.abstractZh: 激励因素是否对绩效支付合同所传递的信息有额外影响？损失框架是否重要？不完整的合同是否会对未受激励的任务产生溢出效应？本研究在尼日利亚的691个初级卫生设施中，对1,363名产科护理人员进行了实地实验，以回答这些问题。参与者被随机分配到三个实验组：（1）提供信息但收取固定参与费；（2）基于绩效的奖励；（3）基于绩效的惩罚。在每个组中，参与者需要根据假设接受产科护理的患者的记录，识别正确的临床操作。十五种可能的操作中，有五种得到了激励，但所有操作都进行了绩效评估。与仅提供信息相比，奖励和惩罚分别使任务时间增加了11%，整体表现提高了6%到8%，直接激励下的绩效则提高了20%。激励措施还使未受激励的任务产生了14%的积极溢出效应。损失框架并未影响绩效。结果表明，提高卫生工作者的工作积极性8%，对新生儿死亡率的影响相当于短期内为卫生设施增加一名医生的效果。最后，研究发现，较小的激励措施就能产生最大的效果，这表明激励措施通过使信息更加有效而发挥作用，同时绩效支付合同可以显著降低成本。

abstract.text: In the past two decades, insights from behavioral sciences, particularly behavioral economics, have been widely applied in the design of social programs such as pensions, social security, and taxation. This paper provides a survey of the existing literature in economics on the application of behavioral insights to infrastructure sectors, focusing on water and energy. Various applications of behavioral insights in the literature are examined from the perspectives of the three main actors in the infrastructure sectors: policy makers, service providers, and consumers. Evidence is presented from the literature on how behavioral regularities, such as imperfect optimization, limited self-control, and nonstandard preferences, affect the strategies, decisions, and actions of policy makers, service providers, and consumers, often leading to suboptimal outcomes for service investment, delivery, access, and use. The paper also highlights how behavioral interventions such as anchoring, framing, nonpecuniary incentives, and altering the choice architecture can lead to improvements in performance, adoption, consumption, and other outcomes of interest in the infrastructure sectors.

10.1596/1813-9450-9704.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，行为科学，尤其是行为经济学的研究成果，在养老金、社会保障和税收等社会项目的设计中被广泛应用。本文对经济学领域中关于将行为学见解应用于基础设施领域的现有文献进行了综述，重点关注水和能源领域。从基础设施领域的三个主要参与者——政策制定者、服务提供者和消费者的角度，对文献中行为学见解的各种应用进行了分析。文中还引用了相关文献，探讨了行为规律（如不完美的优化、有限的自控能力以及非标准偏好）如何影响政策制定者、服务提供者和消费者的策略、决策和行动，这些规律往往会导致服务投资、交付、获取和使用方面的次优结果。此外，本文还强调了诸如锚定效应、框架设定、非金钱激励以及改变选择结构等行为干预措施如何能够提升基础设施领域的绩效、采纳率、消费水平以及其他相关结果。

abstract.text: The Ivorian economy needs to sustain its growth momentum. During the last decade, Côte d’Ivoire’s growth performance has been impressive. To achieve its ambitious goal of reaching emerging market status within one or two generations, however, it needs to maintain the strong growth for many years to come. Fewer than 15 countries have managed to sustain high growth for over 25 years in the postwar period, and their experience has shown that increasing productivity is at the heart of it. To follow in their footsteps, Ivorian growth also needs to be more inclusive and reduce structural imbalances, including the gap between the economic capital, Abidjan, and the rest of the country. This report addresses this question.

10.1596/37233.abstractZh: 科特迪瓦的经济需要保持增长势头。在过去十年中，科特迪瓦的增长表现令人印象深刻。然而，为了实现在一两代时间内达到新兴市场地位的雄心目标，它需要在未来许多年里持续保持强劲的增长。战后时期，只有不到15个国家能够持续实现超过25年的高增长率，他们的经验表明，提高生产力是成功的关键。为了效仿他们的做法，科特迪瓦的增长也需要更加包容，并减少结构性失衡，包括经济中心阿比让与全国其他地区之间的差距。本报告探讨了这个问题。

abstract.text: 🇩🇪 Effizienz ist Ausdruck ökonomischer Zweckrationalität und steht im Mittelpunkt vieler (mikro-) ökonomischer Analysen. Da die Mittel in einer Volkswirtschaft knapp sind, ist ökonomische Effizienz ein als wünschenswert anerkannter Zustand. Wirtschaftliche Aktivität, die Ineffizienz verursacht, ist daher zu vermeiden. Kartelle, das sind nach § 1 GWB „Vereinbarungen zwischen Unternehmen, Beschlüsse von Unternehmensvereinigungen und aufeinander abgestimmte Verhaltensweisen, die eine Verhinderung, Einschränkung oder Verfälschung des Wettbewerbs bezwecken oder bewirken“, stehen im Verdacht, Ineffizienz zu verursachen. Folgerichtig ist die Auswirkung der Kartelle auf die ökonomische Effizienz ein permanentes Motiv der Kartellforschung. Effizienz kann dabei in unterschiedlichen Bedeutungskontexten stehen. Für die Kartellforschung sind der einzelwirtschaftliche Effizienzbegriff, die Produktionseffizienz, und der gesamtwirtschaftliche Effizienzbegriff, die Allokationseffizienz, einschlägig. 1 Dem zu Grunde liegt der Gedanke, dass die durch Kartelle verursachte Ineffizienz sowohl nach unternehmensinternen als auch nach gesamtgesellschaftlichen Kriterien beurteilt werden kann (Roth 2017 S. 49). Innerhalb eines Unternehmens kann der durch die Kartellierung nachlassende Wettbewerbsdruck die Anreizstrukturen dergestalt verzerren, dass Ineffizienzen im Leistungserstellungsprozess schlicht in Kauf genommen werden. Gesamtgesellschaftlich kann die sich verändernde Marktstruktur, die Marktmacht eines Kartells, zu Ineffizienz in der Ressourcenallokation führen. Für beide Arten kartellinduzierter Ineffizienz gibt es überzeugende theoretische Argumente, die (wenige) empirische Evidenz jedoch ist uneindeutig. Die vorliegende Arbeit ist daher von der Motivation getrieben, das Verständnis für den Zusammenhang zwischen Kartellierung und ökonomischer Effizienz zu verbessern und empirische Befunde dazu vorzulegen.

10.17170/kobra-202108024463.abstractZh: 🇩🇪 效率是经济目的理性的体现，是许多（微观）经济分析的核心。由于一个国民经济中的资源是有限的，因此经济效率被视为一种理想状态。因此，应避免造成低效率的经济活动。根据《反垄断法》第1条，卡特尔是指“企业之间的协议、企业联合体的决议以及旨在或导致阻止、限制或扭曲竞争的行为”。卡特尔被认为会导致低效率。因此，卡特尔对经济效率的影响一直是卡特尔研究的持续主题。效率可以在不同的语境中有所体现。在卡特尔研究中，适用的概念包括单个经济体的效率、生产效率，以及整个经济体的效率，即资源配置效率。其背后的思想是，卡特尔造成的低效率可以从企业内部和整个社会两个角度进行评估（Roth 2017 第49页）。在企业内部，卡特尔化可能降低竞争压力，从而扭曲激励机制，导致在产出过程中出现低效率。在全社会层面，市场结构的变化以及卡特尔的市场力量可能导致资源配置的低效率。对于这两种由卡特尔引起的低效率，都有令人信服的理论依据，但相关的实证证据却并不明确。因此，本研究的动机在于提高人们对垄断与经济效率之间关系的理解，并展示相关的实证研究结果。

abstract.text: While it is known that international trade and organizational practices are determinants of firm productivity, empirical evidence on their relation to each other is scarce. This paper explores credible exogenous variation in tariff reductions across manufacturing sectors to show that firms in Brazil are less structured in terms of hierarchies following the shock. Consistent with the literature on knowledge-based hierarchies, increased foreign competition reduces significantly the share of managers and the number of organizational layers on a firm. Besides, we find notable compositional movements within sectors: although similarly sized, entrant firms have fewer managers and layers than leavers. By using comprehensive data with more credible identification than previous work in the literature, our paper documents stylized facts on firms organization in a developing country, as well as contributes to the study of a potentially important determinant of aggregate productivity.

10.17771/pucrio.acad.54867.abstractZh: 虽然已知国际贸易和组织实践是决定企业生产力的重要因素，但关于它们相互关系的实证证据却十分有限。本文通过探讨不同制造行业在关税减让方面的可信外生变化，发现巴西企业受到冲击后，其组织结构中的层级结构有所削弱。与基于知识的层级结构相关的文献一致，外国竞争的增加显著减少了企业管理者数量以及组织层级的数量。此外，我们还发现行业内存在显著的组成变化：尽管企业规模相当，新进入者所拥有的管理者和组织层级数量都少于退出者。通过利用比以往研究更可靠的数据来源，本文记录了发展中国家企业组织的典型特征，并为研究总体生产力的潜在重要决定因素提供了支持。

abstract.text: Arrow (1963) hypothesized that demand-side moral hazard induced by health insurance leads to supply-side expansions in healthcare markets. Capturing these effects empirically has been challenging, as non-marginal insurance expansions are rare and detailed data on healthcare labor and capital is sparse. We combine administrative labor market data with the geographic variation in the rollout of a universal insurance program—the introduction of long-term care (LTC) insurance in Germany in 1995—to document a substantial expansion of the inpatient LTC labor market in response to insurance expansion. A 10 percentage point expansion in the share of insured elderly leads to 0.05 (7%) more inpatient LTC firms and four (13%) more workers per 1,000 elderly in Germany. Wages did not rise, but the quality of newly hired workers declined. We find suggestive evidence of a reduction in old-age mortality. Using a machine learning algorithm, we characterize counterfactual labor market biographies of potential inpatient LTC hires, finding that the reform moved workers into LTC jobs from unemployment and out of the labor force rather than from other sectors of the economy. We estimate that employing these additional workers in LTC is socially efficient if patients value the care provided by these workers at least at 25% of the market price for care. We show conceptually that, in the spirit of Harberger (1971), in a second-best equilibrium in which supply-side labor markets do not clear at perfectly competitive wages, subsidies for healthcare consumption along with the associated demand-side moral hazard can be welfare-enhancing.

10.17848/wp21-357.abstractZh: Arrow在1963年提出，由健康保险引起的需求端道德风险会导致医疗市场的供给端扩张。然而，从实证角度捕捉这些效应一直具有挑战性，因为非边际性的保险扩张较为罕见，且关于医疗领域劳动力和资本的具体数据也较为匮乏。我们结合行政劳动市场数据以及德国1995年引入长期护理保险这一普遍保险计划实施过程中的地理差异，发现由于保险政策的扩张，住院长期护理市场的劳动力供应出现了显著扩张。在德国，老年人口中，保险覆盖率每增加10个百分点，对应的住院长期护理企业数量增加0.05家（占总量的7%），每1000名老年人口对应的工人数量增加4人（占总量的13%）。虽然工资并未上升，但新雇用的工人的质量有所下降。我们发现，这一改革有助于降低老年死亡率。通过机器学习算法，我们对潜在住院长期护理工作的劳动力状况进行了反事实分析，发现这一改革将工人从失业状态转移到了长期护理行业，而非其他经济领域。我们估计，如果患者认为这些工人提供的护理价值至少相当于市场护理价格的25%，那么雇佣这些额外工人从事长期护理工作在社会上是高效的。我们从概念上表明，按照Harberger在1971年提出的观点，在供给端劳动力市场无法以完全竞争的工资水平实现充分就业的次优均衡中，对医疗消费的补贴以及与之相关的需求端道德风险实际上可以提升福利水平。

abstract.text: The consequences of missing targets can be found on a daily basis in many organizations. As such, targets and target setting in an extremely important topic to companies and one that should receive more attention. Although the vast amount of reasons for missing targets are difficult to study, the process of setting the target which includes budgeting has been proven to affect performance and achievement through goal setting theory (Locke & Latham, 2002). Thus, targets are an important element in almost every organization (Chenhall, 2003). We focus this review of literature exclusively in the relationship between target setting and firm performance and as such consolidate, organize, and synthesize past literature in this field and provide a clear direction for future research. We further identify two impactors found to affect firm and management performance but never researched as an impactor of the relationship between target setting and firm performance. Those impactors are Transparency of targets and length of management experience. In this paper, we fill the gaps identified above and inform the study of target setting in order to spark future research on this topic. We also identify the dimensions affecting the relationship between target setting and firm performance as well as the different measurement approaches in target setting literature.

10.19030/jabr.v37i3.10375.abstractZh: 许多组织中，未能达成目标的情况每天都在发生。因此，目标设定对于企业来说是一个极其重要的话题，应当得到更多的关注。尽管导致目标未能达成的原因众多，难以逐一研究，但目标设定过程，包括预算编制，已被证明会通过目标设定理论影响绩效和成就（Locke & Latham, 2002）。因此，目标几乎是所有组织中的重要元素（Chenhall, 2003）。本综述专门探讨了目标设定与企业绩效之间的关系，从而整合、整理并综合了该领域的现有文献，为未来的研究指明了方向。此外，我们还发现了两个可能影响企业和管理层绩效的因素，但这些因素尚未作为目标设定与企业绩效关系的驱动因素进行研究。这两个因素分别是目标的透明度和管理层的经验年限。在本文中，我们填补了上述空白，为目标设定研究提供了依据，从而推动该领域未来的研究。我们还确定了影响目标设定与企业绩效关系的各个维度，以及目标设定文献中不同的测量方法。

abstract.text: We examine the economic analysis of the relationship between innovation and product market competition. First, we give a brief tour of the intellectual history of the area. Second, we examine how the Aghion-Howitt framework has influenced the development of the literature theoretically and (especially) empirically, with an emphasis on the “inverted U”: the idea that innovation rises and then eventually falls as the intensity of competition increases. Thirdly, we look at recent applications and development of the framework in the areas of competition policy, international trade and structural Industrial Organization.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2021.4321.abstractZh: 我们探讨了创新与产品市场竞争关系的经济分析。首先，我们对这一领域的学术历史进行了简要回顾。其次，我们研究了Aghion-Howitt框架在理论及实证研究中的发展影响，特别强调了“倒U型”现象：即随着竞争强度的增加，创新会先上升，随后逐渐下降。第三，我们考察了该框架在竞争政策、国际贸易以及结构型产业组织领域的最新应用与发展。

abstract.text: How does misinformation spill over spatially? We examine this question using novel sales data from 2018-2020 in the Indian market for anti-malarial drugs impacted by the spatial spillover of misinformation around HCQ usage in COVID-19 endorsed by the former POTUS Donald Trump. Using a difference-in-difference approach, where Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) and Chloroquine (CQ) are our treated product markets (other anti-malarial drugs being controls), we find that the HCQ endorsement by Donald Trump resulted in a revenue growth rate increase of 1.1% and 0.67% for HCQ and CQ in India. Analogous figures for sales were 0.96% and 0.67%. Results were robust controlling for molecule, region, time, molecule-region, and region-time specific unobserved heterogeneity. The effects are most prominent in top Indian regions with urban populations, better internet penetration, and population density. Our findings have important implications for spatial spillover of misinformation, global health policy and pharmaceutical markets.

10.2139/ssrn.3764586.abstractZh: 错误信息是如何在空间上扩散的？我们通过使用2018-2020年印度市场上抗疟疾药物的新型销售数据来研究这个问题，这些数据涉及由前总统唐纳德·特朗普在COVID-19疫情中支持使用羟氯喹所产生的错误信息在空间上的扩散影响。采用差异分解方法，其中羟氯喹和氯喹是我们的处理产品市场（其他抗疟疾药物作为对照组），我们发现唐纳德·特朗普对羟氯喹的支持使印度市场的羟氯喹和氯喹收入增长率分别增加了1.1%和0.67%。相应的销售数据分别为0.96%和0.67%。在控制分子、地区、时间、分子-地区以及地区-时间特定未观测的异质性后，结果仍然稳健。这些效应在印度人口密集、互联网普及率较高且城市人口较多的顶级地区最为明显。我们的发现对错误信息的空间扩散、全球卫生政策和制药市场具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We use data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study (UKHLS) to compare measures of socioeconomic inequality in psychological distress, measured by the General Health Questionnaire (GHQ), before (Waves 9 and the Interim 2019 Wave) and during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic (April to July 2020). Based on a caseness measure, the prevalence of psychological distress increased from 18.5% to 27.7% between the 2019 Wave and April 2020 with some reversion to earlier levels in subsequent months. Also, there was a systematic increase in total inequality in the Likert GHQ-12 score. However, measures of relative socioeconomic inequality have not increased. A Shapley-Shorrocks decomposition analysis shows that during the peak of the first wave of the pandemic (April 2020) other socioeconomic factors declined in their share of socioeconomic inequality, while age and gender account for a larger share. The most notable increase is evident for younger women. The contribution of working in an industry related to the COVID-19 response played a small role at Wave 9 and the Interim 2019 Wave, but more than tripled its share in April 2020. As the first wave of COVID-19 progressed, the contribution of demographics declined from their peak level in April and chronic health conditions, housing conditions, and neighbourhood characteristics increased their contributions to socioeconomic inequality.

10.2139/ssrn.3771740.abstractZh: 我们利用了英国家庭纵向研究的数据，比较了在COVID-19疫情第一波期间（2020年4月至7月）以及疫情前（2019年9波和2019年中期波）社会经济不平等对心理困扰的影响。根据犯罪率指标，心理困扰的患病率从2019年波期的18.5%上升到2020年4月的27.7%，但在随后的几个月中又有所回落。此外，Likert GHQ-12评分的总不平等程度也出现了系统性上升。然而，相对社会经济不平等的衡量指标并未增加。Shapley-Shorrocks分解分析显示，在疫情第一波高峰时期（2020年4月），其他社会经济因素在造成心理困扰的不平等中的占比下降，而年龄和性别则占据了更大的比例。最显著的增长体现在年轻女性身上。在2019年9波和2019年中期波期间，与COVID-19应对相关的行业工作对心理困扰的影响较小，但在2020年4月其占比增加了两倍多。随着COVID-19疫情第一波的发展，人口统计因素对心理困扰的不平等贡献从4月的峰值下降，而慢性健康状况、住房条件以及社区特征则增加了它们对社会经济不平等的贡献。

abstract.text: During the first United Kingdom wave of the COVID-19 outbreak, the first lockdown was announced on March 23, 2020, with a final easing of the restrictions on July 4, 2020. Among the most important public health costs of lockdown restrictions are the potential adverse effects on mental health and physical activity. Using data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and Google COVID-19 Mobility Reports we find evidence of reduced park mobility during the initial period of the first UK lockdown and confirm existing evidence of worsening mental health. Linkage with weather data shows that contrary to popular belief, daily or weekly weather conditions do not exacerbate the mental health consequences of the pandemic, as we found no systematic associations during the first lockdown period; on the other hand, we find systematic links between park mobility and weather over the same period.

10.2139/ssrn.3789386.abstractZh: 在英国首次出现COVID-19疫情时，首次封锁措施于2020年3月23日宣布，最终放宽限制措施则于2020年7月4日实施。封锁措施带来的最重要的公共卫生成本之一，是对心理健康和体力活动的潜在负面影响。通过英国家庭纵向研究数据和谷歌COVID-19出行报告，我们发现英国首次封锁初期，公园内的活动量减少，并证实了现有关于心理健康恶化的证据。结合天气数据分析后发现，与普遍看法相反，日常或每周的天气状况并不会加剧疫情对心理健康的影响，因为在首次封锁期间并未发现系统性关联；另一方面，我们发现同一时期公园活动量与天气状况之间存在系统性关联。

abstract.text: We develop a unified theory of exclusive dealing and exclusionary bundling. In a framework with two competing manufacturers which supply their product(s) through a monopolist retailer, we show that buyer power restores the profitability of such practices involving inefficient exclusion. The mechanism underlying this exclusion is that the compensation required by the retailer to renounce selling the rival product erodes with its buyer power. Among others, we further show that our theory holds when the buyer power differs across manufacturers or when the retailer can strategically narrow (or expand) its product assortment.

10.2139/ssrn.3850245.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于独家交易和排他性捆绑行为的统一理论。在一个由两个竞争制造商通过垄断零售商提供产品的框架下，我们证明了买方的力量能够恢复这种涉及低效排他性的行为的盈利能力。这种排他性背后的机制是，零售商为了放弃销售竞争对手的产品而需要支付的补偿金额，随着买方力量的增强而减少。此外，我们还表明，当不同制造商之间的买方力量存在差异，或者零售商能够战略性地缩小（或扩大）其产品组合时，我们的理论仍然成立。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic model of discrete choice that incorporates peer effects into random consideration sets. We characterize the equilibrium behavior and study the empirical content of the model. In our setup, changes in the choices of friends affect the distribution of the consideration sets. We exploit this variation to recover the ranking of preferences, attention mechanisms, and network connections. These nonparametric identification results allow unrestricted heterogeneity across people and do not rely on the variation of either covariates or the set of available options. Our methodology leads to a maximum-likelihood estimator that performs well in simulations. We apply our results to an experimental dataset that has been designed to study the visual focus of attention.

10.2139/ssrn.3871249.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态离散选择模型，该模型将同伴效应纳入随机考虑集合中。我们描述了模型的均衡行为，并研究了模型的实证内容。在我们的模型中，朋友选择的变化会影响考虑集的分布。我们利用这种变化来恢复偏好排序、注意力机制以及网络联系。这些非参数识别结果允许不同个体之间存在不受限制的异质性，且无需依赖于协变量的变化或可用选项的集合。我们的方法导出了一个最大似然估计量，在模拟实验中表现良好。我们将这些结果应用于一个旨在研究注意力视觉焦点的实验数据集。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of vertical markets with multiple upstream and downstream firms. Networks of vertical relationships, negotiated contract terms for those relationships, and downstream prices charged to end customers all arise endogenously. In addition, I provide an estimation procedure to fully rationalize the observed network and contracts in a computationally scale-able manner. I empirically apply the framework to the market between hospitals and health insurers. I use the model to quantify the effects of "network adequacy regulations,'' which are designed to broaden patients' hospital choice sets but can backfire by increasing prices. I show that "tight" regulations have adverse effects. I also show market response is substantially impacted by complex mechanisms involving the interplay among multiple insurers and the interplay between upstream negotiation and downstream pricing.

10.2139/ssrn.3904373.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个包含多个上游和下游企业的垂直市场模型。垂直关系网络、协商达成的合同条款以及下游向终端客户收取的价格都是自发的。此外，我提供了一种估算方法，以计算可行的方式全面解释观察到的网络结构和合同条款。我将该框架应用于医院与健康保险公司之间的市场情况。利用该模型，我量化了“网络充足性法规”的影响，这些法规旨在扩大患者的医院选择范围，但可能会因价格上涨而带来负面影响。研究表明，过于严格的法规会产生不利影响。我还发现，市场反应会受到多种复杂机制的影响，这些机制涉及多个保险公司之间的相互作用以及上游谈判与下游定价之间的互动。

abstract.text: We study how inertia interacts with market power and adverse selection in health insurance. We incorporate inertia into a model of plan selection and price competition, and estimate it using data from the California ACA exchange. We estimate inertia costs equaling 43% of average premiums. Our simulations indicate that inertia exacerbates market power, but has minimal interaction with selection. Eliminating inertia reduces average premiums by 9.5%. Maintaining premium-linked subsidies or reducing consumer churn increases the impact of inertia by enhancing market power. Provider network attachment is an important impediment to plan switching, but substantial inertia remains after accounting for networks.

10.2139/ssrn.3908686.abstractZh: 我们研究了惯性如何与市场力量以及健康保险中的逆向选择相互作用。我们将惯性纳入了计划选择和价格竞争的模型中，并利用加州ACA交易所的数据进行了估算。我们估计惯性成本占平均保费总额的43%。我们的模拟结果显示，惯性会加剧市场力量，但与逆向选择的互动很小。消除惯性可使平均保费降低9.5%。维持与保费挂钩的补贴或减少消费者流失，都能增强惯性的影响，从而提升市场力量。医疗服务提供者网络对计划转换存在重要阻碍，但在考虑网络因素后，惯性仍然对计划选择产生显著影响。

abstract.text: This chapter overviews productivity research from an industrial organization perspective. We focus on what is known and what still needs to be learned about the productivity levels and dynamics of individual producers, but also how these interact through markets and industries to influence productivity aggregates. We overview productivity concepts, facts, data, measurement, analysis, and open questions.

10.2139/ssrn.3924319.abstractZh: 本章从产业组织的角度概述了关于生产力研究的内容。我们重点关注关于个体生产者的生产力水平和动态性的已知信息以及仍需探索的内容，同时也探讨了这些因素如何通过市场与行业之间的互动来影响整体生产力水平。我们概述了相关生产力概念、数据、测量方法、分析方法以及尚未解决的问题。

abstract.text: This is an invited chapter for the forthcoming Volume 4 of the Handbook of Industrial Organization. We present empirical models of demand and supply in differentiated products industries with an emphasis on the key ideas arising from the recent applied literature. We start with a discussion of the challenges in modeling and estimation of demand for differentiated products, and focus on discrete choice characteristics-based demand models that address these challenges while allowing enough flexibility to capture realistic substitution patterns. Our discussion emphasizes how empirical strategies can leverage different features of data depending on the sources of variation that are commonly found in applied work. Moving to the supply-side, we show how demand estimates combined with a pricing model, can be used to recover markups and marginal costs. We also show how the model of pricing can be tested. We discuss a baseline Bertrand-Nash model of competitive pricing, and expand it to cover a) coordinated pricing, b) wholesale relationships, and c) bargaining. We end the chapter with extensions of the demand model, including dynamic and continuous demand.

10.2139/ssrn.3926938.abstractZh: 这是为即将出版的《工业组织手册》第四卷所邀请的章节。我们提出了差异化产品行业的供需实证模型，重点讨论了近期应用文献中的核心观点。我们首先讨论了差异化产品需求建模与估计面临的挑战，并聚焦于基于离散选择特征的需求模型，这些模型能够应对这些挑战，同时具备足够的灵活性以捕捉真实的替代模式。我们的讨论强调了实证策略如何根据应用工作中常见的变异来源，利用数据的不同特征。在供应方面，我们展示了如何将需求估计值与定价模型相结合，以恢复加价率和边际成本。我们还展示了如何对定价模型进行测试。我们讨论了竞争定价的基准伯特兰-纳什模型，并扩展其涵盖a)协调定价、b)批发关系以及c)讨价还价等情形。最后，我们对需求模型进行了扩展，包括动态和连续需求模型。

abstract.text: Learning-by-doing is a fundamental concept in economics but a challenging one to document in high-skilled settings due to non-random assignment of workers to tasks and lacking performance measures. Our paper overcomes these challenges in the context of heart attack treatments in Sweden, where we exploit quasirandom assignment of physicians to patients. We document long learning curves, where physicians keep learning over the first 1000 treatments performed, affecting both proficiency and decision-making skills. These learning effects translate into effects on patient health, but only over the first 150 treatments performed, corresponding to one year of experience. Learning rates are higher for physicians who have worked with more experienced colleagues and who have gained more experience in treating complicated cases. Experienced physicians are more responsive to patient characteristics when deciding on treatments and experience from more recent heart attack treatments is more valuable than experience from more distant ones, suggesting that human capital depreciates. We also show that productivity growth keeps pace with wage growth over the first four years of the career but flattens out thereafter. Our results provide rare evidence on the existence of prolonged learning curves in high-skilled tasks and support the notion that learning-by-doing can be a powerful mechanism for productivity growth.

10.2139/ssrn.3934761.abstractZh: “边做边学”是经济学中的一个基本概念，但在高技能环境中很难进行实证研究，因为工人被随机分配到不同任务的情况并不常见，且缺乏衡量绩效的指标。我们的论文在瑞典心脏病治疗领域克服了这些挑战，我们利用了医生与患者之间的准随机分配方式。我们发现，医生在最初1000次治疗过程中不断学习，这影响了他们的熟练程度和决策能力。这些学习效应体现在患者健康上，但仅体现在最初150次治疗过程中，相当于一年的经验积累。与更有经验的同事合作、在处理复杂病例方面积累更多经验的医生，其学习速度更快。经验丰富的医生在决定治疗方案时更能响应患者的特点，而且最近的治疗经验比较久远的经验更有价值，这表明人力资本会贬值。我们还发现，在职业生涯的前四年里，生产率的增长与工资增长同步，但之后便趋于平稳。我们的研究结果提供了关于高技能任务中长时间学习曲线存在的罕见证据，并支持了“边做边学”可以成为生产率增长强大机制的观点。

abstract.text: This study quantifies bargaining power in supply-side negotiations with incomplete information, where car dealers negotiate inventory prices with large sellers at wholesale used-car auctions. We measure an agent's bargaining power in an incomplete-information setting as the fraction of the agent's take-it-or-leave-it-offer payoff she receives. We propose a direct-mechanism method for estimating a seller's private value, interpreting it as the gradient of a menu from which the seller chooses her secret reserve price. We find that, on average, dealerships (buyers) have a similar degree of bargaining power as sellers. For manufacturer sellers, or sales with substantial buyer competition, sellers' bargaining power is much higher.

10.2139/ssrn.3990290.abstractZh: 本研究量化了在信息不完全的情况下，汽车经销商在批发二手车拍卖中与大卖家谈判库存价格时的议价能力。我们在一个信息不完全的情境下，将代理人的议价能力定义为代理人获得的“接受或放弃”提议的支付比例。我们提出了一种直接机制方法来估算卖家的私人价值，将其解释为卖家从一系列选择中挑选秘密保留价格的梯度。研究发现，平均而言，经销商（买家）的议价能力与卖家相当。对于制造商卖家来说，或者在存在大量买家竞争的情况下，卖家的议价能力要高得多。

abstract.text: Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) laws grant the public access to government records, thereby lowering the cost of monitoring both regulators and the firms they regulate. We document a significantly negative relation between corporate pollution and FOIA laws: when a new provision is added to a state’s FOIA laws, a local firm’s toxic emissions drop by approximately 4 percent. Evidence from paired facilities across state borders supports a causal interpretation of this finding. Our mechanism tests suggest that such a negative effect of FOIA laws can be attributed to enhanced public oversight, collusion prevention, and stricter enforcement of environmental regulation. Overall, our evidence suggests that open records laws deter corporate pollution by facilitating public oversight of environmental regulation and raising firms’ expected costs of noncompliance.

10.2139/ssrn.3995477.abstractZh: 《信息自由法案》赋予公众获取政府记录的权限，从而降低了监督监管机构和被监管企业的成本。我们的研究发现，企业污染行为与《信息自由法案》之间存在显著的负相关关系：当某个州对《信息自由法案》进行修订时，当地企业的有毒排放量会下降约4%。来自州际设施之间的对比数据支持这一发现的因果解释。我们的机制测试表明，这种负面效应可以归因于公众监督的加强、防止勾结行为的发生以及环境法规执行力的提升。总体而言，我们的证据表明，公开记录法规通过促进对环境法规的公众监督，并增加企业不遵守规定的预期成本，从而有效遏制了企业污染行为。

abstract.text: I analyze the relationship between state-level economic shocks and suicides using gold mined in the United States (US) between 1840 and 1860 as a large unexpected economic shock. Mined gold was an unexpected and large economic shock of up to 3.5% of GDP. This provides as good as random variation to the local economy that I use to estimate the effect of economic changes on suicides. Comprehensive mortality data by state and year does not exist for the US for 1840-1860. Thus, I use web-scraped data from a newspaper archive and use suicide mentions per 100,000 pages to proxy for suicides. Overall, results show that mined gold is linked with an apparent reduction in newspaper suicide mentions in line with previous research.

10.2139/ssrn.5156087.abstractZh: 我分析了国家级经济冲击与自杀事件之间的关系，以1840至1860年间美国开采的黄金作为一次重大的意外经济冲击。当时开采的黄金对经济的冲击巨大，高达GDP的3.5%。这一冲击对当地经济产生了类似随机变化的影响，我利用这种影响来估计经济变化对自杀率的影响。在1840至1860年间，美国没有按州和年份分列的全面死亡数据。因此，我使用了从报纸档案中抓取的数据，并以每10万页报纸中的自杀提及次数作为自杀事件的替代指标。总体来看，研究结果表明，黄金开采与报纸上自杀提及次数的减少有关，这与之前的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: The study assessed a product or service by customers that met their needs and aspirations. It sought to examine the influence of non-financial customer performance (CP) measures on non-financial organizational performance (NFOP) in the Nepalese cellular telecommunications industry (NCTI). Using a structured questionnaire survey instrument, it employed a descriptive research approach. This study’s population included all the global system for mobile (GSM) customers of Nepal Telecom (NT) and Ncell. The sample comprised 385 customers delineated through non-probability sampling techniques. The study’s targeted respondents were postgraduate understudies, service holders, business people, and self-employed individuals. The survey instrument was composed of three sections comprising 28 data collection questions. A statistical package for the social sciences (SPSS) and analysis of moment structures (AMOS) programming were used to analyze the collected data. The study applied confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), path analysis (PA), and structural equation modeling (SEM) to evaluate the significance of the hypothesized paths. It was found that CP had a positive and significant relationship with NFOP in NCTI, with customer retention (CR) being a better predictor, followed by customer loyalty (CL), customer satisfaction (CS), and customer acquisition (CA). This was a cited representative study, not exhaustive, and would help to understand the key drivers of CP in the NCTI.

10.21511/ppm.19(2).2021.11.abstractZh: 本研究通过评估客户满足其需求和期望的产品或服务，来考察非财务客户绩效指标对尼泊尔蜂窝电信行业非财务组织绩效的影响。研究采用了结构化的问卷调查工具，并采用了描述性研究方法。研究对象包括尼泊尔电信公司和Ncell的所有全球移动通信系统客户。样本由385名客户组成，采用非概率抽样技术进行选取。研究的目标受访者为研究生、服务持有者、商人和个体经营者。调查工具包含三个部分，共28个数据收集问题。研究使用了社会科学统计软件包（SPSS）和AMOS程序来分析收集到的数据。研究采用了验证性因子分析、路径分析和结构方程模型来评估假设路径的重要性。研究发现，在尼泊尔蜂窝电信行业中，客户绩效与非财务组织绩效之间存在正相关关系，其中客户保留是更好的预测指标，其次是客户忠诚度、客户满意度和客户获取。这是一项具有代表性的研究，并非全面性研究，有助于了解尼泊尔蜂窝电信行业中客户绩效的关键驱动因素。

abstract.text: To meet the requirements of the new curriculum, the syllabus of the course Tunnel Engineering is revised accordingly, with value co-creation in learning and teaching under consideration. The course design and implementation plan development are led by a staff group, but founded on the features and basic requirement of the course, in terms of professional capacity, and the knowledge background and intentions of the students. The effect and results of the value co-creation in learning and teaching plan implementation are evaluated with the consonance and resonance effects of the interaction between the students and the instructors, and the course implementation plan is accordingly tuned to inspire and guide students to become self-directed and critical thinkers. The experience shows that as the student-staff partnership frameworks are of features, of course, own working context, a viable value co-creation approach in the learning and teaching process can make the education flexible and effective, and beneficial to all of the active participants.

10.2991/assehr.k.210120.001.abstractZh: 为了符合新课程的要求，隧道工程课程的教学大纲也进行了相应的修订，注重在学习和教学过程中的价值共创。课程设计与实施计划的制定由团队负责，但必须基于课程的特点和基本要求，包括教师的专业能力以及学生的知识背景和期望。在评估价值共创在学习和教学计划实施中的效果时，会考虑学生与教师之间的互动效果，并据此调整课程实施计划，以激发和引导学生成为自主性和批判性思维能力强的人。经验表明，只要学生与教师之间的合作框架具有针对性，并且考虑到各自的工作环境，一种可行的价值共创方法可以使教育更加灵活和有效，对所有积极参与者都有益。

abstract.text: Governments face many constraints in attracting talented managers to the public sector, where high-powered incentives are often absent. In this paper, we study how a civil service reform in Chile changed the effectiveness of a vital group of public sector managers: school principals. First, we estimate principal effectiveness using an extension of the canonical teacher value-added model. Then, we evaluate the effect of the reform on principal effectiveness using a difference-in-differences approach. We find that public schools appoint more effective managers and improve their students’ outcomes after increasing the competitiveness and transparency of their selection process.

10.31235/osf.io/7zn2b.abstractZh: 政府在吸引有才华的管理人员进入公共部门时面临许多限制，因为公共部门通常缺乏高强度的激励措施。在本文中，我们研究了智利的一项公务员改革如何改变了公共部门管理者这一关键群体的效率。首先，我们采用扩展的规范教师增值模型来估算管理者的效率。然后，我们使用差异-差异方法评估该改革对管理者效率的影响。研究发现，通过提高选拔过程的竞争性和透明度，公立学校能够任命更有效的管理者，并改善学生的学业成绩。

abstract.text: Introduction: The application of and effective fiscal policy for the smoking control in the health context begins understanding the smoking impact over the health market equilibrium. Objective: To describe the basic relation between the health market equilibrium and the application of a fiscal policy for the appropriate smoking control. Materials and methods: Was made a descriptive research about the basic relation between the health market equilibrium and the application of a fiscal policy for the appropriate smoking control. As teoric methods were used the descriptive, the comparative and the historic – logic. As empiric method was used the bibliographic research. The graphs were designed by Microsoft Excel 2007. Results: Society would be better without smoking and fiscal authorities must acknowledge it and take decision agree to that fact. These authorities need induce to smokers to reduce the tobacco consumption. For that fiscal authorities need understand the main causes from the tobacco consumption beginning and keeping. Conclusion: Tobacco consumption intensity growing carries to increase the price equilibrium from this market and much patients leave from this market because of smoking impact. That’s why the fiscal authorities must use the fiscal policies carrying the population to a context with lowest smoking impact over the health services market.

10.31579/2768-0487/036.abstractZh: 引言：在健康背景下，实施有效的财政政策以控制吸烟行为，首先需要了解吸烟对健康市场均衡的影响。目的：描述健康市场均衡与实施适当财政政策以控制吸烟行为之间的基本关系。材料与方法：本研究采用描述性研究方法来探讨健康市场均衡与实施适当财政政策以控制吸烟行为之间的关系。理论方法包括描述性分析、比较分析和历史逻辑分析。实证方法采用文献研究。图表使用Microsoft Excel 2007制作。结果：没有吸烟的社会将更为美好，财政当局必须认识到这一点并据此做出决策。这些当局需要促使吸烟者减少烟草消费。为此，财政当局需要了解导致烟草消费增加的主要原因。结论：烟草消费强度的增加会导致市场均衡价格上涨，许多患者因吸烟对健康服务市场的影响而离开该市场。因此，财政当局必须采取财政政策，引导民众进入一个对健康服务市场影响最小的吸烟环境。

abstract.text: En este artículo planteamos cómo apostar por mercados eficientes y competitivos puede impulsar un crecimiento inclusivo. A tal fin exponemos las vías mediante las cuales estos mercados apoyan dicho crecimiento inclusivo, y revisamos la literatura académica reciente sobre la materia. En particular, mostramos que la competencia y la regulación eficiente fomentan la creación de riqueza gracias a que impulsan la eficiencia, la innovación, la competitividad internacional y la productividad. Pero, además, facilitan que dicho crecimiento tenga naturaleza inclusiva y combaten la desigualdad al promover mejores condiciones de consumo, más empleo, igualdad de oportunidades y mejores servicios públicos, todo lo cual beneficia particularmente a los hogares de rentas más bajas, y sin coste adicional para el Estado; al contrario, favoreciendo una mejoría en las cuentas públicas. Son, por tanto, políticas idóneas para fomentar un crecimiento robusto, sostenible e inclusivo que se traduzca en más bienestar para toda la población.

10.32796/bice.2021.3141.7320.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了如何通过发展高效且竞争性的市场来促进包容性增长。为此，我们阐述了这些市场如何支持包容性增长，并回顾了相关领域的近期学术文献。具体而言，我们发现，有效的竞争和监管能够促进财富创造，因为它们提升了效率、创新、国际竞争力和生产力。此外，这些政策还能使增长具有包容性，并通过改善消费条件、增加就业机会、实现机会平等以及提升公共服务质量来减少不平等现象，这些都将特别惠及低收入家庭，同时不会给国家带来额外负担；相反，这些政策有助于改善公共财政状况。因此，这些政策是促进强劲、可持续和包容性增长的理想选择，从而让全体民众都能享受到更多的福祉。

abstract.text: Providing health information is a non-pharmaceutical intervention designed to reduce disease transmission and infection risk by encouraging behavior change. But does knowledge change behavior? We test whether coronavirus health knowledge promotes protective risk mitigation behaviors early in the COVID-19 pandemic across four African countries (Ghana, Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania). Despite reputations for weak health sectors and low average levels of education, health knowledge of the symptoms and transmission mechanisms was high in all countries in the two months after the virus entered the country. Higher knowledge is associated with increased protective measures that would likely lower disease risk with one exception–knowledge is inversely correlated with social distancing. Respondents largely adhered to mask mandates and lockdowns, but continued coming into contact with others at small, informal gatherings, gatherings not affected by mandates. Knowledge alone appears unlikely to reduce all risky activities, especially gatherings within other people's homes. Even early in the pandemic income loss or stress were commonly reported. Our results suggest that early and consistent government provision of health information, likely reduced the severity of the pandemic in Africa but was not a panacea.

10.3386/w28316.abstractZh: 提供健康信息是一种非药物干预措施，旨在通过鼓励行为改变来降低疾病传播和感染风险。但是，知识是否真的能改变行为呢？我们在COVID-19疫情初期，对四个非洲国家（加纳、马拉维、塞拉利昂和坦桑尼亚）的冠状病毒健康知识对保护性风险降低行为的影响进行了测试。尽管这些国家以薄弱的卫生系统和较低的平均教育水平而闻名，但在病毒进入后的两个月内，所有国家的关于症状和传播机制的健康知识水平都很高。较高的知识水平与更严格的防护措施相关，这些措施可能会降低疾病风险，但有一个例外——知识水平与社交距离措施呈负相关。受访者大多遵守了口罩佩戴要求和封锁措施，但仍然会在小型、非正式的聚会中与他人接触，这些聚会并未受到相关规定的限制。单独的知识似乎不太可能减少所有高风险活动，尤其是在他人家中进行的聚会。即使在疫情初期，人们也普遍报告有收入损失或压力的情况。我们的研究结果表明，政府早期且持续地提供健康信息，可能减轻了非洲疫情的严重程度，但这并非万能之策。

abstract.text: In one of the first studies of service sector robotics using establishment-level data, we study the impact of robots on staffing in Japanese nursing homes, using geographic variation in robot subsidies as an instrumental variable. We find that robot adoption increases employment by augmenting the number of care workers and nurses on flexible employment contracts, and decreases difficulty in staff retention. Robot adoption also reduces the monthly wages of regular nurses, consistent with reduced burden of care. Our findings suggest that the impact of robots may not be detrimental to labor and may remedy challenges posed by rapidly aging populations.

10.3386/w28322.abstractZh: 在最早使用机构级数据研究服务行业机器人应用的研究之一中，我们探讨了机器人对日本养老院人员配置的影响，以机器人补贴的地理差异作为工具变量进行分析。研究发现，机器人应用通过增加灵活雇佣合同的护理人员和护士数量，提升了就业人数，并降低了员工留任的困难。同时，机器人应用还降低了普通护士的月收入，这与护理负担减轻是一致的。我们的研究结果表明，机器人的影响可能不会对劳动力产生负面影响，反而可能解决快速老龄化人口带来的挑战。

abstract.text: Wealth varies considerably across the population and changes significantly over the lifecycle. In this paper, we trace out trajectories of wealth across several key life milestones, including marriage, homeownership, childbirth, divorce, disability, health shocks, retirement and widowhood using multiple decades of longitudinal panel data. We estimate both changes over the ten-year period before and after each milestone and assess whether those changes occur gradually or sharply after the milestone. We find evidence of significant long-run increases in wealth associated with homeownership and retirement, and significant long-run reductions in wealth associated with divorce, health shocks, and disability. In general, these changes appear to occur gradually rather than immediately after the milestone. Our results also indicate a large degree of heterogeneity across demographics, socioeconomic status and risk protection from insurance. In particular, those with lower levels of socioeconomic status and those without access to risk protection experience smaller wealth gains (or larger wealth losses) following life-course transitions. These results identify populations and life stages where individuals are most vulnerable to large reductions in wealth.

10.3386/w28329.abstractZh: 财富在人口中的分布差异较大，并且在生命周期中会发生显著变化。本文利用多个十年的纵向面板数据，追踪了在婚姻、拥有房产、生育、离婚、残疾、健康冲击、退休和丧偶等关键人生阶段财富的变化轨迹。我们分别估算了每个关键阶段前后十年内的财富变化，并评估这些变化是逐渐发生的还是在关键阶段之后突然发生的。研究发现，拥有房产和退休会导致财富在长期内显著增加，而离婚、健康冲击和残疾则会导致财富在长期内显著减少。总体而言，这些变化似乎是在关键阶段之后逐渐发生的，而非立即发生。我们的结果还表明，不同人口群体、社会经济地位以及风险保护情况之间存在较大差异。特别是，社会经济地位较低且缺乏风险保护的人群，在经历人生阶段转变后，财富增长较少（或财富损失较多）。这些结果揭示了哪些人群和生命阶段最容易遭受财富大幅减少的影响。

abstract.text: The general deterrence effects of malpractice laws on physician behavior have been extensively studied but may lack salience for physicians. We study the role of specific deterrence in malpractice liability by examining how physicians respond to being accused of malpractice. With the universe of data on patient care and malpractice complaints for Florida emergency physicians, we find that physicians oversee 9% fewer discharges after allegations and treat each discharge 5% more expensively. Effects are similar for paid claims and dropped accusations. Increases in treatment are generalized, i.e., not limited to conditions similar to what the physician is reported for.

10.3386/w28330.abstractZh: 关于医疗事故法对医生行为的一般威慑效果已有大量研究，但这些研究可能并未引起医生的足够重视。我们通过研究医生在受到医疗事故指控时的反应，来探讨特定威慑措施的作用。利用佛罗里达州急诊医生的患者护理和医疗事故投诉数据，我们发现，在受到指控后，医生处理的出院病例数量减少了9%，且每处理一个出院病例所需的费用增加了5%。无论是针对有偿索赔还是撤销指控，这种影响都是相似的。治疗费用的增加是普遍性的，即不仅限于医生被举报所涉及的病症。

abstract.text: We leverage two unique natural experiments to show that, in public drug insurance for the low-income elderly in the U.S., defaults have large and persistent effects on plan enrollment and beneficiary drug utilization. We estimate that when a beneficiary's default is exogenously changed from one year to the next, 96% of beneficiaries follow that default. We then develop a general framework for choice under costly cognition that allows for the possibility that either paternalistic defaults that steer consumers to plans that suit them (Thaler and Sunstein 2008) or `shocking' defaults that trigger consumers to make active choices (Carroll et al. 2009) could be optimal. We show that optimal default design depends on a previously-overlooked parameter: The elasticity of active choice propensity with respect to the value of the default. Leveraging variation in the match value of randomly-assigned default plans, we estimate an elasticity close to zero: There is little difference in the probability of active choice between beneficiaries assigned a well-matched default versus beneficiaries assigned a poorly-matched default. We also show that this passivity has real consequences, with beneficiaries assigned poorly-matched defaults experiencing large declines in drug consumption relative to those assigned well-matched defaults. This suggests that any potential welfare gains from an active choice response induced by a poorly-matched default are likely to be small and outweighed by the welfare losses due to reductions in drug consumption among beneficiaries who follow the poorly-matched default. Using a third natural experiment and a structural model of attention, we find that the little active choice that is present in this market appears to be largely random, with two-thirds of the variation in active choice coming from within-beneficiary transitory shocks to attention. Our results show that default rules are an integral part of insurance market design and that beneficiaries are likely to benefit from paternalistic defaults rather than be hurt by them.

10.3386/w28331.abstractZh: 我们利用两个独特的自然实验来表明，在美国针对低收入老年人的公共药物保险计划中，违约行为对计划参保率和受益人药物使用有着显著且持久的影响。我们的估计显示，当受益人的违约行为在一年之内发生转变时，有96%的受益人会遵循这一违约行为。随后，我们提出了一个关于在认知成本较高的情境下选择行为的通用框架，该框架认为，无论是引导消费者选择适合自己的计划的家长式违约行为（Thaler和Sunstein，2008年），还是能够促使消费者做出主动选择的“震撼性”违约行为（Carroll等，2009年），都可能是最优选择。我们指出，最优的违约设计取决于一个之前被忽视的参数：即主动选择倾向对违约价值的敏感度。通过利用随机分配的违约计划之间的匹配价值差异，我们估计出这一敏感度的数值接近于零：被分配到匹配良好的违约计划的受益人与被分配到匹配不佳的违约计划的受益人之间，主动选择的概率几乎没有差异。我们还发现，这种被动性会带来实际后果，被分配到匹配不佳的违约计划的受益人，其药物使用量会显著下降，相比之下，被分配到匹配良好的违约计划的受益人则不会出现这种情况。这表明，由匹配不佳的违约行为引发的主动选择反应所带来的潜在福利增益可能很小，而由于受益人药物使用量的减少所带来的福利损失则更为严重。通过第三个自然实验和注意力结构模型的分析，我们发现该市场中存在的少量主动选择似乎主要是随机的，其中三分之二的主动选择变化源于对注意力的临时冲击。我们的研究结果表明，默认规则是保险市场设计的重要组成部分，受益人更有可能从这种家长式的默认规则中受益，而不是受到其负面影响。

abstract.text: Many countries use uniform cost-effectiveness criteria to determine whether to adopt a new medical technology for the entire population. This approach assumes homogeneous preferences for expected health benefits and side effects. We examine whether new prescription drugs generate welfare gains when accounting for heterogeneous preferences by constructing quality- adjusted price indices for colorectal cancer drug treatments. We find that while the efficacy gains from newer drugs do not justify high prices for the population as a whole, innovation improves the welfare of sicker, late-stage cancer patients. A uniform evaluation criterion would not permit these innovations despite welfare gains to a subpopulation.

10.3386/w28333.abstractZh: 许多国家采用统一的成本效益标准来决定是否将新的医疗技术应用于全体人口。这种方法假设人们对预期的健康益处和副作用有着相同的偏好。我们通过构建结直肠癌药物治疗的质量调整价格指数，来研究在考虑异质偏好的情况下，新处方药是否能够带来福利收益。研究发现，尽管新型药物的有效性提升并不足以使整体人群承受高昂的价格，但创新确实改善了病情较重的晚期癌症患者的福祉。然而，统一的评估标准并不允许这些创新，即使这些创新对某个子群体带来了福利收益。

abstract.text: The health care system commonly relies on information about family medical history in the allocation of screenings and in diagnostic processes. At the same time, an emerging literature documents that treatment for “marginally diagnosed” patients often has minimal impacts. This paper shows that reliance on information about relatives' health can perpetuate marginal diagnoses across family members, thereby raising caseloads and health care costs, but without improving patient well-being. We study Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), the most common childhood mental health condition, and document that the younger siblings and cousins of marginally diagnosed children are also more likely to be diagnosed with and treated for ADHD. Moreover, we find that the younger relatives of marginally diagnosed children have no better adult human capital and economic outcomes than the younger relatives of those who are less likely to be diagnosed. Our analysis points to a simple adjustment to physician protocol that can mitigate these marginal diagnosis spillovers.

10.3386/w28334.abstractZh: 医疗保健系统通常依赖家庭病史信息来安排筛查和诊断过程。同时，有研究表明，对“边缘性诊断”患者的治疗往往效果甚微。本文指出，依赖亲属健康信息可能会导致家庭成员之间出现边缘性诊断的情况，从而增加病例数量和医疗成本，但并未改善患者的健康状况。我们研究了注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD），这是最常见的儿童心理健康问题。研究发现，边缘性诊断儿童的弟弟妹妹和堂兄弟姐妹也更容易被诊断出ADHD并接受治疗。此外，我们发现，边缘性诊断儿童的年轻亲属在成人人力资本和经济成果方面并不优于那些不太可能被诊断出问题的儿童的年轻亲属。我们的分析指出，对医生诊疗流程进行简单的调整，可以减轻这些边缘性诊断带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: Recent policy attention has focused on proposals to reduce prices for drugs that have received public funding. From an implementation perspective, such policies rely on public disclosure of government support for research. In this paper, we highlight two conceptual problems with past attempts to measure these public disclosures, and construct a new data set which corrects for these problems. Our corrected measures suggest that under-reporting of public research support is less of an issue than previously thought.

10.3386/w28349.abstractZh: 近期政策关注点集中在减少获得公共资金支持的药品价格上。从实施角度来看，这类政策依赖于政府公开披露对研究的支持情况。在本文中，我们指出了过去衡量这些公开披露情况时的两个概念性问题，并构建了一个新的数据集来纠正这些问题。我们的修正后的数据表明，公共研究支持的披露不足问题并不像之前认为的那么严重。

abstract.text: Investment in intangible capital—in particular, research and development—increased dramatically since the 1990s. However, productivity growth remains sluggish in recent years. One potential reason is that a significant share of the increase in intangible investment is geared toward consumer products such as pharmaceutical drugs with limited spillovers to productivity. We document that a significant share of R&D spending in the U.S. is done by pharmaceutical firms and is geared to developing drugs for the older patients. Increased life expectancy and quality of life among the elderly increases welfare but may not be reflected in estimates of total factor productivity.

10.3386/w28355.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代以来，对无形资本的投资——尤其是研发投资——急剧增加。然而，近年来生产率的增长仍然缓慢。一个可能的原因是，无形投资的增加中，有很大一部分用于消费产品，如药品，这些产品的生产率溢出效应有限。我们发现，在美国，相当一部分研发支出由制药公司承担，并且主要用于开发针对老年患者的药物。老年人预期寿命和生活质量的提高确实提升了福利，但这可能不会反映在总要素生产率的估计中。

abstract.text: We study the impact of the 1918 Spanish Flu on U.S. stock prices. We use the death rate to control for the impact of the global pandemic and war news reported in the New York Times to capture the positive effects of the end of World War I on stock prices. Using a new weekly hand collected NYSE stock price index, we show that there is a -.73 correlation between the aggregate stock market and the death rate. Furthermore, vector autoregressions demonstrate that the death rate can explain up to 24 percent of the forecast error variance in the aggregate stock index from September 1918 until the end of the pandemic in March 1920. We also find that the flu had a significant, but varied impact on nine NYSE sectors. The empirical analysis indicates that pandemics can matter big time for stock prices.

10.3386/w28356.abstractZh: 我们研究了1918年西班牙流感对美国股票价格的影响。我们通过死亡率来控制全球大流行的影响，并利用《纽约时报》报道的战争新闻来捕捉第一次世界大战结束对股票价格的积极影响。通过使用每周收集的新NYSE股票价格指数，我们发现整体股市与死亡率之间存在-0.73的相关性。此外，向量自回归分析表明，从1918年9月到1920年3月大流行结束期间，死亡率可以解释整体股票指数预测误差的24%。我们还发现，流感对纽约证券交易所的九个行业产生了显著但不同的影响。实证分析表明，大流行对股票价格的影响非常显著。

abstract.text: This essay reviews Deaths of Despair and the Future of Capitalism (DEATHS), by Anne Case and Angus Deaton, a fascinating account of life and death in the United States during the late 20th and early 21st centuries. While primarily targeted towards a popular audience, the volume will be of interest to many economists and other social scientists. It postulates how public and private policies currently practiced in the United States, combined with and partly causing the declining economic and social circumstances of less educated, have led to increased mortality from drugs, suicide, and chronic liver disease. After describing the material in DEATHS in considerable detail, I suggest a variety of research questions that need to be answered to confirm or refute Case and Deaton’s arguments and describe challenges to their key hypotheses. Among the latter are the ability of the postulated relationships to explain the sharply differing mortality trajectories of non-Hispanic whites, compared with other groups, and the timing of the observed mortality changes. Along the way, I raise doubts about the usefulness of the “deaths of despair” conceptualization, with its strong implications about causality.

10.3386/w28358.abstractZh: 本文评论了安妮·凯斯和安格斯·迪顿所著的《绝望之死与资本主义的未来》，这是一部关于20世纪末至21世纪初美国生活与死亡的引人入胜的记述。虽然这本书主要面向普通读者，但许多经济学家和其他社会科学家也会对其感兴趣。书中提出了这样一个假设：美国当前实施的公共和私人政策，加上部分原因导致受教育程度较低的群体面临经济和社会状况的恶化，从而导致了药物使用、自杀和慢性肝病导致的死亡率上升。在详细描述了《绝望之死》中的内容后，我提出了一些需要解答的研究问题，以验证或反驳凯斯和迪顿的论点，并探讨他们关键假设面临的挑战。其中一些问题包括：所假设的关系是否能够解释非西班牙裔白人与其他群体之间死亡率的显著差异，以及观察到的死亡率变化的时间点。同时，我对“绝望之死”这一概念化的实用性提出了质疑，因为它对因果关系有着强烈的暗示。

abstract.text: In response to the Covid-19 pandemic, many localities instituted non-essential business closure orders, keeping individuals categorized as essential workers at the frontlines while sending their non-essential counterparts home. We examine the extent to which being designated as an essential or non-essential worker impacts one’s risk of being Covid-positive following the non-essential business closure order in Pennsylvania. We also assess the intrahousehold transmission risk experienced by their cohabiting family members and roommates. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we estimate that workers designated as essential have a 55% higher likelihood of being positive for Covid-19 than those classified as non-essential; in other words, non-essential workers experience a protective effect. While members of the health care and social assistance subsector contribute significantly to this overall effect, it is not completely driven by them. We also find evidence of intrahousehold transmission that differs in intensity by essential status. Dependents cohabiting with an essential worker have a 17% higher likelihood of being Covid-positive compared to those cohabiting with a non-essential worker. Roommates cohabiting with an essential worker experience a 38% increase in likelihood of being Covid-positive. Analysis of households with a Covid-positive member suggests that intrahousehold transmission is an important mechanism

10.3386/w28374.abstractZh: 为应对新冠疫情，许多地区实施了非必要业务关闭令，将被视为一线必要工作的人员留在工作岗位上，而将其余非必要人员遣回家中。我们研究了在宾夕法尼亚州实施非必要业务关闭令后，被指定为必要或非必要工作者对感染新冠风险的影响。我们还评估了同居家庭成员和室友之间的家庭内传播风险。通过差异-差异框架的估计，我们发现被指定为必要工作者的员工感染新冠的可能性比被归类为非必要工作者的员工高出55%；换句话说，非必要工作者具有保护作用。虽然医疗保健和社会援助行业对这一整体效应有显著贡献，但这一效应并非完全由他们驱动。我们还发现，家庭内传播的强度因工作性质的不同而有所差异。与必要工作者同居的受抚养人感染新冠的可能性比与非必要工作者同居的人高出17%。与必要工作者同居的室友感染新冠的可能性则高出38%。对有新冠患者的家庭的分析表明，家庭内传播是一个重要的传播机制。

abstract.text: Why do firms outsource research and development (R&D) for some products while conducting R&D in-house for similar ones? An innovating rm risks cannibalizing its existing products. The more profitable these products, the more the firm wants to limit cannibalization. We apply this logic to the organization of R&D by introducing a novel theoretical model in which developing in-house provides the firm more control over the new product's location in product space. An empirical analysis of our testable predictions using pharmaceutical data concerning patents, patent expiration, and outsourcing at various stages of the R&D process supports our theoretical approach.

10.3386/w28379.abstractZh: 为什么一些企业会为某些产品外包研发工作，而为类似的产品则进行内部研发？一个具有创新能力的企业可能会面临现有产品的市场被侵蚀的风险。这些产品越有盈利潜力，企业就越希望限制这种侵蚀现象。我们将这一逻辑应用于研发组织，引入了一个新颖的理论模型，该模型认为内部研发能让企业更好地控制新产品的市场定位。通过利用有关专利、专利到期时间以及研发不同阶段外包情况的医药数据进行的实证分析，支持了我们的理论观点。

abstract.text: While there is a large literature on gender differences in important childhood developmental inputs in developing countries, the evidence for developed countries is relatively limited. I investigate gender differences in some of these inputs in the US and Canada. In the US very low birthweight males face excess mortality compared to their female counterparts. I provide evidence that the previously documented increase in mortality with the withdrawal of critical care at the Very Low Birth Weight (VLBW) threshold is primarily for boys. The fact that the critical care of both boys and girls changes discretely at this threshold suggests a possible misallocation of scarce hospital resources. In the US first born girls are breastfed longer than first born males, but the difference is so small that it is unlikely to have any consequence. Finally, mothers in the US and Canada are more likely to experience depression post birth when the first born child is a boy. Perhaps related, the parenting of first born boys in Canada in the first years of life is more likely to be confrontational.

10.3386/w28382.abstractZh: 虽然关于发展中国家儿童重要发展因素中性别差异的文献很多，但关于发达国家的相关研究却相对有限。我研究了美国和加拿大在这些发展因素中的性别差异。在美国，极低出生体重的男性比女性面临更高的死亡率。我有证据表明，之前文献中提到的极低出生体重阶段撤除重症监护服务后死亡率上升的现象，主要发生在男性身上。由于男孩和女孩在这一阶段的重症监护需求都发生了变化，这可能表明医院资源分配出现了不合理的情况。在美国，第一个出生的女孩比第一个出生的男孩接受母乳喂养的时间更长，但这一差异非常小，不太可能产生实际影响。最后，在美国和加拿大，如果第一个出生的孩子是男孩，母亲在产后更容易出现抑郁情绪。与此相关的是，在加拿大，第一个出生的男孩在生命早期更可能面临对抗性的育儿方式。

abstract.text: Monthly government transfer programs create cycles of consumption that track the timing of benefit receipt. In this paper, we exploit state-level variation in the staggered timing of nutritional assistance benefit issuance across households to analyze how this monthly cyclicality in food availability affects academic achievement. Using individual-level score data from a large national college admissions exam in the United States linked to national college enrollment data, we find that taking this high-stakes exam in the last two weeks of the SNAP benefit cycle reduces test scores and lowers the probability of attending a 4-year college for low-income high school students.

10.3386/w28386.abstractZh: 政府每月发放的转移支付计划形成了消费周期，这些周期与福利领取的时间相吻合。本文利用各州在家庭间营养援助福利发放时间上的差异，分析这种每月循环性的食物供应变化如何影响学术成就。通过美国一项大型全国大学入学考试中的个人成绩数据，并与全国大学入学数据相结合，我们发现，在SNAP福利周期的最后两周参加这项高风险考试，会降低低收入高中生的考试成绩，并降低他们进入四年制大学的概率。

abstract.text: There is a widespread belief that the COVID-19 pandemic has increased global income inequality, reducing per capita incomes by more in poor countries than in rich. This supposition is reasonable but false. Rich countries have experienced more deaths per head than have poor countries; their better health systems, higher incomes, more capable governments and better preparedness notwithstanding. The US did worse than some rich countries, but better than several others. Countries with more deaths saw larger declines in income. There was thus not only no trade-off between lives and income; fewer deaths meant more income. As a result, per capita incomes fell by more in higher-income countries. Country by country, international income inequality decreased. When countries are weighted by population, international income inequality increased, more in line with the original intuition. This was largely because Indian incomes fell, and because the disequalizing effect of declining Indian incomes was not offset by rising incomes in China, which is no longer a globally poor country. That these findings are a result of the pandemic is supported by comparing global inequality using IMF forecasts in October 2019 and October 2020.

10.3386/w28392.abstractZh: 普遍认为，COVID-19大流行加剧了全球收入不平等，贫困国家的人均收入下降幅度比富裕国家更大。这一假设虽然合理，但实际上并不正确。尽管富裕国家的医疗体系更完善、收入更高、政府能力更强且应对能力更强，但人均死亡人数仍高于贫困国家。美国的状况比一些富裕国家更糟糕，但比另一些国家要好。死亡人数较多的国家收入下降幅度更大。因此，生命与收入之间并不存在权衡关系；死亡人数减少意味着收入增加。结果，高收入国家的人均收入下降幅度更大。从各国来看，国际收入不平等程度有所降低。但当按人口数量对各国进行加权计算时，国际收入不平等程度反而有所上升，这与最初的直觉更为一致。这主要是因为印度收入下降，而中国作为不再属于全球贫困国家的国家，其收入增长并没有抵消印度收入下降带来的不平等效应。这些发现是大流行的结果，通过比较国际货币基金组织2019年10月和2020年10月的预测数据可以证实这一点。

abstract.text: Ethics in social science experimentation and data collection are often discussed but rarely articulated in writing as part of research outputs. Although papers typically reference human subjects research approvals from relevant institutional review boards, most recognize that such boards do not carry out comprehensive ethical assessments. We propose a structured ethics appendix to provide details on the following: policy equipoise, role of the researcher, potential harms to participants and nonparticipants, conflicts of interest, intellectual freedom, feedback to participants, and foreseeable misuse of research results. We discuss each of these, and some of the norms and challenging situations of each. We believe that discussing such issues explicitly in appendices of papers, even if briefly, will serve two purposes: more complete communication of ethics can improve discussions of papers and can clarify and improve the norms themselves.

10.3386/w28393.abstractZh: 在社会科学实验和数据收集过程中，伦理问题经常被讨论，但很少作为研究成果的一部分被明确表述。虽然论文通常会提及对人类受试者的研究审批流程，但大多数人认识到，相关机构审查委员会并不能进行全面的伦理评估。我们建议在一个结构化的伦理附录中详细阐述以下内容：政策平衡、研究者的角色、对参与者和非参与者的潜在伤害、利益冲突、智力自由、对参与者的反馈以及研究结果可能被滥用的情况。我们将逐一讨论这些内容，以及其中一些规范和具有挑战性的情况。我们认为，在论文的附录中明确讨论这些问题，即使只是简短地提及，也能起到两个作用：更全面地传达伦理信息，有助于完善论文的讨论，同时也有助于明确并改进相关规范。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has necessitated the adoption of a number of policies that aim to reduce the spread of the disease by promoting housing stability. Housing precarity, which includes both the risk of eviction and utility disconnections or shut-offs, reduces a person’s ability to abide by social distancing orders and comply with hygiene recommendations. Our analysis quantifies the impact of these various economic policies on COVID-19 infection and death rates using panel regression techniques to control for a variety of potential confounders. We find that policies that limit evictions are found to reduce COVID-19 infections by 3.8% and reduce deaths by 11%. Moratoria on utility disconnections reduce COVID-19 infections by 4.4% and mortality rates by 7.4%. Had such policies been in place across all counties (i.e., adopted as federal policy) from early March 2020 through the end of November 2020, our estimated counterfactuals show that policies that limit evictions could have reduced COVID-19 infections by 14.2% and deaths by 40.7%. For moratoria on utility disconnections, COVID-19 infections rates could have been reduced by 8.7% and deaths by 14.8%. Housing precarity policies that prevent eviction and utility disconnections have been effective mechanisms for decreasing both COVID-19 infections and deaths.

10.3386/w28394.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情迫使政府采取一系列政策，旨在通过促进住房稳定来减少疾病的传播。住房不稳定，包括被驱逐的风险以及公用设施中断或切断，会削弱人们遵守社交距离规定和卫生建议的能力。我们的分析使用面板回归技术，控制各种潜在混杂因素，量化了这些经济政策对COVID-19感染率和死亡率的影响。研究发现，限制驱逐的政策可使COVID-19感染率降低3.8%，死亡率降低11%。暂停公用设施中断的政策可使COVID-19感染率降低4.4%，死亡率降低7.4%。如果自2020年3月初到2020年11月底，所有县都实施此类政策（即作为联邦政策），我们的估计结果显示，限制驱逐的政策可使COVID-19感染率降低14.2%，死亡率降低40.7%。对于暂停公用设施中断的政策，COVID-19感染率可降低8.7%，死亡率可降低14.8%。防止驱逐和公用设施中断的住房不稳定政策，是减少COVID-19感染率和死亡率的有效机制。

abstract.text: On January 6, 2021, the U.S. Capitol was sieged by rioters protesting certification of Joseph R. Biden’s election as the 46th president of the United States. The Director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) quickly predicted that the Riot would be a COVID-19 “surge event.” This study is the first to estimate the impact of the Capitol Riot on risk-averting behavior and community-level spread of the novel coronavirus.
