First, using anonymized smartphone data from SafeGraph, Inc. and an event-study approach, we document that on January 6th there was a substantial increase in non-resident smartphone pings in the census block groups including the Ellipse, the National Mall, and the U.S. Capitol Building, consistent with a large protest that day. Next, using data from the same source and a synthetic control approach, we find that the Capitol Riot increased stay-at-home behavior among District of Columbia residents, indicative of risk averting behaviors in response to violence and health risks. Finally, turning to COVID-19 case data, we find no evidence that the Capitol Riot substantially increased community spread of COVID-19 in the District of Columbia in the month-long period following the event. This may be due to increases in social distancing and a “virtual lockdown” of the Capitol prior to the inauguration of the new president. However, exploiting variation in non-resident smartphone inflows into the January 6 Capitol protest, we find that counties with the highest protester inflows experienced a significant increase in the rate of daily cumulative COVID-19 case growth in the month following the protest. We conclude that the Capitol Riot may have contributed to non-localized COVID-19 spread.

10.3386/w28410.abstractZh: 2021年1月6日，美国国会大厦遭到抗议者围攻，他们抗议约瑟夫·R·拜登被认证为美国第46任总统。美国疾病控制与预防中心主任迅速预测，这次骚乱将成为一次COVID-19“激增事件”。本研究首次评估了国会大厦骚乱对避免风险行为和社区层面新冠病毒传播的影响。首先，利用SafeGraph公司的匿名智能手机数据以及事件研究方法，我们发现1月6日，包括Ellipse、国家广场和美国国会大厦所在的普查区块中的非居民智能手机信号显著增加，这与当天的大规模抗议活动一致。其次，利用同一来源的数据和合成控制方法，我们发现国会大厦骚乱增加了哥伦比亚特区居民的居家行为，这表明居民出于对暴力及健康风险的规避而采取了避免风险的行为。最后，从COVID-19病例数据来看，没有证据表明国会大厦骚乱在事件发生后的一个月内显著增加了哥伦比亚特区的社区传播。这可能是由于在新总统就职前，人们加强了社交距离措施，并对国会大厦实施了“虚拟封锁”。然而，通过分析1月6日国会大厦抗议活动期间非居民智能手机信号的波动，我们发现抗议活动最频繁的地区在抗议活动后的一个月内，每日累计COVID-19病例增长率显著上升。我们得出结论，国会大厦骚乱可能促进了非局部化的COVID-19传播。

abstract.text: We examine gender and race differences in education-mortality trends among 25-64 year olds in the United States from 2001-2018. The data indicate that the relationships are heterogeneous with larger mortality reductions for less educated non-Hispanic blacks than other races and mixed results at higher levels of schooling. We also investigate the causes of death associated with changes in overall mortality rates and identify key differences across race groups and education quartiles. Drug overdoses represent the single most important contributor to increased death rates for all groups, but the sizes of these effects vary sharply. Cardiovascular disease, cancer, and HIV are the most significant sources of mortality rate reductions, with the patterns again heterogeneous across sex, race, and educational attainment. These results suggest the limitations of focusing on all-cause mortality rates when attempting to determine the sources of positive and negative health shocks affecting population subgroups. Examining specific causes of death can provide a more nuanced understanding of these trends.

10.3386/w28419.abstractZh: 我们研究了2001年至2018年间美国25-64岁人群中性别和种族在教育与死亡率趋势上的差异。数据显示，这些关系存在异质性：受教育程度较低的非西班牙裔黑人群体的死亡率降低幅度大于其他种族，而在较高教育水平下则出现不同的结果。我们还探讨了与总体死亡率变化相关的死因，并识别出不同种族群体和教育水平四分位数之间的关键差异。药物过量是所有群体死亡率上升的最重要原因，但这些影响的程度存在显著差异。心血管疾病、癌症和艾滋病是死亡率降低的主要来源，而这些变化的模式在不同性别、种族和教育水平的人群中又表现出异质性。这些结果表明，在试图确定影响特定人群的健康冲击的来源时，仅关注全因死亡率的局限性。通过研究具体的死因，可以更深入地理解这些趋势。

abstract.text: This paper explores whether Big Data, taking the form of extensive high dimensional records, can reduce the cost of adverse selection by private service providers in government-run capitation schemes, such as Medicare Advantage. We argue that using data to improve the ex ante precision of capitation regressions is unlikely to be helpful. Even if types become essentially observable, the high dimensionality of covariates makes it infeasible to precisely estimate the cost of serving a given type: Big Data makes types observable, but not necessarily interpretable. This gives an informed private operator scope to select types that are relatively cheap to serve. Instead, we argue that data can be used to align incentives by forming unbiased and non-manipulable ex post estimates of a private operator’s gains from selection.

10.3386/w28429.abstractZh: 本文探讨了以大量高维数据形式呈现的大数据是否能够降低私人服务提供商在政府运营的按人头付费计划中的逆向选择成本，例如Medicare Advantage计划。我们认为，利用数据来提高按人头付费回归分析的先验精度可能并不有效。即使类型变得可以观测，但协变量的高维度使得精确估计服务某一类型的成本变得不可行：大数据使类型可观测，但不一定可解释。这为私人运营商提供了选择相对便宜的服务类型的机会。相反，我们认为可以通过数据来调整激励，形成无偏且不可操纵的私人运营商从选择中获得的收益的后验估计。

abstract.text: Health insurance plans increasingly pay for expenses only beyond a large annual deductible. This paper explores the implications of deductibles that reset over shorter timespans. We develop a model of insurance demand between two actuarially equivalent deductible policies, in which one deductible is larger and resets annually and the other deductible is smaller and resets biannually. Our model incorporates borrowing constraints, moral hazard, mid-year contract switching, and delayable care. Calibrations using claims data show that the liquidity benefits of resetting deductibles can generate welfare gains of 3-10% of premium costs, particularly for individuals with borrowing constraints.

10.3386/w28430.abstractZh: 健康保险计划通常只承担超过一定年度免赔额后的费用。本文探讨了免赔额在较短时间范围内重新设定的影响。我们建立了一个模型，模拟两种在精算上等效的保险政策之间的保险需求，其中一种免赔额较大且每年重新设定，另一种免赔额较小且每两年重新设定一次。我们的模型考虑了借贷约束、道德风险、年中合同切换以及可延迟护理等因素。通过索赔数据进行的校准表明，重新设定免赔额所带来的流动性收益可以带来相当于保费成本3-10%的福利增益，尤其是对于那些存在借贷约束的个体而言。

abstract.text: What happens when patients suddenly stop taking their medications? We study the health consequences of drug interruptions caused by large, abrupt, and arbitrary changes in price. Medicare’s prescription drug benefit as-if-randomly assigns 65-year-olds a drug budget as a function of their birth month, beyond which out-of-pocket costs suddenly increase. Those facing smaller budgets consume fewer drugs and die more: 0.0164 percentage points per month (13.9%) for each $100 per month budget decrease (24.4%). This estimate is robust to a range of falsification checks, and lies in the 97.4th percentile of 541 placebo estimates, formed in similar populations that lack the same idiosyncratic budget policy. Several facts help make sense of this large effect. First, patients stop taking drugs that are both ‘high-value,’ and suspected to cause life-threatening withdrawal syndromes when stopped. Second, using machine learning, we identify patients at the highest risk of drug-preventable adverse events. Contrary to the predictions of standard economic models, high-risk patients (e.g., those most likely to have a heart attack) cut back more than low-risk patients on exactly those drugs that would benefit them the most (e.g., statins). Finally, patients appear unaware of these risks. In a survey of 65-year-olds, only one-third believe that missing their drugs for up to a month could have any serious consequences. We conclude that, far from curbing waste, cost-sharing policies cause patients to miss opportunities to buy health at very low cost ($11,321 per life-year).

10.3386/w28439.abstractZh: 当患者突然停止服药时会发生什么？我们研究了由于价格大幅、突然且任意变化而导致的药物中断对健康的影响。医疗保险的处方药福利似乎随机地将65岁的老年人分配一定的药物预算，超出该预算后，自付费用会突然增加。那些面临较小预算的人会消耗较少的药物，并且死亡率更高：每月预算减少100美元时，死亡率增加0.0164个百分点（13.9%）。这一估计在一系列验证测试中表现稳定，位于541个安慰剂估计数据的第97.4百分位，这些数据是在缺乏相同特殊预算政策的类似人群中得出的。有几个事实有助于解释这一显著效应。首先，患者会停止服用那些“高价值”且被认为可能导致生命威胁性戒断症状的药品。其次，通过机器学习，我们识别出最容易发生药物可预防不良事件的高风险患者。与标准经济模型的预测相反，高风险患者（例如，最有可能发生心脏病的人）会比低风险患者更频繁地减少那些对他们最有益的药品的使用（例如，他汀类药物）。最后，患者似乎并不意识到这些风险。在一项针对65岁老年人的调查中，只有三分之一的人认为连续一个月错过药物可能会产生严重的后果。我们得出结论，费用分担政策不仅没有减少浪费，反而导致患者错过了以非常低的成本获得健康的机会（每生命年11,321美元）。

abstract.text: We experimentally evaluate the impact on child malnutrition of a maternal cash transfer program in Myanmar that was supplemented with Social Behavior Change Communication (SBCC) in a subset of villages. The combination of interventions significantly reduced the proportion of children stunted, while cash alone had no impact on stunting. SBCC appears to have worked in conjunction with cash to reduce stunting by encouraging mothers to increase children’s total calories and protein consumed. The findings provide evidence that information constraints contribute to low income-elasticity of calorie demand among malnourished populations, and underscore the importance of adding SBCC to cash transfer programs.

10.3386/w28443.abstractZh: 我们通过实验评估了缅甸一项针对儿童营养不良的母系现金转移计划的影响，该计划在部分村庄中结合了社会行为改变传播（SBCC）措施。这两种干预措施显著降低了发育迟缓儿童的比例，而仅使用现金转移措施则对减少发育迟缓效果不明显。SBCC与现金转移措施结合使用，通过鼓励母亲增加儿童摄入的总热量和蛋白质，有效减少了发育迟缓现象。研究结果表明，信息限制是导致营养不良人群对热量需求弹性较低的原因之一，并强调了在现金转移计划中加入SBCC的重要性。

abstract.text: Vaccination against infectious disease may be beneficial to reduce illness in vaccinated persons and disease transmission across the population. The welfare-economic practice of specifying a social welfare function and considering a planner who seeks to optimize welfare provides a constructive framework to evaluate vaccination policy. This paper characterizes choice of vaccination policy as a planning problem that aims to minimize the social cost of illness and vaccination. Manski (2010, 2017) studied vaccination as a problem of planning under uncertainty, assuming that a planner can choose any vaccination rate or that the planner has only two options: mandate or decentralize vaccination. The analysis focused on uncertainty regarding the effect of vaccination on disease transmission. Here I weaken the assumptions to recognize multiple uncertainties relevant to evaluation of policy for vaccination against COVID-19. These include uncertainty not only about the effect of vaccination on disease transmission, but also about the fraction of susceptible persons in the population, the effectiveness of vaccination in reducing illness and infectiousness, and the health risks associated with vaccination. The paper considers planning under ambiguity using the minimax and minimax-regret criteria, as well as planning using a subjective probability distribution on unknown quantities. It develops algorithms that may be applied flexibly to determine policy choices with specified degrees and types of uncertainty.

10.3386/w28446.abstractZh: 针对传染病的疫苗接种可能有助于减少接种疫苗者的疾病发生率以及疾病在人群中的传播。通过指定社会福利函数并考虑一个旨在优化福利的规划者，可以为评估疫苗接种政策提供一个建设性的框架。本文将疫苗接种政策的选择描述为一个规划问题，其目标是最小化疾病和疫苗接种的社会成本。Manski（2010, 2017）将疫苗接种视为一个在不确定性下的规划问题，假设规划者可以选择任意的疫苗接种率，或者规划者只有两种选择：强制接种或分散接种。分析的重点是疫苗接种对疾病传播影响的不确定性。在这里，我放宽了这些假设，承认在评估针对COVID-19的疫苗接种政策时存在多种不确定性。这些不确定性不仅包括疫苗接种对疾病传播的影响，还包括人群中易感人群的比例、疫苗接种在减少疾病和传染性方面的效果，以及与疫苗接种相关的健康风险。本文考虑了在模糊性情况下的规划问题，使用了极小极大和极小极大-遗憾准则，以及基于未知量主观概率分布的规划方法。文中还开发了可以灵活应用于确定具有特定程度和不确定性的政策选择的算法。

abstract.text: Although non-experimental studies find robust neighborhood effects on adults, such findings have been challenged by results from the Moving to Opportunity (MTO) residential mobility experiment. Using a within-study comparison design, this paper compares experimental and non-experimental estimates from MTO and a parallel analysis of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID). Striking similarities were found between non-experimental estimates based on MTO and PSID. No clear evidence was found that different estimates are related to duration of adult exposure to disadvantaged neighborhoods, non-linear effects of neighborhood conditions, magnitude of the change in neighborhood context, frequency of moves, treatment effect heterogeneity, or measurement, although uncertainty bands around our estimates were sometimes large. One other possibility is that MTO-induced moves might have been unusually disruptive, but results are inconsistent for that hypothesis. Taken together, the findings suggest that selection bias might account for evidence of neighborhood effects on adult economic outcomes in non-experimental studies.

10.3386/w28454.abstractZh: 尽管非实验性研究发现了对成年人存在显著的社区效应，但这些发现受到了“机会迁移”住宅流动性实验的结果的挑战。本文采用内部比较设计，对比了“机会迁移”实验与非实验性研究的结果，并对“收入动态面板研究”的数据进行了平行分析。研究发现，基于“机会迁移”实验与非实验性研究的结果之间存在显著相似性。尽管我们的估计值周围存在不确定性区间，但并未发现不同估计值与成年人接触不利社区的时间长度、社区条件的非线性效应、社区环境变化的幅度、迁移频率、处理效应的异质性或测量方法之间存在明确关联。另一种可能性是，“机会迁移”导致的迁移可能具有异常破坏性，但这一假设的结果并不一致。综合来看，这些发现表明，非实验性研究中观察到的社区效应对成年人经济结果的影响，可能是由于选择偏差造成的。

abstract.text: The decision about how and when to open schools to in-person instruction has been a key question for policymakers throughout the COVID-19 pandemic. The instructional modality of schools has implications not only for the health and safety of students and staff, but also student learning and the degree to which parents can engage in job activities. We consider the role of instructional modality (in-person, hybrid, or remote instruction) in disease spread among the wider community. Using a variety of regression modeling strategies , we find that simple correlations show in-person modalities are correlated with increased COVID cases, but accounting for both pre-existing cases and a richer set of covariates brings estimates close to zero on average. In Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) specifications, in-person modality options are not associated with increased spread of COVID at low levels of pre-existing COVID cases but cases do increase at moderate to high pre-existing COVID rates. A bounding exercise suggests that the OLS findings for in-person modality are likely to represent an upper bound on the true relationship. These findings are robust to the inclusion of county and district fixed effects in terms of the insignificance of the findings, but the models with fixed effects are also somewhat imprecisely estimated.

10.3386/w28455.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，关于何时以及如何恢复面对面教学的决定一直是政策制定者关注的关键问题。学校的教学方式不仅关系到学生和教职工的健康与安全，还影响着学生的学习效果以及家长参与工作活动的可能性。我们探讨了教学方式（面对面、混合式或远程教学）对社区疾病传播的影响。通过多种回归建模方法的研究发现，简单的相关性表明面对面教学方式会增加COVID病例数，但综合考虑既有的病例数以及更多相关变量后，这一影响平均来看接近于零。在普通最小二乘法中，面对面的教学方式在现有COVID病例较少的情况下并不会增加疾病的传播，但在现有病例较多的情况下，确实会增加疾病传播的风险。一项边界测试表明，普通最小二乘法的研究结果可能代表了真实关系的上限。这些发现在纳入县和地区固定效应后仍然具有稳健性，但包含固定效应的模型估计结果也相对不够精确。

abstract.text: We study Medicare's competitive bidding program (CBP) for durable medical equipment (DME). We exploit Medicare claims data to examine both prices and utilization, focusing on continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) devices to treat sleep apnea. We find that spending falls by 47.2% percent after a highly imperfect bidding mechanism is introduced. The effect is almost entirely driven by a 44.8% price reduction, though quantities also fall by 4.3%. To disentangle supply and demand, we leverage differential cost sharing across Medicare recipients. We measure a demand elasticity of -0.272 and find that quantity reductions are concentrated among less clinically appropriate groups.

10.3386/w28457.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗保险对耐用医疗设备（DME）的竞争性招标计划（CBP）。我们利用医疗保险索赔数据来考察价格和使用情况，重点关注用于治疗睡眠呼吸暂停的连续正气道压力（CPAP）设备。研究发现，在引入高度不完善的招标机制后，支出减少了47.2%。这一效果几乎完全由价格降低44.8%所驱动，尽管数量也减少了4.3%。为了区分供需关系，我们利用了医疗保险受助者之间的差异化的费用分担方式。我们测得需求弹性为-0.272，并发现数量减少主要集中在临床不太合适的群体身上。

abstract.text: Biologics accounted for roughly $145 billion in spending in 2018 (IQVIA, 2019). They are also the fastest growing segment of the pharmaceutical industry. The Biological Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA) of 2010 created an abbreviated pathway for biosimilar products to promote price competition in the market for biological drugs. There was great anticipation that the BPCIA would lead to a moderation in drug prices driven by market competition. The observed levels of competition and the accompanying savings have not reached those expected levels. we investigate the early impacts of entry of potential biosimilar competitors on use of biosimilars and prices for biological products. We focus especially on entry by biosimilars and how altered market structures stemming from the implementation of the BPCIA are affecting the prices for biological products subject to biosimilar competition. We do so by studying 7 products that have recently faced biosimilar competition. We estimate fixed effects and Instrument Variables models to estimate the impact of market competition on prices. Our results indicate that in the range of 1 to 3 entrants each additional marketed product results in a reduction in weighted average market prices of between 5.4 and 7 percentage points.

10.3386/w28460.abstractZh: 2018年，生物制剂的支出约为1450亿美元（IQVIA，2019年）。它们也是制药行业增长最快的领域。2010年颁布的《生物价格竞争与创新法案》为生物仿制药设立了一条简化的路径，以促进生物药品市场的价格竞争。人们普遍预期，该法案将通过市场竞争降低药品价格。然而，实际观察到的竞争程度以及随之而来的成本节约并未达到预期水平。我们研究了潜在生物仿制药进入者对生物仿制药使用率和生物药品价格的影响。我们特别关注生物仿制药的进入情况，以及《生物价格竞争与创新法案》实施后改变的市场结构如何影响受生物仿制药竞争影响的生物药品价格。我们通过研究7种最近面临生物仿制药竞争的产品来研究这一问题。我们采用固定效应和工具变量模型来估计市场竞争对价格的影响。研究结果表明，每增加1到3个进入市场的产品，加权平均市场价格就会下降5.4%到7%。

abstract.text: We study the effect of state recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) on workers’ compensation (WC) benefit receipt among adults 40-62 years. We find that WC receipt declines in response to RML adoption both in terms of the propensity to receive benefits and benefit amount. We estimate complementary declines in non-traumatic workplace injury rates and the incidence of work-limiting disabilities. We offer evidence that the primary driver of these reductions is an improvement in work capacity, likely due to access to an additional form of pain management therapy.

10.3386/w28471.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级大麻娱乐法对40-62岁成年人工伤赔偿领取情况的影响。研究发现，随着大麻娱乐法的实施，工伤赔偿的领取率下降，既包括领取赔偿的意愿下降，也包括赔偿金额减少。我们还估计了非创伤性工作场所伤害率和工作限制性残疾发病率的相应下降。我们的证据表明，这些减少的主要原因是工作能力的提升，这可能是由于人们获得了另一种疼痛管理疗法。

abstract.text: Amid an aging population and a growing role for private equity (PE) in elder care, this paper studies how PE ownership aﬀects U.S. nursing homes using patient-level Medicare data. We show that PE ownership leads to lower-risk patients and increases mortality. After instrumenting for the patient-nursing home match, we recover a local average treatment eﬀect on mortality of 11%. Declines in measures of patient well-being, nurse staﬃng, and compliance with care standards help to explain the mortality eﬀect. Overall, we conclude that PE has nuanced eﬀects, with adverse outcomes for a subset of patients.

10.3386/w28474.abstractZh: 在人口老龄化以及私募股权在养老护理领域作用日益增强的背景下，本文利用患者层面的Medicare数据，研究私募股权持有情况对美国养老院的影响。研究表明，私募股权的持有会导致患者风险降低，但也会增加死亡率。在考虑了患者与养老院匹配因素后，我们发现养老院对死亡率的平均影响为11%。患者福祉指标、护士流失率以及护理标准遵守率的下降有助于解释这一死亡率的影响。总体而言，我们得出结论，私募股权的持有具有复杂的影响，对部分患者而言可能带来不利影响。

abstract.text: We quantify the effects of a gross receipts tax (GRT) on vertical integration for the first time. We use data from the Washington state recreational cannabis industry, which has numerous advantages including a clean natural experiment: a 25% GRT imposed on cannabis firms was subsequently replaced by an excise tax at retail. We find the short-run elasticity of vertical integration with respect to the intermediate good net- of-tax rate is -0.15 and the long-run elasticity is more than twice as large. We find these incentives lead to large output losses – production increases by 23 percent when the GRT is eliminated.

10.3386/w28478.abstractZh: 我们首次量化了增值税对垂直整合的影响。我们采用了华盛顿州娱乐大麻产业的数据，该产业具有诸多优势，包括一个理想的实验环境：原本对大麻企业征收25%的增值税，后来被改为对零售环节的消费税替代。我们发现，短期内垂直整合对中间商品净税率的弹性为-0.15，而长期弹性则超过两倍。研究还发现，这些政策导致产量大幅减少——当增值税被取消时，产量增加了23%。

abstract.text: How people form beliefs is crucial for understanding decision-making under uncertainty. This is particularly true in a situation such as a pandemic, where beliefs will affect behaviors that impact public health as well as the aggregate economy. We conduct two survey experiments to shed light on potential biases in belief formation, focusing in particular on the tone of information people choose to consume and how they incorporate this information into their beliefs. In the first experiment, people express their preferences over pandemic-related articles with optimistic and pessimistic headlines, and are then randomly shown one of the articles. We find that respondents with more pessimistic prior beliefs about the pandemic are substantially more likely to prefer pessimistic articles, which we interpret as evidence of confirmation bias. In line with this, respondents assigned to the less preferred article rate it as less reliable and informative (relative to those who prefer it); they also discount information from the article when it is less preferred. We further find that these motivated beliefs end up impacting incentivized behavior. In a second experiment, we study how partisan views interact with information selection and processing. We find strong evidence of source dependence: revealing the news source further distorts information acquisition and processing, eliminating the role of prior beliefs in article choice.

10.3386/w28484.abstractZh: 人们如何形成信念对于理解在不确定性下的决策制定至关重要。在像大流行病这样的情境中，信念将影响行为，而这些行为又会对公共健康以及整体经济产生影响。我们进行了两项调查实验，以揭示信念形成中的潜在偏见，特别关注人们选择消费的信息的语气以及他们如何将这些信息融入自己的信念中。在第一个实验中，人们表达了他们对带有乐观或悲观标题的大流行病相关文章的偏好，然后随机展示其中一篇文章。我们发现，那些对大流行病持有更悲观信念的受访者，更有可能偏好悲观的文章，我们认为这是确认偏见的证据。与此一致的是，被分配到不太受欢迎文章的受访者认为该文章不够可靠和信息丰富；当文章不受欢迎时，他们也会减少对该信息的关注。我们进一步发现，这些有动机的信念最终会影响激励行为。在第二个实验中，我们研究了党派观点如何与信息选择和处理相互作用。我们发现存在强烈的来源依赖性：揭露新闻来源会进一步扭曲信息的获取和处理，从而消除了先前信念在文章选择中的作用。

abstract.text: Vaccinating the world’s population quickly in a pandemic has enormous health and economic benefits. We analyze the problem faced by governments in determining the scale and structure of procurement for vaccines. We analyze alternative approaches to procurement. We find that if the goal is to accelerate the vaccine delivery timetable, buyers should directly fund manufacturing capacity and shoulder most of the risk of failure, while maintaining some direct incentives for speed. We analyzed the optimal portfolio of vaccine investments for countries with different characteristics as well as the implications for international cooperation. Our analysis, considered in light of the experience of 2020, suggests lessons for future pandemics.

10.3386/w28492.abstractZh: 在疫情期间迅速为全球人口接种疫苗具有巨大的健康和经济效益。我们分析了政府在确定疫苗采购规模和结构时面临的挑战。我们探讨了不同的采购方式。研究发现，如果目标是加快疫苗交付时间表，采购方应直接资助生产能力，并承担大部分失败风险，同时仍需给予一定的速度激励。我们分析了具有不同特征的国家的疫苗投资最优组合，以及这对国际合作的影响。基于2020年的经验，我们的分析为未来的疫情提供了启示。

abstract.text: Research into the intergenerational transmission of educational advantage has long been criticized for not paying sufficient attention to genetics. This study is based on the Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study (MoBa) and administrative register data on 25000 genotyped Norwegian children and their parents. We assess and disentangle the relative importance of genetics and social background for children’s standardized academic test scores. Norway offers a particularly interesting context for intergenerational transmission, as the welfare state and educational system is designed to provide equal opportunity structures for children. The results point to genetics only confounding the parent status-offspring achievement relationship to a small degree, to ‘genetic nurture’ effects being small, and pro-vide no evidence of neither Scarr-Rowe interactions in test scores nor parent-child genotype interactions. Even in a universal welfare state with relatively low levels of inequality, there are two systems of ascription, one genetic and one social, and these are largely independent of each other.

10.3386/w28498.abstractZh: 关于教育优势代际传递的研究长期以来一直受到批评，因为该研究没有充分关注遗传因素的作用。本研究基于挪威母亲、父亲和儿童队列研究（MoBa）以及25000名具有基因信息的挪威儿童及其父母的行政登记数据。我们评估并分析了遗传因素与社会背景对儿童标准化学业成绩的相对影响。挪威为代际传递提供了一个特别有趣的背景，因为该国的福利制度和教育体系旨在为儿童提供平等的机会。研究结果表明，遗传因素仅对父母与子女之间的成就关系产生了较小程度的干扰，“遗传影响”较小，并且没有证据表明存在Scarr-Rowe交互作用或父母与子女的基因型交互作用。即使在具有相对较低不平等水平的普遍福利国家中，也存在两种不同的归因体系：一种是遗传因素，另一种是社会因素，这两种因素在很大程度上是独立的。

abstract.text: Many patients in need of a kidney transplant have a willing but incompatible (or poorly matched) living donor. Kidney exchange programs arrange exchanges among such patient-donor pairs, in cycles and chains of exchange, so each patient receives a compatible kidney. Kidney exchange has become a standard form of transplantation in the United States and a few other countries, in large part because of continued attention to the operational details that arose as obstacles were overcome and new obstacles became relevant. We review some of the key operational issues in the design of successful kidney exchange programs. Kidney exchange has yet to reach its full potential, and the paper further describes some open questions that we hope will continue to attract attention from researchers interested in the operational aspects of dynamic exchange.

10.3386/w28500.abstractZh: 许多需要肾脏移植的患者，都有愿意提供但不匹配的活体捐赠者。肾脏交换项目通过循环和链式交换的方式，让这些患者与捐赠者之间进行交换，从而使每位患者都能获得一个匹配的肾脏。由于对操作细节的持续关注，以及随着障碍的克服和新问题的出现，肾脏交换已成为美国及少数其他国家的标准移植方式。本文回顾了成功设计肾脏交换项目中的一些关键操作问题。尽管肾脏交换尚未完全发挥其潜力，但本文还提出了一些尚未解决的问题，希望这些问题能够继续吸引对动态交换操作方面感兴趣的研究人员的关注。

abstract.text: Calls for eliminating prioritization for SARS-CoV-2 vaccines are growing amid concerns that prioritization reduces vaccination speed. We use an SEIR model to study the effects of vaccination distribution on public health, comparing prioritization policy and speed under mitigation measures that are either eased during the vaccine rollout or sustained through the end of the pandemic period. NASEM's recommended prioritization results in fewer deaths than no prioritization, but does not minimize total deaths. If mitigation measures are eased, abandoning NASEM will result in about 134,000 more deaths at 30 million vaccinations per month. Vaccination speed must be at least 53% higher under no prioritization to avoid increasing deaths. With sustained mitigation, discarding NASEM prioritization will result in 42,000 more deaths, requiring only a 26% increase in speed to hold deaths constant. Therefore, abandoning NASEM's prioritization to increase vaccination speed without substantially increasing deaths may require sustained mitigation.

10.3386/w28519.abstractZh: 随着人们担忧优先接种SARS-CoV-2疫苗可能会降低接种速度，呼吁取消这种优先制度的要求日益增加。我们使用SEIR模型来研究疫苗接种分配对公共卫生的影响，比较了在疫苗推广期间放宽或持续实施缓解措施下的优先政策与接种速度。NASEM推荐的优先接种政策比不优先接种更能减少死亡人数，但并不能将总死亡人数降至最低。如果缓解措施被放宽，放弃NASEM的优先政策将导致在每月接种3000万剂疫苗的情况下增加约13.4万例死亡。如果不优先接种，接种速度必须至少提高53%才能避免死亡人数增加。如果持续实施缓解措施，放弃NASEM的优先政策将导致增加4.2万例死亡，只需将接种速度提高26%即可保持死亡人数不变。因此，为了加快疫苗接种速度而不大幅增加死亡人数，可能需要持续实施缓解措施，从而放弃NASEM的优先政策。

abstract.text: A large body of evidence documents a link between alcohol consumption and violence involving intimate partners and close family members. Recent scholarship suggests that since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent stay-at-home orders, there has been a marked increase in domestic violence. This research considers an important mechanism behind the increase in domestic violence during the COVID-19 pandemic: an increase in the riskiness of alcohol consumption. We combine 911 call data with newly-available high-resolution microdata on visits to bars and liquor stores in Detroit, MI and find that the strength of the relationship between visits to alcohol outlets and domestic violence more than doubles starting in March 2020. We find more limited evidence with respect to non-domestic assaults, supporting our conclusion that it is not alcohol consumption per se but alcohol consumption at home that is a principal driver of domestic violence

10.3386/w28523.abstractZh: 大量证据表明，饮酒与涉及亲密伴侣和近亲的暴力行为之间存在关联。最近的研究表明，自COVID-19疫情爆发及随后实施居家令以来，家庭暴力现象显著增加。本研究探讨了COVID-19疫情期间家庭暴力增加的一个重要机制：饮酒风险的增加。我们结合911报警数据以及密歇根州底特律市酒吧和酒类商店的详细数据，发现从2020年3月开始，前往酒类场所的频率与家庭暴力之间的关联强度显著增加。关于非家庭暴力行为的证据则较为有限，这支持了我们的结论：导致家庭暴力的主要因素并非饮酒行为本身，而是家庭环境中的饮酒行为。

abstract.text: Understanding how differences in management "best practices" affect organizational outcomes has been a focus of both theoretical and empirical work in the fields of management, sociology, economics and public policy.The World Management Survey (WMS) project was born almost two decades ago with the main goal of developing a new systematic measure of management practices being used in organizations.The WMS has contributed to a body of knowledge around how managerial structures, not just managerial talent, relates to organizational performance.Over 18 years of research, a set of consistent patterns have emerged and spurred new questions.We will present a brief overview of what we have learned in terms of measuring and understanding management practices and condense the implications of these findings for policy.We end with an outline of what we see as the path forward for both research and policy implications of this research programme.

10.3386/w28524.abstractZh: 理解管理“最佳实践”的差异如何影响组织成果，一直是管理学、社会学、经济学和公共政策领域理论研究和实证工作的重点。世界管理调查项目诞生于近二十年前，其主要目标是开发一种系统性的衡量组织内部管理实践的方法。该项目为关于管理结构如何与组织绩效相关联的知识体系做出了贡献。经过18年的研究，一些一致的模式逐渐显现，同时也引发了新的问题。我们将简要概述我们在衡量和理解管理实践方面所取得的研究成果，并总结这些发现对政策的影响。最后，我们将概述我们认为该研究项目在研究和政策应用方面的发展方向。

abstract.text: In many federally-subsidized insurance markets, insurers are subsidized on the basis of enrollee characteristics; in principle, subsidies that are "risk adjusted" in this way compensate insurers for ex ante differences in expected cost. Between 2010 and 2011, the subsidies in Medicare Part D were revised, sharply changing the subsidy for diagnoses and demographic characteristics. This paper uses the response of insurers to the subsidy update to estimate pass-through of government subsidies to two insurer choice variables: premiums and out-of-pocket costs. We find that diagnostic subsidies are passed-through at a rate of 40% to the out-of-pocket costs for relevant drugs. Premiums are not responsive to overall subsidies, but do reflect changes in the demographic component of subsidies.

10.3386/w28529.abstractZh: 在许多由联邦政府补贴的保险市场中，保险公司的补贴是基于参保人的特征来确定的；原则上，这种“风险调整”的补贴能够补偿保险公司对预期成本差异的预先补偿。在2010年至2011年间，Medicare Part D的补贴进行了调整，导致针对诊断结果和人口统计特征的补贴发生了显著变化。本文通过研究保险公司对补贴调整的反应，来估算政府补贴对两个保险选择变量的传递效果：保费和自付费用。我们发现，诊断相关的补贴有40%的比例传递到了相关药物的自付费用上。而保费则没有对整体补贴做出反应，但确实反映了补贴中人口统计成分的变化。

abstract.text: SARS-CoV-2 has had a greater burden, as measured by rate of infection, in poorer communities within cities. For example, 55% of Mumbai slums residents had antibodies to COVID-19, 3.2 times the seroprevalence in non-slum areas of the city according to a sero-survey done in July 2020. One explanation is that government suppression was less severe in poorer communities, either because the poor were more likely to be exempt or unable to comply. Another explanation is that effective suppression itself accelerated the epidemic in poor neighborhoods because households are more crowded and residents share toilet and water facilities. We show there is little evidence for the first hypothesis in the context of Mumbai. Using location data from smart phones, we find that slum residents had nominally but not significantly (economically or statistically) higher mobility than non-slums prior to the sero-survey. We also find little evidence that mobility in non-slums was lower than in slums during lockdown, a subset of the period before the survey.

10.3386/w28541.abstractZh: SARS-CoV-2在城市的贫困社区中造成了更大的感染负担。例如，根据2020年7月进行的一项血清调查，孟买贫民窟居民中有55%的人具有针对COVID-19的抗体，这一比例是非贫民窟地区的3.2倍。一种解释是，政府在贫困社区中的管控力度较弱，因为穷人更有可能被免除管控或无法遵守规定。另一种解释是，有效的管控措施本身加速了贫困社区的疫情扩散，因为贫困家庭人口更为密集，居民共用厕所和水源设施。我们在孟买的研究中几乎没有发现支持第一种假设的证据。通过智能手机的位置数据，我们发现贫民窟居民在血清调查前的移动性虽然高于非贫民窟居民，但这一差异并不显著（无论是经济层面还是统计层面）。此外，我们也没有发现非贫民窟居民在封锁期间的移动性低于贫民窟居民的证据。

abstract.text: We estimate the long-term effects of experiencing high levels of job demands on the mortality and aging of CEOs. The estimation exploits variation in takeover protection and industry crises. First, using hand-collected data on the dates of birth and death for 1,605 CEOs of large, publicly-listed U.S. firms, we estimate the resulting changes in mortality. The hazard estimates indicate that CEOs’ lifespan increases by two years when insulated from market discipline via anti-takeover laws, and decreases by 1.5 years in response to an industry-wide downturn. Second, we apply neural-network based machine-learning techniques to assess visible signs of aging in pictures of CEOs. We estimate that exposure to a distress shock during the Great Recession increases CEOs’ apparent age by one year over the next decade. Our findings imply significant health costs of managerial stress, also relative to known health risks.

10.3386/w28550.abstractZh: 我们估计了高工作需求对首席执行官死亡率和年龄变化的长期影响。这一估计利用了收购保护政策和行业危机的变化情况。首先，通过手工收集的数据，包括1,605位美国大型上市公司首席执行官的出生和死亡日期，我们估算了由此导致的死亡率变化。风险估计表明，当首席执行官不受反收购法律对市场纪律的约束时，其寿命会增加两年；而在整个行业出现衰退时，寿命则会减少1.5年。其次，我们采用基于神经网络的机器学习技术来评估首席执行官照片中的衰老迹象。我们估计，在大衰退期间，遭受经济压力的影响会使首席执行官的表观年龄在未来十年内增加一年。我们的研究结果表明，管理层的压力带来了显著的健康成本，这相对于已知的健康风险来说更为严重。

abstract.text: Many studies have examined the diffusion of health care innovations but less is known about the diffusion of health care fraud. In this paper, we consider the diffusion of potentially fraudulent Medicare home health care billing in the United States during 2002-16, with a focus on the 21 hospital referral regions (HRRs) covered by local Department of Justice anti-fraud “strike force” offices. We hypothesize that patient-sharing across home health care agencies provides a mechanism for the rapid diffusion of fraudulent strategies; we measure such activity using a novel bipartite mixture (or BMIX) network index. First, we find a remarkable increase in home health care activity between 2002 and 2009 in some but not all regions; average billing per Medicare enrollees in McAllen TX and Miami increased by $2,127 and $2,422 compared to a $289 increase in other HRRs not targeted by the Department of Justice. Second, we establish that the HRR-level BMIX (but not other network measures) was a strong predictor of above-average home care expenditures across HRRs. Third, within HRRs, agencies sharing more patients with other agencies were predicted to increase spending the following year. Finally, the initial 2002 BMIX index was a strong predictor of subsequent changes in HRR-level home health billing during 2002-9. These results highlight the importance of bipartite network structure in diffusion and in infection models more generally.

10.3386/w28560.abstractZh: 许多研究探讨了医疗创新的扩散，但关于医疗欺诈的扩散则知之甚少。本文研究了2002年至2016年间美国潜在欺诈性医疗保险家庭护理账单的扩散情况，重点关注由地方司法部反欺诈“打击小组”办公室覆盖的21个医院转诊区域。我们假设家庭护理机构之间的患者共享是欺诈策略快速扩散的机制；我们使用一种新颖的二分混合网络指数来衡量这种活动。首先，我们发现2002年至2009年间，某些地区而非所有地区的家庭护理活动显著增加；德克萨斯州麦卡伦和迈阿密的每位医疗保险参保人的平均账单金额分别增加了2,127美元和2,422美元，而其他未被司法部针对的医院转诊区域的账单金额仅增加了289美元。其次，我们发现医院转诊区域级别的二分混合网络指数（而非其他网络指标）是预测各医院转诊区域家庭护理支出高于平均水平的重要指标。第三，在医院转诊区域内，与其他机构共享更多患者的机构预计在次年会增加支出。最后，2002年的二分混合网络指数指数也是预测2002年至2009年间医院转诊区域级别家庭护理账单变化的重要指标。这些结果强调了二分网络结构在扩散以及更广泛的感染模型中的重要性。

abstract.text: Between 1900 and 1930 typhoid fever and other waterborne diseases were largely eradicated from U.S. cities. This achievement required a mix of technological, scientific, economic, and bureaucratic innovations. This article examines how the interaction of those forces influenced water and sanitary infrastructure provision during the 19th and early 20th centuries. I show the sharp link between infrastructure investments and declines in waterborne disease and discuss how that relationship informs the methodological approaches one should use to assess the impact of sanitary investments on urban development. Finally, I review the literature on the social returns to eliminating the threat of waterborne disease. The evidence suggests the benefits of infrastructure investment far exceeded the costs.

10.3386/w28563.abstractZh: 在1900年至1930年间，伤寒及其他水传播疾病在美国城市中基本被根除。这一成就需要技术、科学、经济和行政方面的创新相结合。本文探讨了这些力量如何相互作用，影响了19世纪和20世纪初的水源及卫生基础设施的提供。我揭示了基础设施投资与水传播疾病减少之间的紧密关联，并讨论了这种关系如何指导评估卫生投资对城市发展影响的方法论。最后，我回顾了关于消除水传播疾病威胁所带来的社会回报的文献。证据表明，基础设施投资所带来的好处远远超过了成本。

abstract.text: A feature of many insurance markets is that they combine vertical differentiation (all consumers prefer high to low-coverage policies) and adverse selection (high cost customers prefer high-coverage plans). Building on Novshek and Sonnenschein (1978) and Azevedo and Gottlieb (2017), this paper characterizes the competitive equilibria in a vertically differentiated market characterized by adverse selection. This provides a simple, dynamic model of the market, along with their welfare consequences over time in response to policy changes. The model makes predictions consistent with recent evidence on the ACA exchange in the US (Frean et al. (2017)). Moreover, it provides a complete characterization of the health insurance “death spiral”. The death spiral leads to an inefficient outcome, but does not lead to a complete breakdown of the market. Rather, it predicts a large number of plans, with coverage that falls with an individual’s willingness to pay. It is shown that introducing a minimum coverage standard combined with an insurance mandate cannot restore efficiency. The optimal system depends on both the valuation of public funds and the social value of insurance. Depending on these parameters, a number of different types of systems may be optimal, including a single payer system with mandatory participation for all, such as the Canadian system, a mixed private-public system, as one sees in many countries, or a pure, free market system.

10.3386/w28565.abstractZh: 许多保险市场的特点在于，它们同时具备垂直差异化（所有消费者都偏好高覆盖率的保险）和逆向选择（高成本客户更倾向于选择高覆盖率的保险计划）。本文基于Novshek和Sonnenschein（1978年）以及Azevedo和Gottlieb（2017年）的研究，描述了在逆向选择条件下形成的垂直差异化市场的竞争均衡。该模型提供了一个简单且动态的市场模型，并分析了市场随政策变化而变化的福利后果。该模型得出的预测结果与美国《平价医疗法案》实施后的市场情况相符（Frean等人，2017年）。此外，该模型还完整地描述了健康保险中的“死亡螺旋”现象。这种螺旋现象会导致市场效率低下，但并不会导致市场的完全崩溃。相反，该模型预测会出现大量保险计划，且保险覆盖程度会随着个人支付意愿的变化而变化。研究表明，引入最低覆盖标准并结合保险强制规定并不能恢复市场的效率。最优系统取决于公共资金的估值以及保险的社会价值。根据这些参数，可能存在多种最优系统，包括由单一支付者主导、要求所有人参与的加拿大系统，或者像许多国家那样的混合公私合作系统，或是纯粹的自由市场系统。

abstract.text: Within the vast body of literature on the relationship between mental disorders and life satisfaction, no satisfactory treatment has been proposed to deal with the bi-directional relationship between the two. We estimate the causal effect of depression and anxiety on life satisfaction by applying an instrumental-variable regression approach to the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA) survey. Our identification strategy exploits regional variation in the tendency to diagnose depression and anxiety, while also using an individual-level panel-data method. Our results show that previous research seriously overestimates the effect of depression and anxiety on life satisfaction. The most comparable estimate from previous research is over five times the size of our estimate. Furthermore, those papers that use such estimates to measure the monetary value of not suffering from depression or anxiety find it to be between $14 to $600 million a year per individual, compared to our estimate of around $60 thousand. Another source of bias which further inflates previous monetary estimates is the endogeneity of income. We account for this issue by using irregular sources of income, such as lottery winnings, instead of regular household income.

10.3386/w28575.abstractZh: 在大量关于精神障碍与生活满意度关系的文献中，尚未提出一种令人满意的方法来处理两者之间的双向关系。我们通过应用工具变量回归方法，对澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动动态调查数据进行了分析，以评估抑郁和焦虑对生活满意度的因果效应。我们的研究策略利用了地区间在诊断抑郁和焦虑倾向上的差异，同时采用了个体层面的面板数据方法。研究结果表明，先前的研究严重高估了抑郁和焦虑对生活满意度的影响。先前研究中的估计值是我们估计值的五倍以上。此外，那些使用这些估计值来衡量不患抑郁或焦虑所带来的经济价值的论文，得出的结果约为每年1400万至6000万美元，而我们的估计值约为6万美元。另一个导致先前估计值高估的偏差来源是收入的内生性问题。我们通过使用非固定来源的收入，如彩票奖金，而不是常规的家庭收入，来解决了这个问题。

abstract.text: Medicare pricing is known to indirectly influence provider prices and care provision for non-Medicare patients; however, Medicare's regulatory externalities beyond fee-setting are less well understood. We study how physicians' outpatient surgery choices for non­-Medicare patients responded to Medicare removing a ban on ambulatory surgery center (ASC) use for a specific procedure. Following the rule change, surgeons began reallocating both Medicare and commercially insured patients to ASCs. Specifically, physicians became 70% more likely to use ASCs for the policy-­targeted procedure among their non-Medicare patients. These novel findings demonstrate that Medicare rulemaking affects physician behavior beyond the program's statutory scope.

10.3386/w28576.abstractZh: 众所周知，医疗保险的定价会间接影响非医疗保险患者的医疗服务提供价格；然而，医疗保险在费用设定之外的监管影响则较为模糊。本研究探讨了医生在非医疗保险患者中的门诊手术选择如何受到医疗保险取消对特定手术使用门诊手术中心禁令的影响。随着规则的变更，外科医生开始将医疗保险和商业保险患者的手术转至门诊手术中心。具体而言，医生在非医疗保险患者中，使用门诊手术中心进行政策目标手术的可能性增加了70%。这些新发现表明，医疗保险的法规制定对医生的行为产生了超出该计划法定范围的影响。

abstract.text: Social distancing via shelter-in-place strategies, and wearing masks, have emerged as the most effective non-pharmaceutical ways of combatting COVID-19. In the United States, choices about these policies are made by individual states. We develop a game-theoretic model and then test it econometrically, showing that the policy choices made by one state are strongly influenced by the choices made by others. If enough states engage in social distancing or mask wearing, they will tip others that have not yet done so to follow suit and thus shift the Nash equilibrium. If interactions are strongest amongst states of similar political orientations there can be equilibria where states with different political leanings adopt different strategies. In this case a group of states of one political orientation may by changing their choices tip others of the same orientation, but not those whose orientations differ. We test these ideas empirically using probit and logit regressions and find strong confirmation that inter-state social reinforcement is important and that equilibria can be tipped. Policy choices are influenced mainly by the choices of other states, especially those of similar political orientation, and to a much lesser degree by the number of new COVID-19 cases. The choice of mask-wearing policy shows more sensitivity to the actions of other states than the choice of SIP policies, and republican states are much less likely to introduce mask-wearing policies. The choices of both types of policies are influenced more by political than public health considerations.

10.3386/w28578.abstractZh: 通过居家隔离策略和佩戴口罩来实施社交距离，已成为对抗COVID-19最有效的非药物手段。在美国，这些政策的制定由各个州自行决定。我们建立了一个博弈论模型，并通过经济计量学方法进行验证，发现一个州的决策会受到其他州决策的强烈影响。如果足够多的州采取社交距离或佩戴口罩的措施，它们将促使尚未采取这些措施的州也跟进，从而改变纳什均衡。如果不同政治倾向的州之间的互动最为紧密，那么可能会出现不同政治倾向的州采用不同策略的均衡状态。在这种情况下，一个政治倾向的州可以通过改变自己的决策来影响其他相同政治倾向的州，但无法影响那些政治倾向不同的州。我们通过Probit和Logit回归模型对这些观点进行了实证检验，发现州与州之间的社会强化作用非常重要，均衡状态可以被改变。政策选择主要受到其他州决策的影响，尤其是那些政治倾向相似的州，而新出现的COVID-19病例数量对政策选择的影响则较小。与SIP政策相比，佩戴口罩政策的制定对其他州的行为更为敏感，而共和党占主导地位的州则不太可能引入佩戴口罩政策。这两种政策的制定更多地受到政治因素而非公共卫生因素的影响。

abstract.text: The decades-long effort to produce a workable HIV vaccine has hardly been a waste of public and private resources. To the contrary, the scientific know-how acquired along the way has served as the critical foundation for the development of vaccines against the novel, pandemic SARS-CoV-2 virus. We retell the real-world story of HIV vaccine research – with all its false leads and missteps – in a way that sheds light on the current state of the art of antiviral vaccines. We find that HIV-related R&D had more than a general spillover effect. In fact, the repeated failures of phase 2 and 3 clinical trials of HIV vaccine candidates have served as a critical stimulus to the development of successful vaccine technologies today. We rebut the counterargument that HIV vaccine development has been no more than a blind alley, and that recently developed vaccines against COVID-19 are really descendants of successful vaccines against Ebola, MERS, and SARS. These successful vaccines likewise owe much to the vicissitudes of HIV vaccine development. We then discuss how the failures of HIV vaccine development have taught us how adapt SARS-CoV-2 vaccines to immune escape from emerging variants. Finally, we inquire whether recent advances in the development of vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 might in turn further the development of an HIV vaccine - what we describe as a reverse spillover effect.

10.3386/w28587.abstractZh: 数十年来，研制出有效的HIV疫苗的努力并非浪费了公共和私人资源。相反，在此过程中获得的科学知识为开发针对新型、具有大流行风险的SARS-CoV-2病毒的疫苗提供了关键基础。我们重新讲述了HIV疫苗研究的真实历程——包括所有的错误和失误——以此来揭示当前抗病毒疫苗技术的最新进展。我们发现，与HIV相关的研发不仅具有普遍性的溢出效应。实际上，HIV疫苗候选产品在第二阶段和第三阶段临床试验中的多次失败，反而推动了当今成功疫苗技术的开发。我们反驳了那种认为HIV疫苗研发只是死胡同的观点，以及认为最近开发的COVID-19疫苗实际上是针对埃博拉、MERS和SARS等疾病的成功疫苗的变体这一观点。这些成功的疫苗同样借鉴了HIV疫苗研发过程中的经验教训。接着，我们探讨了HIV疫苗研发中的失败如何帮助我们调整SARS-CoV-2疫苗以应对新变种的免疫逃逸。最后，我们思考了SARS-CoV-2疫苗开发的近期进展是否有可能进一步推动HIV疫苗的研发——这就是我们所说的逆向溢出效应。

abstract.text: Based on published estimates of its price elasticity of demand and of tax wedges, as well as the method of revealed preference, I estimate that the annual social value of ESI is about $1.5 trillion beyond what policyholders, their employers, and taxpayers pay for it. The private component of that value, which in some respects is the other side of “job lock,” derives in part from group plans, with the group determined by many characteristics other than the demand for healthcare. With voluntary groups formed this way, adverse risk selection is reduced, the groups can be effective at obtaining substantial discounts and rebates for their members, and division of labor employed in shopping for health providers. ESI is also a mechanism for employers to act on their incentives for a healthy and productive workforce. External effects include tax externalities (in both directions), encouraging work, and easing government expenditure obligations by helping to prevent people from going without health insurance.

10.3386/w28590.abstractZh: 根据已发布的关于需求价格弹性和税收效应的估计数据，以及显示偏好法，我估计ESI的年度社会价值约为1.5万亿美元，这一数值超过了保单持有人、雇主和纳税人为此支付的费用。其中，私人层面的价值部分，从某种意义上说，是“工作锁定”现象的另一面，这部分价值部分来源于团体计划。团体计划的形成取决于许多与医疗需求无关的因素。通过这种方式形成的自愿团体可以减少不良风险选择，同时能够为成员提供实质性的折扣和返利，并且可以分工合作来选择医疗服务提供者。ESI也是雇主激励员工保持健康且富有生产力的一种方式。其外部效应包括税收外部性（双向的）、促进工作积极性，以及通过帮助人们避免没有医疗保险的情况来减轻政府的支出负担。

abstract.text: We experimentally vary signals and senders to identify which combination will increase vaccine demand among a disadvantaged population in the United States – Black and White men without a college education. Our main finding is that laypeople (non-expert concordant senders) are most effective at promoting vaccination, particularly among those least willing to become vaccinated. This finding points to a trade-off between the higher qualifications of experts on the one hand, but lower social proximity to low socio-economic status populations on the other hand, which may undermine credibility in settings of low trust.

10.3386/w28593.abstractZh: 我们通过实验改变信号和发送者，以确定哪种组合能够增加美国弱势人群——没有大学教育的黑人和白人男性——的疫苗需求。我们的主要发现是，非专业且一致的发送者在促进疫苗接种方面最为有效，尤其是在那些最不愿意接种疫苗的人群中。这一发现表明，专家较高的资质与较低社会经济地位人群之间的社会亲近度之间存在权衡，这可能在信任度较低的情况下削弱可信度。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has forced countries to make difficult ethical choices, e.g., how to balance public health and socioeconomic activity and whom to prioritize in allocating vaccines or other scarce medical resources. We discuss the implications of benefit-cost analysis, utilitarianism, and prioritarianism in evaluating COVID-19-related policies. The relative regressivity of COVID-19 burdens and control policy costs determines whether increased sensitivity to distribution supports more or less aggressive control policies. Utilitarianism and prioritarianism, in that order, increasingly favor income redistribution mechanisms compared with benefit-cost analysis. The concern for the worse-off implies that prioritarianism is more likely than utilitarianism or benefit-cost analysis to target young and socioeconomically disadvantaged individuals in the allocation of scarce vaccine doses.

10.3386/w28601.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情迫使各国做出艰难的伦理抉择，例如如何平衡公共卫生与社会经济活动，以及在分配疫苗或其他稀缺医疗资源时优先考虑哪些群体。我们探讨了利益成本分析、功利主义以及优先主义在评估与COVID-19相关的政策时的意义。COVID-19带来的负担与防控政策成本之间的相对递减性决定了，对分配问题的更重视是否支持更积极或更消极的防控政策。与利益成本分析相比，功利主义和优先主义更倾向于采用收入再分配机制。对弱势群体的关注意味着，在分配稀缺疫苗时，优先主义比功利主义或利益成本分析更有可能将年轻人和社会经济地位较低的个体作为重点。

abstract.text: The health costs of in-person schooling during the pandemic, if any, fall primarily on the families of students, largely due to the fact that students significantly outnumber teachers. Data from North Carolina, Wisconsin, Australia, England, and Israel covering almost 80 million person-days in school help assess the magnitude of the fatality risks of in-person schooling (with mitigation protocols), accounting for the age and living arrangements of students and teachers. The risks of in-person schooling to teachers are comparable to the risks of commuting by automobile. Valued at a VSL of $10 million, the average daily fatality cost ranges from $0.01 for an unvaccinated young teacher living alone to as much as $29 for an elderly and unvaccinated teacher living with an elderly and unvaccinated spouse. COVID-19 risk avoidance may also be more amenable to Bayesian updating and selective protection than automobile fatalities are. The results suggest that economic behaviors can sometimes invert epidemiological patterns when it comes to the spread of infectious diseases in human populations.

10.3386/w28619.abstractZh: 在疫情期间，面对面授课带来的健康成本，如果有的话，主要应由学生家庭承担，这主要是因为学生数量远远超过教师数量。来自北卡罗来纳州、威斯康星州、澳大利亚、英格兰和以色列的数据表明，在接近8000万个人日的学校活动中，可以评估面对面授课（在采取缓解措施的情况下）的死亡风险。这些数据考虑了学生和教师的年龄及居住安排。面对面授课对教师的风险与开车通勤的风险相当。以1000万美元的VSL计算，平均每天的成本从未接种疫苗的独居年轻教师所需的0.01美元，到与未接种疫苗的老年配偶同住的老年教师所需的29美元不等。避免COVID-19的风险可能比处理汽车事故的风险更容易通过贝叶斯更新和选择性保护来应对。结果表明，在传染病在人类群体中的传播方面，经济行为有时可以逆转流行病学模式。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of a nationwide public health intervention on deaths from sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS), using population data from Denmark in a regression discontinuity research design. The information campaign–implemented primarily through a universal nurse home visiting program–reduced infant mortality by 17.2 percent and saved between 11.6-13.5 lives over 10,000 births. The estimated effect sizes are 11-14 times larger among low birthweight and preterm infants relative to the overall population. Improvement in infant mortality is concentrated among those with low socio-economic status and with limited access to health information, thereby reducing health inequities at birth.

10.3386/w28621.abstractZh: 我们采用丹麦的人口数据，通过回归不连续研究设计，评估了一项全国性公共卫生干预措施对婴儿猝死综合征死亡的影响。该信息宣传活动主要通过普遍的护士家访计划实施，使婴儿死亡率降低了17.2%，并在10,000例出生中挽救了11.6至13.5条生命。与总体人群相比，低出生体重和早产儿的效应大小约为整体的11至14倍。婴儿死亡率的改善主要集中在社会经济地位较低且获取健康信息有限的人群中，从而减少了出生时的健康不平等。

abstract.text: Body-worn cameras (BWCs) are an increasingly common tool for police oversight, accountability, and transparency, yet there remains uncertainty about their impacts on policing outcomes. This paper reviews what we know about the benefits of BWCs and how those benefits compare to the costs of this new technology. We make two contributions relative to existing research. First, we update prior meta-analyses of studies of the impacts of BWCs on policing outcomes to incorporate the most recent, and largest, studies carried out to date in this literature. This additional information provides additional support for the idea that cameras may affect a number of policing outcomes that are important from a social welfare perspective, particularly police use of force. Second, we carry out a benefit-cost analysis of BWCs, as financial barriers are often cited as a key impediment to adoption by police departments. Our baseline estimate for the benefit-cost ratio of BWCs is 4.95. Perhaps as much as one-quarter of the estimated benefits accrue to government budgets directly, which suggests the possibility that this technology could, from the narrow perspective of government budgets, even pay for itself.

10.3386/w28622.abstractZh: 随身摄像机已成为警方监督、问责和透明度提升中越来越常用的工具，但其在提升警务效果方面的实际影响仍存在不确定性。本文回顾了关于随身摄像机带来的益处以及这些益处与这项新技术成本之间的比较情况。我们相对于现有研究提出了两点贡献：首先，我们更新了先前关于随身摄像机对警务效果影响的元分析，纳入了迄今为止该领域最全面、规模最大的研究。这些新增信息进一步支持了摄像机可能对多个警务效果产生影响的观点，尤其是从社会福利的角度来看，对警察使用武力的影响尤为显著。其次，我们对随身摄像机进行了效益与成本分析，因为财政障碍常被认为是警察部门采用该技术的关键障碍。我们得出的随身摄像机效益与成本比率为4.95。估计的益处中，可能有四分之一直接惠及政府预算，这表明从政府预算的狭隘角度来看，这项技术甚至可能实现成本回收。

abstract.text: We empirically assess the potential financial impact of future gene therapies on the US economy. After identifying 109 late-stage gene therapy clinical trials currently underway, we estimate the number of new and existing patients with corresponding diseases to be treated by these gene therapies, developing and applying novel mathematical models to estimate the increase in quality-adjusted life years for each approved gene therapy. We then simulate the launch prices and the expected spending for these therapies over a 15-year time horizon. Under conservative assumptions, the results of our simulation suggest that an expected total of 1.09 million patients will be treated by gene therapy from January 2020 to December 2034. The expected peak annual spending on these therapies is $25.3 billion, and the expected total spending from January 2020 to December 2034 is $306 billion. Assuming a linear pace of future gene therapy development fitted to past experience, our spending estimate increases by only 15.7% under conservative assumptions. As a proxy for the impact of expected spending on different public and private payers, we decompose the estimated annual spending by treated age group. Since experience suggests that insurers with annual budget constraints may restrict access to therapies with expected benefit to the patient, we consider various methods of payment to ensure access to these therapies even among those insured by the most budget-constrained payers.

10.3386/w28628.abstractZh: 我们实证评估了未来基因疗法对美国经济的潜在财务影响。在确定了目前正在进行中的109项晚期基因疗法临床试验后，我们估算了这些基因疗法将治疗的相应疾病的新患者和现有患者数量，并开发和应用新的数学模型来估算每项获批基因疗法的质量调整生命年增加量。然后，我们模拟了这些疗法在15年时间范围内的推出价格及预期支出。在保守假设下，模拟结果显示，从2020年1月到2034年12月，预计将有109万患者接受基因疗法治疗。这些疗法的预期年支出峰值为253亿美元，而从2020年1月到2034年12月的总支出预计为3060亿美元。假设未来基因疗法的开发速度与过去经验相符，在保守假设下，我们的支出估计仅增加15.7%。作为衡量预期支出对不同公共和私人支付者影响的指标，我们将估计的年度支出按治疗年龄组进行分解。由于经验表明，预算有限的保险公司可能会限制那些对患者有预期益处的疗法的获取，因此我们考虑了多种支付方式，以确保即使是最预算有限的支付者也能获得这些疗法。

abstract.text: This paper estimates time-varying COVID-19 reproduction numbers worldwide solely based on the number of reported infected cases, allowing for under-reporting. Estimation is based on a moment condition that can be derived from an agent-based stochastic network model of COVID-19 transmission. The outcomes in terms of the reproduction number and the trajectory of per-capita cases through the end of 2020 are very diverse. The reproduction number depends on the transmission rate and the proportion of susceptible population, or the herd immunity effect. Changes in the transmission rate depend on changes in the behavior of the virus, reflecting mutations and vaccinations, and changes in people's behavior, reflecting voluntary or government mandated isolation. Over our sample period, neither mutation nor vaccination are major factors, so one can attribute variation in the transmission rate to variations in behavior. Evidence based on panel data models explaining transmission rates for nine European countries indicates that the diversity of outcomes results from the non-linear interaction of mandatory containment measures, voluntary precautionary isolation, and the economic incentives that governments provided to support isolation. These effects are precisely estimated and robust to various assumptions. As a result, countries with seemingly different social distancing policies achieved quite similar outcomes in terms of the reproduction number. These results imply that ignoring the voluntary component of social distancing could introduce an upward bias in the estimates of the effects of lock-downs and support policies on the transmission rates. The full set of estimation results and the replication package are available on the authors' websites.

10.3386/w28629.abstractZh: 本文仅基于报告的感染病例数，估算了全球COVID-19的变异再生数，这可能会低估实际感染情况。估算基于一个可以从基于代理的COVID-19传播随机网络模型中推导出的矩条件。关于再生数和截至2020年底人均病例数的变化情况，结果差异很大。再生数取决于传播率以及易感人群的比例，即群体免疫效应。传播率的变化取决于病毒行为的变化，如突变和疫苗接种，以及人们行为的变化，如自愿或政府强制隔离。在我们的样本期间，无论是突变还是疫苗接种都不是主要因素，因此可以将传播率的变化归因于行为的变化。基于面板数据模型对九个欧洲国家传播率的分析表明，结果的多样性源于强制限制措施、自愿预防隔离以及政府提供的经济激励之间的非线性相互作用。这些效应被精确估算，并且对各种假设具有鲁棒性。因此，在看似不同的社交距离政策下，各国的再生数结果却相当相似。这些结果表明，忽略社交距离的自愿成分可能会使对封锁和支持政策对传播率影响的估算出现高估。完整的估算结果和复制包可在作者的网站上获取。

abstract.text: There is growing interest in market design using default rules and other choice architecture principles to steer consumers toward desirable outcomes. Using data from Massachusetts’ health insurance exchange, we study an "automatic retention" policy intended to prevent coverage interruptions among low-income enrollees. Rather than disenroll people who lapse in paying premiums, the policy automatically switches them to an available free plan until they actively cancel or lose eligibility. We find that automatic retention has a sizable impact, switching 14% of consumers annually and differentially retaining healthy, low-cost individuals. The results illustrate the power of defaults to shape insurance coverage outcomes.

10.3386/w28630.abstractZh: 目前，人们越来越关注利用默认规则和其他选择架构原则来引导消费者达成理想的结果。通过马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所的数据，我们研究了一项“自动保留”政策，该政策旨在防止低收入参保者失去保险覆盖。这项政策不是取消那些无法按时支付保费的人，而是自动将他们转至可用的免费计划，直到他们主动取消保险或失去资格。我们发现，自动保留政策具有显著的影响，每年有14%的消费者因此改变选择，并且健康、经济条件较好的个体更容易被保留。这些结果说明了默认规则在塑造保险覆盖结果方面的强大作用。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of school shootings on health and human capital outcomes of exposed students as adults and on their migration during high school and a few years beyond. The analytic dataset use shootings compiled by the Center for Homeland Defense and Security with 2003-2012 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System data. To study migration, we use the 2004-2018 American Community Survey. We find that students exposed to school shootings experience declines in health and well-being, engage in more risky behaviors, and have worse education and labor market outcomes as young adults. There is no evidence of migration in response to school shootings.

10.3386/w28634.abstractZh: 我们研究了校园枪击事件对受影响学生成年后的健康与人力资本结果的影响，以及他们在高中及之后的几年中迁移情况的影响。分析数据来源于国土防御与安全中心收集的枪击事件记录，以及2003-2012年的行为风险因素监测系统数据。在迁移研究方面，我们使用了2004-2018年的美国社区调查数据。研究发现，经历过校园枪击事件的学生在健康和福祉方面表现较差，参与的风险行为增多，在年轻成年时期的教育和劳动力市场表现也较差。然而，并没有证据表明这些学生因校园枪击事件而迁移。

abstract.text: The advent of a pandemic is an exogenous shock, but the dynamics of contagion are very much endogenous --and depend on choices that individuals make in response to incentives. In such an episode, economic policy can make a difference not just by alleviating economic losses but also via incentives that affect the trajectory of the pandemic itself. We develop this idea in a dynamic equilibrium model of an economy subject to a pandemic. Just as in conventional SIR models, infection rates depend on how much time people spend at home versus working outside the home. But in our model, whether to go out to work is a decision made by individuals who trade off higher pay from working outside the home today versus a higher risk of infection and expected future economic and health-related losses. As a result, pandemic dynamics depend on factors that have no relevance in conventional models. In particular, expectations and forward-looking behavior are crucial and can result in multiplicity of equilibria with different levels of economic activity, infection, and deaths. The analysis yields novel policy lessons. For example, incentives embedded in a fiscal package resembling the U.S. CARES Act can result in two waves of infection.

10.3386/w28636.abstractZh: 大流行的出现是一种外部冲击，但传染的动力学实际上是内生的——并且取决于个体在激励下的选择。在这种情况下，经济政策不仅可以减轻经济损失，还可以通过影响大流行本身的轨迹来发挥作用。我们在一个受大流行影响的动态均衡模型中提出了这一观点。与传统SIR模型类似，感染率取决于人们在家与外出工作的时间比例。但在我们的模型中，是否外出工作是个体做出的决策，他们需要在今天外出工作带来的更高收入与更高的感染风险以及预期的未来经济和健康损失之间进行权衡。因此，大流行的动态取决于传统模型中并不相关的因素。特别是，预期和前瞻性行为至关重要，可能导致多种均衡状态的出现，这些状态具有不同的经济活动水平、感染率和死亡人数。这一分析提供了新的政策启示。例如，类似于美国CARES法案的财政激励措施可能导致两波感染。

abstract.text: Schools across the United States and the world have been closed in an effort to mitigate the spread of COVID-19. However, the effect of school closure on COVID-19 transmission remains unclear. We estimate the causal effect of changes in the number of weekly visits to schools on COVID-19 transmission using a triple difference approach. In particular, we measure the effect of changes in county-level visits to schools on changes in COVID-19 diagnoses for households with school-age children relative to changes in COVID-19 diagnoses for households without school-age children. We use a data set from the first 46 weeks of 2020 with 130 million household-week level observations that includes COVID-19 diagnoses merged to school visit tracking data from millions of mobile phones. We find that increases in county-level in-person visits to schools lead to an increase in COVID-19 diagnoses among households with children relative to households without school-age children. However, the effects are small in magnitude. A move from the 25th to the 75th percentile of county-level school visits translates to a 0.3 per 10,000 household increase in COVID-19 diagnoses. This change translates to a 3.2 percent relative increase. We find larger differences in low-income counties, in counties with higher COVID-19 prevalence, and at later stages of the COVID-19 pandemic.

10.3386/w28645.abstractZh: 美国及世界各地的学校已经关闭，以减缓COVID-19的传播。然而，学校关闭对COVID-19传播的影响仍不清楚。我们使用三重差异方法估算每周访问学校数量的变化对COVID-19传播的因果效应。具体来说，我们测量了县级学校访问数量的变化对有学龄儿童的家庭的COVID-19诊断数量变化的影响，与没有学龄儿童的家庭的COVID-19诊断数量变化进行了对比。我们使用2020年前46周的数据集，包含1.3亿户家庭每周的观测数据，其中包括COVID-19诊断信息，这些数据与数百万部手机的学校访问跟踪数据相结合。我们发现，县级学校面对面访问数量的增加会导致有儿童的家庭的COVID-19诊断数量增加，但这一效应相对较小。从县级学校访问数量的第25百分位上升到第75百分位，会导致每10,000户家庭中的COVID-19诊断数量增加0.3例。这一变化相当于相对增加了3.2%。我们发现，低收入县、COVID-19发病率较高的县，以及COVID-19疫情后期阶段，这种差异更为明显。

abstract.text: Thirty-six states have legalized medical marijuana and 14 states have legalized the use of marijuana for recreational purposes. In this paper, we review the literature on the public health consequences of legalizing marijuana, focusing on studies that have appeared in economics journals as well as leading public policy, public health, and medical journals. Among the outcomes considered are: youth marijuana use, alcohol consumption, the abuse of prescription opioids, traffic fatalities, and crime. For some of these outcomes, there is a near consensus in the literature regarding the effects of medical marijuana laws (MMLs). As an example, leveraging geographic and temporal variation in MMLs, researchers have produced little credible evidence to suggest that legalization promotes marijuana use among teenagers. Likewise, there is convincing evidence that young adults consume less alcohol when medical marijuana is legalized. For other public health outcomes such as mortality involving prescription opioids, the effect of legalizing medical marijuana has proven more difficult to gauge and, as a consequence, we are less comfortable drawing firm conclusions. Finally, it is not yet clear how legalizing marijuana for recreational purposes will affect these and other important public health outcomes. We will be able to draw stronger conclusions when more post-treatment data are collected in states that have recently legalized recreational marijuana.

10.3386/w28647.abstractZh: 已有三十六个州将医用大麻合法化，还有十四个州允许将大麻用于娱乐目的。本文回顾了关于大麻合法化对公共健康影响的文献，重点关注那些发表在经济学期刊以及重要的公共政策、公共卫生和医学期刊上的研究。研究的结果包括：青少年使用大麻的情况、酒精消费、处方阿片类药物滥用、交通事故死亡人数以及犯罪率。对于其中一些结果，文献中几乎达成了共识，即医用大麻法律对大麻使用的促进作用。例如，通过利用医用大麻法律在地理和时间上的差异，研究人员几乎没有找到可信的证据表明合法化会促进青少年使用大麻。同样，也有令人信服的证据表明，当医用大麻合法化时，年轻人在酒精消费方面会减少。而对于其他公共健康结果，如涉及处方阿片类药物的死亡率，合法化医用大麻的影响则更难评估，因此我们难以得出明确的结论。最后，目前还不清楚将大麻用于娱乐目的会对这些以及其他重要的公共健康结果产生什么影响。当那些最近将娱乐用大麻合法化的州收集到更多的后续数据时，我们将能够得出更有力的结论。

abstract.text: Decades of evidence reveal a complicated relationship between mammograms and mortality. Mammograms may detect deadly cancers early, but they may also lead to the diagnosis and potentially fatal treatment of cancers that would never progress to cause symptoms. I provide a brief history of the evidence on mammograms and mortality, focusing on evidence from clinical trials, and I discuss how this evidence informs mammography guidelines. I then explore the evolution of all-cause mortality relative to breast cancer mortality within an influential clinical trial. I conclude with some responses to the evolving evidence.

10.3386/w28648.abstractZh: 数十年的研究证据表明，乳腺X光检查与死亡率之间存在复杂的关系。乳腺X光检查能够早期发现致命的癌症，但也可能导致那些永远不会引发症状的癌症被诊断出来，并可能进行可能致命的治疗。我简要回顾了关于乳腺X光检查与死亡率的相关研究，重点介绍了临床试验中的证据，并探讨了这些证据如何为乳腺X光检查指南提供指导。接着，我研究了在一项有影响力的临床试验中，全因死亡率相对于乳腺癌死亡率的变化情况。最后，我对不断发展的证据提出了一些回应。

abstract.text: Can informing people of high community support for social distancing encourage them to do more of it? In theory, the impact of such an intervention on social distancing is ambiguous, and depends on the relative magnitudes of free-riding and perceived-infectiousness effects. We randomly assigned a treatment providing information on true high rates of community social distancing support. We estimate impacts on social distancing, measured using a combination of self-reports and reports of others. While experts surveyed in advance expected the treatment to increase social distancing, we find that its average effect is close to zero and significantly lower than expert predictions. The treatment’s effect is heterogeneous, as predicted by theory: it decreases social distancing where current COVID-19 cases are low (where free-riding dominates), but increases it where cases are high (where the perceived-infectiousness effect dominates).

10.3386/w28651.abstractZh: 向人们宣传社区对社交距离的支持是否能够鼓励他们更多地遵守这一规则？理论上，这种干预对社交距离的影响并不明确，这取决于搭便车效应和感知传染性效应的相对大小。我们随机分配了一种提供有关社区实际高比例社交距离支持信息的干预措施。我们通过自我报告和他人报告相结合的方式来估计这种干预对社交距离的影响。虽然事先接受调查的专家预计这种干预会促进社交距离的实施，但我们发现其平均效应接近于零，且远低于专家预测。正如理论所预测的，这种干预的效果存在异质性：在当前COVID-19病例较少的情况下，这种干预会减少社交距离（此时搭便车效应占主导地位）；而在病例较多的情况下，这种干预则会增加社交距离（此时感知传染性效应占主导地位）。

abstract.text: We use rich administrative data from Denmark to assess medical theories that autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heritable condition transmitted through underlying parental skills. Positing that occupational choices reflect skills, we create two separate occupation-based skill measures and find that these measures are associated with ASD incidence among children, especially through the father’s side. We also assess the empirical relevance of assortative mating based on skill, concluding that intertemporal changes in assortative mating explain little of the increase in ASD diagnoses in recent decades.

10.3386/w28652.abstractZh: 我们利用丹麦丰富的行政数据来评估关于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种通过父母潜在技能传递的遗传性疾病这一医学理论。假设职业选择反映了技能，我们构建了两个基于职业的技能指标，并发现这些指标与儿童中ASD的发病率有关，尤其是通过父亲这一支系。我们还评估了基于技能的择偶模式的实证相关性，得出结论：近几十年来ASD诊断数量的增加，在很大程度上是由择偶模式的跨时间变化所解释的。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on state and local government finances, with an emphasis on health spending needs and the role of the Medicaid program. We arrive at three conclusions. First, we find that nationwide, and over the entirety of the federal budget window, the enhanced federal matching funds are of roughly the same magnitude as expected increases in state Medicaid costs. There is a difference in timing, however, as projected relief funds are more concentrated in the near term than projected spending needs. Second, we show that there is substantial variation in states’ exposure to increases in Medicaid program costs. Third, we evaluate the extent to which federal aid has been targeted at states with large increases in Medicaid costs. We show that the enhanced Medicaid matching funds are quite weakly correlated with variations in states’ cost increases. In contrast, the state aid formula in the American Recovery Plan Act appears, to at least a moderate degree, to direct dollars toward states with large increases in their Medicaid enrollments.

10.3386/w28670.abstractZh: 我们分析了COVID-19大流行对州和地方政府财政的影响，重点关注卫生支出需求以及医疗补助计划的作用。我们得出三个结论。首先，在全国范围内，在整个联邦预算期间，增加的联邦配套资金与预期的州医疗补助成本增加幅度大致相当。然而，资金的时间分布有所不同，预计的救助资金在短期内更为集中，而支出需求则相对滞后。其次，我们发现各州在医疗补助计划成本增加方面的承受力存在显著差异。第三，我们评估了联邦援助在多大程度上针对医疗补助成本大幅增加的州。结果显示，增加的医疗补助配套资金与各州成本增加幅度之间的相关性非常弱。相比之下，《美国复苏计划法案》中的州援助机制似乎至少在某种程度上将资金定向分配给医疗补助参保人数大幅增加的州。

abstract.text: We exploit a quasi-experiment created when New York State began in 2011 to tax cigarettes sold on Native American Reservations. The regime change represents a unique opportunity to quantify brand loyalty because it almost doubled the price of premium-brand cigarettes, while Native brands were still untaxed. We use data from two different sources—the New York State Adult Tobacco Survey and the Nielsen Homescan Panel. We find that the increase in relative prices led to substantial declines in premium cigarette purchases. However, even among the premium consumers with the most to gain from switching, about three-quarters remained brand loyal.

10.3386/w28690.abstractZh: 我们利用了2011年纽约州开始对美洲原住民保留地销售的香烟征税时创建的准实验数据。这一政策变化为量化品牌忠诚度提供了独特的机会，因为该政策几乎使高端品牌香烟的价格翻了一番，而原住民品牌则仍然免税。我们使用了来自两个不同来源的数据——纽约州成人烟草调查和Nielsen Homescan面板调查。研究发现，相对价格的增加导致高端香烟的购买量大幅下降。然而，即使是在那些从转换中获益最多的高端消费者中，也有大约四分之三的人仍然保持对品牌的忠诚度。

abstract.text: Domestic mobility restrictions to control the spread of COVID-19 are widespread in developing countries, and have trapped millions of migrant workers in hotspot cities. We show that bans can increase cumulative infections relative to a counterfactual sans restrictions. A SEIR model shows bans’ impacts are nonlinear in duration. We empirically test this hypothesis using a natural experiment in India as well as data from China, Indonesia, the Philippines, South Africa, and Kenya. Although very short and long restrictions limit the spread of disease, moderately lengthy restrictions substantially increase infections. This underscores the importance of considering duration in mobility-restricting policy decisions in developing countries.

10.3386/w28699.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，为了控制COVID-19的传播，国内流动限制措施普遍存在，这使得数百万移民工人在热点城市陷入困境。我们的研究表明，禁令相对于没有限制措施的情况，会增加累计感染人数。SEIR模型显示，禁令的影响与持续时间呈非线性关系。我们通过印度的自然实验以及中国、印度尼西亚、菲律宾、南非和肯尼亚的数据对这一假设进行了实证检验。虽然非常短或非常长的限制措施会限制疾病的传播，但中等长度的限制措施会显著增加感染人数。这强调了在发展中国家制定限制流动政策时考虑持续时间的重要性。

abstract.text: Teens are risky drivers and often subject to extra restrictions. We examine the effects of an Australian intervention banning first-year drivers from carrying multiple passengers between 11:00pm and 4:59am, which had represented 3% of their accidents and 18% of their fatalities. Using daytime outcomes to account for counterfactual crash risks, we find the reform more than halves targeted crashes, casualties and deaths. The restriction also lowers crashes earlier in the evening and beyond the first year, suggesting it has broad and persistent effects on driving behavior. Overall, this targeted intervention delivers gains comparable to harsher restrictions that delay teen driving.

10.3386/w28707.abstractZh: 青少年是风险较高的驾驶者，通常面临额外的限制。我们研究了澳大利亚的一项干预措施的效果，该措施禁止一年级学生晚上11点至凌晨4点59分搭载多名乘客，这一时间段的事故率和死亡人数分别占整个事故和死亡人数的3%和18%。通过利用白天的数据来反推事故风险，我们发现该改革措施使目标范围内的事故、伤亡和死亡人数减少了超过一半。此外，该限制措施还降低了傍晚时分以及一年级学生之后的事故率，表明其对驾驶行为具有广泛而持久的影响。总体而言，这种有针对性的干预措施所带来的收益，与更为严格的限制措施相当，后者能够推迟青少年的驾驶年龄。

abstract.text: Many human activities can be strategically timed around forecastable natural hazards to mute their impacts. We study air pollution shock mitigation in a high-stakes healthcare setting: hospital surgery scheduling. Using newly available inpatient surgery records from a major city in China, we track post-surgery survival for over 1 million patients, and document a significant increase of hospital mortality among those who underwent surgeries on days with high particulate matter pollution. This effect has two special features. First, pollution on the surgery day, rather than exposure prior to hospitalization, before or after the surgery, is primarily explanatory of the excess mortality. Second, a small but high-risk group – elderly patients undergoing respiratory or cancer operations – bears a majority of pollution’s damages. Based on these empirical findings, we analyze a model of hospital surgery scheduling. For over a third of the high-risk surgeries, there exists an alternative, lower-pollution day within three days such that moving the surgery may lead to a Pareto improvement in survival.

10.3386/w28708.abstractZh: 许多人类活动可以通过策略性地安排时间来避开可预测的自然灾害，从而减轻其影响。我们研究了在高风险医疗领域——医院手术安排中，空气污染对生存影响的缓解措施。利用中国某大城市新获得的住院手术记录，我们追踪了超过100万名患者的术后存活情况，发现在高颗粒物污染日进行手术的患者，其医院死亡率显著上升。这一效应具有两个特殊特点：首先，造成超额死亡的主要原因是手术当天的污染，而非住院前的暴露；其次，一小部分但风险较高的患者群体——如接受呼吸或癌症手术的老龄患者——承担了大部分污染带来的损害。基于这些实证发现，我们分析了一个医院手术安排模型。对于超过三分之一的高风险手术，在三天内可以找到一个污染较低的替代日期，将手术时间调整至此日期，可能会带来生存率的帕累托改进。

abstract.text: This study examines the link between credit supply and hospital health outcomes. We use bank stress tests as exogenous shocks to credit access for hospitals that have lending relationships with tested banks. We find that affected hospitals shift their operations to increase resource utilization following a negative credit shock but reduce the quality of their care to patients across a variety of measures, including a significant increase in risk-adjusted readmission and mortality rates. The results indicate that access to credit can affect the quality of healthcare hospitals deliver, pointing to important spillover effects of credit market frictions on health outcomes.

10.3386/w28709.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了信贷供应与医院健康结果之间的关联。我们通过银行压力测试作为外生冲击，来模拟医院与特定银行存在借贷关系时信贷获取情况的变化。研究发现，在受到负面信贷冲击后，受影响的医院会调整其运营方式以提高资源利用率，但其在多个方面的医疗服务质量却有所下降，包括风险调整后的再入院率和死亡率显著上升。结果表明，信贷获取情况确实会影响医院提供的医疗服务质量，这揭示了信贷市场摩擦对健康结果的重要影响。

abstract.text: Using randomized methodologies, we study a common community HIV/AIDS program that seeks to promote HIV testing by improving knowledge and reducing stigmatizing attitudes. Contrary to expectations, the program has a substantial negative effect on HIV testing rates. We provide evidence of likely mechanisms behind the program’s negative effect: it inadvertently increased misinformation about HIV transmission methods, and worsened HIV-related stigmatizing attitudes. Subsequent household-level randomized treatments providing correct information and addressing stigma concerns counteract the program’s negative effect on HIV testing. These findings highlight the importance of improving knowledge and alleviating stigma concerns when promoting HIV testing.

10.3386/w28716.abstractZh: 我们采用随机化方法，研究了一项常见的社区艾滋病防治项目，该项目旨在通过提高人们的认知水平和减少污名化态度来促进艾滋病检测。与预期相反，该项目对艾滋病检测率产生了显著的负面影响。我们发现，该项目无意中增加了关于艾滋病传播方式的错误信息，并加剧了与艾滋病相关的污名化态度。随后进行的家庭层面随机实验表明，提供正确的信息并解决污名化问题可以抵消该项目对艾滋病检测率的负面影响。这些发现强调了在促进艾滋病检测时，提高认知水平和减轻污名化问题的重要性。

abstract.text: Policymakers often choose a policy bundle that is a combination of different interventions in different dosages. We develop a new technique—treatment variant aggregation (TVA)—to select a policy from a large factorial design. TVA pools together policy variants that are not meaningfully different and prunes those deemed ineffective. This allows us to restrict attention to aggregated policy variants, consistently estimate their effects on the outcome, and estimate the best policy effect adjusting for the winner’s curse. We apply TVA to a large randomized controlled trial that tests interventions to stimulate demand for immunization in Haryana, India. The policies under consideration include reminders, incentives, and local ambassadors for community mobilization. Cross-randomizing these interventions, with different dosages or types of each intervention, yields 75 combinations. The policy with the largest impact (which combines incentives, ambassadors who are information hubs, and reminders) increases the number of immunizations by 44% relative to the status quo. The most cost-effective policy (information hubs, ambassadors, and SMS reminders but no incentives) increases the number of immunizations per dollar by 9.1% relative to status quo.

10.3386/w28726.abstractZh: 政策制定者通常会选择一种包含多种不同干预措施的政策组合，这些干预措施的具体实施强度各不相同。我们开发了一种新的技术——处理变量聚合（TVA），用于从复杂的因子设计中筛选出最优政策。TVA将那些差异不大的政策变体合并在一起，并剔除那些被认为无效的政策。这样，我们可以专注于聚合后的政策变体，一致地评估它们对结果的影响，并调整因“赢者诅咒”而出现的偏差，从而确定最佳政策效果。我们将TVA技术应用于一项大规模的随机对照试验，该试验旨在测试在印度哈里亚纳邦刺激免疫接种需求的干预措施。所考虑的政策包括提醒、激励措施以及社区动员的本地代表等。通过交叉随机化这些干预措施，并调整其实施强度或类型，我们得出了75种可能的政策组合。其中，效果最显著的政策组合包括激励措施、作为信息枢纽的本地代表以及提醒措施，该政策使免疫接种数量比现状增加了44%。而最具成本效益的政策组合则是仅包含信息枢纽、本地代表和短信提醒措施，而不包括激励措施，该政策使每美元投入带来的免疫接种数量增加了9.1%。

abstract.text: Machines increasingly replace people in routine job tasks.The remaining tasks require workers to make open-ended decisions and to have "soft" skills such as problem-solving, critical thinking and adaptability.This paper documents growing demand for decision-making and explores the consequences for life-cycle earnings.Career earnings growth in the U.S. more than doubled between 1960 and 2017, and the age of peak earnings increased from the late 30s to the mid-50s.I show that a substantial share of this shift is explained by increased employment in decisionintensive occupations, which have longer and more gradual periods of earnings growth.To understand these patterns, I develop a model that nests decision-making in a standard human capital framework.Workers predict the output of uncertain, context-dependent actions.Experience reduces prediction error, improving a worker's ability to adapt using data from similar decisions they have made in the past.Experience takes longer to accumulate in high variance, non-routine jobs.I test the predictions of the model using data from the three waves of the NLS.Life-cycle wage growth in decision-intensive occupations has increased over time, and it has increased relatively more for highly-skilled workers.

10.3386/w28733.abstractZh: 机器正在越来越多地替代人从事日常工作任务。剩下的任务则需要工人做出开放式决策，并具备解决问题、批判性思维和适应性等“软性”技能。本文记录了对决策能力的需求不断增加，并探讨了这对生命周期收入的影响。美国的职业收入在1960年至2017年间增长了两倍多，而收入巅峰的年龄从30多岁晚期延长到了50多岁中期。我指出，这一变化在很大程度上是由于决策密集型职业的就业人数增加所致，这些职业的收入增长周期更长且更为平稳。为了理解这些模式，我开发了一个模型，将决策能力纳入标准的人力资本框架中。工人预测不确定且依赖情境的行动结果。经验可以减少预测误差，提高工人利用过去类似决策数据进行适应的能力。在高方差、非例行工作中，积累经验所需的时间更长。我使用NLS的三波数据来验证该模型的预测结果。决策密集型职业的生命周期工资增长随着时间的推移而上升，对于高技能工人来说，这种增长幅度更大。

abstract.text: A randomized-trial of community-level mask promotion in rural Bangladesh during COVID-19 shows that the intervention tripled mask usage and is a cost-effective means of promoting public health.

10.3386/w28734.abstractZh: 一项在孟加拉国农村进行的社区层面口罩推广随机试验表明，该干预措施使口罩使用量增加了三倍，是一种具有成本效益的公共卫生推广方式。

abstract.text: Were workers more likely to be infected by COVID-19 in their workplace, or outside it? Although both economic models of the pandemic and public health policy recommendations often presume that the workplace is less safe, economic theory predicts that group cooperation significantly increases the per capita demand for public goods. Disease prevention may also have scale economies in supply. The available data from schools, hospitals, nursing homes, warehouses, grocery stores, food processing plants, hair stylists, and airlines – covering more than a million employees and students – show employers adopting mitigation protocols in the spring of 2020. Coincident with the adoption, infection rates in workplaces typically dropped from well above household rates to well below. When this occurs, the sign of the disease externality from participating in large organizations changes from negative to positive, even while individuals continue to have an incentive to avoid large organizations due to the prevention costs they impose on members. Rational cooperative prevention sometimes results in infectious-disease patterns that are opposite of predictions from classical epidemiology.

10.3386/w28737.abstractZh: 工人是在工作场所还是外部更容易感染COVID-19？尽管疫情的经济模型以及公共卫生政策建议通常认为工作场所的安全性较低，但经济理论预测，群体合作会显著增加对公共产品的需求。疾病预防在供应方面也可能具有规模经济。来自学校、医院、养老院、仓库、杂货店、食品加工厂、美发店和航空公司的数据表明，在2020年春季，雇主们采取了缓解措施。随着这些措施的实施，工作场所的感染率通常从远高于家庭水平下降到远低于家庭水平。在这种情况下，参与大型组织的疾病外部性的符号从负变为正，即使个人仍然有动机避免大型组织，因为它们会给成员带来预防成本。理性的合作预防有时会导致传染病模式与经典流行病学预测的相反。

abstract.text: We analyze data from a survey we administered during the COVID-19 pandemic to investigate the relationship between people's subjective risk beliefs and their protective behaviors. We report three main findings. First, on average, people substantially overestimate the absolute level of risk associated with economic activity, but have correct signals about their relative risk. Second, people who believe that they face a higher risk of infection are more likely to report avoiding economic activities. Third, government mandates restricting economic behavior attenuate the relationship between subjective risk beliefs and protective behaviors.

10.3386/w28741.abstractZh: 我们分析了在COVID-19疫情期间进行的一项调查数据，以研究人们的主观风险认知与其保护行为之间的关系。我们得到了三个主要发现。首先，人们普遍高估了与经济活动相关的绝对风险水平，但对于相对风险却有着正确的判断。其次，认为自己面临更高感染风险的人更有可能避免参与经济活动。第三，政府限制经济行为的措施减弱了主观风险认知与保护行为之间的关系。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of fall 2020 school reopenings in Texas on county-level COVID-19 cases and fatalities. Previous evidence suggests that schools can be reopened safely if community spread is low and public health guidelines are followed.
