However, in Texas, reopenings often occurred alongside high community spread and at near capacity, making it difficult to meet social distancing recommendations. Using event-study models and hand-collected instruction modality and start dates for all school districts, we find robust evidence that reopening Texas schools gradually but substantially accelerated the community spread of COVID-19. Results from our preferred specification imply that school reopenings led to at least 43,000 additional COVID-19 cases and 800 additional fatalities within the first two months. We then use SafeGraph mobility data to provide evidence that spillovers to adults’ behaviors contributed to these large effects. Median time spent outside the home on a typical weekday increased substantially in neighborhoods with large numbers of school-age children, suggesting a return to in-person work or increased outside-of-home leisure activities among parents.

10.3386/w28753.abstractZh: 本文探讨了2020年秋季德克萨斯州学校重新开放对县级COVID-19病例和死亡人数的影响。先前的研究表明，如果社区传播程度较低且遵循公共卫生指南，学校可以安全地重新开放。然而，在德克萨斯州，学校重新开放往往伴随着严重的社区传播，且学校接近满负荷运转，这使得遵守社交距离建议变得困难。通过事件研究模型以及手工收集的各学区的开学时间数据，我们发现学校重新开放显著加速了COVID-19在社区中的传播。我们的分析结果表明，学校重新开放在最初的两个月内导致了至少43,000例新的COVID-19病例和800例额外的死亡。随后，我们使用SafeGraph的移动性数据来证实，对成人行为的溢出效应也加剧了这些影响。在拥有大量学龄儿童的社区，典型工作日的家庭外出时间显著增加，这表明家长重新恢复了面对面工作或增加了户外的休闲活动。

abstract.text: Pharmaceutical innovation policy involves managing a tradeoff between high prices for new products in the short-term and stronger incentives to develop products for the future. Prior research has documented a causal relationship between market size and pharmaceutical research and development (R&D) activities. The existing literature, however, provides no evidence of how this relationship varies across markets. We investigate whether recent expansions in state Medicaid programs caused an increase in R&D. We find no evidence of a response, potentially a result of Medicaid’s low reimbursement for pharmaceuticals, suggesting low(er) price markets may have different dynamics with respect to innovation policy.

10.3386/w28755.abstractZh: 药品创新政策涉及在短期内为新产品设定高价格与为未来产品开发提供更强激励之间的权衡。先前的研究已经证明了市场规模与药品研发活动之间的因果关系。然而，现有文献并未提供关于这种关系在不同市场中的变化情况的证据。我们调查了州级医疗补助计划的最近扩展是否导致了研发活动的增加。我们发现没有证据表明存在这种反应，这可能是由于医疗补助对药品支付的较低费用所致，这表明价格较低的市场在创新政策方面可能具有不同的动态特征。

abstract.text: I use a model of private and public behavior to mitigate disease transmission during the COVID pandemic over the past year in the United States to address two questions: What dynamics of infections and deaths should we expect to see from a pandemic? What are our options for mitigating the impact of a pandemic on public health? I find that behavior turns what would be a short and extremely sharp epidemic into a long, drawn out one. Absent the development of a technological solution such as vaccines or life-saving therapeutics, additional public health interventions suffer from rapidly diminishing returns in improving long-run outcomes. In contrast, rapidly implemented non-pharmaceutical interventions, in combination with the rapid development of technological solutions, could have saved nearly 300,000 lives relative to what is now projected to occur.

10.3386/w28760.abstractZh: 我使用私人与公共行为模型来分析过去一年美国在COVID疫情期间疾病传播的状况，以探讨两个问题：从疫情中我们应该预期看到怎样的感染和死亡动态？我们有哪些措施可以减轻疫情对公共卫生的影响？我发现，行为因素使得原本会迅速蔓延的疫情变成了长期持续的过程。如果没有开发出疫苗或救命疗法等技术方案，额外的公共卫生干预措施在改善长期结果方面会迅速出现收益递减的现象。相比之下，迅速实施的非药物干预措施，结合技术解决方案的快速开发，可以挽救近30万人的生命，相对于目前预计的情况而言。

abstract.text: Recent expansions of Medicaid eligibility have come with increased experimentation with enrollee cost-sharing. In this paper, we exploit a discontinuous premium increase at the federal poverty level in Michigan’s Medicaid expansion program to test low-income individuals’ sensitivity to premiums using linked enrollment and claims data. At the cutoff, average premiums increase by $3.15 and the probability of disenrollment increases by 2.3 percentage points. Increased disenrollment occurs among those with fewer documented medical needs at baseline, but not among those with greater medical needs. These results suggest healthier low-income individuals may be sensitive to even modest health insurance premiums, and that premiums may induce adverse selection in Medicaid plans.

10.3386/w28762.abstractZh: 最近，医疗补助资格范围的扩大伴随着对参保者费用分担方式的更多尝试。在本文中，我们利用密歇根州医疗补助扩展计划在联邦贫困线处保费不连续增加的特点，通过关联参保和理赔数据来测试低收入人群对保费变化的敏感度。在贫困线处，平均保费增加了3.15美元，退保的概率增加了2.3个百分点。退保现象更多地发生在那些在基线时医疗需求较少的人群中，而不是那些医疗需求较多的人群中。这些结果表明，健康状况较好的低收入人群可能对即使是适度的医疗保险保费也较为敏感，并且保费可能会导致医疗补助计划中的逆向选择现象。

abstract.text: Gun buyback programs (GBPs), which use public funds to purchase civilians' privately-owned firearms, aim to reduce gun violence. However, next to nothing is known about their effects on firearm-related crime or deaths. Using data from the National Incident Based Reporting System, we find no evidence that GBPs reduce gun crime. Given our estimated null findings, with 95 percent confidence, we can rule out decreases in firearm-related crime of greater than 1.1 percent during the year following a buyback. Using data from the National Vital Statistics System, we also find no evidence that GBPs reduce suicides or homicides where a firearm was involved. These results call into question the efficacy of city gun buyback programs in their current form.

10.3386/w28763.abstractZh: 枪支回购计划通过公共资金购买平民私有的枪支，旨在减少枪支暴力。然而，关于这些计划对与枪支相关的犯罪或死亡人数的影响，我们几乎一无所知。根据全国事件报告系统的数据，我们没有发现枪支回购计划能减少枪支犯罪。基于我们估计的零结果，我们有95%的置信度可以排除在回购后一年内与枪支相关的犯罪减少超过1.1%的可能性。同时，根据全国生命统计系统的数据，我们也没有发现枪支回购计划能减少涉及枪支的自杀或杀人事件。这些结果质疑了当前形式的城市枪支回购计划的有效性。

abstract.text: Why do cities differ so much in productivity? A long literature has sought out systematic sources, such as inherent productivity advantages, market access, agglomeration forces, or sorting. We document that up to three quarters of the measured regional productivity dispersion is spurious, reflecting the “luck of the draw” of finite counts of idiosyncratically heterogeneous plants that happen to operate in a given location. The patterns are even more pronounced for new plants, hold for alternative productivity measures, and broadly extend to European countries. This large role for individual plants suggests a smaller role for places in driving regional differences.

10.3386/w28772.abstractZh: 为什么城市在生产力方面存在如此大的差异？大量文献试图寻找系统性的原因，例如固有的生产力优势、市场准入、集聚效应或排序效应。我们发现，高达四分之三的实测区域生产力差异是虚假的，这反映了在给定地点运营的具有独特异质性的工厂数量有限，从而导致了“抽签运气”的结果。这种差异在新工厂中更为明显，适用于其他生产力指标，并且这种现象广泛存在于欧洲国家。个体工厂在生产力差异中的重要作用表明，地方在驱动区域差异方面的作用相对较小。

abstract.text: We study the welfare effects of offering choice over coverage levels—“vertical choice”—in regulated health insurance markets. We emphasize that heterogeneity in the efficient level of coverage is not sufficient to motivate choice. When premiums do not reflect individuals' costs, it may not be in consumers' best interest to select their efficient coverage level. We show that vertical choice is efficient only if consumers with higher willingness to pay for insurance have a higher efficient level of coverage. We investigate this condition empirically and find that as long as a minimum coverage level can be enforced, the welfare gains from vertical choice are either zero or economically small.

10.3386/w28779.abstractZh: 我们研究了在受监管的医疗保险市场中，提供选择而非覆盖水平这一做法对福利的影响。我们强调，覆盖效率的异质性不足以成为选择动机的足够理由。当保费未能反映个人的实际成本时，消费者选择其最合理的覆盖水平可能并不符合自身利益。我们指出，只有当愿意为保险支付更高费用的消费者能够获得更高效率的覆盖水平时，垂直选择才具有效率。我们通过实证研究验证了这一条件，发现只要能够强制执行最低覆盖水平，垂直选择的福利收益要么为零，要么在经济上微不足道。

abstract.text: We exploit novel data from brain-training games to examine the impacts of air pollution on a comprehensive set of cognitive skills in adults. We find that exposure to particulate matter (PM2.5) impairs adult cognitive function, and that these effects are largest for those in prime working age. These results confirm a hypothesized mechanism for the impacts of air pollution on workforce productivity. We also find that the cognitive effects are largest for new tasks and for those with low ability, suggesting that air pollution increases inequality in productivity.

10.3386/w28785.abstractZh: 我们利用脑训练游戏中的新颖数据，来研究空气污染对成年人一系列认知技能的影响。研究发现，接触颗粒物（PM2.5）会损害成年人的认知功能，且这种影响在处于最佳工作年龄的人群中最为显著。这些结果证实了空气污染对劳动力生产力影响的假设机制。我们还发现，认知效应在新任务中最为明显，而对于能力较低的人群来说，空气污染加剧了生产力上的不平等。

abstract.text: According to the World Health Organization, obesity is one of the greatest public-health challenges of the 21st century. Body weight is also known to affect individuals’ self-esteem and interpersonal relationships, including romantic ones. We estimate “utility-maximizing” Body Mass Index (BMI) and calculate the implied monetary value of changes in both individual and spousal BMI, using the compensating income variation method and data from the Swiss Household Panel. Two-stage least squares models are estimated for women and men separately, with mother’s education as an instrument to account for the potential endogeneity in income. Results suggest that the optimal own BMI is 27.4 and 22.7 for men and women, respectively. The annual value of reaching optimal weight ranges from $3,235 for underweight women to $32,378 for obese women and from $19,088 for underweight men to $43,175 for obese men. Women on average value changes in their own BMI about three times higher than changes in their spouse’s BMI. Men, on the other hand, value a reduction in their spouse’s BMI almost twice as much compared to a reduction in their own BMI.

10.3386/w28791.abstractZh: 根据世界卫生组织的数据，肥胖是21世纪最大的公共卫生挑战之一。体重还会影响个人的自尊心和人际关系，包括恋爱关系。我们估算了“效用最大化”的体重指数（BMI），并使用瑞士家庭面板数据，计算了个体和配偶BMI变化所带来的货币价值。我们分别对女性和男性进行了两阶段最小二乘法模型估计，并采用母亲的教育水平作为工具变量，以控制收入的潜在内生性。结果表明，女性的最佳体重指数为27.4，男性为22.7。达到最佳体重所需的年度费用分别为：体重过轻的女性为3,235美元，肥胖的女性为32,378美元；体重过轻的男性为19,088美元，肥胖的男性为43,175美元。女性对自身BMI变化的重视程度平均是配偶BMI变化的三倍左右。而男性则对配偶BMI的降低价值的重视程度几乎是自身BMI降低价值的两倍。

abstract.text: In the midst of mass COVID-19 vaccination distribution efforts in the U.S., Texas became the first state to abolish its mask mandate and fully lift capacity constraints for all businesses, effective on March 10, 2021. Proponents claimed that the reopening would generate short-run employment growth and signal a return to normal while opponents argued that it would cause a resurgence of COVID-19 and kill Texans. This study finds that each side was largely incorrect. First, using daily anonymized smartphone data — and synthetic control and difference-in-differences approaches — we find no evidence that the Texas reopening led to substantial changes in mobility, including foot traffic at a wide set of business establishments. Second, we find no evidence that the Texas reopening affected the rate of new COVID-19 cases or deaths during the five weeks following the reopening. Our null results persist across more urbanized and less urbanized counties, as well as across counties that supported Donald Trump and Joe Biden in the 2020 presidential election. Finally, we find no evidence that the Texas reopening impacted short-run employment, including in industries most affected by the reopening. Together, these findings underscore the persistence of late-pandemic era private behavior and stickiness in individuals’ risk-related beliefs, and suggest that reopening policies may have impacts that are more muted than policymakers expect.

10.3386/w28804.abstractZh: 在美国大规模COVID-19疫苗接种工作的进行中，德克萨斯州成为第一个废除口罩强制要求并完全解除所有企业限制措施的州，这一措施于2021年3月10日生效。支持者认为，重新开放将促进短期就业增长，并标志着恢复正常状态的开始；而反对者则认为，这将导致COVID-19的再次爆发，并危及德克萨斯州民众的生命安全。本研究发现，双方的看法大多是错误的。首先，通过每日匿名智能手机数据以及合成控制和差异估计方法，我们没有发现德克萨斯州重新开放导致出行方式发生显著变化的证据，包括各类商业场所的步行流量。其次，我们没有发现德克萨斯州重新开放在重新开放后的五周内对新增COVID-19病例或死亡人数产生影响的证据。我们的零假设结果在更城市化以及较不城市化的县中依然成立，同样在2020年总统选举中支持唐纳德·特朗普和乔·拜登的县中也是如此。最后，我们没有发现德克萨斯州重新开放对短期就业产生影响的证据，包括在受重新开放影响最大的行业。这些发现强调了疫情后期私人行为的持久性以及个人对风险相关信念的粘性，并表明重新开放政策的影响可能比政策制定者预期的要温和。

abstract.text: The onset of a disability or major health shock can affect the labor supply of not only those experiencing the event but also their family members. Potential caregivers face a tradeoff between time spent earning income for the family and providing care for their spouse, which could be affected by the availability of paid leave. We examine caregiving and labor supply decisions after a spouse’s disability or health shock and the role of paid leave laws implemented in California and New Jersey in the response using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). We show that labor force participation of potential caregivers decreased after spousal work-limiting disability or chronic health condition and, to a lesser extent, work-limiting illness. We find that paid leave reduces the likelihood that potential caregivers decrease their work hours to provide caregiving to their spouse after a work-limiting disability or chronic health condition, but limited evidence of effects on other employment outcomes. Our findings demonstrate that spousal disability and health shocks have long-run effects on household labor supply and therefore could be mediated by paid leave; we conclude by discussing possible reasons for finding limited impact in this context.

10.3386/w28808.abstractZh: 残疾或重大健康危机的发生不仅会影响遭遇此类事件的人本身的劳动力供应，还会影响其家庭成员的劳动力供应。潜在的照顾者面临着在为家庭赚取收入和照顾配偶之间做出权衡的问题，而这一权衡可能受到带薪休假政策的影响。我们通过《收入与计划参与调查》的数据，研究了配偶因残疾或健康危机而需要照顾时，潜在照顾者的照顾决策以及加利福尼亚州和新泽西州实施的带薪休假政策在其中的作用。研究发现，在配偶因残疾或慢性健康状况而需要照顾时，潜在照顾者的劳动力参与率下降，而在因工作限制性疾病需要照顾时，这一影响则较小。研究还发现，带薪休假可以降低潜在照顾者在因残疾或慢性健康状况而需要照顾时减少工作时间的可能性，但关于其对其他就业结果的影响，研究证据有限。我们的研究结果表明，配偶的残疾和健康危机对家庭劳动力供应有长期影响，因此带薪休假政策可能起到调节作用；最后，我们讨论了在这一背景下影响有限的原因。

abstract.text: Using a randomized field experiment, we show that health care specialists cream-skim patients by their expected profitability. In the German two-tier system, outpatient reimbursement rates for both public and private insurance are centrally determined but are significantly higher for the privately insured. In our field experiment, following a standardized protocol, the same hypothetical patient called 991 private practices in 36 German counties to schedule appointments for allergy tests, hearing tests and gastroscopies. Practices were 4% more likely to offer an appointment to the privately insured. Conditional on being offered an appointment, wait times for the publicly insured were twice as long than for the privately insured. We also find smaller access differences when reimbursement rate differences are smaller. Our findings show that structural differences in reimbursement rates lead to structural differences in health care access.

10.3386/w28809.abstractZh: 通过随机实地实验，我们发现医疗专家会根据预期盈利能力来区别对待患者。在德国的两级医疗体系中，公共和私人保险患者的门诊报销率由中央部门确定，但私人保险患者的报销率明显更高。在我们的实地实验中，按照标准化协议，我们将同一假设患者联系了德国36个县的991家私人诊所，以预约进行过敏测试、听力测试和胃镜检查。与私人保险患者相比，私人诊所提供预约的可能性高出4%。在获得预约的情况下，公共保险患者的等待时间是最少预约患者的两倍。我们还发现，当报销率差异较小时，患者获取服务的机会差异也较小。我们的研究结果表明，报销率的结构性差异导致了医疗服务获取上的结构性差异。

abstract.text: Standard measures of bodyweight (overweight and obese, for example) fail to reflect technological progress over time - and in particular, recent progress disproportionately promoting longevity at higher bodyweights (and differences in access to it). This paper builds on the pioneering work of Hans Waaler (Waaler, 1984) and Robert Fogel (Fogel, 1994) to empirically estimate how technological progress, and differential access to it, have fundamentally transformed the relationship between body mass index (BMI) and longevity in high-, middle-, and low-income countries. Importantly, we show that the combined effect of technological progress and access to it across countries is so profound that the share of national populations above mortality-minimizing bodyweight is not clearly greater in countries with higher overweight and obesity rates (as traditionally defined) - and in fact, relative to current standards, a larger share of low-income countries’ populations can be unhealthily heavy.

10.3386/w28813.abstractZh: 标准的体重测量指标（如超重和肥胖）无法反映时代的技术进步——尤其是，最近的技术进步在较高体重的人群中促进了更长的寿命（以及获取技术的差异）。本文基于Hans Waaler（Waaler, 1984）和Robert Fogel（Fogel, 1994）的开创性研究，通过实证分析技术进步的推进以及获取技术的差异如何从根本上改变了高、中、低收入国家中体重指数与寿命之间的关系。重要的是，我们发现技术进步的累积效应以及各国获取技术的差异非常显著，以至于在传统定义的超重和肥胖率较高的国家，达到最小化死亡率所需体重的比例并不明显更高——实际上，相对于当前标准，低收入国家中相当大比例的人口体重可能处于不健康水平。

abstract.text: Unlike demand studies in other industries, models of provider demand in health care often must omit a price or any other factor that equilibrates the market. Estimates of the consumer response to quality may consequently be attenuated, if the limited capacity of individual providers prevents some consumers from obtaining higher quality. We propose a tractable method to address this problem by adding a congestion effect to standard discrete-choice models. We show analytically how this improves forecasts of the consumer response to quality. We then apply this method to the market for heart surgery, and find that the attenuation bias in estimated quality effects can be important empirically.

10.3386/w28817.abstractZh: 与其他行业的需求研究不同，医疗保健领域提供者的需求模型通常必须忽略价格或任何其他平衡市场的因素。如果个别提供者的有限能力导致一些消费者无法获得更高质量的服务，那么对消费者对质量反应的估计可能会减弱。我们提出了一种可行的方法，通过向标准离散选择模型中添加拥堵效应来解决这个问题。我们从理论上证明了这种方法如何改善对消费者对质量反应的预测。然后，我们将这种方法应用于心脏手术市场，发现估计的质量效应中的衰减偏差在实证上可能非常重要。

abstract.text: Starting in 2009, the German state of Saxony distributed sports club membership vouchers among all 33,000 third graders in the state. The policy’s objective was to encourage them to develop a long-term habit of exercising. In 2018, we carried out a large register-based survey among several cohorts in Saxony and two neighboring states. Our difference-indifferences estimations show that, even after a decade, awareness of the voucher program was significantly higher in the treatment group. We also find that youth received and redeemed the vouchers. However, we do not find significant short- or long-term effects on sports club membership, physical activity, overweightness, or motor skills.

10.3386/w28819.abstractZh: 自2009年起，德国萨克森州向该州所有33,000名三年级学生发放了体育俱乐部会员券。该政策的目的是鼓励他们养成长期锻炼的习惯。2018年，我们在萨克森州及两个邻近州对多个群体进行了大规模的登记调查。我们的差异-无差异估计显示，即使经过十年时间，实验组对该会员券计划的认知程度仍然显著更高。我们还发现，青少年们确实收到了并使用了这些会员券。然而，我们并未发现其对体育俱乐部会员资格、身体活动量、超重情况或运动技能产生显著的短期或长期影响。

abstract.text: We examine an indirect but potentially deadly consequence of the “missing girls” phenomenon. A shortage of brides causes many parents with sons of marriageable age to work harder and seek higher-paying but potentially dangerous jobs. In response, employers invest less in workplace safety, which in turn increases work-related mortality. Drawing from a broad range of data sets and taking advantage of large regional and temporal variations in sex ratios in China, we demonstrate that in areas with a more severe shortage of young women, the parents with unmarried sons suffer a significantly higher incidence of accidental injuries and workplace deaths.

10.3386/w28830.abstractZh: 我们研究了“失踪女孩”现象的一个间接但可能致命的后果。新娘短缺导致许多有适婚儿子的父母不得不更加努力地工作，并寻求报酬更高但可能充满危险的工作。作为回应，雇主在工作场所安全方面的投入减少，这反过来又增加了与工作相关的死亡人数。通过利用大量数据集，并考虑到中国地区性和时间上的性别比例差异，我们发现，在年轻女性短缺更为严重的地区，没有结婚儿子的父母遭遇意外受伤和工作场所死亡的情况更为频繁。

abstract.text: As countries transition from facing COVID-19 vaccine supply shortfalls to requiring novel strategies to facilitate vaccination, modern retail chains—often designed and located to target particular demographic groups—are a potential vaccine delivery vehicle. Using geospatial data, we quantify the proximity to vaccines created by a U.S. federal program that distributes vaccines to commercial retail pharmacies. We then quantify the impact of a proposal to provide vaccines at Dollar General, a low-priced general merchandise retailer. We show that adding Dollar General to the federal program would substantially decrease the distance to vaccine sites for low-income and minority U.S. households.

10.3386/w28835.abstractZh: 随着各国从应对COVID-19疫苗供应短缺转向需要新的策略来促进疫苗接种，现代零售连锁店——这些连锁店通常设计和选址以针对特定人群——成为潜在的疫苗配送工具。利用地理空间数据，我们量化了美国联邦计划向商业零售药店分发疫苗所带来的疫苗距离缩短效果。接着，我们评估了在低价百货零售商Dollar General提供疫苗提案的影响。研究表明，将Dollar General纳入联邦计划将显著缩短低收入和少数族裔美国家庭到疫苗站点的距离。

abstract.text: In 2001, a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, while persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.

10.3386/w28848.abstractZh: 2001年，一次大规模且持续的供应冲击成功遏制了澳大利亚的海洛因泛滥。我们通过毒品犯罪数据来识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并研究这一冲击在接下来的八年中对他们的死亡风险和犯罪活动的影响。起初，因 overdose次数减少而带来的好处被药物替代疗法和更多犯罪活动所抵消，其中包括凶杀案。大多数负面影响随着时间的推移逐渐消失，而持续的死亡人数减少则使样本中大约每48个人中就有1个人的生命得以挽救。我们的研究结果表明，即使短期效果不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供应也能带来有意义的长期改善。

abstract.text: The public debate over disability insurance has centered on concerns about individuals without severe health conditions receiving benefits. We go beyond health risk alone to quantify the overall insurance value of U.S. disability programs, including value from insuring non-health risk. We find that disability recipients, especially those with less-severe health conditions, are much more likely to have experienced a wide variety of non-health shocks than non-recipients. Selection into disability receipt on the basis of non-health shocks is so strong among individuals with less-severe health conditions that by many measures less-severe recipients are worse off than more-severe recipients. As a result, under baseline assumptions, benefits to less-severe recipients have an annual surplus value (insurance benefit less efficiency cost) over cost-equivalent tax cuts of $7,700 per recipient, about three-fourths that of benefits to more-severe recipients ($9,900). Insurance against non-health risk accounts for about one-half of the value of U.S. disability programs.

10.3386/w28852.abstractZh: 关于残疾保险的公共讨论主要集中在没有严重健康状况的个体能否获得福利的问题上。我们不仅关注健康风险，还试图量化美国残疾保险计划的整体价值，包括非健康风险方面的价值。我们发现，残疾受益人，尤其是那些健康状况不太严重的个体，比非受益人更有可能经历各种非健康冲击。在健康状况不太严重的个体中，基于非健康冲击选择成为残疾受益人的情况非常普遍，以至于在许多指标上，健康状况不太严重的受益人的状况比健康状况更严重的受益人更差。因此，在基本假设下，对于健康状况不太严重的受益人来说，每年的福利价值（保险收益减去效率成本）比同等成本的减税多出7,700美元，约为健康状况更严重受益人的福利价值（9,900美元）的四分之三。针对非健康风险的保险约占美国残疾保险计划总价值的二分之一。

abstract.text: The organizational structure of U.S. health care markets has changed dramatically in recent years, with nearly half of physicians now employed by hospitals. This trend toward increasing vertical alignment between physicians and hospitals may alter physician behavior relative to physicians remaining in independent or group practices. We examine the effects of such vertical alignment using an instrumental variable strategy and a clinical context facilitating well-defined episodes of care in order to capture effects of integration beyond a single hospital or physician visit. When physicians treat patients at hospitals in which they are integrated, we find increases in total episode spending of around 5%, primarily driven by the administrative substitution of office visits with outpatient visits and associated site-of-care payment differentials. We also estimate a large and statistically significant reduction in overall service counts and claims within an episode, with some evidence of an increase in the intensity of services provided. Ultimately, acquiring hospitals capture more revenue following a physician practice acquisition; yet, the smaller overall bundle of care generates no net savings to Medicare due partly to higher intensity of services as well as site-based payment rules favorable to hospitals.

10.3386/w28859.abstractZh: 近年来，美国医疗保健市场的组织结构发生了显著变化，现在近一半的医生受雇于医院。这种医生与医院之间垂直联系日益紧密的趋势，可能会改变医生的行为，使他们更倾向于留在独立执业或团队执业中。我们采用工具变量策略，并结合临床背景来研究这种垂直联系的影响，以便捕捉超出单一医院或医生就诊的整合效应。研究发现，当医生在与其有联系的医院为患者治疗时，总治疗费用会增加约5%，这主要源于门诊就诊的行政替代以及相关的治疗地点支付差异。我们还估计，在单次治疗过程中，服务次数和索赔金额会显著减少，同时提供的服务强度有所增加。最终，医院收购后能够获取更多的收入；然而，整体护理包的大小较小，对Medicare而言并没有净节省，部分原因是服务强度更高，以及基于治疗地点的支付规则对医院更有利。

abstract.text: The continuing drug overdose crisis in the U.S. has highlighted the urgent need for greater access to treatment. This paper examines the impact of openings and closings of substance abuse treatment facilities in New Jersey on emergency room visits for substance abuse issues among nearby residents. We find that drug-related ER visits increase by 16.6% after a facility closure and decrease by 9.5% after an opening. The effects are largest in relatively under-served areas, among Black residents, and among males. They are smaller for the middle aged than for either younger or older people. The results suggest that expanding access to treatment results in significant reductions in morbidity related to drug abuse.

10.3386/w28862.abstractZh: 美国持续存在的药物过量危机凸显了增加治疗机会的紧迫性。本文研究了新泽西州物质滥用治疗机构关闭和重新开放对附近居民因物质滥用问题前往急诊室就诊情况的影响。研究发现，在机构关闭后，与药物相关的急诊就诊次数增加了16.6%，而在机构重新开放后则减少了9.5%。这种影响在服务相对不足的地区、黑人居民以及男性中最为明显。对于中年人来说，这种影响较小，而年轻人和老年人则更为明显。结果表明，扩大治疗机会可以显著减少与药物滥用相关的发病率。

abstract.text: Health-maximizing and welfare-maximizing behaviors can be at odds, especially among disadvantaged groups, which can contribute to health disparities. To investigate this point, we estimate a lifecycle model of medication and labor supply decisions using data on HIV-positive men. We use the model to evaluate the disparate consequences of an effective HIV treatment innovation that had harsh side effects: HAART. Measured in lifetime utility gains, HAART disproportionately benefited patients with more education. Lower-educated men were more likely to avoid HAART due to its side effects that interfered with work. To illustrate the wedge between health and welfare, we simulate the effects of a HAART treatment mandate, which mimics assignment to treatment in a clinical trial. The mandate improves health, which would be viewed as a success in a randomized trial. However, clinical trials, which often focus solely on health outcomes, can mask downsides of the treatment including its distributional consequences: the mandate increases inequality as measured by lifetime welfare because lower-educated men are more likely to stop working due to HAART-induced side effects. In contrast, a counterfactual policy simulation that provides a non-labor income subsidy increases HAART adoption and improves health, especially among lower-education individuals. Broadly, our study illustrates that the evaluation of medical innovations may be incomplete absent an understanding of their distributional consequences across different groups of patients.

10.3386/w28864.abstractZh: 健康最大化与福利最大化行为可能会相互冲突，尤其是在弱势群体之间，这可能会导致健康差异的出现。为了研究这一点，我们基于HIV阳性男性的数据，建立了一个关于药物使用和生育决策的生命周期模型。我们利用该模型来评估一种具有严重副作用的有效HIV治疗创新——HAART所带来的不同影响。从终身效用收益来看，HAART对受教育程度较高的患者带来了更大的益处。而受教育程度较低的男性则更可能因为副作用而避免使用HAART，因为这些副作用会干扰他们的工作。为了说明健康与福利之间的差距，我们模拟了HAART治疗强制实施的效果，这一模拟类似于临床试验中的治疗分配。强制实施治疗可以改善健康状况，这在随机试验中被视为一种成功。然而，临床试验通常只关注健康结果，可能会掩盖治疗的负面影响，包括其分配后果：由于受教育程度较低的男性更可能因为HAART引起的副作用而停止工作，强制实施治疗会导致不平等加剧，因为终身福利会因此下降。相比之下，如果实施一项提供非劳动收入补贴的反事实政策，可以增加HAART的采用率并改善健康状况，尤其是在受教育程度较低的个体中。总体而言，我们的研究表明，如果不了解医疗创新在不同患者群体中的分配后果，那么对医疗创新的评估可能是不完整的。

abstract.text: A small number of pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) dominate the market for branded pharmaceuticals in the United States, but they are controversial, and their economic significance is poorly understood. Large PBMs are market intermediaries. They are also a common agent operating formularies on behalf of various third-party payers. We present a model that captures these dual roles and also clarifies the economics of drug rebates. We find that PBM-run formularies enhance the efficiency of drug markets, but when PBMs are highly concentrated these gains accrue to PBMs rather than consumers or drug makers. We also identify threats to formulary efficiency including most favored nation agreements between drug makers and PBMs and the strategic setting of high list prices by drug makers. Our model also offers insights into current market structures and a framework for assessing market reforms.

10.3386/w28866.abstractZh: 在美国，少数几家药品福利管理公司主导着品牌药品市场，但它们存在争议，其经济意义也尚未得到充分理解。大型药品福利管理公司是市场中介，同时也是代表各种第三方支付机构运营处方药的常见代理形式。我们提出了一个模型，该模型既涵盖了这些双重角色，又阐明了药品回扣的经济机制。研究发现，由药品福利管理公司运营的处方制度确实提高了药品市场的效率，但当药品福利管理公司高度集中时，这些收益反而归这些公司所有，而非消费者或药品制造商。我们还指出了影响处方制度效率的威胁因素，包括药品制造商与药品福利管理公司之间的最惠国协议，以及药品制造商设定的高定价策略。我们的模型还提供了对当前市场结构的洞察，并为评估市场改革提供了框架。

abstract.text: A key approach used by federal governments to address public health issues is to allocate federal funds to support local responses, but little is known about the effectiveness of this approach for improving health. This study examines the impact of federal public health funds allocated to U.S. cities through the U.S. government’s primary mechanism for combating HIV/AIDS for the past three decades. The empirical approach identifies the impact of this funding by studying funding variation that comes from policy features that resulted in large funding differences among cities that were originally on parallel HIV/AIDS trajectories. The findings indicate that an HIV/AIDS death has been prevented for every $334,000 allocated through the city-level funding and that the $19 billion allocated to cities through this program through 2018 has saved approximately 57,000 lives, which represents over $560 billion of value in terms of lives saved assuming a value of a statistical life of $10 million. The findings also indicate that funding differences across cities have been a major contributor to the uneven progress in combating HIV/AIDS currently observed across the United States that has alarmed public health leaders. Thus, while this analysis supports allocating federal funds to local areas as part of a public health strategy, these funds being effective demonstrates how sustained differences in areas’ receipt of federal public health funds can contribute to the development of health disparities across areas, as has occurred with HIV/AIDS.

10.3386/w28867.abstractZh: 联邦政府解决公共卫生问题的一个关键方法是分配联邦资金以支持地方应对，但关于这种方法在改善健康方面的有效性知之甚少。本研究考察了过去三十年中，通过美国政府的主要机制分配给美国各城市的联邦公共卫生资金的影响。通过实证研究，研究者分析了由于政策因素导致的资金差异，这些差异使得原本处于相同HIV/AIDS发展轨迹的城市之间出现了巨大的资金差异。研究结果表明，每通过城市级资金分配334,000美元，就能防止一例HIV/AIDS死亡。截至2018年，通过这一计划分配给城市的190亿美元资金，大约挽救了57,000条生命，这意味着以每统计生命价值1000万美元计算，这些资金挽救了超过5600亿美元的生命。研究还表明，城市之间资金差异是导致美国各地在抗击HIV/AIDS方面进展不均的主要原因之一，这一情况引起了公共卫生领导者的警觉。因此，虽然这项分析支持将联邦资金分配给地方作为公共卫生策略的一部分，但资金的有效性表明，不同地区在获得联邦公共卫生资金方面的差异可能会加剧地区间的健康差异，正如HIV/AIDS的情况所发生的那样。

abstract.text: The fourfold increase in opioid deaths between 2000 and 2017 rivals even the COVID-19 pandemic as a health crisis for America. Why did it happen? Measures of demand for pain relief – physical pain and despair – are high and in many cases rising, but their increase was nowhere near as large as the increase in deaths. The primary shift is in supply, primarily of new forms of allegedly safer narcotics. These new pain relievers flowed in greater volume to areas with more physical pain and mental health impairment, but since their apparent safety was an illusion, opioid deaths followed. By the end of the 2000s, restrictions on legal opioids led to further supply-side innovations which created the burgeoning illegal market that accounts for the bulk of opioid deaths today. Because opioid use is easier to start than end, America’s opioid epidemic is likely to persist for some time.

10.3386/w28873.abstractZh: 2000年至2017年间，阿片类药物相关死亡人数增加了四倍，这一数字甚至超过了COVID-19疫情对美国造成的健康危机。为什么会这样呢？对止痛需求——包括身体疼痛和绝望情绪——非常高，在许多情况下还在上升，但其增长幅度远不及死亡人数的增长幅度。主要的变化在于供应方面，主要是新型、所谓更安全的麻醉品的供应增加。这些新的止痛药物大量流向了那些身体疼痛和精神健康状况较差的地区，但由于其所谓的安全性其实是一种幻觉，阿片类药物相关的死亡事件也随之增加。到2000年代末，对合法阿片类药物的限制导致了供应方面的进一步创新，从而催生了非法市场，而这一非法市场正是当今阿片类药物相关死亡事件的主要来源。由于开始使用阿片类药物比停止使用要容易，美国的阿片类药物危机可能会持续一段时间。

abstract.text: Social learning is the updating of beliefs based on the observation of others. It can lead to efficient aggregation of information, but also to inaccurate decisions, fragility of mass behaviors, and, in the case of information cascades, to complete blockage of learning. We review the theory of information cascades and social learning, and discuss important themes, insights and applications of this literature as it has developed over the last thirty years. We also highlight open questions and promising directions for further theoretical and empirical exploration.

10.3386/w28887.abstractZh: 社会学习是指基于观察他人而更新信念的过程。它既能实现信息的有效聚合，也可能导致错误的决策、群体行为的脆弱性，在信息级联的情况下，甚至会导致学习的完全阻断。我们回顾了信息级联理论和社会学习理论，并讨论了过去三十年中这些理论的重要主题、见解和应用。同时，我们也指出了尚未解决的问题以及未来理论和实证探索的潜在方向。

abstract.text: Regulatory review is often seen as a barrier to innovation, increasing costs and delaying new medicines. Yet approval may also expand markets by certifying quality and reducing uncertainty. We test this by studying FDA approval for follow-on indications—uses that physicians could already prescribe “off-label”—and find approval raises use in newly approved diseases by 25 percent within a year, with larger increases in smaller off-label markets. Subsequent approvals in the same disease yield smaller gains. Our results suggest regulatory approval of medicines expands market size by increasing demand, rather than easing insurer-imposed restrictions, revealing limits to market-based learning.

10.3386/w28889.abstractZh: 监管审查通常被视为创新的障碍，会增加成本并推迟新药的上市。然而，审批也可以通过认证质量和减少不确定性来扩大市场。我们通过研究FDA对后续适应症的药物审批情况来验证这一点——这些适应症是医生已经可以“超说明书使用”的适应症——发现审批后，新获批疾病的使用量在一年内增加了25%，而在较小的超说明书使用市场中，增长幅度更大。对同一疾病后续的审批则带来较小的增长。我们的结果表明，药品的监管审批是通过增加需求来扩大市场规模，而不是缓解保险公司施加的限制，这揭示了基于市场的学习的局限性。

abstract.text: Many models from epidemiology are not designed to capture tradeoffs between health and economic well-being and few are equipped to predict how these tradeoffs interact with individuals’ preferences to influence behavior. Policies based on such models may not reflect societal preferences or capture how preferences affect behavior and disease spread. Models with epidemiological processes that do incorporate behavior change or health-wealth tradeoffs (mostly from economics) drastically limit individual-level heterogeneity to remain tractable. This makes it difficult to understand variation in behavioral responses and distributional consequences of the pandemic, which should be central to any evaluation of pandemic-related policy. Without the proper tools, we are unable to fully address even basic policy questions, such as whether the long-run effects of social-distancing justify the costs - and if so, for whom and under what circumstances. After reviewing modeling approaches from epidemiology and economics (among other fields), I propose a framework adapted from earlier work on the HIV/AIDS epidemic. Analysis of individual behavior is based on the idea that health is a form of human capital in which individuals invest through their choices. The model integrates individual level variation that other frameworks omit, but does so at the cost of drastically limiting aggregate economic and epidemiological processes. I conclude that what is needed is a multi-disciplinary effort that helps to bridge gaps across disciplines, which would amount to constructing models that capture key features of different approaches. To be useful in evaluating pandemic-related policy, such a model should have rich heterogeneity and capture how individual choices are linked to the broad contours of disease spread and aggregate economic output. Whether such an effort would be feasible and fruitful remains to be seen.

10.3386/w28898.abstractZh: 许多流行病学模型并未设计用于捕捉健康与经济福祉之间的权衡关系，而且很少有模型能够预测这些权衡如何与个体的偏好相互作用并影响行为。基于此类模型的政策可能无法反映社会偏好，也无法揭示偏好如何影响行为和疾病传播。那些包含行为变化或健康与财富权衡的流行病学模型（主要源自经济学领域）会极大地限制个体层面的异质性，使其难以处理。这使得我们难以理解行为反应的差异以及疫情带来的分配后果，而这些因素应该是评估疫情相关政策时的核心内容。如果没有适当的工具，我们甚至无法充分解决一些基本政策问题，比如社交距离的长期影响是否值得付出代价——如果值得，那么代价应该由谁承担，以及在什么情况下如此。在回顾了流行病学和经济学（以及其他领域）的建模方法之后，我提出了一种借鉴早期关于艾滋病疫情研究的框架。对个体行为的分析基于这样的理念：健康是一种人力资本，个体通过自己的选择来投入其中。该模型整合了其他框架所忽略的个体层面的异质性，但这样做会极大地限制总体经济和流行病学过程的处理能力。我得出结论，我们需要一个跨学科的努力，以弥合不同学科之间的差距，从而构建能够捕捉不同方法关键特征的模型。为了有效评估与疫情相关的政策，这样的模型应该具有丰富的异质性，并能够揭示个体选择如何与疾病传播的广泛趋势和总体经济产出相关联。这样的努力是否可行且能取得成效，还有待观察。

abstract.text: There are ongoing debates around the world over the value of private supplements to public health insurance systems. We investigate this issue in the context of one of the world’s deadliest diseases, diabetes, and one of the countries with the worst diabetes problems in the world, Mexico. We implement a novel deniers randomization approach to cost-effectively provide a causal estimate of enrollment in private supplement to the free public health system. Our final sample of more than 1000 diabetics randomized into a large price subsidy for enrollment in the private plan is well balanced. We estimate enormous impacts of the private supplement, with HbA1c blood sugar levels falling by a full point (relative to a control mean of 8.5%), and to increase the share of those treated who are under control by 69%. We show that this effect arises through both improved treatment compliance and health behaviors, and that diabetes complications fall even in the short run. The net costs of this intervention are at most one-third of the gross costs due to offsetting public sector savings, and the health benefits are many multiples of gross costs. But the returns to private care do not appear to reflect more productive delivery of care per visit, which is comparable in a separate quasi-experimental analysis of public insurance; rather, effects arise through more attachment to medical care in the private alternative.

10.3386/w28913.abstractZh: 全球范围内，关于私人补充保险对公共健康体系的价值一直存在争议。我们在世界上最致命的疾病之一——糖尿病的背景下，对这一问题进行了研究，而墨西哥则是全球糖尿病问题最严重的国家之一。我们采用了一种新颖的随机化方法，以成本效益的方式估算私人补充保险在公共健康体系中的普及情况。最终样本包含1000多名糖尿病患者，这些患者被随机分配到接受私人计划的价格补贴中。我们的样本具有很好的平衡性。我们估计，私人补充保险带来了巨大的影响：HbA1c血糖水平下降了整整一个单位（相对于对照组的平均水平为8.5%），同时使得到治患者的控制率提高了69%。我们发现，这种效果是通过改善治疗依从性和健康行为来实现的，即使在短期内，糖尿病并发症的发生率也有所下降。这种干预措施的净成本最多仅为公共部门节省成本的三分之一，而健康效益则是成本的许多倍。不过，私人护理的回报似乎并不体现在每次就诊时提供更高效的护理服务上，这一点在另一项关于公共保险的准实验分析中得到了验证；相反，这种效果是通过增加对私人医疗服务的依赖而产生的。

abstract.text: Innovation policy can be a crucial component of governments' responses to crises. Because speed is a paramount objective, crisis innovation may also require different policy tools than innovation policy in non-crisis times, raising distinct questions and tradeoffs. In this paper, we survey the U.S. policy response to two crises where innovation was crucial to a resolution: World War II and the COVID-19 pandemic. After providing an overview of the main elements of each of these efforts, we discuss how they compare, and to what degree their differences reflect the nature of the central innovation policy problems and the maturity of the U.S. innovation system. We then explore four key tradeoffs for crisis innovation policy—top-down vs. bottom-up priority setting, concentrated vs. distributed funding, patent policy, and managing disruptions to the innovation system—and provide a logic for policy choices. Finally, we describe the longer-run impacts of the World War II effort and use these lessons to speculate on the potential long-run effects of the COVID-19 crisis on innovation policy and the innovation system.

10.3386/w28915.abstractZh: 创新政策可以是政府应对危机时的关键组成部分。由于速度是一个首要目标，危机时期的创新可能需要不同于非危机时期创新政策的政策工具，这引发了不同的问题和权衡。在本文中，我们回顾了美国在两次危机中的政策应对，其中创新对于危机的解决至关重要：第二次世界大战和COVID-19疫情。在概述了每次应对的主要措施后，我们讨论了它们之间的差异，以及这些差异在多大程度上反映了核心创新政策问题的性质以及美国创新系统的成熟度。接着，我们探讨了危机创新政策的四个关键权衡——自上而下的与自下而上的优先级设定、集中式与分布式资金、专利政策以及管理对创新系统的干扰——并为政策选择提供了逻辑依据。最后，我们描述了第二次世界大战应对措施的长期影响，并利用这些经验推测COVID-19危机可能对创新政策和创新系统产生的长期影响。

abstract.text: Recent theoretical and empirical work characterizes attention as a limited resource that decision-makers strategically allocate. There has been less research on the dynamic interdependence of attention: how paying attention now may affect performance later. In this paper, we exploit high-frequency data on decision-making by Major League Baseball umpires to examine this. We find that umpires not only apply greater effort to higher-stakes decisions, but also that effort applied to earlier decisions increases errors later. These findings are consistent with the umpire having a depletable ‘budget’ of attention. There is no such dynamic interdependence after breaks during the game (at the end of each inning) suggesting that even short rest periods can replenish attention budgets. We also find that an expectation of higher stakes future decisions leads to reduced attention to current decisions, consistent with forward-looking behavior by umpires aware of attention scarcity.

10.3386/w28922.abstractZh: 近期的一些理论和实证研究表明，注意力是一种有限的资源，决策者会进行战略性的分配。然而，关于注意力动态相互依赖性的研究相对较少：即当前投入的注意力如何影响之后的表现。在本文中，我们利用美国职业棒球大联盟裁判的决策高频数据来研究这一问题。我们发现，裁判不仅在高风险决策上投入更多的精力，而且较早决策所投入的精力会导致之后的错误增加。这些发现与裁判拥有可消耗的“注意力预算”这一假设一致。但在比赛间歇期间（每局结束时），这种动态相互依赖性并不明显，这表明即使是短暂的休息也能补充注意力预算。我们还发现，对未来高风险决策的预期会导致对当前决策的注意力减少，这与裁判意识到注意力稀缺而采取前瞻性行为的表现一致。

abstract.text: In lower-income countries, the economic contractions that accompany lockdowns to contain the spread of COVID-19 can increase child mortality, counteracting the mortality reductions achieved by the lockdown. To formalize and quantify this effect, we build a macro-susceptible-infected-recovered model that features heterogeneous agents and a country-group-specific relationship between economic downturns and child mortality, and calibrate it to data for 85 countries across all income levels. We find that in low-income countries, a lockdown can potentially lead to 1.76 children's lives lost due to the economic contraction per COVID-19 fatality averted. The ratio stands at 0.59 and 0.06 in lower-middle and upper-middle income countries, respectively. As a result, in some countries lockdowns can actually produce net increases in mortality. In contrast, the optimal lockdown that maximizes the present value of aggregate social welfare is shorter and milder in poorer countries than in rich ones, and never produces a net mortality increase.

10.3386/w28925.abstractZh: 在低收入国家，为遏制COVID-19的传播而实施的封锁措施所带来的经济收缩可能会增加儿童死亡率，从而抵消封锁措施所实现的死亡率降低效果。为了形式化和量化这一效应，我们构建了一个宏观易感-感染-康复模型，该模型包含异质性主体，并考虑了经济衰退与儿童死亡率之间的国家群体特定关系。我们对85个不同收入水平的国家的数据进行了校准。研究发现，在低收入国家，一次封锁措施可能导致的儿童生命损失数量相当于每避免一个COVID-19死亡病例所带来的经济收缩损失1.76个儿童生命。在低中收入国家，这一比例分别为0.59和0.06。因此，在一些国家，封锁措施实际上可能导致死亡率的净增加。相比之下，在较贫穷的国家，实现社会总福利现值最大化的最佳封锁措施时间较短且力度较轻，且不会导致死亡率的净增加。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from 802,777 veterans assigned to 7,548 primary care providers (PCPs) within the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) to examine variations in the efficacy of primary care providers (PCPs), their consequences for health outcomes, and their determinants. Leveraging quasi-random assignment of veterans to PCPs, we measure PCP effectiveness along three dimensions: the probability their patients have subsequent hospitalizations for ambulatory care sensitive conditions (ACSC), subsequent hospitalizations or emergency department (ED) visits for mental health conditions, or hospitalizations/ED visits for circulatory conditions. We find a significant range in these measures across PCPs. For example, a one standard deviation improvement in our measure of mental health effectiveness predicts a 0.21 percentage point (3.8%) lower risk of patient death over the next three years and 4.4% lower total costs. We also find that patients whose physicians are better according to one dimension also have better outcomes in terms of the other dimensions we consider. Finally, we find that more effective PCPs do more with less: Their patients have fewer primary care visits, referrals to specialists, lab panels or imaging tests. Effective PCPs are slightly more likely to comply with guidelines for mental health screenings, and slightly less likely to comply with guidelines for physical health screenings, but these differences in screening propensities are negligible in magnitude.

10.3386/w28929.abstractZh: 本文利用来自802,777名退伍军人的数据，这些数据被分配到7,548名初级保健提供者手中，研究初级保健提供者在疗效上的差异、其对健康结果的影響以及其决定因素。通过准随机分配退伍军人与初级保健提供者，我们从三个维度衡量初级保健提供者的有效性：患者因门诊护理相关疾病再次住院的概率、因心理健康问题再次住院或急诊就诊的概率，以及因循环系统疾病而住院或急诊就诊的概率。我们发现不同初级保健提供者在这些指标上存在显著差异。例如，在心理健康疗效方面，一个标准差的提升可以预测患者在未来三年内死亡风险降低0.21个百分点（3.8%），并降低4.4%的总成本。我们还发现，在某一维度上表现更好的患者，在其他我们考虑的维度上也会取得更好的结果。最后，我们发现更有效的初级保健提供者能够用更少的资源完成更多的工作：他们的患者需要进行的初级保健就诊次数、转诊至专科医生、实验室检查或影像学检查的次数都较少。有效的初级保健提供者稍微更有可能遵守心理健康筛查的指南，而遵守身体健康筛查指南的可能性则稍低，但这些筛查倾向的差异在数量上可以忽略不计。

abstract.text: As a way of slowing COVID-19 transmission, many countries and U.S. states implemented shelter-in-place (SIP) policies. However, the effects of SIP policies on public health are a-priori ambiguous. Using an event study approach and data from 43 countries and all U.S. states, we measure changes in excess deaths following the implementation of COVID-19 shelter-in-place (SIP) policies. We do not find that countries or U.S. states that implemented SIP policies earlier had lower excess deaths. We do not observe differences in excess deaths before and after the implementation of SIP policies, even when accounting for pre-SIP COVID-19 death rates.

10.3386/w28930.abstractZh: 为了减缓COVID-19的传播，许多国家和美国各州实施了居家隔离政策。然而，这些政策对公共健康的影响尚不确定。我们采用事件研究法，利用43个国家和美国所有州的数据，来测量实施COVID-19居家隔离政策后超额死亡人数的变化。我们发现，那些较早实施居家隔离政策的国家或州，其超额死亡人数并没有减少。即使考虑到实施居家隔离政策前的COVID-19死亡率，我们也未能观察到实施政策前后超额死亡人数的差异。

abstract.text: We introduce a model of the diffusion of an epidemic with demographically heterogeneous agents interacting socially on a spatially structured network. Contagion-risk averse agents respond behaviorally to the diffusion of the infections by limiting their social interactions. Firms also respond by allowing employees to work remotely, depending on their productivity. The spatial structure induces local herd immunities along sociodemographic dimensions, which significantly affect the dynamics of infections. We study several non-pharmaceutical interventions; e.g., i) lockdown rules, which set thresholds on the spread of the infection for the closing and reopening of economic activities; and ii) selective lockdowns, which restrict social interactions by location (in the network) and by the demographic characteristics of the agents. Substantiating a “Lucas critique” argument, we assess the cost of naive discretionary policies ignoring agents and firms’ behavioral responses.

10.3386/w28932.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于流行病扩散的模型，其中具有人口异质性的个体在具有空间结构网络的平台上进行社会互动。厌恶传染风险的个体会通过限制社交互动来应对感染的扩散。企业也会根据员工的生产力情况，允许员工远程工作。空间结构会沿着社会人口学特征形成局部群体免疫，这显著影响了感染的动态变化。我们研究了几种非药物干预措施，例如：i) 封锁规则，这些规则设定了经济活动关闭和重新开放的感染传播阈值；以及ii) 选择性封锁，这些措施通过地理位置和个体的人口特征来限制社交互动。基于“卢卡斯批判”的论点，我们评估了忽视个体和企业行为反应的简单自由裁量政策的成本。

abstract.text: State governments face the classic “make or buy” decision for the provision of Medicaid services. Over the past two decades, the majority of states have outsourced the provision of social health insurance through Medicaid Managed Care (MMC) programs. These programs have been extensively studied in the literature – with little evidence of large positive or negative effects. However, most states initially allowed older and sicker enrollees to remain enrolled in the government run fee for service (FFS) programs. It is possible that these more fragile enrollees could have a different experience in managed care. In this paper we study California’s mandatory enrollment of the senior and persons with disabilities (SPD) population in MMC. We find this mandatory enrollment caused an increased use of the emergency department and transfers between hospitals. This was not simply a hassle cost for enrollees – we also estimate an increase in mortality for the affected population. These effects were strongest for the sickest enrollees – the types of enrollees that might be expected to have a different experience with managed care. Our results suggest the adverse impact of MMC varies by the enrollee health, which should inform the optimal outsourcing decision for governments.

10.3386/w28944.abstractZh: 州政府在提供医疗补助服务时面临“购买还是自建”的经典决策问题。过去二十年里，大多数州通过医疗补助管理计划外包了社会健康保险的服务。这些计划在文献中得到了广泛研究，但几乎没有证据表明它们会产生显著的积极或消极影响。然而，大多数州最初允许年龄较大和病情较重的参保者继续参加政府运营的按服务收费计划。这些较为脆弱的参保者可能在管理计划中会有不同的体验。本文研究了加利福尼亚州对老年人和残疾人的强制管理计划规定。我们发现，这一强制规定导致急诊部门的使用增加，并且患者之间的医院转院次数也增加了。这不仅仅是参保者面临的麻烦——我们还估计到受影响人群的死亡率有所上升。这些影响在病情最严重的参保者身上最为明显——这类参保者可能会有不同的管理计划体验。我们的研究结果表明，管理计划的负面影响因参保者的健康状况而异，这应该有助于政府做出最优的外包决策。

abstract.text: We measure inequities from the COVID-19 pandemic on mortality and hospitalizations in the United States during the early months of the outbreak. We discuss challenges in measuring health outcomes and health inequality, some of which are specific to COVID-19 and others that complicate attribution during most large health shocks. As in past epidemics, pre-existing biological and social vulnerabilities profoundly influenced the distribution of disease. In addition to the elderly, Hispanic, Black and Native American communities were disproportionately affected by the virus, particularly when assessed using the years of potential life lost metric. For example, Hispanic and Black Americans in 2020 saw 39.5 and 25 percent increases in excess mortality relative to trend, compared to a less than 15 percent increase for Whites; we find losses in potential years of life three to four times larger among Hispanic and Black compared to White Americans. Individual-level data from a commercially insured population show that otherwise similar Black and Hispanic enrollees were hospitalized due to COVID-19 at a higher rate than White enrollees. We provide a conceptual framework and initial empirical analysis which seek to shed light on contributors to pandemic-related health inequality, and suggest areas for future research.

10.3386/w28958.abstractZh: 我们通过对美国疫情初期阶段的死亡率和住院率进行衡量，来评估新冠疫情带来的不平等现象。我们讨论了衡量健康结果和健康不平等方面的挑战，其中一些挑战是新冠病毒特有的，另一些则会在大多数重大健康冲击中使归因变得复杂。与过去的疫情一样，先前的生物学和社会脆弱性对疾病的分布产生了深远影响。除了老年人之外，西班牙裔、黑人和美洲原住民社区受到病毒的影响尤为严重，尤其是在使用潜在生命年损失指标进行评估时。例如，2020年，西班牙裔和黑人的超额死亡率分别比趋势水平增加了39.5%和25%，而白人的超额死亡率则低于15%；我们发现，西班牙裔和黑人的潜在生命年损失是白人的三到四倍。来自商业保险人群的个体数据表明，在总体相似的情况下，黑人西班牙裔和西班牙裔参保者因新冠住院的比例高于白人参保者。我们提供了一个概念框架和初步的实证分析，旨在揭示导致疫情相关健康不平等的因素，并提出了未来研究的方向。

abstract.text: Taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) are relatively new and there is little evidence about their impact on SSB consumption or body mass index (as opposed to prices, purchases, or sales), their impact on youth (as opposed to on adults), or their impact in non-Western nations. This paper adds to the evidence base on all of these dimensions by estimating the effect of an SSB tax on the consumption and BMI of youth in Mauritius, an island nation in the Indian Ocean, which we compare to Maldives, another island nation in the Indian Ocean which did not implement an SSB tax during the time of our data. Results of difference-in-differences models indicate that the tax in Mauritius had no detectable impact on the consumption of SSBs or the body mass index of the pooled sample of boys and girls. However, models estimated separately by sex indicate that the probability that boys consumed SSBs fell by 9.4 percentage points (11%). These are among the first estimates of the effect of SSB taxes on youth consumption, and contribute to the limited evidence base on the impact of SSB taxes on weight, or in non-Western countries.

10.3386/w28960.abstractZh: 对含糖饮料征税是一项相对较新的政策，关于其对含糖饮料消费或身体质量指数（与价格、购买或销售相比）的影响、对青少年的影响（与对成年人相比），以及在非西方国家的影响，现有证据较为有限。本文通过估算毛里求斯（印度洋上的一个岛国）对含糖饮料征税对青少年消费和身体质量指数的影响，为这些方面的研究提供了更多证据。我们将毛里求斯的结果与马尔代夫进行了比较，后者在数据收集期间并未实施含糖饮料征税。差异模型分析表明，毛里求斯的征税对男孩和女孩的含糖饮料消费或身体质量指数没有显著影响。然而，按性别分列的模型分析显示，男孩消费含糖饮料的概率下降了9.4个百分点（即11%）。这些研究是首次对含糖饮料征税对青少年消费影响的估算，也为关于含糖饮料征税对体重影响的有限证据提供了补充，尤其是在非西方国家。

abstract.text: We study whether it’s possible to identify time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0, and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time-consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time-inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be “priced-out.”

10.3386/w28961.abstractZh: 我们研究在实证设计中是否有可能识别出时间上不一致的偏好。在实证设计中，偏好在时间点0被预先引出，然后在时间点1，在代理人获得额外信息之后，偏好再次被引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间点1中一对替代方案之间的排序始终与时间点0的排序相反时，才拒绝时间一致性。我们建立了这一结果的变体和推广。由于这种明显的反转很少出现，因此选择修正设计需要比之前认为的更强的识别假设。但我们表明，在可以“定价出”对替代方案的偏好的情况下，时间不一致性是可识别的。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between a firm’s legal contracting environment and its innovation incentives. Using granular data from the pharmaceutical industry, we examine a contracting mechanism through which incumbents maintain market power: “pay-for-delay” agreements to delay the market entry of competitors. Exploiting a shock where such contracts become legally tenuous, we find that affected incumbents subsequently increase their innovation activity across a variety of project-level measures. Exploring the nature of this innovation, we also find that it is more “impactful” from a scientific and commercial standpoint. The results provide novel evidence that restricting the contracting space can boost innovation at the firm level. However, at the extensive margin we find a reduction in innovation by new entrants in response to increased competition, suggesting a nuanced effect on aggregate innovation.

10.3386/w28964.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业的法律合同环境与其创新激励之间的关系。通过医药行业的详细数据，我们研究了一种使现有企业保持市场力量的合同机制：即“延迟支付”协议，用于推迟竞争对手进入市场的时间。在这类合同法律效力受到质疑的情况下，我们发现受影响的现有企业随后在多种项目层面的创新活动上有所增加。进一步分析这些创新的性质，我们发现从科学和商业的角度来看，这些创新更具“影响力”。研究结果提供了新的证据，表明限制合同空间可以提升企业的创新水平。然而，在广泛层面上，我们发现新进入者由于竞争加剧而减少了创新活动，这表明对整体创新的影响具有复杂性。

abstract.text: We document large gender disparities within a government program that entitles 46 million poor individuals to free hospital care. We show that care is not free in practice and higher costs are associated with larger disparities. Lowering care costs increases female utilization but does not reduce gender disparities because marginal beneficiaries are as likely to be male as inframarginals. Long-term exposure to local female leaders reduces disparities by addressing factors lowering female care. In the presence of gender bias, subsidizing social services may fail to address gender inequalities without actions that specifically target females.

10.3386/w28972.abstractZh: 我们记录了一项政府计划中存在严重的性别差异，该计划为4600万贫困人群提供免费医疗护理。研究表明，实际上这种护理并非免费，且成本越高，性别差异越明显。降低护理成本确实增加了女性的使用率，但并未减少性别差异，因为边缘受益者中男性与女性比例相同。长期接触当地女性领导者可以通过解决降低女性接受护理的因素来减少性别差异。在存在性别偏见的情况下，单纯补贴社会服务可能无法解决性别不平等问题，除非采取专门针对女性的措施。

abstract.text: Interventions to promote learning are often categorized into supply- and demand-side approaches. In a randomized experiment to promote learning about COVID-19 among Mozambican adults, we study the interaction between a supply and a demand intervention, respectively: teaching via targeted feedback, and providing financial incentives to learners. In theory, teaching and learner-incentives may be substitutes (crowding out one another) or complements (enhancing one another). Experts surveyed in advance predicted a high degree of substitutability between the two treatments. In contrast, we find substantially more complementarity than experts predicted. Combining teaching and incentive treatments raises COVID-19 knowledge test scores by 0.5 standard deviations, though the standalone teaching treatment is the most cost-effective. The complementarity between teaching and incentives persists in the longer run, over nine months post-treatment.

10.3386/w28976.abstractZh: 促进学习的干预措施通常分为供给端和需求端两种策略。在一项针对莫桑比克成年人进行的有序实验中，我们研究了供给端与需求端干预措施之间的相互作用：一种是通过有针对性的反馈进行教学，另一种则是为学习者提供经济激励。理论上，教学与学习激励措施可能是替代品（相互排斥）或互补品（相互促进）。事先进行调研的专家预测这两种干预措施之间存在较高的替代性。然而，我们发现它们之间的互补性远高于专家的预期。将教学与激励措施结合使用能使COVID-19相关知识测试成绩提高0.5个标准差，不过单独使用教学措施才是最具成本效益的方法。在教学与激励措施结合使用的情况下，这种互补性在九个月的治疗期间依然持续存在。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of increased access to telemedicine that followed widespread adoption during the March-April 2020 lockdown period in Israel (due to COVID-19). We focus on the post-lockdown period, which in Israel was characterized by a temporary return to normalcy. Prior to the lockdown, telemedicine accounted for about 5% of all primary care visits. It peaked at around 40% during the lockdown, and remained high, at around 20%, during the post-lockdown period. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we compare primary care episodes before and after the lockdown between patients with high and low access to telemedicine, with access defined based on their main primary care physician’s propensity to adopt telemedicine during the lockdown. Increased access to telemedicine results in a 3.5% increase in primary care visits, but a 5% lower per-episode cost, so overall resource utilization is slightly lower. We find that remote visits involve slightly fewer prescriptions and more follow-ups, mainly with the same physician, which is consistent with a prolonged diagnostic path in the absence of physical examination. However, analyzing specific conditions, we find no evidence of missed diagnoses or adverse outcomes. Taken together, our findings suggest that the increased convenience of telemedicine does not compromise care quality or raise costs.

10.3386/w28978.abstractZh: 我们估算了2020年3月至4月以色列因COVID-19实施封锁期间，随着远程医疗的广泛普及，其使用率增加所带来的影响。我们重点关注封锁后的时期，当时以色列的局势暂时恢复了正常状态。在封锁之前，远程医疗占所有初级保健就诊的约5%。在封锁期间，这一比例达到了约40%，而在封锁后的时期，这一比例仍然保持在约20%的高水平。我们使用差异-差异框架，比较了封锁前后，以及远程医疗使用率高低不同的患者之间的初级保健就诊情况，其中远程医疗使用率是根据患者的主要初级保健医生在封锁期间采用远程医疗的倾向来定义的。远程医疗使用率的增加导致初级保健就诊次数增加了3.5%，但每次就诊的成本降低了5%，因此整体资源利用略低。我们发现，远程就诊涉及的处方数量略少，随访次数更多，且主要由同一位医生进行，这与在没有物理检查的情况下延长诊断过程是一致的。然而，在分析具体情况下，我们没有发现误诊或不良后果的证据。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，远程医疗的便利性增加并不会影响护理质量或增加成本。

abstract.text: Correctional facilities commonly lack climate control, producing a setting absent endogenous responses to hot weather like avoidance, adjustment, and mitigation. We study daily weather variation across the state of Mississippi, and show that high temperatures increase intense violence among the incarcerated. Days with unsafe heat index levels shift both the intensive and extensive margins of violence, raising daily violent interactions by 20%, and the probability of any violence by 18%. Our setting cleanly identifies the effect of heat on violence, and highlights previously unobserved social costs of current facility infrastructure. Rising global temperatures could substantially increase violence absent adjustment.

10.3386/w28987.abstractZh: 矫正设施通常缺乏气候控制，导致环境缺乏对炎热天气的内生反应，如避免、调整和中和。我们研究了密西西比州各地的日常天气变化，发现高温会加剧囚犯之间的暴力行为。在不安全的热指数水平下，暴力的强度和范围都会增加，每日暴力互动次数增加20%，任何暴力行为发生的概率增加18%。我们的研究清晰地揭示了高温对暴力的影响，并突显了当前设施基础设施所带来的未观察到的社会成本。如果不进行调整，全球气温的上升可能会大幅增加暴力行为。

abstract.text: We use a natural experiment in China's health care reform, in which the government mandated zero markups for drugs sold in public hospitals, to study physician-induced demand for medical care. We develop a theoretical model that robustly predicts that the drug price zero markup policy (ZMP) will lead to a reduction in the demand for drugs but an increase in the demand for non-drug services, only when the demands for drugs and non-drug services are at least partially physician induced. Our model also yields testable predictions of the impact of the ZMP regarding the equilibrium number of treated patients. Exploiting the staggered rollout of the ZMP and a unique claims data set, we find that, at the admission level, the reform decreases drug expenses by 63.4 log points (47.0 percent), but the reduction in drug expenses is almost fully substituted by the increases in expenses for non-drug services. Quantitatively similar results are also obtained at the physician and at the hospital levels. We also show that the ZMP reduces the number of patients in the treated hospitals, as predicted by the model, and that the reform has little impact on the quality of health care proxied by the readmission rate.

10.3386/w28998.abstractZh: 我们在中国医疗改革中使用了一个自然实验，该实验要求政府在公立医院销售的药品中实行零加价政策，以研究医生对医疗服务的需求行为。我们建立了一个理论模型，该模型稳健地预测，只有当药品和非药品服务的需求至少部分由医生决定时，药品零加价政策才会导致药品需求的减少，而非药品服务需求的增加。我们的模型还提出了关于零加价政策对治疗患者数量均衡影响的可验证预测。通过利用零加价政策的分阶段实施以及独特的索赔数据集，我们发现，在入院层面，改革使药品费用减少了63.4个对数点（47.0%），但药品费用的减少几乎完全被非药品服务费用的增加所替代。在医生和医院层面也获得了类似的结果。我们还发现，正如模型所预测的，零加价政策减少了治疗医院中的患者数量，并且该改革对以再入院率为代表的医疗服务质量的影响很小。

abstract.text: Even among commercially-insured individuals, opioid use disorder (OUD) is undertreated in the U.S.: nearly half receive no treatment within 6 months of a new diagnosis. Using a difference-in-differences specification exploiting the extension of insurance parity requirements for substance disorder treatment to small group enrollees in 2014, we find that parity increases utilization of residential treatment but decreases utilization of agonist medications, the standard of care. We find direct interventions to increase access to medication may be more promising: increases in the county-level share of physicians able to prescribe agonists are associated with substitution toward medication-assisted treatment.

10.3386/w29001.abstractZh: 即使在商业保险覆盖的人群中，美国的阿片类药物使用障碍也得不到充分治疗：近一半的人在确诊后的6个月内没有接受任何治疗。通过利用2014年对小型团体参保者实施保险平等待遇要求的差异-差异模型，我们发现保险平等待遇增加了住院治疗的使用率，但降低了标准治疗——即使用激动剂药物的利用率。我们发现，直接干预以增加药物获取机会可能更为有效：县级范围内能够开处激动剂药物的医生比例增加，与转向药物辅助治疗有关。

abstract.text: We ask whether epidemic exposure leads to a shift in financial technology usage and who participates in this shift. We exploit a dataset combining Gallup World Polls and Global Findex surveys for some 250,000 individuals in 140 countries, merging them with information on the incidence of epidemics and local 3G internet infrastructure. Epidemic exposure is associated with an increase in remote-access (online/mobile) banking and substitution from bank branch-based to ATM activity. The temporary nature of the effects we identify is more consistent with a demand channel rather than that of supply with high initial fixed costs. Exploring heterogeneity using a machine-learning driven approach, we find that young, high-income earners in full-time employment have the greatest tendency to shift to online/mobile transactions in response to epidemics. Baseline effects are larger for individuals with better ex ante 3G signal coverage, highlighting the role of the digital divide in adaption to new technologies necessitated by adverse external shocks.

10.3386/w29006.abstractZh: 我们探讨了疫情暴露是否会导致金融技术使用的转变，以及哪些群体会参与这一转变。我们利用盖洛普世界民意调查和全球金融指数调查的数据集，涵盖了140个国家的约250,000名个体，并将这些数据与疫情发生情况以及当地3G互联网基础设施的信息相结合。研究发现，疫情暴露与远程访问（在线/移动）银行服务的增加以及从银行网点到自动取款机服务的替代有关。我们发现的这些效应具有临时性，更符合需求渠道而非高初始固定成本的供给渠道。通过机器学习方法探索异质性，我们发现全职工作的年轻高收入人群在应对疫情时更倾向于使用在线/移动交易方式。对于3G信号覆盖较好的个体来说，基线效应更为显著，这凸显了数字鸿沟在适应因外部冲击而 necessitated的新技术方面的作用。

abstract.text: Who bears the consequences of administrative problems in healthcare? We use data on repeated interactions between a large sample of U.S. physicians and many different insurers to document the complexity of healthcare billing, and estimate its economic costs for doctors and consequences for patients. Observing the back-and-forth sequences of claim denials and resubmissions for past visits, we can estimate physicians’ costs of haggling with insurers to collect payments. Combining these costs with the revenue never collected, we estimate that physicians lose 18% of Medicaid revenue to billing problems, compared with 4.7% for Medicare and 2.4% for commercial insurers. Identifying off of physician movers and practices that span state boundaries, we find that physicians respond to billing problems by refusing to accept Medicaid patients in states with more severe billing hurdles. These hurdles are quantitatively just as important as payment rates for explaining variation in physicians’ willingness to treat Medicaid patients. We conclude that administrative frictions have first-order costs for doctors, patients, and equality of access to healthcare. We quantify the potential economic gains—in terms of reduced public spending or increased access to physicians—if these frictions could be reduced, and find them to be sizable.

10.3386/w29010.abstractZh: 谁应承担医疗保健行政问题的后果？我们通过大量美国医生与多家保险公司之间的重复互动数据，来揭示医疗账单处理的复杂性，并估算其给医生带来的经济成本以及对患者的影响。通过观察过去就诊过程中索赔被拒和重新提交的情况，我们可以估算医生与保险公司讨价还价以收取费用所付出的成本。将这些成本与未收取的收入相结合，我们发现医生因账单问题而损失了18%的Medicaid收入，而Medicare和商业保险公司的损失分别为4.7%和2.4%。通过识别那些跨州流动的医生，我们发现医生在面对账单问题时，会拒绝在账单障碍更严重的州接受Medicaid患者。这些障碍在解释医生治疗Medicaid患者的意愿差异方面，与支付率一样重要。我们得出结论，行政摩擦对医生、患者以及医疗保健的公平性都造成了首要成本。我们量化了如果这些摩擦能够减少，可能会带来的潜在经济收益——包括减少公共支出或增加医生的可及性。我们发现这些收益是相当大的。

abstract.text: We argue that alternative COVID-19 vaccine dosing regimens could potentially dramatically accelerate global COVID-19 vaccination and reduce mortality, and that the costs of testing these regimens are dwarfed by their potential benefits. We first use the high correlation between neutralizing antibody response and efficacy against disease (Khoury et. al. 2021) to show that half or even quarter doses of some vaccines generate immune responses associated with high vaccine efficacy. We then use an SEIR model to estimate that under these efficacy levels, doubling or quadrupling the rate of vaccination by using fractional doses would dramatically reduce infections and mortality. Since the correlation between immune response and efficacy may not be fully predictive of efficacy with fractional doses, we then use the SEIR model to show that fractional dosing would substantially reduce infections and mortality over a wide range of plausible efficacy levels. Further immunogenicity studies for a range of vaccine and dose combinations could deliver outcomes in weeks and could be conducted with a few hundred healthy volunteers. National regulatory authorities could also decide to test efficacy of fractional dosing in the context of vaccination campaigns based on existing immune response data, as some did for delayed second doses. If efficacy turned out to be high, the approach could be implemented broadly, while if it turned out to be low, downside risk could be limited by administering full doses to those who had received fractional doses. The SEIR model also suggests that delaying second vaccine doses will likely have substantial mortality benefits for multiple, but not all, vaccine-variant combinations, underscoring the importance of ongoing surveillance. Finally, we find that for countries choosing between approved but lower efficacy vaccines available immediately and waiting for mRNA vaccines, using immediately available vaccines typically reduces mortality.

10.3386/w29018.abstractZh: 我们认为，不同的COVID-19疫苗剂量方案有可能显著加快全球疫苗接种进程并降低死亡率，而这些方案的成本与其潜在效益相比微不足道。首先，我们利用中和抗体反应与疾病预防效果之间的高度相关性（Khoury等人，2021年），表明某些疫苗的半剂量甚至四分之一剂量也能产生与高疫苗效果相关的免疫反应。接着，我们使用SEIR模型估计，在如此高的效果水平下，通过采用分数剂量使疫苗接种率翻倍或四倍，将大幅减少感染和死亡人数。由于免疫反应与效果之间的相关性可能无法完全预测分数剂量的效果，我们进一步使用SEIR模型表明，在广泛的潜在效果水平下，分数剂量将显著减少感染和死亡人数。针对一系列疫苗和剂量组合的进一步免疫学研究可以在几周内得出结果，而且只需几百名健康志愿者即可进行。国家监管机构也可以根据现有的免疫反应数据，在疫苗接种活动中测试分数剂量的效果，就像某些国家对延迟接种第二剂疫苗所做的那样。如果效果证明很高，这种方法可以广泛实施；如果效果较低，则可以通过为已接种分数剂量的人提供全剂量来降低风险。SEIR模型还表明，延迟接种第二剂疫苗可能对多种疫苗组合有显著的死亡人数减少效果，这强调了持续监测的重要性。最后，我们发现，对于在可立即获得但效力较低的疫苗和mRNA疫苗之间做出选择的国家来说，使用可立即获得的疫苗通常能够降低死亡率。

abstract.text: During the COVID-19 epidemic, many health professionals started using mass communication on social media to relay critical information and persuade individuals to adopt preventative health behaviors. Our group of clinicians and nurses developed and recorded short video messages to encourage viewers to stay home for the Thanksgiving and Christmas Holidays. We then conducted a two-stage clustered randomized controlled trial in 820 counties (covering 13 States) in the United States of a large-scale Facebook ad campaign disseminating these messages. In the first level of randomization, we randomly divided the counties into two groups: high intensity and low intensity. In the second level, we randomly assigned zip codes to either treatment or control such that 75% of zip codes in high intensity counties received the treatment, while 25% of zip codes in low intensity counties received the treatment. In each treated zip code, we sent the ad to as many Facebook subscribers as possible (11,954,109 users received at least one ad at Thanksgiving and 23,302,290 users received at least one ad at Christmas). The first primary outcome was aggregate holiday travel, measured using mobile phone location data, available at the county level: we find that average distance travelled in high-intensity counties changed by -0.993 percentage points (95% CI -1.616, -0.371, p-value 0.002) the three days before each holiday. The second primary outcome was COVID-19 infection at the zip-code level: COVID-19 infections recorded in the two-week period starting five days post-holiday declined by 3.5 percent (adjusted 95% CI [-6.2 percent, -0.7 percent], p-value 0.013) in intervention zip codes compared to control zip codes.

10.3386/w29021.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，许多医疗专业人员开始利用社交媒体进行大众传播，传递关键信息并说服人们采取预防性的健康行为。我们这一组临床医生和护士制作并录制了简短的视频信息，鼓励观众在感恩节和圣诞节期间待在家里。随后，我们在美国13个州的820个县进行了一项两阶段随机对照试验，通过大规模的Facebook广告传播这些信息。在第一次随机分组中，我们将各县随机分为两组：高强度和低强度组。在第二次随机分组中，我们将邮政编码随机分配到治疗组或对照组，使得高强度县中有75%的邮政编码接受了治疗，而低强度县中有25%的邮政编码接受了治疗。在每个接受治疗的邮政编码区，我们向尽可能多的Facebook订阅者发送广告（在感恩节有11,954,109名用户至少收到了一次广告，在圣诞节有23,302,290名用户至少收到了一次广告）。第一个主要结果是假期期间的总出行距离，通过县级别的手机位置数据来衡量：我们发现，在假期前的三天里，高强度县的平均出行距离减少了0.993个百分点（95%置信区间：-1.616, -0.371，p值0.002）。第二个主要结果是邮政编码区内的COVID-19感染情况：在假期结束后五天内，干预组邮政编码区的COVID-19感染率下降了3.5%（调整后的95%置信区间[-6.2%, -0.7%]，p值0.013）。

abstract.text: We study a 2008 policy reform in which Medicare revised its hospital payment system to better reflect patients' severity of illness. We construct a simulated instrument that predicts a hospital's policy-induced change in reimbursement using pre-reform patients and post-reform rules. The reform led to large persistent changes in Medicare payment rates across hospitals. Hospitals that faced larger gains in Medicare reimbursement increased the volume of Medicare patients they treated. The estimates imply a volume elasticity of 1.2. To accommodate greater volume, hospitals increased nurse employment, but also lowered length of stay, with ambiguous effects on quality.

10.3386/w29023.abstractZh: 我们研究了2008年的政策改革，其中医疗保险部门修订了医院支付系统，以更好地反映患者的病情严重程度。我们构建了一个模拟工具，该工具能够预测医院因政策变化而发生的支付金额变化，使用的是改革前后的患者数据和规则。这一改革导致医疗保险支付率在不同医院之间出现了显著且持久的变化。那些在医疗保险支付中获得更多收益的医院，治疗的医疗保险患者数量也增加了。估计结果显示，患者数量弹性为1.2。为了增加患者数量，医院增加了护士的雇佣人数，但同时也缩短了住院时间，但对医疗质量的影响尚不明确。

abstract.text: We provide a new method to analyze discrete choice models with state dependence and individual-by-product fixed effects, and use it to analyze consumer choices in the policy-relevant environment of a subsidized health insurance exchange. Moment inequalities are used to distinguish state dependence from consumers’ switching choices in response to changes in product attributes. We infer much smaller switching costs on the health insurance exchange than is inferred from standard logit and/or random effects methods. A counterfactual policy evaluation illustrates that the policy implications of this difference can be substantive.

10.3386/w29025.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的方法，用于分析具有状态依赖性和个体-产品固定效应的离散选择模型，并应用该方法来分析补贴型健康保险交易所政策相关环境中的消费者选择。通过矩不等式，我们可以区分状态依赖性与消费者因产品属性变化而做出的选择切换。与标准逻辑模型和随机效应模型相比，我们的方法能够推断出在健康保险交易所中更小的选择切换成本。通过反事实政策评估表明，这种差异所带来的政策影响可能是实质性的。

abstract.text: Interactions between redistributive policies can confront low-income households with complicated choices. We study one such interaction, namely the relationship between Medicaid eligibility thresholds and the minimum wage. A minimum wage increase reduces the number of hours a low-skilled individual can work while retaining Medicaid eligibility. We show that the empirical and welfare implications of this interaction can depend crucially on the relevance of labor market frictions. Absent frictions, affected workers may maintain Medicaid eligibility through small reductions in hours of work. With frictions, affected workers may lose Medicaid eligibility unless they leave their initial job. Empirically, we find that workers facing this scenario became less likely to participate in Medicaid, less likely to work, and more likely to spend time looking for new jobs, including search while employed. The observed outcomes suggest that low-skilled workers face substantial labor market frictions. Because adjustment is costly, tinkering with safety net program parameters that determine the location of program eligibility notches can be harmful to beneficiaries.

10.3386/w29028.abstractZh: 再分配政策之间的相互作用可能会给低收入家庭带来复杂的选择。我们研究了一种这样的互动关系，即医疗补助资格门槛与最低工资之间的关系。最低工资的提高会减少低技能个体在保持医疗补助资格的情况下可工作的小时数。我们发现，这种互动关系的实证和福利影响在很大程度上取决于劳动力市场摩擦的存在与否。在没有摩擦的情况下，受影响的工人可能通过减少工作时间来保持医疗补助资格。如果存在摩擦，受影响的工人可能会失去医疗补助资格，除非他们离开原来的工作。从实证来看，我们发现面临这种情况的工人参与医疗补助的可能性降低，工作的意愿也降低，同时更有可能花费时间寻找新的工作，包括在在职期间进行求职活动。这些观察结果表明，低技能工人面临着严重的劳动力市场摩擦。由于调整成本较高，对决定资格门槛的安全网项目参数进行微调可能会对受益人造成不利影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the career effects of mental health, focusing on depression, schizophrenia, and bipolar disorder (BD). Individual-level registry data from Denmark show that these disorders carry large earnings penalties, ranging from 34 percent for depression and 38 percent for BD to 74 percent for schizophrenia. To investigate the causal effects of mental health on a person’s career, we exploit the approval of lithium as a maintenance treatment for BD in 1976. Baseline estimates compare career outcomes for people with and without access in their 20s, the typical age of onset for BD. These estimates show that access to treatment eliminates one third of the earnings penalty associated with BD and greatly reduces the risks of low or no earnings. Importantly, access to treatment closes more than half of the disability risk associated with BD.

10.3386/w29031.abstractZh: 本文研究了心理健康状况对职业影响的效应，重点关注抑郁症、精神分裂症和双相情感障碍。来自丹麦的个体级登记数据显示，这些疾病会导致巨大的收入损失，其中抑郁症的亏损率为34%，双相情感障碍为38%，而精神分裂症则高达74%。为了研究心理健康状况对个人职业的因果效应，我们利用了1976年锂盐被批准作为双相情感障碍的维持性治疗这一事实。基线估计结果显示，在20多岁时，有治疗机会的人与没有治疗机会的人相比，其职业状况有显著改善。这些估计表明，获得治疗可以消除与双相情感障碍相关的三分之一收入损失，并大幅降低收入低或没有收入的风险。重要的是，获得治疗还能降低与双相情感障碍相关的超过一半的残疾风险。

abstract.text: Senior participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) has traditionally been lower than other groups among those eligible, with historical estimates below 50 percent. We examine the impacts of state SNAP policies on program participation among low-income senior (age 60 and older) and non-senior households using data from the 2001-2014 December Current Population Survey Food Security Supplement. Our results suggest that policies designed to expand SNAP eligibility modestly increased participation among seniors but led to larger increases among non-seniors. In contrast, we find little evidence of effects of policies related to transaction costs, stigma, or outreach on either group.

10.3386/w29037.abstractZh: 在符合条件的群体中，老年人参与补充营养援助计划（SNAP）的比例历来低于其他群体，历史估计值低于50%。我们利用2001-2014年12月当前人口调查食物安全补充数据，研究了各州SNAP政策对低收入老年人及非老年人家庭参与该计划的影响。研究结果表明，旨在扩大SNAP资格范围的政策在一定程度上增加了老年人的参与率，但对非老年人的影响则更为显著。相比之下，我们发现与交易成本、社会耻辱感或宣传推广相关的政策对这两类群体的影响甚微。

abstract.text: Recreational marijuana laws (RMLs), which legalize the possession of small quantities of marijuana for recreational use, have been adopted by 18 states and the District of Columbia. Opponents argue that RML-induced increases in marijuana consumption will serve as a “gateway” to harder drug use and crime. Using data covering the period 2000-2019 from a variety of national sources (the National Survey of Drug Use and Health, the Uniform Crime Reports, the National Vital Statistics System, and the Treatment Episode Data Set) this study is the first to comprehensively examine the effects of legalizing recreational marijuana on hard drug use, arrests, drug overdose deaths, suicides, and treatment admissions. Our analyses show that RMLs increase adult marijuana use and reduce drug-related arrests over an average post-legalization window of three to four years. There is little evidence to suggest that RML-induced increases in marijuana consumption encourage the use of harder substances or violent criminal activity, and some evidence that RMLs may aid in reducing opioid-related mortality.

10.3386/w29038.abstractZh: 娱乐性大麻法律（RMLs）允许持有少量大麻用于娱乐用途，已有18个州和哥伦比亚特区采纳了这一法律。反对者认为，娱乐性大麻法律导致的大麻消费增加可能会成为使用更危险毒品和犯罪的“入口”。本研究利用2000年至2019年间来自多个国家的数据来源（包括全国药物使用与健康调查、统一犯罪报告、国家重要统计系统以及治疗事件数据集），首次全面探讨了娱乐性大麻合法化对严重药物使用、逮捕、药物过量死亡、自杀以及治疗入院的影响。我们的分析显示，在合法化后的三到四年内，娱乐性大麻法律增加了成年人的大麻使用量，并减少了与毒品相关的逮捕次数。几乎没有证据表明，娱乐性大麻法律导致的大麻消费增加会促使人们使用更危险的毒品或参与暴力犯罪活动，但也有一些证据表明，这些法律可能有助于减少与阿片类药物相关的死亡事件。

abstract.text: This is an invited chapter for the forthcoming Volume 4 of the Handbook of Industrial Organization. We focus on "selection markets," which cover markets in which consumers vary not only in how much they are willing to pay for a product but also in how costly they are to the seller. The chapter tries to organize the recent wave of IO-related papers on selection markets, which has largely focused on insurance and credit markets. We provide a common framework, terminology, and notation that can be used to understand many of these papers, and that we hope can be usefully applied going forward.

10.3386/w29039.abstractZh: 这是即将出版的《工业组织手册》第四卷中的一篇受邀章节。我们重点关注“选择市场”，这类市场中的消费者不仅在愿意为产品支付的价格上存在差异，而且产品的销售成本也对卖方产生不同的影响。本章试图对近期关于选择市场的相关论文进行整理，这些论文主要集中在保险和信贷市场方面。我们提供了一个共同的框架、术语和符号体系，以便理解这些论文，并希望这些工具能够在未来得到有效的应用。

abstract.text: Using US Census Household Pulse Survey data for the period April 2020 to June 2021 we track the evolution of the mental health of nearly 2.3 million Americans during the COVID pandemic. We find anxiety, depression and worry peaked in November 2020, coinciding with the Presidential election. The taking of prescription drugs for mental health conditions peaked two weeks later in December 2020. Mental health improved subsequently such that by April 2021 it was better than it had been a year previously. The probability of having been diagnosed with COVID did not rise significantly in the first half of 2021 but COVID infection rates were higher among the young than the old. COVID diagnoses were significantly lower in States that had voted for Biden in the Presidential Election. The probability of vaccination rose with age, was considerably higher in Biden states, and rose precipitously over the period among the young and old. Anxiety was higher among people in Biden states, whether they had been diagnosed or not, and whether they were vaccinated or not. The association between anxiety and depression and having had COVID was not significant in Biden or Trump states but being vaccinated was associated with lower anxiety and depression, with the effect being larger in Biden states. Whilst being in paid work was associated with lower anxiety, worry and depression and was associated with higher vaccination rates, it also increased the probability of having had COVID.

10.3386/w29040.abstractZh: 我们利用美国人口普查家庭脉搏调查的数据，对2020年4月至2021年6月期间近230万美国人的心理健康状况进行了跟踪研究。研究发现，焦虑、抑郁和担忧在2020年11月达到顶峰，这与总统选举期间相吻合。用于治疗心理健康问题的处方药使用量在两周后的2020年12月达到峰值。此后，心理健康状况有所改善，到2021年4月，情况比一年前有所好转。2021年上半年，被诊断出患有COVID-19的概率并未显著上升，但年轻人群中的感染率高于老年人。在总统选举中投票支持拜登的州，COVID-19的诊断率明显较低。疫苗接种率随年龄增长而上升，在支持拜登的州，这一比例明显更高，并且在年轻人和老年人中这一比例在一段时间内急剧上升。无论是否被诊断出患有COVID-19，以及是否接种了疫苗，支持拜登的州的人们焦虑程度都较高。在支持拜登和特朗普的州，焦虑与抑郁与是否患有COVID-19之间没有显著关联，但接种疫苗与较低的焦虑、抑郁程度相关，且在支持拜登的州这种效应更为明显。虽然从事有偿工作与较低的焦虑、担忧和抑郁程度相关，并且与较高的疫苗接种率相关，但它也增加了患COVID-19的概率。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the opening of a new urgent care center (UCC) on health care costs and the utilization of care among nearby Medicare beneficiaries. We focus on 2006–2016, a period of rapid UCC expansion. We find that total Medicare spending rises when residents of a zip code are first served by a UCC, relative to spending in yet-to-be-served zip codes, while mortality remains flat. We explore mechanisms by looking at categories of spending and by examining utilization. Increases in inpatient visits are the largest contributor to the overall increase in spending, rising by 6.65 percent within six years after UCC entry. The number of emergency room visits that result in a hospital admission also increases by 3.7 percent. In contrast, there is no change in the number of ER visits that do not result in admission to hospital, in visits to physicians outside a UCC, or in imaging and tests.
