10.3982/ecta12807.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，通过汇总各个工厂的运营数据来估算资本与劳动力的替代弹性。总体弹性反映了工厂内部的替代效应以及不同工厂之间的重新分配；资本强度的异质性程度决定了它们的相对重要性。我们利用关于工厂横截面的微观数据，来估算某一时间点的总体弹性。通过多种模型的解释，我们发现美国制造业的总体弹性在0.5到0.7之间，并且自1970年以来略有下降。我们利用这些估算结果来衡量技术变革的偏差，并评估美国制造业中劳动力收入份额的下降情况。那些依赖于要素相对供应变化的机制，比如资本积累的加速，无法解释这一下降现象。

abstract.text: We study individual male earnings dynamics over the life cycle using panel data on millions of U.S. workers. Using nonparametric methods, we first show that the distribution of earnings changes exhibits substantial deviations from lognormality, such as negative skewness and very high kurtosis. Further, the extent of these nonnormalities varies significantly with age and earnings level, peaking around age 50 and between the 70th and 90th percentiles of the earnings distribution. Second, we estimate nonparametric impulse response functions and find important asymmetries: Positive changes for high‐income individuals are quite transitory, whereas negative ones are very persistent; the opposite is true for low‐income individuals. Third, we turn to long‐run outcomes and find substantial heterogeneity in the cumulative growth rates of earnings and the total number of years individuals spend nonemployed between ages 25 and 55. Finally, by targeting these rich sets of moments, we estimate stochastic processes for earnings that range from the simple to the complex. Our preferred specification features normal mixture innovations to both persistent and transitory components and includes state‐dependent long‐term nonemployment shocks with a realization probability that varies with age and earnings.

10.3982/ecta14603.abstractZh: 我们利用对数百万美国工人的面板数据，研究了个体男性在生命周期中的收入动态变化。通过非参数方法，我们首先发现收入分布的变化表现出与对数正态分布显著不同的特征，例如负偏度和极高的峰度。此外，这些非正态性程度随年龄和收入水平的显著变化而变化，在50岁左右达到峰值，并且在收入分布的70%至90%之间也有明显差异。其次，我们估计了非参数脉冲响应函数，并发现了重要的不对称性：高收入个体的正向变化非常短暂，而负向变化则非常持久；低收入个体的情况则相反。第三，我们研究了长期结果，发现收入累计增长率以及个体在25至55岁之间未就业的总年数存在显著的异质性。最后，通过针对这些丰富的矩数据，我们估计了从简单到复杂的收入随机过程。我们首选的模型结构包含对持久性和短暂性成分都有影响的正态混合创新，并包括了与状态相关的长期未就业冲击，其实现概率随年龄和收入而变化。

abstract.text: We study the consequences of measurement error in the dependent variable of random‐coefficients models, focusing on the particular case of quantile regression. The popular quantile regression estimator of Koenker and Bassett (1978) is biased if there is an additive error term. Approaching this problem as an errors‐in‐variables problem where the dependent variable suffers from classical measurement error, we present a sieve maximum likelihood approach that is robust to left‐hand‐side measurement error. After providing sufficient conditions for identification, we demonstrate that when the number of knots in the quantile grid is chosen to grow at an adequate speed, the sieve‐maximum‐likelihood estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal, permitting inference via bootstrapping. Monte Carlo evidence verifies our method outperforms quantile regression in mean bias and MSE. Finally, we illustrate our estimator with an application to the returns to education highlighting changes over time in the returns to education that have previously been masked by measurement‐error bias.

10.3982/ecta14667.abstractZh: 我们研究了随机系数模型中因变量测量误差的后果，重点关注分位数回归这一特定情况。Koenker和Bassett在1978年提出的分位数回归估计量在存在加性误差项时会出现偏差。我们将这个问题视为一个“变量误差”问题，其中因变量受到传统测量误差的影响。我们提出了一种对左侧测量误差具有鲁棒性的筛选最大似然方法。在提供了识别的充分条件后，我们证明了当分位数网格中的节点数量以适当的速度增长时，筛选最大似然估计量具有一致性且渐近正态性，从而可以通过自助法进行推断。蒙特卡洛验证表明，我们的方法在平均偏差和均方误差方面优于分位数回归。最后，我们通过一个教育回报的应用案例来说明我们的估计量，该案例突出了教育回报随时间的变化情况，这些变化之前被测量误差偏差所掩盖。

abstract.text: We characterize optimal asset management contracts in a classic portfolio‐investment setting. When the agent has access to hidden savings, his incentives to misbehave depend on his precautionary saving motive. The contract dynamically distorts the agent's access to capital to manipulate his precautionary saving motive and reduce incentives for misbehavior. We provide a sufficient condition for the validity of the first‐order approach, which holds in the optimal contract: global incentive compatibility is ensured if the agent's precautionary saving motive weakens after bad outcomes. We extend our results to incorporate market risk, hidden investment, and renegotiation.

10.3982/ecta14929.abstractZh: 我们描述了在经典投资组合投资情境下的最优资产管理合同。当代理人能够获取隐藏的储蓄时，其不当行为的动机取决于其预防性储蓄动机。该合同会动态扭曲代理人获取资本的能力，以操纵其预防性储蓄动机，从而减少不当行为的激励。我们提出了第一阶方法有效性的一个充分条件，该条件在最优合同中成立：如果代理人因不良结果而减弱其预防性储蓄动机，则可以确保全局激励的兼容性。我们将研究结果扩展到市场风险、隐藏投资以及重新谈判的情境。

abstract.text: We study information aggregation when n bidders choose, based on their private information, between two concurrent common‐value auctions. There are k s identical objects on sale through a uniform‐price auction in market s and there are an additional k r objects on auction in market r , which is identical to market s except for a positive reserve price. The reserve price in market r implies that information is not aggregated in this market. Moreover, if the object‐to‐bidder ratio in market s exceeds a certain cutoff, then information is not aggregated in market s either. Conversely, if the object‐to‐bidder ratio is less than this cutoff, then information is aggregated in market s as the market grows arbitrarily large. Our results demonstrate how frictions in one market can disrupt information aggregation in a linked, frictionless market because of the pattern of market selection by imperfectly informed bidders.

10.3982/ecta14935.abstractZh: 我们研究了当n个竞买者根据各自的私人信息在两个同时进行的共同价值拍卖中做出选择时的信息聚合问题。市场s中通过统一价格拍卖出售了k个相同的物品，而在市场r中则额外有k个r个物品进行拍卖，市场r与市场s相同，只是存在正的保留价格。市场r中的保留价格意味着在这个市场中信息不会被聚合。此外，如果市场s中的物品与竞买者比例超过某个临界值，那么市场s中的信息也不会被聚合。相反，如果物品与竞买者比例低于这个临界值，那么随着市场规模的任意扩大，市场s中的信息会被聚合。我们的研究结果表明，由于信息不完全的竞买者选择市场的模式，一个市场中的摩擦可能会破坏另一个无缝连接的市场中的信息聚合。

abstract.text: We study how endogenous innovation and technology diffusion interact to determine the shape of the productivity distribution and generate aggregate growth. We model firms that choose to innovate, adopt technology, or produce with their existing technology. Costly adoption creates a spread between the best and worst technologies concurrently used to produce similar goods. The balance of adoption and innovation determines the shape of the distribution; innovation stretches the distribution, while adoption compresses it. On the balanced growth path, the aggregate growth rate equals the maximum growth rate of innovators. While innovation drives long‐run growth, changes in the adoption environment can influence growth by affecting innovation incentives, either directly, through licensing of excludable technologies, or indirectly, via the option value of adoption.

10.3982/ecta15020.abstractZh: 我们研究内生性创新与技术扩散如何相互作用，以决定生产率分布的形态并推动总体增长。我们模拟了那些选择创新、采用新技术或以现有技术进行生产的企业的行为。昂贵的采用成本导致用于生产类似商品的最佳技术和最差技术之间存在差距。采用与创新的平衡决定了生产率分布的形态：创新会拉伸分布，而采用则会压缩分布。在平衡增长路径上，总体增长率等于创新者的最大增长率。虽然创新推动长期增长，但采用环境的变化可以通过影响创新激励来影响增长，这种影响可以是直接的，通过可排他性技术的许可，也可以是间接的，通过采用的期权价值来实现。

abstract.text: This paper studies asset pricing and labor market dynamics when idiosyncratic risk to human capital is not fully insurable. Firms use long‐term contracts to provide insurance to workers, but neither side can fully commit; furthermore, owing to costly and unobservable retention effort, worker‐firm relationships have endogenous durations. Uninsured tail risk in labor earnings arises as a part of an optimal risk‐sharing scheme. In equilibrium, exposure to the tail risk generates higher aggregate risk premia and higher return volatility. Consistent with data, firm‐level labor share predicts both future returns and pass‐throughs of firm‐level shocks to labor compensation.

10.3982/ecta15142.abstractZh: 本文研究了当人力资本的特殊风险无法完全被保险时，资产定价和劳动力市场动态的问题。企业通过长期合同为员工提供保险，但双方都无法完全承诺履行；此外，由于保留员工的成本高昂且难以观察，员工与企业的关系具有内生性持续时间。未保险的劳动收入尾部风险是最优风险分担方案的一部分。在均衡状态下，暴露于尾部风险会引发更高的总体风险溢价和更高的回报波动性。数据与这一结论一致，企业层面的劳动分享率能够预测未来回报以及企业层面冲击对劳动补偿的传递效应。

abstract.text: At an initial time, an individual forms a belief about a future random outcome. As time passes, the individual may obtain, privately or subjectively, further information, until the outcome is eventually revealed. How can a protocol be devised that induces the individual, as a strict best response, to reveal at the outset his prior assessment of both the final outcome and the information flows he anticipates and, subsequently, what information he privately receives? The protocol can provide the individual with payoffs that depend only on the outcome realization and his reports. We develop a framework to design such protocols, and apply it to construct simple elicitation mechanisms for common dynamic environments. The framework is general: we show that strategyproof protocols exist for any number of periods and large outcome sets. For these more general settings, we build a family of strategyproof protocols based on a hierarchy of choice menus, and show that any strategyproof protocol can be approximated by a protocol of this family.

10.3982/ecta15293.abstractZh: 在初始阶段，个体对未来的随机结果形成某种信念。随着时间的推移，个体可能会私下或主观地获得更多信息，直到最终结果被揭示。如何设计一个协议，促使个体以最优化方式在最初就披露他对最终结果的预期以及他预期会收到的信息，以及他私下获得的哪些信息？该协议可以为个体提供仅依赖于结果实现及其报告的收益。我们开发了一个框架来设计这样的协议，并将其应用于构建简单的机制，以处理常见的动态环境。该框架具有通用性：我们证明，对于任何数量的周期和大量的结果集合，都存在策略证明协议。对于这些更通用的设置，我们构建了一族基于选择菜单层次结构的策略证明协议，并证明任何策略证明协议都可以用这一族协议来近似实现。

abstract.text: This paper develops a general framework to study how misinterpreting information impacts learning. Our main result is a simple criterion to characterize long‐run beliefs based on the underlying form of misspecification. We present this characterization in the context of social learning, then highlight how it applies to other learning environments, including individual learning. A key contribution is that our characterization applies to settings with model heterogeneity and provides conditions for entrenched disagreement. Our characterization can be used to determine whether a representative agent approach is valid in the face of heterogeneity, study how differing levels of bias or unawareness of others' biases impact learning, and explore whether the impact of a bias is sensitive to parametric specification or the source of information. This unified framework synthesizes insights gleaned from previously studied forms of misspecification and provides novel insights in specific applications, as we demonstrate in settings with partisan bias, overreaction, naive learning, and level‐k reasoning.

10.3982/ecta15318.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个通用框架，用于研究信息误读如何影响学习过程。我们的主要成果是一个简单的标准，用于根据模型误设的潜在形式来表征长期信念。我们在社会学习的背景下提出了这一表征方法，并强调了其如何适用于其他学习环境，包括个体学习。我们的一个关键贡献是，该表征方法适用于具有模型异质性的情境，并提供了导致根深蒂固分歧的条件。该表征方法可用于判断在异质性情况下代表性代理方法是否有效，研究不同水平的偏见或对其他人偏见的无意识如何影响学习，以及偏见的影响是否对参数化规范或信息来源敏感。这一统一框架综合了先前研究中的误设形式所得出的见解，并在特定应用中提供了新的见解，例如在党派偏见、过度反应、天真学习和水平k推理等情境下。

abstract.text: We propose a bootstrap procedure for data that may exhibit cluster‐dependence in two or more dimensions. The asymptotic distribution of the sample mean or other statistics may be non‐Gaussian if observations are dependent but uncorrelated within clusters. We show that there exists no procedure for estimating the limiting distribution of the sample mean under two‐way clustering that achieves uniform consistency. However, we propose bootstrap procedures that achieve adaptivity with respect to different uniformity criteria. Important cases and extensions discussed in the paper include regression inference, U‐ and V‐statistics, subgraph counts for network data, and non‐exhaustive samples of matched data.

10.3982/ecta15383.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于具有两个或更多维度聚类依赖性的数据的自助法程序。如果观测值之间存在依赖性，但在聚类内部是不相关的，那么样本均值或其他统计量的渐近分布可能并非高斯分布。我们证明，在双聚类条件下，不存在一种能够实现均匀一致性的方法来估计样本均值的极限分布。然而，我们提出了一些自助法程序，这些程序能够适应不同的均匀性标准。本文讨论的重要案例和扩展包括回归推断、U统计量和V统计量、网络数据的子图计数，以及非穷尽匹配数据样本。

abstract.text: Heteroskedasticity‐ and autocorrelation‐robust (HAR) inference in time series regression typically involves kernel estimation of the long‐run variance. Conventional wisdom holds that, for a given kernel, the choice of truncation parameter trades off a test's null rejection rate and power, and that this tradeoff differs across kernels. We formalize this intuition: using higher‐order expansions, we provide a unified size‐power frontier for both kernel and weighted orthonormal series tests using nonstandard “fixed‐ b ” critical values. We also provide a frontier for the subset of these tests for which the fixed‐ b distribution is t or F . These frontiers are respectively achieved by the QS kernel and equal‐weighted periodogram. The frontiers have simple closed‐form expressions, which show that the price paid for restricting attention to tests with t and F critical values is small. The frontiers are derived for the Gaussian multivariate location model, but simulations suggest the qualitative findings extend to stochastic regressors.

10.3982/ecta15404.abstractZh: 在时间序列回归中，针对异方差性和自相关性的稳健性推断通常涉及对长期方差的核估计。传统观点认为，对于给定的核函数，截断参数的选择会权衡检验的零假设拒绝率与功效，而且这种权衡会因核函数的不同而变化。我们对此直觉进行了形式化：通过使用更高阶的扩展，我们为核函数加权正交序列检验提供了一个统一的尺寸-功效边界，这些边界使用了非标准的“固定b”临界值。我们还为那些固定b分布为t分布或F分布的检验子集提供了一个边界。这些边界分别由QS核函数和等权重周期图实现。这些边界具有简单的封闭形式表达式，表明将注意力集中在t分布和F分布临界值上的代价是较小的。这些边界是针对高斯多元定位模型推导出来的，但模拟结果表明，这些发现同样适用于随机回归变量。

abstract.text: A firm selects applicants to hire based on hard information, such as a test result, and soft information, such as a manager's evaluation of an interview. The contract that the firm offers to the manager can be thought of as a restriction on acceptance rates as a function of test results. I characterize optimal acceptance rate functions both when the firm knows the manager's mix of information and biases and when the firm is uncertain. These contracts may admit a simple implementation in which the manager can accept any set of applicants with a sufficiently high average test score.

10.3982/ecta15510.abstractZh: 一家公司根据硬信息（如测试结果）和软信息（如经理对面试的评价）来选拔员工。公司提供给经理的契约可以被视为对接受率的限制，这种限制取决于测试结果。我描述了在公司了解经理所拥有的信息组合及其偏见的情况下，以及公司在不确定情况下的最优接受率函数。这些契约可能通过一种简单的实施方式来实现，即经理可以接受任何平均测试分数较高的员工。

abstract.text: Centralized markets reduce search for buyers and sellers. Their “thickness” increases the chance of order execution at nearly competitive prices. In spite of the incentives to consolidate, some markets, securities markets and on‐line advertising being the most notable, are fragmented into multiple trading venues. We argue that fragmentation is an inevitable feature of any centralized market except in special circumstances.

10.3982/ecta15579.abstractZh: 集中式市场减少了买卖双方的搜索行为。其“厚度”增加了以接近竞争价格完成订单执行的机会。尽管有整合的激励措施，但一些市场，尤其是证券市场和在线广告市场，仍然被分割成多个交易场所。我们认为，除了特殊情况外，市场分割是任何集中式市场不可避免的特征。

abstract.text: We conduct inference on volatility with noisy high‐frequency data. We assume the observed transaction price follows a continuous‐time Itô‐semimartingale, contaminated by a discrete‐time moving‐average noise process associated with the arrival of trades. We estimate volatility, defined as the quadratic variation of the semimartingale, by maximizing the likelihood of a misspecified moving‐average model, with its order selected based on an information criterion. Our inference is uniformly valid over a large class of noise processes whose magnitude and dependence structure vary with sample size. We show that the convergence rate of our estimator dominates n 1/4 as noise vanishes, and is determined by the selected order of noise dependence when noise is sufficiently small. Our implementation guarantees positive estimates in finite samples.

10.3982/ecta15593.abstractZh: 我们对含有噪声的高频数据进行了波动性推断。我们假设观测到的交易价格遵循连续时间的Itô半鞅，并受到与交易到达相关的离散时间移动平均噪声过程的污染。我们通过最大化一个误设的移动平均模型的似然函数来估计波动性，该模型的阶数是根据信息准则选定的。我们的推断在大量噪声过程中均具有一致性，这些噪声的幅度和依赖结构随样本大小而变化。我们证明了当噪声消失时，我们估计量的收敛速率以n 1/4为上限，并且当噪声足够小时，收敛速率由噪声依赖的选定阶数决定。我们的实现方法保证了在有限样本情况下估计值为正。

abstract.text: We use data from Hungary to establish two results about the relationship between the government and the media. (i) We document large advertising favors from the government to connected media, and large corruption coverage favors from connected media to the government. Our empirical strategy exploits sharp reallocations around changes in media ownership and other events to rule out market‐based explanations. (ii) Under the assumptions of a structural model, we distinguish between owner ideology and favor exchange as the mechanism driving favors. We estimate our model exploiting within‐owner changes in coverage for identification and find that both mechanisms are important. These results imply that targeted government advertising can meaningfully influence content. Counterfactuals show that targeted advertising can also influence owner ideology, by making media ownership more profitable to pro‐government connected investors. Our results are consistent with qualitative evidence from many democracies and suggest that government advertising affects media content worldwide.

10.3982/ecta15641.abstractZh: 我们利用匈牙利的数据得出了两个关于政府与媒体关系的结果。(i)我们发现政府向相关媒体提供了大量广告支持，同时相关媒体也向政府提供了大量的腐败报道支持。我们的实证策略通过利用媒体所有权变化及其他事件带来的显著重新分配现象，排除了市场因素的解释。(ii)在结构模型的假设下，我们区分了所有者意识形态和利益交换作为推动这种支持的机制。我们通过利用内部所有者之间的报道变化来进行模型估计，发现这两种机制都很重要。这些结果表明，有针对性的政府广告能够显著影响内容。反事实分析表明，有针对性的广告还可以影响所有者意识形态，使媒体所有权对支持政府的投资者来说更具盈利性。我们的结果与许多民主国家的定性证据一致，表明政府广告在全球范围内影响着媒体内容。

abstract.text: In many areas, practitioners seek to use observational data to learn a treatment assignment policy that satisfies application‐specific constraints, such as budget, fairness, simplicity, or other functional form constraints. For example, policies may be restricted to take the form of decision trees based on a limited set of easily observable individual characteristics. We propose a new approach to this problem motivated by the theory of semiparametrically efficient estimation. Our method can be used to optimize either binary treatments or infinitesimal nudges to continuous treatments, and can leverage observational data where causal effects are identified using a variety of strategies, including selection on observables and instrumental variables. Given a doubly robust estimator of the causal effect of assigning everyone to treatment, we develop an algorithm for choosing whom to treat, and establish strong guarantees for the asymptotic utilitarian regret of the resulting policy.

10.3982/ecta15732.abstractZh: 在许多领域，从业者试图利用观测数据来制定满足特定应用约束的处理分配策略，这些约束包括预算、公平性、简洁性或其他功能形式约束。例如，这些策略可能仅限于基于一组易于观测的个体特征来构建决策树。我们提出了一种基于半参数有效估计理论的新方法来解决这一问题。我们的方法可以用于优化二元处理或连续处理的微小调整，并且能够利用观测数据，其中因果效应可以通过多种策略来识别，包括基于可观测变量和工具变量的选择。在获得了将所有人分配到处理组的因果效应的双重稳健估计器之后，我们开发了一种选择处理对象的算法，并为由此产生的策略的渐近功利性遗憾提供了强有力的保证。

abstract.text: Quantile factor models (QFM) represent a new class of factor models for high‐dimensional panel data. Unlike approximate factor models (AFM), which only extract mean factors, QFM also allow unobserved factors to shift other relevant parts of the distributions of observables. We propose a quantile regression approach, labeled Quantile Factor Analysis (QFA), to consistently estimate all the quantile‐dependent factors and loadings. Their asymptotic distributions are established using a kernel‐smoothed version of the QFA estimators. Two consistent model selection criteria, based on information criteria and rank minimization, are developed to determine the number of factors at each quantile. QFA estimation remains valid even when the idiosyncratic errors exhibit heavy‐tailed distributions. An empirical application illustrates the usefulness of QFA by highlighting the role of extra factors in the forecasts of U.S. GDP growth and inflation rates using a large set of predictors.

10.3982/ecta15746.abstractZh: 分位数因子模型（QFM）代表了一种用于高维面板数据的新因子模型类别。与仅提取均值因子的近似因子模型不同，QFM还允许未观测到的因子对观测变量的分布中的其他相关部分产生影响。我们提出了一种分位数回归方法，称为分位数因子分析（QFA），以一致地估计所有与分位数相关的因子及其载荷。这些因子的渐近分布是通过对QFA估计量进行核平滑处理来确定的。我们提出了两个基于信息准则和秩最小化的一致模型选择标准，用于确定每个分位数的因子数量。即使特异性误差呈现重尾分布，QFA估计仍然有效。一个实证应用通过展示QFA在预测美国GDP增长和通货膨胀率时的有效性，证明了其重要性。

abstract.text: This paper models the evolution of organizations that allow free entry and exit of members, such as cities and trade unions. In each period, current members choose a policy for the organization. Policy changes attract newcomers and drive away dissatisfied members, altering the set of future policymakers. The resulting feedback effects take the organization down a “slippery slope” that converges to a myopically stable policy, even if the agents are forward‐looking, but convergence becomes slower the more patient they are. The model yields a tractable characterization of the steady state and the transition dynamics. The analysis is also extended to situations in which the organization can exclude members, such as enfranchisement and immigration.

10.3982/ecta15873.abstractZh: 本文对允许成员自由加入和退出组织的机构进行了建模，例如城市和工会。在每个时期，现有成员会为组织选择一个政策。政策的改变会吸引新成员并驱逐不满的成员，从而改变未来政策制定者的构成。由此产生的反馈效应使组织陷入一个“滑坡式”的发展过程，最终趋向于一种近视稳定的政策，即使参与者具有前瞻性思维。不过，他们的耐心越足，收敛过程就越慢。该模型为稳态和转型动态提供了易于理解的表征。此外，分析还扩展到了组织可以排除成员的情况，例如公民权利授予和移民问题。

abstract.text: We revisit the causes, welfare consequences, and policy implications of the dispersion in households' labor market outcomes using a model with uninsurable risk, incomplete asset markets, and home production. Allowing households to be heterogeneous in both their disutility of home work and their home production efficiency, we find that home production amplifies welfare‐based differences, meaning that inequality in standards of living is larger than we thought. We infer significant home production efficiency differences across households because hours working at home do not covary with consumption and wages in the cross section of households. Heterogeneity in home production efficiency is essential for inequality, as home production would not amplify inequality if differences at home only reflected heterogeneity in disutility of work.

10.3982/ecta15966.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了家庭在劳动力市场表现中的差异的原因、福利后果以及政策影响。我们的模型考虑了不可保险的风险、不完善的资产市场以及家庭生产等因素。研究发现，家庭在居家工作的不满意度以及家庭生产效率方面的异质性，会加剧基于福利的差异，这意味着生活水平的差距比我们想象的要大。由于家庭在居家工作的小时数与消费和工资之间没有相关性，我们推断家庭之间的家庭生产效率存在显著差异。家庭生产效率的异质性对于不平等现象至关重要，因为如果家庭内部的差异仅反映工作不满意度方面的异质性，那么家庭生产就不会加剧不平等。

abstract.text: To measure the benefits of formal contract enforcement for society, I create a market with merchants and buyers, in which buyers can choose whether to buy, and whether to pay. A set of multiple “state‐favored” ethnic groups control the state. I experimentally vary whether formal contracts are required and the composition of buyer‐merchant pairs. The design separately identifies the effect of the contracts on the buyers' incentive to pay and on their incentive to buy. I document two ways in which society limits the benefits of contracts. First, contracts reduce buyer cheating, thus increasing merchants' profits, if, and only if, the merchant is state‐favored. Buyers' beliefs suggest that the merchants can enforce the contracts if, and only if, the merchant is state‐favored. Second, holding constant whether the pair is state‐favored, contracts only influence buyer choices when the buyer and the merchant belong to two, different, state‐favored ethnic groups. Buyers' choices and beliefs confirm that, in that case, the contracts are expected to be enforceable, but they have no effect on buyers' choices because reputation already governs the incentives to cheat within groups. The findings temper the view of the state as independent from society, offer a rationale for why contracts are not adopted, and nuance the notion of state weakness.

10.3982/ecta16083.abstractZh: 为了衡量正式合同执行对社会的益处，我构建了一个由商人和买家组成的市场，买家可以决定是否购买以及是否支付。一组多个“受国家青睐”的族群控制着国家。我通过实验来研究是否要求签订正式合同以及买家与商人配对的情况。该设计分别考察了合同对买家支付意愿和购买意愿的影响。我发现了社会限制合同益处的两种方式。首先，如果商人受到国家青睐，合同可以减少买家的欺诈行为，从而增加商人的利润。买家的信念表明，只有在这种情况下，商人才能执行合同。其次，即使保持商人是否属于同一受国家青睐的族群不变，合同也只有在买家和商人属于两个不同的受国家青睐的族群时，才会影响买家的选择。买家的选择和信念表明，在这种情况下，合同是可以执行的，但它们对买家的选择没有影响，因为声誉已经决定了群体内部的欺诈动机。这些发现削弱了将国家视为独立于社会的观点，为合同未被采纳提供了理由，并使得“国家弱势”的概念更加复杂化。

abstract.text: We develop a model of international tariff negotiations to study the design of the institutional rules of the GATT/WTO. A key principle of the GATT/WTO is its most‐favored‐nation (MFN) requirement of nondiscrimination, a principle that has long been criticized for inviting free‐riding behavior. We embed a multisector model of international trade into a model of interconnected bilateral negotiations over tariffs and assess the value of the MFN principle. Using 1990 trade flows and tariff outcomes from the Uruguay Round of GATT/WTO negotiations, we estimate the model and use it to simulate what would happen if the MFN requirement were abandoned and countries negotiated over discriminatory tariffs. We find that if tariff bargaining in the Uruguay Round had proceeded without the MFN requirement, it would have wiped out the world real income gains that MFN tariff bargaining in the Uruguay Round produced and would have instead led to a small reduction in world real income relative to the 1990 status quo.

10.3982/ecta16084.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个国际关税谈判模型，以研究GATT/WTO制度规则的设计。GATT/WTO的一个关键原则是最惠国原则，即不歧视原则，这一原则长期以来一直受到批评，因为它可能导致搭便车行为。我们将一个多部门国际贸易模型嵌入到一个相互关联的双边关税谈判模型中，并评估最惠国原则的合理性。利用1990年GATT/WTO谈判的贸易流量和关税结果，我们对该模型进行了估算，并用它来模拟如果放弃最惠国原则，各国进行歧视性关税谈判时会发生什么情况。研究发现，如果乌拉圭回合的关税谈判不遵循最惠国原则，那么它将抵消乌拉圭回合中最惠国关税谈判带来的全球实际收入增长，反而会导致全球实际收入相对于1990年现状略有下降。

abstract.text: We introduce random evolving lotteries to study preference for non‐instrumental information. Each period, the agent enjoys a flow payoff from holding a lottery that will resolve at the terminal date. We provide a representation theorem for non‐separable risk consumption preferences and use it to characterize agents' attitude to non‐instrumental information. To address applications, we characterize peak‐trough utilities that aggregate trajectories of flow utilities linearly but, in addition, put weight on the best (peak) and worst (trough) lotteries along each path. We show that the model is consistent with recent experimental evidence on attitudes to information, including a preference for gradual arrival of good news and the ostrich effect, that is, decision makers' tendency to prefer information after good news to information after bad news.

10.3982/ecta16190.abstractZh: 我们引入随机演变的彩票模型来研究对非工具性信息的偏好。在每个时期，代理人都会因持有彩票而获得流收益，该收益将在终止日期结算。我们为不可分离的风险消费偏好提供了一个表征定理，并利用该定理来描述代理人对非工具性信息的态度。为了应用于实际情境，我们描述了一种峰谷效用函数，该函数能够线性地聚合流效用，并且还会根据每条路径中最佳（峰）和最差（谷）彩票的重要性进行加权。我们证明该模型与最近关于信息态度的实验证据是一致的，包括对于良好消息的逐步传递的偏好，以及“鸵鸟效应”——即决策者倾向于在良好消息之后获取信息，而不是在坏消息之后。

abstract.text: We formulate a stability notion for two‐sided pairwise matching problems with individually insignificant agents in distributional form. Matchings are formulated as joint distributions over the characteristics of the populations to be matched. Spaces of characteristics can be high‐dimensional and need not be compact. Stable matchings exist with and without transfers, and stable matchings correspond precisely to limits of stable matchings for finite‐agent models. We can embed existing continuum matching models and stability notions with transferable utility as special cases of our model and stability notion. In contrast to finite‐agent matching models, stable matchings exist under a general class of externalities.

10.3982/ecta16228.abstractZh: 我们为具有个体无意义的代理人的双边匹配问题提出了稳定性概念，并以分布形式表述。匹配被表述为对待匹配人群特征的联合分布。特征空间可能是高维的，并不一定需要是紧凑的。稳定匹配在存在和不存在转移的情况下都存在，而稳定匹配恰好对应于有限代理人模型中稳定匹配的极限情况。我们可以将现有的连续匹配模型和具有可转移效用的稳定性概念作为我们模型和稳定性概念的特殊情况来嵌入。与有限代理人匹配模型不同，稳定匹配在一般类别的外部性下也存在。

abstract.text: This paper develops inference methods for the iterated overidentified Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimator. We provide conditions for the existence of the iterated estimator and an asymptotic distribution theory, which allows for mild misspecification. Moment misspecification causes bias in conventional GMM variance estimators, which can lead to severely oversized hypothesis tests. We show how to consistently estimate the correct asymptotic variance matrix. Our simulation results show that our methods are properly sized under both correct specification and mild to moderate misspecification. We illustrate the method with an application to the model of Acemoglu, Johnson, Robinson, and Yared (2008).

10.3982/ecta16274.abstractZh: 本文开发了用于迭代过识别的广义矩估计量估计器的推断方法。我们提出了迭代估计量存在的条件以及渐近分布理论，这些理论允许轻微的模型设定错误。矩估计的设定错误会导致传统广义矩估计量方差估计的偏差，进而可能导致假设检验的过度显著性。我们展示了如何一致地估计正确的渐近方差矩阵。我们的模拟结果表明，在模型设定正确或存在轻微至中度设定错误的情况下，我们的方法都能得到适当的估计结果。我们通过一个应用于Acemoglu、Johnson、Robinson和Yared（2008）模型的例子来说明该方法的应用。

abstract.text: We study the joint evolution of the sectoral composition and the investment rate of developing economies. Using panel data for several countries in different stages of development, we document three novel facts: (a) the share of industry and the investment rate are strongly correlated and follow a hump‐shaped profile with development, (b) investment goods contain more domestic value added from industry and less from services than consumption goods do, and (c) the evolution of the sectoral composition of investment and consumption goods differs from the one of GDP. We build a multi‐sector growth model to fit these patterns and provide two important results. First, the hump‐shaped evolution of investment demand explains half of the hump in industry with development. Second, asymmetric sectoral productivity growth helps explain the decline in the relative price of investment goods along the development path, which in turn increases capital accumulation and promotes growth.

10.3982/ecta16295.abstractZh: 我们研究了发展中国家行业构成与投资率的联合演变。通过采用多个处于不同发展阶段的国家的面板数据，我们发现了三个新的现象：(a) 工业占比与投资率之间存在强烈相关性，并随着发展呈现出驼峰状分布；(b) 投资品包含的工业国内附加值高于服务品，而消费品则相反；(c) 投资品与消费品的行业构成演变与GDP的演变不同。我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来拟合这些模式，并得出了两个重要结论。首先，投资需求的驼峰状演变解释了工业发展中一半的驼峰现象。其次，不对称的部门生产率增长有助于解释投资品相对价格随发展路径的下降，这反过来促进了资本积累和经济增长。

abstract.text: A profit‐maximizing seller has a single unit of a good to sell. The bidders have a pure common value that is drawn from a distribution that is commonly known. The seller does not know the bidders' beliefs about the value and thinks that beliefs are designed adversarially by Nature to minimize profit. We construct a strong maxmin solution to this joint mechanism design and information design problem, consisting of a mechanism, an information structure, and an equilibrium, such that neither the seller nor Nature can move profit in their respective preferred directions, even if the deviator can select the new equilibrium. The mechanism and information structure solve a family of maxmin mechanism design and minmax information design problems, regardless of how an equilibrium is selected. The maxmin mechanism takes the form of a proportional auction : each bidder submits a one‐dimensional bid, the aggregate allocation and aggregate payment depend on the aggregate bid, and individual allocations and payments are proportional to bids. We report a number of additional properties of the maxmin mechanisms, including what happens as the number of bidders grows large and robustness with respect to the prior over the value.

10.3982/ecta16297.abstractZh: 一个追求利润最大化的卖家拥有单一单位的商品可供出售。竞买者拥有来自已知分布的纯共同价值。卖家不知道竞买者对于价值的信念，并认为这些信念是自然界为了最小化利润而设计的。我们为这一联合机制设计和信息设计问题构建了一个强的最大最小解，该解包括一个机制、一个信息结构以及一个均衡，使得卖家和自然都无法朝着各自偏好的方向改变利润，即使偏离者能够选择新的均衡。该机制和信息结构解决了包括最大最小机制设计和最小最大信息设计问题的一系列问题，无论均衡是如何选择的。最大最小机制采用比例拍卖的形式：每个竞买者提交一个一维出价，总分配和总支付取决于总出价，而个体分配和支付与出价成正比。我们报告了最大最小机制的若干额外特性，包括当竞买者数量增加时会发生什么，以及其对价值先验的鲁棒性。

abstract.text: We present a new multi‐sector growth model that features nonhomothetic, constant elasticity of substitution preferences, and accommodates long‐run demand and supply drivers of structural change for an arbitrary number of sectors. The model is consistent with the decline in agriculture, the hump‐shaped evolution of manufacturing, and the rise of services over time. We estimate the demand system derived from the model using household‐level data from the United States and India, as well as historical aggregate‐level panel data for 39 countries during the postwar period. The estimated model parsimoniously accounts for the broad patterns of sectoral reallocation observed among rich, miracle, and developing economies. Our estimates support the presence of strong nonhomotheticity across time, income levels, and countries. We find that income effects account for the bulk of the within‐country evolution of sectoral reallocation.

10.3982/ecta16317.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个新的多部门增长模型，该模型具有非齐次性、恒定的替代弹性偏好，并且能够适应任意数量部门的长期需求和供应驱动因素，从而解释结构性变化。该模型与农业的衰退、制造业的驼峰型演变以及服务业随时间的崛起相一致。我们使用来自美国和印度的家庭层面数据，以及战后39个国家的历史总体面板数据，来估算该模型所推导出的需求系统。估计结果表明，该模型能够简洁地解释富裕国家、奇迹国家和发展中国家之间部门再分配的大致模式。我们的估计结果支持了一个观点，即在不同时间、收入水平和国家之间，非齐次性现象普遍存在。我们发现，收入效应在解释国家内部部门再分配的过程中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We provide general formulation of weak identification in semiparametric models and an efficiency concept. Weak identification occurs when a parameter is weakly regular, that is, when it is locally homogeneous of degree zero. When this happens, consistent or equivariant estimation is shown to be impossible. We then show that there exists an underlying regular parameter that fully characterizes the weakly regular parameter. While this parameter is not unique, concepts of sufficiency and minimality help pin down a desirable one. If estimation of minimal sufficient underlying parameters is inefficient, it introduces noise in the corresponding estimation of weakly regular parameters, whence we can improve the estimators by local asymptotic Rao–Blackwellization. We call an estimator weakly efficient if it does not admit such improvement. New weakly efficient estimators are presented in linear IV and nonlinear regression models. Simulation of a linear IV model demonstrates how 2SLS and optimal IV estimators are improved.

10.3982/ecta16413.abstractZh: 我们提出了半参数模型中弱识别的一般表述，并引入了效率概念。当某个参数具有弱正则性时，即该参数在局部是零阶齐次的，就会出现弱识别现象。在这种情况下，一致估计或等变估计变得不可能。随后我们证明了存在一个潜在的正则参数，它能够完全刻画弱正则参数。虽然这个参数不是唯一的，但充分性和最小性概念有助于确定一个理想的参数。如果估计最小充分性参数效率低下，就会在相应估计弱正则参数时引入噪声，因此我们可以通过局部渐近的Rao–Blackwell化方法来改进估计量。如果一个估计量不允许这样的改进，我们称其为弱有效估计量。在线性IV和非线性回归模型中，我们提出了新的弱有效估计量。对线性IV模型的模拟表明，2SLS和最优IV估计量可以通过改进而得到改进。

abstract.text: We study optimal monetary and fiscal policies in a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, incomplete markets, and nominal rigidities. Our approach uses small‐noise expansions and Fréchet derivatives to approximate equilibria quickly and efficiently. Responses of optimal policies to aggregate shocks differ qualitatively from what they would be in a corresponding representative agent economy and are an order of magnitude larger. A motive to provide insurance that arises from heterogeneity and incomplete markets outweighs price stabilization motives.

10.3982/ecta16414.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有异质代理人、不完全市场以及名义刚性特征的新凯恩斯模型中研究最优货币政策和财政政策。我们的方法采用小噪声扩展和Fréchet导数来快速高效地近似均衡状态。最优政策对总冲击的响应在性质上与相应代表性代理人经济中的响应有所不同，其响应幅度也大一个数量级。由于异质性和不完全市场因素而产生的提供保险动机，超过了价格稳定动机的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper studies a penalized statistical decision rule for the treatment assignment problem. Consider the setting of a utilitarian policy maker who must use sample data to allocate a binary treatment to members of a population, based on their observable characteristics. We model this problem as a statistical decision problem where the policy maker must choose a subset of the covariate space to assign to treatment, out of a class of potential subsets. We focus on settings in which the policy maker may want to select amongst a collection of constrained subset classes: examples include choosing the number of covariates over which to perform best‐subset selection, and model selection when approximating a complicated class via a sieve. We adapt and extend results from statistical learning to develop the Penalized Welfare Maximization (PWM) rule. We establish an oracle inequality for the regret of the PWM rule which shows that it is able to perform model selection over the collection of available classes. We then use this oracle inequality to derive relevant bounds on maximum regret for PWM. An important consequence of our results is that we are able to formalize model‐selection using a “holdout” procedure, where the policy maker would first estimate various policies using half of the data, and then select the policy which performs the best when evaluated on the other half of the data.

10.3982/ecta16437.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种用于处理分配问题的惩罚性统计决策规则。考虑一个功利主义政策制定者的情境，他们必须利用样本数据，根据可观测的特征将二元处理分配给人群中的成员。我们将这个问题建模为一个统计决策问题，政策制定者需要从一系列潜在的子集中选择一个子集来分配处理。我们关注政策制定者可能需要在一系列受限子集中选择的情况，例如选择用于进行最佳子集选择的协变量数量，以及通过筛选法近似复杂类别时的模型选择。我们借鉴并扩展了统计学习的结果，以发展出惩罚性福利最大化规则。我们为PWM规则的遗憾值建立了一个预言不等式，表明它能够对可用的所有类别进行模型选择。然后，我们利用这个预言不等式推导出PWM最大遗憾值的相关界限。我们研究的一个重要结果是，我们能够使用“保留样本”程序来形式化模型选择，即政策制定者首先使用一半的数据估计各种政策，然后在另一半数据上评估时选择表现最好的政策。

abstract.text: How much capital should financial intermediaries hold? We propose a general equilibrium model with a financial sector that makes risky long‐term loans to firms, funded by deposits from savers. Government guarantees create a role for bank capital regulation. The model captures the sharp and persistent drop in macro‐economic aggregates and credit provision as well as the sharp change in credit spreads observed during financial crises. Policies requiring intermediaries to hold more capital reduce financial fragility, reduce the size of the financial and non‐financial sectors, and lower intermediary profits. They redistribute wealth from savers to the owners of banks and non‐financial firms. Pre‐crisis capital requirements are close to optimal. Counter‐cyclical capital requirements increase welfare.

10.3982/ecta16438.abstractZh: 金融中介应该持有多少资本？我们提出了一个一般均衡模型，其中金融部门向企业提供风险较高的长期贷款，这些贷款由储蓄者的存款提供资金。政府担保为银行资本监管创造了条件。该模型能够解释宏观经济总量和信贷供应的急剧下降，以及金融危机期间信贷利差发生的剧烈变化。要求中介持有更多资本的政策可以减少金融脆弱性，减小金融与非金融部门的规模，并降低中介的利润。这些政策将财富从储蓄者重新分配给了银行和非金融企业的所有者。危机前的资本要求接近最优水平。反周期资本要求则能够提升福利。

abstract.text: Present bias is the inclination to prefer a smaller present reward to a larger later reward, but reversing this preference when both rewards are equally delayed. Such behavior violates stationarity of temporal choices, and hence exponential discounting. This paper provides a weakening of the stationarity axiom that can accommodate present‐biased choice reversals. We call this new behavioral postulate Weak Present Bias and characterize the general class of utility functions that is consistent with it. We show that present‐biased preferences can be represented as those of a decision maker who makes her choices according to conservative present‐equivalents, in the face of uncertainty about future tastes.

10.3982/ecta16467.abstractZh: 当前偏好是指倾向于选择较小的当前奖励，而不是在较后时间获得的较大奖励，但当两种奖励的延迟时间相同时，这种偏好会逆转。这种行为违反了时间选择的稳定性原则，因此属于指数折扣现象。本文提出了一种削弱稳定性公理的方法，以容纳当前偏好逆转的情况。我们将这种新的行为假设称为“弱当前偏好”，并描述了与之一致的一般效用函数类。我们表明，当前偏好可以表现为一种决策者的行为，这种决策者在面对未来偏好不确定性的情况下，会依据保守的当前等价值来做出选择。

abstract.text: We reconsider the microeconomic foundations of financial economics. Motivated by the importance of Knightian uncertainty in markets, we present a model that does not carry any probabilistic structure ex ante, yet is based on a common order. We derive the fundamental equivalence of economic viability of asset prices and absence of arbitrage. We also obtain a modified version of the fundamental theorem of asset pricing using the notion of sublinear pricing measures. Different versions of the efficient market hypothesis are related to the assumptions one is willing to impose on the common order.

10.3982/ecta16535.abstractZh: 我们重新探讨了金融经济学的微观经济基础。鉴于奈特不确定性在市场中的重要性，我们提出了一个模型，该模型在事前并不包含任何概率结构，但基于一个共同的秩序。我们推导出了资产价格的经济可行性与不存在套利行为之间的基本等价关系。我们还利用次线性定价概念，得到了资产定价基本定理的修改版本。不同版本的有效市场假说与人们对共同秩序的假设有关。

abstract.text: Most assets clear independently rather than jointly. This paper presents a model based on the uniform‐price double auction which accommodates arbitrary restrictions on market clearing, including independent clearing across assets (allowed when demand for each asset is contingent only on the price of that asset) and joint market clearing for all assets (required when demand for each asset is contingent on the prices of all assets). Additional trading protocols for traded assets—neutral when the market clears jointly—are generally not redundant innovations, even if all traders participate in all protocols. Multiple trading protocols that clear independently can be designed to be at least as efficient as joint market clearing for all assets. The change in price impact brought by independence in market clearing can overcome the loss of information, and enhance diversification and risk sharing. Except when the market is competitive, market characteristics should guide innovation in trading technology.

10.3982/ecta16537.abstractZh: 大多数资产是独立清算的，而非共同清算。本文提出了一个基于统一价格双边拍卖的模型，该模型能够适应对市场清算的任意限制，包括资产之间的独立清算（当每种资产的需求仅取决于该资产的价格时允许）以及所有资产的共同市场清算（当每种资产的需求取决于所有资产的价格时要求）。对于已交易的资产而言，额外的交易协议在共同清算时通常是多余的，即使所有交易者都参与所有协议。可以设计出多个独立清算的交易协议，其效率至少与所有资产的共同市场清算相当。市场清算的独立性带来的价格影响变化可以弥补信息缺失，并增强多样化和风险分担。除非市场具有竞争性，否则市场特征应指导交易技术的创新。

abstract.text: Firms and governments often use R&D contests to incentivize suppliers to develop and deliver innovative products. The optimal design of such contests depends on empirical primitives: the cost of research, the uncertainty in outcomes, and the surplus participants capture. Can R&D contests in real‐world settings be redesigned to increase social surplus? I ask this question in the context of the Department of Defense's Small Business Innovation Research program, a multistage R&D contest. I develop a structural model to estimate the primitives from data on R&D and procurement contracts. I find that the optimal design substantially increases social surplus, and simple design changes in isolation (e.g., inviting more contestants) can capture up to half these gains; however, these changes reduce the DOD's own welfare. These results suggest there is substantial scope for improving the design of real‐world contests but that a designer must balance competing objectives.

10.3982/ecta16581.abstractZh: 企业和政府经常通过研发竞赛来激励供应商开发并提供创新产品。这类竞赛的最佳设计取决于几个基本因素：研究的成本、结果的不确定性以及参与者获得的收益。在现实环境中，是否可以通过重新设计研发竞赛来增加社会收益？我在国防部小型企业创新研究项目的背景下提出了这个问题，这是一个多阶段的研发竞赛。我建立了一个结构模型，利用研发和采购合同的数据来估算这些基本因素。我发现，最佳设计可以显著增加社会收益，而单独进行简单的设计改进（例如，增加参赛者数量）也能带来一半的收益；然而，这些改进会降低国防部自身的福利。这些结果表明，在现实环境中的竞赛设计方面有很大的改进空间，但设计者必须平衡各种相互竞争的目标。

abstract.text: Policymakers frequently use price regulations as a response to inequality in the markets they control. In this paper, we examine the optimal structure of such policies from the perspective of mechanism design. We study a buyer‐seller market in which agents have private information about both their valuations for an indivisible object and their marginal utilities for money. The planner seeks a mechanism that maximizes agents' total utilities, subject to incentive and market‐clearing constraints. We uncover the constrained Pareto frontier by identifying the optimal trade‐off between allocative efficiency and redistribution. We find that competitive‐equilibrium allocation is not always optimal. Instead, when there is inequality across sides of the market, the optimal design uses a tax‐like mechanism, introducing a wedge between the buyer and seller prices, and redistributing the resulting surplus to the poorer side of the market via lump‐sum payments. When there is significant same‐side inequality that can be uncovered by market behavior, it may be optimal to impose price controls even though doing so induces rationing.

10.3982/ecta16671.abstractZh: 政策制定者经常使用价格管制来应对他们所控制的市场中的不平等问题。在本文中，我们从机制设计的角度探讨了此类政策的最优结构。我们研究了一个买方-卖方市场，其中交易双方都拥有关于不可分割物品的估值以及货币边际效用的私人信息。规划者寻求一种机制，该机制能够在激励和市场清算约束的前提下最大化交易双方的总效用。我们通过确定分配效率与再分配之间的最优权衡，揭示了受限的帕累托前沿。我们发现，竞争均衡的分配并不总是最优的。相反，当市场各方之间存在不平等时，最优设计采用类似税收的机制，在买方和卖方价格之间引入一个差价，并通过一次性支付将由此产生的剩余重新分配给市场中的贫困方。当市场行为能够揭示出显著的同侧不平等时，即使这样做会导致资源分配的不公平，实施价格管制也可能是最优的。

abstract.text: This paper presents a continuous‐time model of sovereign debt. In it, a relatively impatient sovereign government's hidden type switches back and forth between a commitment type, which cannot default, and an opportunistic type, which can, and where we assume outside lenders have particular beliefs regarding how a commitment type should borrow for any given level of debt and bond price. In any Markov equilibrium, the opportunistic type mimics the commitment type when borrowing, revealing its type only by defaulting on its debt at random times. The equilibrium features a “graduation date”: a finite amount of time since the last default, after which time reputation reaches its highest level and is unaffected by not defaulting. Before such date, not defaulting always increases the country's reputation. For countries that have recently defaulted, bond prices and the total amount of debt are increasing functions of the amount of time since the country's last default. For countries that have not recently defaulted (i.e., those that have graduated), bond prices are constant.

10.3982/ecta16685.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个连续时间模型，用于研究主权债务。在该模型中，一个相对急躁的主权政府所采用的隐藏类型会在两种类型之间交替：一种是无法违约的承诺型，另一种是能够违约的机会主义型。我们假设外部债权人对于承诺型政府在特定债务水平和债券价格下应如何借款有特定的看法。在任何马尔可夫均衡中，机会主义型政府在借款时会模仿承诺型政府的行为，其类型仅通过随机时间的违约行为来揭示。该均衡存在一个“毕业日期”：自上次违约以来的有限时间，在此日期之后，声誉达到最高水平，并且不受不违约的影响。在该日期之前，不违约总是能够提升国家的声誉。对于最近违约的国家来说，债券价格和总债务量都是自上次违约以来的时间的增函数。而对于那些最近没有违约的国家（即已经毕业的国家），债券价格是恒定的。

abstract.text: The location of individuals determines their job and schooling opportunities, amenities, and housing costs. We conceptualize the location choice of individuals as a decision to invest in a “location asset.” This asset has a current cost equal to the location's rent, and a future payoff through better job and schooling opportunities. As with any asset, savers in the location asset transfer resources into the future by going to expensive locations with high future returns. In contrast, borrowers transfer resources to the present by going to cheap locations that offer few other advantages. Holdings of the location asset depend on its comparison to other assets, with the distinction that the location asset is not subject to borrowing constraints. We propose a dynamic location model and derive an agent's mobility choices after experiencing income shocks. We document the investment dimension of location and confirm the core predictions of our theory using French individual panel data from tax returns.

10.3982/ecta16699.abstractZh: 个人的地理位置决定了他们获得工作和教育机会、便利设施以及住房成本的可能性。我们将个人的位置选择视为一种对“位置资产”的投资决策。这种资产当前的成本等同于该位置的租金，而其未来的收益则来自于更好的工作和教育机会。与任何资产一样，持有位置资产的储蓄者通过将资源转移到未来回报较高的昂贵位置来实现资源的未来增值。相比之下，借款者则通过将资源转移到当前、且其他优势较少的便宜位置来实现资源的当前增值。持有位置资产的数量取决于该资产与其他资产之间的比较，其独特之处在于位置资产不受借款限制的影响。我们提出了一个动态位置模型，并推导出了在经历收入冲击后代理人的流动选择。我们通过法国个人税收申报数据验证了位置选择的投资维度，并确认了我们理论的核心预测。

abstract.text: This paper draws parallels between the principal components analysis of factorless high‐dimensional nonstationary data and the classical spurious regression. We show that a few of the principal components of such data absorb nearly all the data variation. The corresponding scree plot suggests that the data contain a few factors, which is corroborated by the standard panel information criteria. Furthermore, the Dickey–Fuller tests of the unit root hypothesis applied to the estimated “idiosyncratic terms” often reject, creating an impression that a few factors are responsible for most of the nonstationarity in the data. We warn empirical researchers of these peculiar effects and suggest to always compare the analysis in levels with that in differences.

10.3982/ecta16703.abstractZh: 本文将无因子的高维非平稳数据的主成分分析与经典的虚假回归方法进行了对比。我们发现，这类数据的主成分中，有相当一部分能够解释几乎所有的数据变异。相应的碎石图表明，数据包含几个主要因子，这一结论得到了标准面板信息准则的支持。此外，对估计出的“特异性项”进行的Dickey–Fuller单位根检验往往会产生拒绝结果，从而让人认为少数几个因子负责了数据中的大部分非平稳性。我们提醒实证研究者注意这些特殊效应，并建议始终在水平层面与差异层面进行比较分析。

abstract.text: A sender ranks information structures knowing that a receiver processes the information before choosing an action affecting them both. The sender and receiver may differ in their utility functions and/or prior beliefs, yielding a model of dynamic inconsistency when they represent the same individual at two points in time. I take as primitive (i) a collection of preference orderings over all information structures, indexed by menus of acts (the sender's ex ante preferences for information), and (ii) a collection of correspondences over menus of acts, indexed by signals (the receiver's signal‐contingent choice(s) from menus). I provide axiomatic representation theorems characterizing the sender as a sophisticated planner and the receiver as a Bayesian information processor, and show that all parameters can be uniquely identified from the sender's preferences for information. I also establish a series of results characterizing common priors, common utility functions, and intuitive measures of disagreement for these parameters—all in terms of the sender's preferences for information.

10.3982/ecta16729.abstractZh: 发送者根据信息结构进行排序，同时知道接收者在采取行动之前会先处理这些信息。发送者和接收者在效用函数和/或先验信念方面可能存在差异，这导致在他们在两个时间点代表同一个个体时，会形成一个动态不一致模型。我将以下两个集合视为基本元素：(i) 所有信息结构上的偏好排序集合，这些排序由行动菜单索引（发送者对信息的先验偏好）；(ii) 行动菜单上的对应关系集合，这些对应关系由信号索引（接收者根据信号做出的选择）。我提供了公理表示定理，描述了发送者作为复杂的规划者，以及接收者作为贝叶斯信息处理者的情况。我还证明了所有参数都可以从发送者对信息的偏好中唯一确定出来。此外，我还建立了一系列结果，描述了这些参数的共同先验、共同效用函数以及直观的不一致度量——所有这些都基于发送者对信息的偏好。

abstract.text: This paper reconciles the asymptotic disagreement between Bayesian and frequentist inference in set‐identified models by adopting a multiple‐prior (robust) Bayesian approach. We propose new tools for Bayesian inference in set‐identified models and show that they have a well‐defined posterior interpretation in finite samples and are asymptotically valid from the frequentist perspective. The main idea is to construct a prior class that removes the source of the disagreement: the need to specify an unrevisable prior for the structural parameter given the reduced‐form parameter. The corresponding class of posteriors can be summarized by reporting the ‘posterior lower and upper probabilities’ of a given event and/or the ‘set of posterior means’ and the associated ‘robust credible region’. We show that the set of posterior means is a consistent estimator of the true identified set and the robust credible region has the correct frequentist asymptotic coverage for the true identified set if it is convex. Otherwise, the method provides posterior inference about the convex hull of the identified set. For impulse‐response analysis in set‐identified Structural Vector Autoregressions, the new tools can be used to overcome or quantify the sensitivity of standard Bayesian inference to the choice of an unrevisable prior.

10.3982/ecta16773.abstractZh: 本文通过采用多先验（稳健）贝叶斯方法，解决了集合识别模型中贝叶斯推断与频率主义推断之间的渐近分歧问题。我们提出了用于集合识别模型中的贝叶斯推断的新工具，并证明这些工具在有限样本中具有明确定义的后验解释，并且从频率主义的角度来看是渐近有效的。主要思路是构建一个先验类，以消除分歧的根源：即无需为结构参数指定不可修正的先验，因为已经给出了简化形式的参数。相应的后验类可以通过报告给定事件的“后验上下概率”以及“后验均值集合”和相关的“稳健可信区域”来概括。我们证明，后验均值集合是真实识别集合的一致估计量，而如果稳健可信区域是凸的，那么该区域具有正确的频率主义渐近覆盖度。否则，该方法可以提供关于识别集合凸包的后验推断。对于集合识别的结构向量自回归模型的脉冲响应分析，这些新工具可以用来克服或量化标准贝叶斯推断对不可修正先验选择的敏感性。

abstract.text: An important goal of empirical demand analysis is choice and welfare prediction on counterfactual budget sets arising from potential policy interventions. Such predictions are more credible when made without arbitrary functional‐form/distributional assumptions, and instead based solely on economic rationality, that is, that choice is consistent with utility maximization by a heterogeneous population. This paper investigates nonparametric economic rationality in the empirically important context of binary choice. We show that under general unobserved heterogeneity, economic rationality is equivalent to a pair of Slutsky‐like shape restrictions on choice‐probability functions. The forms of these restrictions differ from Slutsky inequalities for continuous goods. Unlike McFadden–Richter's stochastic revealed preference, our shape restrictions (a) are global, that is, their forms do not depend on which and how many budget sets are observed, (b) are closed form, hence easy to impose on parametric/semi/nonparametric models in practical applications, and (c) provide computationally simple, theory‐consistent bounds on demand and welfare predictions on counterfactual budge sets.

10.3982/ecta16801.abstractZh: 实证需求分析的一个重要目标是对潜在政策干预所导致的反事实预算集合进行选择和福利预测。当这些预测不依赖于任意的函数形式/分布假设，而是完全基于经济理性时，预测结果会更加可信。经济理性意味着选择行为与异质人群的最大效用最大化是一致的。本文研究了在二元选择这一具有实证重要性的情境下非参数经济理性问题。我们证明了在一般未观测异质性条件下，经济理性等价于对选择概率函数施加一对类似Slutsky的形状限制。这些限制的形式与连续商品的Slutsky不等式不同。与McFadden–Richter的随机揭示偏好不同，我们的形状限制：(a)是全局性的，即它们的形式不依赖于观测到的预算集合的数量和类型；(b)是封闭形式的，因此在实际应用中可以很容易地应用于参数化/半参数化/非参数化模型；(c)提供了计算上简单、理论上一致的关于反事实预算集合的需求和福利预测界限。

abstract.text: We study deep neural networks and their use in semiparametric inference. We establish novel nonasymptotic high probability bounds for deep feedforward neural nets. These deliver rates of convergence that are sufficiently fast (in some cases minimax optimal) to allow us to establish valid second‐step inference after first‐step estimation with deep learning, a result also new to the literature. Our nonasymptotic high probability bounds, and the subsequent semiparametric inference, treat the current standard architecture: fully connected feedforward neural networks (multilayer perceptrons), with the now‐common rectified linear unit activation function, unbounded weights, and a depth explicitly diverging with the sample size. We discuss other architectures as well, including fixed‐width, very deep networks. We establish the nonasymptotic bounds for these deep nets for a general class of nonparametric regression‐type loss functions, which includes as special cases least squares, logistic regression, and other generalized linear models. We then apply our theory to develop semiparametric inference, focusing on causal parameters for concreteness, and demonstrate the effectiveness of deep learning with an empirical application to direct mail marketing.

10.3982/ecta16901.abstractZh: 我们研究了深度神经网络及其在半参数推断中的应用。我们为深度前馈神经网络建立了新的非渐近高概率界限。这些界限所给出的收敛速率足够快（在某些情况下甚至达到极小极大最优），使得我们可以在首次使用深度学习进行估计后，建立有效的第二步推断，这一结果在文献中也是全新的。我们的非渐近高概率界限以及后续的半参数推断方法，适用于当前的标准架构：全连接前馈神经网络（多层感知器），采用现在常见的修正线性单元激活函数，权重无限制，且深度随着样本量的增加而明确增加。我们还讨论了其他架构，包括固定宽度的非常深的网络。我们为这类深度网络建立了非渐近界限，这些界限适用于一般类别的非参数回归型损失函数，其中包括最小二乘法、逻辑回归以及其他广义线性模型作为特殊情况。随后，我们将理论应用于开发半参数推断方法，重点关注因果参数，并通过直接邮件营销的实证应用，证明了深度学习的有效性。

abstract.text: We consider estimation and inference on average treatment effects under unconfoundedness conditional on the realizations of the treatment variable and covariates. Given nonparametric smoothness and/or shape restrictions on the conditional mean of the outcome variable, we derive estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) that are optimal in finite samples when the regression errors are normal with known variance. In contrast to conventional CIs, our CIs use a larger critical value that explicitly takes into account the potential bias of the estimator. When the error distribution is unknown, feasible versions of our CIs are valid asymptotically, even when n ‐inference is not possible due to lack of overlap, or low smoothness of the conditional mean. We also derive the minimum smoothness conditions on the conditional mean that are necessary for n ‐inference. When the conditional mean is restricted to be Lipschitz with a large enough bound on the Lipschitz constant, the optimal estimator reduces to a matching estimator with the number of matches set to one. We illustrate our methods in an application to the National Supported Work Demonstration.

10.3982/ecta16907.abstractZh: 我们考虑在不受治疗变量和协变量实现条件影响的情况下，对平均处理效应进行估计和推断。在结果变量的条件均值满足非参数平滑性和/或形状限制的情况下，我们推导出在有限样本下最优的估计量和置信区间。与传统置信区间不同，我们的置信区间使用更大的临界值，明确考虑了估计量的潜在偏差。当误差分布未知时，即使由于缺乏重叠或条件均值的平滑性较低而无法进行推断，我们的置信区间在渐近意义上仍然有效。我们还推导出了进行推断所需的条件均值的最小平滑性条件。当条件均值被限制为具有足够大的Lipschitz常数时，最优估计量简化为匹配估计量，匹配数量设为1。我们在国家支持工作示范项目中的应用中展示了我们的方法。

abstract.text: We introduce a novel parametrization of the correlation matrix. The reparametrization facilitates modeling of correlation and covariance matrices by an unrestricted vector, where positive definiteness is an innate property. This parametrization can be viewed as a generalization of Fisher's Z ‐transformation to higher dimensions and has a wide range of potential applications. An algorithm for reconstructing the unique n × n correlation matrix from any vector in R n ( n − 1 ) / 2 is provided, and we derive its numerical complexity.

10.3982/ecta16910.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的相关矩阵参数化方法。这种参数化方式使得通过不受限制的向量来建模相关性和协方差矩阵变得更加容易，而正定性则是一种固有的属性。这种参数化可以被视为Fisher Z变换在更高维度上的推广，并且具有广泛的潜在应用前景。我们提供了一种从R^n中的任意向量重建唯一的n×n相关矩阵的算法，并推导了其数值复杂度。

abstract.text: We investigate learning at the workplace. To do so, we use German administrative data that contain information on the entire workforce of a sample of establishments. We document that having more‐highly‐paid coworkers is strongly associated with future wage growth, particularly if those workers earn more. Motivated by this fact, we propose a dynamic theory of a competitive labor market where firms produce using teams of heterogeneous workers that learn from each other. We develop a methodology to structurally estimate knowledge flows using the full‐richness of the German employer‐employee matched data. The methodology builds on the observation that a competitive labor market prices coworker learning. Our quantitative approach imposes minimal restrictions on firms' production functions, can be implemented on a very short panel, and allows for potentially rich and flexible coworker learning functions. In line with our reduced‐form results, learning from coworkers is significant, particularly from more knowledgeable coworkers. We show that between 4 and 9% of total worker compensation is in the form of learning and that inequality in total compensation is significantly lower than inequality in wages.

10.3982/ecta16915.abstractZh: 我们研究了工作场所中的学习现象。为此，我们使用了包含样本企业全体员工信息的德国行政数据。我们发现，拥有更高收入的同事与未来工资增长之间存在强烈关联，尤其是当这些员工收入更高时。基于这一事实，我们提出了一个动态竞争劳动力市场理论，其中企业通过由不同知识水平的员工组成的团队来协作生产。我们开发了一种方法，利用德国雇主与雇员匹配数据的全部丰富性来结构性地估计知识流动。该方法基于这样一个观察：竞争劳动力市场会重视同事之间的学习。我们的定量方法对企业的生产函数施加了最小限制，可以在非常短的时间序列上进行实施，并且允许同事学习功能具有丰富性和灵活性。与我们的简化结果一致，从同事那里学习是显著的，尤其是从知识更丰富的同事那里学习。我们显示，总员工薪酬中有4%到9%是以学习的形式存在的，而且总薪酬的不平等程度明显低于工资的不平等程度。

abstract.text: We develop a model of banking industry dynamics to study the quantitative impact of regulatory policies on bank risk‐taking and market structure. Since our model is matched to U.S. data, we propose a market structure where big banks with market power interact with small, competitive fringe banks as well as non‐bank lenders. Banks face idiosyncratic funding shocks in addition to aggregate shocks which affect the fraction of performing loans in their portfolio. A nontrivial bank size distribution arises out of endogenous entry and exit, as well as banks' buffer stock of capital. We show that the model predictions are consistent with untargeted business cycle properties, the bank lending channel, and empirical studies of the role of concentration on financial stability. We find that regulatory policies can have an important impact on banking market structure, which, along with selection effects, can generate changes in allocative efficiency and stability.

10.3982/ecta16930.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个银行行业动态模型，以研究监管政策对银行冒险行为和市场结构的影响。由于我们的模型是基于美国数据构建的，我们提出了一个市场结构模型，其中具有市场力量的大型银行与小型、竞争性的边缘银行以及非银行贷款机构相互作用。银行除了面临总体冲击外，还面临特殊的融资冲击，这些冲击会影响其投资组合中表现良好的贷款比例。银行规模的分布并非均匀，这是由于银行的内生进入和退出行为，以及银行的资本缓冲库存所决定的。我们表明，模型预测结果与无针对性的商业周期特征、银行贷款渠道以及关于集中度对金融稳定影响的实证研究是一致的。我们发现，监管政策对银行市场结构有着重要影响，这种影响，加上选择效应，可以带来分配效率和稳定性的变化。

abstract.text: A finite number of vertically differentiated firms simultaneously compete for and screen agents with private information about their payoffs. In equilibrium, higher firms serve higher types. Each firm distorts the allocation downward from the efficient level on types below a threshold, but upward above. While payoffs in this game are neither quasi‐concave nor continuous, if firms are sufficiently differentiated, then any strategy profile that satisfies a simple set of necessary conditions is a pure‐stategy equilibrium, and an equilibrium exists. A mixed‐strategy equilibrium exists even when firms are less differentiated. The welfare effects of private information are drastically different than under monopoly. The equilibrium approaches the competitive limit quickly as entry costs grow small. We solve the problem of a multi‐plant firm facing a type‐dependent outside option and use this to study the effect of mergers.

10.3982/ecta17016.abstractZh: 有限数量的垂直差异化企业同时竞争并筛选那些拥有关于自身收益私人信息的代理人。在均衡状态下，较高级别的企业提供更高类型的服务。每家企业都会使分配从有效水平向下扭曲，但在某个阈值以上则向上扭曲。虽然这一游戏中的收益既不是准凹形也不是连续的，但如果企业差异足够大，那么任何满足一组简单必要条件策略组合都构成纯策略均衡，并且均衡是存在的。即使企业差异较小，混合策略均衡也存在。私人信息的福利效应与垄断情况下截然不同。随着进入成本降低，均衡会迅速接近竞争极限。我们解决了多工厂企业面临类型依赖的外部选项的问题，并利用这一模型研究合并的影响。

abstract.text: Waitlists are often used to ration scarce resources, but the trade-offs in designing these mechanisms depend on agents' preferences. We study equilibrium allocations under alternative designs for the deceased donor kidney waitlist. We model the decision to accept an organ or wait for a preferable one as an optimal stopping problem and estimate preferences using administrative data from the New York City area. Our estimates show that while some kidney types are desirable for all patients, there is substantial match-specific heterogeneity in values. We then develop methods to evaluate alternative mechanisms, comparing their effects on patient welfare to an equivalent change in donor supply. Past reforms to the kidney waitlist primarily resulted in redistribution, with similar welfare and organ discard rates to the benchmark first come first served mechanism. These mechanisms and other commonly studied theoretical benchmarks remain far from optimal. We design a mechanism that increases patient welfare by the equivalent of an 18.2 percent increase in donor supply.

10.3982/ecta17017.abstractZh: 等待名单常被用来分配稀缺资源，但设计这些机制时的权衡取决于参与者的偏好。我们研究了不同设计下已故捐赠者肾脏等待名单的均衡分配问题。我们将接受器官与等待更理想的器官之间的决策建模为最优停止问题，并利用纽约市地区的行政数据来估计偏好。我们的估计结果显示，虽然某些肾脏类型对所有患者来说都是可取的，但不同匹配对象之间的价值存在显著差异。随后，我们开发了评估不同机制的方法，将其对患者福利的影响与等同的捐赠者供应变化进行比较。过去对肾脏等待名单的改革主要导致了资源重新分配，其福利效果和器官废弃率与传统的“先到先得”机制相当。这些机制以及其他常见的理论基准都远未达到最优状态。我们设计了一种机制，通过相当于增加18.2%的捐赠者供应来提高患者福利。

abstract.text: We examine intergenerational mobility (IM) in educational attainment in Africa since independence using census data. First, we map IM across 27 countries and more than 2,800 regions, documenting wide cross-country and especially within-country heterogeneity. Inertia looms large as differences in the literacy of the old generation explain about half of the observed spatial disparities in IM. The rural-urban divide is substantial. Though conspicuous in some countries, there is no evidence of systematic gender gaps in IM. Second, we characterize the geography of IM, finding that colonial investments in railroads and Christian missions, as well as proximity to capitals and the coastline are the strongest correlates. Third, we ask whether the regional differences in mobility reflect spatial sorting or their independent role. To isolate the two, we focus on children whose families moved when they were young. Comparing siblings, looking at moves triggered by displacement shocks, and using historical migrations to predict moving-families' destinations, we establish that, while selection is considerable, regional exposure effects are at play. An extra year spent in a high-mobility region before the age of 12 (and after 5) significantly raises the likelihood for children of uneducated parents to complete primary school. Overall, the evidence suggests that geographic and historical factors laid the seeds for spatial disparities in IM that are cemented by sorting and the independent impact of regions.

10.3982/ecta17018.abstractZh: 我们利用人口普查数据，研究了非洲自独立以来教育成就方面的代际流动性问题。首先，我们对27个国家及超过2,800个地区的代际流动性进行了分析，发现跨国家以及国内不同地区的差异非常显著。老一代的识字率差异解释了约一半的代际流动性空间差异。农村与城市的差距也相当明显。虽然在某些国家存在性别差异，但并没有证据表明存在系统性性别差距。其次，我们分析了代际流动性的地理特征，发现殖民时期对铁路和基督教传教活动的投资，以及靠近首都和海岸线的因素，是影响代际流动性的重要因素。第三，我们探讨了地区间流动性的差异是反映了空间排序，还是其他因素独立起作用。为了区分这两种情况，我们重点关注那些在幼年时期随家庭迁移的子女。通过比较兄弟姐妹，研究因迁移冲击而发生的迁移情况，并利用历史迁移数据来预测迁移家庭的目的地，我们发现尽管选择效应显著，但地区性的影响也起着重要作用。在12岁之前（以及5岁之后）在一个高流动性地区度过额外的一年时间，显著提高了未受教育父母子女完成小学教育的可能性。总体而言，这些证据表明，地理和历史因素为代际流动性的空间差异埋下了种子，而这些差异又受到排序效应的影响，同时地区因素也发挥着独立的作用。

abstract.text: May's theorem (1952), a celebrated result in social choice, provides the foundation for majority rule. May's crucial assumption of symmetry, often thought of as a procedural equity requirement, is violated by many choice procedures that grant voters identical roles. We show that a weakening of May's symmetry assumption allows for a far richer set of rules that still treat voters equally. We show that such rules can have minimal winning coalitions comprising a vanishing fraction of the population, but not less than the square root of the population size. Methodologically, we introduce techniques from group theory and illustrate their usefulness for the analysis of social choice questions.

10.3982/ecta17032.abstractZh: 梅定理（1952年）是社会选择领域的一个著名成果，它为多数规则提供了理论基础。梅定理的核心假设是对称性，这一假设通常被视为程序公平性的要求。然而，许多赋予选民相同权力的选择程序都违反了这一假设。我们证明，对梅定理的对称性假设进行弱化，仍然可以设计出更丰富的规则，同时保证选民的平等地位。这些规则所要求的获胜联盟规模可以很小，仅涵盖人口中的一小部分，但至少不小于人口规模的平方根。在方法论上，我们引入了群论中的技术，并展示了这些技术在社会选择问题分析中的实用性。

abstract.text: We study contracts between naive present‐biased consumers and risk‐neutral firms. We show that the welfare loss from present bias vanishes as the contracting horizon grows. This is true both when bargaining power is on the consumers' and on the firms' side, when consumers cannot commit to long‐term contracts, and when firms do not know the consumers' naiveté. However, the welfare loss from present bias does not vanish when firms do not know the consumers' present bias or when they cannot offer exclusive contracts.

10.3982/ecta17126.abstractZh: 我们研究了天真地倾向于当前决策的消费者与风险中立型企业之间的契约关系。我们发现，随着契约期限的增加，由于当前决策倾向导致的福利损失会消失。这一点在以下情况下都成立：当议价能力存在于消费者或企业一方时；当消费者无法承诺长期契约时；以及当企业不了解消费者的天真行为时。然而，当企业不了解消费者的当前决策倾向，或者无法提供独家契约时，由于当前决策倾向导致的福利损失并不会消失。

abstract.text: We study the impact of manipulating the attention of a decision‐maker who learns sequentially about a number of items before making a choice. Under natural assumptions on the decision‐maker's strategy, directing attention toward one item increases its likelihood of being chosen regardless of its value. This result applies when the decision‐maker can reject all items in favor of an outside option with known value; if no outside option is available, the direction of the effect of manipulation depends on the value of the item. A similar result applies to manipulation of choices in bandit problems.

10.3982/ecta17173.abstractZh: 我们研究了操纵决策者的注意力对决策过程的影响。在假设决策者的策略符合自然条件下，将注意力指向某个项目会提高其被选择的概率，无论该项目的价值如何。这一结果适用于决策者能够拒绝所有项目而选择某个已知价值的外部选项的情况；如果不存在外部选项，那么操纵效果的方向则取决于该项目的价值。在强盗问题中，对选择进行操纵也呈现出类似的结果。

abstract.text: A ruler who does not identify with a social group, whether on religious, ethnic, cultural, or socioeconomic grounds, is confronted with a trade‐off between taking advantage of the out‐group population's eagerness to maintain its identity and inducing it to “comply” (conversion, quitting, exodus, or any other way to accommodate the ruler's own identity). This paper first nests economists' extraction model, in which rulers are revenue‐maximizers, within a more general identity‐based model, in which rulers care also about inducing people to lose their identity, both in a static and an evolving environment. This paper then constructs novel data sources to test the implications of both models in the context of Egypt's conversion to Islam between 641 and 1170. The evidence supports the identity‐based model.

10.3982/ecta17265.abstractZh: 一个不认同任何社会群体的统治者，无论是基于宗教、民族、文化还是社会经济因素，都会面临一个权衡：既要利用外群体成员维护自身身份的意愿，又要促使他们“顺从”（如改宗、退出、迁移或采取其他方式来适应统治者的身份）。本文首先将经济学家的提取模型纳入一个更通用的基于身份认同的模型中，在该模型中，统治者不仅关注利用外群体成员的身份认同，还关注促使他们失去自身身份认同。随后，本文构建了新的数据来源，以检验这两种模型在埃及从641年到1170年皈依伊斯兰教背景下的影响。研究结果支持基于身份认同的模型。

abstract.text: Are the highest sample realizations selected from a larger presample more or less informative than the same amount of random data? Developing multivariate accuracy for interval dominance ordered preferences, we show that sample selection always benefits (or always harms) a decision maker if the reverse hazard rate of the data distribution is log‐supermodular (or log‐submodular), as in location experiments with normal noise. We find nonpathological conditions under which the information contained in the winning bids of a symmetric auction decreases in the number of bidders. Exploiting extreme value theory, we quantify the limit amount of information revealed when the presample size (number of bidders) goes to infinity. In a model of equilibrium persuasion with costly information, we derive implications for the optimal design of selected experiments when selection is made by an examinee, a biased researcher, or contending sides with the peremptory challenge right to eliminate a number of jurors.

10.3982/ecta17288.abstractZh: 在更大的预样本中选择的最高样本实现，是否比相同数量的随机数据具有更多的信息价值？针对区间优势有序偏好问题，我们展示了如果数据分布的逆向风险率满足对数超模性（或对数次模性），样本选择总是对决策者有利（或总是有害）。我们发现了一些非病态条件，在这些条件下，对称拍卖中获胜出价所包含的信息量会随着投标者数量的增加而减少。利用极值理论，我们量化了当预样本大小（投标者数量）趋于无穷大时，所揭示的信息量的极限值。在一个具有昂贵信息的均衡说服模型中，我们得出了关于选择性实验最优设计的启示，特别是当选择是由应试者、有偏见的研究人员，或是具有强制挑战权以剔除部分陪审员的双方进行时的考虑因素。

abstract.text: How does an economy's capital respond to aggregate productivity shocks when firms make lumpy investments? We show that capital's transitional dynamics are structurally linked to two steady‐state moments: the dispersion of capital to productivity ratios—an indicator of capital misallocation—and the covariance of capital to productivity ratios with the time elapsed since their last adjustment—an indicator of asymmetric costs of upsizing and downsizing the capital stock. We compute these two sufficient statistics using data on the size and frequency of investment of Chilean plants. The empirical values indicate significant effects of aggregate productivity shocks and favor investment models with a strong downsizing rigidity and random opportunities for free adjustments.

10.3982/ecta17344.abstractZh: 当企业进行不连续的投资时，一个经济体的资本如何应对总体生产率冲击？我们发现，资本的过渡动态与两个稳态特征密切相关：资本与生产率比率的分散度——这是资本分配不当的一个指标；以及资本与生产率比率的协方差与自上次调整以来经过的时间——这是资本增减成本不对称性的一个指标。我们使用智利工厂的投资规模和频率数据来计算这两个充分统计量。实证结果表明，总体生产率冲击具有显著的影响，并且支持那些具有较强减少资本刚性以及存在随机自由调整机会的投资模型。

abstract.text: We often make high stakes choices based on complex information that we have no way to verify. Careful Bayesian reasoning—assessing every reason why a claim could be false or misleading—is not feasible, so we necessarily act on faith: we trust certain sources and treat claims as if they were direct observations of payoff relevant events. This creates a challenge when trusted sources conflict: Practically speaking, is there a principled way to update beliefs in response to contradictory claims? I propose a model of belief formation along with several updating axioms. An impossibility theorem shows there is no obvious best answer, while a representation theorem delineates the boundary of what is possible.

10.3982/ecta17378.abstractZh: 我们常常基于复杂的、无法验证的信息做出高风险的选择。仔细的贝叶斯推理——评估每一个使某个主张可能虚假或具有误导性的理由——并不可行，因此我们不得不凭直觉行事：我们相信某些来源，并将主张视为对相关事件的直接观察结果。当可信来源出现冲突时，这就构成了一个挑战：实际上，有没有一种原则性的方法来根据矛盾的主张更新我们的信念呢？我提出了一个信念形成的模型，并附带了几个更新公理。一个不可能性定理表明，没有明显的正确答案，而一个表示定理则界定了可能的边界。

abstract.text: I show that the zero lower bound (ZLB) on interest rates can be used to identify the causal effects of monetary policy. Identification depends on the extent to which the ZLB limits the efficacy of monetary policy. I propose a simple way to test the efficacy of unconventional policies, modeled via a “shadow rate.” I apply this method to U.S. monetary policy using a three‐equation structural vector autoregressive model of inflation, unemployment, and the Federal Funds rate. I reject the null hypothesis that unconventional monetary policy has no effect at the ZLB, but find some evidence that it is not as effective as conventional monetary policy.

10.3982/ecta17388.abstractZh: 我证明了利率的零下限可以用来识别货币政策的因果效应。识别的效果取决于零下限在多大程度上限制了货币政策的效力。我提出了一种简单的方法来测试非常规政策的效果，该方法通过“影子利率”来建模。我应用这种方法对美国货币政策进行了分析，使用了一个包含三个方程的结构向量自回归模型，用于分析通货膨胀、失业率和联邦基金利率。我们拒绝了非常规货币政策在零下限下没有效应的零假设，并发现了一些证据表明其效果不如传统货币政策。

abstract.text: We characterize the relationship between the distributions of two variables linked by a structural model. We then show that, in models of heterogeneous firms in monopolistic competition, this relationship implies a new demand function that we call “CREMR” (Constant Revenue Elasticity of Marginal Revenue). This demand function is the only one that is consistent with productivity and sales distributions having the same form (whether Pareto, lognormal, or Fréchet) in the cross section, and it is necessary and sufficient for Gibrat's Law to hold over time. Among the applications we consider, we use our methodology to characterize misallocation across firms; we derive the distribution of markups implied by any assumptions on demand and productivity; and we show empirically that CREMR‐based markup distributions provide an excellent parsimonious fit to Indian firm‐level data, which in turn allows us to calculate the proportion of firms that are of suboptimal size in the market equilibrium.

10.3982/ecta17416.abstractZh: 我们描述了由两个变量组成的分布之间的关系，这两个变量通过一个结构模型联系在一起。然后我们证明了，在垄断竞争中的异质企业模型中，这种关系意味着存在一个新的需求函数，我们将其称为“CREMR”（边际收入的恒定收入弹性）。这个需求函数是唯一一个与生产率和销售分布具有相同的形式（无论是帕累托分布、对数正态分布还是弗雷歇分布）相一致的函数，并且它是确保吉布拉特定律随时间成立的必要充分条件。在我们考虑的应用中，我们使用我们的方法来描述企业之间的资源错配问题；我们推导出了基于需求和生产率假设所隐含的加价分布；并且我们通过实证研究表明，基于CREMR的加价分布能够很好地拟合印度企业层面的数据，这反过来又使我们能够计算出在市场均衡中处于次优规模的企业比例。

abstract.text: We propose a general and highly efficient method for solving and estimating general equilibrium heterogeneous‐agent models with aggregate shocks in discrete time. Our approach relies on the rapid computation of sequence‐space Jacobians —the derivatives of perfect‐foresight equilibrium mappings between aggregate sequences around the steady state. Our main contribution is a fast algorithm for calculating Jacobians for a large class of heterogeneous‐agent problems. We combine this algorithm with a systematic approach to composing and inverting Jacobians to solve for general equilibrium impulse responses. We obtain a rapid procedure for likelihood‐based estimation and computation of nonlinear perfect‐foresight transitions. We apply our methods to three canonical heterogeneous‐agent models: a neoclassical model, a New Keynesian model with one asset, and a New Keynesian model with two assets.

10.3982/ecta17434.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种通用且高效的方法，用于求解和估计具有聚合冲击的离散时间下的一般均衡异质代理模型。我们的方法依赖于对序列空间雅可比矩阵的快速计算——这些矩阵是围绕稳态时聚合序列之间完美预见均衡映射的导数。我们的主要贡献是一种快速算法，用于计算大量异质代理问题的雅可比矩阵。我们将这一算法与系统化的雅可比矩阵组合和求逆方法相结合，以求解一般均衡的脉冲响应。我们获得了一种快速的程序，用于基于似然估计和计算非线性完美预见转换。我们将我们的方法应用于三个典型的异质代理模型：新古典模型、一个资产的新型凯恩斯模型以及两个资产的新型凯恩斯模型。

abstract.text: We model the term structure of interest rates that results from the interaction between investors with preferences for specific maturities and risk‐averse arbitrageurs. Shocks to the short rate are transmitted to long rates through arbitrageurs' carry trades. Arbitrageurs earn rents from transmitting the shocks through bond risk premia that relate positively to the slope of the term structure. When the short rate is the only risk factor, changes in investor demand have the same relative effect on interest rates across maturities regardless of the maturities where they originate. When investor demand is also stochastic, demand effects become more localized. A calibration indicates that long rates underreact to forward‐guidance announcements about short rates. Large‐scale asset purchases can be more effective in moving long rates, especially if they are concentrated at long maturities.

10.3982/ecta17440.abstractZh: 我们模拟了利率期限结构，该结构是由具有特定到期日偏好的投资者和厌恶风险的套利者之间的互动所决定的。短期利率的波动通过套利者的套利交易传递至长期利率。套利者通过债券风险溢价来赚取收益，这些风险溢价与利率期限结构的斜率呈正相关。当短期利率是唯一的风险因素时，投资者需求的变化对不同到期日的利率产生相同的相对影响，无论这些需求源自哪个到期日。当投资者需求也是随机的时，需求效应会变得更加局部化。校准结果显示，长期利率对关于短期利率的前瞻性公告反应不足。大规模资产购买在推动长期利率方面可能更为有效，尤其是当这些购买集中在长期到期日时。

abstract.text: We propose a robust method of discrete choice analysis when agents' choice sets are unobserved. Our core model assumes nothing about agents' choice sets apart from their minimum size. Importantly, it leaves unrestricted the dependence, conditional on observables, between choice sets and preferences. We first characterize the sharp identification region of the model's parameters by a finite set of conditional moment inequalities. We then apply our theoretical findings to learn about households' risk preferences and choice sets from data on their deductible choices in auto collision insurance. We find that the data can be explained by expected utility theory with low levels of risk aversion and heterogeneous non‐singleton choice sets, and that more than three in four households require limited choice sets to explain their deductible choices. We also provide simulation evidence on the computational tractability of our method in applications with larger feasible sets or higher‐dimensional unobserved heterogeneity.

10.3982/ecta17448.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在代理人选择集无法观测时进行的稳健离散选择分析方法。我们的核心模型对代理人的选择集不做任何假设，仅要求其最小规模。重要的是，该模型允许在选择集与偏好之间建立不受观测变量影响的依赖关系。我们首先通过一组有限的条件矩不等式来刻画模型参数的精确识别区域。随后，我们将理论发现应用于分析家庭在汽车碰撞保险中的免赔额选择行为，以了解他们的风险偏好和选择集。研究发现，这些数据可以用期望效用理论来解释，且风险厌恶程度较低，选择集具有异质性且非单一。超过四分之三的家庭需要有限的选择集来解释他们的免赔额选择。我们还提供了模拟证据，证明我们的方法在可行集较大或观测异质性较高的情况下仍然具有计算可行性。

abstract.text: This paper develops methods for detecting discrimination by individual employers using correspondence experiments that send fictitious resumes to real job openings. We establish identification of higher moments of the distribution of job‐level callback rates as a function of the number of resumes sent to each job and propose shape‐constrained estimators of these moments. Applying our methods to three experimental data sets, we find striking job‐level heterogeneity in the extent to which callback probabilities differ by race or sex. Estimates of higher moments reveal that while most jobs barely discriminate, a few discriminate heavily. These moment estimates are then used to bound the share of jobs that discriminate and the posterior probability that each individual job is engaged in discrimination. In a recent experiment manipulating racially distinctive names, we find that at least 85% of jobs that contact both of two white applications and neither of two black applications are engaged in discrimination. To assess the potential value of our methods for regulators, we consider the accuracy of decision rules for investigating suspicious callback behavior in various experimental designs under a simple two‐type model that rationalizes the experimental data. Though we estimate that only 17% of employers discriminate on the basis of race, we find that an experiment sending 10 applications to each job would enable detection of 7–10% of discriminatory jobs while yielding Type I error rates below 0.2%. A minimax decision rule acknowledging partial identification of the distribution of callback rates yields only slightly fewer investigations than a Bayes decision rule based on the two‐type model. These findings suggest illegal labor market discrimination can be reliably monitored with relatively small modifications to existing correspondence designs.

10.3982/ecta17489.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种利用模拟简历投递到真实职位空缺的方法来检测个体雇主歧视行为的方法。我们确定了职位回调率分布的高阶矩，这些高阶矩与每个职位投递的简历数量有关，并提出了这些矩的约束型估计方法。通过对三个实验数据集的应用，我们发现不同职位在回调概率上的差异存在显著的种族或性别差异。高阶矩的估计显示，虽然大多数职位几乎没有歧视行为，但少数职位存在严重的歧视现象。这些高阶矩估计被用来界定存在歧视的职位比例以及每个职位进行歧视的后验概率。在一项最近的研究中，我们通过操控具有种族差异的姓名，发现至少有85%的职位在接触两个白人申请和两个黑人申请时都存在歧视行为。为了评估我们的方法对监管机构的潜在价值，我们考虑了在简单的双类型模型下，用于调查可疑回调行为的决策规则的准确性。尽管我们估计只有17%的雇主基于种族进行歧视，但我们发现，对每个职位发送10份申请的方法能够检测出7-10%的歧视性职位，同时Type I错误率低于0.2%。一种承认回调率分布部分不确定性的极小极大决策规则，其所需的调查次数仅比基于双类型模型的贝叶斯决策规则略少。这些研究结果表明，通过对现有的对应设计进行相对较小的修改，可以可靠地监测非法劳动力市场的歧视现象。

abstract.text: Standard models of hierarchy assume that agents and middle managers are better informed than principals. We estimate the value of the informational advantage held by supervisors—middle managers—when ministerial leadership—the principal—introduced a new monitoring technology aimed at improving the performance of agricultural extension agents (AEAs) in rural Paraguay. Our approach employs a novel experimental design that elicited treatment‐priority rankings from supervisors before randomization of treatment. We find that supervisors have valuable information—they prioritize AEAs who would be more responsive to the monitoring treatment. We develop a model of monitoring under different scales of treatment roll‐out and different treatment allocation rules.
