We semiparametrically estimate marginal treatment effects (MTEs) to demonstrate that the value of information and the benefits to decentralizing treatment decisions depend crucially on the sophistication of the principal and on the scale of roll‐out.

10.3982/ecta17497.abstractZh: 传统的层级模型认为，代理人和中层管理者比高层管理者拥有更多的信息。我们研究了当高层管理者引入新的监控技术以改善巴拉圭农村农业推广代理人的绩效时，中层管理者所持有的信息优势的价值。我们的研究方法采用了一种新颖的实验设计，在随机分配处理方案之前，先让管理者对处理方案进行优先级排序。研究发现，管理者掌握着有价值的信息，他们更倾向于优先考虑那些对监控措施反应较快的农业推广代理人。我们还建立了一个模型，用于分析不同处理方案实施规模和不同分配规则下的监控效果。我们通过半参数估计方法，量化了边际处理效果，从而证明了信息价值以及分散处理决策所带来的好处，这些都与高层管理者的复杂性和处理方案的实施规模密切相关。

abstract.text: Standard experimental designs are geared toward point estimation and hypothesis testing, while bandit algorithms are geared toward in‐sample outcomes. Here, we instead consider treatment assignment in an experiment with several waves for choosing the best among a set of possible policies (treatments) at the end of the experiment. We propose a computationally tractable assignment algorithm that we call “exploration sampling,” where assignment probabilities in each wave are an increasing concave function of the posterior probabilities that each treatment is optimal. We prove an asymptotic optimality result for this algorithm and demonstrate improvements in welfare in calibrated simulations over both non‐adaptive designs and bandit algorithms. An application to selecting between six different recruitment strategies for an agricultural extension service in India demonstrates practical feasibility.

10.3982/ecta17527.abstractZh: 标准的实验设计侧重于点估计和假设检验，而强盗算法则侧重于样本内结果。在这里，我们考虑在包含多个阶段的实验中分配处理，以在实验结束时从一组可能的策略（处理）中选择最佳方案。我们提出了一种计算上可行的分配算法，称之为“探索抽样”。该算法中，每阶段的分配概率是一个递增的凹函数，该函数基于每个处理最优性的后验概率。我们证明了该算法的渐进最优性，并在校准后的模拟中展示了其相对于非自适应设计和强盗算法的福利改进。在印度农业推广服务中应用该算法来选择六种不同的招募策略，证明了其实际可行性。

abstract.text: What incentives do governments have to negotiate trade agreements that constrain their domestic regulatory policies? We study a model in which firms design products to appeal to local consumer tastes, but their fixed costs increase with the difference between versions of their product destined for different markets. In this setting, firms' profit‐maximizing choices of product attributes are globally optimal in the absence of consumption externalities, but national governments have unilateral incentives to invoke regulatory protectionism to induce firm delocation. An efficient trade agreement requires commitments not to engage in such opportunistic behavior. A rule requiring mutual recognition of standards can be used to achieve efficiency, but one that requires only national treatment falls short. When product attributes confer local consumption externalities, an efficient trade agreement must coordinate the fine details of countries' regulatory policies.

10.3982/ecta17536.abstractZh: 政府有哪些动机去谈判那些限制其国内监管政策的贸易协定？我们研究了一个模型，在该模型中，企业设计产品以迎合当地消费者的口味，但产品的固定成本会随着产品针对不同市场的版本之间的差异而增加。在这种情况下，在没有消费外部性的情况下，企业选择产品属性的行为在全局上是最优的，但国家政府有单方面采取监管保护主义来促使企业迁移市场的动机。一个有效的贸易协定需要承诺不采取这种机会主义行为。要求相互认可标准的规则可以实现效率，但仅要求国家间实行国民待遇的规则则不够。当产品属性具有当地消费外部性时，有效的贸易协定必须协调各国监管政策的细节。

abstract.text: We study repeated independent Blackwell experiments; standard examples include drawing multiple samples from a population, or performing a measurement in different locations. In the baseline setting of a binary state of nature, we compare experiments in terms of their informativeness in large samples. Addressing a question due to Blackwell (1951), we show that generically an experiment is more informative than another in large samples if and only if it has higher Rényi divergences. We apply our analysis to the problem of measuring the degree of dissimilarity between distributions by means of divergences. A useful property of Rényi divergences is their additivity with respect to product distributions. Our characterization of Blackwell dominance in large samples implies that every additive divergence that satisfies the data processing inequality is an integral of Rényi divergences.

10.3982/ecta17548.abstractZh: 我们研究了重复的独立Blackwell实验；典型的例子包括从总体中抽取多个样本，或在不同的地点进行测量。在二元自然状态的基线设定下，我们比较了这些实验在大样本中的信息量。针对Blackwell（1951年）提出的问题，我们表明，一般来说，如果一个实验在大样本中的Rényi发散度高于另一个实验，那么这个实验的信息量就更大。我们将这一分析应用于通过发散度来衡量分布之间差异程度的问题。Rényi发散度的一个有用特性是，它们可以关于乘积分布进行加性运算。我们对Blackwell优势在大样本中的描述表明，每一个满足数据处理不等式的加性发散度都是Rényi发散度的积分。

abstract.text: Kitamura and Stoye (2018) recently proposed a nonparametric statistical test for random utility models of consumer behavior. The test is formulated in terms of linear inequality constraints and a quadratic objective function. While the nonparametric test is conceptually appealing, its practical implementation is computationally challenging. In this paper, we develop a column generation approach to operationalize the test. These novel computational tools generate considerable computational gains in practice, which substantially increases the empirical usefulness of Kitamura and Stoye's statistical test.

10.3982/ecta17605.abstractZh: Kitamura和Stoye在2018年提出了一种针对消费者行为随机效用模型的非参数统计检验方法。该检验基于线性不等式约束和二次目标函数来构建。虽然非参数检验在概念上具有吸引力，但其实际实施在计算上颇具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种列生成方法来实现该检验。这些新的计算工具在实际应用中能够带来显著的计算效率提升，从而大大增强了Kitamura和Stoye统计检验的实证实用性。

abstract.text: We estimate the distribution of television advertising elasticities and the distribution of the advertising return on investment (ROI) for a large number of products in many categories. Our results reveal substantially smaller advertising elasticities compared to the results documented in the literature, as well as a sizable percentage of statistically insignificant or negative estimates. The results are robust to functional form assumptions and are not driven by insufficient statistical power or measurement error. The ROI analysis shows negative ROIs at the margin for more than 80% of brands, implying over‐investment in advertising by most firms. Further, the overall ROI of the observed advertising schedule is only positive for one third of all brands.

10.3982/ecta17674.abstractZh: 我们估计了众多产品在不同类别中的电视广告弹性分布以及广告投资回报率的分布。我们的研究结果显示，广告弹性明显小于文献中的记载，并且有相当比例的估计结果在统计上不显著或为负。这些结果在功能形式假设下仍然具有稳健性，且并非由于统计能力不足或测量误差所致。分析显示，超过80%的品牌在边际上表现出负的广告投资回报率，这意味着大多数公司在广告投入上存在过度行为。此外，在所有品牌中，只有三分之一的品牌广告计划的整体投资回报率为正。

abstract.text: This paper develops a uniformly valid and asymptotically nonconservative test based on projection for a class of shape restrictions. The key insight we exploit is that these restrictions form convex cones, a simple and yet elegant structure that has been barely harnessed in the literature. Based on a monotonicity property afforded by such a geometric structure, we construct a bootstrap procedure that, unlike many studies in nonstandard settings, dispenses with estimation of local parameter spaces, and the critical values are obtained in a way as simple as computing the test statistic. Moreover, by appealing to strong approximations, our framework accommodates nonparametric regression models as well as distributional/density‐related and structural settings. Since the test entails a tuning parameter (due to the nonstandard nature of the problem), we propose a data‐driven choice and prove its validity. Monte Carlo simulations confirm that our test works well.

10.3982/ecta17764.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于投影的、适用于各类形状限制条件的统一有效且渐近非保守的检验方法。我们的关键洞察是，这些限制条件构成凸锥结构，这一简单而优雅的结构在文献中几乎未被充分利用。基于这种几何结构所赋予的单调性特性，我们构建了一种自举程序，与许多非标准环境下的研究不同，该程序无需估计局部参数空间，而临界值可以通过计算检验统计量来简单获得。此外，通过利用强逼近理论，我们的框架能够适用于非参数回归模型以及分布/密度相关和结构型设置。由于该检验涉及一个调整参数（由于问题的非标准性质），我们提出了一种数据驱动的选择方法，并证明了其有效性。蒙特卡洛模拟结果证实，我们的检验方法运行良好。

abstract.text: We prove that local projections (LPs) and Vector Autoregressions (VARs) estimate the same impulse responses. This nonparametric result only requires unrestricted lag structures. We discuss several implications: (i) LP and VAR estimators are not conceptually separate procedures; instead, they are simply two dimension reduction techniques with common estimand but different finite‐sample properties. (ii) VAR‐based structural identification—including short‐run, long‐run, or sign restrictions—can equivalently be performed using LPs, and vice versa. (iii) Structural estimation with an instrument (proxy) can be carried out by ordering the instrument first in a recursive VAR, even under noninvertibility. (iv) Linear VARs are as robust to nonlinearities as linear LPs.

10.3982/ecta17813.abstractZh: 我们证明了局部投影（LPs）和向量自回归（VARs）能够估计相同的脉冲响应。这一非参数性结果仅需要不受限制的滞后结构。我们讨论了几个重要意义：(i) LP和VAR估计器在概念上并不属于不同的方法；相反，它们只是具有共同估计量但有限样本性质不同的两种降维技术。(ii)基于VAR的结构识别——包括短期、长期或符号限制——可以使用LPs等效地实现，反之亦然。(iii)即使在不可逆的情况下，也可以通过将工具变量首先纳入递归VAR模型来进行结构估计。(iv)线性VAR对非线性的鲁棒性与线性LPs相当。

abstract.text: We compare sparse and dense representations of predictive models in macroeconomics, microeconomics, and finance. To deal with a large number of possible predictors, we specify a prior that allows for both variable selection and shrinkage. The posterior distribution does not typically concentrate on a single sparse model, but on a wide set of models that often include many predictors.

10.3982/ecta17842.abstractZh: 我们比较了宏观经济学、微观经济学和金融领域中预测模型的稀疏表示和密集表示。为了处理大量可能的预测因子，我们定义了一个先验分布，该分布既允许变量选择，也允许模型压缩。后验分布通常不会集中在单一的稀疏模型上，而是集中在一系列模型上，这些模型通常包含许多预测因子。

abstract.text: We study preferences estimated from finite choice experiments and provide sufficient conditions for convergence to a unique underlying “true” preference. Our conditions are weak and, therefore, valid in a wide range of economic environments. We develop applications to expected utility theory, choice over consumption bundles, and menu choice. Our framework unifies the revealed preference tradition with models that allow for errors.

10.3982/ecta17845.abstractZh: 我们研究了从有限选择实验中估计出的偏好，并提出了确保偏好收敛到唯一“真实”偏好的充分条件。我们的条件较为宽松，因此在广泛的经济环境中都适用。我们还将这一框架应用于期望效用理论、消费组合的选择以及菜单选择问题。我们的框架将揭示性偏好传统与允许误差的模型相结合了起来。

abstract.text: Few want to do business with a partner who has a bad reputation. Consequently, once a bad reputation is established, it can be difficult to get rid of. This leads on the one hand to the intuitive idea that a good reputation is easy to lose and hard to gain. On the other hand, it can lead to a strong form of history dependence in which a single beneficial or adverse event can cast a shadow over a very long period of time. It gives rise to a reputational trap where an agent rationally chooses not to invest in a good reputation because the chances others will find out is too low. Nevertheless, the same agent with a good reputation will make every effort to maintain it. Here, a simple reputational model is constructed and the conditions for there to be a unique equilibrium that constitutes a reputation trap are characterized.

10.3982/ecta17891.abstractZh: 很少有人愿意与声誉不佳的合作伙伴开展业务。因此，一旦声誉不佳的情况形成，就很难消除。这一方面导致了一种直观的认识，即良好的声誉容易丧失，而难以获得。另一方面，这也可能引发一种强烈的历史依赖性，即一个有益或不利的事件可能会在很长一段时间内产生影响。这就产生了一个声誉陷阱，即一个理性选择不投资于良好声誉的代理人，因为其他人发现这一情况的可能性太低。然而，拥有良好声誉的同一代理人会尽一切努力维护这一声誉。在这里，构建了一个简单的声誉模型，并描述了存在构成声誉陷阱的独特均衡的条件。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable general equilibrium framework in which firms are large and have market power with respect to both products and labor, and in which a firm's decisions are affected by its ownership structure. We characterize the Cournot–Walras equilibrium of an economy where each firm maximizes a share‐weighted average of shareholder utilities—rendering the equilibrium independent of price normalization. In a one‐sector economy, if returns to scale are non‐increasing, then an increase in “effective” market concentration (which accounts for common ownership) leads to declines in employment, real wages, and the labor share. Yet when there are multiple sectors, due to an intersectoral pecuniary externality, an increase in common ownership could stimulate the economy when the elasticity of labor supply is high relative to the elasticity of substitution in product markets. We characterize for which ownership structures the monopolistically competitive limit or an oligopolistic one is attained as the number of sectors in the economy increases. When firms have heterogeneous constant returns to scale technologies, we find that an increase in common ownership leads to markets that are more concentrated.

10.3982/ecta17906.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个可行的通用均衡框架，其中企业规模较大，在产品和劳动力方面都具有市场力量，企业的决策受到其所有权结构的影响。我们描述了在一个经济体系中，每个企业都最大化股东效用的加权平均值——这使得均衡与价格标准化无关。在一个单一部门的经济中，如果规模报酬非递增，那么“有效”市场集中度的增加（考虑到共同所有权）会导致就业、实际工资和劳动份额的下降。然而，当存在多个部门时，由于部门间的货币外部性，共同所有权的增加可以在劳动力供给的弹性高于产品市场替代弹性的情况下刺激经济。我们分析了在经济发展中，随着部门数量的增加，垄断竞争极限或寡头垄断极限会在哪些所有权结构下实现。当企业具有异质性的规模报酬不变技术时，我们发现共同所有权的增加会导致市场更加集中。

abstract.text: Asymptotic justification of the bootstrap often takes the form of weak convergence of the bootstrap distribution to some limit distribution. Theoretical literature recognized that the weak convergence does not imply consistency of the bootstrap second moment or the bootstrap variance as an estimator of the asymptotic variance, but such concern is not always reflected in the applied practice. We bridge the gap between the theory and practice by showing that such common bootstrap based standard error in fact leads to a potentially conservative inference.

10.3982/ecta17912.abstractZh: 自举法的渐近合理性通常表现为自举分布向某个极限分布的弱收敛。理论文献认识到，弱收敛并不意味着自举法的二阶矩或自举方差作为渐近方差的估计量具有一致性，但这一认识并不总能在实际应用中得到体现。我们通过证明基于自举法的标准误差实际上可能导致保守的推断，从而弥合了理论与实践之间的差距。

abstract.text: We introduce a generalization of the popular local‐to‐unity model of time series persistence by allowing for p autoregressive (AR) roots and p − 1 moving average (MA) roots close to unity. This generalized local‐to‐unity model, GLTU( p ), induces convergence of the suitably scaled time series to a continuous time Gaussian ARMA( p , p − 1) process on the unit interval. Our main theoretical result establishes the richness of this model class, in the sense that it can well approximate a large class of processes with stationary Gaussian limits that are not entirely distinct from the unit root benchmark. We show that Campbell and Yogo's (2006) popular inference method for predictive regressions fails to control size in the GLTU(2) model with empirically plausible parameter values, and we propose a limited‐information Bayesian framework for inference in the GLTU( p ) model and apply it to quantify the uncertainty about the half‐life of deviations from purchasing power parity.

10.3982/ecta17944.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种对流行的局部至单位模型进行推广的方法，该模型允许存在p个自回归根和p-1个接近单位值的移动平均根。这种广义的局部至单位模型，即GLTU(p)，能够使得适当缩放的时间序列收敛到单位区间上的连续时间高斯ARMA(p, p-1)过程。我们的主要理论成果表明，这一模型类别具有丰富的特性，因为它能够很好地近似一大类具有平稳高斯极限的过程，而这些过程与单位根基准模型并没有本质区别。我们证明了Campbell和Yogo在2006年提出的预测回归推断方法，在具有实证上合理参数值的GLTU(2)模型中无法控制样本大小的影响，并提出了一种有限信息贝叶斯推断框架，用于GLTU(p)模型的推断，并应用该框架来量化关于购买力平价偏差半衰期的不确定性。

abstract.text: What should researchers do when their baseline model is falsified? We recommend reporting the set of parameters that are consistent with minimally nonfalsified models. We call this the falsification adaptive set (FAS). This set generalizes the standard baseline estimand to account for possible falsification. Importantly, it does not require the researcher to select or calibrate sensitivity parameters. In the classical linear IV model with multiple instruments, we show that the FAS has a simple closed‐form expression that only depends on a few 2SLS coefficients. We apply our results to an empirical study of roads and trade. We show how the FAS complements traditional overidentification tests by summarizing the variation in estimates obtained from alternative nonfalsified models.

10.3982/ecta17969.abstractZh: 当研究人员的基线模型被证伪时，应该采取什么措施？我们建议报告与最小非证伪模型一致的参数集。我们将其称为证伪自适应集（FAS）。这一集合将标准基线估计量泛化，以考虑可能的证伪情况。重要的是，它不需要研究人员选择或校准敏感性参数。在具有多个工具的经典线性IV模型中，我们展示了FAS有一个简单的封闭形式表达式，该表达式仅依赖于少数2SLS系数。我们将这些结果应用于一项关于道路和贸易的实证研究。我们展示了FAS如何通过总结来自其他非证伪模型的估计值的变化来补充传统的过度识别检验。

abstract.text: Haavelmo (1944) proposed a probabilistic structure for econometric modeling, aiming to make econometrics useful for decision making. His fundamental contribution has become thoroughly embedded in econometric research, yet it could not answer all the deep issues that the author raised. Notably, Haavelmo struggled to formalize the implications for decision making of the fact that models can at most approximate actuality. In the same period, Wald (1939, 1945) initiated his own seminal development of statistical decision theory. Haavelmo favorably cited Wald, but econometrics did not embrace statistical decision theory. Instead, it focused on study of identification, estimation, and statistical inference. This paper proposes use of statistical decision theory to evaluate the performance of models in decision making. I consider the common practice of as‐if optimization : specification of a model, point estimation of its parameters, and use of the point estimate to make a decision that would be optimal if the estimate were accurate. A central theme is that one should evaluate as‐if optimization or any other model‐based decision rule by its performance across the state space, listing all states of nature that one believes feasible, not across the model space. I apply the theme to prediction and treatment choice. Statistical decision theory is conceptually simple, but application is often challenging. Advancing computation is the primary task to complete the foundations sketched by Haavelmo and Wald.

10.3982/ecta17985.abstractZh: Haavelmo（1944年）提出了一种概率结构，用于计量经济学建模，旨在使计量经济学对决策制定具有实际意义。他的这一基础贡献已深深融入计量经济学研究领域，但未能完全解决作者提出的所有深层次问题。值得注意的是，Haavelmo在将模型最多只能近似现实这一事实对决策制定的影响进行形式化方面遇到了困难。同一时期，Wald（1939年、1945年）开始了统计决策理论的发展。Haavelmo积极引用了Wald的理论，但计量经济学并未完全接受统计决策理论，而是专注于识别、估计和统计推断的研究。本文提出使用统计决策理论来评估模型在决策制定中的性能。我考虑了“假设最优”的常见做法：即先构建模型，对其参数进行点估计，然后利用这些点估计来做出决策，如果估计准确的话，这样的决策应该是最优的。一个核心观点是，应该通过模型在整个状态空间上的性能来评估“假设最优”或其他基于模型的决策规则，而不是仅通过模型本身来评估。我将这一理念应用于预测和治疗选择的问题。统计决策理论在概念上较为简单，但在实际应用中往往具有挑战性。推进计算能力是完成Haavelmo和Wald所提出的基础工作的主要任务。

abstract.text: We propose a positive model of empirical science in which an analyst makes a report to an audience after observing some data. Agents in the audience may differ in their beliefs or objectives, and may therefore update or act differently following a given report. We contrast the proposed model with a classical model of statistics in which the report directly determines the payoff. We identify settings in which the predictions of the proposed model differ from those of the classical model, and seem to better match practice.

10.3982/ecta18155.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个实证科学的积极模型，在该模型中，分析师在观察了某些数据后向观众报告。观众中的个体可能在信念或目标上存在差异，因此他们可能会在收到报告后更新自己的观点或采取不同的行动。我们将所提出的模型与传统的统计模型进行对比，在传统统计模型中，报告直接决定了收益。我们确定了所提出的模型与传统模型在预测结果上的差异，并且似乎更符合实际情况。

abstract.text: We characterize the set of extreme points of monotonic functions that are either majorized by a given function f or themselves majorize f and show that these extreme points play a crucial role in many economic design problems. Our main results show that each extreme point is uniquely characterized by a countable collection of intervals. Outside these intervals the extreme point equals the original function f and inside the function is constant. Further consistency conditions need to be satisfied pinning down the value of an extreme point in each interval where it is constant. We apply these insights to a varied set of economic problems: equivalence and optimality of mechanisms for auctions and (matching) contests, Bayesian persuasion, optimal delegation, and decision making under uncertainty.

10.3982/ecta18312.abstractZh: 我们描述了单调函数的极端点集合，这些极端点要么被某个函数f放大，要么自身能够放大f。我们发现这些极端点在许多经济设计问题中起着至关重要的作用。我们的主要结果表明，每个极端点都可以由一组可数的区间唯一表征。在这些区间之外，极端点等于原始函数f；在函数内部，极端点是常数。此外，还需要满足一些一致性条件，以确定极端点在常数区间中的具体值。我们将这些见解应用于一系列不同的经济问题：拍卖和（匹配）竞赛机制的有效性与最优性、贝叶斯说服、最优委托，以及不确定性下的决策制定。

abstract.text: Most jobs require teamwork. Are some people good team players? In this paper, we design and test a new method for identifying individual contributions to team production. We randomly assign people to multiple teams and predict team performance based on previously assessed individual skills. Some people consistently cause their team to exceed its predicted performance. We call these individuals “team players.” Team players score significantly higher on a well‐established measure of social intelligence, but do not differ across a variety of other dimensions, including IQ, personality, education, and gender. Social skills —defined as a single latent factor that combines social intelligence scores with the team player effect—improve team performance about as much as IQ. We find suggestive evidence that team players increase effort among teammates.

10.3982/ecta18461.abstractZh: 大多数工作都需要团队合作。有些人真的是优秀的团队参与者吗？在本文中，我们设计并测试了一种新的方法，用于识别个人对团队绩效的贡献。我们将人们随机分配到多个团队中，并根据先前评估的个人技能来预测团队绩效。有些人在团队中始终能够使其绩效超过预期。我们将这些个体称为“团队参与者”。团队参与者在一项经过验证的社会智力测量指标上的得分显著更高，但在其他多个维度上并没有差异，包括智商、性格、教育背景和性别。社会技能——被定义为将社会智力得分与团队参与者效应结合起来的单一潜在因素——对团队绩效的提升效果与智商相当。我们发现有证据表明，团队参与者会促使队友更加努力地工作。

abstract.text: We study how an agent learns from endogenous data when their prior belief is misspecified. We show that only uniform Berk–Nash equilibria can be long‐run outcomes, and that all uniformly strict Berk–Nash equilibria have an arbitrarily high probability of being the long‐run outcome for some initial beliefs. When the agent believes the outcome distribution is exogenous, every uniformly strict Berk–Nash equilibrium has positive probability of being the long‐run outcome for any initial belief. We generalize these results to settings where the agent observes a signal before acting.

10.3982/ecta18508.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个代理如何在其先验信念被错误指定时从内生数据中学习。我们表明，只有统一的Berk–Nash均衡才能成为长期结果，并且所有统一的严格Berk–Nash均衡都有任意高的概率成为某种初始信念下的长期结果。当代理认为结果分布是外生的时，任何统一的严格Berk–Nash均衡都有正的概率成为长期结果。我们将这些结果推广到代理在行动之前就观察到信号的情况。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a tractable model of Bayesian learning on large random networks where agents choose whether to adopt an innovation. We study the impact of the network structure on learning dynamics and product diffusion. In directed networks, all direct and indirect links contribute to agents' learning. In comparison, learning and welfare are lower in undirected networks and networks with cliques. In a rich class of networks, behavior is described by a small number of differential equations, making the model useful for empirical work.

10.3982/ecta18659.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个在大型随机网络上进行贝叶斯学习的可行模型，其中代理节点决定是否采纳某种创新。我们研究了网络结构对学习动态和产品扩散的影响。在有向网络中，所有直接和间接的链接都对代理节点的学习有贡献。相比之下，在无向网络以及存在团体结构的网络中，学习和福利水平较低。在一系列丰富的网络结构中，行为可以通过少量的微分方程来描述，这使得该模型适用于实证研究。

abstract.text: Applied macroeconomists often compute confidence intervals for impulse responses using local projections, that is, direct linear regressions of future outcomes on current covariates. This paper proves that local projection inference robustly handles two issues that commonly arise in applications: highly persistent data and the estimation of impulse responses at long horizons. We consider local projections that control for lags of the variables in the regression. We show that lag‐augmented local projections with normal critical values are asymptotically valid uniformly over (i) both stationary and non‐stationary data, and also over (ii) a wide range of response horizons. Moreover, lag augmentation obviates the need to correct standard errors for serial correlation in the regression residuals. Hence, local projection inference is arguably both simpler than previously thought and more robust than standard autoregressive inference, whose validity is known to depend sensitively on the persistence of the data and on the length of the horizon.

10.3982/ecta18756.abstractZh: 应用宏观经济学家经常使用局部投影来计算脉冲响应的置信区间，即直接将未来结果作为当前协变量进行线性回归分析。本文证明了局部投影推断能够稳健地处理在应用中常见的两个问题：高度持久性数据以及在长时间范围内估计脉冲响应。我们考虑了能够控制回归中变量滞后项的局部投影方法。研究表明，带有正常临界值的滞后项增强的局部投影在以下情况下具有渐近有效性：(i) 无论是平稳数据还是非平稳数据；(ii) 在广泛的响应时间范围内。此外，滞后项的增加消除了对回归残差中序列相关性进行标准误差修正的需要。因此，局部投影推断不仅比之前认为的更为简单，而且比标准自回归推断更为稳健，因为后者的有效性显然依赖于数据的持久性和时间范围的长度。

abstract.text: The prevailing neo‐Wicksellian view holds that the central bank's objective is to track the natural rate of interest ( r * ), which itself is largely exogenous to monetary policy. We challenge this view using a fixed‐cost model of durable consumption demand, in which expansionary monetary policy prompts households to accelerate purchases of durable goods. This yields an intertemporal trade‐off in aggregate demand as encouraging households to increase durable holdings today leaves fewer households acquiring durables going forward. Interest rates must be kept low to support demand going forward, so accommodative monetary policy today reduces r * in the future. We show that this mechanism is quantitatively important in explaining the persistently low level of real interest rates and r * after the Great Recession.

10.3982/ecta18821.abstractZh: 目前流行的新维克塞尔主义观点认为，中央银行的目标准则是要追踪自然利率（r*），而这一利率本身在很大程度上是货币政策之外的因素。我们基于耐用消费品需求的固定成本模型对这一观点提出质疑，该模型表明，扩张性货币政策会促使家庭加速购买耐用商品。这导致总需求存在时间上的权衡：鼓励家庭当前增加耐用商品的持有量，会使得未来获得耐用商品的家庭数量减少。为了支持未来的需求，利率必须保持较低水平，因此当前的宽松货币政策会在未来降低r*。我们证明，这种机制在解释大衰退之后实际利率和r*持续低迷的现象方面具有重要的定量意义。

abstract.text: In many markets, transaction prices are determined in auctions. In the most common form, prospective buyers compete by submitting bids to a seller. Each bid is an offer to buy that states a quantity and a maximum price. The seller then allocates the available supply among those offering the highest prices exceeding the seller's asking price. The actual price paid by a successful bidder depends on a pricing rule, usually selected by the seller: two common pricing rules are that each successful bidder pays the price bid; or they all pay the same price, usually the highest rejected bid or the lowest accepted bid. Auctions have been used for millennia, and remain the simplest and most famil-iar means of price determination for multilateral trading without intermediary `market makers ' such as brokers and specialists. Their trading procedures, which simply process bids and offers, are direct extensions of the usual forms of bilateral bargaining. Auctions also implement directly the demand submission procedures used in Walrasian models of markets. They therefore have prominent roles in the theory of exchange and in studies of the effects of economic institutions on the volume and terms of trade. Their allocative ef-®ciency in many contexts ensures their continued prominence in economic theory. They are also favored in experimental designs investigating the predictive power of economic theories. Auctions are apt subjects for applications of game theory because they present ex-plicit trading rules that largely ®x the `rules of the game'. Moreover, they present sub-stantive problems of strategic behavior of practical importance. They are particularly valuable as illustrations of games of incomplete information because bidders ' private information is the main factor affecting strategic behavior. The simpler forms of auctions induce normal-form games that are essentially `solved ' by applying directly the basic

10.3982/ecta19347.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，交易价格是通过拍卖来确定的。最常见的形式是，潜在买家通过向卖家出价来竞争。每个出价都是一种购买提议，其中包含了数量和最高价格。然后，卖家将可用的供应分配给那些出价高于卖家要价的最高出价者。成功出价者实际支付的价格取决于卖家选定的定价规则：两种常见的定价规则是，每个成功出价者支付其出价；或者所有出价者支付相同的价格，通常是最高被拒绝的出价或最低被接受的出价。拍卖已经使用了数千年，仍然是没有中间“市场制造者”如经纪人和专家的多边交易中最简单且最熟悉的定价方式。它们的交易程序只是简单地处理出价和报价，是通常的双边谈判形式的直接延伸。拍卖还直接实现了瓦尔拉斯模型市场中使用的需求提交程序。因此，它们在交换理论以及研究经济制度对贸易量和贸易条件的影响方面发挥着重要作用。它们在许多情境中的分配效率确保了它们在经济理论中的持续重要性。在调查经济理论预测能力的实验设计中，拍卖也受到青睐。拍卖是应用博弈论的合适对象，因为它们提供了明确的交易规则，这些规则在很大程度上反映了“游戏规则”。此外，它们还涉及具有实际重要性的战略行为问题。作为不完全信息博弈的例证，拍卖尤其有价值，因为出价者的“私人信息”是影响战略行为的主要因素。较简单的拍卖形式所引发的正常形式博弈，可以通过直接应用基本方法“解决”。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the influential factors underlying corporate innovation input decisions with a theoretical framework based on Cournot Equilibrium in game theory. By identifying the influential factors in theoretical deduction, we incorporate these factors with a sample of Chinese listed companies to empirically examine their impact on corporate innovation input decisions (e.g., R&D investment). The results reveal that corporate innovation input in terms of R & D investment is negatively associated with innovation risk, product cost and cost of capital, and positively related to profitability and innovation efficacy, which are consistent with the inferences of the theoretical framework and confirm the validity of our analytical model. With expanded sample range (multi-industries) and incorporation of market and governmental factors simultaneously, the findings are confirmatory to the main views of previous studies, and help to clarify the inconsistency in the findings in the extant literature. However, our empirical findings show that the type of business ownership (nature of equity right) and the level of regional marketization development do not significantly affect corporate R&D investment by the sample Chinese listed companies at present. This may be an evidence to support the development status of a market economy in China.

10.4236/ajibm.2021.113017.abstractZh: 本研究基于博弈论中的库尔诺均衡理论框架，分析了影响企业创新投入决策的因素。通过理论推导识别出这些影响因素后，我们将这些因素与中国上市公司样本相结合，实证检验它们对企业创新投入决策（如研发投资）的影响。研究结果表明，研发投资方面的企业创新投入与创新风险、产品成本及资本成本呈负相关，而与盈利能力和创新效率呈正相关，这些结果与理论框架的推断一致，进一步证实了我们的分析模型的有效性。通过扩大样本范围（涵盖多个行业）并同时考虑市场与政府因素，研究结果与以往研究的观点一致，有助于澄清现有文献中存在的不一致性。不过，我们的实证研究发现，目前中国上市公司的企业研发投资并未受到企业所有权类型（股权性质）和地区市场化发展水平的显著影响。这可能表明中国市场经济的发展状况。

abstract.text: This paper describes three methods for carrying out non-asymptotic inference on partially identified parameters that are solutions to a class of optimization problems.Applications in which the optimization problems arise include estimation under shape restrictions, estimation of models of discrete games, and estimation based on grouped data.The partially identified parameters are characterized by restrictions that involve the unknown population means of observed random variables in addition to the structural parameters of interest.Inference consists of finding confidence intervals for the structural parameters.Our theory provides finite-sample lower bounds on the coverage probabilities of the confidence intervals under three sets of assumptions of increasing strength.With the moderate sample sizes found in most economics applications, the bounds become tighter as the assumptions strengthen.We discuss estimation of population parameters that the bounds depend on and contrast our methods with alternative methods for obtaining confidence intervals for partially identified parameters.The results of Monte Carlo experiments and empirical examples illustrate the usefulness of our method.

10.47004/wp.cem.2021.3321.abstractZh: 本文描述了三种用于对部分识别参数进行非渐近推断的方法，这些参数是一类优化问题的解。在出现优化问题的应用中，包括受形状限制下的估计、离散博弈模型的估计以及基于分组数据的估计。部分识别参数的特点在于，除了感兴趣的结构参数外，还涉及未知观测随机变量总体均值的限制。推断过程包括为结构参数找到置信区间。我们的理论在三种假设条件下提供了有限样本下置信区间覆盖概率的下界，这些假设条件的强度逐渐增加。在大多数经济学应用中，样本量适中，随着假设条件的加强，这些下界会变得更加精确。我们讨论了这些下界所依赖的总体参数估计问题，并将我们的方法与获取部分识别参数置信区间的其他方法进行了比较。蒙特卡洛实验的结果和实证例子证明了我们方法的实用性。

abstract.text: In recent years, researchers, especially in human resource development, have categorized meaningful work as an important job characteristic.Though meaningful work has largely been examined in western cultures, the topic is becoming increasingly important in eastern societies as well.Prior literature typically frames meaningful work as a psychological construct or human resource function that focuses on an employee's wellbeing.However, economic utility theory is absent from most discussions of meaningful work.I frame meaningful work using utility theory to highlight various challenges that organizations face when trying to improve meaningful work.Based on this theoretical framework, I provide practical, realistic solutions to foster human resource development and meaningful work.Organizations that better understand the challenges faced when addressing meaningful work will likely find success in implementing impactful solutions.

10.47743/rebs-2021-1-0004.abstractZh: 近年来，特别是在人力资源开发领域的研究人员将有意义的工作视为一项重要的工作特征。尽管有意义的工作主要在西方文化中得到了研究，但这一主题在东方社会中也变得越来越重要。以往的文献通常将有意义的工作视为一种心理结构或人力资源功能，重点在于员工的福祉。然而，大多数关于有意义工作的讨论都忽略了经济效用理论。我运用效用理论来探讨有意义的工作，以揭示组织在努力提升有意义的工作时面临的各种挑战。基于这一理论框架，我提出了一些实用且现实的解决方案，以促进人力资源的发展和有意义的工作。那些能够更好地理解在应对有意义的工作时所面临的挑战的组织，很可能会在实施有效的解决方案时取得成功。

abstract.text: Previous research on variation in patient reported experience measures (PREMs) suggest that it is important to be cautious when using comparative information about patients’ experiences, collected via patient surveys, to assess provider performance. Not all factors associated with variation in PREMs are related to factors that providers themselves can control. This study explores if structural characteristics of primary care practices (PCCs), that are difficult to control, and the way that providers manage and organise their work matter for patients’ experiences with care. The purpose was to analyse variation in PREMs at the PCC level in Swedish primary care, with regard to structural characteristics of PCCs, including patient mix, and variables representing how providers organise and manage their work. Since the choice reform in 2007-2010, there is a mix of public and private providers, all with public funding and operating under the same overall requirements. The analysis is based on data from a national patient survey in primary care and registry data from a large Swedish region. OLS regression analysis was used to study variation in seven PREM-dimensions in regards to variables representing structural and organisational characteristics and processes of work at PCCs, covering the years 2018-2019 (N=281 PCC year observations). The results imply that variables that can be changed by providers themselves matter more for patients’ experiences with care than factors that providers cannot control. The most significant associations were found between PREMs and proportion and continuity of GP visits and adherence to clinical guidelines regarding treatment of risk groups. However, it is a challenge for providers to offer a high proportion of visits with GPs and good continuity due to a persisting shortage of GPs in Sweden. Recent policy initiatives have been introduced in this area. From a policy perspective, variation in patients’ experiences with regard to socioeconomic conditions is also a concern. Published: Online August 2021

10.5617/njhe.8030.abstractZh: 先前关于患者报告体验指标变异的研究表明，在评估医疗服务提供者的表现时，使用通过患者调查收集的比较性信息需要谨慎。并非所有与体验指标变异相关的因素都与医疗服务提供者自身能够控制的因素有关。本研究探讨了难以控制的基本护理实践的结构特征，以及医疗服务提供者如何管理和组织工作，这些因素是否对患者的护理体验产生影响。研究旨在分析瑞典基本护理中基本护理实践的结构特征，包括患者构成，以及代表医疗服务提供者如何组织和管理工作的变量，这些变量的体验指标变异情况。自2007-2010年的政策改革以来，瑞典的基本护理领域出现了公共和私人提供者并存的情况，所有提供者都接受公共资金支持，并遵循相同的整体要求。分析基于一项全国性的基本护理患者调查数据，以及瑞典一个大型地区的登记数据。采用OLS回归分析方法来研究2018-2019年期间七个体验指标维度的变异情况，涉及代表基本护理实践的结构和组织特征以及工作过程的变量，共观测了281个基本护理实践案例。研究结果表明，对于患者的护理体验而言，那些可以由医疗服务提供者自身改变的变量比那些无法控制的变量更为重要。最显著的关联在于体验指标与全科医生就诊的比例和连续性，以及与针对风险群体的临床指南的遵守程度之间的关系。然而，由于瑞典全科医生持续短缺，医疗服务提供者要提供高比例的全科医生诊疗服务并保持良好的连续性面临挑战。该领域最近推出了一些政策举措。从政策角度来看，患者在社会经济条件方面的体验差异也是一个值得关注的问题。发布日期：2021年8月在线发布。

abstract.text: Trois essais sur le chômage : géographie et politiques publiques Depuis les chocs pétroliers, le marché du travail français est caractérisé par un taux de chômage national élevé au regard des standards européens. Or, derrière cet agrégat national nécessairement simplificateur, se cache de grandes inégalités sociales et territoriales. Véritable fil rouge de l’action publique française à toutes les échelles de gouvernance, la lutte contre le chômage s’est vue déclinée, ou a influencé, de très nombreuses politiques publiques. Pourtant, notre connaissance sur les causes de ce phénomène et sur l’efficacité des solutions mises en place reste limitée. Cette thèse participe à une meilleure compréhension des causes du chômage et à une nécessaire évaluation des politiques visant à le combattre. Le 1er chapitre quantifie le mauvais appariement spatial de demandeurs d’emploi en France métropolitaine. Il mobilise des données individuelles sur les demandeurs d’emploi et les offres d’emploi pour construire un indice municipal d’accessibilité aux opportunités d’emploi. L’effet de l’accessibilité est identifié pour une sous-population de demandeurs d’emploi récurrents au chômage pour lequel on contrôle d’un effet fixe individuel et d’un effet fixe municipal. L’effet moyen de l’accessibilité sur les trajectoires au chômage ainsi mesuré est significatif mais faible. On montre cependant que l’effet est beaucoup plus important pour les demandeurs peu qualifiés et peu diplômés. Nous montrons de manière descriptive que cet écart pourrait s'expliquer par des différences dans la mobilité résidentielle des demandeurs d’emploi. Le 2nd chapitre étudie les effets de la construction de réseaux de tramways dans la majorité des grandes villes françaises sur les Quartiers Prioritaires de la Villes (QPV) et leurs habitants. Il s’appuie sur des données administratives précisément géolocalisées relatives aux demandeurs d’emploi, aux ménages et aux transactions immobilières. La stratégie empirique repose sur la comparaison de QPV connectés à un groupe témoin non connecté. A court terme, malgré la précision de nos estimations, nous ne trouvons aucun impact du nouveau réseau de transport sur les trajectoires individuelles au chômage des résidents. A moyen terme, nous montrons des effets sur le marché du logement cohérents avec la capitalisation des gains d'accessibilité ainsi qu'un changement dans la composition des revenus des locataires et propriétaires. Cependant la gentrification est limitée par la part importante de logements sociaux. Le 3ème chapitre est consacré au rôle des conseillers Pôle emploi dans les politiques actives de lutte contre le chômage. Grâce à des données administratives, nous estimons la valeur ajoutée individuelle des conseillers en région parisienne. Nous quantifions qu’avoir un conseiller qui se situe un écart-type au-dessus dans la distribution de la valeur ajoutée se traduit par une augmentation d'environ 8.4\% (13.2\%) de la probabilité de trouver un emploi (stable) dans les 6 mois. A l’aide de données détaillées sur les entretiens, les offres d'emploi recommandées, les formations et les autres programmes de politiques actives, nous documentons les types de pratiques qui sont corrélées avec la valeur ajoutée des conseillers. Nous constatons que les conseillers à forte valeur ajoutée ne sont pas les mêmes et ne proposent pas les mêmes services selon l'objectif poursuivi (sortie rapide ou stable) et les caractéristiques du demandeur d’emploi. Cela met en évidence un compromis potentiel entre les pratiques qui favorisent une sortie rapide du chômage et celles qui favorisent des appariements de meilleure qualité.

10.70675/1050a793z0c0ez4e1ez8811zeafbe41.abstractZh: 《关于失业问题的三项研究：地理与公共政策》自石油危机以来，法国的劳动力市场一直以高于欧洲标准的失业率著称。然而，在这一个必然简化的全国数据背后，隐藏着巨大的社会与地区不平等现象。在法国各级政府的行动中，打击失业问题一直是核心议题，许多公共政策都与此相关。然而，我们对这一现象成因以及所采取解决方案的有效性了解仍然有限。本论文旨在更深入地理解失业问题的成因，并评估旨在应对失业问题的政策效果。第一章量化了法国本土求职者在空间分布上的不均衡现象，通过收集个体数据来构建一个反映就业机会可及性的市级指标。研究发现，对于长期失业的求职者群体，可及性效应显著，但影响较小。不过，对于那些技能较低、学历较低的求职者来说，这种效应更为明显。我们还指出，这种差异可能源于求职者居住流动性的差异。第二章研究了法国大多数大城市的有轨电车网络建设对城市重点区域及其居民的影响。该研究基于精确地理定位的行政数据，这些数据涉及失业者、家庭以及房地产交易。实证策略基于将QPV与未连接的对照组进行比较。短期内，尽管我们的估计非常精确，但我们并未发现新的交通网络对失业居民的个人轨迹产生任何影响。中期来看，我们发现住房市场出现了与便利性提升相关的效应，同时租户和业主的收入结构也发生了变化。然而，高档化趋势受到大量社会住房的制约。第三章探讨了就业援助顾问在积极失业对策中的作用。通过行政数据，我们估算了巴黎地区这些顾问的个人附加价值。我们发现，在价值分布中处于较高位置的顾问，其帮助求职者在6个月内找到稳定工作的概率增加了约8.4%（13.2%）。通过详细的数据分析，包括面试信息、推荐的就业机会、培训以及其他积极政策项目，我们记录了与顾问附加价值相关的实践类型。我们发现，具有较高附加价值的顾问所提供的服务并不相同，且会根据求职者的目标（快速或稳定就业）以及其特点来提供不同的服务。这揭示了在促进快速就业与促进更高质量匹配之间可能存在的权衡。

abstract.text: Trois essais sur les politiques du marché du travail : l'aide à la recherche d'emploi et les outils numériques Depuis les années 1970, face à l’augmentation du taux et de la durée du chômage, les pouvoirs publics ont orienté leurs efforts vers des politiques dites « actives » du marché du travail. Parmi celles-ci, les politiques d’accompagnement se sont révélées particulièrement efficaces. Par ailleurs, les changements technologiques ont modifié les pratiques d’embauche et de recherche d’emploi au cours des dernières décennies. L’utilisation d’Internet est devenue la norme, tant pour les employeurs que pour les demandeurs d’emploi. Cette thèse a deux objectifs : comprendre les mécanismes qui se cachent derrière la réussite des politiques d’accompagnement et déterminer le rôle du numérique dans cet accompagnement. Elle se présente en trois chapitres. Le premier chapitre montre qu’un programme d’accompagnement numérique conçu pour une population qui n’avait jusqu’ici fait l’objet d’aucune étude scientifique - les demandeurs d’emploi les plus autonomes - peut augmenter leur chance de retrouver un emploi. Le deuxième chapitre explore le rôle des conseillers. Il mesure l’influence considérable de ces derniers sur la quantité et la qualité des sorties vers l’emploi et souligne que certains conseillers semblent favoriser l’une plutôt que l’autre, notamment à travers les services proposés aux demandeurs d’emploi. Enfin, le dernier chapitre analyse simultanément la réaction des entreprises et des demandeurs d’emploi suite à une stimulation de la recherche d’emploi via une plateforme en ligne. Fournir des recommandations ciblées augmente le retour à l’emploi des femmes et les embauches en CDI des établissements.

10.70675/7425038cze8f7z47fbz8890z5d06241.abstractZh:
关于劳动力市场政策的三项研究：就业援助与数字工具  
自20世纪70年代以来，面对失业率和失业时间的增加，政府开始实施所谓的“积极”劳动力市场政策。其中，就业援助政策被证明特别有效。此外，技术变革在过去几十年中改变了招聘和求职的惯例。互联网的使用已成为雇主和求职者之间的常态。本论文有两个目标：理解就业援助政策成功背后的机制，以及确定数字技术在其中的作用。论文分为三个章节。第一章表明，针对那些此前未接受过科学研究的群体——即自主性最强的求职者，设计的数字就业援助计划可以提高他们找到工作的机会。第二章探讨了顾问的作用，评估了他们对就业成果的数量和质量的影响，并指出某些顾问通过提供的服务更倾向于促进某种结果。最后，第三章同时分析了企业和求职者在使用在线平台促进求职后的反应。提供有针对性的建议可以提高女性的就业率，并促进机构的长期雇佣。

abstract.text: Trois Essais sur la Divulgation Trois chapitres sont inclus dans ma thèse. Ces trois chapitres concernent l'environnement informationnel des institutions et les déterminants et conséquences des pratiques de divulgation. Je me concentre non seulement sur la pratique de la divulgation des entreprises, mais j'apporte également des contributions en étudiant les organisations à but non lucratif et les entités commerciales non conventionnelles, à savoir les universités et les crypto monnaie, dans mes études.

10.70675/ac608d42z7ca1z4d30z9d8bz3ee0d41.abstractZh: 《关于信息披露的三篇论文》我的论文包含三章内容。这三章分别探讨了机构的信息环境以及信息披露行为的决定因素和后果。我不仅关注企业的信息披露实践，还在研究中对非营利组织和非传统商业实体，如大学和加密货币进行了研究，以期为相关领域提供贡献。

abstract.text: Workers wrongly anchor their beliefs about outside options on their current wage. In particular, low-paid workers underestimate wages elsewhere. We document this anchoring bias by eliciting workers’ beliefs in a representative survey in Germany and comparing them to measures of actual outside options in linked administrative labor market data. In an equilibrium model, such anchoring can give rise to monopsony and labor market segmentation. In line with the model, misperceptions are particularly pronounced among workers in low-wage firms. If workers had correct beliefs, at least 10% of jobs, concentrated in low-wage firms, would not be viable at current wages.

10.71432/zsp.pb.2021.02.abstractZh: 工人们错误地将他们对外部机会的信念建立在当前的工资水平上。特别是，低薪工人低估了其他地方的工资水平。我们通过一项在德国进行的代表性调查来记录这种锚定偏见，并将工人的信念与实际外部机会的情况进行比较，后者来自相关的行政劳动力市场数据。在均衡模型中，这种锚定偏见可能导致垄断市场和劳动力市场分割。与模型一致，这种误解在低薪企业的工人中尤为明显。如果工人们的信念是正确的，那么至少10%的低薪企业中的工作岗位在当前工资水平下是无法维持的。

abstract.text: In this dissertation, I explore the implications of various forms of frictions on market outcomes.Specifically, I look at search frictions in two-sided markets, geographic frictions in a healthcare market, and the use of a machine learning approach in the presence of regulatory frictions. In the first chapter, I leverage the entry of a high-speed train system in South Korea as a natural experiment to establish the causal effect of competition between hospitals on health care quality and consumer welfare. Using a difference-in-differences estimator, we examine the effects of competition on hospitals depending on their proximity to train stations, notably how increased competition impacts health outcomes as measured by 30-day mortality rates. Our results suggest that increased competition leads to an improvement in the quality of clinical care. To evaluate the overall impact of the HST on patient welfare, we estimate a structural model of hospital choice, allowing for a flexible formation of patients’ consideration sets. We find that patients living near a HST station experience an improvement in welfare arising from the reduction in travel time as well as improvements in hospital quality. Patients living further away from HST stations also experience an improvement in welfare although they do not gain from the reduced travel time due to the improvement in the quality of treated hospitals. We also find that the HST can have a beneficial impact on patient health by facilitating patients’ sorting to better hospitals, even while holding quality of clinical care constant. In the second chapter, I study the impact of search frictions and preferences on the formation of a match in two-sided markets. Since agents on both sides have private preferences regarding each others’ characteristics, forming a match based on mutual compatibility requires extensive costly search. To better understand the relative impact of search frictions and preferences on match outcomes, we use data from a field experiment conducted on an online dating platform wherein randomly selected users are given the ability to know upfront a piece of information about the private preference of the opposite gender (information which otherwise should have been searched for). We find descriptive evidence suggesting that reducing search frictions through the provision of information may lead to less sorting between matched couples in terms of various characteristics such as race and education level. To investigate the relative contribution of search frictions and preferences on assortative matching, we develop and estimate a model that incorporates both costly search and preference heterogeneity across users. Identification of our model relies on the variation in information caused by the experiment as well as the exclusion restriction to separately identify preferences from costs. Our estimation results reveal that frictions play a significant role in shaping matching outcomes. Using model estimates, we simulate matches under various environments, including the Gale-Shapley protocol. We find that removing frictions leads to significantly less sorting between couples. We also find that frictions in our platform lead to significant departure from efficiency. These results highlight the importance of platform designs that aim to reduce search frictions. In addition, with one-third of the marriages in the U.S. beginning online, this paper shows how the design of an online platform can contribute to diversity, which can in turn alleviate persistent social inequality. In the third chapter, I study how we can use machine learning methods to overcome challenges faced by firms in the presence of restrictive privacy regulations. The ever-increasing volume of consumer data provide unprecedented opportunities for firms to predict consumer behavior, target customers, and provide customized service. Recent trends of more restrictive privacy regulations worldwide, however, present great challenges for firms whose business activities rely on consumer data. We address these challenges by applying the recently developed federated learning approach - a privacy-preserving machine learning approach that uses a parallelized learning algorithm to train a model locally on each individual user’s device. We apply this approach to data from an online retailer and train a Gated Recurrent Unit recurrent neural network to predict each consumer’s click-stream. We show the firm can predict each consumer’s activities with a high level of accuracy without the need to store, access, or analyze consumer data in a centralized location, thereby protecting their sensitive information.

10.7936/q0k9-zm66.abstractZh: 在本论文中，我探讨了各种形式的市场摩擦对市场结果的影响。具体来说，我研究了双边市场中的搜索摩擦、医疗市场中的地理摩擦，以及在监管摩擦存在的情况下使用机器学习方法的情况。在第一章中，我以韩国高速列车系统的引入作为自然实验，来研究医院竞争对医疗质量和消费者福利的因果效应。通过使用差异-差异估计方法，我们考察了竞争对医院的影响，特别是竞争程度与医院距离火车站的远近之间的关系，以及竞争如何通过30天死亡率等指标影响健康结果。我们的研究结果表明，竞争程度的增加有助于提升临床护理质量。为了评估高速列车系统对患者福利的整体影响，我们建立了一个医院选择的结构模型，允许患者考虑因素的灵活组合。我们发现，居住在火车站附近的患者因旅行时间减少而获得福利提升，同时医院质量也有所改善。虽然居住在火车站较远的患者不会因医院质量提升而获得旅行时间的减少带来的福利，但他们仍然能享受到福利的提升。我们还发现，即使临床护理质量保持不变，高速列车系统也能通过促进患者选择更好的医院，从而对患者的健康产生积极影响。在第二章中，我研究了搜索摩擦和偏好对双边市场中匹配形成的影响。由于双方参与者对彼此的特质都有各自的偏好，因此基于相互兼容性进行匹配需要大量的成本性搜索。为了更好地理解搜索摩擦和偏好对匹配结果的影响，我们参考了一个在线约会平台上的实地实验数据。在该实验中，随机选择的用户能够提前了解对方性别的私人偏好信息（这些信息原本需要花费时间进行搜索）。我们发现，通过提供这些信息来减少搜索摩擦，可能会减少匹配伴侣在种族、教育水平等各个特征上的差异。为了研究搜索摩擦和偏好对匹配效果的相对影响，我们开发并估计了一个模型，该模型同时考虑了昂贵的搜索成本和用户之间的偏好差异。我们模型的识别依赖于实验引起的信息差异，以及通过排除限制来区分偏好和成本的方法。我们的估计结果显示，搜索摩擦在塑造匹配结果方面起着重要作用。利用模型估计结果，我们在包括Gale-Shapley协议在内的不同环境下模拟了匹配过程。我们发现，消除摩擦后，伴侣之间的差异显著减少。此外，我们平台上的摩擦还导致效率显著下降。这些结果凸显了设计旨在减少搜索摩擦的平台的必要性。另外，在美国，大约三分之一的婚姻都是在这种平台上进行的。本文首先探讨了在线平台设计如何促进多样性，进而缓解持续存在的社会不平等问题。在第三章中，我们研究了如何利用机器学习方法应对在严格的隐私法规下企业所面临的挑战。不断增长的消费者数据为企业在预测消费者行为、精准定位客户以及提供个性化服务方面提供了前所未有的机会。然而，全球范围内日益严格的隐私法规给依赖消费者数据的企业带来了巨大挑战。我们采用一种新开发的联邦学习方法来应对这些挑战——这是一种保护隐私的机器学习方法，它利用并行化学习算法在每位用户的设备上本地训练模型。我们将这种方法应用于一家在线零售商的数据，训练一个门控循环单元循环神经网络来预测每位消费者的点击流。结果表明，该企业能够在无需将消费者数据存储在集中位置、也无法访问或分析这些数据的情况下，以高准确率预测每位消费者的行为，从而保护了他们的敏感信息。

abstract.text: We conduct a randomized experiment that varies one-time health insurance subsidy amounts (partial and full) in Ghana to study the impacts of subsidies on insurance enrollment and health care utilization. We find that both partial and full subsidies promote insurance enrollment in the long run, even after the subsidies expired. Although the long run enrollment rate and selective enrollment do not differ by subsidy level, long run health care utilization increased only for the partial subsidy group. We show that this can plausibly be explained by stronger learning-through-experience behavior in the partial than in the full subsidy group.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.00617.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，在加纳对不同金额的一次性健康保险补贴（部分补贴和全额补贴）进行了调整，以研究补贴对保险参保率和医疗利用的影响。研究发现，从长远来看，无论是部分补贴还是全额补贴都能促进保险参保率，即使补贴到期后也是如此。尽管长期参保率和选择性参保率在不同补贴水平下没有差异，但长期医疗利用率仅部分补贴群体有所提高。我们认为，这一现象可以合理地解释为部分补贴群体比全额补贴群体具有更强的通过经验学习的行为。

abstract.text: Motivated by kidney exchange, we study the following mechanism-design problem: On a directed graph (of transplant compatibilities among patient-donor pairs), the mechanism must select a simple path (a chain of transplantations) starting at a distinguished vertex (an altruistic donor) such that the total length of this path is as large as possible (a maximum number of patients receive a kidney). However, the mechanism does not have direct access to the graph. Instead, the vertices are partitioned over multiple players (hospitals), and each player reports a subset of her vertices to the mechanism. In particular, a player may strategically omit vertices to increase how many of her vertices lie on the path returned by the mechanism. Our objective is to find mechanisms that limit incentives for such manipulation while producing long paths. Unfortunately, in worst-case instances, competing with the overall longest path is impossible while incentivizing (approximate) truthfulness, i.e., requiring that hiding nodes cannot increase a player's utility by more than a factor of $1 + o(1)$. We therefore adopt a semi-random model where a small ($o(n)$) number of random edges are added to worst-case instances. While it remains impossible for truthful mechanisms to compete with the overall longest path, we give a truthful mechanism that competes with a weaker but non-trivial benchmark: the length of any path whose subpaths within each player have a minimum average length. In fact, our mechanism satisfies even a stronger notion of truthfulness, which we call matching-time incentive compatibility. This notion of truthfulness requires that each player not only reports her nodes truthfully but also does not stop the returned path at any of her nodes in order to divert it to a continuation inside her own subgraph.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.11387.abstractZh: 受肾脏交换的启发，我们研究以下机制设计问题：在一个有向图上（表示患者与捐赠者之间的移植兼容性），该机制必须选择一个简单的路径（一系列移植操作），该路径从某个特殊顶点（无私的捐赠者）开始，使得这条路径的总长度尽可能大（使尽可能多的患者获得肾脏）。然而，该机制无法直接访问这张图。相反，顶点被分配给多个参与者（医院），每个参与者向机制报告其部分顶点。特别地，一个参与者可以策略性地省略某些顶点，以增加其顶点在机制返回的路径上的数量。我们的目标是找到能够限制这种操纵行为的激励措施，同时实现较长的路径。不幸的是，在最坏的情况下，与最长路径竞争是不可能的，同时激励（近似）的真实性要求，即隐藏节点不会使玩家的效用增加超过$1 + o(1)$倍。因此，我们采用了一个半随机模型，在最坏情况下添加少量（$o(n)$）随机边。虽然真实机制无法与最长路径竞争，但我们找到了一种真实机制，它能够与一个较弱但非平凡的基准进行竞争：即任何路径的长度，其每个参与者内部子路径的平均长度最小。实际上，我们的机制甚至满足了更强形式的真实性要求，我们称之为匹配时间激励兼容性。这种真实性要求每个参与者不仅要如实报告其节点，而且不得在任何节点处中断返回的路径，以将其引导到自身子图内的其他路径上。

abstract.text: Understanding the consequences of current health policy is important in order to design and develop a health care system suitable for future challenges. The purpose of this thesis is to bring evidence on the determinants of regional variation in health care and on individuals’ responsiveness to patient out-of-pocket prices in Sweden. The papers included in the thesis are longitudinal register based studies, using representative samples of the Swedish population, with data obtained from national and regional databases. The analyses are primarily based on econometric methods drawing on quasi-experimental approaches to estimate causal effects. The results in Paper I show that regional level mortality and demographics explain a large part of regional variation in visits to specialists, but has limited association with regional variation in visits to primary care physicians. In Paper II, the results show that the relative effect of individual level characteristics outweighs the effect of region-specific characteristics as the drivers of regional variation in pharmaceutical expenditures. The findings in Paper III show that young adults are price sensitive and reduce their use of primary care services after the introduction of patient out-of-pocket prices, with especially strong effects among low-income groups and women. In Paper IV, the findings show that older adults respond to an upcoming elimination of patient out-of-pocket prices by delaying primary care visits in the months before the policy change, but the results show no evidence for a persistent increase in primary care use after the out-of-pocket price elimination. In conclusion, the findings show that the determinants of regional variation differ within the same health care system, which suggests that the specific institutional settings by type of care are key in understanding regional variation. Further, the results imply that policymakers need to consider heterogeneity and forward-looking behavior in individuals’ sensitivity to out-of-pocket prices when developing health care policy.

https://openalex.org/W3129469767.abstractZh: 理解当前健康政策的后果对于设计和开发能够应对未来挑战的医疗保健系统至关重要。本论文旨在提供关于瑞典地区间医疗保健差异的决定因素以及个人对自费价格反应的证据。论文中包含的均为基于纵向登记的研究，使用了瑞典人口的代表性样本，数据来源于国家和地区数据库。分析主要基于计量经济学方法，并采用准实验方法来估计因果效应。第一篇论文的结果表明，地区层面的死亡率和人口统计特征解释了地区间专科就诊差异的很大一部分，但与地区间初级保健就诊差异的关联有限。第二篇论文的结果显示，个体特征的相对影响大于地区特定特征作为药品支出地区差异的驱动因素的影响。第三篇论文的研究表明，年轻人在引入自费价格政策后，对价格较为敏感，减少了初级保健服务的使用，尤其是在低收入群体和女性中这种效应尤为明显。第四篇论文的研究表明，年长者在政策变化前的几个月会推迟初级保健就诊，以应对即将取消自费价格政策，但结果并未显示取消自费价格后初级保健使用量会持续增加。综上所述，研究结果表明，同一医疗体系内，区域差异的决定因素各不相同，这表明根据护理类型的不同，具体的制度环境是理解区域差异的关键。此外，研究结果表明，政策制定者在制定医疗政策时，需要考虑个体对自付费用的敏感性的异质性和前瞻性行为。

abstract.text: In one of the first studies of service sector robotics using establishment-level data, we study the impact of robots on staffing in Japanese nursing homes, using geographic variation in robot subsidies as an instrumental variable. We find that robot adoption increases employment by augmenting the number of care workers and nurses on flexible employment contracts, and decreases difficulty in staff retention. Robot adoption also reduces the monthly wages of regular nurses, consistent with reduced burden of care. Our findings suggest that the impact of robots may not be detrimental to labor and may remedy challenges posed by rapidly aging populations.

https://openalex.org/W3141364604.abstractZh: 在最早使用机构级数据研究服务行业机器人应用的研究之一中，我们探讨了机器人对日本养老院人员配置的影响，以机器人补贴的地理差异作为工具变量进行分析。研究发现，机器人应用通过增加灵活雇佣合同的护理人员和护士数量，提升了就业人数，并降低了员工留任的困难。同时，机器人应用还降低了普通护士的月收入，这与护理负担减轻是一致的。我们的研究结果表明，机器人的影响可能不会对劳动力产生负面影响，反而可能解决快速老龄化人口带来的挑战。

abstract.text: The general deterrence effects of malpractice laws on physician behavior have been extensively studied but may lack salience for physicians. We study the role of specific deterrence in malpractice liability by examining how physicians respond to being accused of malpractice. With the universe of data on patient care and malpractice complaints for Florida emergency physicians, we find that physicians oversee 9% fewer discharges after allegations and treat each discharge 5% more expensively. Effects are similar for paid claims and dropped accusations. Increases in treatment are generalized, i.e., not limited to conditions similar to what the physician is reported for.

https://openalex.org/W3148324665.abstractZh: 关于医疗事故法对医生行为的一般威慑效果已有大量研究，但这些研究可能并未引起医生的足够重视。我们通过研究医生在受到医疗事故指控时的反应，来探讨特定威慑措施的作用。利用佛罗里达州急诊医生的患者护理和医疗事故投诉数据，我们发现，在受到指控后，医生处理的出院病例数量减少了9%，且每处理一个出院病例所需的费用增加了5%。无论是针对有偿索赔还是撤销指控，这种影响都是相似的。治疗费用的增加是普遍性的，即不仅限于医生被举报所涉及的病症。

abstract.text: My dissertation consists of three studies, all viewing aggregate productivity as driven by the individual decisions of firms and the inventors that work for them. I use microeconometric analysis to study why firms innovate and economic theory to link these decisions to macroeconomic outcomes. The first paper in this dissertation studies how German manufacturing firms adjust their productivity in response to an increase in competition from foreign markets. German firms only increase their productivity if their new competitors come from other industrialized economies. This productivity increase is not driven by innovation. Instead, firms cut input expenses and prices while maintaining their output. The second paper traces the matching decisions of firms and inventors on the labor markets of developed economies. It adapts empirical techniques used in labor economics to this special segment of the labor market and shows that assortative matching has been increasing from 1974 to 2012: High quality inventors go to high quality firms more often than was the case in previous decades. This cannot be explained by changes in the patent invention function: The productivity of a match between a firm and an inventor of constant quality remains roughly unchanged. The third paper develops an endogenous growth model with inventor labor markets and two types of innovation: disruptive inventions that change the underlying technology of firms’ products and incremental improvements over existing products. Firms acquire expertise in certain technologies by hiring the inventors who are experts in these fields. This gives them a strong incentive to prevent disruptive inventions: If the underlying technology changes, their investment in these inventors becomes worthless. Large firms inhibit aggregate growth by poaching inventors from firms engaged in disruptive innovation.

https://openalex.org/W3160177551.abstractZh: 我的博士论文包含三项研究，均将总体生产率视为由企业及其雇用的发明家的个人决策所驱动。我采用微观计量经济学分析方法研究企业为何进行创新，并利用经济理论将这些决策与宏观经济结果联系起来。论文的第一篇研究探讨了德国制造企业在面临外国市场竞争加剧时如何调整其生产率。只有当新竞争对手来自其他工业化经济体时，德国企业才会提高生产率。这种生产率提升并非由创新驱动，而是企业通过削减投入成本和价格来维持产出。第二篇研究追踪了发达经济体中企业和发明家在劳动力市场上的匹配决策。该研究将劳动经济学中的实证技术应用于这一特殊劳动力市场领域，并发现自1974年至2012年间，高质量发明家更频繁地进入高质量企业。这一现象无法用专利发明函数的变化来解释：即使企业与发明家之间的匹配质量保持不变，生产率也基本没有变化。第三篇研究建立了一个包含发明家劳动力市场以及两种类型创新的内生增长模型：一种是改变企业产品基础技术的颠覆性创新，另一种是现有产品的渐进性改进。企业通过雇佣这些领域的专家来提升自身在特定技术上的专业知识，这使他们有强烈的动机来阻止颠覆性创新的发生——因为如果基础技术发生变化，他们对这些发明家的投资将变得毫无价值。大型企业通过从从事颠覆性创新的企业中挖走发明家，从而抑制了整体经济增长。

abstract.text: Despite its best efforts, the National Football League (NFL) has long been criticised for its lack of minority leadership amongst its teams. Recent hires (and non-hires) have only served to heighten this criticism. To assess this, we use a new, rich and unique dataset to examine the relationship between race and coaching hierarchy in the NFL. Our results indicate that young, experienced and well performing coordinators are likely to be promoted to Head Coach while older and poorly performing coaches are more likely to be fired. A coach’s race does not seem to play a role in either promotions or firings. In the post Rooney Rule era (post 2003) however, black coordinators are marginally more likely to be promoted than previously. Black Head Coaches on the other hand, are neither more nor less likely to find a job at the same level. The Rooney Rule has been successful to the extent that teams now consider (and ultimately appoint) equally skilled black coordinators to Head Coaching jobs, despite our evidence suggesting that equally skilled black coordinators had always been available.

https://openalex.org/W3161093909.abstractZh: 尽管美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）付出了诸多努力，但其球队中少数族裔领导力的缺失仍长期受到批评。最近的招聘人员（以及未招聘人员）进一步加剧了这一批评。为了评估这一情况，我们使用了一个新的、丰富且独特的数据集来研究NFL中种族与教练层级之间的关系。我们的研究结果表明，年轻、经验丰富且表现优秀的教练更有可能被提升为主教练，而年长且表现不佳的教练则更有可能被解雇。教练的种族似乎对晋升或解雇没有影响。然而，在“鲁尼规则”实施之后（2003年之后），黑人教练被提升为主教练的可能性略高于以前。另一方面，黑人主教练在寻找同等级别的工作时，其被录用的可能性并没有增加或减少。“鲁尼规则”已经取得了成功，因为现在各球队会考虑并最终任命同样有能力的黑人教练担任主教练职位，尽管我们的证据表明，同样有能力的黑人教练一直都是存在的。

abstract.text: Governments face many constraints in attracting talented managers to the public sector, where high-powered incentives are often absent. In this paper, we study how a civil service reform in Chile changed the effectiveness of a vital group of public sector managers, school principals. We measure principals’ e˙ectiveness using an extension of the canonical teacher value-added model and we evaluate the effect of the reform using a dfference-in-differences approach. We find that public schools appoint more effective managers after increasing the competitiveness and transparency of their se-lection process. Our result shows that better recruitment policies can enhance service provision in the public sector, despite rigid wage schemes.

https://openalex.org/W3182598170.abstractZh: 政府在吸引有才华的管理人员进入公共部门时面临许多限制，因为公共部门往往缺乏强有力的激励措施。本文研究了智利的一项公务员改革如何改变了公共部门管理者——学校校长这一关键群体的效率。我们通过扩展经典的教师增值模型来衡量校长的效率，并使用差异差异法来评估改革的效果。研究发现，通过提高选拔过程的竞争性和透明度，公立学校能够任命更有效的管理者。我们的结果表明，更好的招聘政策可以在工资制度僵化的情况下提升公共部门的服务质量。

abstract.text: Objective: This dissertation is made of two academic papers followed by a chapter discussing policy implications of the findings. The objective of this dissertation is to better understand if high-serious mental illness (SMI) nursing homes (NHs) provide poorer quality of care (e.g., operationalized as staffing levels, NH Compare quality star ratings, and health deficiencies) and whether quality in high-SMI NHs is confounded by payer mix (e.g., the proportion of residents who are Medicaid-reimbursed). A modified Donabedian Structure, Process, Outcome (SPO) Model was used as the main theoretical framework. Methods: Data came from the Certification and Survey Provider Enhanced Reports (CASPER) from 2016 for Chapter 2 and from 2014 to 2017 for Chapter 3. Quality star ratings from the NH Compare website were extracted. Multistep linear models were used for Chapter 2 to measure the effect of high-SMI status on staffing levels and NH Compare quality star ratings. Generalized linear mixed effects models (negative binomial) and linear mixed effects models were used for Chapter 3 to measure the effect of high-SMI status on the number of deficiencies, a weighted deficiency score, and the likelihood of deficiencies by scope and severity. Results: Chapter 2 found that Structure proxies such as the proportion of Medicaid-reimbursed residents confounded the relationship between high-SMI status and Process (e.g., staffing levels) and Bottom-Up (e.g., quality star ratings) proxies of quality. High-SMI NHs with a large proportion of Medicaid-reimbursed residents provided lower nurse staffing levels of all types and lower star ratings on overall stars, health inspection stars, overall staffing stars, and registered nurse staffing stars in comparison to high-SMI NHs with a low proportion of Medicaid-reimbursed residents. High-SMI NHs received more deficiencies and a greater deficiency score per inspection. However, these Top-Down proxies of quality were attenuated by the inclusion of Structure proxies such as payer mix. Deficiencies given to high-SMI NHs were associated with wider scope, especially Pattern and Widespread. In an exploratory aim, high-SMI NHs were more likely to be cited for resident abuse, neglect, or involuntary seclusion and the policies that prohibit and monitor for risk of abuse and neglect in comparison to low-SMI NHs when looking exclusively at deficiencies cited for Actual Harm or Immediate Jeopardy. Conclusion: High-SMI NHs are unlike “typical” NHs as a majority of the residents have unique behavioral and mental healthcare needs. Findings from this dissertation suggest that quality in these facilities – measured via Top-Down (health deficiencies), Bottom-Up (NH Compare quality star ratings), or Process proxies (staffing levels) – is lower on average after controlling for a variety of confounding variables. One confounding factor that attenuates but does not fully explain differences in quality is a Structure proxy, payer mix. Specifically, the proportion of residents reimbursed through Medicaid affects the staffing levels, quality star ratings, and health deficiencies given to high-SMI NHs. A potential solution to improve quality in these facilities may be increasing Medicaid reimbursement rates, while tying the increased rates to specific staffing-related expenditures. In conclusion, high-SMI NHs provide poorer quality of care on average, though part of this association is explained by the lower margins provided by Medicaid.

https://openalex.org/W3186111408.abstractZh: 目的：本论文由两篇学术论文组成，后面还附有一章讨论研究结果的政策含义。本论文的目的是更好地了解高严重精神疾病护理院是否提供质量较差的护理服务（例如，通过人员配备水平、护理院质量星级评分和健康缺陷等指标来衡量），以及高严重精神疾病护理院的质量是否受到支付方类型的干扰（例如，接受医疗补助支付的居民比例）。主要理论框架采用了改良的Donabedian结构-过程-结果模型。方法：第二章的数据来自2016年的认证和调查提供者增强报告（CASPER），第三章的数据来自2014年至2017年。护理院质量星级评分数据来自护理院比较网站。第二章使用多步线性模型来测量高严重精神疾病状态对人员配备水平和护理院质量星级评分的影响。第三章使用广义线性混合效应模型（负二项模型）和线性混合效应模型来测量高严重精神疾病状态对缺陷数量、加权缺陷评分以及按范围和严重程度划分的缺陷发生概率的影响。结果：第二章发现，诸如接受医疗补助支付的居民比例这样的结构指标干扰了高严重精神疾病状态与过程指标（如人员配备水平）以及结果指标（如质量星级评分）之间的关系。与接受医疗补助支付的居民比例较低的高严重精神疾病护理院相比，接受医疗补助支付的居民比例较高的高严重精神疾病护理院在各类人员配备水平以及总体星级评分、健康检查星级评分、总体人员配备星级评分和注册护士人员配备星级评分方面都表现较差。高SMI等级的非营利医疗机构在每次检查中面临的缺陷更多，且每项的缺陷得分也更高。然而，这些通过自上而下方式评估的质量指标因纳入了诸如支付方组合等结构性指标而有所减弱。给予高SMI等级非营利医疗机构的缺陷主要涉及更广泛的领域，尤其是“模式”和“广泛性”方面的缺陷。在探索性研究中发现，与低SMI等级非营利医疗机构相比，高SMI等级非营利医疗机构更可能被提及存在居民虐待、忽视或非自愿隔离的问题，以及那些禁止和监控虐待及忽视风险的政策。结论：高SMI等级非营利医疗机构与“典型”非营利医疗机构不同，因为大多数居民具有独特的行为和心理健康需求。本研究的发现表明，在控制多种混杂变量后，这些机构的质量——通过自上而下方式评估的缺陷、自下而上方式评估的质量星级评分，或过程性指标（如人员配备水平）来衡量——平均而言较低。一个能够减弱但不完全解释质量差异的混杂因素就是结构性指标，即支付方组合。具体来说，通过医疗补助获得补偿的居民比例会影响人员配备水平、质量星级评分，以及给予高SMI等级非营利医疗机构的缺陷数量。提高这些机构质量的潜在解决方案可能是提高医疗补助的补偿率，并将这一增加的比率与特定的人员配备相关支出挂钩。总之，高SMI等级非营利医疗机构的平均护理质量较差，尽管这种关联部分可以通过医疗补助提供的较低边际收入来解释。

abstract.text: This dissertation comprises three studies on the incentives and motivations of public sector personnel, including bureaucrats and politicians. Chapter 1 tries to understand how public organizations can strengthen the mission motivation of public employees. Chapters 2 and 3 explore how the supply of politicians can be improved by either appealing to intrinsic motivation of potential candidates or removing the cost and information barriers that prevents them from becoming politicians. In chapter 1, I investigate if public organizations can motivate workers by emphasizing the organizational mission to them. I implement a field experiment in partnership with the Department of Health in Pakistan, where I randomly emphasize the public health mission to community health workers, provide performance-linked financial incentives, or do both. The mission treatment improves worker performance across incentivized (home visits) and non-incentivized tasks, while financial incentives improve performance only on the incentivized task. Financial incentives also become less effective at increasing home visits when combined with the mission treatment. Finally, the mission treatment improves downstream child health outcomes---there is a lower prevalence of diarrhea and higher vaccination rates. These results highlight that promoting an organization's mission can be a powerful motivator for public workers, especially in weakly institutionalized environments.Chapter 2 asks the question: how can we motivate `good' politicians -- those that will carry out a policy that is responsive to citizens' preferences -- to enter politics? In a field experiment in Pakistan, I vary how political office is portrayed to ordinary citizens. I find that emphasizing pro-social motives for holding political office instead of personal rewards -- such as the ability to help others versus enhancing one's own respect and status -- raises the likelihood that individuals run for office and that voters elect them. Emphasizing pro-social motives also better aligns subsequent policies with citizens' preferences. The candidacy decisions are explained by social influence, and not information salience -- I find that social versus personal messaging matters only when randomly delivered in a public setting but not in private. Results also show that changes in political supply, not citizen preferences or behavior, explain policy alignment. Taken together, the results demonstrate that non-financial motivations for political entry also shape how politicians perform in office. In chapter 3, I focus on understanding what barriers may prevent citizens from becoming politicians. Local governments are said to be susceptible to elite capture in the developing world. Reforms that aim to improve political competition by encouraging non-elite candidates may help reduce elite capture. This chapter reports findings from a randomized control trial that encouraged non-elite candidacy by relaxing three barriers to entry: the cost of running for office, information on benefits from the office, and information on their chances to win the elections. The experiment was conducted before elections for village councils in rural Pakistan and has three primary results. First, it is possible to identify prospective non-elite politicians through the involvement of community members. Second, subsidizing the cost of candidacy, through the provision of services of a lawyer, has a positive effect on the decision of non-elite candidates to enter politics. Third, treatment effects are stronger among candidates who hold higher beliefs about their chance of winning and who expect higher benefits from office.

https://openalex.org/W3193166585.abstractZh: 本论文包含三项关于公共部门人员（包括官僚和政客）的激励与动机的研究。第一章试图探讨公共组织如何增强公共员工的使命动机。第二章和第三章则探讨如何通过激发潜在政客的内在动机或消除阻碍他们成为政客的成本和信息障碍来提升政客的供给。在第一章中，我研究了公共组织是否可以通过强调组织使命来激励员工。我与巴基斯坦卫生部合作开展了一项实地实验，随机向社区卫生工作者强调公共卫生使命，同时提供与绩效挂钩的经济激励，或同时采用这两种方式。结果发现，无论是否给予经济激励，使命激励都能提升员工的表现；而经济激励仅在激励任务中有效。此外，当使命激励与经济激励结合使用时，经济激励在增加家访次数方面的效果反而减弱。最后，使命激励还改善了儿童健康结果——腹泻发病率降低，疫苗接种率提高。这些结果表明，在制度化程度较低的环境中，推动组织的使命可以成为公共工作者的强大动力。第二章则提出了一个问题：如何激励那些能够执行符合公民偏好的政策的“优秀”政客进入政坛？在巴基斯坦的一项实地实验中，我改变了普通公民对政治职位的认知。我发现，强调担任政治职务的亲社会动机，而非个人奖励——比如帮助他人的能力，而不是提升个人的声望和地位——能够增加个人竞选公职的可能性，以及选民选择这些人的可能性。强调亲社会动机还能使后续政策更好地符合公民的偏好。候选人的选择是由社会影响决定的，而不是信息的重要性——我发现，社会信息与个人信息在公共场合传递时才有意义，在私人场合则不然。研究结果还表明，政策一致性的变化是由政治供给的变化所解释的，而不是公民偏好或行为的变化。综合来看，非财务动机对政治参与的影响也决定了政治家在任期间的表现。在第三章中，我重点探讨了可能阻碍公民成为政治家的障碍。在发展中国家，地方政府容易受到精英控制的影响。通过鼓励非精英候选人参与竞争来改善政治竞争的改革，可能有助于减少精英控制。本章报告了一项随机对照试验的结果，该试验通过消除三个进入障碍来促进非精英候选人的参与：竞选成本、关于担任公职的好处信息，以及他们赢得选举的机会信息。这项实验在巴基斯坦农村村议会选举前进行，有三个主要结果。首先，可以通过社区成员的参与来识别潜在的非精英政治家。其次，通过提供律师服务等方式补贴竞选成本，对非精英候选人参与政治的决策有积极影响。第三，那些对自己获胜机会有较高信念且期望从担任公职中获得更高利益的候选人，其治疗效果更为显著。

abstract.text: Direct consumption of economic resources by public sector agencies in producing services is a highly significant part of the GDP of OECD countries; yet, productivity in the public sector is a topic that has been long overlooked by research. This paper synthesises what we know about productivity in the public sector at the subnational level to date. It starts with a brief recap of what public sector productivity is and what is not. The next section considers how the specific functions characteristic of the regional and local public sector condition productivity, and the foundation expectations we can formulate about productivity differences across tiers of government. The paper continues with a summary of single-service studies of sub-national government productivity and the best available ideas for improving the productivity of regional, big city and local governments in ways that may generate more growth in their economies. The final parts of the paper are devoted to the renewed importance of governmental resilience and innovation at regional and local levels and on how more inclusive, balanced or compensating forms of economic development may help in lagging regions, especially in the context of adverse climate change. The conclusions argue that boosting public services productivity can also strengthen sub-national governments’ contribution to regional and local growth, and to alleviating these major new risks and challenges.

https://openalex.org/W3203833929.abstractZh: 公共部门机构在提供服务过程中直接消耗的经济资源，在经合组织国家的GDP中占有相当重要的比例；然而，公共部门的生产力问题长期以来一直被研究所忽视。本文综合了目前我们对次国家级公共部门生产力情况的了解。首先简要回顾了什么是公共部门的生产力，以及什么不是生产力。接下来探讨了区域和地方政府特有的职能如何影响生产力，以及我们可以对各级政府之间生产力差异做出哪些基本预期。随后，本文总结了关于次国家级政府生产力的单一服务研究，以及改善区域、大城市和地方政府生产力的最佳方法，这些方法可能有助于促进这些地区的经济增长。最后，本文强调了政府在区域和地方各级的韧性与创新的重要性，并探讨了更具包容性、平衡性或补偿性的经济发展方式如何帮助落后地区，尤其是在气候变化的背景下。结论认为，提高公共服务的生产力也可以增强次国家级政府对区域和本地经济增长的贡献，从而缓解这些重大风险和挑战。
